**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**
 Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long\-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.
   

  

 With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.
   

  

 Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.
   

  

**About Us**
 Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. (MUFG) is one of the world’s leading financial groups. Headquartered in Tokyo and with over 360 years of history, MUFG has a global network with over 2,100 locations in more than 50 markets. The Group has over 160,000 employees and offers services including commercial banking, trust banking, securities, credit cards, consumer finance, asset management, and leasing.
   

  

 The Group aims to “be the world’s most trusted financial group” through close collaboration among our operating companies and flexibly respond to all of the financial needs of our customers, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world. MUFG’s shares trade on the Tokyo, Nagoya, and New York stock exchanges.
   

  

 MUFG Bank, Ltd. is Japan’s premier bank, with a global network spanning more than 50 markets. Outside of Japan, the bank offers an extensive scope of commercial and investment banking products and services to businesses, governments and individuals worldwide.
   

  

 In Asia, MUFG has a presence across 20 markets – Australia, Bangladesh, Cambodia, China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, India, South Korea, Laos, Malaysia, Mongolia, Myanmar, New Zealand, Pakistan, Philippines, Singapore, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Thailand and Vietnam.
   

  

 It has also formed strategic partnerships with some of the most prominent banks in Southeast Asia, further augmenting its unrivalled network across the region – VietinBank in Vietnam, Krungsri in Thailand, Security Bank in the Philippines and Bank Danamon in Indonesia.
   

  

 For more information, visit https://www.mufg.jp/english
   

  

**MUFG Global Service Private Limited**
 Established in 2020, MUFG Global Service Private Limited (MGS) is 100% subsidiary of MUFG having offices in Bengaluru and Mumbai. MGS India has been set up as a Global Capability Centre / Centre of Excellence to provide support services across various functions such as IT, KYC/ AML, Credit, Operations etc. to MUFG Bank offices globally. MGS India has plans to significantly ramp\-up its growth over the next 18\-24 months while servicing MUFG’s global network across Americas, EMEA and Asia Pacific”.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Position: Know Your Customer \[KYC] Client Outreach Team Leader/Manager**
**Location: Bangalore, India**
**Legal Entity: MUFG Global Service – India**
**The Opportunity**
* The role encompasses several tasks involving KYC analysis across multiple business lines, training the team on KYC and regulatory environment, ensuring AML Regulations, policies/procedures are maintained and adhered,
* Monitoring and reporting performance to the management based on agreed timescales.
* This role also involves liaising with the Clients Business partners as well as colleagues and senior onshore partners thus ensuring timely resolution of queries.


**What You Will Do**
**Client Outreach \& Relationship Management**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Clients regarding KYC and regulatory documentation requirements.
* Manage end\-to\-end Client Outreach activities for New Client Onboarding, Periodic Reviews, Remediation programs and Trigger Events.
* Develop and execute outreach strategies to obtain required documentation within internal/ regulatory timelines.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Clients, Group Relationship Managers, Relationship Managers and Business Stakeholders to facilitate documentation collection.
* Conduct follow\-ups through calls, emails, and meetings to ensure timely submission of outstanding requirements.


**Client Onboarding, KYC Review and Remediation Management**
* Coordinate Client Onboarding, KYC Periodic Reviews and Remediation activities for corporate, institutional, financial institution, and commercial banking clients.
* Review document requirements and communicate clear guidance to Clients.
* Track documentation progress and resolve bottlenecks to prevent SLA breaches.
* Escalate overdue cases and critical issues to appropriate Stakeholders.
* Support Low/ Medium/ High risk Client reviews and Anti\-Money Laundering \[AML] / KYC \- Customer Due Diligence (CDD)/ Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) requirements.


**Regulatory Compliance \& Risk Management**
* Ensure compliance with AML/ KYC \[CDD, EDD, Sanctions, CBDDQ, Beneficial Ownership, etc.] regulations.
* Identify and escalate potential Financial Crime risks and regulatory concerns to the relevant Stakeholders timely.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of Client documentation before submission for KYC production team’s review.
* Support audit, compliance testing, and regulatory examination requests.
* Maintain adherence to internal policies, procedures, and risk frameworks.
* Ensure zero operational / reputational loss.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Partner with Group Relationship Managers, Relationship Managers, Financial Crime Compliance Office, KYC Production and Onshore teams.
* Facilitate regular meetings to discuss aging cases, escalations, and New Client Onboarding, Periodic Review and Remediation progress.
* Communicate status updates and key risks to senior management proactively.
* Support Production team and other Business Units in understanding regulatory requirements and outreach strategies.


**Performance Monitoring \& Reporting**
* Monitor outreach effectiveness and case progression against defined KPIs and SLAs.
* Prepare management reports, dashboards, and metrics on: Documentation completion rates, Outreach success rates, Aging cases, SLA adherence and Escalation trends
* Analyze root causes of delays and recommend corrective actions.


**Process Improvement**
* Identify opportunities to streamline Outreach processes and improve Client experience.
* Support automation initiatives and workflow enhancements.
* Develop best practices and standard operating procedures by liaising with Process Excellence function
* Participate in regulatory change initiatives and implementation projects.


**Team Leadership**
* Provide guidance and mentoring to Outreach Specialists/ Analysts.
* Support training and knowledge sharing initiatives.
* Drive performance management and quality standards within the team.
* Assist in resource planning and workload allocation.


**Requirements**
**What you will need to succeed in the role:**
* 5\-9 years of experience in KYC process, Client Outreach and Anti Money Laundering with proficiency in various entity types (E).
* 3\+ years of team handling experience in leading teams delivering KYC Due Diligence/ Client Outreach for global banks with primary focus on risk\-based approach is preferred (E).
* Experience handling regulatory remediation programs and periodic reviews.
* Prior exposure to global banking environments or similar institutions.
* Experience managing high\-volume client outreach and documentation collection programs.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong knowledge of: AML / KYC –\[CDD (Customer Due Diligence), EDD (Enhanced Due Diligence), Sanctions Compliance, Beneficial Ownership regulations, etc.]
* Understanding of corporate and institutional Client structures.
* Knowledge of Financial Crime Compliance \[FCC] frameworks and regulatory expectations.
* Experience with KYC lifecycle management systems and case management tools.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools.


**Stakeholder Management Skills**
* Ability to engage effectively with clients and senior stakeholders.
* Strong relationship management and influencing skills.
* Ability to handle difficult conversations and negotiate timelines.
* Experience working across global and regional teams.


**Communication Skills**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex regulatory requirements in simple business language.
* Strong presentation and meeting facilitation skills.


**Analytical Skills**
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving capability.
* Ability to assess risks and identify compliance gaps.
* Data analysis and reporting skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple deadlines and competing priorities.


**Project \& Process Management Skills**
* Strong organizational and planning capabilities.
* Experience managing large\-scale remediation projects.
* Ability to monitor KPIs and drive performance improvements.
* Knowledge of workflow management and process optimization techniques.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Customer\-focused mindset.
* Accountability and ownership.
* Strong decision\-making ability.
* Resilience under pressure.
* Collaboration and teamwork.
* Adaptability in a changing regulatory environment.
* Continuous improvement mindset.


**What Additional Skills Are Required**

title: Client Solutions Partner
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
   

  

 If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you\- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
   

  

 We're looking for a brilliant technologist, an excellent communicator, and a strategic partner—to be the technical heart of our AI Go\-To\-Market team. You will be the spark that ignites our customers' imagination, bridging the gap between the art of the possible and transformative, real\-world solutions.
   

  

**What You'll Achieve**
* Architect the Future State: Act as the trusted technical advisor to our most strategic clients, architecting end\-to\-end AI solutions and shaping their long\-term technology roadmap.
* Inspire Action: Translate deep technical concepts into compelling business value, delivering jaw\-dropping presentations and demos to audiences ranging from engineers to CXOs.
* Build and Unblock: Lead and build rapid, hands\-on Proofs\-of\-Concept (especially on Google Cloud) that solve critical problems and dismantle technical blockers, paving the way for large\-scale adoption.
* Drive the Win: Own the entire technical sales cycle—from discovery and qualification to overcoming objections and securing the "technical win" for high\-value enterprise deals.
* Shape Our Strategy: Act as the voice of the customer and the market, channeling your insights to directly influence the evolution of our products, services, and company strategy. Build team strategy with including sales planning


**What You'll Bring**
* Applied AI Mastery: Deep, demonstrable, hands\-on expertise in building and deploying modern AI solutions, with a strong focus on Generative AI (RAG, Agents, LLMs) and Computer Vision.
* Cloud \& Systems Fluency: Expertise of cloud architecture, with a proven track record of designing scalable, production\-grade systems (strong Google Cloud experience is a significant advantage).
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, challenge, and guide customers towards solutions they didn't know were possible.
* Effortless Communication: You are a storyteller who can command a room, build instant credibility, and articulate complex ideas with powerful simplicity.
* Proven GTM Experience: A significant track record of success in a senior, customer\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Principal Sales Engineer, or Technical Evangelist.
* Be a Force Multiplier: Mentor and elevate our exceptional team of young AI talent, fostering a culture of curiosity and collaboration by being a leader who actively listens, learns, and guides.


**Additional Skills Required**
 You would be involved in the development of new business opportunities and value\-added services which requires a high level of creativity, learning potential and deep quantitative subject matter expertise and therefore self\-driven individuals willing to learn on the go would be preferred.
   

  

* Knowledge and willingness to learn and apply emerging trends in business research, data science, Machine learning Artificial Intelligence, Cloud
* Strong exposure of cloud technologies like GCP, AWS, Azure etc
* Excellent communication, articulation, abstraction, analytical and presentation skills
* Executive demeanor and experience working with senior client executives
* Ability to work with minimal supervision in a dynamic and time sensitive work environment
* Excellent aptitude in business analysis and awareness of quantitative analysis techniques
* Self\-driven and strong aptitude to work in an entrepreneurial , fast\-paced environment with minimal supervision and a passion for developing new value\-added AI based solutions for clients across a variety of industries


*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*

 Join the team that brought you the Echo Show, a touch\-screen enabled Alexa device that supports video calling, music, weather, and more! Our team also works on other high\-profile consumer electronics products including Fire TV, Kindle, and the Echo family of devices.
   

  

 We are looking for talented and motivated embedded software development engineer to join the team, innovate and build next generation Amazon Echo devices that deliver intuitive and intelligent voice assistant to millions of customers with many exciting features!

* Be responsible for system architecture and development of new features for embedded systems
* Investigate, prototype and deliver new and innovative system solutions
* Profile, Analyze and optimize system level performance
* Design, develop and verify firmware for embedded systems
* Participate in design reviews, API development, and documentation

* Coordinate with operations and support teams to incorporate feedback from production incidents and enhancement requests into the structured demand pipeline in order to improve stability and user satisfaction.

 Shift: Night Shift (Fixed) Experience: Minimum 5 to 6 years of experience as a Manager handling both Email Support and Call Center Operations 
 Job Purpose 
 We are looking for a high-performing Manager to oversee our end-to-end Customer Care operations (Voice & Email channels). You will be responsible for driving daily operational excellence, ensuring strict SLA/TAT compliance, structuring operational workflows, and managing team performance during night hours. The ideal candidate has direct experience scaling processes, standardizing SOPs, and keeping customer satisfaction high while managing nocturnal team dynamics. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Performance Metrics

 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Process Setup & Operational Structuring Establish, standardize, and optimize daily operational processes for both Email Customer Care and Inbound/Outbound Call Center operations. Design robust Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), templates, and escalation protocols tailored to night shift demands. Drive continuous process improvement to eliminate workflow bottlenecks and improve first-contact resolution (FCR). 2. TAT & SLA Management Monitor and enforce target Turnaround Times (TAT) for email queues and key Call Center metrics (ASA, AHT, Service Level, Abandonment Rate). Implement live real-time queue monitoring systems to prevent backlog build-up and maintain performance during peak night traffic. Analyze performance gaps, identify root causes for SLA breaches, and execute immediate corrective action plans. 3. Team Leadership & People Management Directly manage, lead, and mentor Team Leaders, Quality Analysts, and Customer Support Agents working on the night shift. Conduct regular 1-on-1 performance reviews, team huddles, and performance coaching sessions. Drive employee engagement and retention strategies specific to night shift employees to minimize burnout and attrition. 4. Quality, Reporting & Governance Collaborate with the QA team to establish quality benchmarks and monitor interaction standards across both email and call interactions. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports (TAT reports, CSAT/DSAT, call volume trends, agent productivity) for senior leadership. Act as the primary point of contact during night hours for critical production issues, technical escalations, or emergency situations.

title: Customer support travel specialist
description:
Customer support travel specialist 
Our philosophy for customer service is simple: Listen to the customer. Understand their needs. Take ownership. Solve the problem. When a customer contacts Miraee, you take the responsibility till the need is addressed or the issue is solved. You will own urgent disruptions, complex multi-leg trips, VIP requests, and edge cases the AI agents couldn't resolve. Our customers include CEOs, CFOs, senior executives, executive assistants, and frequent business travelers with urgent and complex travel needs. 
 You will own four KPIs: First-Response Time (FRT) Resolution Time Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) Ownership Rate End-to-End Issue Resolution 
 What you will do Handle flight changes, cancellations, rebooking, delays, missed connections, and other travel disruptions especially last-minute and complex requests. Book domestic and international flights, hotels, car rentals, rail, airport transfers, and ground transportation when the frequent travelers are in need. Flag recurring pain points and agent failure patterns to Product and Engineering so the AI improves - you are a key input to our product feedback loop. Support travelers with check-in, seat and upgrade requests, and hotel needs such as early check-in and late checkout. Assist with restaurant bookings, private dinners, meetings, conferences, and other business travel needs. Understand the traveler's schedule and recommend the best available option. Work directly with airlines, hotels, and travel partners to resolve customer issues. Support customers across phone, chat, email, and messaging; keep them updated until the issue is fully resolved. Escalate account-level or program-level issues to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager; you own the traveler, they own the account. 
 Experience needed 3 - 5 years in corporate travel, business travel, airline ticketing, travel agency, or travel customer support. Hands-on experience with at least one GDS: Sabre, Amadeus, Apollo, Galileo, or Travelport. Experience handling US domestic and international travel. Experience supporting business travelers, senior executives, VIPs, or frequent travelers. Strong understanding of flight bookings, changes, cancellations, exchanges, refunds, and fare rules. Experience handling travel disruptions and last-minute changes. Prior experience at a corporate travel desk or travel management company preferred. 
 Skills we value Excellent spoken and written English. Strong attention to detail. Sound problem-solving and decision-making. Comfortable with demanding travelers with complex needs. Able to manage multiple customer requests simultaneously. Takes ownership instead of passing problems along. Comfortable with travel technology and quick to learn new systems including working alongside AI agents.

description:
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
Purpose of your Role:


The broad objective of this role is to drive Customer Success through revenue growth, contract renewals, churn mitigation, timely SDWIP closure, Cross\-sale/Up\-sale and driving adoption and consumption of usage\-based services and provide life\-cycle support to clients finally resulting into achieving Revenue AOP and NPS Targets.  



  

Grows the revenue from the assigned account/s through:


* Build and execute revenue growth plan in allocated accounts.
* Churn mitigation using cross sell or upsell during renewals maintaining a "farming" mindset to CSM. ("Farming" term is used in the context of performance analysis linked upgradation, cross\-sales \& up\-sales of the contracted services).
* Drive accelerated conversion of Service Delivery funnel into realizable revenue.
* Drive consumption of usage\-based services to expand revenue, through effective boarding, adoption, and expansion of services.
* Ensures quality 360\-degree life cycle management of the customer account, ensuring meeting / exceeding the NPS threshold for the territory and all other contractual obligations.
* Nurturing and retaining the customer, voice of the customer analysis, reference programs and Service reviews.
Develops deep relationships within the customer senior management (C\-Level) account across functions create greater value for TCL services thereby enhancing customer lifetime value.  
* 

  

Key Responsibilities:


* CSM is expected to meet Account Contracted Gross Revenue Targets. Contracted Gross Revenue is defined by the following 4 areas.
* Baseline Revenue as FY start.
* SDWIP Acceleration.
* Usage services adoption and growth \- revenue target.
Managing AOP for Price erosion, terminations, Service credits, aged debt.  
* 

  

Contact / Customer Onboarding


* Own the customer contract/project onboarding process and drive alignment between Sales, Solutions, Program Management, and key customer stakeholders who are responsible for buying, designing, delivering, and consuming TCL services.
* Internal Kick\-off call \& handover from Sales to Delivery Program Management.
* Agree with the customer on an approach to Time to Value with customer and internal teams.
* Introduce relevant customer stakeholders to Tata Communications People, Processes \& tools and make it easier for them to do business with us.
* Define Customer Engagement Model along with the customer (Time based, Value\-based, Event\-Based).
* SDWIP funnel management to accelerate implementation for faster revenue realization by clearing the internal and external dependencies.
* Govern on\-hold decision at entry and reduce cancellations.
* Service Adoption \& revenue enhancement.
* Ensuring timely activation and service acceptance.
* Services which are usage based and require end user deployment or migration of traffic such as GSIP are to be monitored and tracked effortlessly to ensure order aspirations are reached.
* For usage\-based services like UCAAS, analyze customers’ usage to help identify areas for adoption and enhancement.
* Identify training needs for end users and if identified, orchestrate this with a product or other functions.
* For network services, understand current network usage and establish predictive capacity and trending.
Drive adoption on customer self\-service portal (Optimus/TCX)  
* 

  

Nurture and Retain


* Monitor performance \& customer health signals \& proactively mitigate any pain points.

 Feedback loop

 What we're looking for
 



  





 2\+ years in a customer success, account management, onboarding, or SaaS support role — ideally with SMB or professional services customers, and ideally serving international (AU, UK, or US) clients.
 



  





 Exceptional spoken and written English — clear, warm, professional, with a neutral accent that Australian customers find easy to follow.
 



  





 An outstanding communicator who can hold a room on a demo, defuse a frustrated email, and translate technical detail into plain language for a non\-technical audience.
 



  





 A natural ability to connect with people — you build rapport quickly, listen more than you talk, and customers genuinely enjoy hearing from you. This is the difference between a good CSR and a great one, and we hire hard for it.
 



  





 Comfortable running demos and speaking with confidence to firm owners, partners, and operations managers on the other side of the world.
 



  





 Confident using Microsoft 365 day to day — Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.
 



  





 Strong understanding of how an accounting, bookkeeping, or advisory firm actually operates day to day (or the curiosity and aptitude to learn fast).
 



  





 Genuinely technical enough to configure a modern SaaS platform: integrations, permissions, automations, data imports.
 



  





 Organised and self\-directed; comfortable owning a customer portfolio without hand\-holding.
 



  





 Willing and able to work Sydney business hours from Gurugram, five days a week, with a reliable early\-morning start. This isn't a rotational shift — it's a consistent schedule.
 



  





 Based in Gurugram or able to relocate; comfortable working from our office.
 



  





 Nice to have
 



  





 Prior experience serving Australian customers, or working on Australian time zones.
 



  





 Experience with practice management, workflow, or CRM platforms (Karbon, Ignition, XPM, FYI, Xero Practice Manager, Canopy, etc.).
 



  





 Background working in or with an accounting or bookkeeping firm.
 



  





 Experience contributing to help centres, onboarding playbooks, or product training material.
 



  





 Why Portal 360
 



  





 Ground\-floor role in a fast\-growing Australian SaaS company with a clear market and real customers.
 



  





 Direct access to the founder and product team — your feedback shapes what gets built.
 



  





 Genuine ownership of the customer experience end to end, not a narrow slice of it.
 



  





 Part of a broader group of companies (with operations across Sydney and Gurugram) and real room to grow your career.

title: Manager - Customer Success
description:

**Company:** 
 Sushine Exports Private Limited (factori.com)

 Headquarters at Bannerughatta, Bengaluru (on\-site, full\-time)

 Founder \& CEO

 2

 4–8 years across digital marketing, e\-commerce, or business consulting/training.

 Up to ₹8 LPA, based on qualifications, experience, and current CTC.
 



  




 About factori.com
 
 Welcome to
 **factori.com — The Factory for the World.** 




 factori.com is a global manufacturing and commerce platform that connects
 **500\+ partner manufacturers across India** 
 with business buyers, brands, institutions, and entrepreneurs worldwide. Our vision is to onboard
 **100,000\+ manufacturers globally by 2030\.** 




 One of our three core offerings is
 **retailing.factori.com** 
 — a plug\-and\-play platform that lets any entrepreneur launch their own e\-commerce store in 30 minutes, on their own domain, with instant access to thousands of ready\-to\-ship products. Thousands of retailers are already live on it — and our goal is to make every one of them successful.
 



  




 About the role
 
 Thousands of entrepreneurs — homemakers, students, first\-time founders, side\-hustlers — have launched their own online stores on retailing.factori.com. What most of them need next isn't more features. It's someone who teaches them how to sell.
 



 That's this role. You'll be the growth teacher and business consultant for our active retailer community — running high\-quality webinars week after week, and helping retailers turn their stores into real, growing businesses. Your success is measured in one place:
 **the sales growth of the retailers you coach.** 




  




 What you'll own1\. Webinars — your main stage
 * Design and run a regular calendar of webinars for active retailers on: digital marketing, social media marketing, performance marketing, community marketing, and running an e\-commerce business.
* Make them practical — every session ends with steps a retailer can execute on their store the same day.


 2\. Business consulting for retailers
 * Go beyond broadcast: consult with retailers on their specific store, category, pricing, and promotion challenges.
* Diagnose why a store isn't selling and prescribe the fix — traffic, catalogue, pricing, promotion, or persistence.


 3\. Driving retailer sales
 * Own the number that matters: more orders per active retailer, month on month.
* Track which retailers attend, what they implement, and what moved — double down on what works.


 4\. Content that compounds
 * Turn your best sessions into repeatable playbooks, guides, and recorded content the whole retailer base can use.



  




 What we're looking forMust\-have
 * **Hands\-on digital marketing depth** 
 — you've actually run social media, performance, or e\-commerce campaigns, not just talked about them.
* **A natural teacher and presenter** 
 — you can hold an audience on a live webinar, explain marketing to a first\-time entrepreneur in plain language, and enjoy doing it.
* **Business consulting instinct** 
 — you can look at a small online store and quickly see what's blocking its sales.
* **Comfort with scale and repetition** 
 — multiple sessions a week, every week, at a consistently high standard.
* Fluent English; Hindi and/or Kannada a strong advantage for our retailer base.


 Nice\-to\-have
 * Experience training, coaching, or consulting for SMEs, D2C brands, or seller communities (e.g., marketplace seller\-education teams, agency training roles, ed\-tech instruction).
* Your own content presence — a channel, page, or community you've grown.
* Familiarity with e\-commerce storefront tools, SEO basics, and WhatsApp\-led selling.


 What you get
 * **Up to ₹8 LPA** 
 CTC, basis qualifications, experience and current CTC.
* **Reports directly to the Founder \& CEO** 
 — this is a flagship initiative, not a side project.
* A live audience of thousands of retailers from day one — your teaching shows up in real businesses growing.
* Full ownership of the webinar and retailer\-education engine at a fast\-scaling platform.

title: Client Success Executive
description:
Esthète Creations is a creative branding and digital marketing agency focused on building impactful brand experiences through strategy, design, content, performance marketing, and digital execution.

We work with brands across education, healthcare, fashion, study abroad, and other growth\-focused industries.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and professionally driven **Client Success Manager** to take ownership of client relationships and ensure the successful execution of their marketing activities.

The role involves understanding client objectives, coordinating with internal creative and marketing teams, managing timelines and deliverables, handling communication and approvals, and ensuring that clients receive consistent value from our services.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working between **clients, strategy, creativity, and execution**.

Key ResponsibilitiesClient Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Build and maintain strong, professional relationships with clients.
* Understand client business objectives, requirements, expectations, and challenges.
* Maintain regular communication and ensure clients are updated on project progress.
* Handle client feedback, concerns, revisions, and escalations professionally.
* Conduct client meetings and discussions whenever required.

Account \& Campaign Management

* Take ownership of assigned client accounts from planning to execution.
* Coordinate monthly content calendars, campaigns, social media activities, and marketing initiatives.
* Understand campaign objectives and ensure the internal team is aligned with them.
* Track account\-level deliverables, timelines, approvals, and dependencies.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines and quality expectations.
* Proactively identify delays, gaps, or potential issues and resolve them before they affect delivery.

Internal Team Coordination

* Coordinate with designers, content creators, video editors, performance marketers, developers, and other internal teams.
* Convert client requirements into clear and actionable briefs.
* Ensure internal teams have the required information, references, timelines, and priorities.
* Follow up on tasks and maintain execution discipline.
* Review work before it reaches the client to ensure it meets the brief and expected standards.
* Coordinate revisions and ensure feedback is implemented accurately.

Strategy \& Creative Coordination

* Understand the client's brand, target audience, positioning, and marketing objectives.
* Participate in campaign brainstorming and contribute relevant ideas.
* Work with the creative and strategy teams to develop campaign concepts and content directions.
* Present creative ideas, campaign proposals, and marketing plans to clients when required.
* Identify opportunities to improve the client's digital presence and marketing performance.

Client Retention \& Growth

* Monitor client satisfaction and proactively address concerns.
* Build long\-term relationships with assigned accounts.
* Identify opportunities for additional services based on client requirements.
* Support account growth through cross\-selling and upselling relevant agency services.
* Understand client performance and communicate meaningful opportunities for improvement.
* Contribute towards client retention and long\-term account value.

Reporting \& Documentation

* Maintain proper records of client communication, requirements, approvals, and deliverables.
* Coordinate monthly reports and performance discussions with relevant teams.
* Track pending approvals, payments, deliverables, and other account\-level requirements.
* Maintain updated account information and project status.

What We’re Looking For

* 2–4 years of experience in **client servicing, account management, digital marketing, advertising, social media, or a creative agency**.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong client relationship and people\-management skills.
* Good understanding of digital marketing and social media.
* Understanding of content creation, branding, design, video, and paid advertising workflows.
* Strong project coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously.
* Good presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned accounts.
* Proactive attitude with strong attention to detail.

Good to Have

* Experience working in a creative/digital marketing agency.
* Experience managing multiple brand accounts.
* Knowledge of Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Understanding of social media analytics and campaign performance.
* Experience preparing or presenting marketing strategies.
* Familiarity with project management and communication tools.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Analyst, Business Operations
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Associate, Customer Success Partner to support day\-to\-day merchant operations and deliver outstanding customer experience. The ideal candidate will assist in resolving merchant queries, ensuring smooth transaction flows, and coordinating with cross\-functional teams for timely issue resolution. A basic understanding of payment methods and reconciliation processes will be an added advantage. This role is a great opportunity for someone who is eager to learn and grow in the fintech/customer success space.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Ownership of Merchant Issues:
+ Handle complex or high\-value merchant concerns, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolution with minimal follow\-ups.

* Escalation Management:
+ Take ownership of L2/L3 escalations, coordinate with cross\-functional teams (Product, Risk, Tech, FinOps), and ensure root cause identification and resolution.

* Workflow Optimization \& SOP Design:
+ Identify gaps in current processes and contribute to the creation or improvement of SOPs to enhance resolution efficiency and merchant experience.

* Merchant Communication \& Stakeholder Alignment:
+ Maintain clear and professional communication with merchants and internal stakeholders to keep all parties informed on resolution progress.

* Operational Reporting \& Metrics Tracking:
+ Track SLAs, TATs, and resolution quality metrics; generate reports for leadership to monitor performance and identify bottlenecks.

* Mentorship \& Peer Support:
+ Guide and mentor junior associates, conduct case reviews, and ensure adherence to quality and tone standards.

* Special Projects \& Initiatives:
+ Lead or contribute to strategic projects such as refund pattern analysis, feature enablement audits, or new payment flow adoption.

* Product Feedback Loop:
+ Identify and relay recurring merchant feedback or product issues to the product/tech teams for prioritization.

* Audit Readiness \& Compliance:
+ Ensure all customer interactions, tickets, and resolutions are properly documented to support internal or regulatory audits.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Education : Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, or a related field.
* Experience : Minimum 2–3 years of experience in customer service, operations, or a similar domain.
* Knowledge of Payment Ecosystem : Familiarity with UPI, Net Banking, Card Payments, eNACH, settlement processes, and refund mechanisms.

title: Category Lead, Sports
description:
**Who we are** 




 Openhouse is building a new\-age learning ecosystem for children, bringing high\-quality
 



 learning experiences across academics, sports and extracurriculars closer to where children live.
 



 Backed by leading investors including Accel, Matrix Partners and GSV, Openhouse has grown to
 



 12 learning centres across Bangalore, reaching 10,000\+ children through our centres and
 



 programs. We are now taking this experience beyond our centres and into the communities
 



 where families live.
 



  





 Over the last three months, we have already gone live in 12\+ apartments, bringing Openhouse's
 



 learning experiences directly into residential communities. This is just the beginning. Our
 



 ambition is to build a significant At Apartment and At Home presence across Bangalore, making
 



 high\-quality learning accessible without children having to travel across the city.
 



  





**Why sports?** 




  





**Sports will be one of the strongest pillars of this expansion.** 




  





 Apartments already have something that makes sports uniquely powerful — children, facilities and
 



 communities in one place. Whether it is a badminton court, football ground, swimming pool,
 



 skating area or multipurpose space, there is an opportunity to turn existing community
 



 infrastructure into a vibrant sporting ecosystem for children.
 



  





 But great sports programs need more than just a facility. They need great coaches, strong
 



 academies, consistent operations and, importantly, opportunities for children to compete and
 



 progress.
 



  





  





**That's where openhouse comes in.** 




  





 We want to build a sports network where a child can discover a sport, find a great coach, train
 



 consistently, participate in competitions and progress — all within or close to their own
 



 community.
 



  





**about the role Preschool \& Extracurriculars** 




 We are looking for a Sports Category Manager who can build this ecosystem from the ground up.
 



 This is not a conventional vendor\-management or operations role. You will be responsible for
 



 building the supply side of Openhouse Sports — creating relationships with individual coaches
 



 and academies, identifying and onboarding great talent, and building a network that allows us to
 



 launch sports programs rapidly across apartments.
 



  





  





 There will be three key ways in which we build our sports network:
 



  





**1\. Build the supply ourselves** 




 Where an apartment has a sports facility but no coach, identify the requirement, find the right
 



 coach and deploy them.
 



  





  





**2\. Partner with individual coaches** 




 Identify talented coaches who are currently teaching independently but may be looking for a
 



 better professional opportunity. Give them access to multiple apartments and take away the
 



 operational workload, allowing them to focus on what they do best — coaching children.
 



  





  





**3\. Partner with established academies** 




 Work with existing cricket, football, badminton, swimming, skating, karate and other sports
 



 academies to bring their best coaches into Openhouse communities. In return, help these
 



 academies expand their footprint across Bangalore without disrupting their existing coach\-
 



 student ecosystem.
 



  





  





 Alongside this, you will help build an Openhouse sports competition ecosystem — inter\-
 



 apartment tournaments, leagues and events that give children opportunities to compete, create
 



 stronger community engagement and make sports a long\-term habit.
 



  





**what you will own Preschool \& Extracurriculars** 



* Build a strong network of individual coaches across major sports.
* Identify and establish partnerships with leading sports academies across Bangalore.
* Build a ready\-to\-deploy pool of coaches for new apartment launches.
* Own coach identification, evaluation and onboarding.
* Work with existing apartment coaches and explore opportunities to bring them into the



 Openhouse ecosystem.
 


* Map apartment facilities and requirements to the right coaches/academies.
* Build and manage long\-term relationships with coaches and academy partners.
* Work with the broader Openhouse team to launch sports programs across apartments.
* Track coach quality, parent feedback, attendance and retention.
* Build a calendar of tournaments, leagues and inter\-apartment competitions.
* Develop relationships with sports communities, clubs, tournament organisers and other



 relevant ecosystem players.
 


* Work with the marketing team to leverage competitions and sporting events for community



 engagement and brand visibility.
 



  





**who we’re looking for** 



* 3–5\+ years of experience in sports management, sports operations, academy management,



 coaching networks or a similar role.
 


* Strong understanding of the Bangalore sports ecosystem.
* Existing relationships with coaches, academies, clubs, sporting organisations or tournament



 organisers will be a significant advantage.
 


* Ideally, someone with a strong sports background who understands coaching, coaches and



 the sporting ecosystem.
 


* Exposure to multiple sports — cricket, football, badminton, swimming, skating, karate, tennis,



 squash etc.
 


* Strong relationship\-building and negotiation skills.
* Someone who is comfortable getting out of the office, meeting coaches and academy owners



 and building relationships on the ground.
 


* Strong execution orientation and an entrepreneurial mindset.
* Experience organising tournaments, leagues, competitions or sports events is highly desirable.



  





**Bangalore\-based** 
 with a strong local network.
 



  





**Success Metrics** 



* Your success will not simply be measured by the number of coaches onboarded.
* We want you to build the foundation of a
 **scalable Openhouse Sports ecosystem:**



**Great coaches → Great programs → More apartments → More children playing → More** 




**competitions → Stronger retention.** 



* Over the first 6–12 months, you should help us build a strong coach and academy network



 across Bangalore, enable rapid sports launches across apartments and establish competitions
 



 as a core part of the Openhouse sports experience.
 


* Ultimately, the ambition is simple: Make openhouse the most trusted sports partner for



 children and families living in communities across Bangalore.
 



  





**the practical bits** 



* Location: Bangalore
* Experience: 3\-5\+ years
* Function: Category Lead, Sports
* Reporting to: Head of Business \& Revenue

* **First Working Day:** Once the offer is accepted, we’ll welcome you on your first day!

 **About Nespresso:**  

The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.  

Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee.

*We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.*

description:

Cat Digital seeks a seasoned **Senior Software Engineering Manager** to lead the **Helios Platform Services India Team**, building and scaling core platform capabilities that power Caterpillar’s digital ecosystem.



This senior leadership role combines **people leadership, technical direction, and product strategy**. You will drive delivery and evolution of **enterprise\-grade capabilities** that help product teams move faster through reusable, secure, and scalable services.



You will partner with global engineering, product, architecture, and business leaders to accelerate **Helios adoption** and strengthen a **reusable, API\-driven engineering culture**.


### **Key Responsibilities**


### **Engineering Leadership and Delivery**


* Lead multiple teams delivering **domain and core services** on Helios, Caterpillar’s largest data platform.
* Drive end\-to\-end delivery across design, development, deployment, and operations.
* Ensure platform services meet **enterprise\-grade standards** for scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Own delivery commitments, roadmaps, and execution for the India\-based teams.

### **Platform Strategy and Architecture**


* Partner with product, architecture, and principal engineering leaders to define the **Helios roadmap**.
* Drive adoption of **cloud\-native architecture patterns**, including microservices, APIs, and event\-driven systems.
* Ensure services are built as **reusable, standardized components** aligned with design principles.
* Align platform services with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance requirements.

### **People Leadership and Organization Building**


* Build, mentor, and scale high\-performing teams, including **engineering managers and senior engineers**.
* Build a strong leadership bench and succession pipeline.
* Lead hiring, talent development, and performance management in line with Cat Digital standards.
* Foster a culture of **ownership, accountability, and engineering excellence**.

### **Operational Excellence and Quality**


* Own platform reliability, availability, and operational health, including SLA/SLO adherence, observability, and incident management.
* Drive adoption of **DevOps, CI/CD, and automated quality practices**, including TDD and BDD.
* Institutionalize **metrics\-driven engineering** across quality, velocity, stability, and customer impact.

### **Platform Adoption and Stakeholder Management**


* Partner with product teams to accelerate onboarding and adoption.
* Partner with global stakeholders to prioritize platform investments and resolve cross\-team dependencies.
* Act as a key bridge between India engineering teams and global Helios leadership.

### **Innovation and Continuous Improvement**


* Drive innovation in platform capabilities, including **automation, AI enablement, and developer experience improvements**.
* Identify opportunities to modernize legacy systems and improve operational efficiency.
* Champion a **product mindset**, with APIs treated as products and services owned across their lifecycle.

### **Required Qualifications**


* 18\&\#43; years of experience in **software engineering** with significant exposure to platform or enterprise\-scale systems
* 8\&\#43; years in **engineering leadership roles** managing multiple teams and managers
* Strong experience building and operating **cloud\-native platforms (AWS)**
* Proven track record delivering **shared services and platform services** used by multiple products
* Deep understanding of **Java, Spring Boot**, microservices, APIs, distributed systems, DevOps, CI/CD, and automation.
* Experience leading **large\-scale, globally distributed teams**.
* Strong understanding of **AI models** and their use in improving developer and business outcomes.
* Ability to normalize and contextualize data from diverse sources for real\-time decision\-making.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive cross\-functional alignment.
* Demonstrated ability to define platform strategy, guide architectural decisions, and align engineering execution with business goals.
* Strong organizational design and talent development skills, including hiring, mentoring, and performance management.

### **What You Will Bring**


* Strong **strategic thinking** with a bias for execution.
* Ability to operate at both the **system** and **organizational** levels.
* A **platform\-first mindset** centered on reuse, consistency, and developer experience.
* Executive presence and the ability to influence across functions.
* Passion for building teams, leaders, and long\-term engineering capability in India

### **Success Measures**


* Increase adoption and usage across products.
* Improve platform reliability, scalability, and developer experience.
* Build a strong engineering culture and leadership pipeline.
* Deliver the platform roadmap and business outcomes predictably.

### **Why This Role Matters**



Helios is the **foundation of Caterpillar’s digital ecosystem**, enabling reusable services, cross\-product integration, and enterprise\-scale innovation. This role is central to scaling the India team into a strategic execution engine for global priorities.



This position requires working onsite five days a week.



Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.


**Posting Dates:**



September 3, 2026 \- September 13, 2026



Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------


Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life\-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.


The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. **Success Profile**
-------------------


Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth\-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.


### **Tech innovators**


Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.


### **Ownership takers**


If you're a self\-aware self\-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.


### **Challenge seekers**


Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.


### **Proactive collaborators**


Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-259609 **Date posted** 09/08/2026
**GCL: D2Introduction to role:**
--------------------------------


Are you ready to turn complex, cross\-functional processes into streamlined, scalable solutions that free our business to focus on delivering life\-changing medicines? In this permanent role based in Chennai, you will shape an impactful pipeline of process re\-engineering initiatives that unlock measurable value. You will work at the intersection of operations, data, and technology, helping teams simplify how work gets done and driving faster improvements for patients and customers!


You will partner closely with leaders across functions, applying process mining, automation, and low\-code platforms as tools to diagnose difficulties and implement pragmatic improvements. By building trusted relationships and challenging the status quo, you will translate business challenges into practical solutions that deliver at pace. Can you see yourself leading end\-to\-end simplification efforts and bringing clarity to complex operating environments?


**Accountabilities:**
---------------------


Collaborator Partnership: Build positive relationships with senior and operational partners, acting as a trusted thought partner who challenges current methods and aligns teams around clear improvement goals.


Opportunity Shaping: Generate, assess, and prioritise a pipeline of process optimisation and analytics opportunities across diverse customer groups, ensuring focus on initiatives with the highest business impact.


End\-to\-End Re\-engineering: Lead discovery, diagnosis, and redesign of complex, multi\-function processes, applying Lean and Six Sigma methods to simplify workflows and improve outcomes.


Automation and Process Mining Assessment: Evaluate and define the scope for automation and process mining, selecting appropriate technologies such as AI, intelligent automation, RPA, and low\-code platforms to solve real business problems.


Case and Value Realisation: Quantify benefits, costs, and risks; build robust cases; and ensure benefits are tracked, reported, and sustained post\-implementation.

Standards and Compliance: Apply BPMN 2\.0 for process mapping; ensure solutions follow internal standards, governance, and ethical practices while supporting virtual, global collaboration.


Ways of Working: Contribute to an energised, in\-person culture by engaging on site on average at least three days per week, employing face\-to\-face collaboration to accelerate decisions and outcomes.


**Essential Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------


* Six Sigma or Lean Management Green Belt certified alongside validated experience in the analysis \& re\-design of complex, multi\-function business processes
* Proven background in delivering end\-to\-end process re\-engineering, optimisation and automation projects, with measurable business outcomes.
* Hands\-on experience assessing use cases for automation solutions using technologies such as AI, intelligent automation, RPA, Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, workflow and low\-code platforms.
* Consulting experience that goes beyond operational delivery, acting as a trusted thought partner to business leaders by, challenging existing ways of working, translating business challenges into practical AI/Automation opportunities that deliver measurable business value
* Demonstrated experience in leading medium to large profile projects/ organisational change activities
* Facilitating process discovery workshops across various stakeholder levels
* Hands\-on Process Mapping experience (no specific tool) using BPMN 2\.0
* Experience in improving service processes going through different functions across organization
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing \& presentation/ oral communication skills
* Energetic and self\-motivated
* Strong analytical skills to be able to discover and interpret business requirements
* Critical thinking skills enabling challenging process findings and solutions
* Strong time management skills with ability to work at pace, handling multiple tasks \& projects at one time
* Comfortable with working virtually in a global environment
* Willingness to undertake some domestic/ international travel (as required)
* Fluency in English

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**


* Experience in participating in service transition projects
* Significant experience with various related BPM capabilities i.e. AI, Process/Task Mining, Robotics Process Automation, Low Code automation, BPM, workflow tools.
* Experience and proven results in change implementation projects within the Pharma industry
* Experience in working in Agile methodology
* Experience in working with Business Information Centre tool by GBTEC
* Experience in working globally

**Why AstraZeneca:**
--------------------


Join a high\-performing, digitally savvy team where ambitious thinking is encouraged and supported. We bring unexpected teams into the same room to fuel bold ideas, use ground breaking technologies to modernise how work happens, and connect daily effort to real outcomes for patients. Here, you will influence how a global enterprise operates, run fast on agile projects, and take balanced risks with the backing of collaborative colleagues. We value patience alongside ambition, pairing curiosity with rigor so that smart ideas turn into scalable, ethical solutions that move the business forward.

title: Senior Manager, Technical Services
description:
**Description**


**Who is USP?**


The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.


At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.


USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.


**Brief Job Overview**


The Sr. Manager, Technical Services Support (India) is a strategic people leadership role responsible for overseeing the India\-based Technical Services team and supporting the continued growth and evolution of USP's global Technical Services function. This position plays a critical role in ensuring the delivery of high\-quality scientific product/service inquiry support, operational excellence, and an exceptional customer experience while fostering a high\-performing, customer\-centric culture.


The role operates within a matrixed leadership structure, functionally reporting to the Senior Director, Customer Success \& Operations (US\-based) and administratively reporting to the Director, Scientific Affairs (India\-based). The incumbent will provide direct people leadership and administrative oversight for the India\-based Technical Services team while partnering closely with the US\-based Senior Manager, Technical Services Operations, who provides functional direction related to service delivery processes, performance standards, and inquiry management activities.


As USP continues to expand its global service delivery capabilities, this role is expected to evolve in scope and strategic impact, contributing to organizational scaling efforts, talent development, operational excellence initiatives, knowledge management, process optimization, workforce planning, and the advancement of global scientific and product/service support capabilities.


The Sr. Manager will collaborate extensively with stakeholders across Customer Success \& Operations, Strategic Customer Development, Scientific Affairs, Quality Assurance, Customer Service, Reference Material Support, Reference Standards Technical Operations, Reference Standards Production, Distribution, Reference Standards Evaluation, Legal, Documentary Standards and Compendial Policy, Global Biologics, and other cross\-functional teams located in both the United States and India.


The primary working shift for this position is 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST.


**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**


As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.


Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.


The Sr. Manager, Technical Services Support role has the following responsibilities:


**Key Responsibilities**


**People Leadership \& Team Management**


* Provide leadership, guidance, direction, and administrative oversight to the India\-based Technical Services team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer\-centricity.
* Integrate employee engagement principles into daily leadership practices to cultivate a high\-performing, motivated, and inclusive team environment, led by example through visible leadership and active coaching.
* Manage all aspects of employee performance, including goal setting, communicating job expectations, performance evaluations, coaching, mentoring, career development, recognition, corrective action, and succession planning.
* Partner with the Customer Success and Operations leadership team to support workforce planning, talent acquisition, onboarding, employee retention, and capability development initiatives as the Technical Services organization continues to evolve and expand.
* Ensure team members have access to the appropriate resources, tools, training, and support required to effectively perform their responsibilities.

**Service Delivery \& Operational Excellence**


* Partner closely with the Senior Manager, Technical Services Operations, who provides the functional strategy and strategic direction for the Global Technical Services, to effectively execute and operationalize the Technical Services operating model within India.
* Translate established strategies, processes, policies, procedures, training programs, and service delivery standards into consistent day\-to\-day execution, ensuring high\-quality, efficient, and scalable service delivery.

**Job Title**

**Management Level**

 Bangalore,Gurgaon,Mumbai,Pune,Hyderabad,Chennai
   

  

**Must Have Skills**
 Process Excellence, Process Re\-engineering, Customer Service Transformation, Lean Six Sigma
   

  

**Good To Have Skills**
 Customer Experience Design, AI\-enabled Process Design, Process Mining, CCaaS, CRM, Operating Model Design
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Process and Customer Experience Manager, you will lead end\-to\-end process and service transformation programs, from assessing market, customer, and technology shifts through defining future\-state process and service strategies and enabling adoption. You will combine process re\-engineering and Lean Six Sigma rigour with customer experience design to diagnose service friction, quantify its impact, and design practical future\-state processes, operating models, technology enablement, and AI integration. You will lead teams and engage senior client stakeholders to deliver measurable business and customer outcomes.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Embed AI into future\-state client design and team ways of working by using appropriate AI tools and strategically creating agents to support deliverable development.
* Lead future\-state process specification, AI integration design, operating model changes, and adoption planning for clients.
* Lead large\-scale process re\-engineering and service transformation programs from conception through implementation, with ownership of scope, approach, timelines, resourcing, and outcomes.
* Conduct in\-depth analysis of existing business processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.
* Drive the application of Lean Six Sigma methodologies, including DMAIC and DMADV, and establish KPIs that measure process effectiveness and customer impact.
* Design future\-state customer service models covering channel strategy, self\-service and containment, omnichannel orchestration, governance, and ways of working.
* Run client discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews; present and defend recommendations to senior client leadership; manage day\-to\-day client relationships and issue resolution.
* Drive benchmarking analysis and change\-impact assessments grounded in an understanding of the client industry.
* Connect the operating model to future\-state processes to create practical and credible transformation approaches.
* Maintain working knowledge of the customer service technology landscape, including CCaaS, CRM, case management, AI, and automation, and advise clients on how technology choices shape process and service design.
* Contribute to business development by qualifying opportunities and co\-authoring proposals.
* Coach junior practitioners on process redesign, journey design, domain\-specific trend assessment, and operating model design.


**Professional \& Technical Skills**
* Must have: 7\-12 years of experience in process excellence, process redesign, customer service transformation, or management consulting.
* Must have: Demonstrated ability to lead client discovery workshops and present recommendations to senior leadership.
* Must have: Extensive experience in process transformation, including senior\-level process modelling and re\-engineering responsibilities; relevant certification such as Six Sigma Black Belt is preferred.
* Must have: Deep knowledge of Lean Six Sigma principles and methodologies, with a track record of implementation.
* Must have: Experience using AI\-assisted tools for benchmarking, analytics, or workshop facilitation.
* Must have: Experience designing future\-state processes with AI integration points, operating model changes, and adoption approaches.
* Must have: Strong problem\-solving and data\-driven decision\-making skills, with experience in process mining and analytics tools such as Celonis or Power Automate.
* Must have: Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and drive change across organizational levels.
* Good to have: Working knowledge of CCaaS and CRM platforms such as Genesys, Amazon Connect, and Salesforce Service Cloud, and how they enable service process design.
* Good to have: Experience designing service operating models, governance structures, or organization structures for customer\-facing functions.
* Good to have: Strong executive communication skills and the ability to present complex process and technology design decisions in business terms.
* Good to have: Experience contributing to business development, proposals, or RFP responses.
* Good to have: Experience in management consulting firms.
* Good to have: Lean Six Sigma certification, with Black Belt preferred.


**Additional Information**
* The ideal candidate combines process re\-engineering expertise, customer\-centric service design, AI\-enabled transformation, and senior client leadership.
* The role requires the ability to design at the intersection of people, AI agents, and process while aligning outcomes for the business, customers, and employees.
