title: Senior Manager, Customer Experience
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**QAD** 
 is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose\-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food \& beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.
   

  

 Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain\-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.
   

  

**ERA — QAD's Enterprise Resource Allocation platform —** 
 is the domain intelligence layer that sits between any ERP and any AI agent. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable.
   

  

 Shift Timing: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the
 **Senior Manager, Customer Experience (Cloud Operations)** 
 , you will serve as a critical operational pillar within QAD’s global Cloud Operations organization, reporting directly to the Senior Director of Cloud Operations. In this high\-visibility leadership role, you will bridge strategic cloud direction with world\-class operational delivery.
   

  

 You will lead QAD’s IT Service Management (ITSM) framework, own major incident and problem resolution lifecycle, drive change management, and serve as the primary operational QAD interface for our outsourced Managed Service Provider (MSP) partner. Your core mission is to ensure secure, highly available, and performant AWS cloud infrastructure that delivers an exceptional, seamless customer experience for QAD's enterprise SaaS clients.
   

  

**Role Division \& Core Focus Areas**
 60% — IT Service Management \& Governance \| \| (Incident \& Problem Management, SLA Enforcement, MSP Governance)
   

  

 40% — AWS Cloud Ops, FinOps \& Release \| \| (AWS Infrastructure, Change Advisory, Release Management)
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Incident \& Problem Management Leadership
* Major Incident Command: Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle for P0, P1, and P2 incidents. Serve as the incident commander leading war room discussions, managing real\-time bridge calls, establishing stakeholder communication discipline, and driving swift resolution.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA) \& Quality: Oversee rigorous RCA documentation and track permanent fixes to completion to eliminate repeat failures across complex cloud environments.
* Incident Protocol Enforcement: Maintain war room discipline, enforce post\-incident review SLAs, and ensure compliance with P0 real\-time handling protocols.
* Service Delivery \& SLA Governance
* SLA Performance: Own weekly SLA breach analyses and strictly enforce Response and Resolution SLA tiers (P0–P3\) across both internal teams and vendor partners.
* Queue \& Ticket Hygiene: Drive daily ticket health reviews, enforce priority accuracy, eliminate stalled tickets (e.g., "waiting on customer" discipline), and manage inactive P1/P2 queues.
* Executive Reporting: Deliver weekly operational SLA trend analysis and performance metrics to the Senior Director of Cloud Operations.
* MSP \& Outsourced Partner Governance
* Primary Partner Interface: Act as QAD’s daily operational interface for our outsourced managed services partner, collaborating directly with their Principal Engineering Manager level.
* Scope \& SLA Governance: Oversee Statement of Work (SOW) compliance, chair regular scope reviews, and strictly prevent out\-of\-scope creep in both directions. Hold the MSP accountable to contractual SLAs via weekly BAU tracker reviews.
* Formal Reviews \& RACI: Lead monthly formal service reviews and mandate actionable, written improvement plans for any SLA breaches. Maintain and enforce incident/change RACI matrices across QAD and MSP teams.
* Cutover \& Release Alignment: Oversee pre\-UAT and production cutover handovers with clear RACI framework execution, staffing confirmations, and standardized communication templates.
* Change Advisory \& Cloud Release Management
* CAB Leadership: Chair the Change Advisory Board (CAB) process, ensuring all high\-risk changes feature detailed rollback plans and clear go/no\-go criteria.
* Release Coordination: Maintain the global change calendar, coordinating seamlessly between cloud migrations, monthly patch releases, and MSP deployments.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Requirements**
* Experience: 12\+ years of total experience in Cloud/IT Operations, with 5\+ years specifically in ITSM or Service Delivery leadership roles.
* Incident Leadership: Proven track record in P0/P1 major incident command at enterprise scale.
* ITSM Mastery: Deep expertise in ITIL framework—specifically Incident, Problem, Change, SLA, and Supplier Management.
* Vendor/MSP Governance: Hands\-on experience governing third\-party MSPs or outsourced service partners (scope management, contractual SLAs, performance reviews).
* Cross\-Team RACI: Experience establishing and enforcing live incident/change RACI frameworks across combined internal and vendor teams.
* People Leadership \& Hours: 3\+ years of direct people management experience. Flexibility to work overlapping US East / EMEA business hours (approx. 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST) from Pune.
* Technical Depth: Solid experience with SaaS\-hosted infrastructure, Linux/Windows server administration, and AWS cloud operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications: ITIL v4 Foundation or Managing Professional; AWS Certified SysOps Administrator or Cloud Practitioner; FinOps Certified Practitioner (FinOps Foundation).
* Tools: Hands\-on working knowledge of enterprise ITSM platforms like ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or Zendesk.
* Domain Knowledge: Background in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) SaaS hosting or manufacturing software environments.
* Vendor Background: Direct experience managing tier\-1 Indian IT services delivery partners (e.g., Persistent, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, or similar).
* AWS Expertise: Hands\-on working knowledge of core AWS services (EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Security Groups, VPN, CloudWatch).


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set


**About QAD**
 QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD \| Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
   

  

 QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

You will work closely with our extended account teams to maximize the value provided to the customer, ensuring our long\-term partnership, while also owning the discipline that keeps renewals and payments on track across a broad client base spanning SMB, Mid\-Market, and Enterprise. Meltwater offers an environment where you'll be surrounded by talented coworkers at the cutting edge of AI Martech, working across one of our most diverse account portfolios in the region.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
* Lead efforts to ensure on\-time renewal revenue across your India portfolio, spanning SMB, Mid\-Market, and Enterprise accounts, collaborating closely with our account teams.
* Own collections end\-to\-end on your book chasing overdue invoices, resolving billing disputes, and working with Finance/AR to keep outstanding balances current and DSO in check.
* Handle the hard conversations at volume. This portfolio involves customers weighing competitors, raising product or billing concerns, or facing payment delays you'll be the person having those conversations, calmly and commercially, week in and week out.
* Proactively cultivate relationships with customers, ensuring their awareness of our product offerings and adoption of their current package.
* Identify upcoming renewals and maintain accurate account and payment status data within the CRM system.
* Develop quotes, manage administrative tasks, and oversee the execution of renewal contracts.
* Flag payment risk and churn risk early, and build recovery plans before either becomes a surprise.
* Feed what you're hearing from customers competitor moves, product gaps, payment friction back to leadership to shape our approach to the market.

* 3\+ years in sales, renewals, or customer success, ideally SaaS including experience retaining customers in competitive or at\-risk situations.

* Act as the primary point of contact for key accounts and ensure smooth business operations.

title: Customer Success Specialist (B2B AI SaaS)
description:
**About the role** 




  





 You'll be the person who takes a signed client from "we just bought this" to "this is running and driving results." At JoyzAI, that means standing up their AI chatbot and AI calling agents end\-to\-end — building the knowledge base, configuring the agent's behaviour, wiring up the lead and CRM flows, and then staying with them so the product actually delivers.
 



  





 This is not a ticket\-closing role. It's a build\-and\-own role. You're technical enough to configure agents yourself, and human enough to make clients feel taken care of at every step. You delight customers by solving the real problem, not by marking a query "resolved."
 



  





 What you'll do
 



  





**Onboarding \& agent setup** 



* Own new\-client onboarding from kickoff to go\-live: scope the use case, gather source material, and set clear delivery timelines.
* Build and structure knowledge bases from client content (websites, brochures, PDFs, FAQs) so the AI answers accurately and on\-brand.
* Configure AI chatbot and AI calling agents across the platform — Tasks, Access, Behaviour, and AI Config — including prompt design, conversation flows, guardrails, and tone (including Hinglish where needed).
* Set up CRM contact fields, ticket types, and automated workflows so leads and conversations route correctly.
* Configure voice agent call handling — greetings, one\-question\-per\-turn flows, voicemail/no\-answer/silence fallbacks, and WhatsApp follow\-ups for links and addresses.



  





**Integrations \& data flow** 



* Wire up lead pipelines — e.g. Meta lead forms → Joyz webhook, Google Sheets automations — and validate that phone/contact data lands clean and deduplicated.
* Coordinate WhatsApp Business API setup with clients (WABA, embedded signup, number provisioning) and troubleshoot access or restriction issues.
* Assist with booking, calendar, and payment integrations where the client's flow requires them.



  





**Ongoing success** 



* Run demos, walkthroughs, and handover sessions so clients can self\-serve confidently.
* Monitor live agent performance, catch weak answers or broken flows, and iterate on prompts and KB content.
* Troubleshoot issues technically before escalating — reproduce, diagnose, and fix where you can.
* Track client health, drive adoption, and surface expansion or churn signals to the team.



  





 Roughly 75% of your time is hands\-on build: software configuration, AI agent design, and API integrations into whatever the client already runs. CRM, ERP, Google Sheets, calendars, WhatsApp, and the odd internal tool nobody has documented.
 



  





 The other 25% is sitting with the client, understanding how their business actually works, and figuring out where our software can move a number that matters to them.
 



  





 That split shifts as the product matures. Expect it to land closer to 60/40 within two years, with more of your time spent on the thinking and less on the plumbing.
 



  





 We're under 15 people building AI calling agents. This is not a comfortable corporate job. You'll be in the trenches, you'll work hard, and you'll compress ten years of ordinary career growth into two (this means salary growth also, not just more work).
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





 We don't care too much about experience or degree as long as you have what it takes to do the job.
 



  





**Why JoyzAI?** 




 ✨
 **Utmost freedom and autonomy** 
 — to make decisions. You are the taskmaster, do it the way you think is best. We will only suggest.
 



 ✨
 **Complete responsibility** 
 . You are the taskmaster. Take responsibility for it.
 



 ✨
 **Top\-of\-the\-market pay** 
 – we reward high performance with the best packages.
 



 ✨
 **5\-day working** 
 – weekends are yours to recharge.
 



 ✨
 **Work from office in Noida** 
 – collaborate, learn, and grow with a passionate team.
 



 ✨
 **High\-growth startup** 
 – opportunity to be see first hand how AI brings change and be a part of that.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO) – ReUnited India
description:
Chief Operating Officer (COO) – ReUnited India

**Location:** Delhi NCR, India  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 5–10\+ years  
**Department:** Leadership / Business Operations  
**Reports To:** Founder \& CEO

About ReUnited

ReUnited is a B2B platform transforming the way real estate brokers operate, collaborate and grow.

Our vision is to move brokers from a traditional **“Property Dealer” mindset to a “Real Estate Portfolio Manager” mindset**, while building a strong professional network, business opportunity ecosystem, knowledge platform and technology\-enabled operating environment for the real estate community.

As we scale across cities and build a national network, we are looking for a **Chief Operating Officer (COO)** to build and lead the operating engine of the business.

About the Role

The COO will work directly with the Founder \& CEO and will be responsible for **turning strategy into execution, building scalable systems, driving business growth and creating a high\-performance organisation.**

This is not a traditional administrative operations role.

We are looking for a commercially driven operator who can bring together **people, processes, technology, data and execution** to build a scalable and profitable business.

Key areas of ownership:

* Business operations and cross\-functional execution
* Membership growth and revenue operations
* Member onboarding, engagement and retention
* Sales and CRM performance
* Team productivity and performance management
* SOP and process development
* Technology, automation and reporting
* Events and broker community initiatives
* City/franchise operations
* Financial and operational discipline
* Management dashboards and business performance

Key ResponsibilitiesBusiness Operations \& Execution

* Translate the Founder \& CEO's strategy into annual, quarterly and monthly operating plans.
* Establish clear KRAs, KPIs and accountability across functions.
* Build and manage a strong weekly and monthly operating cadence.
* Track business performance and ensure timely execution.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and drive cross\-functional solutions.
* Build systems that reduce dependency on Founder\-led day\-to\-day execution.

Growth \& Revenue Operations

* Build a predictable membership growth and revenue engine.
* Optimise the complete funnel: **Lead → Qualification → Audit/Demo → Conversion → Onboarding → Engagement → Renewal → Referral.**
* Establish sales targets, conversion benchmarks and pipeline reviews.
* Improve CRM adoption, sales productivity and follow\-up discipline.
* Work with the marketing and sales teams to improve lead quality and conversion.
* Track metrics such as leads, conversion %, revenue, pipeline, CAC, revenue/member, renewal and churn.

Member Success \& Retention

* Own the overall member lifecycle and member experience.
* Build structured onboarding and 30\-60\-90 day member success programs.
* Establish systems to monitor member engagement and identify at\-risk members.
* Develop strategies to improve retention, renewals and referrals.
* Establish member satisfaction and NPS measurement.
* Create processes to understand and reduce member churn.

Events \& Community

* Own the operational and commercial performance of ReUnited broker meets and events.
* Develop event processes, targets and performance metrics.
* Build a structured **Event → Prospect → Membership** conversion process.
* Track registrations, attendance, leads, conversions and event ROI.

City \& Franchise Operations

* Build scalable systems for launching and managing ReUnited across cities.
* Develop city\-level KPIs and reporting.
* Standardise onboarding, training and operating processes for city partners.
* Monitor city performance and create improvement plans for underperforming locations.
* Ensure a consistent ReUnited member experience across markets.

Technology, CRM \& Automation

* Drive effective adoption of ReUnited's technology platform and CRM.
* Build dashboards that provide real\-time visibility into business performance.
* Identify opportunities for automation and AI\-driven productivity.
* Work with technology teams to prioritise features based on business impact.
* Use technology to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.

Team \& Performance Management

* Build a high\-performance, accountable organisation.
* Define roles, KRAs, KPIs and performance expectations.
* Recruit and develop key functional leaders.
* Establish regular performance reviews.
* Build incentive structures linked to measurable outcomes.
* Develop future leaders and strengthen organisational capability.

Financial \& Operational Discipline

* Work with the Founder and Finance function on budgets and operating plans.
* Monitor revenue, expenses, profitability and unit economics.
* Track CAC, cost\-to\-serve and revenue per member.
* Identify productivity and cost optimisation opportunities.
* Establish monthly management reporting and performance reviews.

Process \& SOP Development

Build the **ReUnited Operating System** with clear, documented processes for:

* Lead management
* Sales
* CRM
* Membership conversion
* Member onboarding
* Member engagement
* Member success
* Renewals
* Referrals
* Events
* Complaints and issue resolution
* City/franchise operations
* Recruitment and training
* Reporting and performance management

The goal is simple:

**A good employee should be able to join ReUnited and understand what to do because the system tells them.**

Candidate ProfileRequired

* 5–10\+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Strong experience in business operations, general management or a scale\-up environment.
* Proven experience managing cross\-functional teams.
* Strong commercial and business understanding.
* Experience building processes and systems from scratch.
* Strong understanding of sales, customer/member lifecycle and retention.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working with KPIs, dashboards and performance metrics.
* Strong CRM and technology orientation.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills.
* High ownership and strong execution mindset.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be strongly preferred:

* Real Estate
* B2B platforms or marketplaces
* SaaS
* Membership businesses
* Franchise/network businesses
* Start\-ups or scale\-ups
* Sales\-driven organisations
* Community or professional network businesses
* Technology\-enabled services

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

**Strategic enough to see the big picture.**  
**Commercial enough to understand the numbers.**  
**Operational enough to build the systems.**  
**Analytical enough to identify the problem.**  
**People\-oriented enough to build the team.**  
**Disciplined enough to drive accountability.**  
**Entrepreneurial enough to operate without a playbook.**

The ideal candidate is a **builder and operator**—someone who can take ownership, solve problems, create systems and make things happen.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means building an organisation that is:

* **Scalable**
* **Measurable**
* **Process\-driven**
* **Technology\-enabled**
* **Customer/member\-centric**
* **Commercially strong**
* **Less dependent on Founder\-led execution**

If you are excited by the opportunity to **build the operating system of a growing business and play a key role in scaling a national real estate network**, we would love to hear from you.

Pay: ₹80,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you currently live in Gurgaon/Gurugram or Delhi NCR?
* How soon can you join us?
* What is your current CTC (annual)?
* Have you worked in a startup, scale\-up, real estate, B2B, SaaS, marketplace, membership or franchise/network business?

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 GCL Dreams is part of GCL, one of India’s leading diversified financial services groups, promoted by a family with decades of experience in financial markets. As a member of major exchanges such as NSE, BSE, MCX, and NCDEX, GCL offers robust online and offline platforms for investing, hedging, and trading. GCL has grown from an entrepreneurial start\-up to a market leader by adapting to changing market conditions while maintaining a strong focus on its core financial services domain.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Relationship Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for building, managing, and strengthening relationships with existing and prospective clients across GCL Dreams’ financial products and services. Day\-to\-day activities include understanding client goals, recommending suitable investment and trading solutions, addressing queries, and ensuring timely resolution of service issues. The Relationship Manager will regularly follow up with clients, assist with account opening and documentation, and coordinate with internal teams to deliver a seamless client experience. The role also involves identifying new business opportunities, meeting defined sales and retention targets, and maintaining accurate records of client interactions and portfolios.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong client relationship management skills, including ability to build trust, understand client needs, and provide tailored financial solutions.
* Solid communication and interpersonal skills to explain financial products clearly and handle client queries professionally.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of capital markets, trading, and investment products; prior experience in financial services or brokerage is an advantage.
* Proficiency in using CRM tools, MS Office, and online trading or investment platforms.
* Ability to work towards sales and retention targets, with good negotiation and problem\-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., NISM) are beneficial.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, and a customer\-centric mindset.
* Comfort working in an on\-site environment in Ahmedabad and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.

title: Sr. Success Manager (EMEA Shift)
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale - across every customer touchpoint. By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team - spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management - enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights. Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide. Job Description Sr. Success Manager (EMEA Shift) Sprinklr s Customer Organization focuses on four strong pillars of Client Experience, Operational Excellence, Profitable Growth and Team Culture. 
 Sprinklr s Customer Success Manager align highly skilled expertise , thought leadership and program management, and unlock the deepest level of partnership with customers. With a bias towards action and ability to deliver organizational-wide impact, the CSM strategizes and executes on a plan how the customer can do things differently and better using Sprinklr. 
 
 T he CSM develop s a deep understanding of the customer s business, processes, teams and technical architectures (tech stacks), to prescribe use of Sprinklr products and features to solve high level business challenges and resolve organizational inefficiencies. The CSM s advanced mastery of Sprinklr s product and solutions is paired with domain and industry expertise , business acumen, and exceptional communication and program management skills, positioning the CSM to take a consultative approach in informing and actioning on partnership strategy plans 
 Directly responsible for: Manage a portfolio of customers at scale, delivering proactive guidance, adoption support, and value realization across multiple accounts simultaneously through a structured engagement model. Prioritize customer needs effectively and drive outcomes through a mix of digital touchpoints, virtual engagements, and scalable success programs while maintaining high customer satisfaction. Demonstrate a strong understanding of SaaS platforms, customer workflows, integrations, and product capabilities to effectively guide customers on adoption and best practices. Translate customer business requirements into product recommendations, troubleshoot common platform queries, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive successful outcomes. Conduct Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to showcase value realization, align on business objectives , review adoption metrics, and identify opportunities to drive customer outcomes and growth. Cultivate relationships with key stakeholders across customer organizations and establish new relationships, directly or by introducing Sprinklr executives and product leadership. Build customer champions and advocates to ensure clients can articulate and understand the value Sprinklr is driving to their business. Oversee customer adoption journey, ensuring appropriate resources are engaged, and effective solutions are implemented, at each stage of the lifecycle to achieve successful outcomes. Ensure awareness of Sprinklr s product, product roadmap and new releases to all relevant customer stakeholders, in the context of the customer stakeholder s role, current and prescribed future use cases of Sprinklr. Co-develop a success plan with customer to deliver on agreed KPI s and success metrics. Conduct regular customer cadences to align on value realization, agreed business priorities, and provide thought leadership specific to client s evolving business needs. Leverage customer health data, product adoption insights, and consumption metrics to proactively identify risks, drive recommendations, and improve customer outcomes. Responsible for customer workspace configuration audits, partnering with cross-functional teams on the process and related deliverables. Drive customer enablement and self-service adoption through scalable playbooks, best practices, and digital programs to improve adoption, retention, and operational efficiency Proactively identify adoption blockers to eliminate consumption risk. Empower customers in using Sprinklr to minimize redundant workflows, processes and resources. Advocate for the customer with Sprinklr s Product Team and Partnerships Team which entails identifying product enhancements, opportunities and paths to solutions that require development and sometimes third-party partners. Increasing revenue from customers. Collaborate with the Sales, Solutions Consultant other cross-functional teams to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities. Develop a deep understanding of customer business objectives , industry trends, competitors and market dynamics to identify opportunities for value realization, expansion, and strategic growth. Preferred qualifications skills: Minimum of 6 -8 years experience in Customer Success, Technical Account management, Technology Consulting, or Technology Solutions Development. Experience delivering large-scale transformational programs across Fortune 100 enterprise clients customer experience functions, working across multiple lines of business to deliver organization-wide impact, often breaking through legacy silos. Ability to analyze customer s usage data, KPIs and health indicators to identify opportunities for improvement and translate into actionable recommendations, plan and path to solutions. Demonstrated experience and/or knowledge of marketing automation technologies, or contact center technologies digital transformation, AI solutions, market research and insights, business analytics, emerging technologies, and data management platforms and technology. Strong program management experience overseeing large, cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution of deliverables. Proven ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners, as well as mapping business requirements into technical features. Interest in continuously learning and advancing understanding of tech industry, customer experience technologies, technology platforms and solutions, AI advancement, and trends with top global brands We focus on our mission : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data - helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things: Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM. Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience. Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability. We believe in our product : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything - and everyone - can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world s leading enterprise brands. title: Gainsight  Openings for Customer Success Solutions Consultant & Technical
Specialist Digital Customer Success Senior Advisor - S/4 Private Cloud Edition
India Customer Success Leader
description:
**Company Description**  

NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered through advanced analytics and state\-of\-the\-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™.


NIQ operates in 100\+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population. For more information, visit https://www.niq.com.

 **Job Description** **India Customer Success Leader**

**Location: Gurgaon/ Mumbai**

**The Role**


We are seeking a transformational Customer Success \& Consulting Leader to drive strategic growth, customer value realization, and executive engagement across NielsenIQ’s FMCG and Technology \& Durables businesses in India. This leader will define and execute the customer success strategy, build deep C\-suite relationships, and position NIQ as a trusted strategic partner for some of India's leading organizations.


The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, consulting expertise, customer leadership, and people management capabilities to accelerate growth, strengthen client partnerships, and deliver measurable business outcomes. They will serve as the voice of the customer internally while influencing strategic decisions across Commercial, Product, Analytics, Data Science, and Operations teams.


This highly visible leadership role offers the opportunity to shape a future\-ready Customer Success organization, foster a culture of collaboration and excellence, and influence the future direction of NielsenIQ's customer engagement model

 **Key Leadership Accountabilities**

**Strategic Customer Leadership**

* Build and manage strategic relationships with C\-suite executives across key customer accounts, positioning NIQ as a trusted advisor and growth partner for both the verticals.
* Act as the voice of customers within NielsenIQ, ensuring customer priorities are reflected in product innovation, business planning, and service delivery strategies
* Lead customer transformation conversations, connecting market intelligence, analytics, and insights to measurable business outcomes. Drive customer adoption, value realization, retention, and long\-term partnership growth.
* Serve as the executive escalation point for critical customer opportunities and challenges.

 **Drive Commercial Growth**

* Drive a disciplined account growth strategy by identifying whitespace opportunities, expanding strategic partnerships, and accelerating cross\-sell and upsell initiatives.
* Partner closely with Commercial, Product, Pricing, and Operations teams to unlock sustainable growth and maximize customer lifetime value.
* Influence revenue growth by aligning customer priorities with NIQ capabilities and innovation roadmap.
* Create a scalable framework for value\-based customer engagement that strengthens loyalty and accelerates growth.

**Lead a High\-Performing Organization**

* Inspire, align, and empower a high\-performing Customer Success and Consulting organization to achieve ambitious growth and customer impact objectives.
* Develop future\-ready capabilities and a strong leadership pipeline through coaching, talent development, mentoring, and succession planning.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, customer centricity, and excellence.
* Drive organizational effectiveness through clear governance, workforce planning, resource allocation, and fit\-for\-purpose operating models.
* Champion employee engagement, inclusion, and continuous learning to build a best\-in\-class Customer Success function.

**Shape Cross\-Functional Strategy**

* Influence strategic priorities and decisions across Commercial, Product, Data Science, Engineering, Operations, and Analytics teams to deliver integrated customer outcomes.
* Translate customer needs and market opportunities into clear priorities for business planning, solution development, and service innovation.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives that improve customer experience, operational excellence, solution adoption, and overall business performance.
* Establish strong alignment and accountability across functions to ensure consistent execution against strategic customer commitments.
* Contribute customer and market perspectives to NielsenIQ’s broader India business strategy and innovation agenda.

 **E****stablish Customer Success Excellence**

* Define and institutionalize Customer Success methodologies, performance standards, governance mechanisms, and operating rhythms across the organization.
* Build differentiated and scalable customer engagement models based on customer needs, strategic value, and growth potential.
* Establish a disciplined approach to measuring customer health, adoption, value realization, satisfaction, retention, and growth.
* Leverage customer insights, market intelligence, and performance data to proactively identify risks, resolve barriers, and unlock growth opportunities.
* Drive continuous improvement across customer experience, service quality, consulting effectiveness, and operational efficiency.
* Embed best practices and capability\-building programs that strengthen Customer Success maturity and deliver consistent customer outcomes.

 **What Success Looks Like**


The successful leader will:

* Elevate NielsenIQ's strategic position with key customers
* Increase customer retention, advocacy, and lifetime value
* Accelerate revenue growth across existing customer portfolios
* Strengthen executive\-level customer relationships
* Improve Net Promoter Scores (NPS) and customer satisfaction metrics
* Build a highly engaged and high\-performing team
* Drive greater adoption of NielsenIQ's analytics, measurement, and consulting solutions
* Create a scalable and future\-ready Customer Success organization

 **Why This Role?**


This is not a traditional Customer Success leadership position.


It is an opportunity to lead a strategically important function at the intersection of customer growth, consulting, analytics, and commercial strategy. You will shape how some of the world's leading brands leverage data and insights to make critical business decisions while building a high\-performing team and influencing the future direction of NielsenIQ's customer engagement model.

 **Qualifications**  

* 12\+ years of progressive leadership experience across Customer Success, Consulting, Consumer Intelligence, FMCG, Retail, Analytics, Professional Services, or related industries.
* Proven track record of leading large customer\-facing teams, driving customer outcomes, and delivering sustainable business growth.
* Demonstrated success building strategic client partnerships and influencing C\-suite stakeholders.
* Strong commercial mindset with experience identifying and converting growth opportunities through expansion, cross\-sell, and value\-based engagement.

title: Digital Customer Success Specialist, Insights & Renewal Intelligence
description:
**Digital Customer Success Specialist, Insights \& Renewal Intelligence** 




*Customer Success \| Digital Customer Success* 




  





**Employment type** 




 Full\-time
 



**Experience guide** 




 3–6 years
 



**Reporting line** 




 Manager, Digital Customer Success
 



  





**About the Role** 




**AspenTech, an Emerson company, is a global leader in industrial software, helping organizations optimize operations, improve efficiency, and accelerate digital transformation.** 




 You will own the account\-intelligence and renewal\-risk workstream, converting multi\-source customer data into repeatable health reviews, early\-warning insights, portfolio reporting, and actionable Customer Success narratives. The role combines hands\-on analysis with process ownership, data quality, stakeholder coordination, and automation readiness.
 



  





**About Digital Customer Success** 




 Digital Customer Success provides structured, scalable Customer Success engagement for customers outside dedicated one\-to\-one coverage. The function combines customer intelligence, proactive risk identification, digital engagement, and cross\-functional coordination to help customers realize value and enable account teams to take timely, informed action.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* **Account health reviews:** 
 Build standardised reviews that combine renewal timing, product usage, entitlement, support activity, training, certification, version adoption and customer sentiment into clear strengths, risks and recommended actions.
* **Early\-warning and risk analysis:** 
 Maintain risk inputs, logic, thresholds and tiering; validate outputs and distinguish genuine customer risk from data gaps.
* **Portfolio and segmentation:** 
 Maintain priority account cohorts using approved segmentation rules, renewal timing, risk triggers and stakeholder inputs.
* **Renewal intelligence:** 
 Track renewal cohorts, surface concerns early and prepare account\-level inputs for regional renewal reviews.
* **Risk and leadership reporting:** 
 Produce concise account and portfolio reporting with evidence, data\-quality caveats and recommended follow\-up.
* **CRM health narratives:** 
 Draft and maintain clear health, risk and next\-step entries aligned to the review cadence.
* **Data and source management:** 
 Extract, reconcile and quality\-check information from CRM, BI, usage, support, training, version and survey sources.
* **Cross\-functional collaboration:** 
 Work with account teams, Customer Success Operations and technical data owners to validate context and recommendations.
* **Documentation and controls:** 
 Maintain source links, definitions, standard operating procedures, quality checks, templates and cadence calendars.
* **Automation and enablement:** 
 Help translate review and risk\-reporting processes into scalable workflows while preserving quality and traceability.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* **Experience:** 
 3–6 years in Customer Success operations, customer\-health or renewal analytics, business analytics, data analytics or comparable work.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Analytics, Business, Information Systems or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* **Data capability:** 
 Advanced Excel skills and demonstrated experience handling and reconciling multiple data sources.
* **Reporting tools:** 
 Hands\-on experience with a business intelligence tool such as Power BI and experience working with CRM data.
* **Business judgement:** 
 Working understanding of customer health, adoption, churn or attrition risk, renewals and Customer Success operating models.
* **Communication:** 
 Ability to convert complex evidence into concise, defensible narratives and practical recommendations for business stakeholders.
* **Operating discipline:** 
 High attention to detail, source traceability, documentation quality and recurring delivery commitments.



  





**Preferred / Nice to Have** 



* **Customer Success platforms:** 
 Experience with Gainsight or a comparable platform.
* **Data and automation:** 
 Exposure to Snowflake or other data\-warehouse extracts, Power Query, SQL, scripting or workflow automation.
* **Relevant models:** 
 Experience developing health scores, early\-warning models, renewal dashboards or executive account reviews.
* **Industry context:** 
 Experience in B2B enterprise software or industrial software.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* **Reliable delivery:** 
 Account reviews, risk refreshes, reports and CRM narratives are accurate and completed against an agreed operating calendar.
* **Actionable insight:** 
 Account teams can understand the evidence, validate the context and act on the recommendations.
* **Data integrity:** 
 Material data gaps are visible and tracked rather than being misclassified as customer risk.
* **Scalability:** 
 Processes and controls are documented and progressively standardised or automated without reducing quality.



  





**How This Role Works** 




 This role supports customers and internal stakeholders across multiple regions and requires effective collaboration in a globally distributed environment. The role enables account teams with structured insights or scaled engagement and does not replace commercial account ownership.

title: Technical Customer Solutions Manager, India CSM Team
description:
**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi\-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
   

  

 You will take end\-to\-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi\-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
   

  

 Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best\-practices are applied, including: (1\) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2\) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3\) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
   

  

 In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy\-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non\-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on\-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

title: Customer Engagement Manager
description:
**What We Do** 
  At GoGuardian, we’re helping build a future where all learners are ready and inspired to solve the world’s greatest challenges. Our award\-winning system of learning solutions is purpose\-built for K\-12 and trusted by school leaders to promote effective teaching and equitable engagement while helping empower educators to keep students safe.  
 **What It’s Like to Work at GoGuardian** 

 We are an outcomes\-focused learning company with a steadfast focus on improving learning environments, one classroom at a time. Working with us means joining a remote team of diverse, committed, mission\-driven employees who are inspired by our vision, dedicated to our customers, and ready to roll up their sleeves. Guardians put their heads together to solve problems, learn together from experiments that fail, and stand together by their work with full accountability. We balance our diligence with an inclusive culture that invites everyone to bring their whole self to work. Join us and learn why “I love the people here” is one of the most frequent comments we hear from Guardians.
 



**The Role** 




 We’re looking for a Customer Engagement Manager to help identify and address customer engagement, adoption, and churn risks across GoGuardian’s Curriculum and Instruction products.
 



 This is a data\-driven, customer\-facing role that combines customer investigation, analytics, product knowledge, and cross\-functional problem\-solving. You’ll use customer and product data to identify strategic and at\-risk customers, deep dive into their behavior and engagement patterns to understand the underlying causes, and work with Customer Success, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Engineering to determine and drive appropriate actions.
 



 You’ll also work directly with customers and customer\-facing teams to understand issues, answer questions, and support customers who require additional attention. This position sits within the Product Team and serves as a bridge between customers and the teams responsible for improving the product experience.
 



 This is a remote opportunity for candidates located in India and requires regular overlap with U.S. working hours.
 



**What You'll Do** 




**Customer Engagement \& Risk Management (\~40%)** 



* Partner with Customer Success to identify and support strategic and at\-risk customers.
* Maintain a data\-informed view of customer engagement, adoption, and churn risk.
* Provide support to identified at\-risk customers and help ensure their concerns are addressed.
* Participate in customer meetings and product discussions to understand customer goals and challenges.
* Help identify and drive actions that improve customer engagement, adoption, and retention.



**Analytics \& Customer Investigation (\~20%)** 



* Regularly examine dashboards and customer/product usage data to identify customers with declining engagement, adoption risks, or other signals of churn.
* Deep dive into individual customer behavior and usage patterns to understand why engagement or adoption is changing.
* Investigate customer history, product usage, and other relevant signals to identify root causes.
* Develop clear, actionable findings and recommendations based on customer and product data.
* Track the impact of actions taken and use data to determine whether customer engagement or risk is improving.
* Build and maintain a reliable, data\-informed list of customers requiring attention.



**Product Partnership \& Customer Advocacy (\~20%)** 



* Bring customer findings, recurring issues, and product opportunities to Product Managers in a clear and actionable way.
* Partner with Product Management to investigate customer problems and validate potential solutions or workflows.
* Capture and synthesize customer feedback, enhancement requests, and recurring product challenges.
* Work with Solutions Engineering and Engineering when customer issues require deeper technical investigation or resolution.
* Validate new features and workflows with customers and share feedback to help improve the product experience.



**Cross\-Functional Customer \& Product Support (\~20%)** 



* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering to address customer questions and issues.
* Help troubleshoot customer\-reported product and data issues and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams.
* Support customer data onboarding, integrations, and account maintenance where applicable.
* Communicate customer issues and findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Follow issues through to resolution and ensure relevant customer\-facing teams are kept informed.



**Who You Are** 



* 3 to 5 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Engagement, Technical Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer\-facing SaaS role.
* Experience working directly with U.S.\-based customers and confidently leading customer conversations, presentations, and business reviews.
* Experience supporting or retaining strategic or at\-risk customers and understanding customer engagement or churn risk.
* Analytical and data\-driven, with experience using customer, product, or business data to identify risks, investigate customer behavior, and inform actions.
* Strong investigative and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to dig into customer issues, identify root causes, and determine appropriate next steps.
* Familiarity with customer\-facing web applications, data integrations, APIs, and common web technologies, with the ability to troubleshoot issues and work effectively with technical teams.
* Ability to work effectively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Engineering teams.
* Strong communication, relationship\-building, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer engagements and priorities.
* Comfortable learning new products, workflows, and technical concepts quickly.
* Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of problems in a fast\-paced, changing environment.
* Ability and willingness to regularly work during required U.S. working hours.



 Nice to Have
 


* Experience in K\-12 education technology.
* Experience working with enterprise, strategic, or at\-risk customer accounts.
* Familiarity with student information systems (SIS), rostering systems, assessment platforms, or education data.
* Experience with SQL, APIs, data integrations, reporting tools, BI platforms, or CRM systems.
* Experience with Google Sheets or Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics tools.



  
 **What We Offer** 



* Competitive pay, health insurance, accident insurance, life insurance, and a retirement savings plan.
* Paid annual leave, paid holidays, paid parental leave, paid leave for life events, and a paid year\-end holiday break.
* A robust catalog of benefits that support your professional growth and personal wellbeing, including work from home funds, wellness checks, and more…



*Plus the intangible:* 



* A varied and challenging role in an innovative, global company.
* Supportive, driven colleagues who have your back and share your passion.

As a Client Success Advisor, you’ll guide key clients in configuring, adopting, and optimizing a GRC platform—strengthening retention, uncovering expansion opportunities, and helping teams work more effectively.
   

  

 You’ll combine GRC expertise, advisory skills, and a strong understanding of client needs to shape practical solutions, improve platform usage, and build lasting partnerships. Your work will influence client outcomes while contributing valuable insights to internal product and go\-to\-market teams.
   

  

**Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff)**

* Assess client requirements, challenges, and goals, then recommend tailored solutions that deliver measurable value.
* Partner with clients on governance, risk, and compliance roadmaps, translating priorities into effective platform implementations.

title: Technical Implementation Manager
description:
**About Esper**
 Esper revolutionizes device management by redefining what it should be: a driver of business growth. With advanced and modern capabilities, automation replaces outdated workflows, re\-provisioning becomes obsolete, and managing by exception transforms efficiency, resulting in increased efficiency, improved ROI, and bolsters security for device fleets of all sizes. Esper has been recognized as number 735 on Inc. Magazine's 2025 5000 fastest\-growing private companies in America, and 133 on the 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 500\. Some of the world’s most innovative brands, like Google, Doordash, Taco Bell, Clinical ink, SF 49ers, and Intelity, rely on Esper to deliver exceptional device experiences. Esper partners with the leading mobile device hardware manufacturers, solution providers, and distributors globally.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Technical Implementation Manager is the technical backbone of Esper’s customer accounts. This is an engineering role with a customer axis: TIMs own the implementation from contract sign through ful fleet scale, and they bring engineering\-level depth to every customer engagement. They build things, use AI as a daily tool, and hold the technical relationship inside every account they carry.
   

  

 TIMs operate as forward\-deployed technical experts alongside the Enterprise Account Manager. Together, they close the gap between contract sign and devices live, remove friction, resolve blockers, and connect the customer’s operational reality to Esper’s platform. The best TIMs know their accounts better than the customer knows themselves, and they use that knowledge to drive both customer success and Esper’s revenue growth.
   

  

 AI is not a side skill at Esper. TIMs are expected to use agentic AI tools across all facets of their responsibilities: accelerating implementation workflows, building automation and integration tooling, identifying optimal technical solutions, generating account insights, and forecasting customer behavior. The ability to build practical AI components that create real value for customers and the team is a core part of this role.
   

  

 Technical fluency at the device operations layer is non\-negotiable. TIMs must hold credible conversations with engineering teams and business stakeholders alike, without routing every question back to Esper Engineering.
   

  

**In Summary**
****Technical Implementation and Delivery****
* Own end\-to\-end device implementations from onboarding through full fleet rollout, including the project plan, escalation path, and all technical blockers
* Get hands\-on with devices, MDM software, and platform configuration; train customers to operate Esper independently


****Technical Expertise and Liaison****
* Serve as the primary technical escalation point: triage and resolve issues, engage Engineering only when required, and coordinate with hardware ecosystem partners (OEMs, ODMs, ISVs, VARs, 3PLs)
* Debug complex multi\-system issues, produce clear documentation, and provide deep expertise across Esper platform configuration, provisioning, and MDM/EMM architecture


****Account Management and Expansion****
* Partner with the Enterprise Account Manager on QBRs; surface expansion opportunities, maintain strong multilevel relationships, and advocate internally for customer needs with Product and Engineering
* Keep account records, device milestones, and next actions current in Salesforce


****Technical Engineering and AI****
* Use agentic AI tools (Claude Code, OpenCode, custom agents) daily across implementation planning, troubleshooting, automation, and documentation
* Leverage AI to generate account insights from calls, support history, and usage data to anticipate customer needs


**Qualifications**

title: Head of Support
description:
**About MyYogaTeacher** 




  





 MyYogaTeacher connects qualified yoga and fitness teachers from India with customers globally for personalized 1\-on\-1 live video sessions.
 


* 300,000\+ customers across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, Australia, Singapore, UAE, and more
* 400,000\+ five\-star reviews, 95% session satisfaction rate
* 450\+ highly qualified teachers on the platform
* Headquartered in California, operations based in Bangalore



 Our customers come to us managing pain, rebuilding health, or working through stress. Yoga becomes part of how they take care of themselves, and support is how we honour that. A great interaction should feel like a knowledgeable friend picked up the phone, not a ticket getting resolved. A student should stay because the experience genuinely helps them, and because we noticed and reached out before they ever thought about leaving.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Support \& Retention Operations** 



* Raise the bar on escalation handling, so quality holds across every rep and every shift
* Close the gaps in 24/7 shift coverage
* Build the SOPs and training that let quality scale independent of tenure or memory
* Get a clear, evidence\-based view of why students actually cancel, and fix what that reveals



**Team Leadership** 



* Directly manage Support and Retention as one unified team, hiring for empathy and coaching for ownership
* Run regular 1\-on\-1s, give specific feedback, and build clear growth paths for each person
* Personally handle the toughest escalations, so the team sees the standard you expect



**Systems \& Metrics** 



* Own the metrics that matter: resolution quality, response time, renewal rate, student sentiment etc
* Partner with Product and Engineering to fix root causes, not just symptoms
* Build the retention playbook: pre\-renewal outreach, pause\-and\-reactivation flows, and how cancellation signals get surfaced and acted on before a student churns
* Be the voice of the customer to the Founder and to Product, backed by data



  





**Who You Are** 



* 8 to 10 years in customer support or customer success, with meaningful time at a startup
* You have built a support process from scratch at least once, and know the difference between building on a clean slate and rebuilding under pressure
* 3\+ years managing teams of 10 or more
* A genuine customer service mindset: your first instinct is to understand the person's situation before offering a solution
* Comfortable being hands\-on. You will still personally work the hardest escalations, not just review dashboards
* Sharp with data: comfortable defining metrics and using evidence to challenge assumptions, including your own team's
* Clear, structured communicator, since you report directly to the Founder
* Energized by ambiguity and the work of building something from an imperfect starting point



  





**Work Setup** 




 Bangalore, hybrid. As the senior\-most person in this function, you set the standard for availability and coverage, including stepping in personally when the team needs it.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive compensation, based on experience
* ESOPs, equity participation as the company grows
* Direct reporting line to the Founder
* Ownership of a combined team scaling from 12 to 20 in the near term
* Health and wellness benefits
* A culture that values ownership and evidence over process for its own sake

title: Key Account Manager, Maternity Hospitals (Multiple Cities)
description:
**About Us**
**BEMPU Health: Saving Lives, One Newborn at a Time**
 BEMPU Health is a purpose\-driven medical device company dedicated to improving newborn healthcare outcomes. We develop innovative, life\-saving devices for neonates, tackling critical challenges in resource\-limited settings. Funded by leading organizations like the Gates Foundation and USAID, our solutions are already making a difference in the lives of newborns in India and around the world. Our devices are used by UNICEF, government health programs, and top private hospitals, making a real impact on global newborn health. Join our mission and be part of something bigger!
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are hiring
 **Key Account Managers** 
 to own every private maternity hospital and hospital chain in their city. A single mid\-sized maternity hospital can become a substantial recurring account for us, so this is a role about depth rather than volume: landing new accounts, growing the ones we already have, and becoming the person every pediatrician and nursing superintendent in your city knows by name.
   

  

 We are hiring for
 **Bangalore, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune** 
 . Applicants from other cities are also welcome to apply.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the private maternity hospitals, nursing homes and hospital chains in your city as a named account list.
* Land new accounts: identify the high\-delivery\-volume hospitals, get the first meeting, place evaluation samples, and follow through to a first purchase order.
* Grow existing accounts by expanding from one product to our full range, and from one unit of the hospital to the whole facility.
* Build lasting relationships with neonatologists, pediatricians, nursing superintendents and procurement staff.
* Run in\-person product demonstrations and in\-service training for nursing and NICU staff.
* Maintain a territory coverage plan and log every visit, sample and outcome in our CRM.
* Feed back market intelligence on competitor activity, pricing and unmet clinical needs.
* Represent BEMPU at local medical conferences, CMEs and exhibitions.


**Requirements**
* 1 to 6 years of field or key account sales experience, ideally in medical devices, diagnostics, healthcare or pharma.
* A track record of meeting or exceeding targets in a B2B or healthcare setting.
* Existing relationships with pediatricians or neonatologists in your city are a strong advantage.
* High energy and a real willingness to travel within and around your city on a daily basis.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with clinicians and hospital staff quickly.
* Self\-motivated and able to manage your own schedule and territory with limited supervision.
* Good spoken English plus the main local language of your city.
* Basic proficiency with CRM or field reporting tools.
* Bachelor's degree; Science, Pharmacy or Business preferred.


**Benefits**
* A defined territory you genuinely own, with real targets and real rewards.
* Selling a product with published clinical evidence behind it, to clinicians who want it to work.
* Direct collaboration with BEMPU's leadership, product and clinical teams.
* Health insurance and statutory benefits as applicable.
* A clear growth path as the commercial team scales across cities.


**Start Date:** 
 As soon as possible.

title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 2\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross\-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5\+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi\-workstream delivery programs ($5M\+/year in professional services revenue) end\-to\-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health
* Experience in adopting and championing emerging delivery methodologies and tooling that accelerate team productivity, including experience adapting governance frameworks for new technology\-driven delivery models


**Preferred Qualifications**
* cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect \- Associate
* Experience creating and implementing large\-scale programs
* MBA, or 3\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience in advising and influencing executive leadership
* Experience building trusted relationships with senior customer executives (VP\+) to influence strategic and operational decisions and managing escalation paths across complex stakeholder landscapes
* Experience in software development and proficiency in AI\-DLC or equivalent AI\-accelerated development methodologies at the governance and program leadership level, including experience adapting estimation, milestone tracking, and quality assurance frameworks for AI\-native delivery models
