title: Sr. Technical/Sr Product Support Engineer I
description:
Overview:

Planview has one mission: to build the future of connected work, from ideas to impact.  

As the global leader in work and resource management, Planview helps organizations accelerate the achievement of what matters most, supporting our customers from need to speed, from passion to progress, and from overhead to optimization. We provide the industry’s most comprehensive solutions designed for strategic planning, portfolio and resource management, Lean and Agile delivery, product portfolio management, capability, and technology management (enterprise architecture), innovation management, and collaborative work and project management. Our connected platform of solutions underpins the business and digital transformations of more than 4,500 customers globally, including 59 of the Fortune 100\.  

At Planview, our people connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1400\+ work remotely and across our offices including Austin, Vancouver, Hod Hasharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We’re proud of our world\-class, connected culture built on our shared values, that supports our teams to be successful from anywhere.  

The Support Operations team is at the heart of Planview's customer experience, ensuring that enterprises around the world get the most value from Planview's industry\-leading platform. As Planview expands its AI\-first portfolio through continued innovation and acquisition, the Support Operations team plays a critical role in delivering consistent, high\-quality technical assistance across a growing suite of solutions  

Learn more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X.
Responsibilities:
**Customer Support \& Expert Escalation Handling**

* Provide expert\-level technical support and guidance to customers and internal teams for KeyedIn and related technologies, serving as the senior escalation point for the Care queue.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for the most complex, high\-severity, or cross\-product escalated issues, driving them from intake to resolution.
* Lead root\-cause analysis for major incidents — distinguishing defect vs. configuration vs. data — and drive corrective actions that design out recurrence.
* Manage multiple high\-priority responsibilities simultaneously, making strategic decisions with minimal supervision, and retain Care ownership of the customer through Development, Tier 3, and Cloud Operations hand\-offs.

**Technical Leadership \& Tooling**

* Apply seasoned KeyedIn/PPM expertise and creative problem\-solving to resolve complex, cross\-functional issues across reporting/widgets, custom entities, resource/capacity/schedule, data loads, and integrations/APIs.
* Develop and maintain advanced troubleshooting tools, diagnostic queries, runbooks, and the BI/analytics layer used across the support team.
* Understand interrelationships across Planview product lines, support functions, and engineering systems, and factor them into escalation and RCA work.
* Analyze the support function for systemic weaknesses, then build stronger, reusable solutions that raise the whole team's efficiency and reduce knowledge single points of failure.

**Product Knowledge \& Strategic Contribution**

* Apply expert KeyedIn product knowledge to configuration guidance, best\-practice recommendations, and defect documentation to a Development\-ready standard for Product Management and Development.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of support processes, methodologies, severity discipline, and best practices.
* Contribute to the design and delivery of advanced technical training and certification programs for KeyedIn support engineers.
* Represent the technical support team in cross\-functional meetings and strategic planning sessions, and provide thought leadership to the manager and key stakeholders as input to long\-term direction.

**Mentoring \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Mentor and coach TSE I and TSE II engineers — reviewing case quality, coaching on reproduction and documentation, and accelerating their technical development and career growth.
* Own and expand the KeyedIn knowledge base, setting the standard for reusable diagnostics and Customer Success Center content.
* Build and maintain a professional brand in the KeyedIn/PPM domain, both internally and with strategic customers.
* Act with diplomacy and tact to manage conflicts or disagreements constructively across levels, functions, and geographies.


Qualifications:
**Required Qualifications**

* 6\+ years of experience in technical support, software support, or a closely related customer\-facing technical role, with at least 2 years at a senior or SME level.
* Demonstrated expert\-level ability to own and resolve the most complex, high\-severity, or cross\-functional escalations in enterprise software or SaaS environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to provide thought leadership to managers and executives and to influence direction through expertise.
* Experience leading root\-cause analysis for major incidents and driving corrective actions across teams, including reproducing and documenting defects to an engineering\-ready standard.
* Proven track record of mentoring and developing technical talent at the junior and mid\-level.
* Experience representing a technical function in cross\-functional or strategic planning forums (e.g., QBRs, product reviews, incident post\-mortems).
* Works with minimal supervision; demonstrated ability to self\-direct priorities and hold accountability for team\-level outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated track record of building advanced troubleshooting tools, BI dashboards, training programs, or support methodologies adopted by the wider team.
* Expert\-level SQL, API, and integration troubleshooting skills with the ability to advise engineering teams on root\-cause findings and schema\-level problems.
* Deep knowledge of cloud platform architecture (Azure, AWS) and enterprise identity management (SSO, OAuth, SAML, RBAC) at an architectural level.
* Hands\-on expertise with BI/analytics platforms (Power BI, Tableau, SSRS) sufficient to design and own the team's reporting and support\-analytics layer.
* Experience contributing to or leading cross\-functional product\-improvement, process\-design, or support\-transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of the Planview product ecosystem; experience supporting multiple Planview product lines (KeyedIn and adjacent PPM/work\-management solutions) is a strong differentiator.
* Advanced technology certifications (ITIL Expert, Microsoft Certified Expert, AWS Solutions Architect, or similar).

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**

* A seasoned, autonomous professional who can decide and act without having the whole picture — nimble, resilient, and able to adjust priorities and strategies quickly.
* Maintains a positive attitude despite adversity and grows from setbacks — models this behavior for junior team members.
* Builds constructive relationships across all levels, functions, cultures, and geographies, and earns the trust of colleagues and stakeholders.
* Seeks out diverse perspectives and finds opportunities to collaborate; acts with diplomacy and tact to manage conflicts equitably.
* Creates strategies that show a clear connection between vision and action; thinks broadly and introduces new ways of looking at problems.
* Encourages diverse thinking and nurtures innovation across the support team.
* Shows a strong capacity to make complex decisions; seeks input from leadership and key stakeholders for the most consequential choices.
* Committed to continuous learning and staying current on emerging trends, technologies, and best practices — and inspires the same curiosity in others.
* Expert user of AI\-assisted tools (e.g., Planview Anvi, Copilot) who actively promotes their adoption across the support team.

**Technical Skillset (Product\-Specific)**

*Experience Required: 6\+ years (2\+ at senior/SME level).*

**Must Have**

* **Expert KeyedIn / PPM \& Data\-Model Mastery —** authoritative command of projects, resources, timesheets, dashboards, reporting/widgets, custom entities, and the underlying data model; able to advise Development on schema\- and design\-level problems.
* **Expert SQL \& Data Diagnostics —** writes and reviews complex queries and stored\-procedure logic, independently diagnoses data\-integrity issues, and builds the diagnostic queries the rest of the team reuses.
* **Business Intelligence \& Analytics Leadership (BI) —** expert with Power BI, Tableau, or SSRS; designs and owns the KeyedIn support\-analytics and customer\-reporting diagnostic layer — building data models, semantic layers, and executive dashboards (case trends, SLA, defect hotspots, churn\-risk signals), advising engineering and customers on data\-model, DAX/measure, and refresh/performance issues, and setting the BI standards the TSE I/II tiers consume.
* **Expert API / Integration Troubleshooting —** traces end\-to\-end integration failures across authentication, payload, and network layers, and designs test harnesses that engineering teams can reuse for reproduction.
* **Observability \& Incident Post\-Mortems —** deep expertise in log analysis, distributed tracing, and observability tooling (Splunk, CloudWatch, Datadog, HAR, or similar) sufficient to independently run incident post\-mortems and drive root\-cause findings.
* **Cloud Architecture Fluency —** advanced working knowledge of cloud platform architecture (Azure or AWS) as it relates to KeyedIn hosting — sufficient to work independently alongside Cloud Operations and SRE teams during major incidents.
* **Enterprise Identity \& Access Management —** expert with SSO, OAuth 2\.0, SAML, RBAC, and MFA at an implementation and troubleshooting level, including tracing authentication failures across identity\-provider and service\-provider logs.
* **Defect Reproduction, RCA \& Cross\-Functional Drive —** reproduces and documents defects to a Development\-ready standard and drives them with Product Management and Development to a permanent, recurrence\-preventing fix.

**Nice to Have**

* **Advanced BI Governance —** row\-level security, embedded/paginated analytics, dataflows/pipelines, and reusable semantic models for the wider support organization.
* **Scripting / Automation Development —** Python, JavaScript, or PowerShell sufficient to build and maintain diagnostic automation tools used by the broader support team.
* **Training \& Enablement Design —** designing and delivering technical training or certification for support engineers, including curriculum development, facilitation, and content upkeep.
* **Agile / Product\-Delivery Fluency —** Agile, SAFe, or product\-delivery frameworks sufficient to represent Support Operations in sprint reviews, PI planning, or roadmap discussions.
* **Support\-Transformation Leadership —** contributing to or leading a tooling\-modernisation, knowledge\-management, or support\-transformation initiative with measurable team\-wide impact.
* **Jira \& Broader Planview Familiarity —** advanced defect\-tracking workflows and exposure across Planview's PPM / work\-management portfolio.

title: Sr Manager, Software Engineering
description:

JOB DESCRIPTION
**Innovate in Bengaluru**


This position is based at our on\-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting\-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on\-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.

  


**About Lowe’s** Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.


Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India.


**Role Summary**


Lead the infrastructure engineering organization responsible for network telemetry, network automation management, virtualization platforms, and AI\-driven Operations strategy. This leader will establish technical direction, develop high\-performing engineering teams, and deliver secure, scalable capabilities that improve network visibility, reliability, and operational efficiency within an overall AI operations vision.  

  



**Key Responsibilities**


* Lead and coach software and network engineering engineers across telemetry, automation, and virtualization domains.
* Define and execute the engineering roadmap for network observability, telemetry pipelines, automation platforms, and virtualized infrastructure with a priority on solutioning this roadmap for an AI Operations future state.
* Partner with Network Engineering, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Architecture, and Product stakeholders to prioritize outcomes and align delivery to enterprise needs.
* Integrate the principles of software engineering into a comprehensive AI Operations strategy across all team activities which will be used to enhance infrastructure observability and improvement performance of Lowe's infrastructure services.
* Establish and align with engineering standards for software quality, reliability, security, CI/CD, testing, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Drive modernization of network automation workflows, including configuration management, orchestration, compliance validation, and remediation.
* Influences and establishes best\-in\-class engineering practices through sound design decisions; conducts regular code reviews to ensure teams adhere to best practices; and is directly involved with resolving defects at the code and platform levels.
* Develop integration principles with vendor platform systems for infrastructure telemetry, automation, and performance.
* Oversee development and operation of telemetry services that collect, process, store, and present network health and performance data.
* Lead the design and evolution of virtualization integrations and platform capabilities supporting network and infrastructure services.
* Manage capacity planning, vendor relationships, financial planning, and delivery metrics for the engineering portfolio.
* Develop talent through hiring, performance management, succession planning, and technical career development.
**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

\* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years leading engineering teams.
  

\* Demonstrated experience delivering production software for network automation, network telemetry, observability, infrastructure platforms, or virtualization.
  

\* Strong knowledge of network technologies and protocols, such as routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, syslog, NetFlow/IPFIX, gNMI, or streaming telemetry.
  

\* Experience with automation and configuration\-management tooling, such as Python, Ansible, Terraform, APIs, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
  

\* Experience with virtualization and cloud platforms, such as VMware, Kubernetes, OpenShift, AWS, Azure, or equivalent technologies.
  

\* Proven ability to translate business and operational goals into technical roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
  

\* Strong communication, stakeholder\-management, and people\-leadership skills.

***You will build a success function for Saas Marketplace from scratch.***

 bizdeals.gonuclei.com (AWS drives our bulk of the business)

**About IWG**


With almost 4,000 tech\-enabled, sustainable and inspiring centres across the world, we’re already four times the scale of our nearest competitor – and we’re continuing to grow.


With 80% of the Fortune 500 already among our customers, and plans to expand to 30,000\+ centres over the next decade, we’re uniquely placed to offer the right person exciting career opportunities as we continue pioneering the workspaces of tomorrow.


We know we can only succeed if we give all our people every opportunity to shine. That’s why so many of our most senior leaders started their careers in our centres.


We’re also proud of reducing commuting\-related carbon emissions by getting workers out of their cars and onto their bikes and their feet. Alongside our investments in advanced buildings, this supports our commitment to be carbon neutral – which we achieved in 2023\.


So don’t hesitate. Apply today – and let’s work together to help millions of people have a great day at work.

title: Supervisor, Real Assets Operations Skills Development
description:
**About Citco:**

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 80 offices worldwide. With more than $1 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end\-to\-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.


For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com .


**About the Team \& Business Line:**

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.  



  

As part of the Real Assets Operations Skills Development team, you will help build accounting, technical and operational capabilities across our Real Assets business through training, onboarding and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.


  
**Your Role:**

* Develop, maintain and periodically update training materials, process guides and onboarding documentation in line with curriculum standards and guidance from the (Assistant) / Vice President and Subject Matter Experts.
* Translate operational procedures, process updates and system enhancements into practical training and knowledge\-sharing materials, ensuring alignment with approved policies and practices.
* Support the review and update of training content following process, system or regulatory changes, identifying and escalating content gaps where appropriate.
* Coordinate with Subject Matter Experts to arrange training sessions, gather content and follow up on agreed actions.
* Deliver onboarding, introductory and process\-level training covering operational procedures, recurring tasks, documentation standards and system navigation.
* Provide day\-to\-day onboarding support to new joiners, helping them navigate training materials, process documentation and operational resources.
* Maintain training records, attendance logs, feedback trackers, version control and completion monitoring, and support scheduling and invitations for training programmes.
* Maintain approved training and process documentation within designated knowledge management repositories, ensuring information remains accurate and accessible.
* Monitor recurring operational errors, training challenges and documentation gaps, and escalate recurring training needs, quality concerns and recommendations to the (Assistant) / Vice President.
* Maintain a proactive internal customer focus, provide practical support to trainees, reviewers and managers.
* Perform other duties as required to support the Company's business needs.

  
**About You:**

* Degree in Business, Finance or a related discipline desirable; part\-qualified or working towards an ACA, CA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent professional designation an advantage.
* Minimum 6 years of private and/or public accounting experience, ideally including exposure to Real Assets and Fund Accounting.
* Working understanding of SPV accounting, real estate structures, operational processes, reporting cycles and review expectations.
* Experience delivering onboarding and process\-level training and supporting structured knowledge transfer, with the ability to explain operational and system processes clearly.
* Experience developing, updating and maintaining training materials, process documentation and knowledge\-sharing resources to established standards.
* Well\-organised, with strong attention to detail in maintaining training records, version control, attendance and completion tracking.
* Ability to identify content gaps, recurring training needs and process inconsistencies and escalate them appropriately.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, facilitation and business writing skills, with the ability to collaborate with Subject Matter Experts, Operations teams and Learning \& Development; solid Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint skills, and exposure to fund accounting systems (Yardi and/or Investran an advantage).
A motivated, proactive self\-starter with a passion for supporting others, able to work independently, manage multiple priorities and collaborate across locations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.  
* 

**Our Benefits**

Your wellbeing is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.


We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.


Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

title: Manager, Supply Chain Learning & Organizational Excellence
description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-254233 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 08, 2026 CATEGORY: Supply Chain
**Manager, Supply Chain Learning \& Organizational Excellence**
===============================================================

**Location:** Amgen India  

**Career Framework:** GCF 5 – Manager

**Role Overview**
-----------------


The Manager, Supply Chain Learning \& Organizational Excellence will play a key role in enabling the growth, effectiveness and long\-term capability of the Supply Chain organization at Amgen India. The role will work closely with site and global Supply Chain leadership to translate organizational priorities into coordinated execution, strengthen operating rhythms, support cross\-functional initiatives, and build the learning capabilities required for a high\-performing and compliant organization.


A significant focus of the role will be to establish, sustain and continuously mature the Supply Chain Learning \& Development program at Amgen India. The successful candidate will help evolve this capability toward a comprehensive Supply Chain Academy that enables structured onboarding, knowledge transfer, technical and functional capability development, and continuous learning across the organization.


This role requires a combination of strong program leadership, organizational effectiveness, learning operations, GxP knowledge and the ability to work across a complex global and cross\-functional environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Organizational Enablement \& Strategic Execution**

* Partner with Supply Chain leadership to translate strategic priorities into coordinated plans, actions, milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Establish and maintain effective operating rhythms across key organizational priorities, including leadership reviews, initiative tracking, decision follow\-up, risk management and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Provide structure and visibility across strategic initiatives by consolidating progress, identifying risks and interdependencies, and enabling timely escalation and decision\-making.
* Coordinate across Planning, Distribution, Enablement, Customer Service, Clinical Supply Chain and other in\-scope functions to connect priorities, process knowledge, capability requirements and organizational needs.
* Develop leadership\-ready materials, insights and progress updates that enable effective governance and informed decision\-making.
* Support organizational change, capability\-building and continuous\-improvement initiatives as the Amgen India Supply Chain organization grows and matures.

### **Learning \& Capability Development**

* Execute global GxP learning strategies, standards and frameworks for in\-scope global Supply Chain functions, adapting implementation to meet Amgen India organizational and site needs.
* Build, sustain and continuously improve the Supply Chain Learning \& Development program, establishing the foundations for an integrated Supply Chain Academy.
* Develop a structured capability\-development approach spanning onboarding, role\-based learning, technical and functional knowledge, leadership development, continuous learning and knowledge retention.
* Support the Supply Chain knowledge\-transfer plan for Amgen India onboarding, including transfer cadence, readiness assessments, risk identification, progress tracking and stakeholder coordination.
* Partner with functional leaders and subject matter experts to identify current and future capability requirements and translate them into scalable learning solutions and development pathways.
* Lead implementation and execution of Supply Chain training programs at the site level, ensuring alignment with GMP/GxP/GDP requirements, Amgen quality standards and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Establish measures to assess learning effectiveness, organizational capability and program maturity, using insights to continuously strengthen the learning strategy.

### **GxP Learning Operations \& Governance**

* Create, revise and maintain Training Assignment Profiles (TAPs), associated learning and assessment materials, SOPs, work instructions, job aids and other learning documentation using approved templates, systems and workflows.
* Ensure appropriate document ownership, version control, traceability, approvals and inspection readiness across learning materials.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Supply Chain learning operations, including training intake, LMS processes, training assignments, completion tracking and day\-to\-day training activities.
* Support audits and regulatory inspections by preparing training reports, responding to training\-record requests and supporting direct interface with auditors or inspectors as assigned.
* Participate in the GxP Learning Community of Practice and collaborate with global learning partners to advance continuous improvement, change management, standardization and learning governance.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and scale learning processes while maintaining compliance and quality.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Master’s degree and 8\-12 and relevant professional experience; OR
* Bachelor’s degree and significant relevant professional experience in Supply Chain, Learning \& Development, Quality, Operations, Organizational Effectiveness or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience working in a regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device or similarly controlled environment.
* Experience supporting or leading cross\-functional programs involving multiple stakeholders, priorities and dependencies.
* Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple interconnected workstreams and provide clear visibility to leadership.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information into concise, leadership\-ready communications.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and influencing skills with demonstrated effectiveness working across functions, organizational levels and geographies.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Ability to operate effectively in an evolving environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset with an interest in building scalable, sustainable organizational capabilities.
* Experience within pharmaceutical or biotechnology Supply Chain
* Strong understanding of GxP/GMP/GDP requirements and their application to training, qualification and learning operations.
* Experience designing, implementing or scaling learning and capability\-development programs in a complex organization.
* Experience with LMS platforms, controlled documentation, training assignment processes and learning governance.
* Experience supporting knowledge transfer, organizational onboarding or establishment of new teams or capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to convert broad organizational priorities into structured execution plans and operating mechanisms.

**Working Expectations**
------------------------

* Collaborate extensively with colleagues and stakeholders across Amgen India and the global organization.
* Work across global time zones as required to support international teams and initiatives.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


Success in this role will be reflected in a well\-connected and effectively operating Supply Chain organization, strong visibility and execution against key organizational priorities, and a sustainable learning ecosystem that enables employees to become proficient in their roles and continue developing throughout their careers.


Over time, the role will help establish an integrated Supply Chain Academy that preserves critical organizational knowledge, accelerates onboarding and proficiency, develops functional and leadership capabilities, and creates a culture of continuous learning across Amgen India Supply Chain.

 .
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**India Customer Success Leader**




**Location: Gurgaon/ Mumbai**




**The Role**




 We are seeking a transformational Customer Success \& Consulting Leader to drive strategic growth, customer value realization, and executive engagement across NielsenIQ’s FMCG and Technology \& Durables businesses in India. This leader will define and execute the customer success strategy, build deep C\-suite relationships, and position NIQ as a trusted strategic partner for some of India's leading organizations.
   

  





 The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, consulting expertise, customer leadership, and people management capabilities to accelerate growth, strengthen client partnerships, and deliver measurable business outcomes. They will serve as the voice of the customer internally while influencing strategic decisions across Commercial, Product, Analytics, Data Science, and Operations teams.
   

  





 This highly visible leadership role offers the opportunity to shape a future\-ready Customer Success organization, foster a culture of collaboration and excellence, and influence the future direction of NielsenIQ's customer engagement model
   

  





  

  





**Key Leadership Accountabilities**




**Strategic Customer Leadership**



* Build and manage strategic relationships with C\-suite executives across key customer accounts, positioning NIQ as a trusted advisor and growth partner for both the verticals
* Act as the voice of customers within NielsenIQ, ensuring customer priorities are reflected in product innovation, business planning, and service delivery strategies
* Lead customer transformation conversations, connecting market intelligence, analytics, and insights to measurable business outcomes. Drive customer adoption, value realization, retention, and long\-term partnership growth
* Serve as the executive escalation point for critical customer opportunities and challenges



  

  





**Drive Commercial Growth**



* Drive a disciplined account growth strategy by identifying whitespace opportunities, expanding strategic partnerships, and accelerating cross\-sell and upsell initiatives
* Partner closely with Commercial, Product, Pricing, and Operations teams to unlock sustainable growth and maximize customer lifetime value
* Influence revenue growth by aligning customer priorities with NIQ capabilities and innovation roadmap
* Create a scalable framework for value\-based customer engagement that strengthens loyalty and accelerates growth



**Lead a High\-Performing Organization**



* Inspire, align, and empower a high\-performing Customer Success and Consulting organization to achieve ambitious growth and customer impact objectives
* Develop future\-ready capabilities and a strong leadership pipeline through coaching, talent development, mentoring, and succession planning
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, customer centricity, and excellence
* Drive organizational effectiveness through clear governance, workforce planning, resource allocation, and fit\-for\-purpose operating models
* Champion employee engagement, inclusion, and continuous learning to build a best\-in\-class Customer Success function



**Shape Cross\-Functional Strategy**



* Influence strategic priorities and decisions across Commercial, Product, Data Science, Engineering, Operations, and Analytics teams to deliver integrated customer outcomes
* Translate customer needs and market opportunities into clear priorities for business planning, solution development, and service innovation
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives that improve customer experience, operational excellence, solution adoption, and overall business performance
* Establish strong alignment and accountability across functions to ensure consistent execution against strategic customer commitments
* Contribute customer and market perspectives to NielsenIQ’s broader India business strategy and innovation agenda



  

  





**E** 
**stablish Customer Success Excellence**



* Define and institutionalize Customer Success methodologies, performance standards, governance mechanisms, and operating rhythms across the organization
* Build differentiated and scalable customer engagement models based on customer needs, strategic value, and growth potential
* Establish a disciplined approach to measuring customer health, adoption, value realization, satisfaction, retention, and growth
* Leverage customer insights, market intelligence, and performance data to proactively identify risks, resolve barriers, and unlock growth opportunities
* Drive continuous improvement across customer experience, service quality, consulting effectiveness, and operational efficiency
* Embed best practices and capability\-building programs that strengthen Customer Success maturity and deliver consistent customer outcomes



  

  





**What Success Looks Like**




 The successful leader will:
   

  




* Elevate NielsenIQ's strategic position with key customers
* Increase customer retention, advocacy, and lifetime value
* Accelerate revenue growth across existing customer portfolios
* Strengthen executive\-level customer relationships
* Improve Net Promoter Scores (NPS) and customer satisfaction metrics
* Build a highly engaged and high\-performing team
* Drive greater adoption of NielsenIQ's analytics, measurement, and consulting solutions
* Create a scalable and future\-ready Customer Success organization



  

  





**Why This Role?**




 This is not a traditional Customer Success leadership position.
   

  





 It is an opportunity to lead a strategically important function at the intersection of customer growth, consulting, analytics, and commercial strategy. You will shape how some of the world's leading brands leverage data and insights to make critical business decisions while building a high\-performing team and influencing the future direction of NielsenIQ's customer engagement model.

* Demonstrated success building strategic client partnerships and influencing C\-suite stakeholders

title: Wealth Manager
description:
**Locations:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 years
 



**Industry:** 
 Wealth Management
 



**Company:** 
 Stockify Fintech
 



**Package:** 

 Fixed CTC: Rs. 5\.0 Lakhs per annum \+ Yearly bonus (3\-6 months salary)
 








**About Stockify** 




  






 Stockify is building India's most trusted marketplace for pre\-IPO and unlisted shares, giving HNI and UHNI investors access to exclusive investment opportunities before companies go public. We cover a wide universe of high\-growth unlisted companies across sectors and provide investors with pricing, research and seamless transaction support. Our offices are in Bengaluru, Mumbai, Gurugram and Dubai, and we are expanding our wealth management team aggressively to serve the growing demand from sophisticated investors.
 




  





**About the Role** 




  






 We are hiring experienced Wealth Managers for our Mumbai office. This is a senior client\-facing role where you will manage a portfolio of HNI and UHNI investors, advise them on pre\-IPO and unlisted share investment opportunities, and drive AUM and revenue growth for Stockify. The role combines relationship management, investment advisory and business development in equal measure.
 




  






 This is the right role for a wealth professional who already understands how HNI clients think, has experience with alternative investments or capital markets products, and wants to work in one of the most exciting and high\-growth segments of Indian finance. You will have the full backing of Stockify's research, operations and technology teams, but the relationships you build and the revenue you generate will be very much your own.
 




  





**What You Will Do** 




  




* Build, manage and grow a dedicated book of HNI and UHNI clients who are interested in pre\-IPO and unlisted share investments, with a focus on deepening relationships and increasing AUM over time
* Advise clients on specific unlisted share opportunities available on the Stockify platform, clearly explaining pricing, liquidity considerations, transfer timelines, risk factors and potential upside in a way that is suitable to their financial profile
* Proactively source new HNI leads through your personal network, referrals from existing clients, community events, industry associations and targeted outreach to high\-net\-worth individuals across Mumbai \& west India
* Conduct client meetings, portfolio reviews and investment update calls at regular intervals, keeping clients informed on the performance of their holdings and new opportunities that match their profile
* Cross\-sell Stockify's broader investment offering to existing clients and introduce referrals to the B2B sales team where appropriate
* Work closely with the back office team to ensure smooth and timely execution of all client transactions, including documentation, share transfer and settlement
* Maintain detailed and up\-to\-date records of all client interactions, portfolios, upcoming transactions and follow\-ups in the CRM on a daily basis
* Represent Stockify professionally at investor events, wealth management conferences and community gatherings to build brand visibility and source new relationships



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  




* Three to six years of experience in wealth management, private banking, investment advisory or relationship management within a financial services organisation
* A strong and demonstrable existing network of HNI clients in Mumbai and west India who trust your investment recommendations and are open to alternative investments
* Prior experience advising clients on alternative investment products such as PMS, AIF, unlisted shares, pre\-IPO investments, structured products or private equity is strongly preferred
* NISM certification in Mutual Funds Distribution or Investment Advisory is preferred; candidates without certification but with a strong track record will also be considered
* Excellent consultative selling skills, with the ability to explain complex investment ideas in a simple and compelling way without oversimplifying the risks involved
* High integrity, a client\-first approach and the professional maturity to build lasting relationships based on trust rather than transactional interactions
* Self\-motivated with the discipline to independently manage a pipeline, set your own outreach schedule and consistently deliver against revenue targets



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 




  




* Fixed CTC: Rs. 5\.0 Lakhs per annum \+ Yearly bonus
* Performance Incentives: Bonus of up to 3 to 6 months of monthly salary, paid based on individual and company performance
* Review Cycle: Performance review at 6 months with potential for salary revision, with earning potential that grows significantly with AUM and revenue performance

title: Salesforce Architect – Service 2.0
description:
#### **Job Description**


Job Description
  

Salesforce Architect – Service 2\.0
  

About Service 2\.0
  

Service 2\.0 is Blue Star's three\-year transformation of the Unitary Products service business, moving from reactive complaint handling to proactive ownership of the customer experience.
  

The programme is redesigning the complete customer journey — from installation and warranty onboarding through breakdown, repair, closure and renewal — on a modern service technology stack comprising Salesforce as the system of record, Salesforce Field Service (FSL) for the technician workforce, a bi\-directional integration backbone with SAP and partner systems, and a WhatsApp\-first customer communication layer.
  

The transformation includes GenAI\-powered service bots and self\-service, intelligent ticket allocation, workforce capacity optimisation, mobile\-first field workflows, digital proof\-of\-work, AI\-assisted audit, predictive analytics and role\-based performance dashboards.
  

The programme operates across a pan\-India service ecosystem of partners and technicians and is measured through business outcomes including warranty cost, first\-time\-fix rate, turnaround time and customer satisfaction.
  

Role: Salesforce Architect – Service 2\.0
  

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect to own the technology architecture and solution design for the Service 2\.0 transformation.
  

The person will be responsible for translating business and service transformation objectives into a scalable Salesforce architecture covering Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Field Service, integrations, digital channels, automation, analytics and AI/GenAI capabilities.
  

The role will work closely with business leaders, service operations, IT teams, Salesforce/product teams, integration teams, partners and implementation vendors to establish a robust architecture that can scale across Blue Star's pan\-India service network.
  

Key Responsibilities
  

1\. Salesforce Architecture \& Solution Design
  

* Own the end\-to\-end Salesforce architecture for Service 2\.0\.
* Define the target architecture across Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Field Service, Experience Cloud/digital channels and supporting Salesforce capabilities.
* Translate business requirements and service\-process designs into scalable, secure and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Define application, data, integration and security architecture.
* Establish architecture principles, design standards and reusable patterns.
* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend their adoption where they create measurable business value.
* Ensure the architecture remains scalable for future service transformation initiatives.

2\. Field Service \& Technician Transformation
  

* Architect Salesforce Field Service solutions supporting the complete technician lifecycle.
* Design solutions for work\-order management, intelligent scheduling, dispatch, technician allocation, capacity planning, mobility and digital proof\-of\-work.
* Enable optimisation of technician productivity, travel, skill matching, SLA adherence and first\-time\-fix.
* Design mobile\-first experiences suitable for a large and diverse pan\-India technician ecosystem.
* Ensure solutions work effectively across service partners and different operating models.

3\. Customer Service \& Digital Experience
  

* Architect end\-to\-end customer journeys across complaint registration, service request, appointment, technician visit, repair, closure and renewal.
* Design WhatsApp\-first and digital self\-service journeys integrated with Salesforce.
* Define architecture for GenAI\-powered service bots and assisted customer\-service journeys.
* Enable consistent customer interactions across digital and assisted service channels.
* Ensure customer, asset, warranty and service history are available as a unified view.

4\. Integration Architecture
  

* Own the Salesforce integration architecture with SAP, partner systems, WhatsApp and other enterprise applications.
* Define API, event\-driven and bi\-directional integration patterns.
* Ensure reliable synchronisation of customer, product, asset, warranty, service and transaction data.
* Establish standards for integration security, monitoring, error handling, retry mechanisms and performance.
* Work with integration architects and technology teams to build a scalable integration backbone.

5\. AI, GenAI \& Intelligent Service
  

* Define the architecture for AI/GenAI use cases within the service ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to use AI for customer self\-service, case classification and summarisation, technician assistance, smart ticket allocation, capacity and demand forecasting, audit and anomaly detection, and predictive service analytics.
* Ensure AI solutions are integrated appropriately into Salesforce workflows and user experiences.
* Establish governance around data, security, accuracy and responsible AI adoption.

6\. Data, Analytics \& Performance Management
  

* Define the Salesforce data architecture supporting service analytics and reporting.
* Ensure data quality, consistency and availability across the service ecosystem.
* Enable role\-based dashboards for service leaders, managers, partners and field teams.
* Work with data and analytics teams to enable predictive service insights.
* Establish architecture that supports measurement of warranty cost, first\-time\-fix, turnaround time, technician productivity and customer satisfaction.

7\. Governance \& Technical Leadership
  

* Act as the technical authority for Salesforce architecture within Service 2\.0\.
* Review and approve solution designs, technical specifications and major changes.
* Establish Salesforce development, configuration, integration and release\-management standards.
* Drive technical debt reduction and platform optimisation.
* Ensure appropriate Salesforce licensing and platform utilisation.
* Conduct architecture reviews and ensure adherence to enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Mentor Salesforce developers, administrators and implementation partners.

8\. Partner \& Programme Management
  

* Work closely with Salesforce, system integrators and technology partners.
* Provide technical direction to implementation partners and ensure adherence to the target architecture.
* Challenge solution designs where required and ensure commercial and technical decisions are aligned.
* Support programme planning, estimation, prioritisation and technology\-roadmap decisions.
* Ensure successful transition from implementation to sustainable operations and support.

Key Deliverables / Success Measures

Collaborates on the commercial management of complex tailored standard renewal and new business deals. * Align commercial aspects with technical solutions and limitations by working closely with SITA's technical and solution communities.

Chat Operations Manager is responsible for leading and optimizing the performance of customer service team focused on chat interactions. The manager will lead, develop, and mentor their agents, implement strategic initiatives for chat operations, and foster a culture of digital excellence and continuous improvement.

* Performance Management: Establish, monitor, and achieve critical chat\-specific customer service KPIs, including Average Response Time (ART), Concurrent Chat Handling, Chat Abandonment Rate, Quality Assurance (QA) scores for written interactions, and First Contact Resolution (FCR) in digital channels. Develop and implement strategies to enhance these metrics.
* Team Development \& Coaching: Lead, coach, and mentor team members focusing on effective written communication, tone, multi\-tasking skills in a chat environment, and efficient use of chat tools and resources. Conduct regular performance reviews and identify development opportunities.
* Strategy \& Planning: Contribute to the strategic development and execution of digital customer service initiatives, including integrating new chat technologies, optimizing chat flows, and exploring AI/chatbot synergies to improve efficiency and customer experience.
* Process Improvement: Identify areas for improvement within chat operations, implement best practices for digital engagement, streamline chat processes (e.g., template usage, knowledge base integration), and reduce resolution times. Drive continuous improvement based on data analysis and customer feedback.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Technology, Bot team and Quality Assurance to ensure seamless integration of chat channels and alignment with overall business goals.
* Reporting \& Analysis: Analyze chat interaction data, generate comprehensive reports on team performance, chat trends, and bot performance. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for strategic decision\-making.
* Issue Resolution: Serve as an escalation point for complex or sensitive customer issues encountered via chat, ensuring timely and effective resolution while upholding service standards.
* Compliance \& Risk Management: Ensure all chat operations comply with internal policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements pertaining to digital communication and data privacy. Identify and mitigate potential operational risks
* Projects \& Initiatives: Lead and participate in various projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing the chat platform, introducing new features, improving agent tools, or integrating with other digital channels to elevate the overall digital customer experience.

* Technical Proficiency: Proficient in chat management systems, knowledge base systems, and familiarity with AI/chatbot technologies. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

description:

title: Customer Service
description:
About Clean Harbors Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $4\.3 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CEO.
  
  

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
  
  

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
  
  

**Process:** Customer Success
  
  

**Location:** Pune, Baner
  
  

**Previous Experience:** 2\+ Years
  
  

**Shift Timings:** US Shifts (4:30 PM – 9:00 PM as a Login)
  
  

**Job Overview:** Customer Success Associate will be the primary point of contact for our customers. Through the interactions, they will help our customers see the value in our product/services and ensure they are able to use it to its fullest potential. The prime responsibility of this position is to manage inbound calls from our existing customers and assist in an efficient, courteous, professional manner. The key role involves providing customer support via phone, email/chat \- processing payments, scheduling services, handling general queries and cross sell our products across North A
  
  

Roles And Responsibilities
  
  

➢ Being the first point of contact for customers and handling all customer inquiries and focusing on First Call Resolution.
  
  

➢ The team will be responsible to ensure that our customer data is secured while taking payments/ billing queries, scheduling services, or sharing any documents requested by the customer.
  
  

➢ The customer success team will seek opportunities to upsell new services/cross sell additional products to existing customers after they assess their needs and requirements.
  
  

➢ Maintain sales pipeline and follow up towards the closure of pending sales opportunities. Perform daily sales activities, and other tasks assigned by the sales manager or supervisor.
  
  

➢ The team will be responsible for managing adherence and hygiene while handling these calls.
  
  

➢ Apply active listening skills to diffuse a potential escalation or if required follow through with the right channel for escalation.
  
  

**Skills Required:**  

➢ Overall, 2\+ years of experience with strong handling of B2B \& B2C Inbound Sales.
  
  

➢ Excellent communication and stakeholder management with an ability to be both persuasive and influential.
  
  

➢ Proficient in English communication skills (Neutral). Should have great relationship building skills and customer orientation to understand customer needs and provide tailored solutions.
  
  

➢ Tremendous work ethic, high integrity, willingness to learn, laser\-focused, passionate \& committed.
  
  

➢ Growth mindset and high change agility – ability to learn new things quickly and can adapt to and champion change with peers and others. A Team player who thrives in a rapidly changing environment
  
  

➢ Disciplined in business management; adaptable to a culture of accountability; meets sales targets and operational standards.
  
  

➢ Must be proficient in objection handling while pitching or new sale.

title: Manager - Customer Delight
description:
**Location: Ugaoo Farm, Talegaon (On\-site) \-** https://maps.app.goo.gl/8cQ7yiL4HhAt9m596### **About Us:**


AUgaoo is a leading D2C brand in India's booming home gardening space. We provide a comprehensive range of live plants, seeds, tools, and plant care essentials. Our mission is to make urban gardening accessible, enjoyable, and sustainable. We are a content\-first company dedicated to building the ultimate community for plant parents.### **What does that mean for you?**


It means you have the opportunity to be part of a dynamic, fast\- growing company that blends time\-tested wisdom with modern innovation. As a young company, Ugaoo is the perfect place for those eager to make an impact, push boundaries, and grow—both personally and professionally.### **What’s In It for You?**

* **Continuous Learning:**At Ugaoo, we’re committed to your personal and professional development. Whether you’re honing your skills or exploring new ones, we provide the tools and environment you need to grow.
* **Ownership of Your Journey:** You’ll have the freedom to take charge of your projects and see them through from start to finish. We value initiative and empower our team members to lead with confidence.
* **Collaborative Culture:** You’ll work alongside a team of passionate individuals who support each other every step of the way. We believe in the power of collaboration, where every voice is heard, and every idea counts.
* **Room to Shine:** In our performance\-driven environment, your contributions won’t go unnoticed. We celebrate success and ensure that your achievements are recognized and rewarded.

### **About the Opportunity:**


As the Manager – Customer Delight, you will lead a team dedicated to enhancing our customers’ plant care journey. You’ll ensure proactive and engaging support by empowering your team with the right training, resources, and strategies. This role is pivotal in fostering lasting relationships, driving loyalty, and promoting a culture of customer\-centric excellence.### **Responsibilities:**

**Customer Experience*** Design and implement strategies to improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention.
* Ensure customers receive proactive support, education, and guidance for their gardening needs.
* Resolve escalated customer issues, ensuring timely and satisfactory outcomes.
* Set clear performance goals and consistently monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as response time, resolution time, customer satisfaction (CSAT), and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
* Ensure the Net Promoter Score (NPS) remains above 90% by delivering exceptional customer experiences and fostering loyalty.
* Continuously identify and implement opportunities to enhance customer satisfaction across all communication channels, including phone, email, chat, and social media platforms like Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Instagram (comments and DMs).
* Develop and maintain customer service policies, procedures, and standards.

**Team Management and Development*** Recruit, mentor, and manage the Customer Delight team.
* Conduct regular training sessions and workshops focused on plant management and customer engagement.
* Foster an environment of encouragement, empowerment, and professional growth.

**Industry Awareness and Innovation*** Stay ahead of industry trends and incorporate best practices into the team’s approach.
* Leverage the latest tools and technologies to enhance customer interactions and support efficiency.

### **Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in any field
* Proven experience in a customer service as Assistant Manager/Manager, preferably in the D2C company
* Strong leadership and team\-building skills, with a focus on mentoring and development.
* Proficiency in customer service tools, software, and databases.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong troubleshooting capabilities.
* Ability to think strategically, manage priorities, and implement innovative solutions.
* Passion for gardening and knowledge of plant care is highly desirable.

### **Who We’re Looking For**


We’re looking for individuals who are ready to take the next step in their career. If you’re driven, eager to learn, and excited about taking ownership of your work, Ugaoo is the place for you. **Join us, and let’s grow together—starting with you; because we believe Plants Grow People**

Develop customer journey\-based service models and experience frameworks.
  
Create service hierarchy, topology correlation and impact analysis models.
  
Build service\-aware operational frameworks for proactive service assurance.

Drive service impact analysis and prioritization based on business criticality.

Develop predictive models for service degradation detection and prevention.
  
Establish automation for service correlation, root\-cause identification and impact analysis.
  
Implement advanced analytics dashboards and executive service health views.

Drive problem management through root cause elimination and preventive actions.
  
Institutionalize service knowledge repositories and best practices.
  
Drive continual service improvement through data\-driven insights.

title: Customer Manager
description:
**WHO YOU ARE** 
  

 • You have at least 5 years of leadership experience in a customer\-focused, fast paced, and multi\-channel retail environment.
   

 • You are passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and driving business growth through operational excellence.
   

 • You have proven experience in leading, coaching, and developing teams, fostering a high\-performance culture, and building future talent through succession planning.
   

 • You possess strong problem\-solving and conflict management skills, enabling you to make informed decisions and improve business performance.
   

 • You have a solid understanding of cost and budget management, retail operations, and customer satisfaction metrics.
   

 • You are knowledgeable about talent management, including recruitment, coaching, and employee development.
   

 • You understand change management principles and can effectively lead teams through change and business transformation.
   

 • You have a good understanding of legal compliance, third\-party contracts, safety and security requirements, and can work confidently with external authorities when required.
   

 • You have knowledge of the food business, including food safety standards and commercial operations.
   

 • You are analytical, collaborative, and an effective communicator who builds strong relationships across functions to deliver business results.
   

  

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** 
  

 • Lead the Customer Experience function by creating a seamless, convenient, and rewarding shopping journey across all customer touchpoints.
   

 • Drive a customer\-first culture by using customer insights, feedback, and market trends to improve the overall shopping experience and influence business decisions.
   

 • Ensure operational excellence by identifying and removing barriers that impact customers throughout their buying, checkout, payment, and after\-sales journey.
   

 • Support commercial priorities and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to maximize sales, customer satisfaction, and business performance.
   

 • Oversee the IKEA Food business, ensuring commercial success while maintaining the highest standards of food safety, Swedishness, and regulatory compliance.
   

 • Develop and implement customer service, food business, and operational action plans aligned with local, national, and global business objectives.
   

 • Ensure compliance with IKEA policies, legal requirements, food safety regulations, and operational best practices.
   

 • Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders and external partners to enhance operational efficiency and protect the IKEA culture and values.
   

 • Plan and manage departmental resources, budgets, and investments to achieve operational and financial targets.
   

 • Lead, coach, and develop team members by setting clear goals, supporting individual growth, and building a strong succession pipeline.
   

 • Analyze customer, consumer, brand, and operational data to provide recommendations that improve customer experience and business performance.
   

 • Champion continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the implementation of customer experience and retail food strategies across the store.
   

 • Ensure a safe environment for customers and co\-workers by promoting safety, security, and compliance across all operations.
   

 • Foster collaboration across commercial and support functions to deliver integrated and consistent customer experience across all channels.
   

  

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 
  

 At IKEA it’s all about our customers, and in Customer Relations we build and retain long\-lasting relationships with new and existing customers in a multichannel retail environment. Our modus operandi is to connect to people by listening to their personal needs and to create genuine interactions. We’re a bunch of people who are truly passionate about people!
   

  

 Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don't apply for jobs unless they're 100% "qualified". If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think. We look forward to receiving your application. From: "Why Women Don't Apply for Jobs Unless They're 100% Qualified" by Tara Sophia Mohr, August 2014"

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Job Description – Customer Success Manager (CSM)**
**Company:** 
 Aliste Technology
   

  

**Department:** 
 Customer Success
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Customer Success Manager
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–5 years
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Noida
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Head of Customer Success / Head of Support
   

  

**About Aliste Technology**
 Aliste Technology is a smart\-metering and energy\-technology company helping property owners and operators manage electricity consumption, metering, billing and collections more efficiently.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **high\-ownership Customer Success Manager** 
 who can manage assigned clients/properties end\-to\-end and ensure that customers receive consistent service, operational issues are resolved quickly, and properties remain healthy and retained.
   

  

**Role Objective**
 The CSM will be the
 **primary owner of assigned client accounts/properties** 
 after onboarding.
   

  

**The Person Will Be Responsible For**
* Maintaining strong client relationships.
* Ensuring smooth onboarding and installation.
* Monitoring property health and meter performance.
* Driving resolution of grievances and escalations.
* Coordinating with Operations, CCE, Sales and Finance.
* Monitoring outstanding payments and supporting collections.
* Reducing property churn/drop.
* Driving Auto\-Pay and Partner App adoption.
* Conducting regular client reviews.
* Identifying risks before they become escalations.
* Maintaining accurate CRM/Zoho and reporting data.


 The CSM is expected to
 **own the problem until closure** 
 , rather than simply forwarding it to another team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client \& Account Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Build strong professional relationships with property owners, operators and key stakeholders.
* Understand each property's business requirements and operational challenges.
* Conduct regular client calls and meetings.
* Maintain proper records of all important client discussions.
* Ensure commitments made to clients are tracked and closed within agreed timelines.
* Property Health Management


 The CSM should continuously monitor the health of assigned properties, including:
   

  

* Number of active meters.
* Offline meters.
* Installation pendency.
* Replacement pendency.
* Grievances and unresolved tickets.
* Over\-consumption complaints.
* Billing\-related issues.
* Low\-voltage and technical complaints.
* User/deduction\-related issues.
* Outstanding payments.
* Client dissatisfaction/escalation.
* Property drop/churn risk.


 The objective should be
 **zero surprise escalations** 
 —the CSM should identify risks before the client raises them.
   

  

* Grievance \& Escalation Management
* Monitor all open grievances on a daily basis.
* Ensure tickets are progressing within defined TAT/SLA.
* Coordinate with Operations and CCE teams for resolution.
* Follow up with technicians where required.
* Ensure "Under Review" cases are actively followed up and not left unattended.
* Personally handle critical client escalations.
* Keep clients updated until final resolution.
* Ensure closure is properly documented in Zoho.
* Installation \& Operational Coordination
* Coordinate with Operations for new installations.
* Track installation pendency and ageing.
* Ensure technicians complete assigned work properly.
* Ensure final checking/closure processes are followed.
* Coordinate re\-visits wherever genuinely required.
* Ensure client communication happens during important operational activities.
* Identify recurring operational issues and escalate them to management.
* Customer Retention


 The CSM will be directly responsible for reducing customer churn.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Identify properties showing dissatisfaction or drop risk.
* Maintain a Property Risk/Health Tracker.
* Understand reasons behind client dissatisfaction.
* Create action plans for high\-risk properties.
* Escalate commercial/operational risks to management early.
* Conduct regular client health reviews.
* Maintain strong engagement with decision\-makers.


 Retention is a core CSM responsibility, with customer health and churn risk being standard measures in modern customer\-success teams.
   

  

* Outstanding \& Revenue Coordination
* Monitor outstanding amounts for assigned properties.
* Follow up with clients for pending payments.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation.
* Identify accounts where outstanding is increasing.
* Escalate chronic payment delays.
* Support Finance in improving collection timelines.
* Ensure billing/payment\-related client concerns are resolved quickly.
* Auto\-Pay \& Product Adoption
* Drive adoption of Auto\-Pay among assigned properties.
* Encourage clients to use Aliste's Partner App and relevant features.
* Educate clients on the benefits of the system.
* Monitor usage/adoption.
* Identify properties with low adoption and create an action plan.
* Client Meetings \& Reviews
* Conduct regular client meetings.
* Prepare property performance updates before meetings.
* Discuss:
+ Meter health
+ Grievances
+ Installations
+ Collections
+ Consumption\-related concerns
+ Pending actions
+ Overall property performance

* Share MOM after meetings.
* Ensure every action item has an owner and deadline.


 The CSM should act as the
 **single owner coordinating these teams** 
 , rather than allowing the client to chase multiple internal teams.
   

  

* Reporting \& Data Management
* Maintain accurate client/property data.
* Update Zoho/CRM on a real\-time basis.
* Maintain daily/weekly CSM reports.
* Track open grievances and ageing.
* Track property health.
* Track outstanding.
* Track client meetings.
* Track retention/drop risks.
* Share weekly performance reports with management.

You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI\-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

You will focus on managing troubleshooting tasks and provide resolution to issues. You will also be responsible for liaising with internal/external stakeholders to provide communication on customer issues and questions.
   

  

 However, ensuring a seamless, customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. To fully support your well\-being, Google provides support for any non\-standard operational shifts.
   

  

 Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

 Area Manager is responsible for the overall Business operations of the allocated restaurants according to California Burrito operational standards and run profitable business. A majority of time is spent leading/Guiding and coaching the team to meet Guest expectations, achieving both bottom and topline objectives by the guiding ambition of our organization. 
 Looking for someone who is from QSR or FMCG industry.

 Own the performance of your allotted restaurants and Strive for Excellence across operations, hospitality, food safety, sanitation and cleanliness. Lead from the front. Model great hospitality, coach restaurant teams and remove anything getting in the way of a great guest experience. Empower teams to resolve guest concerns quickly, thoughtfully and for the long term. Spot problems and opportunities early, build clear action plans and make sure they get done.

Lead new product rollouts, support new restaurant openings and drive strong sales across new and existing locations. 
 4) KEEP EVERYONE MOVING TOGETHER 
 Work closely with support teams to solve problems, align on business priorities and turn plans into action. Communicate goals, results and next steps clearly so every team understands what they are working towards and how they contribute. Keep growing everyday. Ask for feedback, share ideas and keep finding better ways to work.

title: Senior Customer Experience Executive
description:
1. Role Purpose The Senior Customer Experience Executive will be responsible for delivering a high-quality customer experience while providing effective sales and after-sales support. The role requires strong product knowledge, customer understanding, communication, problem-solving and cross-functional coordination to ensure customers receive accurate information and timely resolution. The ideal candidate should understand the product portfolio in depth, confidently guide customers based on their requirements, handle product-related queries independently and take complete ownership of customer cases through to closure. 2. Product Knowledge & Customer Advisory Develop and maintain strong knowledge of the company's complete product portfolio, including features, specifications, applications, benefits, pricing, warranty and service policies. Understand product differences and recommend the most suitable product based on customer requirements. Confidently explain product features, benefits, usage and limitations to customers. Handle product-related customer queries independently wherever possible. Continuously update product knowledge when new products, features or policies are introduced. Identify gaps in customer understanding and provide clear, accurate product guidance. 3. Customer Experience Handle customer enquiries, complaints and requests through phone, email, WhatsApp and other approved communication channels. Provide accurate, professional and solution-oriented responses with a strong focus on customer satisfaction. Take complete ownership of customer cases from initiation to closure. Proactively follow up on pending cases rather than waiting for the customer to contact the company again. Handle difficult customers and escalations with maturity, empathy and professionalism. 4. Sales Support Support the Sales team with customer enquiries, product information, order-related requirements and follow-ups. Provide Sales with accurate product information and customer insights whenever required. Coordinate with Sales and relevant internal functions to ensure customer requirements are fulfilled. Follow up on customer requirements and ensure timely closure. Maintain accurate records of enquiries, customer requests, follow-ups and pending actions. 5. Complaint & Issue Resolution Understand the customer's actual concern and identify the appropriate resolution. Use product knowledge to distinguish between product-related, usage-related, service-related and process-related issues. Coordinate internally for resolution while retaining ownership of the customer case. Track escalated cases and ensure timely closure. Identify recurring customer or product issues and highlight them to management with practical recommendations. 6. After-Sales Support Handle product usage, warranty, replacement, service and other post-sales queries. Explain applicable policies and processes clearly to customers. Coordinate with relevant teams for service, replacement or other approved resolutions. Keep customers informed throughout the resolution process. Ensure all customer commitments are properly documented and followed up. 7. Customer Records, MIS & Reporting Maintain accurate and updated customer records and interaction history. Ensure enquiries, complaints, follow-ups and customer interactions are properly documented. Prepare regular reports on customer enquiries, pending cases, complaints, resolution status, sales-support activities and escalations. Monitor ageing cases and highlight matters requiring management intervention. Identify trends in customer queries and complaints and support continuous improvement. 8. Internal Coordination Work closely with Sales, QC, Operations, Dispatch, Warehouse, Accounts and other relevant functions to address customer requirements. Ensure clear communication between customers and internal teams. Follow up proactively rather than waiting for other departments to provide updates. Maintain professional working relationships across functions. Candidate Profile Graduate in any discipline. A degree or diploma in Business Administration, Sales, Customer Service or a related field is an advantage. Relevant experience in Customer Care, Customer Experience, Sales Coordination, Sales Support or a similar customer-facing role. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Strong product-learning ability and confidence in explaining products to customers. Good customer-handling, follow-up and coordination skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, email and CRM/ERP or other business systems. Ability to maintain trackers and prepare basic MIS. Role & responsibilities
