title: Technical Support Engineer (Customer Engagement Specialist)
description:
**Technical Support Engineer (Customer Engagement Specialist), Enterprise LMS**

**Location:** Chenai  
**Experience:** 5 to 12 years  
**Function:** Product and Customer Engagement

**About the role**

This is not a ticket\-routing job.

**PeopleOne** which is earlier called as **ExpertusONE** is an enterprise learning platform used by global organisations to run compliance training, certification programs, instructor\-led and virtual sessions, and skills development at scale across tens of thousands of learners. When something behaves unexpectedly in an environment like that, the question is rarely "did the user click the wrong button." It is usually a configuration interaction, an integration payload, a permissions model edge case, or a genuine defect hiding behind three layers of plausible explanations.

We are looking for someone who can tell the difference, and prove it.

You will own customer\-reported issues end to end: reproduce them, isolate the root cause, resolve what can be resolved through configuration or guidance, and hand the rest to Engineering with a diagnosis sharp enough that they can start fixing instead of start investigating. You are the person who makes the difference between a bug report that says "enrollment is broken for this customer" and one that says "enrollment fails when a training plan has sequencing enforced and the learner holds a prior exempted module, here is the reproduction path, here are the three affected tenants, here is the query that identifies them."

***If you enjoy the puzzle more than the ticket count, read on...***

**What you will do**

**Investigate and diagnose**

* Take ownership of escalated customer issues across the platform: enrollments, training plans, compliance and certification workflows, ILT and virtual classroom sessions, content playback (SCORM, xAPI, AICC, cmi5\), reporting and analytics, notifications, mobile, and integrations.
* Reproduce issues in test environments. Establish what is configuration, what is data, what is expected behaviour that the customer did not expect, and what is a genuine defect.
* Query production data (read\-only) to quantify blast radius: how many learners, which tenants, since when, and under what conditions.
* Read application and integration logs, trace API request and response payloads, and inspect webhook and SSO flows to isolate where a transaction actually failed.
* Distinguish correlation from causation. The most recent change is not automatically the cause.

**Resolve and communicate**

* Resolve issues directly where the fix is configuration, data correction, workflow redesign, or customer enablement.
* Write customer\-facing responses that a non\-technical LMS administrator can act on: what happened, what the impact is, what we are doing, what they need to do, and by when.
* Manage expectations honestly on issues that will not be fixed quickly. Vague reassurance is worse than an inconvenient timeline.
* Run live troubleshooting sessions with customer administrators and IT teams, including screen shares with enterprise security and identity teams.

**Escalate with a prognosis, not a summary**

* Package defects for Engineering with a reproduction path, environment details, affected versions and tenants, log evidence, expected versus actual behaviour, and a stated hypothesis on root cause.
* Assign severity and business impact yourself, and defend that assessment. Everything is not a P1\.
* Stay attached to the issue through to resolution. Escalation is a handoff of ownership for the fix, not a handoff of ownership for the customer.

**Improve the system**

* Identify recurring issue patterns and drive them to permanent elimination: product change, documentation gap, onboarding defect, or default configuration problem.
* Build and maintain internal diagnostic runbooks and customer\-facing knowledge articles. Reduce the number of issues that need you at all.
* Feed themes and evidence back into the product roadmap. You will have a direct line to Product Management and your input is expected to be substantiated with data, not anecdote.

**What success looks like**

**By 90 days:** You are independently resolving escalated issues across at least three functional areas without shadowing. Your defect reports are accepted by Engineering without a round trip for missing information.

**By six months:** Your average escalated\-to\-Engineering rate is falling because you are resolving more at source. You have shipped knowledge articles or runbooks that measurably reduce repeat issues. You have raised at least two product changes that were accepted onto the roadmap.

**By twelve months:** You are the person other engineers and CSMs come to when an issue does not make sense. You are trusted to speak directly to enterprise customers during a severity incident without supervision.

**What you need**

**Non\-negotiable:**

* **5 to 12 years** in technical support, application support, product support engineering, or solutions engineering for a B2B SaaS or enterprise software product. **Consumer support and pure L1 experience will not transfer.**
* Working SQL. You must be able to write joins, aggregations, and filtered queries against a relational schema to investigate an issue yourself, without asking an engineer.
* Practical fluency with REST APIs: reading documentation, constructing requests, interpreting status codes and error payloads, and using Postman or an equivalent tool.
* Demonstrated ability to read application logs and trace a transaction across systems.
* Structured diagnostic reasoning. You form a hypothesis, test it, and discard it when the evidence disagrees.
* Written English strong enough for direct communication with enterprise customers in EMEA and North America.
* Comfort with ambiguity and with saying "I do not know yet, here is how I will find out."

**Strongly preferred:**

* Prior experience with an LMS, LXP, HCM, or talent management platform (Cornerstone, Docebo, Absorb, SuccessFactors Learning, Workday Learning, Saba, or similar).
* Understanding of e\-learning standards: SCORM 1\.2 and 2004, xAPI, AICC, cmi5, and LRS concepts.
* Enterprise integration experience: SAML and OIDC single sign\-on, SCIM provisioning, HRIS data feeds, webhooks, and file\-based imports.
* Exposure to BI or reporting tools (Superset, Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to validate a reporting discrepancy against source data.
* Experience supporting multi\-tenant SaaS, including the reasoning required to separate tenant\-specific configuration issues from platform defects.
* BE, BTech, MCA, or equivalent technical education. We care more about what you can do than where you learned it.

**What we are not looking for**

To save everyone time:

* This role does not involve reading from a script or routing tickets to a queue.
* This is not a Customer Success Manager role. It is not primarily about renewals, QBRs, or adoption metrics, although you will work closely with the people who own those.
* If your last three years have been spent exclusively in a tier\-one queue with a strict escalation\-after\-fifteen\-minutes policy, this will be a difficult jump.
* If you are looking for a step towards a pure development role, be honest about that in the interview and we will tell you honestly whether this is the right path.

**How we evaluate**

Beyond conversation, we will put a real anonymised issue in front of you: a description, some log output, and a data extract. We will ask you to tell us what you think is happening and what you would check next. We are assessing how you reason, not whether you already know our product.

**Why this role is worth your time**

You will get read\-only production access, direct access to Engineering, and a direct line into Product Management where your findings shape what gets built. You will work on genuinely complex enterprise problems for recognisable global customers. And you will be measured on whether problems stay solved, not on how many tickets you closed.

If you're interested, please share your resume with **swethav@peopleone.co** or apply directly through this job post.

**We look forward to connecting with talented professionals and wish you the very best in your career journey!**

* Ensure customer readiness for new product features integration

* Create and maintain customer and partner\-specific playbooks


**Qualifications**

* Fluent English
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities for interacting with customers, partners, and internal teams.
* Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve complex issues and find mutually beneficial solutions
* Solid Presentation skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities efficiently
* Flexibility to handle various customer needs and changing product landscapes
* Experience recommending solutions and identifying upsell opportunities, a plus

* Experience guiding customers and partners through changes
* Data analysis experience, including the ability to interpret and present data
* Working knowledge of business software/applications \- Google Suite, Microsoft Office Suite

As the primary point of contact for assigned customers and partners within Gracenote, this role involves comprehensive relationship management. Key responsibilities include handling escalations, developing action plans, managing reports and dashboards, coordinating product updates and integrations, and maintaining customer\-specific playbooks. * Communicate essential details to customers/partners about product retirements and replacement solutions
* Ensure customer readiness for new product features integration
* Create Product Inquiry tickets and coordinate customer responses

* Strong attention to detail

Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. title: Territory Manager
description:
### **Job Description**


**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**



When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


### **Role Purpose**



Lead MWM’s direct commercial development in India by identifying, developing and closing new equipment and lifecycle service opportunities with end users and other direct project stakeholders. The Territory Manager will establish MWM as a visible, technically credible and commercially responsive partner in the Indian power generation market, with priority on gas engine generator applications.


**This is a direct market role.**The position is not responsible for building or managing a dealership network. The successful candidate will create demand, own strategic customer relationships, and lead opportunities directly for MWM, while coordinating qualified EPCs, engineering firms, and service providers on a project\-specific basis as required.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Own MWM’s direct sales development across India for gas engine generator sets, power modules, combined heat and power solutions, and related lifecycle offerings.
* Build and manage a strong pipeline of direct opportunities with industrial end users, utilities, independent power producers, data centers, oil and gas companies, petrochemical and chemical plants, steel, cement, mining, food and beverage, textiles, pharmaceuticals, commercial infrastructure and other energy\-intensive industries.
* Develop strategic account plans for priority customers and convert market potential into qualified projects, tenders, orders and long\-term customer relationships.
* Engage early with customer decision\-makers, plant engineering teams, consultants, EPC organizations and project developers to position MWM during concept development, feasibility studies, FEED and specification stages.
* Lead the complete opportunity cycle from prospecting and qualification through application definition, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, order intake and structured handover.
* Translate customer operating requirements into clear technical\-commercial inputs, including fuel composition, gas pressure, site conditions, load profile, operating mode, heat recovery requirements, installation concept and commissioning expectations.
* Coordinate closely with application engineering, quotation, project management, service, finance, legal, and commercial teams to prepare compliant and competitive solutions.
* Lead value\-based selling by quantifying customer benefits such as fuel efficiency, availability, lifecycle cost, emissions performance, operational flexibility and serviceability.
* Develop and maintain relationships with relevant EPCs, consultants and engineering companies as project influencers and execution partners, without assigning dealer or territory rights.
* Identify service, overhaul, long\-term maintenance, upgrade, spare parts, and installed\-base opportunities that strengthen customer lifecycle value.
* Maintain accurate opportunity, forecast, customer and activity data in the company CRM system and provide clear monthly outlooks, risks, actions and market intelligence.
* Represent MWM at targeted customer workshops, technical seminars, industry associations, conferences and exhibitions in India.
* Monitor competitive activity, pricing dynamics, regulations, gas availability, segment trends, and customer investment plans, and convert findings into actionable sales priorities.
* Achieve agreed order intake, revenue, margin, pipeline quality and strategic account development objectives while following internal governance and approval processes.

### **Target Candidate Profile**


* 8 to 12 years of progressive experience in technical B2B sales, business development or key\-account management in the Indian power generation market.
* Preferred experience with gas engine generators, reciprocating engine power plants, cogeneration or trigeneration, distributed energy, captive power, waste\-to\-energy, biogas, natural gas, special gas or hybrid power solutions.
* Demonstrated success in direct selling to end users and managing complex, project\-based sales cycles with multiple technical and commercial stakeholders.
* Established market access and customer relationships in one or more priority segments such as industrial captive power, oil and gas, petrochemicals, data centers, utilities, infrastructure, manufacturing or process industries.
* Strong understanding of the Indian project ecosystem, including direct customers, EPCs, consultants, tender processes, regulatory considerations and commercial practices.
* Ability to engage at plant, engineering, procurement, finance, and senior management levels and to build credibility with both technical and commercial decision\-makers.
* Commercial ownership, disciplined follow\-up and a proven ability to progress opportunities from early\-stage lead to signed order.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India and, when required, internationally for customer meetings, factory visits, training and business reviews.

### **Education**



Preferred degrees:


* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, power engineering, energy engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
* B.E. or B. Tech is preferred. An M.E., MTech, or an MBA in Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or General Management is advantageous.
* Candidates with another relevant engineering degree may be considered where supported by strong, directly relevant power\-generation sales experience.

### **Technical and Commercial Knowledge**


* Working knowledge of gas engines, generator sets, alternators, balance of plant, electrical integration and power plant operating concepts.
* Understanding of captive power, grid\-parallel and island operation, base\-load applications, CHP or CCHP, containerized and powerhouse installations, and high\-ambient site conditions.
* Ability to interpret customer specifications, single\-line concepts, fuel\-gas data, load profiles and technical\-commercial tender requirements.
* Competence in solution selling, financial justification, contract negotiation, risk identification, pricing discipline and stakeholder management.
* Experience with CRM\-based pipeline management and forecasting. Salesforce experience is preferred.
* Strong written and spoken English. Proficiency in Hindi and additional Indian languages is advantageous.

### **Core Competencies**


* Direct customer acquisition and strategic account development
* Technical sales and consultative value selling
* Business development and market creation
* Complex opportunity and tender management
* Negotiation, commercial judgment, and closing discipline
* Customer focus and long\-term relationship management
* Cross\-functional coordination and clear communication
* Decision\-making, accountability, and structured execution
* Market intelligence and competitive positioning
* Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline

### **Measures of Success**


* Achievement of approved new equipment and service order\-intake, revenue, and margin objectives.
* Growth and quality of the qualified direct\-customer pipeline.
* Conversion of strategic opportunities and acquisition of new MWM customers in India.
* Early specification and positioning of MWM in priority projects.
* Development of sustainable relationships with end users, EPCs and consultants.
* Forecast accuracy, opportunity data quality and timely execution of agreed next steps.
* Customer satisfaction and effective coordination from opportunity development through handover.

### **Positioning Statement for Candidates**



This role offers the opportunity to shape MWM’s direct market presence in India. It is suited to a commercially ambitious power\-generation professional who wants to build strategic customer relationships, influence complex energy projects and take visible ownership of growth in one of MWM’s priority markets.


**Job Description Notice**



This job description is intended as a general guide to the role. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or effort required. The company may revise the description to address evolving business and organizational needs. Final title, grade, reporting line, targets, and employment conditions remain subject to approval by management and Human Resources.



Additional information: This job requires 5days in a week working from office.


**Posting Dates:**



September 9, 2026 \- September 23, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150\+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.
 



  





 Over 2,000 data teams in 45\+ countries use Hevo, including DoorDash, Foot Locker, Iceland Air and Shopify. We’re top\-rated in the G2 Data Pipeline category, backed by Sequoia Capital, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, and operate out of San Francisco and Bangalore.

 Hevo’s customers are data engineers, analytics leaders, and platform teams who rely on us for critical data infrastructure. Customer Success here goes well beyond satisfaction surveys. The job is to help technical teams get real value from their pipelines, cut the time it takes to get to insight, and grow their data operations.
 



 We’re looking for a strong leader to build and run the CS function. You’ll own the full post\-sales journey (onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion) and be directly accountable for Net Revenue Retention and customer health across our global base.

* A growing team of TAMs, based primarily in Bangalore and Pune
* A product with 1000\+ customers but an evolving post\-sales playbook for 250\-300 accounts
* A customer base spanning SMB to enterprise across e\-commerce, fintech, medtech and B2B Software companies.
* Strong executive support and buy\-in for investing in Technical Account Management
* A chance to shape CS strategy at a company that’s defining the data pipeline category



  





**Responsibilities**

* Segment the customer base (enterprise, mid\-market, self\-serve) and build the right engagement model for each

* Improve renewal rates and reduce churn by driving deeper product adoption and making sure customers see tangible results
* Work with Sales on cross\-sell and upsell opportunities, always leading with retention
* Build customer advocacy through NPS programs, case studies, and community engagement
* Grow lifetime value by catching risks early through health monitoring and having clear playbooks for when to step in



**Customer Lifecycle** 



* Map out the customer journey for Hevo’s technical buyers and end users

* Define and track operational metrics: time\-to\-value, adoption rates, health scores, NRR, GRR.

**Cross\-Functional Work** 



* Work with Product to make sure customer insights feed into the roadmap
* Coordinate with Sales on ideal customer definition, handoff process, and expansion pipeline
* Team up with Marketing on customer campaigns, advocacy programs, and lifecycle comms
* Work with Finance on forecasting, renewal projections, and unit economics



**Invest in CS/TAM Technology** 



* Use AI and automation to make the program more efficient and scale the team’s impact without growing headcount at the same rate



  





**Who We’re Looking For** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 10\+ years of overall experience, and 5\+ years leading Technical Customer Success or Tech Account Mgmt teams in B2B SaaS, with experience building or scaling a technical CS/TAM function
* Experience with technical or developer\-facing products, ideally in data infrastructure, analytics, or related areas like ETL/ELT, data warehousing, observability, or DevOps
* Track record of owning and improving net revenue retention in a subscription / recurring\-revenue business
* Comfortable managing technical CSEs who spend their days working with data engineers and analysts
* Analytical and numbers\-driven. You make decisions based on data and you build the systems to track it
* Strong communication skills. Comfortable presenting to the board and working across functions to get things done



  





**Nice\-to\-Have** 



* Time spent at a modern data stack company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, or similar)
* Familiarity with usage\-based or consumption\-based pricing models
* Mix of technical (engineering, solutions) and business (CS, account management) experience
* Experience managing CSEs across multiple geographies or time zones



  





**Why Hevo** 



* We’re in a large, growing market (data integration is projected to hit $17B\+) and we’re one of the leaders
* Our customers actually like the product. Top\-rated on G2, with strong word\-of\-mouth growth
* Sequoia Capital\-backed with strong investor support
* CS is treated as a growth function here, not a cost center. You’ll have real ownership

title: ITSM - Knowledge Management - Associate/Senior Associate
description:
### **Description**

  

The Knowledge Manager owns the operational governance and full lifecycle of IT knowledge used by the Service Desk, resolver teams and end users. Reporting to the Senior Lead Associate \- Service Desk and Knowledge Management, the role converts technical and operational expertise into accurate, searchable, reusable and user\-friendly content.  

The role works across Incident, Request, Problem and Change Management to embed knowledge capture and reuse into day\-to\-day practices, strengthen first\-contact resolution and improve self\-service. This is an individual\-contributor role; Service Desk leadership, staffing, escalation ownership and strategic direction remain with the Senior Lead Associate.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Execute and continually improve the Knowledge Management roadmap under the direction of the Senior Lead Associate.
* Maintain KM policies, standards, article templates, ownership models, approval workflows and review schedules.
* Govern the complete article lifecycle, including creation, validation, publication, review, update, archive and retirement.
* Maintain taxonomy, metadata, naming and tagging standards to improve findability and consistency.
* Coordinate knowledge health reviews and remediate stale, duplicate, inaccurate or low\-value content.
* Embed knowledge capture, reuse and improvement into Incident, Request, Problem and Change workflows.
* Facilitate knowledge harvesting after major incidents, recurring incidents, problem investigations, releases and significant changes.
* Work with Service Desk analysts, subject matter experts, resolver groups and service owners to capture and validate solutions.
* Ensure known errors, workarounds and standard resolutions are converted into governed knowledge where appropriate.
* Support operational readiness by ensuring new or changed services have approved support knowledge before go\-live.
* Apply Knowledge\-Centred Service principles and coach authors, reviewers and approvers on contribution behaviours and quality standards.
* Curate clear, task\-based content for self\-service and approved support channels.
* Use search results, user feedback and ticket trends to identify content gaps and improvement priorities.
* Administer and improve ServiceNow KM workflows, including templates, approvals, feedback and lifecycle controls.
* Identify automation opportunities for classification, tagging, review reminders, duplicate detection and content recommendations.
* Support controlled use of AI\-assisted knowledge capabilities with human review and governance.
* Maintain measures for article quality, freshness, reuse, findability, contribution and self\-service success.
* Produce regular KM reporting and maintain a prioritised improvement backlog for the Senior Lead Associate.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

  

* Mandatory total professional experience: 7 to 12 years.
* Mandatory relevant experience: 4 to 7 years in Knowledge Management, KCS, ITSM knowledge governance, technical content governance or a related discipline.
* Practical experience in an IT Service Desk, technical support or IT operations environment.
* Hands\-on experience managing knowledge in ServiceNow Knowledge Management or a comparable enterprise ITSM platform.
* Experience improving KM governance, workflows, taxonomies, article standards and review controls.
* Experience integrating knowledge activities with Incident, Request, Problem and Change Management.
* Experience using reports and analytics to identify knowledge gaps and drive continual improvement.
* Experience facilitating knowledge\-harvesting sessions and coaching contributors.
* Minimum education: Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
* Desirable: experience with KCS maturity, self\-service portals, enterprise search, chatbots, virtual agents, ServiceNow AI capabilities or global shared services.

**Knowledge, Skill, ability*** Strong understanding of ITIL 4 Knowledge Management and its relationship with Service Desk and core ITSM practices.
* Practical knowledge of KCS principles, knowledge lifecycle governance and content quality controls.
* Hands\-on understanding of ServiceNow Knowledge Management, article structures, workflows and reporting.
* Ability to design and maintain taxonomies, metadata, tagging structures and content templates.
* Ability to translate complex technical information into concise and audience\-appropriate content.
* Strong analytical skills across search, usage, quality, feedback and operational data.
* Strong facilitation, coaching and stakeholder\-influencing skills without direct reporting authority.
* Sound understanding of accessibility, version control, auditability and responsible AI governance.

  

**Essential requirement (non\-negotiable) \**** Total professional experience within the 7 to 12\-year range.
* Minimum 4 years of directly relevant Knowledge Management, KCS or ITSM knowledge\-governance experience.
* Hands\-on ServiceNow Knowledge Management or comparable enterprise ITSM knowledge\-platform experience.
* Practical experience in a Service Desk, technical support or IT operations environment.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Strong written communication and ability to simplify technical information.
* Ability to work the stated UK shift from Pune.

  

### **About Davies**


We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  

  

We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation \& risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation \& change management.  

  

Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK \& the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20\-fold, investing heavily in research \& development, innovation \& automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

title: Data Platform Consultant (DBT)
description:
### **Description**

  

**The headlines...**  

  

**Immediate Joiners Preferred**  

**Location** \- Hybrid in our central Pune office  

  

**A few application tips…**  

  

We want to help you put your best foot forward. Here are a few things we look for:* Clear, specific examples of your work and impact
* Relevant experience aligned with the role’s focus
* A thoughtful response to any application questions
* A resume that highlights both what you did and why it mattered

If you’re unsure whether your background is the “perfect fit,” we still encourage you to apply. We value potential and growth just as much as experience.  

  

**Why this role exists…**  

This role is designed to strengthen our delivery capability across our most strategic accounts in industries like Consumer Goods, Financial Services and Energy.  

As the demand for data and AI\-driven transformation grows, so does the need for structured, proactive project leadership. At Snap Analytics, we help clients unlock the full potential of their data, and we’re scaling fast**.**  

  

We’re building DBT capability on a project. As a small, agile organisation, we’re investing in people who can help us deliver quickly and grow our competency in India with support from UK colleagues. You’ll have clear impact from day one and room to move across projects as you develop.### **What you’ll be doing…**

  

You’ll play a central role in designing and delivering data transformations that power a high‑visibility project. You’ll work closely with project leads, project managers, and senior engineers to ship quality outcomes with increasing autonomy.  

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**
* **Data Modelling:** Design, develop, and maintain complex data models using dbt Core to support various business functions.
* **Pipeline Optimization:** Build and manage scalable data transformation pipelines within Snowflake, ensuring high performance and cost\-efficiency.
* **Code Quality:** Implement software engineering best practices in the data stack, including version control (Git), modularity, and CI/CD.
* **Testing \& Documentation:** Ensure data integrity by writing robust dbt tests and maintaining comprehensive documentation via dbt docs.
* **Performance Tuning:** Optimize Snowflake compute and storage by managing clustering keys, materialized views, and efficient SQL querying.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work closely with Data Analysts and Business Leads to translate business requirements into technical data schemas.

**In your first 3–6 months, success might look like:*** Delivering the majority of your assigned work independently, to a high standard (quality \+ on‑time)
* Demonstrating holistic project understanding \- how your work fits the wider data flow and business goals
* Building healthy working relationships across the India team and, over time, with UK stakeholders

  

### **What you’ll need to succeed…**

  

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of experience, curiosity, and collaboration.  

  

**You might be a great fit if you have:**
* **2 years’ experience** in dbt Core, including macros, packages (like dbt\-utils), and Jinja templating (we’re not considering freshers for this role)
* Strong **SQL** fundamentals and practical exposure to **DBT**
* Deep understanding of Snowflake\-specific features such as Tasks, Streams, Snowpipe, and Zero\-copy cloning.
* Familiarity with **Git/Bitbucket** and awareness of **CI/CD** concepts (nice to have)
* **Clear communication \-** you can articulate your thinking to technical and non‑technical partners
* **A** **learning mindset**: proactive, curious, and willing to work “a notch above” expectations (automation, generalising code, improving process)
* **Transparency** and ownership \- comfortable asking for help early and taking accountability for outcomes

**This role might not be the right fit if you’re looking for:*** Highly siloed work with very narrow task scopes (we value holistic project thinking)
* Constant step‑by‑step guidance (we expect growing autonomy and initiative)

  

### **Why choose Snap**

  

* **Impact from day one** on a new, high‑visibility project
* **Growth in a small, agile company** with opportunities to rotate across projects as you develop
* **Supportive team culture \-** mentorship from seniors, collaboration with India \& UK colleagues, open feedback and help‑seeking encouraged

### **About Snap Analytics**


We're a high\-growth data analytics consultancy on a mission to help enterprise businesses unlock the full potential of their data. With offices in the UK, India, and South Africa, we specialise in cutting\-edge cloud analytics solutions, transforming complex data challenges into actionable business insights.  

  

We partner with some of the biggest brands worldwide to modernise their data platforms, enabling smarter decision\-making through Snowflake, Databricks, Matillion, and other cloud technologies. Our approach is customer\-first, innovation\-driven, and results\-focused, delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision.  

  

At Snap, we’re not just consultants, we’re problem\-solvers, engineers, and strategists who thrive on tackling complex data challenges. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and pushing boundaries, ensuring our people grow just as fast as our business.  

  

Join us and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of data analytics!

At PALFINGER, we have been lifting goods to a new level for over 90 years \- with a pioneering and passionate spirit. The overall purpose of this job is to ensure the proper maintenance and functioning of production equipment within PALFINGER AG. * Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Customer Success Manager-Deputy Manager-Bangalore
description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------



We are seeking a Customer Success professional who will manage long\-term relationships with international enterprise customers, ensuring retention, satisfaction, and service adoption. This role focuses on delivering an exceptional customer experience by overseeing service performance, driving improvements, resolving escalations, and guiding customers across connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, IoT, SD\-WAN and other telecom services. The individual will be responsible for customer engagement across multiple global regions, support contract commitments, and contribute to financial performance through commercial awareness and service optimisation.

**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Drive customer satisfaction, retention and experience, ensuring high Net Promoter Scores (NPS).
* Manage end\-to\-end relationships with global enterprise customers across multiple regions and segments including multinational corporations and public sector organisations.
* Act as the primary point of contact for all service\-related discussions with senior customer decision\-makers.
* Oversee contract management, ensuring operational and enabling teams meet all obligations.
* Analyse service performance, identify gaps, and drive continuous service improvements.
* Lead monthly and quarterly customer service reviews, maintaining documentation and follow\-up actions.
* Manage service lifecycle across sell–build–run phases.Guide various service and delivery teams in resolving escalations outside business\-as\-usual processes.
* Maintain accurate customer and service inventories, updating reports and dashboards as required.
* Identify opportunities for cross\-selling, upselling, and plugging revenue leakages.
* Support delivery teams in clearing on\-hold orders and coordinating with cross‑functional teams.
* Champion digitalisation by identifying areas where manual reporting can be automated.
* Mentor and provide guidance to service management analysts.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Experienced in customer‑facing international Customer Success roles (4\+ years).
* Skilled in telecom products such as Fixed Line, Mobility, Cybersecurity, SD\-WAN, IoT, SaaS, MPN, Cloud and Unified Communications.
* ITIL 4 certified with strong understanding of service lifecycle management.
* An effective communicator able to engage confidently with senior customer stakeholders.
* Technically sound in networking fundamentals (SDH, DWDM, MPLS, LAN/WAN, Internet, Fixed Voice, SD\-WAN).
* A collaborative influencer who can work across global teams and resolve conflicts.
* Commercially aware with the ability to interpret P\&L statements.
* Proficient in data analysis to identify trends and enable decision\-making.Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable in dynamic customer environments.
* Knowledge of automation tools such as Power BI, SQL or Python is beneficial.
* Able to mentor others and demonstrate accountability, critical thinking, and strong organisational skills.
**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to work with global enterprise customers and develop deep expertise across telecom and digital services.
* Exposure to senior\-level stakeholder management and strategic customer engagement.
* Experience in contract governance, service reviews, and P\&L\-linked decision\-making.
* Involvement in digital transformation initiatives and modernisation of service reporting.
* Growth through collaboration with cross\-functional teams across multiple countries.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Advanced customer success strategies for global enterprise environments.
* Enhanced technical understanding of evolving telecom technologies and digital solutions.
* Strong commercial acumen through hands\-on exposure to financial analysis and P\&L impact.
* Leadership and stakeholder management across diverse geographies.
* Analytical, data\-driven decision\-making and dashboard streamlining using automation tools.
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------



Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------



At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Learning & Development Operations
description:
Job Description
**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026\.

 **About Position:**

  

To execute training operations for either training or assessment offering types, including creation of schedules, trainer interactions, logistics arrangement and feedback collection. The candidate should possess strong MS Excel skills for maintaining reports and tracking training\-related data, effective communication skills to coordinate with stakeholders, trainers, and participants, and good analytical ability to manage queries, interpret feedback, and support smooth execution of training and assessment operations.

* **Role: Learning \& Development Operations**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 6 to 12 years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Stakeholder Management: Should interact with training requestors to collect training requirements. Should coordinate/interact with internal/external trainers for training schedule. Should facilitate the evaluation calls/meetings between internal SMEs and external trainers, if required. Should ensure that all internal customer / stakeholder queries are addressed and closed in a timely fashion. In case of assessment operations, should co\-ordinate with all internal/external trainers and assessment requestors for creating questions, review and evaluation of assessments and scheduling the same.
* Training/ Assessment Planning: Should manage the scheduling in the system as per the calendar planned by the Operations Manager and/or Lead. Should ensure logistics including room booking, virtual machine management, and any other learning material requirements, are taken care of for any training/assessments allocated. Should ensure that training/assessments are scheduled as per SLA.
* Training Execution \- Nomination tracking: Should keep track of nomination data and ensure that the minimum quorum for any training is met. Should continuously follow up with the relevant grades by sending out nuggets/mailers to increase nominations. Should send mailers to employees who have a particular training mapped as part of their Individual Learning Plan. In case of low nominations, should communicate the same to the management and implement the decisions given.
* Assessment Execution: For each assessment event, handle the following event logistics: \- Should send mailers to employees providing venue and other test details. Ensure that all assessments start and end at the stipulated time, and that all invigilators are performing their assigned duties properly. Ensure that subjective assignments are uploaded on server, and a backup is maintained for future use. Handle queries (at first level) from assessment participants and redirect them to respective POCs if required. Ensure that all queries are taken to a logical closure.
* Training Execution \- Logistics: Should manage end\-to\-end execution on the day of training. Should kickstart training sessions with a short introduction to set participant expectations and address any queries that may arise. Should manage last\-minute cancellations, in unavoidable situations. Should maintain attendance records for all training courses executed.
* Training/Assessment Execution \- Feedback: Should ensure that desired feedback is obtained for any particular training/ assessments. Should take corrective action based on feedback and inform the respective candidate. Should follow up with participants for submitting feedback in the system. Should collate manager (of participant) feedback for quarterly project request surveys.
* Reports: Should maintain and update reports for all training transactions on a daily basis. Should update the same on a timely basis. Should log and maintain various status reports for different offerings. Should address any adhoc queries for reports arising from management and any other internal stakeholders.

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* Experience in Learning \& Development operations, including training coordination, scheduling, logistics, participant communication, feedback collection, and post\-training support.
* Ability to manage multiple training and assessment programs while coordinating effectively with stakeholders, trainers, participants, and internal teams.
* Proactive and detail\-oriented, with strong ownership, a learning mindset, and the ability to support process improvements and deliver a positive learner experience.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

 **Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

 **Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent \-** **persistent.com/careers**

title: Manager – Member Engagement & Experience
description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 The Manager – Member Engagement \& Experience will lead member engagement and experience initiatives for CPA Australia in India, with a focus on creating meaningful connections and delivering ongoing value to members.
 



  





 The role will develop and execute programmes, events, thought leadership and other engagement initiatives that strengthen members’ connection with CPA Australia throughout their membership journey.
 



  





 The role will also develop a strong understanding of member needs and insights, using these to continually enhance the member experience and shape relevant initiatives for the India market.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Member Engagement \& Experience** 




  




* Develop and execute initiatives that strengthen member engagement, connection and the overall member experience.
* Build meaningful relationships with members and understand their needs, expectations and interests.
* Identify opportunities to enhance the value and relevance of CPA Australia membership.
* Develop initiatives that encourage greater member participation, connection and advocacy.
* Engage with members at different stages of their membership journey and ensure a consistent and positive experience.



  





**Member Programmes, Events \& Thought Leadership** 




  




* Plan and deliver relevant member events, programmes and engagement activities across India.
* Develop opportunities for members to connect with peers, industry leaders and the broader CPA Australia community.
* Support the delivery of thought leadership, professional development and networking initiatives that are relevant to members.
* Work with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure high\-quality execution and member participation.
* Ensure effective communication and follow\-up before and after member activities.



  





**Member Insights \& Experience Improvement** 




  




* Develop a strong understanding of the India member community, including member needs, interests and engagement patterns.
* Gather and use member feedback and insights to identify opportunities to improve the member experience.
* Identify emerging trends and opportunities to enhance member value and engagement.
* Share member insights with relevant stakeholders to inform future programmes, services and initiatives.



  





**Stakeholder Collaboration** 




  




* Work closely with India and CPA Australia teams across membership, marketing, communications, events and other relevant functions.
* Build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders to deliver member initiatives.
* Coordinate multiple initiatives and ensure timely and effective delivery across markets.



  





**Key Skills \& Experience** 




  




* 8–10 years of experience in
 **member engagement, customer experience, relationship management, membership organisations, events or a related field** 
 .
* Strong relationship\-building and interpersonal skills, with a genuine member/customer\-centric approach.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute engaging programmes, events or experiences.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong organisational and project\-management capabilities, with attention to detail.
* Ability to understand customer/member insights and translate them into meaningful initiatives.
* Proactive, creative and solutions\-oriented, with the ability to identify new ways of engaging members.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
* Experience in a professional association, membership organisation, professional services or education environment would be an advantage.

title: Associate (CCA) - Customer CoE
description:
**About us**


Bain \& Company is a global management consulting that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

Our fast\-paced, innovative environment emphasizes continuous learning and problem\-solving. We offer strong professional development and a global experience, enabling collaboration with experts and clients worldwide.

  

  

**Position Summary**  

  



This role plays a critical role in driving proposal and client development efforts by partnering with Bain’s leadership, Customer practice (Customer experience Transformation), and subject\-matter experts. You will lead high\-level discussions with senior stakeholders, bringing strong structured problem\-solving, clear points of view, and persuasive storytelling to ambiguous or open\-ended commercial situations.


You will demonstrate comfort navigating complexity, translating loosely defined client needs (at times) into sharp commercial narratives, and delivering outputs that directly align with client objectives. While this role is based out of Mexico, it will frequently collaborate with EMEA and India counterparts. In addition, the role will require to work with a high\-performing team responsible for proposal development and commercial acceleration.

  

  

**What you’ll do**


* Support client development and commercial acceleration initiatives
	+ Identify and shape account\-level growth opportunities by synthesizing industry dynamics, client business models, competitive positioning, and revenue potential

	+ Show comfort in driving open\-ended client requests, creating point\-of\-views, and delivering output aligned with client objectives

* Deliver high\-quality zero\-defect outputs with strong attention to detail, structured problem solving, and effective work planning in fast\-paced commercial initiatives
* Use your storylining skills to drive conversations with senior stakeholders
* Assist in operational tasks including leadership updates, business reviews, and maintaining the internal knowledge database
	+ Maintain structured repositories of research, client insights, and commercial materials to improve knowledge reuse and team efficiency
  

**About you**  

  



* Undergraduate degree (preferably in Engineering, Business, Economics or related field) with 2–5 years of experience, or Postgraduate degree (MBA preferred) with 1\-3 years of experience


* Experience contributing to sales collateral (proposals, pitch decks, RFPs, discussion materials) on topics such as, branding, marketing, sales, customer experience, go\-to\-market, commercial excellence and growth strategy for clients


* Experience within a Professional Services or within customer and marketing strategy division in the Industry


* Proficiency in MS PowerPoint and Excel is required; familiarity with analytical and data visualization tools and comfort working with marketing or commercial performance data is a strong advantage


* Demonstrated structured problem\-solving capability and comfort translating open\-ended client asks into clear, actionable outputs


* Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders


* Self\-motivated, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment


* Interest in commercial strategy, client development, and growth\-oriented problem solving

  

  

**What makes us a great place to work**


We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

 Join the dynamic team at Wholsum Foods and be part of an extraordinary movement! Our mission is simple: to change the world's eats.  employer and a

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

description:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
4\-6 years of software engineering experience building production\-quality applications or platform services.
  
Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Python, or Node.js.
  
Experience building APIs, services, or microservices in a cloud environment.

Understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including scalability, resiliency, and debugging.
  
Experience with test automation, source control, code review, and CI/CD workflows.
  
Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment.
  
Good written and verbal communication skills.
  
Good understanding of GenAI technologies Coding AI assistants, LLMs, agents, RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector databases.

Experience with serverless platforms, event\-driven architectures, or API integrations.

Familiarity with React, TypeScript, and modern front\-end tooling.
  
Experience with observability, monitoring, performance tuning, and production support.
  
Familiarity with secure application design, authentication, and enterprise integration patterns.
  
Experience working in a multi\-team platform environment where usability, scale, and reliability all matter.
  
  

**Success in This Role means:**  

Shipping high\-quality features with strong engineering fundamentals.
  
Improving platform reliability, usability, and scalability.
  
Reducing developer friction through better tooling and workflows.
  
Collaborating effectively across teams to deliver extensibility capabilities customers can adopt with confidence.
  
Bringing thoughtful technical judgment, ownership, and steady execution to the team.

You’ll work on a strategic platform that enables extensibility across Adobe products and helps developers build meaningful custom experiences on Adobe infrastructure. Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.

title: Customer Success & Onboarding Executive
description:
Job Summary The Customer Success Onboarding Executive will own the customer journey from the initial post-sale handover through successful implementation, activation and early adoption. The person will coordinate customer and internal actions, deliver product training, ensure customers achieve measurable value, and identify relevant opportunities to adopt additional features or plans. This is not pure support, chat-support or aggressive sales role. It requires consultative communication, structured follow-up, product understanding, commercial awareness and end-to-end accountability for onboarding outcomes. Responsibilities Onboarding Ownership: Own assigned customers from sales handover until onboarding completion and transition to ongoing customer success or support. Conduct structured kickoff calls to understand the customers business model, platforms, fulfillment workflow, use cases, expected outcomes and launch timeline. Prepare and maintain a clear onboarding plan with milestones, owners, dependencies, target dates, risks and next actions. Guide customers through account setup, platform connections, configuration, product mapping, testing and go-live readiness. Coordinate dependencies involving the customer, support, product, engineering, QA, operations and sales teams. Ensure the customer reaches an agreed activation milestone, such as a successful first order, inventory sync or completed production workflow. Prevent onboarding from becoming inactive by following up consistently and escalating genuine blockers. Product Training and Adoption: Conduct product demonstrations and role-based training sessions for customer stakeholders. Explain workflows in simple business language while remaining accurate about system behaviour and limitations. Recommend configurations and features based on the customers operating model rather than giving generic demonstrations. Create or improve onboarding checklists, training material, help articles, call summaries and reusable templates. Monitor whether customers are using the capabilities required to achieve their intended outcome. Identify adoption risks and conduct follow-up sessions where customers need additional guidance. Consultative Upselling and Expansion: Identify additional WebBee features, modules, integrations or plans that solve a genuine customer requirement discovered during onboarding. Explain the business value, use case and expected impact of relevant features. Qualify the opportunity by confirming need, stakeholders, timing and expected outcome. Coordinate with sales or the commercial owner for pricing, proposals and closure when required. Maintain accurate notes and opportunity status in the relevant CRM or tracking system. Avoid forced selling; recommendations must be relevant, transparent and aligned with customer success. Customer Communication and Relationship Management: Act as the primary onboarding contact and maintain professional, proactive communication. Send clear meeting summaries containing decisions, owners, deadlines, risks and next steps. Manage customer expectations regarding scope, timelines, dependencies and product limitations. Handle objections and delays calmly while keeping the onboarding plan moving. Coordinate handovers to support or the ongoing customer success owner with complete context and documentation. Capture customer feedback and communicate recurring product or process gaps internally. Issue Triage and Internal Coordination: Perform first-level analysis when onboarding is blocked and gather screenshots, examples, order identifiers, configuration details and relevant context. Distinguish between missing customer action, configuration gaps, training needs, product defects and enhancement requests. Create clear internal tickets or tasks when another teams involvement is required. Follow up on internal commitments and communicate realistic status to customers. Do not promise product changes, delivery dates or technical outcomes without internal confirmation. Metrics and Process Improvement: Maintain accurate onboarding status, milestone dates, risks, customer health and expansion notes. Track time to kickoff, time to activation, onboarding completion, feature adoption, delays and reasons for non-completion. Identify recurring onboarding friction and recommend improvements to product, documentation, training or internal processes. Participate in weekly onboarding reviews and highlight customers requiring decisions or escalation. Contribute to scalable onboarding playbooks and standard operating procedures. Requirements Required Skills and Experience Approximately three years of experience in SaaS customer onboarding, customer success, implementation, account management or a related customer-facing role. Experience conducting online product demonstrations, discovery sessions and customer training. Strong spoken and written English, including professional email and meeting communication. Ability to understand software workflows, integrations and configuration dependencies. Experience coordinating multiple customers, tasks and stakeholders with clear follow-up. Ability to understand business needs and recommend suitable product capabilities. Comfort discussing upgrades, feature value and expansion opportunities in a consultative manner. Strong ownership, organization, documentation and problem-solving skills. Willingness to work full-time from the Noida office. Preferred Skills Experience with e-commerce, fulfillment, ERP, marketplace or integration products. Exposure to Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, NetSuite, WooCommerce or similar platforms. Understanding of APIs, webhooks, credentials, data synchronization and common integration failures at a functional level. Experience with Zoho CRM, Zoho Desk, Zoho Projects or similar CRM, support and task-management tools. Experience working with international customers in US, UK, Europe or Australia. Experience achieving onboarding, adoption, retention or expansion targets. Basic ability to review logs, JSON/API errors or technical evidence is advantageous but not mandatory. Job Type Full time Location Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India

Establish clear agendas and objectives for customer calls. Maintain a calm and professional approach when customers experience technical challenges or delays. Send concise post\-call summaries covering: Discussion points Completed activities Open issues Action items Owners Expected timelines
   

  

* Documentation \& Operational Excellence


 Maintain accurate and timely customer onboarding records. Update CRM/Salesforce after customer interactions. Track onboarding milestones and commitments. Maintain clear technical documentation for every engagement. Use AI\-assisted tools to improve documentation, analysis, and operational efficiency. Manage multiple customer onboarding projects simultaneously. Prioritize activities based on customer urgency, business impact, and committed timelines. Identify blockers early and proactively communicate risks. Continuously identify opportunities to improve onboarding processes and runbooks.
   

  

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Escalation


 Act as the primary technical point of accountability during onboarding. Collaborate closely with: Customer Engineers Account Executives Technical Support Professional Services Other internal product and engineering teams Escalate complex technical or architectural issues with complete troubleshooting information. Ensure smooth handoffs without compromising the customer experience. Identify potential opportunities for additional Cloudflare products or capabilities and provide relevant context to the appropriate CE or AE.
   

  

* Technical Learning \& Continuous Development


 Develop working knowledge of Cloudflare's core product areas, including: Application Security CDN and performance Zero Trust / SASE Network Services Stay current with Cloudflare product updates and new capabilities. Learn and apply relevant technical concepts through hands\-on customer engagements. Use AI tools, scripting, and automation to improve onboarding efficiency. Participate in training, certifications, peer learning, and feedback sessions.
   

  

**Required Technical Skills**
 Networking Fundamentals
   

  

**Strong Understanding Of**
 DNS HTTP/HTTPS TLS/SSL TCP/IP fundamentals CIDR NAT BGP Basic networking troubleshooting
   

  

 Web \& Application Security
   

  

**Working Knowledge Of**
 OWASP concepts Web Application Firewall (WAF) Authentication and authorization OAuth SAML MFA Zero Trust security principles
   

  

 Cloudflare \& Configuration
   

  

 Hands\-on exposure to the Cloudflare Dashboard or similar cloud/networking platforms. Understanding of DNS, SSL/TLS, CDN, WAF, and Zero Trust configurations. Familiarity with API\-based configuration. Exposure to Terraform or other Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools is preferred. Familiarity with identity providers such as Okta or Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD is advantageous. Understanding of SAML/OIDC integrations is a plus.
   

  

 Troubleshooting \& Observability
   

  

**Ability To Analyze And Troubleshoot Using**
 Security events and logs HTTP response codes c URL HAR files Browser developer tools DNS lookup utilities Basic application and network logs
   

  

 Candidates should understand common causes of 4xx and 5xx errors and be able to follow a structured troubleshooting approach.
   

  

 Scripting \& APIs
   

  

 Ability to read and troubleshoot REST API requests and responses. Basic proficiency in Python and/or Bash. Understanding of JSON and common API concepts. Familiarity with automation or scripting for repetitive operational tasks is preferred.
   

  

**Required Experience**
 Experience in a customer\-facing or hands\-on technical role such as:
   

  

 Technical Support Engineer Customer Support Engineer Implementation Specialist Customer Onboarding Engineer Junior Sales Engineer / Systems Engineer NOC Analyst SOC Analyst Network Support Engineer Cloud Support Engineer Systems Administrator
   

  

 Equivalent hands\-on technical experience managing customer deployments will also be considered.
   

  

**Required Soft Skills**
 Customer Empathy
   

  

 Able to understand customer concerns and provide practical solutions. Comfortable working with frustrated or non\-technical customers. Patient, professional, and service\-oriented.
   

  

 Communication
   

  

 Strong verbal and written communication skills. Able to simplify complex technical concepts. Comfortable leading customer calls and technical walkthroughs. Strong documentation and follow\-up skills.
   

  

 Problem Solving
   

  

 Structured approach to troubleshooting. Curious and willing to investigate the root cause of issues. Able to distinguish between issues that can be resolved independently and those requiring escalation.
   

  

 Ownership
   

  

 Takes responsibility for customer onboarding outcomes. Proactively tracks open actions and blockers. Does not allow customer issues to fall through the cracks.
   

  

 Time Management
   

  

 Comfortable managing multiple onboarding engagements. Able to prioritize competing customer requirements. Consistently meets agreed timelines and commitments.
   

  

 Adaptability \& Learning
   

  

 Comfortable working in a fast\-changing technical environment. Willing to learn new Cloudflare products and technologies. Open to feedback and continuous improvement. Demonstrates a strong bias for action.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Cloudflare certification such as Cloudflare Fundamentals, Cloudflare for Teams, or Cloudflare for Developers. Prior experience administering or onboarding customers onto Cloudflare. Experience with Terraform, Pulumi, or other Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines. Experience with REST APIs and automation. Experience with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD, SAML, or OIDC. Experience with AI assistants, LLM\-based tools, or AI\-powered productivity solutions. Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as: PCI DSS HIPAA SOC 2 ISO 27001 Multilingual communication skills relevant to the hiring region.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

**In This Role, Success Means**
 Customers reach first value quickly and confidently. Onboarding activities are completed accurately and on schedule. Common technical issues are resolved efficiently. Complex issues are escalated with complete technical context. Customer interactions are professional, clear, and well documented. CRM and onboarding records remain accurate and up to date. Customers are able to independently manage their Cloudflare environment after onboarding. Internal teams receive clean and actionable handoffs. AI, automation, and process improvements are continuously used to make onboarding more efficient.

title: Solution Consultant - SAP Digital Manufacturing
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next\-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.


Are you passionate about understanding business needs and turning them into smart technical solutions? Do you enjoy working closely with both customers and developers? If yes, this role might be your next adventure!

**Role description**
--------------------

We perceive that in the role of Solution Consultant, you will work with SAP Digital Manufacturing (SAP DM), helping our manufacturing sites turn business needs into reliable IT solutions. The requirements might need support from the development team of our IT\-solutions or be hands\-on configuration changes in the setup of the IT\-solutions. You will be part of the Stable Team that have the End to end(E2E) responsibility. Which means that we are involved from early stage to maintenance This is a broad role with a high degree of ownership. You will have the opportunity to shape the role around your strengths while developing deep expertise in SAP DM, manufacturing IT and our global solutions. You will work in a global environment together with colleagues, stakeholders and manufacturing sites across Volvo. Your solutions will directly support production critical IT systems used in our factories.

  

We are in a transformation towards a more agile, product\-focused way of working, where the goal is to work with shortened time to market for our applications.


Are Your ready for a challenge and to be part of our Vision and journey towards a more Agile setup?

***Your focus will be to:***
----------------------------

* Understand customer needs, in close cooperation with them
* Design and configure Production Process Designs (PPD) and Production Operator Dashboards (POD) in SAP Digital Manufacturing.
* Become an expert in our IT\-applications and how they operate in factories
* Support roll\-out, upgrade activities and SAP DM quarterly releases
* Support our factories with IT\-specific knowledge
* Work actively with maintenance and improvements
* Be part of On\-call
**Who are we looking for?**
---------------------------

We are looking for someone who has a passion for understanding the needs of the customer and getting the details right. Teamwork is a great part of our daily work – therefore You should be a team player and appreciate an open environment for discussions and dialogue. As a person you are analytical, structured, and communicative.


You should have an agile mindset and feel a strong commitment in delivering with high quality.

  



We believe diverse teams create better solutions and a stronger workplace. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, perspectives and experiences, and particularly encourage women to apply.

***Required***
--------------

* Experience with SAP DM implementation/configuration
* Experience with SAP integrations
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent English in both spoken and in writing
***Nice to have***
------------------

* Experience from the automotive industry
* Experience working in an agile/product\-oriented environment
* Experience with manufacturing IT

  

If you don't meet every requirement but believe you have the right mindset and relevant experience, we still encourage you to apply.

 **Travel Required:** Occasional

**Location:** Bangalore, India or Skövde, Sweden

 **For further information, please contact hiring manager:**


Christer Sandström, DPAO Produce\&Maintain Manufacturing Control


Phone \+46 72 8623117


Email: christer.sandstrom@volvo.com

 **Union representatives for Swedish applicants:**

**Akademikerna** – Mikael Johansson, \+46 73 902 34 30

**Unionen** – Lajla Dahlsjö, \+46 31 322 45 75

**Ledarna** – Carina Sachade, \+46 73 902 40 83


We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

**Who we are and what we believe in**


We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.


Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

 **Volvo Group Digital Technology \& Operations (DTO)** is a new division established to integrate the capabilities of VG Digital \& IT and VG Connected Solutions to accelerate the digital transformation in Volvo Group. The organizational set up is structured around domains, digital products with functions for digital excellence to deliver outstanding customer experience.

  

Joining the new DTO division means being part of a fast\-moving digital product\-oriented organization where teams truly own what they build from idea to delivery. In DTO, we work in agile, cross\-functional teams, mastering the latest technology, and creating outstanding digital experiences that make a real difference for our colleagues and Volvo Group customers around the world. We put people first and build our culture on trust, passion, customer success, change, and performance. If you want to grow, collaborate across functions and entities, and help shape the future of digital products within Volvo Group, DTO is a great place to be.
