* Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, accountability, curiosity and continuous learning.
* Attract, develop, and retain top talent while strengthening leadership bench strength.
* Champion diversity, inclusion, and employee engagement.


Partner Across the Organization


* Work closely with Product Management to align vision, priorities, and roadmaps.
* Collaborate with Quality Engineering to ensure robust testing strategies and product quality.
* Engage with architecture and platform teams to drive scalable and future\-ready solutions.
* Coordinate effectively with global stakeholders across regions to ensure alignment and transparency.


Shape Strategy and Innovation


* Contribute to engineering strategy and product direction, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Drive adoption of modern technologies, engineering practices, and innovation initiatives.
* Foster a mindset of continuous improvement and customer\-centricity.


Provide Technical and Operational Leadership


* Maintain a strong understanding of software architecture, cloud technologies, AI technologies and SDLC best practices.
* Guide teams in balancing speed, quality, and scalability.
* Improve engineering metrics including productivity, quality, and cycle time.

**What We’re Looking For**


Experience


* 15\+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant leadership responsibility
* Proven experience managing large, multi\-layered engineering teams (150–200\+)
* Background in product\-based organizations, preferably enterprise or SaaS

Leadership \& Collaboration


* Strong people leadership and team development experience
* Ability to influence and collaborate across matrixed, global organizations
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage at all levels


Technical Expertise


* Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI and Agile methodologies Familiarity with Software architectures (cloud, microservices, APIs) and DevOps practices and AI
* Ability to engage in technical discussions and decision\-making, without being hands\-on daily


Mindset \& Approach


* Strategic thinker with a bias for execution
* Customer\-focused and outcome\-driven
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, evolving environment

**Why Join MRI** **Software?**

* Being part of a mission\-driven, global organization with a strong culture
* Lead large\-scale engineering initiatives with real customer impact
* Collaborate with talented teams across the world
* Opportunity to shape technology, people, and product outcomes

**Our Values**


At MRI, we believe in:

* Client Focus – Delivering value to our customers
* Innovation – Continuously improving and evolving
* Collaboration – Working together to achieve more
* Integrity – Doing the right thing

**About Us**

  

From the day we opened our doors, MRI Software has built flexible, game\-changing real estate software that powers thriving communities and helps make the world a better place to live, work and play. Fulfilling that mission is only possible because of one thing: exceptional people. People like you!

  

Our people\-first approach to PropTech is defining a new industry standard for client experiences that, quite frankly, can’t be duplicated. Experiences that deliver real value every day. And we know those experiences begin with our people.

  

We believe MRI is more than just a workplace; it’s a connected community of people who truly feel they belong. Whether we’re investing in employee resource groups or providing tailored resources for each person to reach their full potential, we’re passionate about creating a work environment that makes you excited to show up every single day.

  

At MRI, one of our core values is to *strive to amaze.* From the intelligent solutions we create to the culture we cultivate, that’s our goal every day. Because that’s what industry leaders do. Whether you’re joining as a new Pride member or rejoining us after a short time away, your talent is vital to us, our partners and our clients.

 **Amazing growth requires amazing employees. Are you up to the challenge?**


We know confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting remarkable candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

 *MRI is proud to be an inclusive employer. We welcome and celebrate diversity across all backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, military, veteran status and more.*

*We believe that Belonging is a direct result of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Those values are woven into the fabric of who we are and are foundational to our continued success. Come and see for yourself!*

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Overview:

Part of the Jira Service Management (JSM) organisation within Atlassian Engineering. The ITSM Analytics group builds the reporting \& analytics platform that turns JSM operational data (requests, incidents, SLAs, Assets and Ops/Opsgenie) into actionable insight for IT and service teams — a key competitive differentiator for JSM in the ITSM market.

  

The ITSM Analytics team owns JSM's reporting \& analytics surface end\-to\-end: **Custom Metrics** (configurable and ratio metrics, OOTB PM\-authored templates), **JSM Insights** (SLA\-breach insight generation engine and GraphQL APIs), **Operations Reports**, **Assets Reporting** and the **JSM Summary Page**. It is a full\-stack team spanning frontend dashboards and metric\-authoring UIs, backend GraphQL APIs and data pipelines, and reporting data infrastructure. High ownership, shipping across EAP Beta GA while investing in performance, scale and data quality/observability.


Responsibilities:

Lead a charter\-defining team building the analytics engine at the heart of Atlassian's ITSM strategy. High visibility (directly tied to FY27 JSM growth KRs), a broad surface spanning greenfield\-to\-scale (Custom Metrics, Insights, Ops \& Assets reporting), and real technical depth across data platform, GraphQL APIs and modern React frontends. You will grow and shape a multi\-pod team, set technical direction for a large data domain, and own outcomes GA'ing to enterprise customers.


Qualifications:
* 10\+ years in software engineering with 4\+ years managing engineering teams (managing senior ICs and/or managers preferred at M60\).
* Track record shipping and scaling data\-intensive analytics, reporting or platform products.
* Strong technical depth in: distributed backend/data pipelines and GraphQL/API platforms, comfortable operating across the full stack.
* Experience with cloud data infrastructure (GCP/AWS), performance at scale, and data quality/observability.
* Proven people leadership: hiring, growing, coaching and retaining senior engineers.

title: Chief Information Officer - Business Relationship Manager
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

**Your Role**  

As a Portfolio Manager, you will shape and govern a portfolio of programs and projects that support customer outcomes and business priorities. The role balances strategic planning with hands on portfolio oversight, ensuring work is prioritized, risks are managed, and delivery remains aligned to agreed objectives. You will operate as a central point of coordination across delivery, technical, and account teams, using data and structured governance to drive predictable outcomes and continuous improvement.
  

  

**What you will do**

* Serve as the primary liaison between the CIO organization and India Market leadership, ensuring CIO capabilities, investments, and technology initiatives are closely aligned to India business priorities, growth objectives, and client needs.
* Partner closely with the India Country President, market leadership team, and business units to shape demand, identify opportunities, and translate business strategies into actionable CIO roadmaps and technology initiatives.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Kyndryl India, influencing decisions, driving collaboration, and ensuring business outcomes remain at the center of technology investments.
* Represent the CIO organization externally with strategic customers, partners, and industry stakeholders, communicating Kyndryl's technology capabilities, roadmap, and transformation vision.
* Meet directly with customers to understand business challenges, gather market insights, and showcase CIO capabilities through Kyndryl Customer Zero stories, demonstrating how Kyndryl leverages its own technology solutions to drive measurable business results.
* Drive adoption of CIO technology solutions and digital capabilities across the India market, helping business leaders understand how technology can accelerate growth, productivity, and client value.
* Act as a strategic advisor to both business and technology leaders, translating customer and market feedback into priorities that influence CIO strategy, capabilities, and investment decisions.
* Oversee the portfolio of technology initiatives supporting the India market, ensuring strategic alignment, value realization, timely execution, and effective risk management.
* Establish and monitor KPIs that measure business value, stakeholder satisfaction, technology adoption, and overall market impact. Lead organizational change initiatives that support new technologies, business processes, and ways of working across India.
* Champion innovation and emerging technologies, identifying opportunities to create competitive advantage, enhance client engagement, and strengthen Kyndryl's market position in India.

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  

  

**Required Skills and Experience**  

* Experience managing a portfolio of projects or programs within a technology or services environment
* Proficiency with portfolio and project management methodologies, including Agile, Scrum, or hybrid models
* Ability to assess complex delivery scenarios and make data driven prioritization and trade off decisions
* Experience working with delivery leaders, technical teams, and account stakeholders
* Skill in tracking and reporting portfolio performance using metrics, dashboards, or management reviews
* Experience identifying and managing cross project risks, dependencies, and resource constraints

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**  

* Relevant certifications such as PMP, PgMP, ITIL, or Six Sigma
* Experience in technology domains such as cloud, infrastructure, application services, or network services
* Experience with stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Support digital transformation through implementation of advanced solutions in areas like cloud computing, data analytics, artificial intelligence, and enterprise systems. * Identify operational trends and implement corrective and preventive actions

* Establish standards for operational work intake, prioritization, workflow management, and reporting
* Improve transparency, workload balancing, resource utilization, and reporting accuracy

* Provide executive oversight for high\-impact operational issues and service disruptions

* Partner with regional leadership teams across APAC and EMEA
* Collaborate closely with SIS Automation, Cloud, DevOps, Security, Platform Engineering, and Application teams
* Ensure alignment between regional operational execution and global infrastructure strategy
* Drive consistency and collaboration across geographically distributed teams

 **REQUIREMENTS**


How you will get here:

**Required**:

* Proven experience managing managers and cross\-functional infrastructure teams across global regions
* Strong knowledge of Cloud Infrastructure, Server and Compute Operations, Storage and Backup Platforms, Infrastructure Automation, and Platform Operations
* Experience building or managing CloudOps operational environments
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes and operational governance frameworks
* Advanced experience with JIRA or enterprise work management platforms
* Demonstrated experience leading major incidents and operational escalations
* Experience driving operational transformation and automation initiatives
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills

**Preferred**:

* Experience working across APAC and EMEA operational environments
* Background in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Automation initiatives
* Experience partnering with enterprise automation or engineering teams
* Exposure to AI\-enabled operations (AIOps) and operational analytics platforms
* Strong analytical and metrics\-driven leadership mindset


Leadership Competencies:

* Strategic Thinking
* Operational Excellence and Governance
* Executive Presence
* Automation and Transformation Leadership
* Data\-Driven Decision Making
* Cross\-Regional Collaboration
* Talent Development and Mentorship
* Organizational Change Leadership
* Structured and Scalable Operational Leadership

title: Associate Advisory Account Manager
description:
At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**About the Role**




 The Advisory Account Manager (AAM) is a dual\-mandate, portfolio\-owning role. Unlike a traditional CSM or a pure hunter\-AM, the AAM operates as a trusted advisor across the full customer lifecycle — responsible simultaneously for protecting Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and driving Net Expansion through upsell and cross\-sell. This is a digital\-first, high\-velocity motion that blends proactive advisory engagement with a disciplined, data\-driven approach to identifying both risk and opportunity across the assigned book.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**



* **Own an assigned portfolio of accounts end\-to\-end, accountable for both renewal/retention (GRR) and expansion outcomes across the book.**
* Proactively engage customers using the tiered digital engagement model (tech\-touch, low\-touch, and 1:many plays based on segment and risk/opportunity signal).
* Build and execute account\-level Customer Success Plans that identify whitespace for upsell/cross\-sell and flag early indicators of churn or contraction risk.
* Run consultative value conversations with key stakeholders — demonstrating ROI, product adoption gains, and business outcomes tied to the Freshworks suite.
* Drive expansion revenue through upsell (higher tiers, additional seats) and cross\-sell (adjacent Freshworks products) to meet or exceed a blended revenue target.
* Identify at\-risk accounts early using health scores, usage data, and engagement signals; build and execute save plans in partnership with Support, Billing, and Deal Desk.
* Maintain deep product fluency across the Freshworks suite to run demos, map use cases, and recommend the best\-fit solution for a customer's problem.
* Use the customer success platform to track account health, adoption metrics, and pipeline, and to report portfolio status on a defined cadence.
* Partner cross\-functionally with RevOps, Renewals, Sales, Support, and Product Marketing to remove friction across the customer journey.
* Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene for both the expansion and renewal book.
* Adhere to Freshworks compliance and information security processes in all customer\-facing activity.



**What Success Looks Like**



* Consistent attainment against a blended quota comprising Net Expansion (upsell/cross\-sell bookings) and Gross Revenue Retention (renewal/anti\-churn).
* Improving product adoption and account health scores across the assigned portfolio.
* A portfolio where expansion is proactively sourced — not just reactive to inbound demand — while renewal risk is caught and mitigated well ahead of the renewal date.


**Qualifications**
* 1–4 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or SaaS sales, with direct experience carrying both a retention and an expansion/upsell number.
* Demonstrated track record of account growth (upsell/cross\-sell) alongside strong renewal/retention performance — not one at the expense of the other.
* Consultative approach: comfortable building business cases, ROI narratives, and stakeholder\-mapped account plans.
* Experience managing a digital\-first portfolio at scale, using tech\-touch and low\-touch cadences alongside targeted 1:1 engagement.
* Working knowledge of SaaS retention/expansion metrics — GRR, NRR, churn, expansion ARR, adoption.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical/product concepts for varying stakeholder levels (ESSENTIAL).
* Comfort working with CRM and customer success tooling for health scoring, forecasting, and reporting.
* Self\-starter, organized, and able to prioritize across a large book without losing attention to at\-risk or high\-potential accounts.



 Bachelor's degree required; Business or Computer Science background preferred
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Bajaj Capital Insurance Broking Limited (BCIBL) is a licensed insurance broker regulated by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority (IRDA) and has been in operation since 2004, serving over six lakh clients across India. The company owns and operates BajajCapitalInsurance.com, a leading online portal for insurance comparison, transactions, and services. BCIBL offers a broad range of life and general insurance products, providing free quotes and online purchase options where available. Through its platform, customers can compare plans side by side, review hospital networks, and assess key benefits for term life, health (mediclaim), car, and travel insurance. The organization focuses on helping customers make informed, transparent insurance decisions with ease and convenience.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Relationship Manager role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Chennai. The Relationship Manager will be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of clients by understanding their insurance needs, recommending suitable life and general insurance products, and ensuring a seamless service experience. Day\-to\-day activities include engaging with prospective and existing clients, explaining product features and benefits, assisting with policy comparisons, handling documentation, and coordinating with internal teams for policy issuance and servicing. The role also involves maintaining accurate records in CRM systems, following up on renewals, resolving client queries, and supporting sales targets through proactive relationship\-building. The Relationship Manager is expected to uphold regulatory and company standards while providing clear, trustworthy guidance to clients.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong client relationship management and customer service skills, with the ability to build trust and long\-term engagement.
* Sales and negotiation capabilities, including experience in promoting financial or insurance products and meeting defined targets.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in explaining complex insurance concepts in clear, simple language.
* Basic analytical and problem\-solving abilities to compare insurance plans, interpret benefits, and support suitable product recommendations.
* Familiarity with insurance products (life and general) or financial services is preferred; prior experience in insurance broking or banking is an advantage.
* Comfort with using digital tools, online portals, and CRM or sales tracking systems for managing leads and client information.
* Minimum qualification: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; professional certifications in insurance or finance are beneficial.
* Ability to work in an on\-site environment in Chennai, with a proactive, goal\-oriented, and ethical approach to client advising.

title: Lead – Supply Chain Operations & Customer Experience
description:

* Own the post\-purchase journey end to end — from first delivery to repeat purchase, including re\-order nudges, win\-back campaigns, loyalty mechanics

title: Client Implementation & Service - Team Lead
description:
Who we are looking for
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced and delivery\-focused Team Lead to manage end\-to\-end client onboarding and conversion activities within the Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding function. The role is accountable for translating business requirements into scalable reconciliation solutions, directing system and data readiness, overseeing testing and production deployment, managing delivery risks, and ensuring a controlled transition to business\-as\-usual operations.
   

  

 The candidate will lead onboarding specialists and work closely with investment managers, custodians, fund administrators, business teams, technology partners, and reconciliation operations. Strong expertise in middle office reconciliation, data analysis, data mapping, TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, project delivery, people leadership, and stakeholder management is required.
   

  

 Why this role is important to us
   

  

 The Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding team supports the implementation of new investment managers and funds onto State Street’s reconciliation platforms. The Team Lead provides day\-to\-day delivery leadership and serves as the central coordination and escalation point across business, operations, technology, clients, and external data providers.
   

  

 The role is critical to ensuring that cash, position, transaction, and market\-value reconciliation requirements are accurately designed, configured, tested, deployed, and handed over to operations. It also promotes consistent delivery standards, effective risk management, team capability, process scalability, and a controlled, low\-risk transition into live reconciliation services.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.  

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
Overview:

The Customer Success Manager primary responsibility is to drive meaningful product adoption, measurable value, and practical use\-case expansion across a high\-volume pool of customers. You will use customer goals, workflow needs, product usage, and engagement trends to identify adoption opportunities, remove barriers, and recommend best practices that improve outcomes and return on investment. You will deliver this value at scale through digital\-first touchpoints, including Seismic Community, Seismic University courses, self\-guided resources, office hours, targeted adoption campaigns, and the consistent delivery of success metrics and adoption insights to key stakeholders. This role is focused on usage growth, workflow optimization, value realization, and business impact through practical, use\-case\-driven engagement delivered efficiently across many customers.
Who you are::
* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Sciences or related fields required. Master’s Degree is desired.
* 3\+ years of experience with Microsoft Office Suite, including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
* 2\+ years of experience using AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude to improve day\-to\-day efficiency and quality of work.
* 3\+ years of experience working with SaaS platforms, data structures, product analytics, and customer workflows.
* 1\+ year working with Gainsight preferred.
* Strong written and oral communication skills with the ability to explain product value, guide users through use cases, and influence adoption across customer teams.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into adoption plans, use cases, and practical product recommendations.
* Critical thinking, curiosity, analysis, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving expertise to diagnose adoption barriers and customer workflow challenges.


What you'll be doing::
**Who you are:*** Possess a strong sense of ownership and takes pride in all that you do.
* Comfortable in dynamic environments with changing priorities.
* Skilled at managing multiple responsibilities while striving to exceed expectations.
* Displays a sense of humor and humility during those challenging times.
* Self\-starter with the ability to manage multiple projects and customer accounts simultaneously.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and escalate customer issues.
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment.
 **What you will be doing:*** Drive adoption progress and product proficiency by delivering use\-case reinforcement, best\-practice coaching, and product guidance through digital touchpoints such as proactive Digital Sales Rooms, targeted email outreach, and office hours.
* Use product analytics, usage data, adoption health, and value realization metrics in Gainsight to identify trends, risks, adoption gaps, and ROI opportunities.
* Triage and prioritize customers based on health, product usage data, engagement, and risk signals; build focused intervention plans that increase usage, confidence, and value where the need is greatest.
* Translate customer goals, usage patterns, and workflow challenges into practical adoption recommendations, next\-best use cases, and repeatable success motions.
* Identify adoption blockers, configuration needs, and product feedback; coordinate with Support, Product, Services, or Engineering when additional expertise is required.
* Work within customer tenants to understand configuration, workflows, and platform usage; surface technical adoption gaps and recommend specific platform actions to drive customer outcomes.
* Execute scaled adoption motions by leveraging adoption playbooks, Seismic Community, Seismic University, office hours, targeted email campaigns, and Adoption\-at\-a\-Glance reporting to drive measurable usage growth across a broad book of business.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Support, Product, Services, and regional CS teams to escalate blockers, share customer insights, and drive resolution of adoption barriers.

Job Posting Footer:  

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.  

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

The objective of this role is to drive the adoption of our products within our clients and to help our solutions become a mission\-critical, irreplaceable part of our client's talent acquisition strategy.
   

  

  

  

 You will partner closely with Account Managers to ensure LinkedIn Customers achieve a significant return and feel successful with their LinkedIn investment. The CSM serves as a key project manager and talent advisor to assigned accounts, to support effective onboarding and complex implementation of products for our existing customers.
   

  





 At LinkedIn, we trust each other to do our best work where it works best for us and our teams. This role offers a hybrid work option, meaning you can both work from home and commute to a LinkedIn office, depending on what’s best for you and when it is important for your team to be together.
   

  

  

  

**Responsibilities** 
  

  




* Partner with the account team on prioritized accounts in order to drive overall customer adoption, enhance customer success, and mitigate customer churn risk
* Agree on business objectives and goals with customers and build measurable success plans, set the cadence of communication to deliver ROI and operational reviews.
* Ensure success by setting goals that result in customer’s fluency in product functionality and understanding of how to leverage that solution to meet their objectives
* Maintain healthy customer engagement levels by identifying low utilization and providing solutions to further drive customer success
* Analyze engagement metrics to identify and provide product education and ongoing onboarding needs, driving best practice usage of the Learning Center
* Act as a trusted advisor to customer management to drive product adoption and ensure they leverage the solution to achieve agreed operational priorities, leading to full business value
* Maintain a deep understanding of LinkedIn products and industry knowledge to effectively drive greater customer engagement on the most relevant features/functionality for their specific business needs
* Document all communication with accounts accurately and in a timely manner via system tools.
* Interpret customer insights to drive change in product and act as the voice of the customer to the Product team
* Provide strategic advice to help drive product adoption and map solutions to existing customer workflows
* Celebrate customer wins when customers are realizing success through the use of LinkedIn’s products and solutions
* Act as a change agent for internal (systems \& process) and external (product \& workflow) change management


**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:** 
  

  




* 7\+ years of experience in Consulting, Customer Success, Account Management, Customer Education/Training, Sales, Project Management, Talent Management



**Preferred Qualifications:** 
  

  




* BS/BA degree from a 4\-year college or university
* Recruiting, Learning, Human Capital Management, or other applicable experience
* Demonstrates an innate curiosity and growth mindset
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and technical aptitude
* Excellent organizational, project management, and change management skills
* Demonstrated experience in understanding and aligning to customer objectives, building relationships across multiple stakeholders, to drive value
* Experience analyzing data, trends, and client information to build actionable strategy and identify product or service growth opportunities
* Proficient in CRM (Dynamics) \& Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build authentic business relationships and deal effectively with relational challenges as they come up



**Suggested Skills**



* Analytical Skills
* Communication
* Training delivery
* AI Fluency

title: Client Success Manager (B2B)
description:
We run AI \+ human voice calls for Amazon, Flipkart, Paytm, and more — 10M\+ conversations a month. We're hiring an Account Manager to own client relationships and grow them. If you're sharp, logical, and love solving problems, read on.
 



  





**About Futwork** 




 Futwork runs AI \+ human voice calls for enterprises, handling both inbound and outbound calling. We power 10M\+ conversations a month for top companies like Amazon, Flipkart, Paytm, Lenskart, Shiprocket, and BharatPe across logistics, e\-commerce, fintech, education, and more.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 You will own a set of client accounts (partners who run their calling operations with us). Your job is to keep these clients happy, make sure they hit their goals, and grow the account over time. This is a mix of client management, coordination, and problem\-solving.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own 5–7 client accounts and be their main point of contact at Futwork.
* Understand each client's business, their goals, and the return they expect for the time and money they invest with us.
* Take client requirements and pass them clearly to our internal teams (operations and tech).
* Make sure new processes go live on time, and keep the client updated at every step.
* Track performance against agreed benchmarks. If numbers are not being met, dig into why.
* Do a proper root cause analysis (RCA) when things go off track, find the real gap, and fix it with the internal team or client.
* Check that our operations team is running the process correctly, and close any gaps you spot.
* Set the right expectations with clients, so there are no surprises.
* Handle discussions between our tech/ops teams and the client's teams.
* When there are limitations at our end \- for eg tech issues, workflows, uncontrollables\- communicate them honestly and in a way that keeps the client's trust.
* Look for ways to grow the account — more use cases, more volume, more value.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 2–3 years of experience in a relevant role (account management, client success, or similar \- B2B roles only; no B2C customer service/success). Minimum 2 years.
* Smart, logical thinkers who can break down a problem and find the real reason behind it.
* Strong common sense and the ability to make good decisions on your own.
* People who can understand both our business and the client's business quickly.
* Good communicators who can keep clients calm, confident, and informed.
* Comfortable coordinating across many teams and keeping timelines on track.
* Analytical mindset — you enjoy digging into data and numbers to find answers.
* Excellent command of spoken and written communication skills in English



  





**Tools You Should Know** 



* Strong hands\-on skills in Excel and Google Sheets.
* Comfortable with data reporting — building and reading reports to track performance.
* Handy with AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI Studio and similar.
* Able to use AI tools to automate processes and repetitive tasks wherever possible, to work faster and smarter.



  





**Details** 



* **Experience:** 
 2–3 years (minimum 2 years)
* **Salary:** 
 ₹4\.8–7 LPA
* **Location:** 
 Marol, Andheri East — 5–6 minute walk from the metro station (on\-site)

title: Senior Client Service Manager
description:
Job Title: Client Service Manager / Sr. Client Service Manager (Skale 50\)
   

  

**PURPOSE:** 
 TO BE A KEY POINT OF CONTACT FOR CLIENTS ON A SPECIFIC AREA OF THEIR BUSINESS. TO HANDLE ALL DATA REQUESTS AND PROJECT BRIEFS ENSURING TIMELY, ACCURATE DELIVERY OF INFORMATION AND OFFERING GOOD LEVELS OF INSIGHT, WHILST ALSO CONTRIBUTING TO THE GROWTH OF THE CLIENT’S BUSINESS WITHIN KANTAR WORLDPANEL BY IDENTIFYING POTENTIAL REVENUE OPPORTUNITIES.
   

  

**Client Relationship**
 ü Be a key point of contact for a specific area of the client’s business, attending on\-site days and owning all related client data requests and project briefs
   

  

 ü Deliver a highly responsive service to clients, continuing to build good relationships and trust with your contacts
   

  

 ü Understand where Worldpanel complements and competes with other information your client buys
   

  

 ü Further develop the client relationship by seeking out opportunities to introduce other Worldpanel capabilities and services to your contacts
   

  

**Account Handling**
 ü Be responsible for managing your own day\-to\-day workload on the area of the business you have responsibility for and establishing priorities with the client as needed
   

  

 ü Anticipate client demands and proactively find solutions, rather than just answering requests
   

  

 ü Support Manager in client meetings/whilst on\-site by preparing meeting material and handling follow\-up requests
   

  

 ü Personally de\-brief key contacts on any requests/project briefs that you have completed
   

  

 ü Demonstrate commercial awareness by understanding revenue targets, identifying and acting upon potential revenue opportunities
   

  

 ü Manage client expectations if demands are unreasonable or you can see a better approach
   

  

 ü Demonstrate an inquisitive nature and desire to go the extra mile for your client contacts
   

  

 ü Anticipate client needs and be cognizant of the Worldpanel plans for developing the account
   

  

 ü When faced with a problem adopt a positive, solution\-driven attitude
   

  

 ü Train client users on software and data interpretation
   

  

**Service Development**
 ü Highlight and escalate client concerns with any Worldpanel deliverables and help identify potential issues as they arise
   

  

 ü Offer your opinion and recommendations to your team manager regarding the relevance and effectiveness of regular deliverables and general client servicing in order to ensure the service’s high standard is maintained.
   

  

 ü Share best practices and efficient ways of working with other team members
   

  

**Basic Data \& Tracking**
 ü Assume responsibility for checking and reviewing any regular reports that are sent out to your client contacts to ensure their accuracy and relevance
   

  

 ü Production and interpretation of BIG 5 analyses (Cross Tabs, Gain \& Loss, Entry – Erosion, LMH, Multiple Usership) with a focus on finding patterns in the data, highlighting key points and making recommendations
   

  

 ü Confidently use the more advanced capabilities within PulsePlus such as Customized Grouping etc
   

  

 ü Build a network of contacts within Worldpanel Operations who can help you resolve difficulties with the data or systems if they arise
   

  

**Analysis \& Insight**
 ü Attend on\-site days and de\-brief key contacts on any requests/smaller project briefs that you have completed
   

  

 ü Discuss briefs with clients, challenging appropriately to make sure requests have been properly thought through and offering advice on how best to tackle issues
   

  

 ü Be conversant in the methodology and deliverables of all the panels and services run by the division – eg building a good working knowledge of Expert Services capabilities in order to introduce them as relevant to help solve client issues
   

  

 ü Recognise patterns, draw logical conclusions, consider implications and make recommendations based on your analysis and knowledge of the client’s business
   

  

 ü Always add value to basic ad\-hoc client data requests by adding commentary and drawing out key findings
   

  

 ü Draw on your understanding of your client’s business, brand plans and category goals in order to ensure your recommendations are relevant
   

  

 ü Be responsible for managing client briefs from start to finish ie – designing correct methodology, running the required analysis, adding interpretation and insight based on category knowledge, delivering back to the client
   

  

**Team, People \& Self Development**
 ü Actively participate in your Academy training programmes to develop the required skills
   

  

 ü Seek opportunities to practice and apply what you have learned in training
   

  

 ü Take part in your own performance management using the KWP appraisal system
   

  

 ü Ensure you maintain an up\-to\-date PDP with your line manager – monitor your progress and find solutions for your development needs
   

  

 ü Engage with your line manager – seeking their feedback, input and contribution to your development – act upon it appropriately asking for advice when relevant
   

  

 ü Build relationships internally, specifically with immediate team with the view to willingly offer help and support to others in the team where possible
   

  

 ü Understand your personal impact, and build your reputation as a member of the team who has the confidence to work independently when required, but who is also an active, flexible, confident and trusted team member
   

  

 ü Show that you are a positive, inquisitive individual who is prepared to go the extra mile and get involved
   

  

 ü Seek out opportunities to grow your client and category knowledge by reading trade press, making store visits, meeting the panel respondents having an opinion on your clients’ products and advertising (and their competitor products/advertising) for example
   

  

**PERSON SPECIFICATION**
**A person in this role is likely to have the ability to:**
 ü Gather facts and figures, monitor self and others, and achieve goals in a timely and factual manner
   

  

 ü Seek ways of perfecting things, raising standards, reducing errors and overcoming omissions
   

  

 ü Bring a sense of urgency to situations, demonstrating an active approach, and a willingness to get involved in order to increase the pace, achieve goals and meet objectives
   

  

 ü Take decisions as appropriate, and ensure others do likewise
   

  

 ü Provide satisfactory solutions in situations involving the new and unexpected
   

  

 ü Have a flexible approach in changing situations and be adaptable in difficult circumstances, continuously striving to achieve a result
   

  

 ü Work independently when required, while remaining responsive to feedback and direction received from their line manager
   

  

 ü Be curious, demonstrate a real desire to learn, seek out training opportunities and actively participate in meetings (both internal and external as appropriate)
   

  

 ü Show dedication to both the client and the client service team, demonstrating a professional work ethic and willingness to go the extra mile when required
   

  

**A person aspiring towards promotion to Account Manager should be demonstrating:**
 ü A good understanding of client’s overall goals and objectives, as well as the role that different departments and individuals are playing in achieving these
   

  

 ü An increasing network of contacts within the client organisation, not limited to the insight department
   

  

 ü An increasing network of internal contacts in “expert” roles within the Kantar Worldpanel India
   

  

 ü An awareness of contractual obligations and ability to spot potential conflicts or issues arising
   

  

 ü Ability to convert revenue opportunities arising from client issues
   

  

 ü Evidence of introducing new concepts or new ways of working with your client
   

  

 ü Ability to independently deliver actionable insights focused on things your client can influence
   

  

 ü Give junior members coaching and feedback, acting as a role model and mentoring where appropriate
   

  

 ü A strong track record of attending and actively participating in training
   

  

 ü Ownership of your self development in completing and managing your own PDP, highlighting areas where further development is required

 • Plan, Forecast, measure, and report business volumes on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis as required.

 • The person should be team player and should be able to work with and manage direct, support and cross\-functional teams and other relevant stakeholders to grow business.
 



 • Ability to drive relationship at Senior levels and decision makers in the PSUs/Pvt/MNC Banks \& NBFCs. Should be able to partner the stakeholders in the FIs to work out solutions for them from our product suite.
 



 • The person should be able to plan, forecast, measure, and report business volumes on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis as required.

* Experience selling capital equipment, medical devices, or clinically focused solutions within a healthcare environment.
* Experience developing and executing territory or regional business plans to achieve commercial objectives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within Spine, Orthopedics, Neurosurgery, Trauma, or Operating Room (O.R.) environments.

* Review the health of accounts regularly across client relationships, revenue, profitability, scope, quality of work and growth potential.



  




* Identify opportunities to deepen existing relationships through upselling, cross\-selling and expanding the agency’s role within the client’s business.



  




* Develop account growth plans and work with Account Managers and senior leadership to convert identified opportunities.



  




* Own the commercial health of the portfolio, including revenue, scope, budgets, resource requirements and profitability.



  




* Lead senior\-level client reviews and conversations, bringing recommendations, insights and a clear point of view to the table.



  




* Challenge client briefs and internal thinking where required, ensuring the agency is solving meaningful business and brand problems.



  




* Work closely with Creative and Strategy leadership to ensure the work across the portfolio is strategically strong, relevant and aligned with client objectives.



  




* Lead and mentor Account Managers and wider account teams, setting clear expectations around client management, business growth and ownership.



  




* Build strong second\-line leadership within accounts, ensuring Account Managers are empowered to independently manage their businesses.

title: Senior Analyst, Incident Management
description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

  

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.  

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.  

Are you ready to love your job?  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.**PURPOSE**
-----------


Coordinates and oversees the resolution of critical incidents ensuring minimal business impact and swift restoration of services through structured processes and effective communication (and triggers crisis management process).**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

* As Senior Analyst, Incident Management, you will serve as the operational control tower for Major Incidents and Priority 1 incidents across the Digital Customer Organization (DCO) and Portfolio Service Operations (PSO). You will establish command and control, coordinate the right technical and business resources, and maintain a disciplined focus on restoring customer services while minimizing operational, financial, reputational, and customer impact.
* You will be accountable for the quality and pace of end\-to\-end major incident governance, including impact assessment, stakeholder mobilization, technical and customer bridge management, escalation, communications, recovery validation, documentation, and post\-incident follow\-through. You will support the accountable Incident Manager and ensure that resolver teams retain ownership of technical diagnosis and remediation.
* Reporting to the Manager, Major Incident Management, you will be part of the Digital Customer Organization (DCO)function responsible for service resilience, customer confidence, consistent global incident response, and the continued transformation and maturity of Incident Management.
* You will collaborate with DCO Service Desks, PSO resolver teams, Customer Service Managers (CSO), Site Reliability Engineers (SRE), Service Practice Owners, Product and Engineering teams, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Vendor Management (VMO), suppliers, and senior stakeholders. Through these partnerships, you will strengthen DCO and PSO integration, improve operational handovers, and convert incident learning into sustainable service improvements.
* Lead and coordinate Major Incidents and P1 incidents from declaration through service restoration and formal closure, maintaining a clear command structure, accurate situational awareness, and momentum toward recovery.
* Rapidly evaluate technical, customer, and business impact; validate priority; initiate the appropriate Major Incident or crisis pathway; and ensure compliance with agreed SLAs, OLAs, customer commitments, and escalation procedures.
* Mobilize and coordinate DCO, PSO, SRE, Product, Engineering, vendor, supplier, and specialist resolver teams, establishing clear accountabilities, time\-bound actions, dependencies, and escalation points.
* Establish and facilitate technical, customer, and management bridges, keeping discussions outcome\-focused, recording decisions and actions, challenging stalled progress, and escalating risks, resource gaps, or conflicting priorities.
* Deliver accurate, concise, and timely communications for customers, operations, senior leadership, and executives, clearly presenting impact, recovery actions, workarounds, risks, assumptions, estimated next updates, and service status.
* Maintain a complete and auditable incident record in the ITSM platform, including business impact, chronology, ownership, decisions, evidence, communications, recovery validation, links to related Problems and Changes, and closure details.
* Produce high\-quality Post\-Major Incident Reports (PMIRs), executive summaries, and post\-incident review packs; facilitate blameless learning reviews that identify control gaps, contributing factors, and practical opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) with Problem Management and technical owners, ensuring actions are risk\-based, measurable, assigned, due\-dated, tracked, and closed only after effectiveness is verified.
* Analyze incident performance and trends, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, repeat incidents, business impact, communication timeliness, escalation quality, action ageing, and customer feedback; translate insights into prioritized improvement plans.
* Advance the maturity of Incident Management through playbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, templates, simulations, training, automation opportunities, governance reviews, and stronger integration across DCO, PSO, SRE, CSO, VMO, and Service Practices.

  


Qualifications:
**EXPERIENCE**
--------------


Preferably 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in a customer\-focused service or support role within a large\-scale enterprise environment. Experience should include Customer Support, Service Desk, Help Desk, Call Centre, Incident Management, Service Operations, NOC, Command Centre, or IT Operations. **NICE TO HAVE*** ITIL 4 Foundation/Practitioner, SRE, Agile, DevOps, Lean, Six Sigma, or related Service Management certifications.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical environments such as aviation, travel technology, telecommunications, cloud services, managed infrastructure, SaaS platforms, or financial services, with exposure to executive communications, crisis management, and business continuity processes.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, observability and monitoring tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, etc), operational analytics, AI Ops, and Incident Management transformation initiatives.
  

Candidates should demonstrate strong customer engagement skills and practical experience supporting a broad range of services and products at intermediate to advanced levels. Experience or working knowledge of airline and travel industry operations, applications, and customer service environments is highly desirable.**KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS**
-----------------------

**IT Service Management Knowledge**

* Advanced practical understanding of ITIL\-based Incident and Major Incident Management, including interfaces with Problem, Change, Event, Knowledge, Service Level and Continual Improvement practices.
* Understanding of service management governance, SLAs/OLAs, operational acceptance, service transition, risk and control frameworks.
* Proficiency with enterprise ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent, collaboration tools, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories.
* Strong command of RCA methods including 5 Whys, fishbone analysis, fault\-tree thinking, timeline analysis and contributory\-factor analysis.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Broad operational understanding of enterprise networks, LAN/WAN, MPLS, SD\-WAN, VPN, DNS, load balancing, firewalls and connectivity services.
* Working knowledge of cloud, data centre, virtualization, compute, storage, databases, middleware, messaging, APIs, identity, monitoring and application support.
* Ability to interpret monitoring alerts, logs, service dependencies, transaction flows, change records and technical recovery plans.
* Awareness of cybersecurity incident interfaces, business continuity, disaster recovery and regulated or safety\-critical service environments.
* Ability to lead technical specialists effectively without being the deepest subject\-matter expert in every technology domain.

**Management \& Interpersonal Skills**

* Exceptional incident leadership, command\-and\-control, facilitation and prioritization under time pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including executive summaries and customer\-facing updates.
* Strong analytical reasoning, structured problem solving, attention to evidence and disciplined decision\-making.
* Influencing, negotiation and conflict\-resolution capability across teams with competing priorities and no direct reporting relationship.
* Cultural awareness and effectiveness in a global, virtual and matrix organization.

**PROFESSION COMPETENCIES**
---------------------------

**Major Incident Leadership:** Establishes control rapidly, sets priorities, drives decisions and maintains momentum until stable service is verified.

**Customer \& Business Orientation:** Understands business impact and balances technical recovery, operational risk, contractual commitments and customer experience.

**Operational Excellence:** Applies repeatable controls, accurate records, measurable standards and evidence\-based governance.

**Problem Solving \& Judgement:** Synthesizes incomplete information, challenges assumptions and makes timely, risk\-informed decisions.

**Process Integration:** Connects incident learning to Problem, Change, Knowledge, Event, Service Level and Continual Improvement outcomes.

**Transformation \& Improvement:** Identifies systemic gaps and converts lessons into sustainable improvements, automation and improved ways of working.

**Stakeholder Leadership:** Influences global teams, suppliers, customers and leaders through credibility, clarity and constructive challenge.

**Data \& Insight:** Uses operational metrics, trends and quality analysis to target improvements and demonstrate benefits.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**
---------------------

* Accountability and ownership
* Customer centricity
* Collaboration and inclusion
* Integrity and professional courage
* Agility and resilience
* Strategic and systems thinking
* Results orientation
* Learning mindset and continuous improvement
* Composure under pressure
* Attention to detail and quality

**EDUCATION \& QUALIFICATIONS**
-------------------------------


? Diploma / Certificate in Computer Science Electronic Engineering or equivalent Telecommunications in country qualification. ? Bachelors/University degree in related field or equivalent work experience required. ? ITIL Foundation Certificate ?**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

  

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.  

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

  

**Flex\-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.  

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.  

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** and **Airport Council International** \-available to all employees\-to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.  

**Competitive Benefits:** Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status. *SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*

title: CPL Delivery Manager
description:
CPL Delivery Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 years
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a CPL Delivery Manager to own the end\-to\-end delivery and performance of lead generation campaigns. This role sits at the intersection of publisher relationships, campaign performance, and business growth, ensuring campaigns consistently deliver the right balance of quality, volume, and profitability.
 



 The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in CPL/CPA affiliate marketing, strong publisher relationships, and a data\-driven approach to campaign optimization.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Success in this role means consistently delivering high\-quality leads at scale, maintaining strong publisher partnerships, and improving campaign performance and profitability through data\-led decisions.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of CPL/CPA campaigns, from publisher onboarding and traffic activation to ongoing optimization and performance management.
* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage high\-quality publishers and affiliates aligned with campaign objectives.
* Build and maintain strong publisher relationships to ensure consistent traffic volume, lead quality, and long\-term business growth.
* Monitor campaign performance across volume, conversion rates, lead quality, payout, ROI, and profitability, and take timely optimization actions.
* Analyze campaign and publisher\-level data using Excel/Google Sheets to identify trends, performance gaps, and growth opportunities.
* Work with tracking platforms such as Trackier, Everflow, Affise, HasOffers, or similar affiliate tracking solutions.
* Negotiate commercial terms, payouts, traffic volumes, and campaign requirements with publishers and affiliates.
* Collaborate with internal teams to resolve campaign delivery, tracking, lead validation, and quality\-related issues.
* Identify and address fraudulent, low\-quality, or non\-compliant traffic to protect campaign performance and advertiser relationships.
* Support the scaling of successful campaigns across publishers, geographies, and international markets.
* Maintain accurate campaign and publisher performance records and provide regular performance updates.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 2–5 years of experience in CPL/CPA affiliate marketing, performance marketing, lead generation, or a closely related role.
* Hands\-on experience managing affiliate/publisher relationships and campaign delivery.
* Strong understanding of CPL, CPA, lead quality, conversion rates, payouts, ROI, and campaign profitability.
* Experience with affiliate tracking platforms such as Trackier, Everflow, Affise, HasOffers, or similar tools.
* Strong analytical skills with practical experience using Excel or Google Sheets.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and a data\-driven approach to decision\-making.



  





**Good to Have** 



* An established network of publishers and affiliates.
* Experience managing international or high\-volume lead generation campaigns.
* Knowledge of fraud detection, lead validation, and traffic quality monitoring.
* Experience scaling campaigns while maintaining lead quality and profitability.

title: Territory Account Rep
description:
**Job Description:**
====================

**Pentair Overview**


At Pentair, we are driven to create a better world through smart, sustainable water solutions. Our approximately 11,250 global employees are living our purpose to make the most of water, life’s most essential resource. We work around the globe to deliver industry\-leading products, services, and solutions for our customers’ diverse needs in water and other fluids. Our inventive thinking, collaborative spirit, disciplined work ethic and breadth of experts allows us to deliver **Inspired** **Solutions for a Changing World**.

**ROLE SUMMARY:**


We are looking for an enthusiastic Sales Manager our Pool product sales in India, Maldives, Nepal, Bhutan \& Sri Lanka. Suitable candidate is required to create business opportunities and has responsibility to sell products (mainly Swimming Pool, Fountain and Aquatic products) in the Residential/commercial market with consultative approach/value selling to OEMs, End User \& driving Channel Partners for business development. He or she is expected to work closely with Pool distribution channels, Major Pool builders, Architects, Design consultants and major Developers in the region. Incumbent will have to provide sales management for the specified region/territory and sales development activities, in alignment with the strategic direction from the company.

**Essential Responsibilities /Expectations:**

* The Sales resource works closely with internal and external stakeholders to meet assigned objectives, reporting to national sales manager
* Drive growth by continuously creating and selling customer value propositions, geographical coverage, meeting End User/OEM in assigned territory. Focus on our competitive advantage while leveraging our broad product portfolio
* Working closely with Channel partners in forecasting, order indents to ensure the healthy inventory to satisfy the market demands
* Working closely with distribution partners in driving growth and securing major commercial project opportunities
* Working with major architects, design consultants to specify Pentair Pool product specifications
* Working with stake holders and agencies in BIS regulatory requirements for specific products
* Supporting Regional Sales Manager with sourcing and other internal departments to establish the vendor and product lines.
* Provide Technical training/inputs on our products and applications to channel partners, consultants and OEM’s.
* Partner cross\-functionally within organization to optimize our solutions offering.
* Develop a plan to effectively meet sales targets by meeting or exceeding key metrics for revenue, account retention.
* Keep updating awareness of market trends, competitive actions, product needs, and customer base.
* Provide technical support to Channel Partners, OEMs \& End Customers.
* Regular usage of CRM Salesforce for sales management

**Experience Required:** 8 years or more.

**Educational Qualification/experience/skills:**

* Bachelors in Engg degree with 8\+ years of experience in application knowledge and technical selling
* Deep domain knowledge in Swimming Pool, Fountain and Aquatic treatment systems and equipment’s
* Experience in Pool system design and equipment selections
* Well\-developed sales skills to make decisions and evaluations to determine the needs of the customers.
* Ability to work on your own initiative and make effective decisions under pressure.
* Willingness to travel frequently.
* Excellent oral, written \& strong communication skills in both technical and business terms.
* Excellent customer relations skills
* Treats all colleagues and customers with dignity, respect, and courtesy.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and prior use of a CRM tool to manage customer engagements and run sales reports.
* Knowledge of target market industries is highly desirable.
* Strong organizational, analytical and project management skills

title: Client Servicing Manager
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 At Mad Men Marketing, we’re not just about ads\- we’re about impact. As a new\-age creative and digital agency, we work at the intersection of ideas, technology, and culture. We collaborate with some of the most exciting brands in India, crafting stories that spark conversations and drive measurable results. If you're passionate about building brands and managing relationships that matter, you might be the perfect fit.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are seeking a seasoned Client Servicing Manager/Account Manager who will be responsible for managing top\-tier client relationships and leading the execution of strategic digital campaigns. You’ll serve as the go\-to person for both clients and internal teams, ensuring seamless delivery and client satisfaction. This is a senior\-level role that demands commercial acumen, creative thinking, and a deep understanding of digital marketing trends.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Client Relationship Management**



 Act as the primary liaison for key clients, nurturing strong and lasting partnerships.
 



 Gain a thorough understanding of each client’s business goals, target audience, and market positioning.
 



 Maintain high levels of client satisfaction through clear communication, transparency, and timely delivery.
 



  




* **Campaign Planning \& Execution**



 Lead the full lifecycle of campaigns—from brief to brainstorm, from strategy to reporting.
 



 Work cross\-functionally with internal teams (creative, content, influencer, media, performance) to drive execution.
 



 Ensure project timelines, budgets, and quality standards are met without compromise.
 



  




* **Strategic Consulting \& Brand Stewardship**



 Deliver strategic guidance backed by industry trends and insights to help clients meet their marketing objectives.
 



 Ensure all campaigns are on\-brand and aligned with the client’s voice, positioning, and market narrative.
 



 Recommend new formats, channels, or content opportunities based on platform innovation and market shifts.
 



  




* **Performance Monitoring \& Reporting**



 Monitor campaign KPIs and performance metrics using tools like Google Analytics, Meta Suite, and internal dashboards.
 



 Analyze results to deliver actionable insights and clear next steps to improve campaign outcomes.
 



 Lead client reporting meetings and present performance reviews, learnings, and forward\-looking strategies.
 



  




* **Revenue Growth \& Account Expansion**



 Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities within existing accounts—introducing new services or retainer scopes.
 



 Collaborate with the new business team to pitch ideas and renew or expand contracts.
 



 Play a key role in driving account revenue and contributing to overall agency growth.
 



  




* **Team Collaboration \& Leadership**



 Be the internal voice of the client—aligning teams and managing expectations across departments.
 



 Mentor junior account executives or interns, sharing best practices and leadership guidance.
 



 Drive internal brainstorming sessions to enhance campaign quality and originality.
 



  




* **Crisis Management \& Problem Solving**



 Tackle challenges head\-on—whether it’s a tight deadline, a shifting brief, or a difficult client conversation.
 



 Maintain professionalism under pressure, offering quick solutions and managing escalation efficiently.
 



 Stay adaptable and proactive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum 2\+ years of account management experience in a digital/creative agency.
* Proven ability to manage high\-stakes clients and complex campaigns.
* Solid understanding of digital marketing, content creation, performance media, and influencer strategy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with client\-facing polish.
* Proficiency in tools like Google Workspace, MS Office, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and project trackers.
* Ability to handle multiple projects, teams, and deadlines simultaneously with composure and clarity.



  





 Full\-Time \| Immediate Joiners only
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices.
