You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
About the Role


Equinix is seeking a highly motivated **Senior Business Systems Analyst** to join our Bangalore office. In this role, you will serve as the functional and systems expert for Source to Pay processes and technology solutions, partnering closely with Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, IT, and other business stakeholders to drive process excellence and digital transformation.


You will be responsible for analyzing business requirements, designing scalable P2P solutions, optimizing Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) processes, and supporting global procurement initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion with exceptional analytical, stakeholder management, and solution design skills.


The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering business value through process standardization, automation, system enhancements, integrations, and adoption of best\-in\-class procurement practices that support Equinix's global operations.

  

Key Responsibilities


 Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Financials and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) processes across global business units.


 Partner with Finance, Accounts Payable, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business Operations, and IT stakeholders to gather, analyze, document, and prioritize business requirements.


 Translate business requirements into functional designs, process improvements, solution architectures, and implementation roadmaps.


 Lead end\-to\-end Oracle Cloud/EBS functional initiatives spanning Procure\-to\-Pay, Accounts Payable, General Ledger integration points, Supplier Risk Management, Purchasing, and Financial Operations.


 Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on process optimization, automation, controls, compliance, and operational efficiency.


 Analyze current\-state business processes and identify opportunities for standardization, simplification, and digital transformation across finance and procurement functions.


 Facilitate requirements workshops, fit\-gap analyses, solution design sessions, process mapping exercises, and stakeholder reviews.


 Configure, support, and enhance Oracle Financials and Procurement modules, including system testing, deployment, and post\-production support.


 Collaborate with technical teams, integration teams, reporting teams, and third\-party vendors to deliver scalable enterprise solutions.


 Support and coordinate integrations between Oracle ERP and upstream/downstream systems, including banking, supplier, tax, reporting, and other enterprise applications.


 Lead data conversion, reconciliation, system validation, SIT/UAT testing, defect resolution, and change management activities during implementations and enhancements.


 Develop and maintain business process documentation, functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, and operational procedures.


 Design and support reports, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics that provide visibility into financial and operational performance.


 Partner with business leaders to recommend best\-practice solutions aligned with Oracle capabilities, governance standards, and evolving business needs.


 Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive timely resolution of functional and process\-related challenges.


 Support period\-end close activities, financial controls, audit requirements, and compliance initiatives related to P2P processes.


 Provide mentorship to junior analysts and consultants while contributing to functional competency development across Finance and ERP domains.


 Stay current with Oracle ERP capabilities, emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices across Finance, P2P, and enterprise business processes.

  

Required Qualifications


 Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related field.


 8\+ years of experience as an Oracle Functional Consultant, Business Systems Analyst, ERP Analyst, or Functional Lead supporting Finance and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) business processes.


 Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle ERP Cloud and/or Oracle E\-Business Suite, including Purchasing, Accounts Payable, Supplier Management, General Ledger integrations, and Procurement modules.


 Deep understanding of end\-to\-end Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Accounts Payable (AP), Supplier Management, Financial Controls, and ERP business processes.


 Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications, process designs, configuration solutions, and implementation roadmaps.


 Proven track record leading Oracle ERP implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and business transformation initiatives.


 Strong knowledge of finance and procurement controls, approval workflows, compliance requirements, audit support, and business governance practices.


 Experience supporting enterprise application integrations between Oracle ERP, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Banking, Tax, and third\-party systems.


 Hands\-on experience with configuration, testing, SIT/UAT coordination, defect management, production support, and release management activities.


 Strong understanding of Oracle reporting, analytics, dashboards, and KPI development to support business decision\-making.


 Experience with data conversion, data migration, reconciliation, and master data management activities.


 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and business process improvement skills.


 Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery environments.


 Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations.


 Ability to work effectively with global teams across multiple regions and time zones.


 Oracle Cloud certification in Procurement, Financials, or related Oracle ERP modules is preferred.


 Experience leading or supporting Oracle Cloud ERP implementation and transformation programs.


 Knowledge of complementary enterprise applications such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, Ivalua, GEP, Concur, BlackLine, or other finance/procurement platforms is a plus.


 Experience with integrations, APIs, middleware platforms, and enterprise architecture frameworks.


 Strong understanding of Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, and Shared Services business processes.


 Experience supporting month\-end close, financial operations, audit readiness, and compliance initiatives.


 Project management, change management, and stakeholder engagement experience preferred.


How You will find success


* Cultivate a strong sense of curiosity and a product\-focused mindset.
* Collaborate effectively with managers, cross\-functional teams, and teammates to achieve shared goals.
* Demonstrate persistence, creativity, and an unwavering drive to deliver results.
* Take pride in ownership and consistently strive for excellence in every initiative.

This role is tasked with the overall responsibility for the test effort's success. The role involves quality and test advocacy, resource planning and management, and resolution of issues that impede the test effort.


Single point of contact for testing for the project
  

Coordinates with the project team (QA/Project Management, Bas, Technology and QA Directors) to ensure the Master test Plan is created, reviewed and signed off
  

Ensure traceability of all testing deliverables to business requirements
  

Manage test lead's and tester's work throughout testing life cycle to ensure timely completion of all testing deliverables
  

Ensuring the appropriate planning and management of the test resources
  

Assessing the progress and effectiveness of the test effort
  

Develop/maintain testing process training materials and ensure that the team follows the testing standards, guidelines, and testing methodology as specified in the test strategy document.
  

Establish and facilitate communication between QA Team, Project Team and appropriate support teams
  

Weekly status updates and reporting
  

Prioritize impacts and facilitate viable workarounds
  

Provide regular status of progress, as well as issues and appropriate escalation requests to Stakeholders (Development Manager, QA Directors and Business Managers)
  

Provide ongoing coaching and support for new test resources joining the test or as needed
  

Advocating the appropriate level of quality by the resolution of important Defects
  

Advocating an appropriate level of testability focus in the software development process
  

Organize various scrum and status update meetings
  

Build a testing team of professionals with appropriate skills, attitudes and motivation.
  

Identify Training requirements
  

Assign task to all Testing Team members and ensure that all of them have sufficient work in the project
  

Ensure content and structure of all Testing documents / artifacts is documented and maintained
  

Be a strong leader for the team to look up to and follow. Be instrumental to conduct performance reviews.
  

Skills:\-
  

The appropriate skills and knowledge for the Test Manager role include:
  

10 \+years of overall testing experience across multiple platforms and applications which includes proven experience of leading test teams for a minimum of 5 years.
  

Must have hands on working experience in manual /automation testing and usage of different test management tools, Testing techniques, Estimation, Design Test solutions.
  

Expertise in any two major stream of testing (Functional Automation, Security, process definition or Performance)
  

Should have led projects on Manual testing and Automation/Performance testing
  

Ability to lead a team of 15\+ engineers
  

Ability to think on their feet and lead by example. This will be a hand on Lead position with the flexibility to take on new responsibilities when asked to do so
  

Knowledge of all aspects of the software engineering process
  

People skills, especially diplomacy and advocacy skills
  

Planning and management skills
  

Should have strong experience on Agile, Kanban etc. processes
  

Should have knowledge on any of the Scripting languages
  

Able to mentor the team on Technical aspects
  

Strong experience in preparing project status reports
  

Excellent Communication skills

title: Customer Assurance Prog Mgr
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**


At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.


Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real\-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.


**Customer Assurance Prog Mgr**
===============================


Bengaluru, India
**Job category:** Customer Support **Job ID:** 136262\-en\_US **Job Summary**
---------------


The Customer Assurance Program (CAP) Manager serves as NetApp’s highest level of customer advocacy and escalation management, leading the resolution of critical customer situations when standard support channels are no longer sufficient. As a trusted advisor, this role is responsible for restoring and maintaining customer confidence by driving complex issue resolution, influencing cross\-functional teams, and managing executive\-level communications.
Working across global teams, the CAP Manager owns escalations from initiation through resolution, balancing customer needs with business objectives while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. The role also contributes to strategic initiatives that strengthen customer support quality, improve operational processes, and drive organizational change across people, processes, and products.
**Jon Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Customer Escalation \& Advocacy**
* Own and drive the resolution of critical customer escalations with end\-to\-end accountability.
* Conduct comprehensive situation assessments to understand customer concerns, business impact, risks, and resolution requirements.
* Develop and execute resolution plans that balance customer satisfaction, business priorities, timelines, and costs.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for executive stakeholders throughout complex customer engagements.
* Restore and maintain customer trust through effective communication, transparency, and advocacy.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Lead global, cross\-functional virtual teams across multiple geographies, functions, and time zones.
* Influence stakeholders and drive alignment across Engineering, Support, Sales, Product Management, Professional Services, and Leadership teams.
* Facilitate collaboration and remove obstacles to accelerate issue resolution.
* Drive accountability and ownership across all teams involved in customer engagements.

**Executive \& Stakeholder Management**
* Build trusted relationships with executives, customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Provide executive\-level updates, action plans, risk assessments, and recommendations.
* Manage expectations and communicate effectively during high\-pressure situations.
* Facilitate decision\-making by clearly articulating business impacts and potential outcomes.
* Continuous Improvement \& Strategic Initiatives
* Identify recurring trends, root causes, and systemic issues impacting customer experience.
* Drive improvement initiatives focused on enhancing support quality, operational effectiveness, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead or contribute to strategic projects and transformation initiatives across the business.
* Document lessons learned, best practices, and operational improvements to strengthen organizational capabilities.

**Operational Excellence**
* Manage multiple high\-priority escalations, projects, and initiatives simultaneously.
* Maintain accurate documentation and ensure clear communication throughout engagement lifecycles.
* Monitor progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies.
* Drive measurable outcomes aligned with NetApp’s customer success objectives.
**Job Requirements**
--------------------


**Experience**
* 8\+ years of experience in the technology industry, customer success, escalation management, support operations, program management, or related functions.
* Proven experience leading complex customer escalations and critical business situations.
* Demonstrated success managing globally distributed, cross\-functional teams.
* Experience supporting enterprise and Fortune 500 customers.
* Strong track record of influencing senior leaders and driving successful outcomes.
* Experience restoring and maintaining customer trust during high\-impact situations.

  

**Skills \& Competencies*** Strong customer advocacy and relationship management skills.
* Exceptional leadership, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to influence executives and cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with executive presence.
* Ability to remain calm, decisive, and effective under pressure.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Growth mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across global teams and time zones.

Strong diplomacy, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.  
* 

**Technical Knowledge**
* Fundamental understanding of enterprise storage infrastructure technologies.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and productivity tools.
* Ability to quickly develop knowledge of NetApp products, solutions, and support processes.

**Education**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, certifications, and relevant industry experience.
* Additional certifications or advanced qualifications are considered a plus.
At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in\-office and/or in\-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:**


NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.


**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**


At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.


NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise\-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.


**Our culture**


We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.


If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment \- make your next move your best one. Apply now.


**Submitting an Application**


To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.


**AI Disclosure**


For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision\-making.

title: Senior Director
description:
**Role**: Director / Sr Director– Engineering (Product Delivery)


**Location**: Bangalore, India

**Department**: Software Development / Engineering

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a ‘Director / Sr Director’ of Engineering to lead delivery across multiple product families, driving innovation, quality, and execution at scale. In this role, you will lead a large, geographically distributed engineering organization and work closely with Product Management, Quality Engineering, and cross\-functional teams to deliver impactful software solutions to our customers.


This is a high\-impact leadership role requiring a balance of strategic thinking, operational excellence, and technical understanding, along with exceptional people and stakeholder leadership skills.

**What You’ll Do**


Drive Delivery Excellence


* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of multiple product families, ensuring high\-quality, predictable outcomes.
* Establish and evolve delivery processes, Agile practices, Agent Centric Development and operational governance.
* Ensure alignment with product roadmaps, timelines, and customer commitments.
* Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities for continuous improvement.


Lead and Inspire Teams


* Lead and mentor a large engineering organization, including managers and senior leaders.
* Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, accountability, curiosity and continuous learning.
* Attract, develop, and retain top talent while strengthening leadership bench strength.
* Champion diversity, inclusion, and employee engagement.


Partner Across the Organization


* Work closely with Product Management to align vision, priorities, and roadmaps.
* Collaborate with Quality Engineering to ensure robust testing strategies and product quality.
* Engage with architecture and platform teams to drive scalable and future\-ready solutions.
* Coordinate effectively with global stakeholders across regions to ensure alignment and transparency.


Shape Strategy and Innovation


* Contribute to engineering strategy and product direction, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Drive adoption of modern technologies, engineering practices, and innovation initiatives.
* Foster a mindset of continuous improvement and customer\-centricity.


Provide Technical and Operational Leadership


* Maintain a strong understanding of software architecture, cloud technologies, AI technologies and SDLC best practices.
* Guide teams in balancing speed, quality, and scalability.
* Improve engineering metrics including productivity, quality, and cycle time.

**What We’re Looking For**


Experience


* 15\+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant leadership responsibility
* Proven experience managing large, multi\-layered engineering teams (150–200\+)
* Background in product\-based organizations, preferably enterprise or SaaS

Leadership \& Collaboration


* Strong people leadership and team development experience
* Ability to influence and collaborate across matrixed, global organizations
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage at all levels


Technical Expertise


* Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI and Agile methodologies Familiarity with Software architectures (cloud, microservices, APIs) and DevOps practices and AI
* Ability to engage in technical discussions and decision\-making, without being hands\-on daily


Mindset \& Approach


* Strategic thinker with a bias for execution
* Customer\-focused and outcome\-driven
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, evolving environment

**Why Join MRI** **Software?**

* Being part of a mission\-driven, global organization with a strong culture
* Lead large\-scale engineering initiatives with real customer impact
* Collaborate with talented teams across the world
* Opportunity to shape technology, people, and product outcomes

**Our Values**


At MRI, we believe in:

* Client Focus – Delivering value to our customers
* Innovation – Continuously improving and evolving
* Collaboration – Working together to achieve more
* Integrity – Doing the right thing

**About Us**

  

From the day we opened our doors, MRI Software has built flexible, game\-changing real estate software that powers thriving communities and helps make the world a better place to live, work and play. Fulfilling that mission is only possible because of one thing: exceptional people. People like you!

  

Our people\-first approach to PropTech is defining a new industry standard for client experiences that, quite frankly, can’t be duplicated. Experiences that deliver real value every day. And we know those experiences begin with our people.

  

We believe MRI is more than just a workplace; it’s a connected community of people who truly feel they belong. Whether we’re investing in employee resource groups or providing tailored resources for each person to reach their full potential, we’re passionate about creating a work environment that makes you excited to show up every single day.

  

At MRI, one of our core values is to *strive to amaze.* From the intelligent solutions we create to the culture we cultivate, that’s our goal every day. Because that’s what industry leaders do. Whether you’re joining as a new Pride member or rejoining us after a short time away, your talent is vital to us, our partners and our clients.

 **Amazing growth requires amazing employees. Are you up to the challenge?**


We know confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting remarkable candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

 *MRI is proud to be an inclusive employer. We welcome and celebrate diversity across all backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, military, veteran status and more.*

*We believe that Belonging is a direct result of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Those values are woven into the fabric of who we are and are foundational to our continued success. Come and see for yourself!*

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

Bengaluru

Full Time Permanent

Candidate profile (title) Who you are
Candidate profile (text) \- Default language You are an experienced P\&C professional with minimum 7\+ years who enjoys working with people, processes and data – and understands how important accuracy, compliance and empathy are in People Services. You bring solid expertise in HR and personnel administration, including payroll\-related processes, taxation and legal requirements, and you feel confident working with HR systems and tools (such as Success Factors, Service Now, Global View or equivalent) as well as Microsoft Office.
  

  

You are comfortable taking ownership of your tasks and working independently, while also valuing collaboration and diverse perspectives. You express your ideas openly, listen carefully to others and make thoughtful, well balanced decisions. You are reliable and ready to step up when challenges arise – someone your team can depend on.
  

Clear communication and active listening come naturally to you. You are a collaborative team player who works towards shared goals and builds positive relationships with ease.
  

  

You like structure and clarity, and you understand the value of following established processes step by step to ensure high\-quality outcomes. At the same time, you are curious and persistent: when something doesn’t look right, you take the time to investigate, understand the root cause and resolve issues thoroughly and accurately.
  

You feel confident navigating in complexity and at the same time organizing data and managing documentation in a clear and structured way is your natural talent.
  

  

You have a problem solving mindset and act quickly when action is needed. You learn from experience and proactively introduce improvements, controls or safeguards to prevent issues from recurring. You enjoy out of the box thinking and drive ideas that support continuous improvement.
  

  

You think end to end, understanding how your work impacts colleagues, stakeholders and the wider organization. You are comfortable working with KPIs, supporting service quality and leading initiatives that deliver meaningful results. You enjoy taking responsibility and are motivated by achieving and exceeding agreed goals.
  

  

You care about your growth, understand what you look for in your career journey, actively develop and learn continuously. You are self aware, open to feedback and keen to build your expertise further.
  

  

Australia HR operations process experience is mandate. This role requires you to have a strong knowledge of Success Factors, Service Now or equivalent applications. ADP Global View Knowledge is an added advantage.
  

  

This role is situated within Bangalore and will report directly to the GBO People Services Team Leader or GBO People Services Manager in India.

Your work ensures that personal data is handled with care, accuracy and confidentiality – from employment contracts and employee changes to payroll related records and reporting.
  

You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across HR and GBO, contributing to reliable operations and a positive co worker experience.

* Committed responsibility during the implementation of new initiatives, programs, policies and services and the integration and transition of HR transactional processes from different IKEA countries into GBO
* Monitor the quality of services in your area of responsibility and partner with other internal and external departments and HR locations to improve customer satisfaction
* Actively involved in coaching and developing Junior co\-workers
* Assume responsibility for other tasks and projects assigned.
* Accept and perform additional tasks delegated by team leader.

We deliver our services through our regional hubs, located in Poznan, Shanghai, Bangalore and Baltimore. To provide professional, service minded, support to the core business – that’s our business! ### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home\-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.  

  

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co\-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.  

  

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing

* Having fun!

title: Senior Revenue Operations & AI Adoption Executive
description:
### **Job Information**

### **Job Description**


Who We Are:

  

Increff is the most preferred retail SaaS partner, solving complex inventory management and supply chain challenges for retailers seeking to revolutionize their supply chains both technologically and operationally.

  

What We Offer:

  

Our core focus is on providing innovative retail tech solutions, including merchandising and omni channel inventory management. These solutions are meticulously designed to cater to the specific needs of brands and retailers, empowering them to thrive in the dynamic marketplace Innovative technology, comprehensive support, and a dynamic environment for career growth.

  

Our Vision:

  

To be the most admired retail technology company.

  

Job Summary:

  

As a Senior Revenue Operations \& AI Adoption Executive, you'll own the systems, data, and automation that connect Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. This is a senior individual\-contributor role with architectural ownership: you will design the CRM data model, lead revenue analytics and forecasting, build the automation and AI infrastructure the GTM org runs on, and set the operating standards other RevOps executives and GTM teams follow.

  

This is also a builder role, ideal for someone who enjoys owning systems end\-to\-end, designing scalable processes, and working directly with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and leadership to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable systems.

  

Responsibilities:

  

1\. Revenue Operations Strategy \& GTM Analytics

* Own end\-to\-end revenue reporting: pipeline, MRR, expected MRR, conversion, stage movement, forecasting, and revenue performance
* Build and continuously evolve management dashboards and recurring weekly/monthly revenue reporting for leadership
* Maintain pipeline and revenue snapshots to enable historical trend analysis and forecasting accuracy
* Lead ad\-hoc analysis and data\-driven input for business reviews, board decks, and leadership decision\-making
* Set the reporting and metrics framework (definitions, cadences, ownership) that the entire S\&M team follows

  

2\. CRM Architecture, Data Governance \& Salesforce Administration

* Own Salesforce configuration end\-to\-end: custom objects, fields, Flows, validation rules, sharing model, and Experience Cloud access
* Define and enforce data governance standards across Leads, Accounts, Contacts, and Opportunities
* Design multi\-track lead qualification frameworks (e.g. product\-line\-specific tracks), BANT structures, and auto\-population logic
* Diagnose and resolve complex production issues (record\-locking flows, trigger bugs, sharing/ownership conflicts) with root\-cause investigation
* Author CRM SOPs and process documentation that scale as the GTM org grows

  

3\. Revenue Automation \& AI\-Driven Systems

* Architect the revenue automation stack — intent/visitor data, contact enrichment, email sequencing, and workflow orchestration (e.g. Factors.ai, Apollo/Seamless, Salesforce, n8n, Make)
* Build integrations across CRM, communication, productivity, and GTM systems to create connected, end\-to\-end workflows
* Design AI\-assisted processes that convert unstructured inputs (emails, meeting notes, internal chat) into structured CRM and revenue data
* Evaluate and maintain the entire S\&M tech stack, building custom MCP/API connectors where needed to enable AI\-assisted workflows
* Build lightweight internal tools or agents where off\-the\-shelf software doesn't solve the problem

  

4\. Pipeline \& Forecast Ownership

* Own monthly pipeline and revenue forecast accuracy, including coverage\-vs\-target analysis
* Build and maintain deal/pipeline health scoring (risk flags, weighted scoring, stage\-based alerts) for rep\- and manager\-level visibility
* Identify forecast risk early and communicate gaps to Sales leadership with supporting data
* Run pipeline hygiene audits — stale\-deal and stale\-lead identification using activity\-based (not just date\-based) criteria
* Support Monthly/Quarterly Business Reviews with accurate, defensible revenue and pipeline narratives

  

5\. Cross\-Functional Leadership \& GTM Intelligence

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to design cross\-functional workflows (deal approvals, commercial reviews, customer hand\-offs)
* Build structured intake/ticketing processes for revenue\-related requests with clear SLAs and ownership
* Own competitive intelligence and account/GTM research frameworks that drive outbound and demand\-gen prioritization
* Mentor and set standards for other RevOps Executives, reviewing their CRM builds, reports, and automations
* Continuously identify and prioritize process redesigns that scale with GTM headcount growth

### **Requirements**


Who Should Apply:

  

This role is ideal for candidates with 2\-3 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Analytics, with demonstrated ownership of a CRM instance end\-to\-end.

  

Required Skills:

* 2\-3 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Analytics, with demonstrated ownership of a CRM instance end\-to\-end
* Deep, hands\-on Salesforce administration expertise: Flows, validation rules, sharing/security model, custom objects, Experience Cloud
* Proven experience designing and operating automation/integration workflows (n8n, Make, or equivalent) or AI tools (Claude, OpenAI etc) across multiple systems
* Strong quantitative fluency in revenue/SaaS metrics (MRR, pipeline coverage, conversion, forecasting) and advanced spreadsheet modeling
* Excellent written communication for leadership reporting, SOPs, and cross\-functional alignment, with a track record of translating ambiguous business problems into scalable systems

  

Nice to Have:

* Experience with AI/LLM\-assisted workflow design (agentic automation, structured data extraction from unstructured text)
* Background in B2B SaaS, supply chain, or retail\-tech GTM
* Experience building GTM strategy for new market segments or regulatory\-driven opportunities
* Familiarity with MCP/API connector setup for AI\-assisted tooling

title: Property Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Property Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring experienced Property Managers to manage the owner and tenant experience across active residential property\-management files.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Strong account, portfolio or client\-service managers with experience managing multiple files, relationships and escalations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

 This role is for someone who can keep files moving, keep clients informed, manage urgent issues and remain organized in a high\-volume environment. You will be responsible for communication, follow\-up, documentation, issue resolution and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
   

  

 This is not a basic customer\-service position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of client outcomes, manage multiple properties and files simultaneously, and communicate professionally with property owners, tenants, internal teams and service providers.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Act as the main point of contact for property owners and tenants throughout the management relationship.
* Manage multiple active clients, properties and files with strong organization and follow\-through.
* Provide proactive updates so owners understand what is happening, what is pending and what comes next.
* Handle time\-sensitive property and tenancy matters with urgency, professionalism and clear communication.
* Coordinate next steps between owners, tenants, internal departments, vendors and other service providers.
* Collect, review and track required property, owner and tenant documentation.
* Maintain complete CRM records, including notes, tasks, follow\-ups, updates and file movement.
* Identify stalled files, missed follow\-ups, client concerns and service problems before they escalate.
* Escalate serious issues promptly and use sound judgment to protect client satisfaction.
* Support a structured, process\-driven property\-management experience from onboarding through ongoing management.


**Requirements**
* Three to five or more years of property management, account management, client success, client services, relationship management or comparable client\-ownership experience.
* Proven ability to manage multiple clients, properties, accounts or active files simultaneously.
* Strong communication skills and confidence handling owner, tenant or client concerns.
* Strong process discipline and comfort working within a structured CRM and task\-management system.
* Strong follow\-up habits, task management and documentation accuracy.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and prioritize quickly in a high\-volume environment.
* Professional judgment when handling complaints, escalations, deadlines and sensitive client matters.
* Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours.
* Excellent written and spoken English.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Direct property\-management, leasing, real estate operations or housing\-related experience.
* Experience supporting both clients and end users, such as owners and tenants or customers and service providers.
* Experience working with North American clients.
* Experience in a high\-volume, service\-based, operations\-heavy or SLA\-driven environment.
* Experience coordinating maintenance, leasing, payments, documentation or service\-provider activities.
* Comfort using AI and other tools to improve documentation, reporting, summaries and internal efficiency.


 Remote Technology Requirements
   

  

* Dual\-monitor setup
* Computer with at least 16GB of RAM
* Reliable internet connection of at least 100 Mbps
* Webcam
* Noise\-cancelling headset
* Professional and quiet environment for calls


**Compensation**
 Total annual compensation ranges from
 **C$30,000 to C$36,000** 
 , based on experience, qualifications and performance.
   

  

 Candidates with direct property\-management experience, strong owner and tenant communication skills, and proven success managing a high volume of active files may be considered near the top of the range.
   

  

 Complete details regarding base compensation and performance bonuses will be shared during the interview process.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive a link to complete a short pre\-recorded video interview from our recruitment partner within 24–48 hours of applying.

title: Manager – Revenue (Chennai)
description:
**About The Team**
 We are building a high\-performance Revenue \& Marketing pod — a geography\-focused business unit that owns end\-to\-end top\-line and bottom\-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
   

  

 This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data\-fluent, and thrive in a fast\-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Revenue \& P\&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P\&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course\-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth \& Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first\-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install\-not\-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in\-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on\-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end\-to\-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high\-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence \& Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in\-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data\-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health \& Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock\-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop\-offs — with revenue\-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Maintain a real\-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions


**Who We Are Looking For**
 Must Have
   

  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution \[IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e\-commerce operations, or P\&L\-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross\-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment


 Good to Have
   

  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e\-commerce, Q\-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on\-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in\-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell\-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on\-ground activation


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P\&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High\-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
  

**Technical Project Manager — Core Technical Delivery**


Infinite Computer Solutions \| Nokia Business Unit


**Reports To:** Delivery Manager — Nokia Professional Services (practice aligned)
  

**Practice Areas:** IPTEL · Packet Core · SDM (HSS/HLR/UM, SDL) · CSP (Charging, Policy \& Signalling)
  

**Location:** Bangalore / Chennai / Noida
  

**Experience:** 8–15 years in telecom delivery, network operations, managed services or deployment
**Role Purpose**
================


The Technical Project Manager owns the safe, predictable and high\-quality execution of project and live network intervention (LNI) activity within an assigned practice. The role combines genuine technical depth with delivery rigour — every activity executed safely, on time and with zero customer impact.
  

This is a hands\-on role. The TPM is expected to hold the technical command to review a MoP, challenge an implementation approach and lead a critical incident personally — while driving standardisation, automation and a strong engineering culture within the team. The TPM reports to the practice Delivery Manager and is the primary execution owner beneath that layer.
**Key Responsibilities**
========================


**1\. End\-to\-End Delivery Ownership**
---------------------------------------


* Own complete execution of assigned work packages from planning through successful completion.
* Ensure every intervention is delivered safely, within schedule and in compliance with customer standards.
* Drive timely closure of all deliverables while proactively managing risks and dependencies.
* Take accountability for delivery outcomes rather than simply tracking activities.
* Provide the Delivery Manager with accurate, early and unfiltered status — no surprises.

**2\. Work Package Planning \& Ownership**
------------------------------------------


* Allocate work packages to engineers based on competency, certifications and experience.
* Ensure the right engineer is assigned to the right task, with verified readiness.
* Monitor work package progress, remove execution blockers and maintain delivery governance.
* Ensure ownership across the entire lifecycle of each assigned activity.

**3\. Customer Project Alignment**
----------------------------------


* Work closely with customer project managers, planners and technical leads.
* Ensure LNI execution aligns with project timelines, milestones and deployment priorities.
* Represent the execution team during customer governance meetings.
* Build customer confidence through proactive communication and predictable delivery.

**4\. Technical Leadership — Hands On**
---------------------------------------


* Maintain genuine working command of the practice domain — not oversight from a distance.
* Provide technical guidance during planning, execution, rollback and issue resolution.
* Review implementation approaches, Method of Procedure (MoP), rollback plans and risk assessments; approve before execution.
* Lead technical discussions during complex interventions and critical incidents, and drive root cause analysis personally.
* Coach engineers on best practices and promote continuous technical improvement.

**5\. Standardisation**
-----------------------


* Execute against the practice delivery framework — MoP templates, checklists, readiness criteria and acceptance standards — and drive full team adoption.
* Eliminate ad\-hoc, engineer\-specific ways of working; make execution repeatable regardless of who performs it.
* Convert every lesson learned into an updated standard, checklist or preventive control.
* Feed practice\-level gaps and improvement proposals back to the Delivery Manager for framework updates.

**6\. Automation \& Efficiency**
--------------------------------


* Identify repetitive, manual and error\-prone steps within the execution lifecycle and propose automation candidates.
* Drive automation of health checks, pre/post validation, configuration and reporting activities within the team.
* Set and track efficiency targets — effort per work package, cycle time, first\-time\-right percentage.
* Reuse assets from the BU automation repository rather than rebuilding, and contribute back what the team creates.

**7\. Thought Leadership**
--------------------------


* Stay current with technology and tooling direction in the practice domain and bring it into execution practice.
* Propose improvements to delivery approach rather than only executing the defined method.
* Document and share knowledge — playbooks, execution guides, incident learnings — across the wider practice.
* Contribute technical input to solutioning, estimation and proposal work when required.

**8\. Team Management \& People Leadership**
--------------------------------------------


* Build a culture of ownership, accountability and collaboration.
* Conduct regular 1:1s to understand workload, aspirations and challenges.
* Balance shift planning, resource utilisation and fatigue management for 24x7 operations.
* Support hiring, onboarding, mentoring and capability development.

**9\. Inspired Leadership \& Team Motivation**
----------------------------------------------


* Set direction the team believes in — connect day\-to\-day execution to the wider account and customer outcome.
* Foster a positive, high\-performance environment where engineers raise problems early and propose improvements without being asked.
* Recognise individual and team achievement visibly; address underperformance directly and fairly.
* Encourage continuous learning, certification and knowledge sharing.
* Create development plans for engineers to grow into future technical leaders and build a succession bench.

**10\. Quality of Work \& Deliverables**
----------------------------------------


* Ensure every deliverable meets customer quality expectations before submission.
* Drive first\-time\-right execution and eliminate repeat issues.
* Perform quality reviews of documentation, implementation plans and execution reports.
* Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned and preventive actions.

**11\. Operational Excellence**
-------------------------------


Ensure consistent adherence to LNI operational standards, including:
* Right engineer for the right task, with validated competency.
* Pre\-LNI readiness verification.
* MoP and rollback validation.
* Network health validation before execution.
* Executor\-Observer compliance.
* Weekly engineer engagement and mentoring.
* Shift and fatigue governance.
* Information Security compliance.
* End\-to\-end ownership of every LNI.
* Same\-day escalation of risks and delivery issues.
* Full adherence to LNI process and governance.

**Key Performance Indicators**
==============================


**Delivery \& Quality** **Compliance \& People**
  

Work Package Delivery Success Rate Quality Audit Compliance
  

On\-Time Delivery (OTD) First Time Right (FTR)
  

Delivery Fulfilment Rate (DFR) Information Security Compliance
  

LNI Success Rate Certification \& Competency Compliance
  

Zero Customer Escalations Team Utilisation \& Productivity
  

Zero Network Impact from execution errors Customer Satisfaction
  

Manual effort automated / standard adoption Employee Engagement and Team Retention
  

**Required Skills**
===================


**Technical**
-------------


* Strong hands\-on understanding of telecom network operations — Core / IP / Cloud preferred.
* Practice domain depth in one or more of IPTEL, Packet Core, SDM or CSP.
* Live network planning and execution.
* Change management; incident and problem management.
* Risk assessment and root cause analysis.
* Network implementation and integration; project delivery.
* Working knowledge of Linux, scripting and automation tooling (Python, Shell, Ansible) sufficient to direct and review automation work.

**Leadership**
--------------


* Team leadership and inspired people management.
* Stakeholder management and customer communication.
* Coaching, mentoring and capability building.
* Decision making under pressure; conflict resolution.
* Planning, prioritisation and delivery governance.
* Personal ownership — takes accountability for outcomes without deflection.

**Preferred Experience**
========================


* 8–15 years in telecom delivery, network operations, managed services or deployment.
* Prior experience within or alongside Nokia delivery organisations.
* Demonstrated automation\-led efficiency improvement with quantified outcomes.
* Relevant certifications — Nokia product certifications, ITIL, PMP, Kubernetes (CKA) or equivalent.

We are looking for an experienced Production Support / SRE Lead to lead L2/L3 production support operations for a highly available, microservices\-based environment. The role requires strong technical expertise across cloud, container platforms, application technologies, databases, monitoring, automation, and incident management.  

The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, reliability, performance, and operational excellence of production systems while leading and mentoring a team of production support engineers.  

The candidate should be comfortable navigating multiple technologies and working closely with Development, DevOps, Architecture, QA, and business stakeholders to resolve critical production issues and continuously improve platform reliability.

* Good understanding of SLA, SLO, SLI, availability, reliability, and performance metrics.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience with production deployments, rollback strategies, blue/green deployments, and canary releases.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Node.js, Shell, or similar technologies.
* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder\-management, and team\-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during critical production incidents.
* Strong ability to navigate and troubleshoot across multiple technologies rather than being limited to a single technology stack.


Good to Have Skills

* Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools.
* Experience with Kafka or other messaging technologies.

description:
**Position Title:** 
 Client Success Manager
   

  

**Reporting Line:** 
 Senior Manager \- Client Success
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 The Client Success Manager (CSM) is accountable for the overall health, retention, satisfaction, and growth of an assigned portfolio of clients. Acting as a trusted advisor and executive relationship owner, the CSM develops a deep understanding of each client's business strategy, industry environment, operational processes, and technology landscape to ensure clients realize maximum value from ADP solutions.
   

  

 The role is responsible for building strong stakeholder relationships, conducting regular business and service reviews, proactively identifying risks and early indicators of client dissatisfaction, and driving corrective actions before issues impact retention. The CSM serves as the voice of the client within ADP while representing ADP's capabilities, strategy, and product roadmap to clients.
   

  

 A key aspect of the role is protecting and growing recurring revenue through effective renewal management, client engagement, and identification of upsell and cross\-sell opportunities that align with client business needs. The CSM is expected to leverage insights into the client's organization, workforce strategy, and technology environment to uncover opportunities for expansion, optimization, and innovation. The role also drives continuous improvement by analyzing service performance, identifying operational inefficiencies, and coordinating actions across both ADP and client teams to improve service quality, business outcomes, and overall client experience.

title: Lead – Supply Chain Operations & Customer Experience
description:
This is precise because it names both functions the role actually owns (not a generic "founder's office" or "chief of staff" label that pulls in unrelated generalists), and it's the exact phrase candidates with real supply chain/ops \+ CX experience search for and apply against.
 



  





 If you can spot where a business is leaking, understand why, and build the fix, this role is for you. Direct founder access, full business context from day one, and real accountability for outcomes across two critical functions CX and Operations.
 



  





**1\. Customer Experience \& Retention** 



* Own the post\-purchase journey end to end — from first delivery to repeat purchase, including re\-order nudges, win\-back campaigns, loyalty mechanics
* Track cohort repeat rates, time\-to\-second\-order, churn triggers, and NPS by product/channel via a weekly retention dashboard
* Own CX metrics as performance targets CSAT, first response time, resolution SLA, repeat complaint rate, NPS, repeat purchase rate, refund/return rate
* Write, own, audit, and update the CX SOP library complaint handling, delivery delay resolution, escalation matrices, agent playbooks
* Run RCA on every recurring failure trace root cause, fix the source, update the SOP, verify the fix held
* Feed CX insights upstream to inform NPD, formulation, and supply chain decisions
* Own the CX tech stack ticketing, WhatsApp automation, logistics webhooks



  





**2\. Supply Chain \& Operations** 



* Own the Operations SOP library procurement, inbound QC, CMO coordination, warehouse, dispatch, returns
* Drive SOP adherence through floor\-level checks and exception tracking
* Run RCA on operational failures (batch rejection, delivery delay, procurement gap) and verify fixes over 2\-3 cycles
* Own the CMO performance scorecard on\-time delivery, batch quality, rejection rates, CoA compliance
* Own inventory planning reduce OOS without creating excess stock or working capital lock\-in
* Own 3PL coordination — NDR management, RTO reduction, SLA adherence, exception\-handling SOPs



**3\. Business Intelligence \& Cross\-Functional Work** 



* Build founder dashboards as early\-warning systems, not rear\-view mirrors
* Track retention\-led revenue metrics — cohort repeat rates, refund/return trends, complaint\-to\-churn correlation, fulfilment SLA impact on NPS
* Own cross\-functional projects from intake through prioritisation, execution, and closure



**Must\-have:** 



* 1\-8 years post\-qualification experience in consulting, operations, supply chain, a founder's office, or a high\-ownership role at a D2C/FMCG/consumer startup (Tier 1 consulting or early startup particularly valued)
* Independently builds data models and turns complex operational problems into crisp recommendations
* Has built SOPs from scratch, run RCA when they broke, and closed the loop at root cause
* Comfortable moving between strategic framing and ground\-level execution
* High ownership orientation accountable for outcomes, not just outputs



**Strongly preferred:** 



* CX operations with a retention/revenue lens cohort tracking, post\-purchase engagement flows, loyalty programme impact
* Hands\-on procurement or vendor management with CMOs or RM/PM suppliers
* Shopify, Freshdesk/Zoho Desk, Shiprocket, Klaviyo, advanced Excel/Sheets; SQL or data viz a bonus

title: Senior Customer Experience Manager
description:

 The Global Accounts Receivable (GAR) Customer Experience team exists for one reason: make sure every customer interaction with Amazon's AR function is so good it strengthens the relationship and accelerates revenue collection. We do this across 8 business channels and 9 support centers worldwide, building smarter processes, better communication, and technology that scales.
   

  

 We're looking for a Senior CX Manager who can turn that mission into results. You'll lead the AR customer experience function across some of Amazon's largest and fastest\-growing business channels: AWS, Amazon Business, Retail, Advertising, and Transportation, ensuring every AR touchpoint with customers and vendors meets a high bar. You'll do this through a globally distributed team of Customer Experience Specialists, and you co\-own the global CX metric with Operations, which means you're accountable for what customers actually experience, not just what's planned on a slide.
   

  

 This is a people\-leadership role at its core. You'll manage across time zones and cultures, coach CX Specialists into independent problem\-solvers, and build mechanisms that work when you're not in the room. But you also need to be hands\-on with data, comfortable pulling apart CX trends, building root\-cause models, and presenting findings to senior leaders who expect clarity and a point of view.
   

  

 You'll need to design scalable automation (partnering with FinTech and FinAuto), deploy ML\-powered sentiment detection, and build self\-service tools that reduce manual effort. If you're energized by operating in a high\-growth, high\-ambiguity environment where you have to invent the playbook, this is the role.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities

 CX Strategy \& Metric Ownership
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end CX quality across assigned businesses, driving measurable year\-over\-year improvement in defect rates and customer response quality
* Define the annual CX roadmap: balance quick wins that move the needle this quarter with structural fixes that compound over time


 Automation \& Technology
   

  

* Partner with FinTech, FinAuto, and Data Engineering teams to design and deploy solutions that reduce manual touchpoints: zero\-touch email responses, intelligent case routing, automated root\-cause tagging
* Drive adoption and improvement of ML\-powered negative sentiment analysis to proactively flag and resolve customer concerns before they become escalations
* Own the rollout of next\-generation communication and feedback management tools that improve first\-contact resolution rates and shrink resolution time


 Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Leadership

* Partner with Tech and Operations leadership to align on priorities, share data, and unblock execution

 People Leadership
   

  

* Manage, develop, and inspire Customer Experience Specialists across the globe — each with distinct operating rhythms and cultural contexts

* Build a team culture where data\-backed experimentation, dive deep, bias for action, and customer obsession are the default

description:
Who we are looking for
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced and delivery\-focused Team Lead to manage end\-to\-end client onboarding and conversion activities within the Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding function. The role is accountable for translating business requirements into scalable reconciliation solutions, directing system and data readiness, overseeing testing and production deployment, managing delivery risks, and ensuring a controlled transition to business\-as\-usual operations.
   

  

 The candidate will lead onboarding specialists and work closely with investment managers, custodians, fund administrators, business teams, technology partners, and reconciliation operations. Strong expertise in middle office reconciliation, data analysis, data mapping, TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, project delivery, people leadership, and stakeholder management is required.
   

  

 Why this role is important to us
   

  

 The Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding team supports the implementation of new investment managers and funds onto State Street’s reconciliation platforms. The Team Lead provides day\-to\-day delivery leadership and serves as the central coordination and escalation point across business, operations, technology, clients, and external data providers.
   

  

 The role is critical to ensuring that cash, position, transaction, and market\-value reconciliation requirements are accurately designed, configured, tested, deployed, and handed over to operations. It also promotes consistent delivery standards, effective risk management, team capability, process scalability, and a controlled, low\-risk transition into live reconciliation services.

* Excellent executive communication and presentation skills.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent customer implementations.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.

**Job Expectations:**

* B Sc, B Com, BBM, MBA, M Com with Business, Finance, Banking, Accounting or Economics as preferred major subject.

description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Technical Support Manager** to lead, mentor, and scale B2B SaaS support operations. This role is accountable for delivering exceptional customer experiences, building a high\-performing technical support team, and driving cross\-functional collaboration to resolve complex customer issues. The ideal candidate has a proven background in B2B SaaS, preferably within hospitality technology, strong people leadership skills, and a practical understanding of how modern AI tools can improve support quality, efficiency, and scalability.

 **Job Responsibilities**

**People Leadership \& Support Operations**

* Lead, coach, and scale a team of Technical Support Engineers delivering support across global communication channels, including chat, email, and phone.
* Establish, monitor, and improve key support metrics, including CSAT, Time to First Response, Mean Time to Resolution, and SLA compliance.
* Drive individual and team performance through regular one\-on\-ones, skill assessments, performance reviews, and career development planning.
* Promote clear ownership, accountability, urgency, and consistency in customer\-facing support execution.

**Cross\-Departmental Collaboration**

* Serve as the primary operational liaison between Technical Support, Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Success.
* Establish feedback loops that convert support ticket trends, recurring defects, and customer pain points into actionable insights for Product and Engineering teams.
* Partner with Customer Success to manage critical account escalations, protect high\-value customer relationships, and improve retention outcomes.
* Ensure escalations are clearly documented, prioritized, and resolved with appropriate urgency and follow\-through.

**AI \& Process Optimization**

* Evaluate, integrate, and champion AI\-driven tools such as auto\-triage, generative AI response drafting, automated ticket routing, and predictive analytics.
* Improve self\-service capabilities by strengthening knowledge base quality, AI\-powered search, and support documentation workflows.
* Balance automation with a high\-touch customer experience, ensuring efficiency gains do not reduce customer trust or issue ownership.
* Continuously identify workflow gaps, manual bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve support scale without sacrificing quality.

 **Job Requirements**

* **Experience \-** Seeking a candidate with experience of 5\+ years in technical support, including at least 2 years in direct people management leading technical teams.
* **Domain Expertise \-** Strong background in B2B SaaS models. Hospitality technology experience, including PMS, POS, or guest management systems, is highly preferred.
* **Technical Skills \-** Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, database querying, system integrations, and enterprise support tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, and Jira.

The successful candidate will combine technical fluency, disciplined operational management, and strong people leadership. title: Head of GenAI Products, EMAP
description:
Role Overview  

The **Head of GenAI Products, EMAP** will shape and execute Experian EMAP's AI‑enhanced product strategy across the Ascend and Fraud portfolios. This role is accountable for the commercial success of the GenAI portfolio across EMAP, including revenue growth, monetization strategy, and market adoption. You will operate as a "mini‑GM", owning both product direction and business outcomes, reporting to the Chief Product Officer.


This is a specialist role in the EMAP Product Management team. You will focus on embedding Generative AI capabilities into core products, reimagining customer propositions, accelerating innovation and converting innovation into scalable, revenue\-generating offerings, and driving adoption across diverse EMAP markets.


Operating horizontally across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Client Delivery, and Market Product teams, you will act as a bridge between global GenAI strategy, regional priorities, and market execution.

**What You'll Do:**

**GenAI Product Strategy \& Direction**

* Own the regional GenAI product strategy and roadmap for EMAP across Ascend and Fraud
* Own the commercial performance of the GenAI portfolio, including revenue growth, margins, and business case delivery
* Translate GenAI capabilities into clear customer value propositions and monetizable offerings

 **Product Discovery \& Productization**

* Lead discovery of high‑impact GenAI opportunities across customer journeys and internal product workflows.
* Define use cases with clear value hypotheses, success measures, and risk considerations.
* Drive productization of GenAI capabilities into market\-ready, revenue\-generating products
* Ensure solutions are designed for repeatability, supportability, and regional scale, rather than bespoke delivery
* Ensure clear linkage between product features and monetization models

 **Scaling \& Adoption Across EMAP**

* Work with markets and regional functions to scale GenAI use cases across EMAP, with primary focus on customer‑facing innovation and considering productivity enablement where it supports product outcomes
* Define how GenAI capabilities will be adopted, measured, and evolved over time across markets
* Drive adoption in close partnership with Sales and GTM teams, supporting strategic deals and client engagement
* Track outcomes including adoption, productivity gains, customer impact, revenue impact and product differentiation.

 **Embedding GenAI into Core Platforms**

* Partner with Engineering and Data Science to embed GenAI capabilities into existing Ascend and Fraud products, rather than standalone tools
* Ensure GenAI features are explainable and auditable by design; aligned to Experian's product operating model and naturally integrated into customer and analyst workflows

 **Cross‑Functional \& GTM Collaboration**

* Act as a senior product partner across Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, Client Delivery, Market Product, and regional GTM teams
* Lead collaboration with GTM and Sales to define value propositions, pricing inputs, and commercial messaging
* Actively support deal shaping, client conversations, and strategic sales opportunities where GenAI capabilities are a differentiator
* Commercial impact assessment
* Influence prioritization and solution design through strong product judgement, evidence‑based trade‑offs, and clear articulation of customer and commercial value

 **Governance, Risk \& Responsible AI**

* Work closely with regional and global AI technology teams to ensure GenAI governance, controls, and guardrails are embedded into product design and delivery
* Ensure GenAI product capabilities align with product development and risk frameworks

 **Client Co‑Creation \& Ecosystem Engagement**

* Co‑create GenAI capabilities with selected clients to validate value, usability, and adoption.
* Partner with global technology and AI platform teams to leverage external GenAI providers where appropriate, in line with Experian standards and governance

 **What Success Looks Like**

* GenAI capabilities embedded into EMAP products at scale, not isolated pilots
* Tangible improvements in customer decision quality, speed, and usability
* Clear revenue growth and monetization of GenAI portfolio
* Successful launch of commercial GenAI offerings
* Increased attach rates, upsell, and client adoption tied to economic value
* Strong market positioning and differentiated value proposition

  

  

Experience and Skills  

* **What You'll Bring:**
	+ 15\+ years of experience as a Senior Product Manager / Principal PM / Product Leader with experience owning business outcomes or product portfolio performance
	+ Strong grounding in product discovery, productization, and outcome‑based prioritization
	+ Deep understanding of Generative AI concepts, patterns, and limitations
	+ Ability to translate AI capabilities into commercially compelling, customer\-ready offering
	+ Experience communicating complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences with senior stakeholders and technical teams
	+ Proven track record in one or more of the following: product monetization, pricing \& packaging, go\-to\-market strategy, revenue ownership or business case delivery
	+ Experience operating in regulated or high‑trust environments is highly advantageous.
* **This role is best suited to product leaders who enjoy turning innovation into measurable business results, not only building capabilities.**

  

  

About Experian  

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.


Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award\-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25\), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

**Benefits/Perks:**

* Great compensation package and discretionary bonus plan
* Core benefits include pension, health Insurance and term life Insurance, Sharesave scheme and more!
* 25 days annual leave with 13 bank holidays and 3 volunteering days. You can also purchase additional annual leave.
* You will report to Chief Product Officer
* Role Location: Mumbai

**Recruitment Fraud Awareness** \- Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an **@experian.com** email address.

**Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment** as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit **experian.com/careers**.
