**Company Description** 
 Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd. (MOFSL) is a diversified financial services company offering products and services across private wealth, retail and institutional broking, asset management, investment banking, private equity, commodities, currencies, and home finance. Founded in 1987, the organization has grown into a team of over 12,000 members, with a strong focus on customer\-first values, ethical practices, professionalism, and technology\-driven solutions. MOFSL serves a wide client base including retail investors, high net worth individuals, mutual funds, foreign institutional investors, financial institutions, and corporate clients. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has an extensive presence across 550\+ cities and towns with over 2,500 business locations and more than 5\.2 million customers. MOFSL invests heavily in research and has received multiple industry awards for its performance and advisory excellence.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Team Manager role based in the Pune Division. The Team Manager will lead and supervise a team to achieve defined business targets, ensure high\-quality customer service, and maintain compliance with internal policies and regulatory standards. Daily responsibilities include planning and monitoring team performance, setting clear objectives, conducting reviews, and providing coaching and feedback to team members. The role involves coordinating with cross\-functional stakeholders, ensuring accurate execution of financial products and services, and resolving escalated client queries in a timely and professional manner. The Team Manager will also contribute to process improvement, support training initiatives, and uphold a culture of integrity, collaboration, and accountability.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong team leadership and people management skills, with experience in performance monitoring, coaching, and mentoring.
* Proficiency in sales and business development, including target achievement, pipeline management, and customer relationship handling.
* Solid knowledge of financial markets, investment products, and wealth management or broking services.
* Ability to analyze data, use reports and dashboards, and make informed, data\-driven decisions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with diverse stakeholders and handle escalations.
* Comfort with technology platforms and tools commonly used in financial services operations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field; a relevant postgraduate qualification or professional certification (e.g., NISM, CFP, MBA) is an advantage.
* Prior experience in a supervisory or managerial role in financial services, broking, or wealth management is highly beneficial.

title: AM Customer Care
description:
Kohler Co.'s mission is to contribute to a higher level of gracious living for those who are touched by our products and services.
 



 Beyond the competitive benefits and compensation, Kohler proudly offers a rich culture, steeped in creativity and commitment to our associates and communities.  We invite you to learn more about our culture and company at www.kohlercompany.com
 



 It is Kohler’s policy to recruit, hire, and promote qualified personnel in all job classifications without regard to race, creed, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Kohler Co. is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.
 



**Kohler India is certified as a Great Place to Work Organization. This certification is an endorsement of the culture and values we live by \- every day.** 




  
 



**Position Description**




**Position Title** 




 AM – Customer Care
 



**Department** 




 Customer Services
 



**Division** 




 Kohler India Technical Center, Pune
 



**Grade** 




 AM
 



**Reporting to** 




 Manager – Customer Care
 



  
 



  
 



  
 



  
 



  
 



**About the position:**




 We (Kohler India Technical Center) are a captive global center providing technical and nontechnical support for all the businesses and product lines for Kohler India (Kitchen and Bath).
 



 As a Customer Care Assistant Manager at Kohler, you will be responsible for managing the daily operations of our Customer Care department. You will oversee a team of customer care associates, ensuring that they provide excellent service to our end consumers. In this role, you will be responsible for setting goals and metrics, monitoring performance, and implementing strategies to improve customer experience. You will also work closely with other departments to ensure smooth operations and effective communication.
 



**Role and Responsibility:**




**Be a Brand Ambassador for our customers by building relationships and creating loyalty**
 . Provide world\-class first level inbound phone/chat/email support for customers by troubleshooting, investigating, and resolving customers' inquiries about Kohler India products with the goal of resolving each issue on the first contact. You will be expected to provide empathetic, courteous, quality customer service in an accurate and timely manner in accordance with Kohler protocols while maintaining a positive, problem\-solving approach.
 



  
 


* Manage and oversee the daily operations of the Customer Care department.
* Hire, train, and supervise a team of customer service associates.
* Set performance goals and metrics for the team and monitor progress.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve customer experience.
* Maintain and improve customer service level agreements and procedures.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and provide regular reports to senior management.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as sales, marketing, and operations, to ensure smooth operations and effective communication.
* Develop and maintain relationships with key customers.
* Provide coaching and feedback to team members to improve their performance and development.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiencies.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures, as well as applicable regulations and laws.



**Qualifications:**



* Bachelor’s degree mandatory – master’s degree preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in customer service or related field, with at least 5 years in a people management role.
* Strong leadership, Problem solving and People management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop strategies.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and customer service software.
* Experience working in the manufacturing industry is preferred.



  
 



 This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as assigned by the supervisor.
 



**Working Conditions:**




 This is a full\-time role based in our customer service Pune office. The includes evenings and weekends working to meet customer demands, as we operate 24/7\. You'll work six days a week with rotating shifts and weekly offs. Occasional travel for business may also be required.
 



**Organizational Relationships:**



* Reports to Manager – Customer Care,
* Regular interactions with business stakeholders from different Kohler business verticals at ITC
* Frequent interaction with internal stakeholders including senior leadership team.

title: AI Services Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
 Why This Role? Why Now?
   

  

 Customer experience is transforming through AI\-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we don’t just embrace this change — we lead it. Our Professional Services team is revolutionizing how we help our customers implement and adopt AI by building an AI Delivery team and methodology. As the technical and product expert for our AI\-powered Resolution Platform, the AI Services Consultant role is integral to delivering quick time to value while guiding our customers through their configuration and optimization.
   

  

 Mission
   

  

 As an AI Services Consultant at Zendesk, your mission is to provide technical solutions and remove roadblocks for your customers to drive resolutions on our AI Platform. You will act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, guiding customers through complex configurations with agility and precision. Your strong consulting skills and project management expertise will ensure seamless integration and optimization of AI solutions, driving transformative business outcomes.
   

  

**Overarching Objective For The Role**
* Accelerate customers’ time‑to‑value by driving adoption and operational excellence for Zendesk AI solutions, ensuring customers realize measurable business impact from initial deployment through scale
* Be the customer’s AI technical expert. Turn goals into the right configuration, integrations, and design choices, and remove blockers fast.
* Lead smooth, on\-time delivery. Run projects end\-to\-end with clear scope, timelines, and stakeholder alignment to deliver reliably.


 How You’ll Make an Impact
   

  

 Strategic Accountabilities
   

  

* Technical Expertise \& Guidance: Provide expert advice on the implementation and optimization of Zendesk AI products, ensuring customers leverage the full capabilities of the technology to meet their business goals.
* Change Management \& Training: Facilitate change management processes and deliver consultative sessions to ensure smooth adoption and integration of AI solutions within customer organizations.
* Successful Project Delivery: Accountable for the timely and successful delivery of AI projects, meeting or exceeding customer expectations and maintaining high standards of quality.
* Customer Satisfaction: Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction, contributing to customer retention and potential upsell opportunities.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, including Customer Success and Sales, to ensure alignment on the customer’s AI Roadmap and address any technical challenges that would block the customer from adopting AI.
* Tactical solutions for business outcomes: Ensure that AI solutions are effectively aligned with customer business goals, resulting in measurable improvements in customer experience and AI Adoption.


 What You’ll Need to Succeed
   

  

 Strategic Skills \& Expertise
   

  

* Consulting Expertise: Strong consulting skills with the ability to assess client needs, develop strategic solutions, and provide expert guidance throughout the project lifecycle.
* Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Project Management: Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of AI projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and meet quality standards.
* Technical Proficiency in AI: Deep understanding of AI technologies, particularly Zendesk AI products, with the ability to implement and optimize these solutions effectively.
* Agility and Adaptability: Ability to work effectively in diverse and dynamic environments, adapting to changing client needs and industry trends.
* Problem\-Solving Abilities: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify challenges and develop innovative solutions.
* Continuous Learning: Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends and advancements, ensuring the delivery of cutting\-edge solutions to clients.


**Qualifications**
* Must have a minimum of 3\+ years of related experience in Consulting / Professional Services
* Previous experience in go\-to\-customer/GTM roles in enterprise technology / SaaS — either customer success management, professional services/consulting, technical account management, or solutions engineering/pre\-sales consulting
* Demonstrated experience in using adoption and health analytics to build predictive models and forecasts for churn and expansion; surface early risk signals and recommended mitigations to secure retention and growth
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing success plans or roadmaps that drive measurable customer outcomes
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees; certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
* Experience managing AI or software adoption programs with demonstrated impact on business metrics such as retention or satisfaction.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees; certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
* Certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred
* Excellent program management and cross\-functional influence skills
* Familiarity with emerging AI trends is a plus
* Ability to distill complex AI concepts for diverse audiences, especially executive stakeholders


 AIAA
   

  

 Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
   

  

 Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration \- while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in\-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.
   

  

**The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience**
 Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.
   

  

 Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.
   

  

 As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.
   

  

 Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, \& inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here.
   

  

 Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e\-mail to peopleandplaces@zendesk.com with your specific accommodation request.

title: Senior Growth Consultant (CPG Experience)
description:
Entrepreneurship Acceleration: Customer Success and Account management
 



  





**About Bizom** 




 Bizom is the retail intelligence platform of choice for more than 750\+ global brands helping them improve their channel, manpower and process efficiency.
 



  





 Every day, our systems run the heartbeat of modern distribution, including salesforce automation, distributor management, retail execution, trade marketing, and AI\-driven insights, reaching millions of retail outlets and field users across emerging markets.
 



 Excited to know more about us? Learn more about Bizom here and discover what makes our culture truly people\-first: Algorithmic Jugaad.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Ever watched "the sharks of the world" and felt that entrepreneurial itch? Well, that alone won't make you an entrepreneur! You absolutely need to learn the art of being creative, innovative, strategic, in addition to having a leadership mindset. So, here is a risk free way to play your hand
 



 and make BIZOM your playground! If you're driven by the curiosity about how businesses tick and have the smarts to visualize success, then you're in the right place! Keep reading ahead.
 



  





 We're looking for people who are obsessed about consumer brands, can solve problems like a pro, love driving sales, and live for making a difference! If that's you, congratulations, you are our Superhero! We're the cape that will guide you through the magic of building relationships, the impact of the data\-driven world, and the difference you can make to an organization!
 



  





 We can make you a kickass customer success and account management executive if you have a genuine passion for sales, a hustling attitude, and can help us scale the revolution we have begun in SaaS Mobility with Bizom \- a leading retail intelligence platform with over 500 leading CPG brands as our customers.
 



  





 You will work with the Regional Sales Head and collaborate with the multiple teams to lead the impact of Bizom in the CPG industry.
 



  





**The Responsibilities Behind the Cape:** 




 ● Own and manage relationships with CPG customers as the primary point of contact, ensuring smooth coordination between internal teams and customer stakeholders.
 



 ● Build strong relationships with business and functional stakeholders through regular weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews and discussions.
 



 ● Understand customer challenges and business goals, and use insights to recommend effective route\-to\-market strategies that drive business outcomes.
 



 ● Identify opportunities for upselling and cross\-selling by aligning Bizom’s solutions with customer needs and objectives.
 



 ● Gather and analyze customer requirements in detail and create clear and structured BRDs.
 



 ● Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure faster go\-lives, smooth execution, and successful implementation of new initiatives for customers.
 



  





**The Superpowers That Make You Stand Out:** 




 ● Passionate about taking ownership, solving customer problems, and working towards business and revenue goals with a strong target\-oriented mindset.
 



 ● Strong understanding of numbers, business metrics, and customer growth drivers.
 



 ● Data\-driven mindset with the ability to analyze trends, derive insights, and recommend actionable solutions for customers.
 



 ● Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with clarity of thought and articulation.
 



 ● Ability to build strong relationships and earn trust with both business and functional stakeholders.
 



 ● Strong problem\-solving and consultative thinking skills with a customer\-first approach.
 



 ● Experience in managing enterprise customers and handling cross\-functional coordination across teams.
 



 ● Ability to understand customer business challenges and align solutions to business outcomes.
 



 ● Strong curiosity and interest in technology, AI, and evolving trends in the CPG/FMCG industry, with a mindset to drive innovation and create impact in the space.
 



 ● Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment with high ownership and adaptability.
 



 ● Strong follow\-through and execution skills with attention to detail.
 



 ● Open to candidates from diverse educational backgrounds; however, a BTech or MBA background would be preferred.
 



 ● Prior experience working in consulting, SaaS, retail, FMCG, or distribution\-focused businesses in emerging markets would be an added advantage.
 



  





**The League You will Grow With:** 




 ● Get the opportunity to work with highly ambitious, sharp, and result\-oriented people from across the globe.
 



 ● Bring your FMCG/CPG industry knowledge into the world of technology, AI, and SaaS, while solving large\-scale business problems for leading brands.
 



 ● Work closely with some of the biggest CPG brands and understand how technology is transforming route\-to\-market operations.
 



 ● Own your ideas, strategies, and execution and see your impact directly on customer growth and business outcomes.
 



 ● Gain hands\-on exposure to technology, AI\-driven solutions, data\-led decision making, and modern SaaS business models.
 



 ● Work on real business challenges that directly influence sales execution, distribution, retail visibility, and market growth for customers.
 



 ● Accelerate your learning curve and career growth by working at the intersection of business and technology.
 



 ● Be part of a culture where leaders are built from within through ownership, hustle, and consistent impact \- not just hierarchy or tenure.
 



 ● Drive meaningful business outcomes by helping customers adopt mobile\-first and AI\-led technologies that impact millions of retailers and users on the ground.
 



  





**Why Bizom?** 




 ● We are happy Souls, working together and having each other’s back! People, Product and Profit is our motto.
 



 ● Fly beyond your imagination as we believe in giving wings to your passion.
 



 ● No Kinder\-garden, We fall, We learn and we stick together like a chewing\-gum.
 



 ● We trust in our association and allow free rein to our employees. To act and explore themselves while delivering the best and sustainable results.
 



 ● We celebrate success hard and failures harder, It's always a collective success or collective failure. We enjoy our learnings more with a sip of our poison;)
 



 ● Have Buddies, Mentors But be your own boss. It goes hand in hand.
 



 ● Know your people, Talk, Chat, learn and Share \- have access anytime to reach anyone in the family.
 



 ● Stay Quiet \- Stay Foolish. We are courageous people who speak and do right things keeping in heart to serve best to our clients and our company.
 



 ● We believe in rolling our sleeves up, getting our hands dirty, dreaming and achieving together.
 



  





**What Will you get while working with Bizom?** 




 ● Work is Fun \- We believe work is fun\-and we go the extra mile to make sure you enjoy what you do every single day.
 



 ● Design Your Own Role \- You don’t just fit into a job\-we let you shape it. Take up what excites you, and we’ll back you with trust and responsibility.
 



 ● Freedom to Own Your Work \- Less rules, more trust. You get the freedom to figure things out your way\-with the right support when needed.
 



 ● Take Full Ownership \- It’s your ship. You steer it. You own it. You make things happen.
 



 ● Grow into a Leader \- This isn’t just a job\-it’s your launchpad to becoming a strong, independent leader.
 



 ● People Come First \- Always. We back our people through thick and thin. That’s our culture.
 



 ● Stay Fit \& Feel Good \- We care about your health\-with fitness activities, sports, and regular wellness sessions to keep you balanced.
 



 ● Happy Tummy, Happy You \- Enjoy fresh, tasty meals every day at our very own in\- house cafeteria. We take food seriously!
 



  





**What will you not get?**

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Hindustan Parking Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd (HPIPL) is an Indian brand focused on designing, manufacturing, and installing next\-generation parking systems that make urban mobility more efficient and convenient. The company combines Indian ingenuity with global technology standards to deliver ISO\-certified, durable, and safe parking solutions. HPIPL emphasizes innovation, automation, sustainability, and quality assurance, using premium components and providing nationwide and international service with 24/7 customer care. Its portfolio covers parking solutions for buses, trucks, cars, bikes, and fully automatic systems, serving housing complexes, offices, airports, and commercial spaces. The organization is driven by a mission to build smarter, cleaner, and more connected cities, believing that a smarter India starts with smarter spaces.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Senior Account Manager is a full\-time role based in Noida with a hybrid work arrangement, allowing a mix of on\-site and work\-from\-home days. This role involves managing key client accounts, building long\-term relationships, and serving as the primary point of contact for corporate and project clients. The Senior Account Manager will oversee end\-to\-end account lifecycle activities, including understanding client needs, coordinating proposals, negotiating contracts, and ensuring timely delivery of parking solutions and services. Daily tasks include collaborating with sales, engineering, and operations teams, monitoring project and service performance, preparing account reports, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross\-selling. The role also requires handling escalations professionally, maintaining high customer satisfaction, and supporting strategic initiatives to grow HPIPL’s presence in smart parking and infrastructure projects.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong account management and client relationship skills, including stakeholder management, negotiation, and customer service.
* Experience in B2B sales or corporate account handling, preferably in infrastructure, engineering, real estate, or technology\-driven solutions.
* Ability to coordinate with cross\-functional teams (sales, technical, operations) and manage multiple projects or accounts simultaneously.
* Proficiency in business communication, presentation, and documentation, with strong written and verbal skills in English; Hindi proficiency is an advantage.
* Solid analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with comfort using CRM tools, spreadsheets, and reporting dashboards.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Management, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus.
* Prior experience in a senior or lead role managing key accounts, including revenue responsibility and performance targets.
* Willingness to travel to client sites and project locations as needed and to work in a hybrid setup based in Noida.

title: Restaurant Onboarding Manager
description:
Experience Required: 3–6 Years
 



 CTC: 3\-3\.5 LPA
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**About Gintaa** 




 At Gintaa, were redefining how Indians order food. With our focus on affordability, exclusive restaurant partnerships, and hyperlocal logistics, we aim to scale across India’s Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities. We’re backed by a mission\-driven team and expanding rapidly – now’s the time to join the core tech leadership and build something impactful from the ground up.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced and execution\-driven
 **Restaurant Onboarding Manager** 
 to lead Gintaa’s restaurant acquisition and onboarding operations.
 



 The role will be responsible for identifying and acquiring high\-potential restaurant partners, managing commercial discussions, ensuring documentation and onboarding completion, coordinating menu and catalogue setup, driving restaurant activation, and ensuring that newly onboarded restaurants become successfully operational on the Gintaa platform.
 



 The ideal candidate must have
 **5–7 years of hands\-on experience specifically in restaurant onboarding, restaurant acquisition, merchant acquisition, food\-tech partnerships, or restaurant account management within the online food delivery ecosystem.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Restaurant Acquisition \& Market Expansion
 


* Own restaurant acquisition and onboarding targets across assigned territories, zones, and markets.
* Identify high\-potential restaurants, QSRs, cloud kitchens, local food brands, restaurant chains, and strategic merchant partners.
* Develop market\-level acquisition strategies based on cuisine gaps, customer demand, locality coverage, pricing, and restaurant popularity.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective restaurant partners.
* Conduct regular market mapping and identify restaurants currently missing from Gintaa's portfolio.
* Drive both field\-based and strategic restaurant acquisition initiatives.
* Support Gintaa's expansion into new locations by rapidly developing the restaurant supply base.



  





 2\. Restaurant Onboarding
 


* Manage the complete restaurant onboarding lifecycle from initial contact to successful activation.
* Coordinate collection and verification of required restaurant information and documentation.
* Ensure restaurant profiles, menus, pricing, operating hours, images, bank details, tax information, and other required information are accurately captured.
* Coordinate internally for account creation and platform configuration.
* Ensure onboarding activities are completed within defined turnaround times.
* Maintain high onboarding quality and minimize errors that could affect restaurant operations or customer experience.



  





 3\. Commercial Negotiation \& Partner Conversion
 


* Conduct commercial discussions with restaurant owners, decision\-makers, and management teams.
* Clearly communicate Gintaa's value proposition and partnership model.
* Negotiate commercials and partnership terms within approved company guidelines.
* Handle objections and competitive comparisons effectively.
* Drive conversion of qualified restaurant leads into active partners.
* Maintain transparency in all commercial commitments made to restaurant partners.



  





 4\. Restaurant Activation \& Go\-Live
 


* Own the journey from
 **Lead → Meeting → Agreement → Documentation → Menu Setup → Onboarding → Go\-Live → First Order** 
 .
* Ensure newly onboarded restaurants become operational within the defined activation timeline.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners to resolve issues delaying activation.
* Track restaurants that have completed onboarding but have not gone live or received orders.
* Drive activation and first\-order completion for newly onboarded partners.
* Ensure restaurant partners understand the operational workflow before going live.



  





 5\. Menu \& Catalogue Readiness
 


* Ensure restaurant menus are accurately represented on the Gintaa platform.
* Coordinate menu collection, item categorization, pricing, descriptions, images, availability, add\-ons, and customization requirements.
* Ensure restaurant information including address, operating hours, cuisines, and contact details is accurate.
* Work closely with catalogue/content teams to minimize menu\-related errors.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners for timely menu updates whenever required.



  





 6\. Partner Training \& Operational Readiness
 


* Educate newly onboarded restaurant partners on order acceptance and management processes.
* Explain platform workflows, restaurant responsibilities, delivery coordination, cancellations, customer issues, and escalation procedures.
* Ensure restaurant staff understand how to efficiently manage online orders.
* Provide initial operational support during the restaurant's launch phase.
* Reduce early\-stage operational issues through effective onboarding and training.



  





 7\. Restaurant Partner Relationship Management
 


* Build strong working relationships with restaurant owners and key decision\-makers.
* Act as an escalation point during the initial onboarding and activation period.
* Understand restaurant partner concerns and coordinate internally for resolution.
* Maintain high levels of partner satisfaction throughout the onboarding journey.
* Ensure smooth handover of successfully activated restaurants to the relevant account management or restaurant operations team.



  





 8\. Team Management \& Leadership
 


* Lead and mentor Restaurant Acquisition Managers, Onboarding Executives, Business Development Executives, and field teams.
* Allocate territories and acquisition targets based on market potential.
* Conduct daily and weekly pipeline reviews with the team.
* Track individual and team\-level performance against defined targets.
* Coach team members on pitching, negotiation, objection handling, and restaurant conversion.
* Build a high\-performance culture focused on acquisition quality, speed, ownership, and execution.



  





 9\. Market Intelligence \& Competition Tracking
 


* Maintain strong awareness of the local restaurant and food delivery ecosystem.
* Track competitor restaurant partnerships, market penetration, restaurant offers, and acquisition activities.
* Gather structured feedback from restaurant partners regarding market trends and competitor propositions.
* Identify cuisine, pricing, locality, and restaurant\-selection gaps in Gintaa's marketplace.
* Share actionable market intelligence with business leadership.



  





 10\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Restaurant Operations
* Catalogue/Menu Management
* Sales \& Business Development
* Finance
* Legal/Compliance
* Customer Support
* Delivery Operations
* Product \& Technology
* Marketing



  





 Ensure smooth movement of restaurant partners across the entire acquisition, onboarding, activation, and operational handover journey.
 



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 Performance for this role will primarily be measured through:
 


* Number of Restaurants Acquired
* Qualified Lead\-to\-Onboarding Conversion %
* Restaurants Onboarded per Month
* Restaurant Activation / Go\-Live Rate
* Average Onboarding TAT
* Documentation Completion Rate
* Menu/Listing Accuracy
* Agreement\-to\-Go\-Live TAT
* Onboarding\-to\-First\-Order Conversion
* Restaurant Partner Drop\-Off Rate
* Acquisition Cost per Restaurant
* Restaurant Coverage by Zone
* Target vs. Achievement
* Team Productivity
* Restaurant Partner Satisfaction



  





 Required Experience \& Qualifications
 


* **5–7 years of relevant professional experience.**
* **Prior experience in the same domain – restaurant acquisition, restaurant onboarding, food\-tech merchant acquisition, or restaurant partnerships – is MANDATORY.**
* **Candidates without relevant restaurant/food\-delivery onboarding or acquisition experience will not be considered for this position.**
* **Proven experience working directly with restaurant owners, restaurant chains, QSRs, cloud kitchens, or food\-service businesses.**
* **Strong experience in restaurant acquisition, onboarding, activation, and commercial negotiations.**
* **Experience managing field sales/acquisition teams and territory\-level targets.**
* **Strong understanding of online food delivery marketplace operations.**
* **Graduate degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Hospitality, or a related discipline.**
* **MBA/PGDM will be an advantage.**
* **Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, CRM systems, MIS reporting, and performance dashboards.**
* **Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.**
* **Willingness to travel extensively within assigned markets and interact directly with restaurant partners.**

 Relationship Manager
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and deepen relationships with existing Priority Customers to achieve increase in share of wallet and revenues.
* Provide professional customer service to achieve a high percentage of customer satisfaction and retention.
* Manage the portfolio to de\-risk against attrition and achieve stability of book.
* Have complete knowledge of the customer base in terms of the profile, demographics \& psychographics and assets in the Bank and in other places.
* Serve as the one\-point contact to the High\-Net\-Worth customers of the Bank


**Business**
* Maximize sales performance to achieve given revenue targets (self and branch) through liability products \[Current /Savings /Term deposits], wealth management products and asset related products (secured, unsecured)
* Generate new business via sales promotions, out\-marketing calls and presentations and in\-branch contacts
* Ensure high level of customer service in the Branch. Manage difficult customer situations
* Generate new business to achieve defined targets in terms of no. of customers, volumes and revenue for the segment
* Achieve the Targets set in terms of product mix
* Induction of all new customers brought in by the Branches \& Direct Sales team.
* Achieve “best in class” productivity in order to maximize the efficacy of the sales process.
* Achieve the budgeted cross sell targets.
* Aggressive Sales call plans to acquire large prospective customers through referrals.
* Ensure coverage of customer base in accordance with the approved contact plans.
* Coordinate customer events for the cluster along with the product team


**Processes**
* Ensure compliance with internal and external guidelines and ensure minimal comments in audits and other inspections
* Ensure transactions are processed with a high level of accuracy and commitment in order to satisfy customer needs
* Ensure validity and completeness of transactions processed and ensure concessions relative to exchange rate, fees, charges etc. are authorized/ overridden by appropriate authorities


**People \& Talent**
* Servicing primarily mapped customers to fulfill the specific transactional requirements of the customer through high quality customer service, while increasing product penetration through cross sell and achieving allocated portfolio and revenue targets


**Risk Management**
* Ensure he/ she is fully aware of all the policies and procedures issued in relation to ORMA, Group Code of
* Conduct, KYC/CDD/EDD \& Money laundering prevention. He/she must ensure compliance with these policies and procedures on an ongoing basis. Any suspicious transaction must immediately be reported to the supervising officer.


**Governance**
* Monitor customer satisfaction survey ratings, net promoter score or any other survey/ feedback ratings taken from customers and ensure continuous improvement if below benchmark, sustain and better quality service.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Key stakeholders**
* Branch Banking Retail department


**Other Responsibilities**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead the \[India / Retail Banking / Branch Frontline /Branch] to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles


**Skills And Experience**
* Nurturing relationship
* Service excellence
* Product Knowledge
* Non\-disclosure of information


**Qualifications**
* CPBB essentials online and classroom trainings
* IRDA, NISM certifications


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**
 Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
   

  

 Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
   

  

 Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
   

  

**What We Offer**
 In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

 Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
   

  

 Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
   

  

 Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
   

  

 Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
   

  

 A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
   

  

 Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

description:
**Job Description:** 




**Join AlmaShines Technologies as a Customer Success Associate!** 




  





**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, India (Onsite)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time, Onsite
 



  





**About Us:** 




 AlmaShines Technologies Private Limited, founded by IIT Kanpur alumni, provides innovative cloud\-based solutions to educational institutions. We empower institutes to build and manage alumni communities through platforms such as Alumni Management Systems, Virtual Alumni Events, and Mobile Apps. Trusted by over 850 institutes across 14 countries, AlmaShines is transforming alumni engagement globally.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




 We are seeking a motivated Customer Success Associate to join our on\-site team in Ahmedabad. In this role, you’ll be essential to helping our clients successfully leverage our education\-focused platforms to achieve their goals.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Customer Onboarding:** 
 Guide clients through a smooth onboarding process, ensuring they understand our products and services.
* **Relationship Management:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, building and maintaining strong relationships and advocating for their needs.
* **Customer Success Planning:** 
 Collaborate with clients to develop success strategies and track their progress.
* **Product Training \& Adoption:** 
 Provide training to help clients maximize platform usage.
* **Proactive Support:** 
 Identify potential challenges and address them with timely solutions.
* **Issue Resolution:** 
 Handle client inquiries and coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues.
* **Feedback \& Advocacy:** 
 Gather client feedback for product improvements and share success stories within the company.
* **Renewals \& Upsells:** 
 Work with the Sales team to secure renewals and explore upselling opportunities.
* **Client Engagement:** 
 Organize events and webinars to promote product usage and client engagement.



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Problem\-solving ability combined with strategic thinking.
* Ability to understand and explain software products.
* Customer\-centric and proactive mindset.
* Familiarity with SaaS business models and client lifecycles.
* Adaptable and able to work in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
* 0–3 years of experience in customer success, account management, or a related role is preferred.



  





**Compensation (CTC):** 



* **Annual CTC:** 
 ₹4,00,000 – ₹6,50,000 LPA
* **Fixed Pay:** 
 ₹4,00,000 – ₹6,00,000 per year
* **Variable Pay:** 
 ₹50,000 per year



  





 This will be based on your experience, skills, and alignment with the role. We believe in fair, performance\-driven compensation and ensure clarity from day one to make the hiring process transparent for both sides.
 



  





**Important:** 
 Candidates whose expected CTC aligns with the above structure are encouraged to apply.
 



  





**Why Join AlmaShines?** 




 At AlmaShines, you’ll be part of a mission to enhance alumni engagement and support the growth of educational institutes. If you are passionate about customer success and excited to join a dynamic team in Ahmedabad, apply today!

**Diversity \- Innovation \- Caring \- Global Collaboration \- Winning Spirit \- High Performance**
 At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high\-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.
   

  

**Location:**
 Ahmedabad
   

  

**Job Description**
* Sells and promotes company products within a defined geographic territory by developing new accounts and expanding usage of company products by current accounts in an effort to meet a sales quota based on company sales goals and to directly increase sales revenue of the company.


**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Sells products by scheduling sales calls to meet with current and potential customers to fulfill revenue and unit growth objectives assigned by company on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.
* Develops and implements sales strategies by determining the relevant factors (e.g., product, competition and pricing needs) of existing and potential accounts to effectively promote the company's products to appropriate hospital personnel and physicians.
* Develops action plans (i.e., weekly, quarterly, monthly) by analyzing quarterly and monthly sales figures and reports identifying the needs of particular accounts and discussing issues with Regional Manager to help the organization achieve its annual sales goals.
* Determines the needs (e.g., product and pricing), goals, product usage, and types of cases handled by specific customers by meeting with and asking in\-depth questions of physicians and other hospital personnel to learn which Boston Scientific products can best address their specific needs.
* Observes actual procedures in the cardiac catheterization lab and operating room of hospital accounts to gain insight into the specific nuances of each physician and each member of the lab staff.
* Establishes pricing packages by working with relevant Boston Scientific personnel to establish price points that address specific customer's needs while satisfying company guidelines and policies.
* Responds to customer needs and complaints regarding products and service by developing creative and feasible solutions or working with other related personnel (e.g. clinical research, pricing and/or marketing) to develop optimal solutions.
* Develops relationships with hospital personnel (e.g. through casual conversation, meetings, participation in conferences) to make new contacts in other departments within hospital and to identify key purchasing decision makers in order to facilitate future sales.
* Educates customers on the merits and proper clinical usage of company products by giving presentations and demonstrations using a wide variety of formats and platforms (e.g., slides, transparencies, manuals) to secure purchasing commitments, often with the help of incentive programs and services made available to the account being developed.


**Must Have**
 5\+ Years of individual role experience
   

  

 Must have experience in Intervention Cardiology OR any cardiology therapy areas

 Knowledge
   

  

* A developing professional. Working knowledge and application of business and technical concepts, procedures and practices. General knowledge of industry practices, techniques, and standards. General understanding of business unit/group function. Exercises judgment when interpreting company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues.


 Problem Solving
   

  

* Develops solutions to a variety of problems of moderate scope and complexity where analysis of situations or data requires a review of identifiable factors. Exercises judgment to determine appropriate action. Has knowledge of alternatives and an understanding of their impact on the business or technological environment.


 Planning and Organization

description:
Role & Responsibilities Act as the primary point of contact for customers and ensure a smooth, professional customer experience. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing customers. Regularly communicate with customers to understand their requirements, concerns, feedback, and expectations. Handle customer queries related to orders, delivery status, invoices, payments, and other service-related matters. Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Purchase, Warehouse, Accounts, and Delivery teams to resolve customer issues promptly. Proactively follow up on pending orders, delayed deliveries, shortages, replacements, returns, and other open issues. Collect customer feedback and share relevant insights with management and concerned departments. Monitor customer satisfaction and take proactive steps to prevent customer dissatisfaction or loss. Support customer retention and encourage repeat business through consistent service and relationship management. Prepare regular reports related to customer complaints, pending issues, order status, customer activity, and service performance. Ensure timely escalation of critical or unresolved customer issues to the appropriate senior team member. Follow company policies, SOPs, and service standards while dealing with customers. Good interpersonal and relationship-management skills. Customer-focused attitude with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility. Ability to handle customer complaints and difficult situations professionally. Good follow-up and coordination skills. Comfortable communicating with customers over phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and other communication channels . Good working knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets and basic computer applications . Ability to maintain accurate records and prepare basic reports. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple customers and follow-ups simultaneously. Should be proactive, disciplined, and comfortable working in a target- and deadline-oriented environment. Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple internal departments. title: Customer Relationship Manager
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW As a Customer Relationship Manager (CRM) at Lenskart, you will be the face of the store the first person a customer meets and the last impression they carry. You will own the end-to-end in-store experience, ensuring every visitor feels welcomed, heard, and valued. Beyond warm hospitality, you will play a critical role in resolving escalations, managing difficult situations with grace, and turning dissatisfied customers into loyal advocates. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Customer Greeting & Experience Management Welcome every customer entering the store with warmth and professionalism, setting a positive first impression from the door. Understand customer needs proactively and guide them to the right product, service, or associate within the store. Acknowledge and manage wait times; keep customers engaged and comfortable during peak hours. Coordinate seamless handoffs between optometrists, sales associates, and the CRM desk. Grievance Resolution & Customer Recovery Own all in-store customer complaints from product defects and service delays to prescription concerns. Resolve grievances at the store level within defined TATs; escalate with full context when required. Maintain a complaint log and follow up post-resolution to confirm customer satisfaction. Identify recurring complaint patterns and flag them to store leadership and the operations team. Difficult Customer Handling Manage irate or highly dissatisfied customers with empathy, patience, and solution orientation. De-escalate tense situations through active listening and calm, composed communication. Exercise judgment on goodwill gestures (replacement, priority service, escalation) within authorized limits. Store Experience & CRM Operations Maintain store ambience, queue management, and signage in the customer-facing zone. Capture customer feedback (NPS, in-store forms) and share weekly insights with the store team. Track daily footfall, walk-in-to-conversion ratios, and complaint resolution metrics. Coordinate with the post-sales and fulfilment team for order status updates and delivery queries. 
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Must-Have 1–4 years of experience in customer-facing roles — hospitality (hotel front desk, concierge), premium retail, airport lounge, or mall guest services. Demonstrated ability to handle difficult, unhappy, or demanding customers with composure and empathy. Fluency in Kannada and English; Hindi is a strong advantage. Warm, approachable personality with a solution-first and ownership mindset. Graduate in any discipline. 
 Good to Have Background from premium malls (UB City, Phoenix, Palladium), 5-star hotel front desks (Taj, Oberoi, Leela), or airport lounges (Encalm, Plaza Premium). Familiarity with CRM tools, complaint ticketing systems, or basic store management software. Prior exposure to eyewear, healthcare retail, or regulated product categories. Comfort with basic data entry — logging complaints, updating resolution status, sharing daily reports. 
 CORE COMPETENCIES Customer Empathy Acknowledges emotions before jumping to solutions; makes every customer feel heard and respected. Conflict De-escalation Stays calm under pressure; reframes complaints into resolvable problems without getting defensive. Service Ownership Does not pass the buck; sees every complaint through to closure personally. Communication Clear, polite, and confident in both Kannada and English; adapts tone to the customer. Attention to Detail Notices potential service gaps proactively and addresses them before they escalate. Adaptability Maintains service quality consistently across high-footfall peak hours and quieter periods.

Collaborate with other analysts to monitor and troubleshoot EDI transactions, providing a reliable exchange of electronic information between K-C and the customer. Prioritize and expedite assistance based upon severity of situations. Analyze customer requirements to determine EDI configuration needs and system specifications. Create entries in system tables and map data between internal applications and standardized EDI formats to support. Apply industry rules and guidelines to ensure compliance. Manage system and tool security access based on role definitions. title: Customer Success Executive – Client & Partner Operations
description:
Customer Success Executive – Client \& Partner Operations
   


**Bengaluru (HSR Layout) · On\-site, 5 days · Immediate joiners preferred** 
  




 About Finkraft
   


 Finkraft is a Bengaluru\-based travel\-fintech recovering money that large enterprises silently lose every year in their expense and compliance processes. We work with
 **1,250\+ enterprise clients** 
 , including
 **HCL, Philips, Volkswagen, Cipla, BCG, Tata Communications, JSW, Cleartrip and BCD** 
 — Fortune 500 manufacturers, global consulting firms and India's largest IT services and travel companies.
   





 For a single client this runs into crores a year. We've built the platform and the data engine. What turns it into recovered money is a network of partner businesses doing their part — and that is the function you'd be joining.
   




 Role \& responsibilities
   

* **Own a partner portfolio end to end.** 
 You're the single point of contact for your set of partner businesses — onboarding them, getting them transacting, and keeping the relationship warm enough that next month is easier than this one.
* **Drive high\-volume outbound follow\-ups.** 
 This is a phone\-first role: 60–90 conversations a day with operations staff, finance teams and business owners to close out pending documentation and commitments.
* **Escalate and unblock.** 
 When a partner who committed three weeks ago goes quiet, there's no escalation matrix handed to you. You work out who in that organisation can actually say yes, and you get to them — by phone, by WhatsApp, or by showing up.
* **Onboard new partners onto the platform,** 
 walking them through the process and getting them to first transaction quickly.
* **Conduct on\-ground visits across Bengaluru** 
 where a face across the table moves things faster than a call — to onboard, unblock, or repair a stalled relationship.
* **Resolve client escalations.** 
 When an enterprise client flags something missing, you're the person who chases it down, fixes it, and reports back.
* **Coordinate internally** 
 with data, product and operations teams to close cases that need more than a follow\-up.
* **Maintain accurate, current records.** 
 Every commitment, follow\-up and outcome logged — what we report to our clients is only as good as your tracker.


 Requirements
   

  

 Education \& eligibility
   

* **Any graduate.** 
 Stream and institution are not filters — we hire on capability, not credentials.
* **Fluent English and Hindi** 
 on the phone, with the confidence to hold a commercial conversation with a business owner or finance controller. Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi or Bengali is a genuine advantage and we weight it in selection.
* **Working comfort with Excel / Google Sheets** 
 — filters, lookups, and a tracker you keep clean without being asked.
* **Based in Bengaluru or willing to relocate,** 
 available to work 5 days a week from our HSR Layout office.
* **Immediate or 15\-day joiners preferred.**


 Preferred background
   


**1\+ year in an outbound, outcome\-owned role.** 
 Industry doesn't matter. What matters is that you were measured on whether the thing happened — not on how many calls you logged.
   





 Backgrounds that map well:
   




* Customer success or post\-sales, where renewals and adoption were yours to hit
* Collections and recovery — B2B, consumer, or NBFC
* Fee and payment recovery in edtech
* B2B inside sales or account management
* Client servicing in a role where you chased external stakeholders for deliverables


 Benefits
   

  

 Why this role is worth your time
   


 This isn't a support function sitting downstream of the business. It is one of our two largest revenue lines, and the difference between a portfolio worked well and one worked badly shows up directly in what we bill and what our clients get back. You'll deal with finance and operations leaders at Fortune 500 companies, and you'll see the outcome of your own work in a number every month.
   





 Growth from here runs into account ownership, partner management, and team leadership as the function scales. We'd rather promote from here than hire above it.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY** 




 CultureMonkey is an AI\-powered employee engagement and experience platform helping organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100\+ countries and rated 4\.7/5 on G2\.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We are looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own the customer journey from adoption through renewal and help customers achieve measurable value from CultureMonkey.
 



 You will build relationships with champions, key stakeholders, and executive sponsors, drive product adoption, monitor account health, and proactively manage risks and opportunities.
 



 This is a strategic, data\-driven role for someone who enjoys solving customer problems, leading meaningful business conversations, and turning customer goals into measurable outcomes.
 



 You will also work closely with our founding team and internal teams to bring customer insights into the business and help shape our Customer Success function.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




 As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will be working on customer engagement efforts, playing a pivotal role in driving success and satisfaction. Your responsibilities will include:
 



  




* Strategic CS Development: Craft and implement cohesive CS strategies tailored to critical stages of the customer journey, including upcoming renewals and QBRs/EBRs.
* Collaborative Insight Sharing: Partner closely with our founding members, providing valuable insights to enhance the overall customer process.
* Innovative Project Management: Strategically plan and execute new projects to identify areas for increased product usage and adoption.
* Creative Customer Campaigns: Develop and launch engaging campaigns to educate and nurture customers on the latest product features.
* Performance Reporting: Regularly report on product adoption, usage, and customer health to our leadership team, ensuring continuous monitoring and delivering actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Renewal pipeline generation: Experiment with diverse approaches to maintain a steady, qualified pipeline of renewals.
* Key Metric Tracking: Continuously monitor and report on crucial metrics such as renewals, churn rates, and CSAT scores.
* Operational Oversight: Provide operational oversight to ensure targets and KPIs are met.
* Best Practice Sharing: Educate clients on best practices to achieve product success with CultureMonkey.



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 



* 5\-8 years of experience, with at least 5 years in Customer Success, preferably in B2B SaaS or HR Tech.
* Experience managing strategic or enterprise customer relationships with multiple stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Strong understanding of customer health, adoption, retention, renewals, churn, and CSAT.
* A data\-driven mindset with the ability to turn customer and product data into actionable insights.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience working with senior and executive stakeholders.
* Excellent project management and execution skills with strong attention to follow\-through.
* Strong commercial awareness and comfort participating in renewal and expansion conversations.
* A customer\-first, empathetic approach combined with structured and analytical thinking.
* Experience with Customer Success tools, CRM platforms, and analytics tools is a strong advantage.
* Experience working with global customers, preferably in the US, is preferred.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment where ownership matters.



  





**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET** 



* Someone who thinks beyond customer support and understands that great Customer Success is about delivering measurable value.
* Someone who can speak confidently with an HR leader, understand the data behind an account, and turn both into a clear action plan.
* Someone who takes ownership, spots risks early, and follows through.
* Someone who sees renewals as the result of consistently delivering value \- not just a date on the calendar.
* Someone who wants to help build something, not just operate within it.



  





 If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil \& gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.
 



 Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two\-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000\+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.
 



 Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.
 



**Senior Customer Success Manager** 





**\*\*This position requires candidates to be located in Bangalore only\*\***





 In this role, you will own the health, growth, and defence of Syndigo’s Enhanced Content (Content Cast) retailer network. You will be the single accountable owner for script implementation, network performance, and retailer and manufacturer relationships, helping protect and grow the brand revenue that depends on this network.
 



 This role requires working in the
 **European shift** 




**HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY** 



* Own the correct implementation and ongoing health of Syndigo scripts across retailer websites.
* Drive adoption of rich content modules and logo programs, such as HP Recommends and Epson Recommends.
* Lead Energy Label rollouts and coordinate custom XML, HTML, and API integrations from setup through launch.
* Monitor coverage, script functionality, content gaps, and syndication performance.
* Conduct coverage studies, audits, and year\-over\-year trend analysis to identify opportunities and risks.
* Partner with dashboard and reporting owners to improve the accuracy of recipient status and network reporting.
* Maintain retailer wishlists, growth plans, onboarding trackers, dashboards, and regional retailer lists used by Sales and Customer Success teams.
* Surface actionable insights and business cases for CSMs, Sales, Product, and other internal stakeholders.
* Serve as the primary liaison across manufacturers, retailers, CSMs, Sales, Product, Operations, Support, and Engineering.
* Own the relationship motion for active retailers after acquisition, including implementation follow\-up, engagement, usage reviews, issue escalation, and relationship health.
* Run regular business reviews with key brand and retailer partners and drive retailer advocacy based on the value delivered by Syndigo.
* Lead regular network expansion and health meetings, including expansion status, escalations, and RACI alignment.
* Support strategic retailer conversations where Syndigo needs to be positioned as a partner in marketplace, content, syndication, or PDP experience programs.
* Defend Syndigo placements against Flixmedia, Loadbee, Icecat, and other syndication providers by identifying competitive risks and defining actions to improve Syndigo’s position in the retailer waterfall.
* Identify brands already selling through a retailer but not yet syndicating rich content there, creating expansion opportunities for Sales and Customer Success.
* Use retailer feeds, coverage data, traffic, and priority\-account analysis to identify high\-value brand gaps.
* Support CSMs and Sales with retailer\-specific expansion narratives and business cases.
* Work with strategic brands to leverage their influence in support of retailer expansion where appropriate.
* Engage Tier 2 and Tier 3 retailers requested by brands and drive interest in implementing Syndigo Enhanced Content scripts, while supporting Tier 1 outreach and discussions.
* Coordinate escalations related to content visibility, missing content, retailer waterfalls, PDP rendering, inactive connections, dashboard inaccuracies, and conflicting provider behavior.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success to resolve issues that impact retailer confidence or content availability.



**WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU** 



* Strong experience in Enhanced Content, Rich Content, product content syndication, or a closely related domain.
* Existing relationships with brands and EMEA retailers.
* Experience working with retailers, brands, e\-commerce platforms, or retail technology.
* Technical fluency with script deployment and web technologies, including JavaScript, HTML, CSS, XML, and JSON.
* Understanding of API integrations and experience working with technical teams to troubleshoot integration issues.
* Basic understanding of iFrames, product feeds, and Server\-Side Rendering (SSR).
* Familiarity with browser developer tools, such as Chrome DevTools, for troubleshooting and validation.
* Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, comparisons, and data analysis.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence for issue tracking and documentation.
* Commercially aware and comfortable participating in QBRs, customer and deal conversations, and competitive positioning.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Support, Operations, and Engineering.
* Highly organised and self\-directed, with the ability to independently manage multiple critical customer issues and priorities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work during European hours.
* Familiarity with CMS and e\-commerce platforms such as Magento, WordPress, or Shopify (preferred but not required).
* Experience with Product Information Management (PIM) or Master Data Management (MDM) platforms (preferred but not required).
* Experience with Rich Content or Enhanced Content syndication (preferred but not required).
* Experience with Salesforce or Customer Success platforms (preferred but not required).
* Understanding of Content Security Policy (CSP) (preferred but not required).
* Knowledge of SEO, Product Detail Page (PDP) optimisation, or digital merchandising (preferred but not required).
* Knowledge of EU Energy Labels or other product compliance programs (preferred but not required).
* Experience in SaaS, product syndication, or retail technology (preferred but not required).
* Willingness to learn new technologies and integration methods, with training provided.



  
 


**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion** 

 To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.
 



 Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful! 
 



 All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth! 
 



**GDPR/CCPA**




 Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.
 



**Syndigo Job Applicant Privacy Notice** 




 At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

description:
**About the Role** 




 As the Manager, Category Account Management, you will be at the forefront of shaping the seller experience charter on Walmart.com for India CBT (Cross Border Trade) team. You will lead a team focused on developing and executing strategies that empower sellers to optimize their product listings, manage their inventory, understand performance metrics, and leverage various Walmart services. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, operational excellence, strong analytical skills, and a passion for helping businesses grow.
 



  





**About the Team** 




 Walmart Marketplace is a rapidly growing e\-commerce platform that empowers businesses of all sizes to reach millions of customers. We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Senior Manager, Seller Enablement to join our dynamic team. In this critical role, you will be responsible for driving the success of our third\-party sellers by providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive on the Walmart Marketplace.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 



* **Seller Enablement Strategy \& Execution:** 
 Design and implement end\-to\-end seller enablement strategies, programs, and initiatives to drive performance, retention, and satisfaction across Walmart Marketplace.
* **Seller\-Driven Problem Solving:** 
 Identify seller pain points and growth opportunities, and translate them into scalable solutions, tools, and resources.
* **Feature Adoption \& Engagement:** 
 Accelerate adoption of Walmart Marketplace features, tools, and services by sellers through targeted enablement and communications.
* **Cross\-Functional Product Partnership:** 
 Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to advocate for seller needs and influence the roadmap of seller\-facing capabilities.
* **Content \& Resource Development:** 
 Own the development and upkeep of high\-quality, actionable seller\-facing materials, including guides, tutorials, webinars, FAQs, and best practices.
* **Performance Analytics \& Insights:** 
 Track and analyze key seller metrics, uncover trends, and identify improvement opportunities to inform decision\-making.
* **Executive Reporting \& Recommendations:** 
 Build and present data\-driven insights to leadership to guide strategic priorities and resource allocation.
* **Impact Measurement \& Benchmarking:** 
 Define success metrics, establish benchmarks, and evaluate the effectiveness of enablement initiatives against seller outcomes.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** 
 Partner closely with internal teams, including Product Management, Engineering, Business Development, Account Management, Marketing, and Customer Service, to deliver a cohesive seller experience.
* **Voice of Seller Advocacy:** 
 Represent seller perspectives in internal forums and product development discussions, ensuring their needs shape solutions and strategy.
* **Market Intelligence \& Differentiation:** 
 Stay current on industry trends, competitor activity, and best practices in seller enablement to identify opportunities for marketplace differentiation.



  





  





**What you’ll bring:** 



* **Analytical \& Performance Acumen:** 
 Demonstrated ability to leverage data, metrics, and insights to assess seller performance, identify trends, and drive measurable improvements.
* **Insight\-Driven Decision Making:** 
 Strong capability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations that inform strategy, prioritization, and resource allocation.
* **Cross\-Functional \& Influencing Skills:** 
 Proven experience partnering with Product, Engineering, and business teams, with the ability to advocate for customer needs and influence roadmap decisions.
* **Customer\-Focused Mindset:** 
 Deep commitment to representing the voice of the seller and enhancing the end\-to\-end marketplace experience through scalable, impactful solutions.
* **Market \& Industry Awareness:** 
 Strong understanding of e\-commerce trends, competitive dynamics, and seller enablement best practices to identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.



  





  





**Minimum Qualifications:** 



* Master's degree (MBA) or equivalent advanced degree.
* 6\+ years of experience in e\-commerce, marketplace operations, seller support, or a related field.
* Proven track record of developing and executing successful programs that drive business growth.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuasively.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly changing environment.



  





**Equal Opportunity Employer** 




 Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunity Employer by Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions while being welcoming of all people.
 



 Walmart doesn’t charge any recruitment or similar fee in the recruitment process, including but not limited to interview, offering, and onboarding.
