title: Manager, Customer Service
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 The Manager, Customer Service provides operational leadership for the India\-based Customer Success team within a global, matrixed Customer Success \& Operations organization, with primary responsibility for quote\-to\-order and order\-related customer Success activities. The role oversees the day\-to\-day execution and resolution of customer requests related to quotes, orders, order changes, order status, fulfillment, pricing, and other transactional activities across the customer journey. Working closely with the US\-based Senior Manager, Customer Success, the Manager translates global strategy and Success standards into effective local execution, while leading team performance, workforce management, escalations, process adherence, and continuous improvement to drive timely, accurate, and consistent customer outcomes.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Manager, Customer Service Has The Following Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership \& Capability Development**
* Lead, coach, and develop the India Customer Service team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, engagement, and succession readiness.
* Build workforce capability through effective hiring, onboarding, performance management, targeted development, and cross\-training that supports business continuity.
* Create an inclusive, customer\-focused culture that reinforces quality, integrity, collaboration, sound judgment, and readiness for change.


**Customer Operations \& Service Excellence**
* Own the consistent delivery of quote\-to\-order and order\-related customer service outcomes, ensuring customer needs are addressed accurately, promptly, and in accordance with established service standards.
* Provide leadership for complex or high\-impact customer issues and escalations, maintaining clear ownership, communication, and follow\-through to resolution.
* Use service, quality, productivity, and customer feedback insights to set priorities, manage risk, and improve the customer experience.


**Cross\-Functional Partnership \& Execution**
* Partner with the Senior Manager, Customer Service to translate global strategy, priorities, and performance expectations into clear plans and measurable outcomes for the India team.
* Build effective partnerships across Finance, Distribution, Trade Compliance, Quality, IT, Sales, Account Management, Product, and other global teams to resolve dependencies and deliver customer and business outcomes.
* Represent Customer Service requirements and customer impact in cross\-functional initiatives, system changes, business reviews, and implementation activities.


**Operational Excellence, Compliance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Ensure team execution complies with applicable policies, procedures, quality requirements, and controls related to orders, documentation, controlled substances, permits, customs, licensing, and shipments.
* Lead improvements that strengthen service quality, efficiency, data accuracy, productivity, cost effectiveness, process consistency, and organizational readiness.
* Serve as the lead for ISO audits within the India Customer Service department, coordinating audit readiness, compliance documentation, corrective actions, and adherence to established quality management standards.


**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Education \& Experience**
 The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree required in a business, sales or related field.
* Minimum of seven (7\) years of experience in customer Success, sales, or related field in a multi\-cultural environment, preferably for a global organization
* Minimum of three (3\) years of people management experience
* In depth knowledge of customer Success principles and practices
* Previous experience in a customer Success environment required.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Fluency in English required, and a second language strongly preferred.
* Customer Success focused and ability to provide a high degree of customer Success.
* Must possess ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment with a high level for stress tolerance while maintaining composure and enthusiasm.
* Excellent organization, problem analysis, problem solving and decision\-making skills, and attention to details required.
* Excellent communication skills (written and oral) and presentation skills are a must.
* Individuals must possess the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Results driven with demonstrated successful outcomes.
* Excellent supervisory skills with a history of building high performing and motivated teams.
* Strong team builder and people leader with the ability and desire to work well with diverse employees and customers in a cooperative and friendly manner.
* Must be able to work independently and in a team environment.
* Must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft software (word processing, email, spreadsheet, database, and Internet).
* Proficiency in Oracle and CRM systems desired.
* Familiarity with automated order entry systems, Ariba or other EDI processes a plus.
* Good understanding of complaint handling and resolution management.
* Familiarity with imports, exports, customs, and business with other countries strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with the culture(s) in the applicable geography(s) is strongly preferred.
* Candidates must be able to work flexible hours, when needed.


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 Yes

title: POD Manager
company: Digital Mojo - Branding and Digital Marketing Agency in Hyderabad
description:
**Company Description** 





 Digital Mojo is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, storytelling, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.
 




  





**Role Description** 




**We are looking for a highly ownership\-driven Pod Manager with 5\-7 years of agency experience to lead a pod of clients end\-to\-end.** 





 The Pod Manager is not a delivery coordinator. They are the business head of their pod. They own the P\&L of their accounts, drive client growth strategy, lead the pod team, and are the last point of escalation before it reaches the CEO. Every commercial decision, every retention risk, every growth opportunity within the pod runs through them.
 





 If something goes wrong in the pod, the Pod Manager owns it. If something goes right, the Pod Manager drove it.
 




**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not a senior Account Manager with a fancier title
* Not someone who only reviews reports and attends calls
* Not someone who escalates client problems to the CEO without first attempting resolution
* Not a task manager or execution coordinator
* Not someone who waits for strategy to come from above



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Pod P\&L Ownership** 



* Own the revenue, profitability, and commercial health of all accounts within the pod
* Track pod\-level billing, scope utilization, and team bandwidth against revenue
* Identify accounts where the agency is over\-servicing and course\-correct scope or pricing
* Protect agency margins by managing team allocation and delivery efficiency
* Flag accounts at commercial risk to the Founder with a clear plan, not just a problem
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and close them in coordination with the Founder
* Own monthly pod revenue targets and report against them with clarity



**2\. Client Growth Strategy** 



* Go beyond delivery. Actively think about what is next for each client's business
* Develop quarterly growth plans for key accounts covering new campaigns, channels, and opportunities
* Proactively bring ideas to clients before they ask. Be the strategic voice in every client relationship
* Identify gaps in a client's current marketing mix and recommend solutions backed by data
* Lead strategic review meetings with clients, not just performance catch\-up calls
* Connect client business goals to marketing strategy and keep both aligned as the business evolves
* Be the person a client calls when they want a fresh perspective, not just a status update



**3\. Escalation Leadership** 



* Serve as the final internal escalation point before the CEO for all pod\-level issues
* Handle client escalations, conflicts, and difficult conversations directly and with confidence
* Resolve delivery failures, team gaps, and quality issues at the pod level without pushing them upward
* Make judgment calls on scope disputes, pricing conversations, and client dissatisfaction independently
* Know when to involve the Founder and walk in with context, options, and a recommendation
* Protect the Founder's bandwidth by resolving 90% of pod issues at the pod level



**4\. Team Leadership and Pod Management** 



* Lead and manage Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, and SEO Specialists within the pod
* Set clear expectations, review output quality, and hold team members accountable
* Run pod reviews, identify underperformance early, and address it directly
* Build a culture of ownership, speed, and quality within the pod
* Identify training or skill gaps in the team and flag them to the Founder
* Ensure Account Managers are handling day\-to\-day client communication so the Pod Manager can focus on strategy and commercial outcomes



**5\. Delivery and Quality Oversight** 



* Own the quality of everything that leaves the pod, from reports to creatives to campaign performance
* Ensure all client deliverables across social media, SEO, and performance marketing are on time and to standard
* Review monthly performance reports before they reach the client
* Maintain SLA adherence across the pod and flag risks before they impact delivery
* Coordinate with centralized teams including design, SEO, website, and automation for seamless execution



**6\. Performance and Campaign Strategy** 



* Understand performance marketing fundamentals including CPL, ROAS, CTR, lead quality, and funnel structure
* Review campaign performance across accounts and push for optimization when results are not meeting targets
* Work with Performance Marketers on budget planning, channel strategy, and campaign direction
* Ensure SEO, social, and paid strategies are aligned and working toward the same client business outcome
* The character in sitcom is Ross



**7\. Commercial Responsibility and Client Retention** 



* Own client retention across all pod accounts
* Conduct regular health checks on every account and know the status of each relationship at all times
* Identify at\-risk clients early and create a recovery plan before it becomes a churn situation
* Manage contract renewals, scope expansions, and pricing conversations
* Track client satisfaction and act on early signals before they escalate



  





**Key KPIs** 



* Pod Revenue vs Target
* Pod Gross Margin and Profitability
* Client Retention Rate
* Upsell and Cross\-sell Revenue Generated
* Client Satisfaction Score
* Escalations Reaching CEO (target: minimal)
* On\-Time Delivery Percentage
* Team Utilization and Bandwidth Efficiency
* Strategic Growth Plans Delivered per Quarter



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 



* 4\-7 years of experience in a digital marketing agency
* Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and cross\-functional teams
* Strong understanding of agency P\&L, billing, scope management, and margin control
* Deep knowledge of performance marketing, social media, SEO, and content marketing
* Experience handling client escalations and difficult commercial conversations independently
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to build and present growth plans for clients
* Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal
* Confident in senior client\-facing discussions and presentations
* Experience with project management and reporting tools
* Ability to lead, motivate, and hold a team accountable in a fast\-paced environment



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 



* **Agency experience is mandatory.**
* Has managed a revenue\-bearing portfolio of clients, not just a team of people
* Has had commercial conversations with clients around scope, pricing, and renewals
* Thinks in terms of client business growth, not just campaign delivery
* Is a problem\-solver who finds solutions before escalating
* Can lead a room whether it is a team standup or a senior client strategy session



  





**Reporting Structure** 



* Reports To: Founder / CEO
* Manages: Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, SEO Specialists
* Coordinates With: Creative Team, SEO Team, Website Team, Automation Team
* Escalation Authority: Final internal point before the CEO

 Xtovia is a Hyderabad\-based, science\-backed haircare brand reimagining Indian beauty at global standards. Powered by our proprietary TriLayerX bond\-repair technology, Xtovia is building a new generation of high\-performance haircare for Indian hair.

 You will work across CRM, customer segmentation, lifecycle campaigns, loyalty, referrals, reactivation and customer engagement. This is a highly hands\-on role where you will be expected to analyse, experiment, execute and learn quickly.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



  





 Customer Retention
 



  





 \-Own and execute Xtovia's retention and repeat\-purchase strategy.

 \-Analyse customer behaviour to understand why customers repurchase, churn or become inactive.
 



 \-Build replenishment strategies based on product usage and consumption cycles.

 CRM \& Lifecycle Marketing
 



  





 \-Own the customer journey from first purchase product experience replenishment repeat purchase loyalty advocacy.
 



 \-Plan and execute campaigns across WhatsApp, Email, SMS and other CRM channels.

title: Parent Relationship Senior Manager
description:
**Parent Relationship Senior Manager**




***Zonal (North \& West, or South \& East) · Reports to the Parent Relationship Head***




  





**Function:** 
 Parent Relationship Management
 



**Reports into:** 
 Parent Relationship Head
 



**Zone owned:** 
 North \& West, or South \& East (one Senior Manager per zone)
 



**Direct reports:** 
 All Parent Relationship Managers across the zone's campuses
 



**Experience:** 
 8–10 years overall, incl. 2–3\+ years in people management
 



**Education:** 
 Graduate; MBA / relevant PG preferred, not mandatory
 



  





**Role Summary**




  





 The Parent Relationship Senior Manager owns parent trust and engagement across every campus in a zone. This is a people\-management role first, and — because parent conversations can be sensitive and emotionally charged — it calls for real maturity too: you will hire, ramp, coach, and review a bench of Parent Relationship Managers, hold the line on the 1:300 mapping ratio as the zone grows, and act as the second\-level escalation point for the harder, trust\-critical conversations a Manager can't close alone.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**



* **Zonal ownership** 
 — be accountable for parent trust and NPS across every campus in the zone — not any single campus, all of them
* **People management** 
 — hire, ramp, coach, and review Parent Relationship Managers in the zone, adding headcount as campuses or batch sizes grow so the 1:300 ratio holds
* **Escalation** 
 — pick up anything a Manager can't close on their own — especially sensitive or trust\-critical conversations — and coach Managers on how those are handled
* **Trust oversight** 
 — sample how cases were handled — the tone and the follow\-through, not just closure speed — and hold the expectation\-management standard, not only the SLA
* **Reporting** 
 — consolidate every campus dashboard in the zone into one view, report it to the Parent Relationship Head, and coordinate with Program Ops and the Student Relationship function



  





**What Success Looks Like — Key Result Areas** 




  





**Zonal parent trust / NPS:** 
 NPS rolled up across all campuses in the zone
 



**2nd\-level escalation TAT:** 
 Time to close issues escalated past the Manager
 



**SLA adherence across zone:** 
 % of managers' concerns closed within SLA
 



**Ratio adherence:** 
 Managers in zone operating at or near 1:300
 



**Manager stability:** 
 Retention of Parent Relationship Managers in the zone
 



  





***Note: Targets and review cadence for each KRA are being finalised by the function.***




  





**Who We're Looking For**



* 8–10 years of total experience, with demonstrated people management — has directly managed a team of 5 or more
* Background in a relationship\-, trust\-, or service\-delivery function, ideally one involving sensitive or emotionally\-charged conversations
* Strong escalation handling — stays calm, decisive, and empathetic when an issue is urgent, emotional, or high\-visibility
* A track record of hiring and coaching a frontline team on tone and judgment, not just supervising for numbers
* Comfortable owning a number (trust/NPS, SLA adherence, retention) and reporting on it upward with a plan, not just a status
* Willing to travel across campuses within the zone



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience running distributed or multi\-location teams
* Exposure to trust\-building, expectation\-management, or escalation frameworks in a client\- or family\-facing context

description:
**Role Summary** 




 The Parent Relationship Head owns the parent relationship function end to end — the playbook every campus runs on, the two zonal Senior Managers, and the escalation of last resort for anything neither a Manager nor a Senior Manager can close. Because this function sits directly on parent trust, it calls for someone still early enough in their leadership career to be hands\-on and hungry to build — not someone managing an already\-mature machine. You are setting the standard once, so a parent gets the same quality of engagement whichever zone or campus their ward is on, and owning the function's standing — one trust/NPS number, company\-wide — for leadership to see.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Function ownership** 
 — set the playbook — hiring bar, SLAs, the 1:300 ratio policy, tracker and reporting standards — applied consistently across both zones
* **People leadership** 
 — hire, review, and hold accountable the two zonal Senior Managers, and keep people practices consistent across both zones
* **Escalation of last resort** 
 — pick up what neither a Manager nor a Senior Manager could close — especially anything that touches a parent's trust in NIAT or NIAT's reputation
* **Executive reporting** 
 — consolidate both zones into a single parent trust/NPS and function\-health view for leadership, rather than leaving it as two separate zonal stories
* **Education strategy** 
 — own the company\-wide parent education and communication calendar — newsletters, program updates, new\-economy career awareness
* **Cross\-functional alignment** 
 — represent the function with Program Ops, University Partnerships, the Student Relationship function, and Infrastructure \& Facilities Excellence


- 


**What Success Looks Like — Key Result Areas** 




**KRA Metric** 




**Company\-wide parent trust / NPS\-** 
 NPS rolled up across both zones
 



**Escalation\-of\-last\-resort TAT\-** 
 Time to close issues escalated past a Senior Manager
 



**Ratio policy adherence\-** 
 Company\-wide adherence to the 1:300 mapping ratio
 



**Senior Manager performance\-** 
 Both zones meeting their Senior Manager KRAs
 



**Education program reach\-** 
 % of parents reached by the quarterly education calendar
 



**Playbook adoption\-** 
 Standards (SLAs, tracker, ratio policy) applied consistently across both zones
 



*Note: Targets and review cadence for each KRA are being finalised by the function.* 




  





**Who We're Looking For** 



* 10–14 years overall experience, including several years managing managers or running a multi\-location, relationship\- or trust\-facing function
* Has personally built or meaningfully reshaped a relationship/customer\-experience playbook — not only inherited and maintained one
* Comfortable being the final escalation point on sensitive, emotionally\-charged, or reputation\-sensitive issues
* Can represent the function clearly in a review with leadership and own a company\-wide number
* Still operates hands\-on — will personally review a hard case, not only a dashboard
* Experience managing managers — has led team leads or regional managers, not only frontline staff



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience specifically in higher education, ed\-tech, or family/parent\-facing operations

 This is currently the function's senior\-most role; a strong incumbent grows the scope of the function itself — more zones, a larger bench, a deeper education program — as NIAT scales.

title: Snabbit - Director - Customer Experience
description:
**About Snabbit**
**Director \- Customer Experience**
 Snabbit is building the future of on\-ground service operations by solving for high\-quality, reliable workforce supply at scale. We operate at the intersection of customer demand, workforce supply, technology, and operational excellence, with a sharp focus on delivering consistent, high\-quality service at the last mile.
   

  

 As we scale across cities and categories, customer experience is a core differentiator for Snabbit. We are looking for a Director \- Customer Experience to build and own the next generation of CX \- ensuring every customer interaction, from booking to service completion and beyond, is seamless, reliable, and delightful.
   

  

**The Role**
 As the Director \- Customer Experience, you will own the overall customer experience charter at Snabbit across the customer journey.
   

  

 You will be responsible for building a scalable, data\-driven CX organisation that proactively identifies customer pain points, improves resolution and service quality, and works closely with Product, Operations, Technology, Marketing and Supply teams to drive customer satisfaction and retention.
   

  

 This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, operational rigour, customer obsession and strong execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the Customer Experience Charter:
* Define and own the overall CX strategy aligned with Snabbit's business and growth objectives.
* Own key CX metrics including CSAT, NPS, complaint rate, resolution time, repeat rate, cancellation rate and customer retention.
* Build a strong understanding of customer behaviour, expectations and pain points across the entire service journey.
* Establish mechanisms to continuously identify and eliminate recurring customer issues.
* Build a Scalable CX Organisation:
* Build and lead a high\-performing customer experience team across customer support, quality, escalation management and CX operations.
* Design scalable processes, SOPs, workflows and governance mechanisms as Snabbit expands across cities.
* Build the right balance between human intervention, automation and technology\-led resolution.
* Establish clear SLAs and performance standards across all customer touchpoints.
* Improve End\-to\-End Customer Journey:
* Own the customer journey from booking \- service confirmation \- partner arrival \- service delivery \- payment \- post\-service experience.
* Identify friction points and work with relevant teams to improve the overall experience.
* Create structured feedback loops between customers, operations and product teams.
* Drive initiatives to reduce customer effort and improve service reliability.
* Drive Customer Insights \& Product Improvements:
* Build a strong customer insights engine using complaints, feedback, support interactions, NPS/CSAT and behavioural data.
* Partner with Product and Technology teams to translate customer pain points into product and process improvements.
* Identify recurring issues and drive root\-cause analysis rather than simply solving individual tickets.
* Influence product roadmap through strong customer and business insights.
* Partner Closely with Operations \& Supply:
* Work closely with City Operations and Supply teams to improve service quality and reliability.
* Identify operational drivers behind customer complaints and build corrective mechanisms.
* Create feedback loops for service partners to improve quality and customer handling.
* Drive accountability across functions for customer experience outcomes.
* Build a Data\-Driven CX Culture:
* Establish dashboards and reporting mechanisms for real\-time visibility into CX performance.
* Analyse trends across city, category, service partner, issue type and customer cohort.
* Develop early\-warning mechanisms to identify potential customer experience deterioration.
* Use data to prioritise high\-impact interventions and measure their business impact.
* Customer Retention \& Business Impact:
* Go beyond ticket resolution and build CX as a lever for retention, repeat usage and customer lifetime value.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer trust, loyalty and frequency.
* Quantify the business impact of CX initiatives and continuously improve ROI.
* Build differentiated experiences that strengthen Snabbit's customer proposition.


**What We're Looking For**
* 10 \- 15\+ years of experience in Customer Experience, Customer Operations, Customer Success, Consumer Operations or related functions.
* Experience leading large\-scale CX/customer operations in a high\-growth consumer internet, marketplace, hyperlocal, services or technology business.
* Strong experience in building and scaling CX teams, processes and operating mechanisms.
* Proven ability to work cross\-functionally with Product, Technology, Operations, Analytics and Business teams.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a data\-first approach.
* Experience using technology and automation to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Strong understanding of customer metrics such as NPS, CSAT, FCR, AHT, complaint rate, resolution time and retention.
* Ability to operate effectively in a high\-ambiguity, fast\-paced startup environment.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management and team\-building skills.


**What Success Looks Like**
* A significant improvement in customer satisfaction and retention.
* Reduction in customer complaints and repeat contacts.
* Faster and more effective issue resolution.
* Improved service reliability and consistency across cities.
* A scalable CX operating model that can support Snabbit's rapid growth.
* Stronger integration between Customer Experience, Product and Operations.
* CX becoming a measurable competitive advantage for Snabbit.


**Why This Role Matters**
 At Snabbit, the customer doesn't just experience an app \- they experience the entire service journey on the ground.
   

  

 This role will be critical in ensuring that as Snabbit scales, speed does not come at the cost of quality. The Director \- CX will have the opportunity to build the systems, team and culture that define what an exceptional Snabbit customer experience looks like.

* Partner with sales, marketing, and cross\-functional engineering teams to engage with C\-level clients in pre\-sales meetings and conferences. Represent the corporate brand and lead the promotion of Data Center Solutions to capture CSP, NCP, and enterprise cloud business.

 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering discipline; computer science, computer engineering or electrical engineering is preferred
   

  

* Good to Strong experience with data center infrastructure and comprehensive knowledge of data center facilities
* Strong experience in networking topology and architecture is preferred
* Excellent communication skills and business sense required
* Minimum 16 years related experience with Compute/Storage Server or Data Center or IT Infrastructure experience desired
* Strong background and experience with x86, HPC, Cloud and/or GPU\-based server architecture is highly preferred
* Proven ability to autonomously architect comprehensive technical solution proposals, translating complex AI/HPC requirements into a precise, integration\-ready hardware proposal. This requires ensuring seamless interoperability across core subsystems while optimizing solution is highly preferred
* Solid HW system expertise and diagnostics skills
* Familiarity with Firmware, Linux, Windows and virtualization platforms is a plus
* Strong technical communication and leadership skills to lead investigations with engineers of multiple disciplines
* Individuals must be able to work effectively in a high\-pressure environment

title: Growth Manager - Enterprise Growth (Digital Commerce)
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 GobbleCube is an agentic growth operating system designed to help brands scale profitably across digital marketplaces. Founded in November 2022 by the ex\- core team of Blinkit, the platform went live commercially from private beta in September 2024\.
 



  





 Since then, GobbleCube has scaled rapidly, supporting 600\+ brands across enterprise and D2C, growing revenue 10X, and onboarding 45 of India’s largest CPG enterprises in just the last 9 months, including HUL, Nivea, Tata Consumer Products, ITC, Godrej, Beiersdorf, MTR, L’Oréal, Hershey’s, and many more.
 



  





 As commerce becomes more distributed and hyperlocal, GobbleCube is building agentic solutions to help brands navigate complexity in real time, across visibility, performance marketing, supply chain, and growth strategy. Headquartered in Gurugram, the company supports brands across India, MENA, and LATAM.
 



  





**About the role** 




 India's largest CPG brands do business worth hundreds of crores every year on Quick Commerce platforms. They lose share for reasons invisible from a 360 dashboard: a dark\-store availability gap, a competitor outbidding them on a category keyword, a discount ladder that buys volume at the cost of contribution margin.
 



 GobbleCube finds those reasons. Your job is to walk into the brand's boardroom, tell the CXO what is happening, recommend what to do about it, and get a room of senior people who might disagree to commit to a decision.
 



  





**What this role is not** 




 This is not a marketing growth role. No funnel, no CAC, no acquisition budget, and no performance campaigns to run. If you are a growth marketer, this isn't the job you want.
 



 This is also not a traditional Customer Success role. You are not measured on tickets closed, QBR decks delivered, or logins. Nobody here will ask you to "drive adoption."
 



 The closest analogue is what an MBB consultant does for a CPG client, except you do it under a productised strategic consulting environment, for India's largest CPG brands at once, with a product doing the work in the background.
 



  





**What you will actually do** 



* Run regular strategic connects (online and in\-person both) with each account's senior leadership. Not a status update. A point of view on their business, and recommendations backed by data, to drive their business objectives.
* Diagnose why an output metric moved: market share, offtake, margin, etc. Decompose it into availability, visibility, discounting and supply chain. Then decide what is worth acting on.
* Take a difficult position to a senior stakeholder and make it land. Frequently the recommendation is "stop doing the thing that makes your number this month."
* Build the quarterly impact story: problem identified, action recommended, outcome achieved, revenue or share impact, in the brand's own numbers.
* Find the next business problem worth solving, prove it in a pilot, and convert it into expansion revenue.
* Turn what worked on one account into a repeatable SOP or a product requirement, so the ninth account does not need a ninth person.



  





**Who you will be in the room with** 




 CMOs, Sales Heads, E\-commerce Heads, Supply Chain Heads, occasionally CFOs. They are senior, have limited face time, and each of them wants something different from the same budget. Their KAMs and brand managers are your day\-to\-day.
 



  





**What makes this different from consulting** 




 The dogwork is automated. RCA, data pulls, anomaly detection, competitive tracking, and most of the analysis run through the product and agentic workflows in the backend. You are deciding what the analysis means, what to recommend (the right action at the right time), and how to get it approved. That is also the bar. When the analysis is free, the analysis is not the value. Your judgement is.
 



  





**How you will be measured** 



* Net revenue retention across your portfolio. Zero downsell, plus expansion.
* A documented, quantified impact story per account per quarter.
* Pilot\-to\-conversion rate on expansion modules.
* Qualified expansion opportunities briefed to GTM with a written business case.
* No account goes Amber without you flagging it first.
* Strategic connect coverage and conversation quality across your book.



  





**You will do well here if** 



* You can hold your position when a senior stakeholder tells you your data is wrong, without either backing down or repeating "the data says so."
* You are comfortable being the least senior person in the room and still owning the recommendation.
* You end conversations with an owner, a decision, a metric and a review date, rather than with an action\-items list.
* You would rather be right in eight weeks than agreeable today.



  





**You will struggle here if** 



* You need a clean brief before you can start.
* You want analysis to be your main contribution.
* Confrontation with senior stakeholders drains you.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's from a Tier 1 institute (IIT, IIM, ISB and equivalent).
* 3\-7 years in management consulting, strategy and ops, growth, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS company. Consumer or retail exposure is a strong plus.
* Structured problem\-solving you can demonstrate live, not just describe.
* Presentation and stakeholder management skills at CXO level.
* Strong Excel. Enough SQL to interrogate an analysis and find the hole in it.

 The ideal candidate will have 12–18 years of progressive experience in post\-sales service delivery, field service, technical services or infrastructure service operations, preferably within enterprise technology, data center, server, storage, HPC or AI infrastructure environments. An engineering degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline is preferred.

title: Lender Relationship Manager (Credit)
description:
**About Recur Club** 




  





 Recur Club is an AI\-native debt marketplace transforming how startups and SMEs access growth capital. Founded in 2021, we leverage real\-time business data and proprietary underwriting technology to connect high\-quality businesses with the right lenders\-enabling faster, smarter, and non\-dilutive financing.
 



  





 We raised $50M in Series A funding, led by Info Edge Ventures and Village Global, with participation from prominent global investors including Y Combinator, Titan Capital, and R8 Capital further accelerating our mission to make capital more accessible, faster, and more efficient for growing businesses.
 



  





 Powering this ecosystem is AICA (AI Credit Assistant) — our in\-house AI\-led infrastructure enabling faster underwriting, smarter risk assessment, and seamless credit decisioning at scale.
 



 We are also the force behind Bharat Ke Super Founders — India’s premier startup show, where bold
 



 founders pitch their ideas to top investors for real capital, with a ₹100 crore investment pool backing the next wave of entrepreneurs. With 2,000\+ businesses served and ₹3,000\+ crore in capital disbursed, we’re building the future of financing for growing companies.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  




* As a Lender Relationships Manager (Credit), you will own lender engagement and case progression once a
* loan application has been logged in. While our operations team handles the login process, you will work
* directly with lender relationship managers, partnership teams, and credit decision\-makers to secure
* sanctions and drive disbursals.
* This is not a loan\-processing role. It requires someone who can understand a lender\&\#39;s credit concerns, build
* a credible case for reconsideration, negotiate justified deviations, and take ownership of moving
* transactions forward.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Drive sanctions and disbursals: Own post\-login case progression across lenders, proactively follow up with relevant stakeholders, resolve bottlenecks, and keep cases moving towards closure.
* Lead credit discussions and reconsiderations: Review rejected or stalled applications, understand the underlying credit concerns, and present supporting information and risk mitigants to seek reconsideration \- not simply resubmit the same file.
* Negotiate deviations and loan terms: Work with lender credit teams to secure justified policy deviations through the appropriate approvals. Negotiate competitive interest rates, suitable ticket sizes, and longer tenures based on the borrower;s profile.
* Own lender relationships across levels: Build and manage relationships with lender relationship managers, partnership teams, regional and zonal teams, and credit heads. Identify and engage the right decision\-makers to resolve case\-specific issues.
* Apply lender\-policy knowledge: Maintain a strong understanding of each lender\&\#39;s eligibility criteria, credit policies, negative lists, and serviceable pincodes. Use this knowledge to assess lender fit and identify potential approval challenges.
* Coordinate internal resolution: Work closely with sales and operations teams to address lender queries, obtain supporting information, and resolve requirements that could delay sanction or disbursal.
* Maintain accurate case tracking: Keep every live case updated with its current status, pending requirements, next steps, and expected timelines. Flag delays and risks proactively and communicate outcomes transparently.



  





**Required Experience and Skills** 




  




* 4\-8 years of relevant experience in business loans or unsecured business loans within an NBFC or fintech.
* Experience in credit management, lender or bank relations, or credit/backend leadership, with direct exposure to lender credit teams.
* Demonstrated experience in converting logged\-in applications into sanctions and disbursals.
* A track record of securing reconsideration of rejected cases through substantive credit discussions and supporting evidence.
* Strong knowledge of lender policies, negative lists, pincode eligibility, credit assessment criteria, and deviation requirements.
* The ability to assess borrower profiles, explain credit strengths and risks, and present appropriate mitigants.
* Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, follow\-through, and case\-tracking skills.



  





**What We Look For** 




  





 You take ownership beyond follow\-ups. You know when to challenge a rejection, when to escalate, and
 



 when a case is unlikely to proceed. You are persistent in pursuing viable cases while respecting lender credit requirements.
 



 You also communicate honestly. When a case slips or a commitment is at risk, you flag it early, explain the issue, and take responsibility for the next steps.
 



  





**Working Environment** 




 This is a fast\-paced, execution\-focused role where consistent effort is expected throughout the month \- not only at month\-end. You should be comfortable managing multiple live cases, navigating lender escalations, and being accountable for disbursals.

The role ensures high customer satisfaction, operational excellence, service revenue growth, and compliance with safety and quality standards.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Service Operations Management
   

  

* Lead and manage the service team responsible for installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, breakdown support, and retrofit projects for HVAC chiller systems.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and critical equipment outages.
* Monitor service KPIs, response times, and customer service levels.
* Plan and allocate manpower, tools, and resources effectively.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Provide technical expertise for applied HVAC systems, including:
+ Centrifugal Chillers
+ Screw Chillers
+ Air\-Cooled Chillers
+ Water\-Cooled Chillers
+ Cooling Towers
+ Pumps and Hydronic Systems
+ Building Management Systems (BMS)
+ Chiller Plant Optimization Solutions

* Support root cause analysis for recurring equipment failures.
* Guide field engineers on complex troubleshooting and repair activities.


 Customer Relationship Management
   

  

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customers, consultants, facility managers, and contractors.
* Conduct regular customer reviews and service performance meetings.
* Identify opportunities for service contract renewals, upgrades, retrofits, and modernization projects.


 Business Growth \& Revenue Management
   

  

* Drive annual maintenance contract (AMC) and comprehensive maintenance contract (CMC) renewals.
* Achieve service revenue and profitability targets.

 Team Management
   

  

* Recruit, train, mentor, and develop service engineers and technicians.

title: Business Head  – Government Business & Strategic Projects
description:
**Business Head – Government Business \& Strategic Projects** 




  






 Company: Intozi Tech Pvt. Ltd.
 





 Location: Delhi NCR / Gurugram
 





 Experience: 20\+ Years
 





 Function: Government Business, Sales \& Strategic Projects
 




  





**Role Overview** 





 Intozi is looking for a senior leader with 20\+ years of experience in Government business and large technology/infrastructure projects to lead our Government vertical.
 





 This is not purely a sales or relationship\-management position. We are looking for someone who has handled the complete end\-to\-end lifecycle of large Government projects—from identifying and shaping an opportunity to tendering, order closure, project execution, acceptance, payment collection and long\-term account management.
 





 The candidate should also have a strong network and established relationships across Government departments, Smart Cities, Safe Cities, Police, Traffic Police, Municipal Corporations/MCD, Defence, PSUs, consultants and System Integrators.
 




  





**Key Areas of Experience** 





 The candidate should preferably have worked on large projects involving:
 



* Smart City \& Safe City
* CCTV Surveillance \& Video Analytics
* Integrated Command \& Control Centres (ICCC)
* Intelligent Traffic Management Systems (ITMS)
* Traffic Enforcement \& e\-Challan
* Police \& Homeland Security
* Municipal Corporations / MCD / Urban Local Bodies
* Defence \& Critical Infrastructure
* AI\-based Video Analytics
* Networking, Data Centre, Cloud and ICT infrastructure
* Large Government system\-integration projects



  





**End\-to\-End Project Ownership** 





 The candidate must have hands\-on experience across the complete Government project lifecycle, including:
 





 1\. Opportunity Identification \& Account Development
 





 Identify upcoming Government projects, budgets and opportunities well before the tender is published.
 





 Build relationships with Government decision\-makers, consultants, PMCs, Smart City SPVs, Police departments, municipal bodies and other stakeholders.
 





 2\. Requirement Understanding \& Solution Conceptualisation
 





 Understand the customer's operational requirements and work with technical teams to develop the overall solution architecture, scope, BoQ and implementation approach.
 





 3\. Pre\-RFP \& Tender Shaping
 





 Engage with customers, consultants and ecosystem partners during DPR, RFP and specification\-development stages.
 





 Understand technical specifications, eligibility criteria, PQ requirements, SLAs and commercial conditions.
 





 4\. Tender \& Bid Management
 





 Take ownership of bid strategy, including:
 



* Tender qualification and Go/No\-Go
* Technical and commercial bid strategy
* OEM and partner selection
* Consortium/JV strategy where required
* MAF and compliance requirements
* Technical specifications and BoQ
* Commercial costing
* Competition analysis
* Pre\-bid meetings and clarifications
* Technical presentations and demonstrations




 5\. Commercial Negotiation \& Order Closure
 





 Lead commercial negotiations with customers, SIs, partners and other stakeholders through final contract/PO closure.
 





 The candidate should understand payment terms, PBG/EMD, LD clauses, SLA penalties, warranty, AMC and other contractual obligations.
 





 6\. Project Execution \& Stakeholder Management
 





 Remain actively involved after order closure and work closely with project and technical teams for successful execution.
 





 Experience should include coordination with:
 



* Government customers
* System Integrators
* OEMs
* Consultants/PMCs
* Project teams
* Subcontractors
* Site teams and other stakeholders




 The candidate should understand implementation challenges associated with large multi\-location Government technology projects.
 





 7\. Testing, Acceptance \& Go\-Live
 





 Experience managing project milestones including:
 



* FAT
* Site deployment
* Integration
* UAT
* SAT
* Go\-Live
* Customer acceptance
* SLA compliance
* Project handover




 8\. Billing, Collection \& Project Closure
 





 The candidate should understand the commercial lifecycle beyond winning the order, including:
 



* Milestone billing
* Customer acceptance documentation
* Invoice approvals
* Payment follow\-up
* Receivables management
* PBG/retention release
* Project closure




 9\. AMC \& Account Expansion
 





 Develop the account beyond the initial project through AMC, additional licenses, capacity expansion, new use cases and additional projects.
 




  





**Candidate Profile** 





 We are specifically looking for someone who:
 



* Has 20\+ years of experience, preferably with significant Government/PSU exposure.
* Has personally managed large Government projects from opportunity identification through final payment/closure.
* Has strong relationships across Smart Cities, Safe Cities, Police, Traffic Police, Municipal Corporations/MCD, Defence and Government departments.
* Understands both sales and project execution, rather than having experience only in tender participation.
* Has experience working with large System Integrators, OEMs, EPC players, consultants and PMCs.
* Understands Government tendering, GeM, RFPs, PQ criteria, consortiums, contracts, PBG/EMD, SLAs and payment processes.
* Can engage with senior Government officials as well as technical/project teams.
* Has experience handling large\-value, multi\-stakeholder and multi\-location projects.
* Has strong commercial negotiation and stakeholder\-management capabilities.
* Can take complete revenue, order\-book, execution and collection responsibility for strategic Government accounts.



  





**Preferred Previous Roles** 





 Candidates may currently or previously have held positions such as:
 





 VP – Government Business
 





 Business Head – Government \& PSU
 





 Director – Government Business
 





 National Head – Government \& Smart Cities
 





 Business Head – Smart \& Safe Cities
 





 Government \& Defence Business Head
 





 Strategic Projects Head
 




  





**What We Are Looking For** 





 We are not looking only for a Government salesperson who can bring leads or participate in tenders.
 





 We are looking for a senior business leader who understands how a ₹10 Cr–₹100\+ Cr Government technology project moves through its entire lifecycle:
 





 Opportunity → Customer Engagement → Solution → DPR/RFP → Tender → Bid → Negotiation → PO/Contract → Execution → Integration → UAT/SAT → Go\-Live → Billing → Collection → AMC/Expansion
 





 The person should have the relationships to open doors, the commercial experience to win projects, and the execution understanding to take responsibility until successful project and commercial closure.

title: NOC Manager
description:
**Business Unit:**
==================


Cubic Transportation Systems**Company Details:**
====================


When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
  

  

We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.**Job Details:**
================


CTS is seeking a hands\-on Network Operations Center (NOC) Manager to build and operate a centralized, global 24x7 NOC based in Hyderabad, India. This role reports to the VP of Operations and is accountable for establishing the people, processes, and performance required to support more than 50 global customer programs delivering transit fare collection and payment card processing services.


The NOC Manager will lead a team of approximately 40–60 Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC analysts operating around the clock, with defined escalation to Tier 3 engineering and regional field services teams. The role requires prior experience building or significantly maturing a 24x7 operations center and enforcing disciplined, repeatable operational practices aligned with ITIL 4, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS v4 operational monitoring expectations.

**Responsibilities**
====================


This is a build\-and\-operate leadership role responsible for end\-to\-end NOC effectiveness, including:

* Build and lead a centralized Hyderabad\-based NOC organization (40–60 staff) with Tier 1 and Tier 2 roles and defined escalation to Tier 3 engineering and regional operations.
* Design and manage 24x7 shift coverage, staffing models, onboarding, training, coaching, and performance management.
* Establish and operate 24x7 monitoring and event management for networks, systems, cloud services, applications, and OT/edge devices supporting transit payments.
* Implement and enforce ITIL\-aligned Incident Management, including triage, severity assignment, escalation, major incident coordination, communications, and post\-incident review.
* Ensure continuous verification of operational controls including log management, monitoring coverage, backup success, recovery testing, change control discipline, and DR readiness.
* Ensure NOC operations support PCI DSS v4 monitoring requirements and are executed in a manner consistent with ISO 27001 operational control and evidence expectations.
* Lead operational response to emergent incidents, ensuring rapid containment, service restoration, and accurate executive and stakeholder communications.
* Define and maintain runbooks, SOPs, escalation matrices, and shift handover standards.
* Establish KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadences; drive continual improvement through trend analysis and postmortems.
* Coordinate closely with Security Operations (SOC) for escalation of operational anomalies with potential security implications.

**Essential Job Duties**
========================

* Operate a 24x7 NOC covering monitoring, performance and capacity management, incident management, logging, change coordination, backup verification, and DR readiness.
* Ensure rapid identification, escalation, and resolution of outages and degradations affecting customer\-facing payment and transit services.
* Lead major incident bridges and enforce structured communication and restoration validation.
* Ensure logging, monitoring, and telemetry failures are treated as operational risks and remediated with urgency.
* Produce and maintain incident records, reports, and operational evidence suitable for audit and compliance review.

**General Duties and Responsibilities**
=======================================

* Operate effectively under limited supervision in a high\-availability, mission\-critical environment.
* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and consistency in process execution and documentation.
* Communicate effectively in English, including written incident updates and executive\-level operational summaries.
* Motivate and lead teams across multiple shifts, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.

title: Senior Engineering Manager – Service Transformation & Platform Capabilities
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!


Our Values

**Best Life**


We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**


We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**


From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.


**What You'll Do**

**Lead the service transformation teams**


Build and manage small, high\-ownership squads responsible for converging duplicated product capabilities into shared, domain\-oriented services. Own the delivery cadence, quality, and predictability of a multi\-year transformation executed in steady quarterly increments with clear boundaries, owners, and cutover plans.

**Turn architecture into shipped services**


Partner with principal engineers and staff engineers to translate target architecture, service boundaries, migration seams, and compatibility strategies into sequenced, executable plans your teams can implement safely. Your job is to make the architecture real: prioritized, staffed, de\-risked, and delivered.

**Establish the base service tier**


Drive the standards for how shared services are designed, contracted, versioned, documented, and consumed, so that every ABC application — and the AI agents and partners building on top of them — can rely on one consistent capability layer. Ensure services are designed for both human and machine consumption from day one, with structured contracts that agents can use reliably.

**Protect compatibility and business continuity**


Convergence only counts if customers never feel it. Lead teams through incremental strangler\-style migrations, staged cutovers, dual\-running periods, and post\-cutover hypercare. Existing behavior, reporting, and integrations keep working until each consumer has safely moved.

**Modernize the application foundations**


Guide the movement of business logic out of legacy, database\-centric implementations into testable, cloud\-native services on our target stack. Retire duplicated builds, legacy dependencies, and aging infrastructure as consumers cut over.

**Raise the bar for engineering quality**


Build quality in as a system, not a stage. Establish a software\-factory approach where every change moves through automated validation loops — layered validators for scope, contracts, parity, runtime behavior, and user experience — that produce evidence of correctness rather than claims of completion. Design the pipeline so that failures are detected, diagnosed, and corrected in\-loop before work integrates, and so that each converged service ships with a durable, inspectable evidence trail. The goal is simple: ship quality software, quickly.

**Drive AI\-native ways of working**


Enable your engineers to use AI across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation. Turn promising individual uses into repeatable team practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio\-scale transformation.


Make AI the way your team works: engineers direct agents across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation, and the factory's validation gates — not manual inspection — prove every change correct. Turn what works into repeatable factory practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio\-scale transformation.

**Hire and grow strong engineers**


Recruit, coach, and develop engineers who are comfortable working across legacy code and modern service design. Set clear expectations, give honest feedback, and build a culture of ownership, craft, and follow\-through.

**Partner across the program**


Work closely with product, program leadership, principal engineering, SRE, security, and data teams to sequence domains by customer impact and technical dependency, surface risk early, and keep cross\-team commitments visible and managed.

**What This Is Not**


This is not an architecture\-only or people\-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes — while your engineers own the code.


This is not a greenfield platform build. The value of this work is measured by safely converging live, revenue\-critical systems onto shared services, not by producing new frameworks. Decisions must balance long\-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.


This is not a big\-bang rebuild or a customer migration program. The transformation is evolutionary: systems stay releasable throughout, and customers experience better capabilities, not disruptive migration events.

**What You Bring**

**Proven engineering leadership**


Substantial experience leading backend or platform teams delivering complex, high\-throughput production systems, with direct accountability for delivery, quality, and team health.

**Service transformation depth**


Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, and defining domain boundaries, ownership models, and migration strategies within complex existing environments — and delivering those migrations to production.

**Credible backend and distributed\-systems fluency**


Enough hands\-on depth — in Java and Spring or comparable enterprise backend ecosystems — to review designs, ask the hard questions, spot risk in implementation plans, and unblock your teams. You don't need to write the code, but you need to earn the room.

**Migration safety instincts**


You understand compatibility strategies, staged rollout, data migration, dual\-running, rollback, and the operational realities of moving live traffic and data between systems while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.

**Quality and operational discipline**


You treat automated testing, code review, observability, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of how software gets built — and you hold that bar for your teams.

**People development**


You hire well, coach deliberately, develop engineers into stronger versions of themselves, and manage performance honestly and with care.

**Cross\-functional execution**


You create clarity across teams, communicate technical risk in business terms, sequence work against dependencies, and help stakeholders converge on decisions they can execute.

**An opportunity\-focused approach to AI\-assisted engineering**


You actively look for ways AI can expand your team's leverage across code comprehension, implementation, refactoring, test generation, and planning — and you help turn those into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.

**Bonus Points**


Experience modernizing large Java and Spring estates, including runtime and framework upgrades.


Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.


Experience delivering shared or platform services consumed by multiple product teams, including versioning, deprecation, and consumer migration done well.


Experience with cloud migrations (especially AWS) and decommissioning legacy infrastructure or data centers.


Experience designing APIs and services for agentic or LLM consumption (MCP or similar frameworks).


Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI coding assistants or agents in day\-to\-day engineering.

**What Success Looks Like**

**The base service tier becomes real**


Shared services ship on a steady, predictable cadence. Each is adopted across every in\-scope ABC application, and the duplicated product\-specific builds behind them are retired — reducing cost, complexity, and maintenance burden with every domain delivered.

**Convergence advances without destabilizing the business**


Every cutover has clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, safety controls, and hypercare. Customers never experience a migration event; they simply get a better, more consistent platform underneath the products they already use.

**The platform compounds**


New capabilities are built once and land everywhere. Products, AI agents, and partners all consume the same well\-governed capability layer, and each converged domain makes the next one faster and safer to deliver.

**The team gets stronger**


Engineers grow in scope and skill, quality practices become consistent, AI leverage becomes normal working practice, and the team becomes a model for how ABC delivers complex platform change.

**Why This Matters**


Everything ABC is building — the unified member experience, embedded AI, the agent ecosystem, and the open platform — stands on the shared service tier this role delivers. The transformation succeeds only if these services are well\-designed, safely landed, and genuinely adopted.


This role connects platform strategy with team leadership and hands\-on delivery. Done well, it turns a portfolio of parallel products into one platform: capabilities built once instead of three times, engineering effort shifted from duplication to innovation, and a foundation strong enough to carry everything ABC builds next.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. \#oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee \+ spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent\-in\-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers


At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.


About ABC Fitness


ABC Fitness is the \#1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data\-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.


From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Job Description**

**Senior Technical Project Manager \- Supply Digital Technology**

**Job Purpose / Overview**


This role exists to provide senior technical project management leadership for the Food \& Nutrition Supply Digital Technology portfolio, ensuring critical Supply DT initiatives are delivered with quality, pace, strong governance and clear business value.


The role will drive the delivery of digital and technology projects across key Supply capabilities, including Thema / Supply Data Foundations, Planning capabilities such as Blue Yonder, and Smart Manufacturing / Industry 4\.0 solutions.


The Senior Technical Project Manager will coordinate business, DT, data, architecture, security, vendor and delivery teams to move initiatives from concept through design, build, testing, deployment, transition and benefit realization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of Supply Digital Technology projects across Food \& Nutrition, covering data foundations, planning, manufacturing and analytics capabilities.
* Manage project delivery across the full lifecycle, including demand shaping, business case support, concept and initiation, design, build, test, deployment, hypercare, project closure and transition to support.
* Drive delivery of Supply DT initiatives such as Thema / Supply Data Foundations, Blue Yonder planning enhancements, and Smart Manufacturing / Industry 4\.0 capabilities, ensuring each initiative has clear scope, milestones, dependencies, risks and success measures.
* Coordinate internal teams, third\-party vendors, system integrators, data partners and business stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within agreed budget and to expected quality standards.
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, RAID logs, dependency maps, governance materials, financial tracking and status reporting for senior DT and business stakeholders.
* Translate business objectives and Supply pain points into actionable delivery plans, working closely with Supply leaders, Business Partners, Product Owners, Data teams, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, GDO and functional SMEs.
* Ensure technical delivery activities are aligned with architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, integration, service introduction and operational support standards.
* Partner with Supply business stakeholders to support business readiness, UAT planning, deployment preparation, adoption tracking and post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Manage delivery risks and issues proactively, escalating where required and driving clear decisions through appropriate governance forums.
* Support vendor and partner management, including input to Statements of Work, delivery plans, resource models, deliverable acceptance and performance management.
* Ensure project documentation is complete, controlled and suitable for transition to support teams, including business process documentation, technical design artefacts, testing evidence, cutover plans and operational handover materials.
* Work with Finance and PMO stakeholders to support budget planning, capitalization requirements, cost tracking, forecast updates and benefits realization.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery ways of working, including stronger use of PMX, agile/hybrid delivery methods, lessons learned, reusable templates and project governance discipline.
* Build strong relationships across global and regional Supply teams to ensure delivery plans reflect business priorities, local deployment realities and global template requirements.
* Act as a senior delivery leader within the Supply DT team, providing coaching, structure and delivery discipline to project teams, vendors and junior project resources where required

 **Context and Scope**

  

The role operates within the Food \& Nutrition Supply Digital Technology team, partnering closely with Supply business leaders, regional business partners, functional SMEs, DT delivery teams, Data \& AI, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, GDO, Finance, PMO and external vendors.


The portfolio includes initiatives that enable Supply Chain visibility, planning effectiveness, data\-driven decision making, factory performance improvement and digital adoption across Food \& Nutrition. These include data and analytics foundations through Thema, planning capabilities involving Blue Yonder, and Smart Manufacturing capabilities such as connected worker, factory data, operational visibility and predictive insights.


The role must balance strategic ambition with practical delivery constraints, ensuring projects are planned realistically, governed effectively and delivered in a way that creates sustainable business value. The role will work across regions and functions, often influencing without direct authority and managing delivery through a combination of internal resources, vendors, contractors and cross\-functional teams.


The Senior Technical Project Manager will be expected to operate comfortably with senior stakeholders, manage ambiguity, resolve delivery blockers, and bring structure to complex initiatives that span process, data, technology, integration and change

**Education \& Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Management or a related discipline.
* Project Management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM or equivalent is preferred.
* Agile, Scrum, SAFe or hybrid delivery certification is desirable.
* Additional knowledge or certification in Supply Chain planning, data platforms, manufacturing systems or cloud/data technologies would be advantageous

**Knowledge / Experience**


Required:

* Experience delivering technology projects, with significant experience in digital transformation, Supply Chain, manufacturing, planning, data or enterprise technology environments.
* Proven experience as a senior Project Manager, Technical Project Manager, Delivery Manager or equivalent role leading cross\-functional technology delivery.
* Strong experience managing full project lifecycle delivery, including planning, governance, budget tracking, RAID management, stakeholder reporting, testing, deployment, hypercare and transition to support.
* Experience delivering projects involving complex stakeholder groups across business, DT, data, architecture, security, vendors and operations.
* Strong understanding of Supply Chain processes, ideally including planning, S\&OP, manufacturing, inventory, logistics, data and analytics.
* Experience working with or around planning platforms such as Blue Yonder, SAP planning capabilities or equivalent enterprise Supply Chain systems.
* Experience with data and analytics delivery, including data platforms, dashboards, reporting solutions, data governance, data quality and Power BI or equivalent analytics tools.
* Experience delivering manufacturing, Smart Manufacturing, Industry 4\.0, connected worker, factory data, automation or operational technology initiatives is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to manage third\-party vendors, system integrators and delivery partners, including delivery governance, SoW input, milestone tracking and deliverable acceptance.
* Strong financial discipline, including budget tracking, forecasting, capitalization awareness and benefits realization.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical delivery topics into clear business\-facing updates and senior stakeholder messages.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, prioritization and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to work globally across cultures, time zones and business functions.
