title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Portfolio Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
   

  

 You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
   

  

 This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at\-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re\-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow\-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.


**What You’ll Need**
* Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
* Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
* Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
* Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
* Excellent organization, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property\-management platform, or workflow\-management system.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
* Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work full\-time during Eastern Time business hours.
* Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.


 Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring\-service industry will be considered.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.
   

  

 Who Will Succeed
   

  

 The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.
   

  

 You are client\-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.
   

  

**Compensation**
 The annual compensation range is
 **C$30,000–C$36,000** 
 , based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre\-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

title: Account Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
   

  

 Account Manager – Marketing Clients
   

  

 Company: BingeAt Media LLP
   

 Department: Client Servicing / Marketing
   

 Location: Kalyan / Mumbai
   

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

 Experience: Minimum 3years in Account Management, Client Servicing, Digital Marketing or Agency Operations
   

  

 About the Role
   

  

 BingeAt Media LLP is looking for an Account Manager to manage day\-to\-day relationships with marketing clients and coordinate the successful execution of their marketing requirements.
   

  

 The Account Manager will be responsible for understanding client requirements, planning deliverables, coordinating with internal teams, maintaining communication, monitoring project progress, and ensuring client satisfaction and retention.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 1\. Client Management
   

  

 \- Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
   

 \- Understand client business objectives, requirements and expectations.
   

 \- Maintain regular communication through calls, meetings, email and approved communication channels.
   

 \- Build strong, professional and long\-term client relationships.
   

 \- Handle client feedback, concerns and escalations professionally.
   

  

 2\. Marketing Project Coordination
   

  

 \- Coordinate with Social Media, Performance Marketing, Creative, Content, Video and Web teams.
   

 \- Prepare and communicate briefs clearly to internal teams.
   

 \- Track project timelines, deliverables and approvals.
   

 \- Ensure deliverables are completed as per agreed scope and timelines.
   

 \- Follow up internally to avoid delays and bottlenecks.
   

  

 3\. Strategy \& Client Understanding
   

  

 \- Understand the client's business, target audience, competitors and marketing objectives.
   

 \- Participate in marketing planning and review meetings.
   

 \- Assist the team in developing monthly marketing plans, campaigns and content strategies.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve campaign and marketing performance.
   

  

 4\. Reporting \& Reviews
   

  

 \- Coordinate monthly/periodic performance reports.
   

 \- Present campaign updates and key performance metrics to clients.
   

 \- Maintain records of client feedback, approvals, pending items and action points.
   

 \- Conduct regular account reviews with clients where required.
   

  

 5\. Client Retention \& Growth
   

  

 \- Monitor client satisfaction and identify potential retention risks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for additional services based on client requirements.
   

 \- Coordinate cross\-selling/up\-selling of relevant services such as:
   

 \- Social Media Management
   

 \- Performance Marketing
   

 \- Branding \& Creative
   

 \- Website Development
   

 \- Video Production
   

 \- SEO
   

 \- Lead Generation
   

 \- Content Marketing
   

 \- Coordinate internally for proposals and quotations for additional requirements.
   

  

 6\. Account Administration
   

  

 \- Maintain updated client information, requirements, deliverables and communication records in the company's systems.
   

 \- Ensure proper documentation of approvals and important decisions.
   

 \- Follow BingeAt Media LLP's internal project management and documentation processes.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Excellent verbal and written communication.
   

 \- Strong client\-handling and relationship\-management skills.
   

 \- Good understanding of digital marketing and social media.
   

 \- Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
   

 \- Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines.
   

 \- Problem\-solving and escalation\-management ability.
   

 \- Good presentation and meeting skills.
   

 \- Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into actionable briefs.
   

 \- Working knowledge of Google Workspace and project\-management tools.
   

 \- Basic understanding of marketing metrics and campaign performance.
   

  

 Preferred Qualifications
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication or a related field.
   

 \- Prior experience in a digital marketing / advertising / creative agency.
   

 \- Experience handling multiple marketing accounts will be preferred.
   

  

 Performance Expectations
   

  

 The Account Manager will be expected to maintain:
   

  

 \- High client satisfaction and retention.
   

 \- Timely completion of client deliverables.
   

 \- Clear and proactive client communication.
   

 \- Accurate internal coordination and follow\-ups.
   

 \- Strong understanding of assigned client accounts.
   

 \- Identification of opportunities for account growth.
   

 \- Proper documentation and project tracking.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 \- Client Retention
   

 \- Client Satisfaction
   

 \- Timely Delivery of Projects
   

 \- Client Communication \& Response Management
   

 \- Account Growth / Cross\-Selling
   

 \- Quality of Briefs \& Internal Coordination
   

 \- Reduction in Client Escalations
   

 \- Timely Collection/Follow\-up coordination where assigned
   

  

 Reporting
   

  

 Reports To: General Manager / Business Head / Assigned Team Leader
   

  

 Works Closely With:
   

 Creative Team • Social Media Team • Performance Marketing Team • Content Team • Video Team • Web Development Team • Management
   

  

 Candidate Profile
   

  

 We are looking for someone who is proactive, organised, client\-focused and commercially aware, with the ability to manage relationships while ensuring that the internal team delivers work efficiently.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should not merely take instructions from clients—they should understand the client's business, anticipate requirements, coordinate solutions and contribute to the growth of the account.

 3 – 5 years

 Full\-time

 Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships
 



**Key Stakeholders:** 
 SVP, Life Sciences Partnerships (Business Head); Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships; Strategy and Growth Team
 








  





**About Us** 





 Qure.ai
 
 is a global healthtech company using artificial intelligence to improve disease detection and patient outcomes at scale. Our solutions are deployed across hospitals, diagnostic networks, and public health programs worldwide.
 



 Today, our technology has impacted
 **40M\+ lives** 
 across
 **105\+ countries** 
 , deployed across
 **5,200\+ sites** 
 , and powered by one of the world’s largest real\-world medical imaging datasets. With
 **26 FDA\-cleared indications** 
 , we are helping shape the future of AI\-driven healthcare.
 



  





  





**The Opportunity** 




 Qure.ai’s AI solutions are already embedded in the workflows of leading pharmaceutical companies such as AstraZeneca, Merck, Lilly and J\&J. As pharma continues to be our fastest\-growing business in the US, this is a field\-facing, high\-ownership role at the forefront of driving our next phase of growth.
 



  





 You’ll report to the Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships, who leads partnership strategy and deal development, and work closely with our Strategy and Growth Team, who support account planning, commercial collateral, and deal execution. You'll also collaborate with the SVP, Life Sciences Partnerships, who leads the business globally. In this role, you'll own the field\-building pipeline, developing strategic customer relationships, and driving opportunities from initial engagement through to successful closure.
 



 This role is designed as a high\-growth commercial path, with opportunities to take ownership of strategic accounts and grow into senior partnerships as the business scales.
 



  





 If you’re 3–5 years into a career in healthcare consulting, life sciences, digital health, or a client\-facing commercial role, and are eager to build strategic relationships, create new business opportunities, and thrive in a fast\-paced, field\-facing environment, this role is built for you.
 



  





  





**What You’ll Own \& Drive** 



* Build and manage a pipeline of pharma partnership opportunities across oncology, cardiology, respiratory and other priority therapeutic areas.
* Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders – including Medical Affairs, Market Access, Digital Health and Commercial leads \- within strategic accounts including AstraZeneca, Merck, Lilly and J\&J, while expanding into new pharma logos.
* Represent Qure.ai at industry conferences, customer meetings and life sciences events across the US \- identifying new opportunities and converting engagements into qualified pipeline.
* Partner with the Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships to shape partnership strategies and commercial opportunities by translating Qure.ai's clinical and AI capabilities into compelling value propositions.
* Collaborate closely with the Strategy and Growth team to develop account plans, proposals, presentations, and commercial collateral that support successful customer engagements.
* Own the day\-to\-day commercial execution, including prospecting, outreach, meeting cadence, CRM management, follow\-ups, forecasting, and pipeline reporting.
* Develop a strong understanding of priority disease areas, clinical workflows, and Qure.ai's AI solutions to engage credibly with physicians, scientists, and pharmaceutical stakeholders.
* Drive opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution, partnering with the Senior Director on commercial structuring, negotiations, and final approvals.








  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Within your first 6–12 months, you will have:
 


* Built and actively managed a qualified pipeline of strategic pharmaceutical partnership opportunities, with accurate forecasting and CRM reporting.
* Represented Qure.ai at major industry conferences and customer events, establishing meaningful relationships with key stakeholders across strategic pharmaceutical accounts.
* Successfully progressed at least one partnership opportunity from initial engagement through to contract execution, in collaboration with the Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships.
* Developed sufficient expertise across multiple disease areas and clinical workflows to independently lead introductory customer discussions and identify partnership opportunities.
* Established yourself as a trusted commercial partner through well\-developed account plans, disciplined pipeline management, and reliable execution



  





  





**Core Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 3–5 years of experience in strategy or management consulting, healthcare, life sciences, digital health, or pharmaceutical commercial roles, or another high\-performance, client\-facing environment.
* Bachelor's degree required; an MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Demonstrated success in building and managing client relationships, driving commercial opportunities, and delivering against commitments with a high degree of ownership.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders across pharmaceutical organizations.
* Strong analytical and learning agility, with the ability to quickly understand new disease areas, clinical workflows, and AI\-driven healthcare solutions.
* Willingness to travel extensively across the United States for customer meetings, conferences, and industry events (approximately 40% travel, if applicable).



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior experience working with pharmaceutical companies, healthcare providers, or life sciences organizations.

title: Assistant Facility Manager Soft Services

**Work location:** Mumbai, Goregaon East.
  
  

**Skills:** General Administration, HK, Pantry, cafeteria, vendor management, cost control and floor Management and corporate experience is Mandatory.
  
  

Work Dynamics
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

Serving on the front lines of customer service
  
Are you a people person who can make daily interactions such a breeze?
  
  

In this role, you’ll be in charge of one of the busiest places in the office—the front desk. Constantly on the go, you’ll give our visitors a warm welcome, and guide them and our employees along the way. In other words, you will set the benchmark in giving our company a good first impression.
  
  

Throughout the day, you will also handle all incoming and outgoing calls, including distribution. Therefore, it is essential to remain professional and polite in the way you present yourself, from appearance to behaviour.
  
You will spend each day looking at how you can maintain and improve the front office. Part of your checklist is to get your hands on the latest magazines and newspapers to be displayed in the reception.
  
  

Being at the heart of the business
  
Maintaining and updating records and database are also part of your basic daily routine. These include telephone registers, call tracking and client contacts. Much of your time will also be spent on general admin activities and other help desk tasks. Working at JLL, you should constantly keep in mind that you are working in compliance with our regulations.
  
  

Other responsibilities you will take care of include contributing to the monthly management report for the client and participating in emergency evacuation procedures. On top of these, you’ll be expected to develop policies and procedures needed for all functions in the reception. As needed, you’ll also take part in managing conference rooms, events, flower arrangement coordination, and others.
  
  

**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**  

A highly skilled professional
  
You should be a graduate in any discipline and have one to five years’ experience in front desk management or reception. Proven experience with continuous improvement initiatives and client reporting is also vital for this role. If you’re familiar with occupational safety requirements matched with strong computer literacy and the ability to manage activities using different systems, then you might be the best fit for this job.
  
  

A client service champ
  
A strong customer service focus is a pre\-requisite of this job. Do you have unmatched people skills that can help you ease your interactions with a wide range of client staff—regardless of their level—and their demands? An outstanding multitasking talent also provides a perfect complement to your skill set.
  
  

**What we can do for you:**  

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  

Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Staff Technical Account Manager
description:
What You'll Do
   

  

 The Staff Technical Account Manager is responsible is a critical member of Avalara’s support organization, responsible for managing technical tickets, ensuring timely resolution, and driving customer satisfaction for our Enterprise. Involving complex product and connector issues that cannot be fully resolved through frontline troubleshooting alone, while improving the speed, quality, and consistency of engineering engagement. This is an engineering\-aligned support talent that can reduce time to resolution, improve case quality, raise the standard of Jira submissions, and turn repeat issues into durable knowledge and process improvements. It also reflects Avalara’s broader need to embed AI into technical support in practical ways that improve investigation speed, communication quality, and team scalability. In addition to resolving complex issues, this role is expected to use AI in day\-to\-day work to accelerate research, strengthen technical analysis, improve case documentation, and identify opportunities to make technical support more effective and scalable over time.
   

  

 The business outcome this role enables is straightforward: better customer experience, faster and more reliable resolution of complex cases, better use of engineering capacity, stronger support scalability, and fewer repeat incidents over time. By combining technical judgment with thoughtful AI adoption, this role also helps Avalara improve how support work is performed, not just how individual cases are resolved.
   

  

**How This Role Elevates Avalara**
* This role raises the technical bar of Enterprise Support by bringing stronger investigation discipline, better case documentation, cleaner handoffs, more effective Jira creation, and clearer collaboration with Product and Engineering. It also improves the capability of the broader support organization by turning difficult cases into reusable knowledge, troubleshooting actions, and support\-ready guidance that reduces future rework.
* This role helps Avalara reduce unnecessary Jira volume, improve the quality of engineering escalations, and protect engineering capacity for the issues that truly require development effort. It also supports better operational performance through stronger SLA discipline, cleaner milestone adherence, faster TTR, and more predictable case outcomes.
* This role improves customer trust by ensuring that the most complex issues are handled with technical depth, clear communication, accurate diagnosis, and accountable resolution ownership. It also improves the long\-term customer experience by reducing repeat incidents and strengthening self\-service through better knowledge assets and preventative actions.
* Protect and increase Enterprise customer revenue and retention by resolving complex customer\-impacting issues quickly and accurately.
* For customers, the TAM provides a trusted technical partner who understands their environment, anticipates risk, and delivers clarity during high\-impact situations. This proactive, relationship\-driven approach increases platform reliability, improves customer experience, and drives long\-term success


**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
* Provide leadership and mentorship to TAMs – providing knowledge sessions, brown\-bag training and advanced troubleshooting of APIs and ERPs.
* Own a portfolio of Avalara’s Enterprise customers with premium support entitlement.
* Own complex support cases from assignment through verified resolution, especially where advanced troubleshooting, reproduction, deep product analysis, or engineering coordination is required.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across ERP/CRM/eCommerce platforms (NetSuite, D365, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Shopify, Workday, etc.).
* Diagnose customer issues across AvaTax, connectors, and related workflows by reproducing issues, gathering diagnostics, isolating scope, documenting findings, and confirming business impact.
* Determine when engineering involvement is warranted and ensure Jira tickets are necessary, complete, technically credible, and supported by strong due diligence before submission.
* Create, refine, and manage Jira tickets that clearly describe the issue, expected and actual behaviour, troubleshooting completed, reproduction detail, supporting evidence, and urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to drive defect resolution, maintain momentum on linked development work, and keep customer cases moving while internal work is in progress.
* Maintain strong customer communication discipline by meeting milestone expectations, providing proactive updates, responding quickly to new customer messages, and keeping status and documentation audit ready.
* Improve support effectiveness beyond the individual case by completing troubleshooting of the issues and analysis on major or repeat issues and contributing knowledge articles, playbooks, or reusable troubleshooting guidance that reduce repeat volume.
* Contribute to High priority support or production\-support responsiveness where applicable by providing fast technical guidance, validating escalation paths, and helping the broader support organization make better decisions earlier in the case lifecycle.
* Act as a technical role model for quality, ownership, and judgment in how cases are investigated, escalated, documented, and resolved.
* Contribute to responsible AI adoption by using sound judgment, validating outputs, and ensuring that final recommendations, communications, and actions remain accurate and customer ready.
* Help embed AI into support ways of working by sharing effective use cases, improving repeatable practices, and supporting continuous improvement across the team.


**12\-Month Success Signals**
* Consistently meets or exceeds SLA targets and maintains high CSAT scores.
* Reduces complex escalation backlog and improves average resolution time.
* Contributes documented root\-cause fixes that decrease repeat incidents.
* Delivers measurable efficiency gains through AI\-assisted workflows (e.g., reduced case handling time, improved documentation speed).


 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

**At Avalara, this role is expected to be a bar raiser for Support Engineering, leveraging technical expertise, data\-driven insights, and AI\-enabled capabilities to elevate troubleshooting, accelerate issue resolution, and prevent recurring customer problems. They continuously improve support operations, knowledge management, and team effectiveness while delivering exceptional customer outcomes.**
* Raise the bar for the team. Provide guidance, improve execution quality, and leave cases, routing, and knowledge resources better than you found them.
* Own complex cases end to end. Drive the issue forward, clarify ambiguity, follow up proactively, and make sure cases do not stall waiting on others.
* Identify and drove resolution of recurring product defects, resulting in improved customer experience and reduced support volume.
* Consistently achieve high customer satisfaction scores through effective issue ownership, technical expertise, and proactive communication.
* Reduce critical issue resolution time to 5 days through structured root cause analysis and cross\-functional collaboration.


**AI Bar Raiser Expectations**
**This role is expected to be an AI Bar Raiser, applying AI in a deliberate and impactful way to improve how technical issues are diagnosed, resolved, and prevented, while elevating the team’s ability to use AI to drive meaningful gains in support efficiency, knowledge quality, technical troubleshooting, and customer outcomes.**
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to accelerate root cause analysis and reduce troubleshooting time for complex customer issues.
* Identify and implement new AI\-driven approaches to technical support (e.g., automated diagnostics, intelligent case triage, predictive risk identification) that go beyond current team practices
* Utilize Generative AI to create knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and customer\-facing documentation, improving knowledge accessibility and consistency
* Develop AI\-driven workflows that automated repetitive support tasks, increasing team productivity and reducing manual effort.
* Create AI\-powered prompt libraries and support playbooks that standardized troubleshooting approaches across the team.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to integrate AI\-driven customer feedback analysis into product improvement initiatives.
* Champion AI adoption across the support organization, driving measurable improvements in resolution efficiency and support quality.
* Use AI insights to prioritize critical customer issues based on business impact, severity, and historical trends.


**Qualifications A**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of proven experience in handling complex technical issues in SaaS, APIs, integrations, or similar environments, with strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
* Expert experience with ERP/CRM/eCommerce platforms: NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP S/4 Hana, SageX, Salesforce, Magento, Oracle, Shopify, Workday, or similar systems is required
* Demonstrated proficiency in API and workflow analysis across ERP, e\-Commerce, and Marketplace platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with Engineering/Product teams and manage high\-quality escalation artifacts (e.g., Jira) with clear technical detail.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working in SLA\-driven support environments using tools such as Salesforce, Jira, and Confluence.
* Mandatory experience using AI tools and automation to improve support efficiency, diagnostics, communication quality, and scalability.


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

 In this leadership role, you will take ownership of client conversion initiatives, onboarding plans, and operational deliverables for premier institutional accounting, custody, and insurance clients. Acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and project lead, you will bridge the gap between global clients, internal Centers of Excellence (COEs), and daily operations teams.  Map operational workflows, identify and document processing methodology variances between legacy and target environments, and articulate these changes clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.

 Leverage deep functional expertise in platforms like
 **Geneva, MCH, and eHorizon** 
 to troubleshoot accounting exceptions, NAV discrepancies, and position breaks during parallel runs.

 Assess operational efficiency, eliminate bottlenecks, design straight\-through processing improvements, and ensure strict compliance with risk\-mitigation controls.
* **Cross\-Functional \& COE Coordination:** 
 Partner with global Shared Services, COEs, Technology, and Client Service verticals to guarantee procedural accuracy and meet strict SLA deadlines.
* **Team Leadership \& Mentorship:** 
 Guide, train, and mentor conversion team members, conduct cross\-skilling sessions, oversee daily deliverables, and drive high performance across rotational shift windows.
* **Executive \& Risk Reporting:** 
 Track project milestones, maintain audit trails, and proactively escalate migration risks and timeline variances with proposed remediation strategies.



**Qualifications \& Sourcing Criteria** 




**Must\-Have:** 



* **Experience:** 
**10\+ years of active financial services experience** 
 specializing in Global Custody Operations, Fund Accounting Conversions, Investment Manager Servicing, or Back\-Office Transaction Management.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with a concentration in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Commerce, or Financial Technology.
* **Custody \& Settlement Mechanics:** 
 Expert understanding of global custody frameworks, clearing/settlement cycles, asset servicing, SSIs, cash reconciliation, and SWIFT message structures.
* **Complex Fund Knowledge:** 
 Deep domain exposure to offshore products, ETFs, hedged structures, derivatives, and Master\-Feeder setups.
* **Platform Proficiency:** 
 Hands\-on operational knowledge of accounting engines such as
 **Advent Geneva, MCH, eHorizon** 
 , or comparable tier\-1 systems.
* **Leadership \& Influence:** 
 Proven track record of leading teams, managing complex stakeholder relationships, and driving client implementations independently.
* **Shift Flexibility:** 
 Willingness to work in
 **rotational shifts** 
 from the
 **Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai** 
 office.



**Preferred / Desired:** 



* Industry\-recognized credentials such as Investment Banking Certifications, CFA, or CA/CPA.
* Demonstrated experience handling large\-scale fund migrations, ledger conversions, and parallel accounting runs.
* Outstanding analytical, negotiation, and executive communication skills.



**Why Join This Team?**

 Direct operational leadership over multi\-billion\-dollar global custody and accounting migrations.

 End\-to\-end engagement with sophisticated investment structures across international markets.
* **Dynamic Culture:**

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Virohan:** 




 Founded in 2018, by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an education\-to\-industry partner, shaping the future of healthcare education. It enables India's top universities to deliver best\-in\-class undergraduate programs such as Optometry, MLT, Hospital Administration, OTT, MRIT, and more. Combining cutting\-edge technology, learner\-centric innovations, and strong industry partnerships, Virohan equips students with skills that go beyond degrees, preparing them
 



 for meaningful careers in healthcare. By 2030, Virohan aims to impact a million aspiring healthcare professionals and collaborate with over 100 universities across India to transform education and strengthen healthcare.
 



 We are backed by Blume Ventures, Mynavi Corporation and Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation and Artha Impact (Switzerland), Yunus Social Business (Germany), AngelList, and Keiretsu Forum, among others. Virohan operates at the intersection of education and Healthcare—two industries that have entered a new phase of rapid growth post\-pandemic. The time to make your mark in this space is now! We’re looking for entrepreneurs to join us in building the next unicorn.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a
 **Manager/Senior Manager – Partnerships \& Alliances** 
 to lead strategic collaborations with top private universities across India.
 



 This is a senior, high\-impact role where you will engage directly with university leadership — Chancellors, Vice Chancellors, Vice Presidents, Directors, and Deans — to forge long\-term, high\-value partnerships. You will be responsible for driving alliances that enable universities to launch and scale Allied Health Science programs through revenue\-sharing models, ensuring both academic excellence and sustainable business growth.
 



 The ideal candidate is a confident relationship builder, a strategic thinker, and a trusted advisor capable of influencing senior stakeholders and translating opportunities into impactful collaborations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**A. Business Development \& Strategic Partnerships** 




 ● Identify and develop partnerships with top\-tier NAAC A, A\+, and A\+\+ private universities across India.
 



 ● Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential partners and manage the end\-to\-end partnership lifecycle — from outreach and engagement to closure and onboarding.
 



 ● Establish deep, trust\-based relationships with senior university leaders and decision\-makers.
 



 ● Lead partnership discussions and negotiations to secure win\-win agreements aligned with Virohan’s growth goals.
 



**B. Sector \& Market Expertise** 




 ● Develop an in\-depth understanding of Allied Health Sciences and the higher education ecosystem to position yourself as a domain expert.
 



 ● Stay up to date with UGC guidelines, regulatory frameworks, and emerging trends in healthcare education.
 



 ● Monitor market movements and competitive landscape to identify new partnership opportunities and strategic directions.
 



**C. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 ● Work closely with internal teams and partner universities to ensure seamless handover and successful program implementation.
 



 ● Collaborate with Partner Success and Academic teams to deliver exceptional outcomes for universities and students alike.
 



 ● Drive operational excellence and ensure partnerships deliver long\-term value.
 



  





**Experience \& Skills Requirements:** 




 ●
 **3\+ years of experience in B2B sales, strategic partnerships, or account management, preferably engaging with universities or large institutions.** 




 ● Proven success in managing C\-suite or senior academic relationships and closing large, consultative deals.
 



 ● Strong existing network within the higher education ecosystem is highly desirable.
 



 ● Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities.
 



 ● Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
 



 ● Self\-driven, goal\-oriented, and capable of working independently while collaborating cross functionally.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 At Virohan, you’ll play a pivotal role in transforming India’s healthcare education landscape. You’ll work with passionate teams, visionary leaders, and a mission\-driven culture that rewards innovation, ownership, and real\-world impact.

title: Category Manager - Orthopedic Power Systems
description:
Category Manager \- Orthopedic Power Systems
   

 Location: Pune, Maharashtra
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

 Travel: Extensive domestic travel; occasional international travel
   

  

 1\. Role Purpose
   

  

 The Category Manager – Orthopedic Power Systems will be responsible for building, managing, and growing Manman’s Orthopedic Power Systems business as an independent strategic category.
   

  

 The role will own the complete category lifecycle — from market intelligence, product strategy and portfolio planning to pricing, sales enablement, channel development, marketing, product launches, inventory planning and profitability.
   

  

 The individual will act as the central interface between R\&D, Engineering, Production, Quality \& Regulatory, Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain, ensuring that the Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio remains clinically relevant, commercially competitive and financially successful.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should combine strong orthopedic product knowledge with commercial and business\-development capability.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. Key Responsibilities
   

  

 A. Category Strategy \& Business Ownership
   

  

 \- Develop and execute the annual and long\-term strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 \- Own category revenue, gross margin, market share and growth objectives.
   

 \- Develop annual business plans covering:
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Unit volumes
   

 \- ASP
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- Channel mix
   

 \- Geographic expansion
   

 \- Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and applications for orthopedic power systems.
   

 \- Develop category growth strategies for India and selected international markets.
   

 \- Track competitors, pricing, technology, product launches and market positioning.
   

 \- Identify gaps in Manman’s portfolio and recommend new products or product variants.
   

  

 B. Product Portfolio Management
   

  

 Own the complete Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio, including relevant:
   

  

 \- High\-speed drill systems
   

 \- Large\-bone systems
   

 \- Small\-bone systems
   

 \- Saw systems
   

 \- Oscillating/sagittal saws
   

 \- Reciprocating saws
   

 \- Shaver systems
   

 \- Endoscopic burr systems
   

 \- Attachments
   

 \- Handpieces
   

 \- Accessories
   

 \- Consumables
   

 \- Batteries and chargers
   

 \- Related service and AMC offerings
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Define product positioning and target customer for each product.
   

 \- Maintain the product portfolio and product lifecycle.
   

 \- Identify products requiring upgrades, replacement or discontinuation.
   

 \- Develop product roadmaps in coordination with R\&D and Engineering.
   

 \- Define product specifications based on market and clinical requirements.
   

 \- Gather voice\-of\-customer and surgeon feedback.
   

 \- Convert clinical requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering/R\&D.
   

  

 C. Product Development \& New Product Introduction
   

  

 \- Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for new products.
   

 \- Work with Engineering/R\&D on product development priorities.
   

 \- Coordinate prototype evaluation with surgeons and key opinion leaders.
   

 \- Organize clinical/user evaluations and product trials.
   

 \- Coordinate with Quality \& Regulatory for required documentation and approvals.
   

 \- Develop launch plans for new products.
   

 \- Establish product readiness gates before commercial launch.
   

 \- Coordinate first production, field trials and commercial release.
   

  

 D. Pricing \& Commercial Management
   

  

 \- Develop product pricing strategy based on:
   

 \- Manufacturing cost
   

 \- Landed cost
   

 \- Competitor pricing
   

 \- Clinical value
   

 \- Channel margins
   

 \- Customer segment
   

 \- Market positioning
   

 \- Recommend MRP, distributor/dealer pricing and institutional pricing.
   

 \- Monitor discounting and price realization.
   

 \- Develop tender and institutional pricing frameworks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve category gross margin.
   

 \- Monitor profitability by product, customer segment and channel.
   

  

 E. Sales Enablement
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales team to increase conversion and category penetration.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop sales presentations and product literature.
   

 \- Create product comparison sheets.
   

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

**Job Description**
**Senior Director, Global Delivery Hub – Pune, India**
 Zendesk
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Zendesk is seeking an experienced Senior Director to lead and develop the Global Delivery Hub based in Pune, India. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving the vision, execution, and growth of our consulting and staffing business operations in India. You will oversee end\-to\-end delivery excellence, manage key client relationships, lead a diverse team of talented professionals, and ensure our India operations support global business objectives while maintaining the highest standards of service delivery and client satisfaction.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on Zendesk's global services strategy, shape the future of our delivery capabilities, and build and mentor a world\-class organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Vision \& Business Leadership**
* Develop and execute the strategic vision and roadmap for the Zendesk Global Delivery Hub in India, aligned with overall business goals and growth initiatives
* Lead the entire India AI consulting, data migration and custom development teams, driving customer adoption, growth and operational excellence
* Partner with Global Services leadership team on strategic planning and execution to support global business requirements through India\-based delivery capabilities
* Enable cross\-region coordination between global clients and India delivery teams to ensure seamless service delivery


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Manage key client relationships and serve as the primary executive stakeholder for major accounts
* Oversee multiple project delivery teams to ensure client satisfaction for customer engagements
* Drive client satisfaction, retention, and account growth initiatives
* Maintain focus on understanding client needs and driving continuous improvements in service delivery


**Delivery Operations \& Quality**
* Oversee end\-to\-end consulting and staffing delivery operations
* Ensure delivery quality, productivity, and fulfillment metrics meet or exceed established targets
* Establish effective governance structures, processes, and performance metrics to ensure efficient, cost\-effective operations aligned with global customer priorities
* Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance capabilities, productivity, and service delivery


**Organizational Leadership \& Development**
* Lead and develop the Global delivery organization in India, including recruiting, delivery, and operations teams
* Oversee hiring, performance management, KPIs, and organizational planning
* Build engaged, productive teams that collaborate effectively across roles, departments, locations, and external partners
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and employee development
* Energize and inspire people through empowerment, recognition, and passion


**Operational Excellence \& Scalability**
* Develop and optimize operational processes to enable scalability and growth
* Collaborate with Finance, HR, Compliance, Recruiting, and Operations to drive organizational effectiveness
* Mitigate risk and solve complex problems through innovative and out\-of\-the\-box thinking
* Manage continuity, change, and transition effectively in a dynamic environment


**Leadership \& Culture**
* Embody and model Zendesk values, mission, and vision
* Demonstrate integrity, develop people, and build high\-performing teams
* Drive organizational change and influence others toward shared goals
* Address the impact of attitude and action on the organization and its participants


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 15\+ years of progressive leadership experience in consulting, services delivery, staffing, or professional services organizations
* 10\+ years of senior leadership experience managing P\&L, large teams, and complex operations at a regional or global scale
* Proven track record of building and scaling high\-performing organizations from the ground up
* Demonstrated success driving revenue growth, profitability, and operational efficiency
* Experience managing key strategic client relationships and driving client satisfaction and retention
* Experience operating successfully in matrix organization structures
* Strong background in recruiting, talent development, and performance management
* Experience implementing operational improvements and continuous optimization initiatives
* Knowledge of India market dynamics and experience operating India\-based delivery centers highly preferred
* Experience in AI, technology services, or customer\-centric delivery models preferred
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced business qualification preferred


**Core Competencies**
**Customer Focus**
 Strives for customer success and exceeds expectations by understanding client needs and driving meaningful improvements in products and services. Takes a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to enhance the customer experience.
   

  

**Team Collaboration**
 Builds engaged, productive teams while sharing knowledge and collaborating effectively across roles, departments, and locations. Extends collaboration externally with partners and customers. Creates an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and leveraged.
   

  

**Motivation \& Engagement**
 Energizes and inspires teams through empowerment, recognition, and genuine passion for excellence. Manages continuity, change, and transition with grace. Skillfully influences and enables others to achieve shared objectives. Understands the impact of attitude and action on organizational success.
   

  

**Leading Change**
 Possesses the skills and implements the functions of a transformational leader. Shares and communicates the company's values, mission, and vision effectively. Consistently displays integrity, models desired behaviors, develops talent, and builds strong, cohesive teams. Navigates organizational change while maintaining team morale and performance.
   

  

**Innovation \& Problem\-Solving**
 Mitigates risk and solves complex problems through innovative, out\-of\-the\-box thinking and creative problem\-solving approaches. Challenges conventional wisdom and drives continuous improvement.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a strategic, visionary leader with an entrepreneurial mindset who can build and scale an exceptional delivery organization in India. The ideal candidate will:
   

  

* Have a genuine passion for building world\-class organizations and developing talent
* Demonstrate a customer\-first mentality and commitment to exceeding client expectations
* Bring strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities
* Show comfort operating in ambiguity and driving results in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
* Possess strong financial acumen and business judgment
* Display emotional intelligence and the ability to inspire diverse teams
* Be a strong communicator with excellent presentation skills for executive\-level audiences
* Have experience navigating complex organizational structures and stakeholder dynamics

 Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration \- while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. **The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience**
 Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.

Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

title: FAAS -Global Treasury Services -Manager
description:
Locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Jose, Seattle, Tampa, Miami, Hoboken
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives
* Maintain a strong client focus by being responsive to client requests and developing/maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel.
* Collaborate with the partner and client to determine a strategy that appropriately addresses risk and manages client expectations relating to deliverables, understanding the client’s industry, key performance drivers, business trends and industry developments
* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
* 
+ New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700
+ Bay Area California offices – $160,500 to $267,400
+ All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $128,400 to $235,300

* Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
* Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.


**Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.**
* To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six\-month period.
* EY accepts applications for this position on an on\-going basis.
* For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
* At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
   

  

 All in to shape the future with confidence.
   

  

 EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law.
   

  

 EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process, please call 1\-800\-EY\-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com.
