description:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil \& gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.
 



 Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two\-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000\+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.
 



 Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.
 



**Senior Customer Success Manager** 





**\*\*This position requires candidates to be located in Bangalore only\*\***





 In this role, you will own the health, growth, and defence of Syndigo’s Enhanced Content (Content Cast) retailer network. You will be the single accountable owner for script implementation, network performance, and retailer and manufacturer relationships, helping protect and grow the brand revenue that depends on this network.
 



 This role requires working in the
 **European shift** 




**HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY** 



* Own the correct implementation and ongoing health of Syndigo scripts across retailer websites.
* Drive adoption of rich content modules and logo programs, such as HP Recommends and Epson Recommends.
* Lead Energy Label rollouts and coordinate custom XML, HTML, and API integrations from setup through launch.
* Monitor coverage, script functionality, content gaps, and syndication performance.
* Conduct coverage studies, audits, and year\-over\-year trend analysis to identify opportunities and risks.
* Partner with dashboard and reporting owners to improve the accuracy of recipient status and network reporting.
* Maintain retailer wishlists, growth plans, onboarding trackers, dashboards, and regional retailer lists used by Sales and Customer Success teams.
* Surface actionable insights and business cases for CSMs, Sales, Product, and other internal stakeholders.
* Serve as the primary liaison across manufacturers, retailers, CSMs, Sales, Product, Operations, Support, and Engineering.
* Own the relationship motion for active retailers after acquisition, including implementation follow\-up, engagement, usage reviews, issue escalation, and relationship health.
* Run regular business reviews with key brand and retailer partners and drive retailer advocacy based on the value delivered by Syndigo.
* Lead regular network expansion and health meetings, including expansion status, escalations, and RACI alignment.
* Support strategic retailer conversations where Syndigo needs to be positioned as a partner in marketplace, content, syndication, or PDP experience programs.
* Defend Syndigo placements against Flixmedia, Loadbee, Icecat, and other syndication providers by identifying competitive risks and defining actions to improve Syndigo’s position in the retailer waterfall.
* Identify brands already selling through a retailer but not yet syndicating rich content there, creating expansion opportunities for Sales and Customer Success.
* Use retailer feeds, coverage data, traffic, and priority\-account analysis to identify high\-value brand gaps.
* Support CSMs and Sales with retailer\-specific expansion narratives and business cases.
* Work with strategic brands to leverage their influence in support of retailer expansion where appropriate.
* Engage Tier 2 and Tier 3 retailers requested by brands and drive interest in implementing Syndigo Enhanced Content scripts, while supporting Tier 1 outreach and discussions.
* Coordinate escalations related to content visibility, missing content, retailer waterfalls, PDP rendering, inactive connections, dashboard inaccuracies, and conflicting provider behavior.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success to resolve issues that impact retailer confidence or content availability.



**WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU** 



* Strong experience in Enhanced Content, Rich Content, product content syndication, or a closely related domain.
* Existing relationships with brands and EMEA retailers.
* Experience working with retailers, brands, e\-commerce platforms, or retail technology.
* Technical fluency with script deployment and web technologies, including JavaScript, HTML, CSS, XML, and JSON.
* Understanding of API integrations and experience working with technical teams to troubleshoot integration issues.
* Basic understanding of iFrames, product feeds, and Server\-Side Rendering (SSR).
* Familiarity with browser developer tools, such as Chrome DevTools, for troubleshooting and validation.
* Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, comparisons, and data analysis.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence for issue tracking and documentation.
* Commercially aware and comfortable participating in QBRs, customer and deal conversations, and competitive positioning.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Support, Operations, and Engineering.
* Highly organised and self\-directed, with the ability to independently manage multiple critical customer issues and priorities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work during European hours.
* Familiarity with CMS and e\-commerce platforms such as Magento, WordPress, or Shopify (preferred but not required).
* Experience with Product Information Management (PIM) or Master Data Management (MDM) platforms (preferred but not required).
* Experience with Rich Content or Enhanced Content syndication (preferred but not required).
* Experience with Salesforce or Customer Success platforms (preferred but not required).
* Understanding of Content Security Policy (CSP) (preferred but not required).
* Knowledge of SEO, Product Detail Page (PDP) optimisation, or digital merchandising (preferred but not required).
* Knowledge of EU Energy Labels or other product compliance programs (preferred but not required).
* Experience in SaaS, product syndication, or retail technology (preferred but not required).
* Willingness to learn new technologies and integration methods, with training provided.



  
 


**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion** 

 To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.
 



 Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful! 
 



 All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

 At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




 As the Manager, Category Account Management, you will be at the forefront of shaping the seller experience charter on Walmart.com for India CBT (Cross Border Trade) team. You will lead a team focused on developing and executing strategies that empower sellers to optimize their product listings, manage their inventory, understand performance metrics, and leverage various Walmart services. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, operational excellence, strong analytical skills, and a passion for helping businesses grow.
 



  





**About the Team** 




 Walmart Marketplace is a rapidly growing e\-commerce platform that empowers businesses of all sizes to reach millions of customers. We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Senior Manager, Seller Enablement to join our dynamic team. In this critical role, you will be responsible for driving the success of our third\-party sellers by providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive on the Walmart Marketplace.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 



* **Seller Enablement Strategy \& Execution:** 
 Design and implement end\-to\-end seller enablement strategies, programs, and initiatives to drive performance, retention, and satisfaction across Walmart Marketplace.
* **Seller\-Driven Problem Solving:** 
 Identify seller pain points and growth opportunities, and translate them into scalable solutions, tools, and resources.
* **Feature Adoption \& Engagement:** 
 Accelerate adoption of Walmart Marketplace features, tools, and services by sellers through targeted enablement and communications.
* **Cross\-Functional Product Partnership:** 
 Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to advocate for seller needs and influence the roadmap of seller\-facing capabilities.
* **Content \& Resource Development:** 
 Own the development and upkeep of high\-quality, actionable seller\-facing materials, including guides, tutorials, webinars, FAQs, and best practices.
* **Performance Analytics \& Insights:** 
 Track and analyze key seller metrics, uncover trends, and identify improvement opportunities to inform decision\-making.
* **Executive Reporting \& Recommendations:** 
 Build and present data\-driven insights to leadership to guide strategic priorities and resource allocation.
* **Impact Measurement \& Benchmarking:** 
 Define success metrics, establish benchmarks, and evaluate the effectiveness of enablement initiatives against seller outcomes.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** 
 Partner closely with internal teams, including Product Management, Engineering, Business Development, Account Management, Marketing, and Customer Service, to deliver a cohesive seller experience.
* **Voice of Seller Advocacy:** 
 Represent seller perspectives in internal forums and product development discussions, ensuring their needs shape solutions and strategy.
* **Market Intelligence \& Differentiation:** 
 Stay current on industry trends, competitor activity, and best practices in seller enablement to identify opportunities for marketplace differentiation.



  





  





**What you’ll bring:** 



* **Analytical \& Performance Acumen:** 
 Demonstrated ability to leverage data, metrics, and insights to assess seller performance, identify trends, and drive measurable improvements.
* **Insight\-Driven Decision Making:** 
 Strong capability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations that inform strategy, prioritization, and resource allocation.
* **Cross\-Functional \& Influencing Skills:** 
 Proven experience partnering with Product, Engineering, and business teams, with the ability to advocate for customer needs and influence roadmap decisions.
* **Customer\-Focused Mindset:** 
 Deep commitment to representing the voice of the seller and enhancing the end\-to\-end marketplace experience through scalable, impactful solutions.
* **Market \& Industry Awareness:** 
 Strong understanding of e\-commerce trends, competitive dynamics, and seller enablement best practices to identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.



  





  





**Minimum Qualifications:** 



* Master's degree (MBA) or equivalent advanced degree.
* 6\+ years of experience in e\-commerce, marketplace operations, seller support, or a related field.
* Proven track record of developing and executing successful programs that drive business growth.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuasively.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly changing environment.



  





**Equal Opportunity Employer** 




 Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunity Employer by Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions while being welcoming of all people.
 



 Walmart doesn’t charge any recruitment or similar fee in the recruitment process, including but not limited to interview, offering, and onboarding.

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Portfolio Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
   

  

 You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
   

  

 This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at\-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re\-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow\-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.


**What You’ll Need**

 You will also work closely with the founders to identify
 **new business segments and opportunities** 
 where VYONE can create value. We want this person to continuously think about how the VYONE ecosystem can expand, what new categories we can enter, what partnerships we should build, and how those partnerships can create stronger value for both customers and VYONE.
 



 The role will involve building a strong
 **VYONE Business Partner Network** 
 across the market. You will help create a structured ecosystem where selected partners work with VYONE under clearly defined service standards, commercial arrangements, customer experience guidelines, and SLAs. The objective is not simply to onboard vendors, but to create a reliable network that becomes an important part of VYONE's competitive advantage.
 



  





 You will design operational processes across the complete customer lifecycle, ensuring that every interaction is simple, transparent, dependable, and built around customer trust. This includes defining workflows, escalation processes, quality standards, turnaround times, communication protocols, and partner accountability.
 



  





 You will also work closely with the product and technology teams to translate real\-world operational requirements into scalable systems, dashboards, workflows, and automation. As the business grows, your responsibility will be to ensure that processes that begin manually can eventually become structured, technology\-enabled, and scalable.
   




 Who we are looking for
 
 We are looking for someone who is
 **entrepreneurial, hands\-on, commercially aware, and comfortable operating in ambiguity** 
 .
 



 You should be someone who can walk into a new market, understand how the ecosystem works, identify the right partners, negotiate relationships, build processes, solve operational gaps, and continuously improve the customer experience.
 



 Most importantly, you must have a
 **builder mindset** 
 . VYONE is still being built, which means ideas will evolve, processes will change, and new opportunities will emerge. We want someone who welcomes that environment instead of waiting for a finished playbook.
 



  





 Experience in automotive operations, mobility, fleet management, aftersales, dealer operations, service networks, automotive insurance, customer lifecycle management, marketplaces, or partner\-led businesses would be highly relevant.
 



  





 Strong experience in
 **partner and vendor management, operational process design, SLA management, customer experience, commercial negotiations, cost management, and operational performance** 
 will be important for this role.
   




 What success will look like
 
 Success in this role will mean building a dependable partner ecosystem, improving service quality, creating scalable operational processes, maintaining strong partner performance, controlling service economics, and delivering an experience that customers consistently trust.
 



 As VYONE grows, this person will play a major role in defining
 **how the business operates, how our partner ecosystem works, and how we build an entirely new category within India's automotive ownership market** 
 .
 



  





 If you have spent your career running operations but have always wanted the opportunity to
 **build something rather than simply manage something** 
 , we would like to hear from you.
 



  





**Join VYONE and help us build the operating ecosystem behind the future of car ownership in India.**

title: Industry Solution Leader - Oil, Gas & Chemical (Refining / Chemical Asset Performance)
description:
C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end\-to\-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry\-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain\-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: **C3 AI**


C3 AI is seeking an Industry Solution Leader (ISL) for Oil, Gas \& Chemical to lead the design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions for its clients with a specialization in Refining / Chemical Asset Performance.



Industry Solution Leaders combine deep industry and engineering expertise with end\-to\-end ownership of customer solutions. They are expected to understand a customer's operations deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify and quantify the highest\-value opportunities, define the right technical solution, and lead cross\-functional teams through design, deployment, validation, and scale.



The role combines the responsibilities of a senior domain expert and solution leader. Industry Solution Directors work directly with customer engineering, operations, maintenance, and executive teams while leading C3 AI Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product teams, and other technical resources to deliver measurable business outcomes.



The ideal candidate brings significant hands\-on experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, or maintenance and has the technical judgment, customer leadership, and delivery ownership required to lead complex enterprise AI solutions from problem definition through production.



The ISL, Oil, Gas \& Chemical \- Refining / Chemical Asset Performance should have **hands\-on experience working inside a refinery, chemical plant, or similar continuous\-process facility, including distillation, reactors, furnaces, compressors, heat exchangers, or utilities, with ownership of throughput, yield, energy, APC/process control, or reliability outcomes.**


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Own the overall solution strategy, technical direction, and delivery outcomes for assigned customer engagements, maintaining accountability from initial problem definition through production deployment and scale.
* Serve as the primary customer\-facing solution leader and domain expert, developing a detailed understanding of customer operations, equipment, processes, constraints, and business objectives.
* Identify and quantify high\-impact business opportunities across equipment reliability, maintenance, production performance, process optimization, throughput, yield, quality, energy efficiency, and operating economics.
* Translate complex engineering and operational challenges into tractable AI, machine learning, optimization, and software problems with clearly defined requirements, success criteria, and expected business value.
* Lead engagements through use case definition, requirements gathering, solution architecture, application configuration, validation, production deployment, user adoption, and scale\-out.
* Apply deep engineering and industry expertise to challenge assumptions, evaluate technical approaches, interpret analytical results, and ensure solutions are consistent with engineering fundamentals and operational realities.
* Lead cross\-functional teams of Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product managers, engineers, and industry experts, establishing technical priorities and driving alignment around customer outcomes.
* Work directly with customer engineers, operators, reliability teams, maintenance organizations, and executives to validate requirements, solution performance, operational workflows, and business impact.
* Guide the interpretation and use of industrial data, including process signals, equipment attributes, operating states, maintenance history, production information, alarms, quality data, and other engineering information required to solve customer problems.
* Maintain accountability for solution quality, business value, technical risks, delivery progress, customer adoption, and executive communication throughout the engagement.
* Partner with C3 AI product management and engineering teams to identify reusable capabilities, inform product development, and scale successful solutions across assets, production lines, facilities, and business units.
* Support sales teams during opportunity assessment and capture by helping define customer problems, solution approaches, business value, technical requirements, deployment strategy, and demonstrations.
* Support development of statements of work and deployment plans, ensuring scope, deliverables, assumptions, data requirements, risks, timelines, and resource requirements are clearly defined.
* Develop repeatable industry methodologies, solution patterns, and best practices and represent C3 AI in relevant customer, industry, and technical forums.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Industrial, Mining, Metallurgical, Petroleum, Materials, or similar engineering backgrounds are preferred.
* 7\+ years of experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, maintenance, industrial technology, or technically focused consulting.
* Deep experience in one or more asset\-intensive industries, including high\-tech or semiconductor manufacturing, steel and metals, minerals and mining, utilities and power generation, oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, LNG, pharmaceuticals, or heavy manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience solving complex operational problems and improving equipment reliability, production performance, throughput, yield, quality, maintenance effectiveness, energy efficiency, or operating economics.
* Strong understanding of industrial equipment, manufacturing or production processes, process controls, maintenance practices, and operational workflows.
* Experience working with industrial data including sensor and time\-series data, equipment states, alarms, maintenance history, production data, laboratory or quality information, equipment hierarchies, and engineering data.
* Experience with industrial systems such as process historians, SCADA, DCS, MES, EAM/CMMS, ERP, advanced process control, or industrial analytics platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to reason from engineering fundamentals and determine whether analytical and AI\-driven recommendations are physically, technically, and operationally credible.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, customer\-facing technical engagements and working directly with engineering, operational, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, establish priorities, and drive teams toward practical solutions.
* Ability to work effectively with software engineers, data scientists, product managers, and customer technical teams and translate between domain, business, and technical requirements.
* Excellent presentation, written communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to travel to customer locations as required.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Experience delivering AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, optimization, predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, process optimization, or industrial digital transformation solutions.
* Hands\-on technical experience working with industrial data, SQL, Python, analytics tools, application configuration, scripting, or similar technologies, with the ability to directly inspect data, prototype analyses, and troubleshoot solution behavior.
* Experience with rotating equipment, electrical equipment, production equipment, manufacturing lines, process units, mining systems, utility assets, or other complex industrial systems.
* Experience taking technical solutions from initial proof of value through production deployment and scale.
* Experience scaling solutions across multiple assets, plants, facilities, or business units.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical discipline.


**C3 AI provides excellent benefits, a competitive compensation package and generous equity plan.**


C3 AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status.

title: Senior Architect (Data, Cloud, AI)
description:
About Ellucian:

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI\-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best\-in\-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data\-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.
About the Opportunity:

Ellucian is seeking a highly skilled and innovative Senior Architect to lead the architecture and technical strategy for our next\-generation Data Platform and analytics solution. This role will be instrumental in transforming our current data warehouse ecosystem into a modern, scalable, cloud\-native Lakehouse platform capable of supporting analytics, AI/ML workloads, agentic AI experiences, and real\-time data products.


This is a hands\-on architecture leadership role requiring deep expertise in data platforms, data warehouse, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and emerging AI technologies.


As a key technical leader , role offers opportunities to spearhead technical initiatives, mentor engineers at all levels, and work closely with internal product managers, experienced engineers, and cross\-functional teams to design, develop, test, and deliver advanced features that enhance student success and drive higher education transformation.

**Where You Will Make an Impact**

**Architecture \& Strategy**

* Build and own the target\-state architecture for a next\-generation Lakehouse platform.
* Develop technology roadmaps aligned with business strategy and product vision.
* Lead architectural decisions across data ingestion, storage, processing, governance, observability, security, and AI enablement.
* Establish architecture principles, standards, and reference architectures.

**Platform Modernization**

* Lead migration from traditional data warehouse architectures to modern Lakehouse architectures.
* Design scalable data platforms supporting structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data.
* Evaluate and drive adoption of technologies such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, DuckDB, Trino, Flink, Kafka, and cloud\-native analytics services.
* Design multi\-tenant SaaS architectures with strong security and data isolation.

**AI \& Intelligent Data Platform**

* Define architecture patterns enabling AI\-powered data experiences.
* Design platforms supporting:
* + Generative AI applications
	+ Agentic AI workflows
	+ Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
	+ Vector databases and semantic search
	+ AI\-assisted analytics and insights
* Partner with AI teams to operationalize ML and GenAI workloads.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine applicability to the platform roadmap.

**Technical Leadership**

* Take ownership of critical tasks from specification review through final testing and deployment, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Serve as the highest level technical authority for the platform.
* Mentor architects and senior engineers.
* Conduct architecture reviews and guide critical design decisions.
* Drive engineering excellence and technical innovation across teams.

**Scalability, Reliability \& Operations**

* Architect for high availability, performance, resiliency, and cost optimization.
* Define observability and operational excellence standards.
* Drive platform reliability through automation and SRE practices.
* Establish governance around performance, security, compliance, and data quality.

**What You Will Bring**

* **Experience**: Bachelor / Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, AI, or related field. Overall 15\+ years of software engineering exp with 7\+ years of professional software development experience in a product or SaaS environment building modern Data platform.
* Deep expertise in modern data architectures including Data warehouse, Data Mesh, Data platforms.
* Deep expertise in distributed data processing frameworks, Apache Spark, Trino, Flink, Kafka.
* Experience with open table formats, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake.

  

* Strong understanding of Metadata management, Lineage, observability.
* **Distributed Systems**: Experience designing, building, and evolving large\-scale distributed systems, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and highly available production services.
* **Cloud and Platform Engineering**: Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, containerization, infrastructure automation, and modern operational practices for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* **Engineering Excellence**: Deep experience with CI/CD, code review, test automation, observability, release engineering, and DevOps practices in modern software delivery environments.
* **Security and Risk Awareness**: Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, encryption, secure design, and practical application security principles in enterprise software.
* **LLM and Agentic Systems Experience**: Demonstrated experience building or guiding solutions that use large language models, including agent\-based workflows, prompt and context design, tool orchestration, structured outputs, and human\-in\-the\-loop validation patterns.
* **Model Selection and Evaluation**: Experience working with multiple LLMs or AI providers and making practical tradeoff decisions across model quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and enterprise suitability.
* **AI Engineering Practices**: Understanding of core patterns for production AI systems such as retrieval\-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, observability, prompt management, guardrails, fallback strategies, and secure handling of sensitive data.
* **Judgment and Governance**: Ability to evaluate AI\-generated output critically, define validation standards, identify risk areas, and maintain human accountability for technical decisions and delivered outcomes.
* **Technical Communication**: Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, with the ability to align engineers, product partners, and stakeholders around technical direction and execution tradeoffs.
* **Mentorship and Influence**: Proven experience mentoring engineers, leading technical discussions, raising engineering standards, and shaping development practices across a team or organization.

* Integrate knowledge bases, AI chatbots, and digital tools to support just\-in\-time learning and problem solving.

**Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of learning designers, trainers, and knowledge managers.
* Partner with senior leaders across Product, Compliance, and Trading and Operations to align learning and knowledge initiatives to business priorities.
* Act as a thought leader for innovative training practices, championing digital transformation in learning.

**Measurement \& Impact**

* Define KPIs for learning and knowledge initiatives, using analytics and AI insights to demonstrate business impact.
* Drive continuous improvement by incorporating learner feedback, data, and performance outcomes into strategy.

**What you’ll need for this role**

**Key Qualification Requirements:**

* Proven senior experience in learning \& development, training, or knowledge management leadership roles.
* Strong track record in designing and implementing corporate learning strategies.
* Experience with AI\-enabled learning and knowledge management platforms (Sana, Docebo, Cornerstone, ServiceNow KM, or similar).
* Demonstrated success in leading teams and managing global stakeholders.
* Excellent business acumen and ability to align learning strategy with operational and commercial goals.

* Background in financial services, fintech, or trading environments.
* Experience driving digital transformation in customer service organisations.
* Familiarity with regulatory training requirements in financial markets.

We follow a hybrid working model with 3 days in the office – which we think balances the need to collaborate effectively and connect with each other . * **Lead and Inspire:** Drives trust, alignment, and enthusiasm
* **Think Big:** Focus on the problems that most impact commercial outcomes
* **Champion the client:** Understand and prioritise client's needs
* **Deliver at pace:** Push for fast, sustainable growth;

We’re committed to building teams with a variety of perspectives and skills to help us realise our vision and strategy, that’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join us on this journey.


**The Perks**

Your growth fuels our success! Thrive with tailored development programs, mentoring opportunities with leaders, and clear career progression. Expand your network through committees, sports and social clubs. Enjoy extra time off for volunteering and community work.  



**Join us for this exciting journey.** **Apply now!**

title: Director, Technical Program Management
description:
**Job Description**  

As a Technical Project Manager, you will serve as the strategic connective tissue between product strategy and cross\-functional execution. This is a principal\-level, hands\-on leadership role. You are accountable for the delivery of the organization’s most complex, high\-revenue initiatives \- not for reporting on them \- and you carry the dates yourself.


You will guide a team responsible for architecting the Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) framework and providing the operational infrastructure required to scale. You will be responsible for the integrity of the delivery process \- managing the interdependencies between Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial teams. You ensure that the company’s most significant investments are delivered with transparency, alignment, and high impact.


Greenfield initiatives are where this role earns its keep. New programs receive dedicated senior ownership rather than shared program management capacity borrowed across unrelated engineering projects. On these builds you set the plan, hold the commitments, remove blockers directly where you can, and escalate with a recommendation and a recovery path where you cannot.


Your success in this role will be measured by the increased velocity, predictability, and transparency of our most critical product investments.

* Significant increase in the percentage of top initiatives delivered on time and within scope.
* Reduction in the "administrative tax" on Product Managers, as measured by time reclaimed from manual reporting and tool maintenance.
* Improved internal satisfaction scores from Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial leaders regarding the clarity and reliability of the delivery pipeline.
* Greenfield initiatives hitting their committed launch dates, with this role personally accountable for those commitments.


Level, Location, and Scope

* Level. Principal\-level. This is a senior individual leadership role, comparable in scope to an L7 Principal Technical Program Manager at a large technology company.
* Location. Bangalore\-based, most of the engineering, product and data science team are also based in India.
* Dedication. Fully dedicated to Product Operations and the greenfield portfolio. This is not a shared resource split across multiple engineering projects.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Update and maintain a scalable Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) that bridges the gap between high\-level roadmaps and delivery.
* Establish standardized stage\-gates and "Definition of Ready/Done" criteria to ensure Engineering and Data Science receive high\-quality, actionable requirements.
* Conduct quarterly audits of the delivery pipeline to identify friction points, automate manual handoffs, and reduce lead time without over\-engineering the process.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the "Top 20" initiatives \- those involving 3\+ functional teams or multi\-million revenue impact \- from post\-PRD alignment through launch. You hold the timeline and are answerable when it moves.
* Actively unblock the work. Identify and resolve cross\-team resource conflicts and technical dependencies between Product, Tech, Data Science, and Operations, driving each issue to a decision rather than routing it onward.
* Stand up greenfield programs from zero: scope, sequencing, staffing needs, operating cadence, and launch criteria, with no existing process to inherit.
* Engage directly with Engineering and Data Science on architecture, data pipeline, and integration tradeoffs at enough depth to pressure\-test estimates and challenge plans credibly.
* Escalate to executive leadership with a recommendation and a recovery plan attached, not a status color.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for high\-value client steering committees and strategic data vendors (e.g., Netflix, Amazon) to ensure technical integrations stay on schedule.
* Design and own the executive dashboarding strategy, providing a "single source of truth" for product health (adoption, retention) and delivery health (predictability, throughput).
* Ensure Jira and Confluence are configured to provide clean, automated reporting, eliminating the need for Product Managers to manually aggregate status updates.
* Provide quarterly insights to the C\-suite on execution trends, highlighting areas where resource reallocation may be necessary to meet Op Plan goals.
* Oversee the administration and configuration of Jira, Confluence, and associated add\-ons to support a unified workflow across the department.
* Evaluate and implement emerging tools (AI\-assisted productivity, roadmap visualization) that enhance the productivity of the Product and Tech teams.
* Maintain the centralized repository of best practices, templates, and guidelines that standardize how the organization builds and launches products.
* Lead quarterly training sessions to ensure new hires and existing team members are proficient in the PDLC and operational tools, ensuring a consistent culture of execution.

 **Qualifications*** 15\+ years of experience in Product Operations, Technical Program Management, or Product Management, with at least 5 years operating at a principal or director level. For calibration: comparable in scope and seniority to an L7 Principal TPM at a company such as Amazon.
* Proven track record of managing "Top\-Tier" strategic initiatives that require the synchronization of cross\-functional areas (e.g., Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and Sales).
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing a Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) in a growth\-stage or enterprise technology environment.
* Demonstrated ownership of greenfield, 0\-to\-1 programs where the plan, process, and cadence did not yet exist and had to be built.
* A track record of unblocking rather than tracking. Be ready to describe specific technical and organizational blockers you personally cleared, and launch dates you were held to.
* Technical fluency sufficient to hold a credible conversation with Engineering and Data Science leaders about architecture, data pipelines, and integration risk.
* Strong ability to translate raw delivery data into executive\-level insights. Experience building automated dashboards that track both business health (KPIs) and delivery health (velocity, lead time).
* Exceptional ability to build consensus and maintain high\-trust partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Customer Success and Commercial leadership.
* A passion for process as an enabler, not a hurdle. You should have a reputation for making the teams around you faster and more effective.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
* Professional certifications in Program Management (PMP, PgMP) are welcomed but secondary to proven real\-world results.

 **Additional Information**

Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. * **About the role:**


Designs, builds, and evolves enterprise data and AI capabilities that enable reliable, secure, and scalable digital solutions across the organization. Oversees data platforms, pipelines, analytics, and intelligent technologies to ensure high\-quality, accessible, and well\-governed data that supports operational and strategic decision\-making. Applies advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and automation to improve efficiency, accuracy, and business performance while enabling scalable and data\-driven ways of working. Establishes and enforces governance frameworks, standards, and responsible AI practices to maintain data integrity, compliance, consistency, and trusted use of enterprise technologies. Partners closely with business and technology teams to translate evolving business needs into robust data and AI solutions that drive innovation, operational maturity, and long\-term enterprise value.


### **JOB RESPONSIBILITY**


* Platform Architecture \& Technical Ownership
* Own the overall architecture of the enterprise data platform based on a Lakehouse paradigm, covering storage, compute, metadata, governance, and observability.
* Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and architectural standards applicable across AWS and GCP.
* Act as the final technical authority for platform‑level architectural decisions, trade‑offs, and exceptions.
* Ensure architectural choices support scalability, resilience, security, cost efficiency, and operational excellence.
* Lakehouse \& Open‑Standards Strategy
* Design the platform around open data standards to ensure portability and long‑term flexibility.
* Standardize on open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg or equivalent) and open file formats (e.g., Parquet) as the foundation of the Lakehouse.
* Enforce separation of storage and compute, enabling multiple analytics and processing engines without vendor lock‑in.
* Define principles for schema evolution, ACID guarantees, time travel, and multi‑engine interoperability.
* Multi‑Cloud Platform Design (AWS \& GCP)
* Architect the Lakehouse platform to run on AWS and GCP, with cloud‑specific implementations mapped to a common logical architecture.
* Define standards and patterns for:
* Cloud‑native storage and processing services
* Environment isolation (dev / test / prod)
* Networking and identity models
* Security, encryption, and access controls
* Establish cloud‑agnostic abstractions and guardrails so data products behave consistently across clouds.
* Ensure platform design aligns with enterprise security, compliance, and cost‑management requirements.
* Platform Development \& Engineering Enablement
* Partner with Platform Engineers and Data Engineers to translate architecture into reusable platform capabilities, frameworks, and templates.
* Define configuration‑driven and template‑based approaches to accelerate onboarding and reduce bespoke development.
* Review and guide detailed solution designs to ensure alignment with architectural standards.
* Enable self‑service platform usage while preserving governance and operational controls.
* Governance, Metadata \& Lineage Architecture
* Define the governance architecture for the Lakehouse, including metadata management, lineage, access control, and auditability.
* Ensure support for open metadata and lineage standards (e.g., OpenLineage‑style event models).
* Embed data quality, ownership, discoverability, and compliance as first‑class architectural concerns.
* Align platform design with enterprise data governance and regulatory expectations.
* Operational Excellence \& Non‑Functional Architecture
* Architect for high availability, observability, and operational simplicity.
* Define platform‑level SLAs, SLOs, and operational readiness criteria.
* Incorporate FinOps principles into architectural decisions to optimize performance and cost.
* Ensure the platform supports Day‑2 operations, incident management, and continuous improvement.
* Stakeholder Leadership \& Architecture Governance
* Serve as the primary architecture interface between engineering teams, security, governance, and business stakeholders.
* Clearly communicate architectural vision and decisions through architecture documents, standards, and review forums.
* Lead architecture reviews, roadmap planning, and technology evaluations.
* Mentor senior engineers and architects, raising overall platform and architecture maturity.

### **Required Qualifications**


* 16\&\#43; years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or data architecture roles.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise‑scale data platforms.
* Strong experience designing and governing Lakehouse architectures.
* Hands‑on architectural experience with AWS and/or GCP, with the ability to design for both.
* Deep understanding of open data standards, including open table formats, file formats, metadata, and lineage.
* Experience defining reference architectures, guardrails, and engineering standards.
* Strong ability to balance long‑term architectural vision with near‑term delivery needs.


Preferred / Optional Qualifications


* Experience with Microsoft Azure data and analytics services (optional, not required).
* Experience designing multi‑cloud or cloud‑agnostic data platforms.
* Familiarity with multiple analytics and query engines across cloud ecosystems.
* Experience with enterprise data governance frameworks and metadata platforms.
* Exposure to AI/ML platform integration on Lakehouse architectures.
* Prior experience leading large‑scale platform modernization or migration initiatives

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Portfolio Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
   

  

 You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
   

  

 This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at\-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re\-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow\-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.


**What You’ll Need**
* Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
* Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
* Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
* Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
* Excellent organization, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property\-management platform, or workflow\-management system.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
* Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work full\-time during Eastern Time business hours.
* Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.


 Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring\-service industry will be considered.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.
   

  

 Who Will Succeed
   

  

 The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.
   

  

 You are client\-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.
   

  

**Compensation**
 The annual compensation range is
 **C$30,000–C$36,000** 
 , based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre\-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

title: FAAS -Global Treasury Services -Manager
description:
Locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Jose, Seattle, Tampa, Miami, Hoboken
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives
* Maintain a strong client focus by being responsive to client requests and developing/maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel.
* Collaborate with the partner and client to determine a strategy that appropriately addresses risk and manages client expectations relating to deliverables, understanding the client’s industry, key performance drivers, business trends and industry developments
* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
* 
+ New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700
+ Bay Area California offices – $160,500 to $267,400
+ All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $128,400 to $235,300

* Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
* Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.


**Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.**
* To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six\-month period.
* EY accepts applications for this position on an on\-going basis.
* For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
* At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
   

  

 All in to shape the future with confidence.
   

  

 EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law.

 Reporting directly to the Manager of Professional Services, Training \& Onboarding (India), you will serve as the trusted technical advisor for net\-new and existing Tekla Structures accounts across India. You will have full ownership over discovery meetings, workflow customization, and client success roadmaps. Working at the intersection of sales, customer support, and global product development, you will play a central role in conveying real\-world customer feedback directly back to core engineering teams to influence future software capabilities.
   

  

 Key Exciting Responsibilities
   

  

* End\-to\-End Onboarding Execution: Lead full\-lifecycle software onboarding and implementation programs for new and existing clients utilizing Tekla Structures (Steel and Concrete configurations).
* Workflow Discovery \& Problem Solving: Conduct deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to analyze client requirements, troubleshoot output customization challenges, and engineer tailored structural detailing workflows.

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Value Advocacy: Serve as the primary onboarding anchor across Sales, Support, and Product Development teams, while actively presenting the value of Professional Services to prospective clients.


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Tekla Structures Deep\-Dive Expertise: 4–5 years of direct, hands\-on experience using Tekla Structures across Steel and Concrete modules.
* Domain \& Industry Experience: 6–7 years of hands\-on structural detailing and design experience with strong domain mastery in structural steel and reinforced concrete workflows.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil, Structural, or Mechanical Engineering.
* Communication \& Engagement: Fluent written and spoken English with exceptional interpersonal skills to command credibility across client C\-suites and job\-site engineering teams.
* Independent Execution: Strong diagnostic capability to troubleshoot software issues independently, manage tight schedules, and drive project success with minimal supervision.


**Bonus Points For**
* Multilingual Capability: Fluency in spoken Hindi to engage effectively across diverse regional client bases in India.
* Global Design Codes: Direct experience executing structural detailing projects according to international engineering codes and standards.
* Customer\-Centric Mindset: Highly organized, detail\-oriented approach with an eagerness to learn complementary Trimble software products.

We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

title: FAAS -Global Treasury Services -Manager
description:
Locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Jose, Seattle, Tampa, Miami, Hoboken
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives

* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
* 
+ New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700
+ Bay Area California offices – $160,500 to $267,400
+ All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $128,400 to $235,300

* Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
* Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.

Much of this work involves designing and implementing workflows that manage large volumes of claim resolution activity, with a focus on improving visibility, throughput, and operational consistency.


These systems support work that may be completed manually by operations partners or automated to improve overall productivity. That means our teams build software that helps route work, manage exceptions, connect business rules to execution paths, and create a more efficient experience across revenue cycle operations. The engineering work often involves balancing scale, reliability, maintainability, and evolving business needs across distributed systems.


As a Member of Technical Staff, this role contributes directly to the development of backend services and microservices that power these workflows. description:

 At Zithara.ai, we are pioneering the next generation of Customer Intelligence. Our platform serves as the “North Star” for consumer brands, enabling them to unify disparate customer data, automate personalized omnichannel engagement, and deploy advanced AI Agents for sales, support, and marketing.
   

  

 From deep analytics powered by our Customer Data Platform (CDP) to AI\-led customer engagement, Zithara.ai helps retail and e\-commerce businesses simplify retention, improve customer lifetime value, and accelerate revenue growth across India and Australia.
   

  

**The Role**

 This is a mid\-level “player\-coach” role where you will manage a portfolio of strategic retail accounts while leading and mentoring a small team of junior Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Support Associates.
   

  

 A core expectation of this role is ensuring
