title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Portfolio Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
   

  

 You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
   

  

 This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at\-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re\-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow\-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.


**What You’ll Need**
* Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
* Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
* Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
* Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
* Excellent organization, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property\-management platform, or workflow\-management system.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
* Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work full\-time during Eastern Time business hours.
* Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.


 Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring\-service industry will be considered.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.
   

  

 Who Will Succeed
   

  

 The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.
   

  

 You are client\-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.
   

  

**Compensation**
 The annual compensation range is
 **C$30,000–C$36,000** 
 , based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre\-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

title: Manager, Customer Service
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 The Manager, Customer Service provides operational leadership for the India\-based Customer Success team within a global, matrixed Customer Success \& Operations organization, with primary responsibility for quote\-to\-order and order\-related customer Success activities. The role oversees the day\-to\-day execution and resolution of customer requests related to quotes, orders, order changes, order status, fulfillment, pricing, and other transactional activities across the customer journey. Working closely with the US\-based Senior Manager, Customer Success, the Manager translates global strategy and Success standards into effective local execution, while leading team performance, workforce management, escalations, process adherence, and continuous improvement to drive timely, accurate, and consistent customer outcomes.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Manager, Customer Service Has The Following Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership \& Capability Development**
* Lead, coach, and develop the India Customer Service team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, engagement, and succession readiness.
* Build workforce capability through effective hiring, onboarding, performance management, targeted development, and cross\-training that supports business continuity.
* Create an inclusive, customer\-focused culture that reinforces quality, integrity, collaboration, sound judgment, and readiness for change.


**Customer Operations \& Service Excellence**
* Own the consistent delivery of quote\-to\-order and order\-related customer service outcomes, ensuring customer needs are addressed accurately, promptly, and in accordance with established service standards.
* Provide leadership for complex or high\-impact customer issues and escalations, maintaining clear ownership, communication, and follow\-through to resolution.
* Use service, quality, productivity, and customer feedback insights to set priorities, manage risk, and improve the customer experience.


**Cross\-Functional Partnership \& Execution**
* Partner with the Senior Manager, Customer Service to translate global strategy, priorities, and performance expectations into clear plans and measurable outcomes for the India team.
* Build effective partnerships across Finance, Distribution, Trade Compliance, Quality, IT, Sales, Account Management, Product, and other global teams to resolve dependencies and deliver customer and business outcomes.
* Represent Customer Service requirements and customer impact in cross\-functional initiatives, system changes, business reviews, and implementation activities.


**Operational Excellence, Compliance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Ensure team execution complies with applicable policies, procedures, quality requirements, and controls related to orders, documentation, controlled substances, permits, customs, licensing, and shipments.
* Lead improvements that strengthen service quality, efficiency, data accuracy, productivity, cost effectiveness, process consistency, and organizational readiness.
* Serve as the lead for ISO audits within the India Customer Service department, coordinating audit readiness, compliance documentation, corrective actions, and adherence to established quality management standards.


**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Education \& Experience**
 The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree required in a business, sales or related field.
* Minimum of seven (7\) years of experience in customer Success, sales, or related field in a multi\-cultural environment, preferably for a global organization
* Minimum of three (3\) years of people management experience
* In depth knowledge of customer Success principles and practices
* Previous experience in a customer Success environment required.


**Skills \& Competencies**

* Customer Success focused and ability to provide a high degree of customer Success.
* Must possess ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment with a high level for stress tolerance while maintaining composure and enthusiasm.

* Strong team builder and people leader with the ability and desire to work well with diverse employees and customers in a cooperative and friendly manner.

title: POD Manager
company: Digital Mojo - Branding and Digital Marketing Agency in Hyderabad
description:
**Company Description** 





 Digital Mojo is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, storytelling, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.
 




  





**Role Description** 




**We are looking for a highly ownership\-driven Pod Manager with 5\-7 years of agency experience to lead a pod of clients end\-to\-end.** 





 The Pod Manager is not a delivery coordinator. They are the business head of their pod. They own the P\&L of their accounts, drive client growth strategy, lead the pod team, and are the last point of escalation before it reaches the CEO. Every commercial decision, every retention risk, every growth opportunity within the pod runs through them.
 





 If something goes wrong in the pod, the Pod Manager owns it. If something goes right, the Pod Manager drove it.
 




**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not a senior Account Manager with a fancier title
* Not someone who only reviews reports and attends calls
* Not someone who escalates client problems to the CEO without first attempting resolution
* Not a task manager or execution coordinator
* Not someone who waits for strategy to come from above



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Pod P\&L Ownership** 



* Own the revenue, profitability, and commercial health of all accounts within the pod
* Track pod\-level billing, scope utilization, and team bandwidth against revenue
* Identify accounts where the agency is over\-servicing and course\-correct scope or pricing
* Protect agency margins by managing team allocation and delivery efficiency
* Flag accounts at commercial risk to the Founder with a clear plan, not just a problem
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and close them in coordination with the Founder
* Own monthly pod revenue targets and report against them with clarity



**2\. Client Growth Strategy** 



* Go beyond delivery. Actively think about what is next for each client's business
* Develop quarterly growth plans for key accounts covering new campaigns, channels, and opportunities
* Proactively bring ideas to clients before they ask. Be the strategic voice in every client relationship
* Identify gaps in a client's current marketing mix and recommend solutions backed by data
* Lead strategic review meetings with clients, not just performance catch\-up calls
* Connect client business goals to marketing strategy and keep both aligned as the business evolves
* Be the person a client calls when they want a fresh perspective, not just a status update



**3\. Escalation Leadership** 



* Serve as the final internal escalation point before the CEO for all pod\-level issues
* Handle client escalations, conflicts, and difficult conversations directly and with confidence
* Resolve delivery failures, team gaps, and quality issues at the pod level without pushing them upward
* Make judgment calls on scope disputes, pricing conversations, and client dissatisfaction independently
* Know when to involve the Founder and walk in with context, options, and a recommendation
* Protect the Founder's bandwidth by resolving 90% of pod issues at the pod level



**4\. Team Leadership and Pod Management** 



* Lead and manage Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, and SEO Specialists within the pod
* Set clear expectations, review output quality, and hold team members accountable
* Run pod reviews, identify underperformance early, and address it directly
* Build a culture of ownership, speed, and quality within the pod
* Identify training or skill gaps in the team and flag them to the Founder
* Ensure Account Managers are handling day\-to\-day client communication so the Pod Manager can focus on strategy and commercial outcomes



**5\. Delivery and Quality Oversight** 



* Own the quality of everything that leaves the pod, from reports to creatives to campaign performance
* Ensure all client deliverables across social media, SEO, and performance marketing are on time and to standard
* Review monthly performance reports before they reach the client
* Maintain SLA adherence across the pod and flag risks before they impact delivery
* Coordinate with centralized teams including design, SEO, website, and automation for seamless execution



**6\. Performance and Campaign Strategy** 



* Understand performance marketing fundamentals including CPL, ROAS, CTR, lead quality, and funnel structure
* Review campaign performance across accounts and push for optimization when results are not meeting targets
* Work with Performance Marketers on budget planning, channel strategy, and campaign direction
* Ensure SEO, social, and paid strategies are aligned and working toward the same client business outcome
* The character in sitcom is Ross



**7\. Commercial Responsibility and Client Retention** 



* Own client retention across all pod accounts
* Conduct regular health checks on every account and know the status of each relationship at all times
* Identify at\-risk clients early and create a recovery plan before it becomes a churn situation
* Manage contract renewals, scope expansions, and pricing conversations
* Track client satisfaction and act on early signals before they escalate



  





**Key KPIs** 



* Pod Revenue vs Target
* Pod Gross Margin and Profitability
* Client Retention Rate
* Upsell and Cross\-sell Revenue Generated
* Client Satisfaction Score
* Escalations Reaching CEO (target: minimal)
* On\-Time Delivery Percentage
* Team Utilization and Bandwidth Efficiency
* Strategic Growth Plans Delivered per Quarter



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 



* 4\-7 years of experience in a digital marketing agency
* Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and cross\-functional teams
* Strong understanding of agency P\&L, billing, scope management, and margin control
* Deep knowledge of performance marketing, social media, SEO, and content marketing
* Experience handling client escalations and difficult commercial conversations independently
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to build and present growth plans for clients
* Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal
* Confident in senior client\-facing discussions and presentations
* Experience with project management and reporting tools
* Ability to lead, motivate, and hold a team accountable in a fast\-paced environment



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 



* **Agency experience is mandatory.**
* Has managed a revenue\-bearing portfolio of clients, not just a team of people
* Has had commercial conversations with clients around scope, pricing, and renewals
* Thinks in terms of client business growth, not just campaign delivery
* Is a problem\-solver who finds solutions before escalating
* Can lead a room whether it is a team standup or a senior client strategy session



  





**Reporting Structure** 



* Reports To: Founder / CEO
* Manages: Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, SEO Specialists
* Coordinates With: Creative Team, SEO Team, Website Team, Automation Team
* Escalation Authority: Final internal point before the CEO

title: Retention & Growth Manager
description:
RETENTION \& GROWTH MANAGER \- XTOVIA
 



 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Work Mode: Full\-Time \| Work From Office
 



 Experience: 2\-5 years
 



 Industry: Beauty \& Haircare / D2C
 



  





 About XTOVIA
 



 Xtovia is a Hyderabad\-based, science\-backed haircare brand reimagining Indian beauty at global standards. Powered by our proprietary TriLayerX bond\-repair technology, Xtovia is building a new generation of high\-performance haircare for Indian hair.
 



 We are a fast\-growing D2C brand building a strong customer community and a long\-term relationship with our customers through product innovation, education and personalised experiences.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We're looking for a Retention \& Growth Manager to take ownership of the customer lifecycle at Xtovia.
 



 The core focus of this role is retention marketing converting first\-time buyers into repeat customers, increasing customer lifetime value, and building a loyal customer base.
 



 You will work across CRM, customer segmentation, lifecycle campaigns, loyalty, referrals, reactivation and customer engagement. This is a highly hands\-on role where you will be expected to analyse, experiment, execute and learn quickly.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



  





 Customer Retention
 



  





 \-Own and execute Xtovia's retention and repeat\-purchase strategy.
 



 \-Identify opportunities to increase repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency and LTV.
 



 \-Analyse customer behaviour to understand why customers repurchase, churn or become inactive.
 



 \-Build replenishment strategies based on product usage and consumption cycles.
 



 \-Develop cross\-sell and upsell journeys across the product portfolio.
 



 \-Build win\-back strategies for dormant and lapsed customers.
 



  





 CRM \& Lifecycle Marketing
 



  





 \-Own the customer journey from first purchase product experience replenishment repeat purchase loyalty advocacy.
 



 \-Plan and execute campaigns across WhatsApp, Email, SMS and other CRM channels.
 



 \-Build automated journeys for welcome, post\-purchase, product education, replenishment, cross\-sell, upsell, abandoned cart and win\-back.
 



 \-Test different messaging, offers, content, timing and customer segments.
 



 \-Work closely with the content and creative teams to develop high\-performing CRM campaigns.
 



  





 Loyalty \& Community
 



  





 \-Build and manage loyalty and rewards initiatives.
 



 \-Develop referral programs to turn existing customers into acquisition channels.
 



 \-Drive customer reviews, UGC, testimonials and referrals.
 



 \-Create campaigns that build engagement and brand affinity beyond discount\-led marketing.
 



  





 Data \& Experimentation
 



  





 \-Track Repeat Purchase Rate, LTV, Churn, Purchase Frequency, CRM Revenue, AOV and Reactivation Rate.
 



 \-Build customer segments based on purchase behaviour, recency, frequency, product purchased and customer value.
 



 \-Analyse campaign performance and identify growth opportunities.
 



 \-Run A/B tests and continuously optimise the customer lifecycle.
 



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 \-2\-5 years of experience in Retention Marketing, CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, D2C or E\-commerce.
 



 \-Strong understanding of customer lifecycle and retention marketing.
 



 \-Hands\-on experience with WhatsApp, Email, SMS and CRM/marketing automation platforms.
 



 \-Strong analytical skills and comfort working with customer data.
 



 \-Experience with Shopify and D2C analytics is a plus.
 



 \-Experience in beauty, personal care, wellness or consumer brands is preferred.
 



 \-Strong communication and copywriting skills.
 



 \-Someone who enjoys experimenting and finding out what actually makes customers come back.
 



 \-A hands\-on, ownership\-driven startup mindset.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 Your core goal: Turn first\-time customers into repeat customers and repeat customers into loyal Xtovia advocates.
 



  





 You will be responsible for improving: Repeat Purchase Rate \| Customer LTV \| Purchase Frequency \| CRM Revenue \| Reactivation \| Customer Engagement \| Referrals
 



  





 Why Join Xtovia?
 



 \-Work directly with the founding team.
 



 \-Own retention marketing for a fast\-growing Indian haircare brand.
 



 \-Build the CRM, loyalty and customer lifecycle engine from the ground up.
 



 \-Get exposure to D2C growth, consumer behaviour, data and brand building.
 



 \-High ownership, experimentation and learning.
 



  





 Apply
 



 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Work Mode: Full\-Time \| Work From Office
 



 Send your resume to:
 



 levelup@xtovia.com

title: Parent Relationship Senior Manager
description:
**Parent Relationship Senior Manager**




***Zonal (North \& West, or South \& East) · Reports to the Parent Relationship Head***




  





**Function:** 
 Parent Relationship Management
 



**Reports into:** 
 Parent Relationship Head
 



**Zone owned:** 
 North \& West, or South \& East (one Senior Manager per zone)
 



**Direct reports:** 
 All Parent Relationship Managers across the zone's campuses
 



**Experience:** 
 8–10 years overall, incl. 2–3\+ years in people management
 



**Education:** 
 Graduate; MBA / relevant PG preferred, not mandatory
 



  





**Role Summary**




  





 The Parent Relationship Senior Manager owns parent trust and engagement across every campus in a zone. This is a people\-management role first, and — because parent conversations can be sensitive and emotionally charged — it calls for real maturity too: you will hire, ramp, coach, and review a bench of Parent Relationship Managers, hold the line on the 1:300 mapping ratio as the zone grows, and act as the second\-level escalation point for the harder, trust\-critical conversations a Manager can't close alone.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**



* **Zonal ownership** 
 — be accountable for parent trust and NPS across every campus in the zone — not any single campus, all of them
* **People management** 
 — hire, ramp, coach, and review Parent Relationship Managers in the zone, adding headcount as campuses or batch sizes grow so the 1:300 ratio holds
* **Escalation** 
 — pick up anything a Manager can't close on their own — especially sensitive or trust\-critical conversations — and coach Managers on how those are handled
* **Trust oversight** 
 — sample how cases were handled — the tone and the follow\-through, not just closure speed — and hold the expectation\-management standard, not only the SLA
* **Reporting** 
 — consolidate every campus dashboard in the zone into one view, report it to the Parent Relationship Head, and coordinate with Program Ops and the Student Relationship function



  





**What Success Looks Like — Key Result Areas** 




  





**Zonal parent trust / NPS:** 
 NPS rolled up across all campuses in the zone
 



**2nd\-level escalation TAT:** 
 Time to close issues escalated past the Manager
 



**SLA adherence across zone:** 
 % of managers' concerns closed within SLA
 



**Ratio adherence:** 
 Managers in zone operating at or near 1:300
 



**Manager stability:** 
 Retention of Parent Relationship Managers in the zone
 



  





***Note: Targets and review cadence for each KRA are being finalised by the function.***




  





**Who We're Looking For**



* 8–10 years of total experience, with demonstrated people management — has directly managed a team of 5 or more
* Background in a relationship\-, trust\-, or service\-delivery function, ideally one involving sensitive or emotionally\-charged conversations
* Strong escalation handling — stays calm, decisive, and empathetic when an issue is urgent, emotional, or high\-visibility
* A track record of hiring and coaching a frontline team on tone and judgment, not just supervising for numbers
* Comfortable owning a number (trust/NPS, SLA adherence, retention) and reporting on it upward with a plan, not just a status
* Willing to travel across campuses within the zone



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience running distributed or multi\-location teams
* Exposure to trust\-building, expectation\-management, or escalation frameworks in a client\- or family\-facing context

title: Parent Relationship Head
description:
**Role Summary** 




 The Parent Relationship Head owns the parent relationship function end to end — the playbook every campus runs on, the two zonal Senior Managers, and the escalation of last resort for anything neither a Manager nor a Senior Manager can close. Because this function sits directly on parent trust, it calls for someone still early enough in their leadership career to be hands\-on and hungry to build — not someone managing an already\-mature machine. You are setting the standard once, so a parent gets the same quality of engagement whichever zone or campus their ward is on, and owning the function's standing — one trust/NPS number, company\-wide — for leadership to see.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Function ownership** 
 — set the playbook — hiring bar, SLAs, the 1:300 ratio policy, tracker and reporting standards — applied consistently across both zones
* **People leadership** 
 — hire, review, and hold accountable the two zonal Senior Managers, and keep people practices consistent across both zones
* **Escalation of last resort** 
 — pick up what neither a Manager nor a Senior Manager could close — especially anything that touches a parent's trust in NIAT or NIAT's reputation
* **Executive reporting** 
 — consolidate both zones into a single parent trust/NPS and function\-health view for leadership, rather than leaving it as two separate zonal stories
* **Education strategy** 
 — own the company\-wide parent education and communication calendar — newsletters, program updates, new\-economy career awareness
* **Cross\-functional alignment** 
 — represent the function with Program Ops, University Partnerships, the Student Relationship function, and Infrastructure \& Facilities Excellence


- 


**What Success Looks Like — Key Result Areas** 




**KRA Metric** 




**Company\-wide parent trust / NPS\-** 
 NPS rolled up across both zones
 



**Escalation\-of\-last\-resort TAT\-** 
 Time to close issues escalated past a Senior Manager
 



**Ratio policy adherence\-** 
 Company\-wide adherence to the 1:300 mapping ratio
 



**Senior Manager performance\-** 
 Both zones meeting their Senior Manager KRAs
 



**Education program reach\-** 
 % of parents reached by the quarterly education calendar
 



**Playbook adoption\-** 
 Standards (SLAs, tracker, ratio policy) applied consistently across both zones
 



*Note: Targets and review cadence for each KRA are being finalised by the function.* 




  





**Who We're Looking For** 



* 10–14 years overall experience, including several years managing managers or running a multi\-location, relationship\- or trust\-facing function
* Has personally built or meaningfully reshaped a relationship/customer\-experience playbook — not only inherited and maintained one
* Comfortable being the final escalation point on sensitive, emotionally\-charged, or reputation\-sensitive issues
* Can represent the function clearly in a review with leadership and own a company\-wide number
* Still operates hands\-on — will personally review a hard case, not only a dashboard
* Experience managing managers — has led team leads or regional managers, not only frontline staff



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience specifically in higher education, ed\-tech, or family/parent\-facing operations
* Exposure to building a trust\- or expectation\-management standard across a distributed team



  





**Growth Path** 




 This is currently the function's senior\-most role; a strong incumbent grows the scope of the function itself — more zones, a larger bench, a deeper education program — as NIAT scales.

**The Role**
 As the Director \- Customer Experience, you will own the overall customer experience charter at Snabbit across the customer journey.
   

  

 You will be responsible for building a scalable, data\-driven CX organisation that proactively identifies customer pain points, improves resolution and service quality, and works closely with Product, Operations, Technology, Marketing and Supply teams to drive customer satisfaction and retention.
   

  

 This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, operational rigour, customer obsession and strong execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the Customer Experience Charter:
* Define and own the overall CX strategy aligned with Snabbit's business and growth objectives.
* Own key CX metrics including CSAT, NPS, complaint rate, resolution time, repeat rate, cancellation rate and customer retention.
* Build a strong understanding of customer behaviour, expectations and pain points across the entire service journey.
* Establish mechanisms to continuously identify and eliminate recurring customer issues.
* Build a Scalable CX Organisation:
* Build and lead a high\-performing customer experience team across customer support, quality, escalation management and CX operations.
* Design scalable processes, SOPs, workflows and governance mechanisms as Snabbit expands across cities.
* Build the right balance between human intervention, automation and technology\-led resolution.
* Establish clear SLAs and performance standards across all customer touchpoints.
* Improve End\-to\-End Customer Journey:
* Own the customer journey from booking \- service confirmation \- partner arrival \- service delivery \- payment \- post\-service experience.
* Identify friction points and work with relevant teams to improve the overall experience.
* Create structured feedback loops between customers, operations and product teams.
* Drive initiatives to reduce customer effort and improve service reliability.
* Drive Customer Insights \& Product Improvements:
* Build a strong customer insights engine using complaints, feedback, support interactions, NPS/CSAT and behavioural data.
* Partner with Product and Technology teams to translate customer pain points into product and process improvements.
* Identify recurring issues and drive root\-cause analysis rather than simply solving individual tickets.
* Influence product roadmap through strong customer and business insights.
* Partner Closely with Operations \& Supply:
* Work closely with City Operations and Supply teams to improve service quality and reliability.
* Identify operational drivers behind customer complaints and build corrective mechanisms.
* Create feedback loops for service partners to improve quality and customer handling.
* Drive accountability across functions for customer experience outcomes.
* Build a Data\-Driven CX Culture:
* Establish dashboards and reporting mechanisms for real\-time visibility into CX performance.
* Analyse trends across city, category, service partner, issue type and customer cohort.
* Develop early\-warning mechanisms to identify potential customer experience deterioration.
* Use data to prioritise high\-impact interventions and measure their business impact.
* Customer Retention \& Business Impact:
* Go beyond ticket resolution and build CX as a lever for retention, repeat usage and customer lifetime value.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer trust, loyalty and frequency.
* Quantify the business impact of CX initiatives and continuously improve ROI.
* Build differentiated experiences that strengthen Snabbit's customer proposition.


**What We're Looking For**
* 10 \- 15\+ years of experience in Customer Experience, Customer Operations, Customer Success, Consumer Operations or related functions.
* Experience leading large\-scale CX/customer operations in a high\-growth consumer internet, marketplace, hyperlocal, services or technology business.
* Strong experience in building and scaling CX teams, processes and operating mechanisms.
* Proven ability to work cross\-functionally with Product, Technology, Operations, Analytics and Business teams.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a data\-first approach.
* Experience using technology and automation to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Strong understanding of customer metrics such as NPS, CSAT, FCR, AHT, complaint rate, resolution time and retention.
* Ability to operate effectively in a high\-ambiguity, fast\-paced startup environment.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management and team\-building skills.


**What Success Looks Like**
* A significant improvement in customer satisfaction and retention.
* Reduction in customer complaints and repeat contacts.
* Faster and more effective issue resolution.
* Improved service reliability and consistency across cities.
* A scalable CX operating model that can support Snabbit's rapid growth.
* Stronger integration between Customer Experience, Product and Operations.
* CX becoming a measurable competitive advantage for Snabbit.


**Why This Role Matters**
 At Snabbit, the customer doesn't just experience an app \- they experience the entire service journey on the ground.
   

  

 This role will be critical in ensuring that as Snabbit scales, speed does not come at the cost of quality. The Director \- CX will have the opportunity to build the systems, team and culture that define what an exceptional Snabbit customer experience looks like.

title: Key Relashionship manager-psf channel
description:
**Company Description** 
 Bajaj Life Insurance is one of India’s fastest\-growing life insurance companies, offering a broad portfolio of ULIPs, term plans, retirement, and child policies to support diverse financial goals. With over 3\.47 crore policyholders, an AUM of ₹1\.34 lakh crores, a 99\.33% claim settlement ratio, and a 266% solvency margin, the company provides robust financial protection and wealth creation solutions. Its product suite includes innovative offerings such as zero allocation charge ULIPs, specialized term plans for diabetics and women, and flexible income plans tailored to individual needs. Bajaj Life combines strong digital capabilities, including WhatsApp\-based services, with a wide distribution network of branches, consultants, and bank partnerships to ensure easy access and customer\-first service. Recognized with multiple employer and digital innovation awards, the organization fosters an inclusive, collaborative, and high\-performance culture for its 27K\+ employees.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Key Relationship Manager – PSF Channel is a full\-time, on\-site role based in New Delhi. This role focuses on managing and growing business through the PSF (Preferred/Partner Sales Force) channel by building strong relationships with channel partners and key stakeholders. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include driving sales targets, supporting partners with product knowledge, conducting regular performance reviews, and implementing sales strategies aligned with Bajaj Life’s goals. The role involves coordinating with internal teams for smooth onboarding, training, and performance enablement of channel partners, as well as ensuring high standards of customer service and compliance. The Key Relationship Manager will analyze sales data, identify growth opportunities, and proactively resolve partner and customer issues to sustain long\-term, profitable relationships.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong channel sales and channel partner management skills, with experience in driving business through partner networks.
* Proven track record in sales and sales management, including meeting or exceeding targets in financial services or related industries.
* Customer service skills with the ability to handle queries, manage expectations, and ensure positive customer experiences.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Ability to analyze data, prepare reports, and use insights to improve channel performance.
* Knowledge of life insurance products and distribution models is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, marketing, or a related field; relevant professional certifications are an advantage.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment and collaborating with cross\-functional teams on\-site in New Delhi.

title: General Manager - Business
description:
**About Us:** 




  





 We are B2B Travel Tech startup that is reshaping the way travel agents sell and deliver exceptional travel experiences worldwide. We enable travel agents to book flights, hotels \& holidays conveniently and we provide comprehensive end\-to\-end on\-ground travel services.
 **We do over INR 1000 crore\+ GMV (sales) and are growing rapidly.** 




 Our strong business model and focus on delivering excellent customer experience has facilitated our sustainable growth funded by internal cashflows.
 **To fuel innovation and growth, we have raised USD 5\.5mn\+ funds from marquee global investors!** 




  





**Our Founding Team** 




  





 • Arun Bagaria – Co\-founder, Product — Ex\-Cars24, TravelTriangle, TripFactory \| IIM Bangalore
 



 • Chirag Agrawal – Co\-founder, Business — Ex\-OYO, TravelTriangle \| IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Roorkee
 



 • Ashish Thapliyal – Co\-founder, Technology — Ex\-CTO Cars24 \| CTO FabFurnish \| Gaadi
 



  





**What do we value?** 




  




* **We are a team of believers.** 
 At the same time, we are constantly learning and growing. We are on an audacious mission and have a rock\-solid belief we can get there.
* **We dream big,** 
 yet we start small and start quickly. We are not deterred by the extra effort needed to relentlessly execute, iterate, and execute to realise our dreams.
* **We are a team of differentiated and ambitious individuals** 
 , united by a common goal. We are a single team, where every member is important.
* **We believe flexibility in** 
 roles and freedom to execute ideas are the two foundational values for aggressive growth.
* **We constantly protect and** 
 evolve our culture. As a super energetic and experienced team, we want to enjoy the time we spend together.



  





**Our philosophy is simple :** 
 when travel agents grow, we grow with them.
 



  





**Your Mission** 




  





 Own and scale a high\-growth business unit at TravClan with end\-to\-end accountability for strategy, revenue, contribution margin, customer outcomes and execution. Build the growth engine, team and operating systems required to deliver ambitious and sustainable business results
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities\-** 




  





 1\. Own the strategy and P\&L of the assigned business unit, including GMV, revenue, contribution margin, customer growth and operating costs.
 



 2\. Build and execute sales and go\-to\-market plans across acquisition, activation, retention and account expansion.
 



 3\. Identify and scale new customer segments, products, channels and partnerships based on customer insight and market opportunity.
 



 4\. Lead strategic customer and partner relationships and negotiate terms that improve margins, service quality or market access.
 



 5\. Build and lead a high\-performing team with clear goals, KPIs, decision rights and leadership depth. Run a rigorous operating cadence using data on pipeline, conversion, productivity, unit economics and customer outcomes.
 



 6\. Partner across Product, Marketing, Operations, Supply, Finance and Analytics to remove bottlenecks and deliver the business plan.
 



  





**What is on Offer ?** 



* Ownership of a meaningful business charter with direct founder access.
* The opportunity to build teams, systems and partnerships at scale.
* Competitive compensation of about 35\-50 LPA (80% fixed and 20% variable)Long\-term wealth creation through ESOPs



  





**Growth Path:** 



* GM/Director \- 35\-50 LPA
* Head \- 18\-35 LPA
* Manager \- 10\-18 LPA
* Associate \- 5\-10 LPA



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




  





 • 5\+ years of experience with significant ownership of a P\&L, business unit, category or large revenue charter.
 



 • Evidence of growing revenue and margins, not merely maintaining operations.
 



 • Strong sales, go\-to\-market, commercial and analytical capability.
 



 • Experience building teams and developing managers or second\-line leaders.
 



 • Entrepreneurial judgement, high ownership and comfort operating through ambiguity.
 



 • Relevant experience in travel, marketplaces, consumer internet, fintech, SaaS or another high\-velocity business.
 



 • Candidates should be able to quantify the P\&L managed, revenue and margin growth delivered, team size led and one business initiative they personally built or materially scaled.
 



  





**You will Thrive in This Role If....** 




  





 • You enjoy carrying a business number and owning the complete outcome.
 



 • You can move between strategy, sales, data, people and execution.
 



 • You challenge the status quo and solve root causes.
 



  





**This Role May not be the Right Fit if you.** 




  





 • You prefer advisory roles without direct revenue and execution ownership.
 



 • You are uncomfortable with ambitious targets or difficult commercial decisions.
 



 • You prefer narrowly defined responsibilities and established playbooks.
 



 • You avoid using data to diagnose performance and hold teams accountable.
 



  





**The Recruitment Process:** 




  





**1\. Personal Interviews:** 
 2\-3 video interviews. Detailed discussions about the job profile, company \& candidature are discussed in these rounds.
 



**2\. Extending an offer** 
 : On successfully clearing the interview rounds, the job offer is extended to the candidate. This includes financial benefits and many other benefits.
 



  





**Important Points** 




  





**Location** 
 : Connaught Place, New Delhi
 



 Work Schedule:
 **You are considering joining a startup. Building anything of value takes time.**

title: D2C Ecommerce Manager (From Myntra or Shopify)
description:

 A fast\-scaling D2C (Direct\-to\-Consumer) consulting firm operating across India’s high\-growth consumer brands, we help emerging \& established brands architect, launch, and scale their digital commerce engines. Specializing in omnichannel retail strategy, we partner with founders and marketing teams to build profitable, data\-driven D2C flywheels — leveraging platforms like Shopify, Myntra, and native e\-commerce tooling to drive customer lifetime value and conversion velocity.
 **Role \& Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end D2C commerce strategy — from storefront architecture and conversion funnel design to post\-purchase retention \& lifecycle automation.
* Optimize Shopify/Myntra brand stores for maximum conversion rate, AOV, and customer retention using heatmap tools, A/B testing, and behavioral analytics.
* Own P\&L for client D2C operations: drive CAC efficiency, CLTV growth, and ROAS through paid/organic channel mix optimization.
* Collaborate with UX, creative, and product teams to align visual merchandising, on\-site messaging, and product storytelling with performance KPIs.
* Deploy and manage commerce tech stack: Shopify Plus, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Postscript, Google Analytics 4, and custom checkout flows.
* Run weekly performance deep\-dives, present insights to stakeholders, and translate data into actionable growth playbooks.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Must\-Have**
* Shopify
* Myntra Marketplace
* Google Analytics 4
* Klaviyo
* A/B Testing
* Conversion Rate Optimization
* Customer Journey Mapping
* ROAS Optimization


**Preferred**
* Shopify Plus
* Postscript SMS
* Looker Studio or Tableau


**Benefits \& Culture Highlights**
* Work directly with C\-suite founders and brand leaders — your strategy directly impacts revenue and scale.
* Flexible, outcome\-driven culture with autonomy to experiment and own results.
* Access to premium tools, training budgets, and exposure to 10\+ D2C brands across fashion, beauty, and FMCG sectors.

Over 150,000 businesses use Birdeye’s AI\-powered platform to effortlessly manage online reputation, connect with prospects through social media and digital channels, and gain customer experience insights to grow sales and thrive.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
Implementation Manager
 



 Function: Customer Delivery \& Implementation \| Travel: As\-Required (customer site) \| Reports to: Head\- AI Value Delivery
 



  





 Mission
 



 Own and deliver the customer roadmap, including AI use cases and platform features end to end. The Implementation Manager is the organization's principal representative at the customer, driving delivery, stakeholder coordination, adoption, and value tracking.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 The Implementation Manager represents the organization on\-site at the customer and acts as the single point of accountability for that customer's roadmap. This role owns the relationship between the customer and internal teams (engineering, solutioning, and platform) ensuring they are aligned and mobilized around agreed customer outcomes. The Implementation Manager travels to customer sites as needed, builds and protects customer trust, and owns customer\-facing outcomes and deliverables.
 



 Each Implementation Manager manages multiple accounts at a time and is expected to develop a deep working understanding of each customer's business context, priorities, and constraints to make sound delivery and prioritization calls on their behalf.
 



 Base Location should be Delhi NCR / Bhopal.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Own and drive the customer roadmap, including AI use case delivery and adoption, from commitment through to realized value.
 



 • Represent the organization at the customer, serving as the primary point of contact and the trusted face of the organization on\-site.
 



 • Align internal engineering, solutioning, and platform teams around customer priorities; unblock cross\-team dependencies and hold internal teams accountable to customer commitments.
 



 • Travel to customer sites as required to maintain proximity, strengthen relationships, and resolve issues in person.
 



 • Build and sustain customer trust through consistent, transparent, and proactive engagement.
 



 • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of each customer's business, context, and strategic priorities.
 



 • Act as the last line of defense for all customer outcomes and deliverables, identifying risk early, escalating appropriately, and personally ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
 



 • Track and report on adoption of AI use cases and the hard\-dollar value they unlock for the customer, using the organization's value framework.
 



 • Manage scope and change requests and prioritize competing demands across accounts.
 



 • Coordinate with customer stakeholders and end users to drive adoption of delivered use cases and platform features.
 



  





 Success Metrics
 



 \-Customer Pulse \& Sentiment: Sustained customer pulse score \> 8 (on a scale of 1\-10\) based on Sutra internal framework
 



 \-AI Adoption: Adoption rate of delivered AI use cases across the customer's teams and workflows.
 



 \-Value Delivered: Hard\-dollar value unlocked for the customer, measured against the organizational value framework.
 



  





 Focus Areas (Outcomes)
 



 • Delivery: owning execution of the customer roadmap end to end and a sustained healthy customer sentiment.
 



 • Coordination: aligning internal stakeholders and engaging customer stakeholders and users.
 



 • Adoption: driving uptake of AI use cases and platform features.
 



 • Value Tracking: measuring and communicating realized customer value.
 



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 • Proven experience in business transformation and customer\-facing implementation ideally in AI, SaaS
 



 • 10\-12 years of technical project management experience, ideally in AI, data, or software development projects.
 



 • Experience in Industrial domain (manufacturing, supply chain, production)
 



 • Working knowledge of AI sufficient to engage credibly with customer and technical stakeholders.
 



 • Strong stakeholder management skills
 



 • Ability to align and influence cross\-functional teams (engineering, solutioning, platform) without direct authority.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, and multiple concurrent accounts.
 



 • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with executive presence.
 



 • Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites as required

title: Growth Manager - Enterprise Growth (Digital Commerce)
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 GobbleCube is an agentic growth operating system designed to help brands scale profitably across digital marketplaces. Founded in November 2022 by the ex\- core team of Blinkit, the platform went live commercially from private beta in September 2024\.
 



  





 Since then, GobbleCube has scaled rapidly, supporting 600\+ brands across enterprise and D2C, growing revenue 10X, and onboarding 45 of India’s largest CPG enterprises in just the last 9 months, including HUL, Nivea, Tata Consumer Products, ITC, Godrej, Beiersdorf, MTR, L’Oréal, Hershey’s, and many more.
 



  





 As commerce becomes more distributed and hyperlocal, GobbleCube is building agentic solutions to help brands navigate complexity in real time, across visibility, performance marketing, supply chain, and growth strategy. Headquartered in Gurugram, the company supports brands across India, MENA, and LATAM.
 



  





**About the role** 




 India's largest CPG brands do business worth hundreds of crores every year on Quick Commerce platforms. They lose share for reasons invisible from a 360 dashboard: a dark\-store availability gap, a competitor outbidding them on a category keyword, a discount ladder that buys volume at the cost of contribution margin.
 



 GobbleCube finds those reasons. Your job is to walk into the brand's boardroom, tell the CXO what is happening, recommend what to do about it, and get a room of senior people who might disagree to commit to a decision.
 



  





**What this role is not** 




 This is not a marketing growth role. No funnel, no CAC, no acquisition budget, and no performance campaigns to run. If you are a growth marketer, this isn't the job you want.
 



 This is also not a traditional Customer Success role. You are not measured on tickets closed, QBR decks delivered, or logins. Nobody here will ask you to "drive adoption."
 



 The closest analogue is what an MBB consultant does for a CPG client, except you do it under a productised strategic consulting environment, for India's largest CPG brands at once, with a product doing the work in the background.
 



  





**What you will actually do** 



* Run regular strategic connects (online and in\-person both) with each account's senior leadership. Not a status update. A point of view on their business, and recommendations backed by data, to drive their business objectives.
* Diagnose why an output metric moved: market share, offtake, margin, etc. Decompose it into availability, visibility, discounting and supply chain. Then decide what is worth acting on.
* Take a difficult position to a senior stakeholder and make it land. Frequently the recommendation is "stop doing the thing that makes your number this month."
* Build the quarterly impact story: problem identified, action recommended, outcome achieved, revenue or share impact, in the brand's own numbers.
* Find the next business problem worth solving, prove it in a pilot, and convert it into expansion revenue.
* Turn what worked on one account into a repeatable SOP or a product requirement, so the ninth account does not need a ninth person.



  





**Who you will be in the room with** 




 CMOs, Sales Heads, E\-commerce Heads, Supply Chain Heads, occasionally CFOs. They are senior, have limited face time, and each of them wants something different from the same budget. Their KAMs and brand managers are your day\-to\-day.
 



  





**What makes this different from consulting** 




 The dogwork is automated. RCA, data pulls, anomaly detection, competitive tracking, and most of the analysis run through the product and agentic workflows in the backend. You are deciding what the analysis means, what to recommend (the right action at the right time), and how to get it approved. That is also the bar. When the analysis is free, the analysis is not the value. Your judgement is.
 



  





**How you will be measured** 



* Net revenue retention across your portfolio. Zero downsell, plus expansion.
* A documented, quantified impact story per account per quarter.
* Pilot\-to\-conversion rate on expansion modules.
* Qualified expansion opportunities briefed to GTM with a written business case.
* No account goes Amber without you flagging it first.
* Strategic connect coverage and conversation quality across your book.



  





**You will do well here if** 



* You can hold your position when a senior stakeholder tells you your data is wrong, without either backing down or repeating "the data says so."
* You are comfortable being the least senior person in the room and still owning the recommendation.
* You end conversations with an owner, a decision, a metric and a review date, rather than with an action\-items list.
* You would rather be right in eight weeks than agreeable today.



  





**You will struggle here if** 



* You need a clean brief before you can start.
* You want analysis to be your main contribution.
* Confrontation with senior stakeholders drains you.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's from a Tier 1 institute (IIT, IIM, ISB and equivalent).
* 3\-7 years in management consulting, strategy and ops, growth, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS company. Consumer or retail exposure is a strong plus.
* Structured problem\-solving you can demonstrate live, not just describe.
* Presentation and stakeholder management skills at CXO level.
* Strong Excel. Enough SQL to interrogate an analysis and find the hole in it.

title: Technology Account Lead
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Technology Account Lead
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Function as primary contact for technology work at each account. Integrate technology contracts and engagements at the client. Leverage all technology offerings to expand the scope of technology work at the account (up\-sell/cross\-sell). Create the technology account plan and get the right people involved to maximize the opportunity and build the account.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Delivery Excellence
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Delivery Operations Control
   

  

**Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Delivery Lead is responsible for coordinating end\-to\-end delivery of services to key enterprise customers, including execution oversight across programs/projects/contracted services, and monitoring, managing, and reporting on deliverables and service performance. The role requires experience in a multinational environment and familiarity with Business Excellence frameworks and/or service delivery practices
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead and/or support development of supplier/vendor/sub\-contractor strategy for service delivery operations.
   

  

 Identify, understand, and implement tools/initiatives that drive efficiency gains across delivery.
   

  

 Manage recruiting, staffing, pyramid mix, utilization, and capacity planning to balance cost and delivery targets.
   

  

 Resolve delivery performance issues in collaboration with delivery leadership and stakeholders.
   

  

 Support and contribute to strategic initiatives that improve delivery outcomes for clients by partnering with relevant internal teams
   

  

 Formalize delivery plans with service group delivery leadership and ensure execution across one or more delivery operations.
   

  

 Drive efficiencies through standard processes, synergies, and continuous improvement levers (e.g., operational excellence / Six Sigma).
   

  

 Manage supply and demand, service quality, and delivery processes to meet expectations, while continuously improving methods and outcomes.
   

  

 Proactively strengthen customer relationships through regular engagement, partnering with Client Account and Account Delivery leadership.
   

  

 Deliver the agreed scope of services while driving profitability improvements and productivity gains.
   

  

 Manage and reduce costs on standard offerings, assets, technologies, licenses, and facilities where applicable.
   

  

 Implement and track SLAs and associated financial/operational metrics support achievement of contract controllable income (CCI) and cost\-to\-serve targets.
   

  

 Support estimate\-at\-completion (EAC) adjustments when required and drive year\-on\-year efficiencies with delivery service providers.
   

  

 Act as an escalation point for delivery managers/project managers and clients to ensure customer satisfaction and timely resolution of concerns.
   

  

 Own service delivery across operations including incident and change management (as applicable to the delivery scope).
   

  

 Participate in account quality review processes and engage in the quality assurance program as required.
   

  

 Review and validate standard solutions/models for new deals and take accountability for execution/completion.
   

  

 Track duties and deliverables across multiple project managers and their respective projects to ensure delivery governance and control.
   

  

 Lead career management for service delivery staff (training, engagement, mentoring, succession planning, and annual performance processes).
   

  

 Act as a subject matter expert (SME), providing deep expertise and guidance to teams to optimize delivery of standard solutions.
   

  

**Required Skills / Competencies (Must Have)**
 Strong oral and written English communication skills with ability to engage directly with clients.
   

  

 Proven leadership capabilities with ability to motivate teams to meet goals and deadlines.
   

  

 Conflict resolution and negotiation skills to balance customer needs with organizational priorities
   

  

 Effective delegation and execution management ability to produce clear, functional reports for technical and non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 Ability to lead complex projects/programs where new services/tools may be introduced or created strong problem identification and action orientation
   

  

 Capability to monitor performance, identify improvement opportunities, and drive service improvement activities with clients and operations teams.
   

  

 Experience working with global teams and offshore/nearshore delivery models.
   

  

 Strong client management and relationship\-building experience.
   

  

**Preferred Skills (Good To Have)**
 Certifications such as PMP / Agile / Scrum / Six Sigma.
   

  

 Experience Guidelines (Adjustable per Level)
   

  

 10\+ years leading delivery (program/project/service delivery) with demonstrated ownership of SLA and operational outcomes.
   

  

 15\+ years of client management and relationship\-building experience (where applicable to role scope).
   

  

 Success Measures (What Good Looks Like)
   

  

 Consistent SLA adherence and strong customer satisfaction through effective escalation management.
   

  

 Improved delivery efficiency through standardization, synergies, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Strong financial discipline via CCI, cost\-to\-serve targets, and accurate EAC governance.
   

  

 Healthy staffing/utilization and capability development through mentoring, training, and succession planning.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About the Opportunity**




**Role:** 
 Key Account Management
 



**Level:** 
 Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Zonal Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



  





**About the Function:**




 MakeMyTrip is one of the largest and fastest\-growing verticals within the organization, driving exceptional travel experiences for millions of customers every year. With a strong focus on customer delight, technology\-led innovation, and deep partnerships, the Hotels team curates and manages an extensive portfolio of domestic and international stays across leisure and business destinations. The function works closely with supply partners, revenue management, marketing, product, and operations teams to ensure the right balance of availability, pricing, and quality delivering unmatched value to travelers while strengthening partner relationships.
 



  





 The International Hotel Supply team expertly manages the supply portfolio of over 17,000 prestigious hotels across the globe, covering iconic travel destinations such as Dubai, the Maldives, Sri Lanka, Bali, Thailand, Malaysia, and many others.
 



  





**About the Role:**




 This role will be a part of International Hotel Supply team for international locations where the incumbent will be responsible for driving on\-boarding of new hotels within the assigned territory and generate revenue from acquired partners.
 



  





**What will you be doing:**




  





**1\. Relationship \& Key Account Management:** 



* The person will be responsible for connecting and engaging with top level management of the branded and independent hotels and will be responsible for the account management of key chain hotels and driving sustainable performance of the account at a unit level across the portfolio.
* Collaborating with partners in the portfolio and providing expertise, metrics, analysis and recommendations based on the industry's best practices.



**2\. Portfolio Management \& Driving Growth for units:** 



* Grow net revenue in the market by producing business plans to achieve revenue goals, ensuring inventory levels exceed demand throughout the market, ensuring rate competitiveness across multiple available platforms



**3\. Data Analysis and Reporting:** 



* Establish and maintain supplier relationships, train partner hotels on our extranet and the wholesale business, review monthly production reports and provide feedback to top producing hotels, plan and execute market site visits
* Building MIS \& market intelligence reports, preparing geography wise and service wise sales plans and achieving them. Sharing insights on market and industry with the clients and internal stake holders



**4\. Negotiation Skills:** 



* Networking, deal initiating, negotiation \& closing deals with our partners
* Strategize in order to market the hotel in a better way. It helps hotel partners to serve the needs of their customers and at the same time grow their businesses



  





**Qualification \& Experience:**



* MBA from a reputed institute with 2 to 5 years of experience working in sales, account \& client management, contracting and relationship management.
* Prefer someone from internet/ e\-commerce industry.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent personal and interpersonal skills to interact with a diverse set of individuals, including building strong partnerships with other teams and departments.
* Ability to work under pressure in a competitive industry/rapidly changing environment.



  





**Key Success Factors for the Role:**




  




* Mindset that will constantly think about Return on Investment, business.
* Strong communication, Influencing skills, great interpersonal \& stakeholder management skills.
* High on energy, team player coupled with a great attitude.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and MS PowerPoint is essential.

title: Lender Relationship Manager (Credit)
description:
**About Recur Club** 




  





 Recur Club is an AI\-native debt marketplace transforming how startups and SMEs access growth capital. Founded in 2021, we leverage real\-time business data and proprietary underwriting technology to connect high\-quality businesses with the right lenders\-enabling faster, smarter, and non\-dilutive financing.
 



  





 We raised $50M in Series A funding, led by Info Edge Ventures and Village Global, with participation from prominent global investors including Y Combinator, Titan Capital, and R8 Capital further accelerating our mission to make capital more accessible, faster, and more efficient for growing businesses.
 



  





 Powering this ecosystem is AICA (AI Credit Assistant) — our in\-house AI\-led infrastructure enabling faster underwriting, smarter risk assessment, and seamless credit decisioning at scale.
 



 We are also the force behind Bharat Ke Super Founders — India’s premier startup show, where bold
 



 founders pitch their ideas to top investors for real capital, with a ₹100 crore investment pool backing the next wave of entrepreneurs. With 2,000\+ businesses served and ₹3,000\+ crore in capital disbursed, we’re building the future of financing for growing companies.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  




* As a Lender Relationships Manager (Credit), you will own lender engagement and case progression once a
* loan application has been logged in. While our operations team handles the login process, you will work
* directly with lender relationship managers, partnership teams, and credit decision\-makers to secure
* sanctions and drive disbursals.
* This is not a loan\-processing role. It requires someone who can understand a lender\&\#39;s credit concerns, build
* a credible case for reconsideration, negotiate justified deviations, and take ownership of moving
* transactions forward.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Drive sanctions and disbursals: Own post\-login case progression across lenders, proactively follow up with relevant stakeholders, resolve bottlenecks, and keep cases moving towards closure.
* Lead credit discussions and reconsiderations: Review rejected or stalled applications, understand the underlying credit concerns, and present supporting information and risk mitigants to seek reconsideration \- not simply resubmit the same file.
* Negotiate deviations and loan terms: Work with lender credit teams to secure justified policy deviations through the appropriate approvals. Negotiate competitive interest rates, suitable ticket sizes, and longer tenures based on the borrower;s profile.
* Own lender relationships across levels: Build and manage relationships with lender relationship managers, partnership teams, regional and zonal teams, and credit heads. Identify and engage the right decision\-makers to resolve case\-specific issues.
* Apply lender\-policy knowledge: Maintain a strong understanding of each lender\&\#39;s eligibility criteria, credit policies, negative lists, and serviceable pincodes. Use this knowledge to assess lender fit and identify potential approval challenges.
* Coordinate internal resolution: Work closely with sales and operations teams to address lender queries, obtain supporting information, and resolve requirements that could delay sanction or disbursal.
* Maintain accurate case tracking: Keep every live case updated with its current status, pending requirements, next steps, and expected timelines. Flag delays and risks proactively and communicate outcomes transparently.



  





**Required Experience and Skills** 




  




* 4\-8 years of relevant experience in business loans or unsecured business loans within an NBFC or fintech.
* Experience in credit management, lender or bank relations, or credit/backend leadership, with direct exposure to lender credit teams.
* Demonstrated experience in converting logged\-in applications into sanctions and disbursals.
* A track record of securing reconsideration of rejected cases through substantive credit discussions and supporting evidence.
* Strong knowledge of lender policies, negative lists, pincode eligibility, credit assessment criteria, and deviation requirements.
* The ability to assess borrower profiles, explain credit strengths and risks, and present appropriate mitigants.
* Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, follow\-through, and case\-tracking skills.



  





**What We Look For** 




  





 You take ownership beyond follow\-ups. You know when to challenge a rejection, when to escalate, and
 



 when a case is unlikely to proceed. You are persistent in pursuing viable cases while respecting lender credit requirements.
 



 You also communicate honestly. When a case slips or a commitment is at risk, you flag it early, explain the issue, and take responsibility for the next steps.
 



  





**Working Environment** 




 This is a fast\-paced, execution\-focused role where consistent effort is expected throughout the month \- not only at month\-end. You should be comfortable managing multiple live cases, navigating lender escalations, and being accountable for disbursals.

Manager, People Operations – APAC  

  

We’re looking for a dynamic People Operations Manager for our APAC region (Japan, China, Hong Kong, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, India) to drive operational excellence and lead our People Ops team across the APAC region. This is a people manager role that combines strategic thinking with hands\-on execution. You’ll be responsible for delivering exceptional employee experiences, leading regional HR initiatives, managing day\-to\-day People Operations tasks, ensuring operational excellence and leading a high\-performing APAC People Operations team.
  

  

As a trusted leader, you’ll work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders, regional managers, and global HR colleagues to bring consistent, high\-quality People Operations support throughout the employee lifecycle and focussing on operational excellence. This role will be reporting directly to the Senior Director, People Operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage the APAC People Operations team, providing coaching, guidance, and career development.
* Oversee the execution of core HR processes across the region — onboarding, offboarding, HRIS transactions, employee job changes, benefits, and immigration.
* Ensure compliance with local labor laws and internal policies across APAC locations.
* Partner with the global People team on company\-wide projects, bringing an APAC lens to HR initiatives.

* Build strong relationships with employees and managers, delivering proactive support and timely resolution of People\-related queries.

* Lead training initiatives and enablement programs for employees and managers in maintaining operational efficiency and self\-serve initiatives.
* Lead global and APAC internal audits and also manage people systems audit ensuring data integrity and compliance.
* Own or co\-lead strategic People Operations projects that enhance employee experience and operational excellence in the region.
* Generate and analyze HR metrics and reports to inform decision\-making, support the rest of the People Team with reporting and data insights.

**Qualifications \& Skills**:

* 6 \- 8\+ years of progressive HR/People Operations experience, with at least 2 years in a managerial or team lead capacity.

* A passion for building scalable processes and improving employee experiences.

Hyderabad

October/November 2026

description:
