 \- Own category revenue, gross margin, market share and growth objectives.
   

 \- Develop annual business plans covering:
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Unit volumes
   

 \- ASP
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- Channel mix
   

 \- Geographic expansion
   

 \- Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and applications for orthopedic power systems.
   

 \- Develop category growth strategies for India and selected international markets.
   

 \- Track competitors, pricing, technology, product launches and market positioning.
   

 \- Identify gaps in Manman’s portfolio and recommend new products or product variants.
   

  

 B. Product Portfolio Management
   

  

 Own the complete Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio, including relevant:
   

  

 \- High\-speed drill systems
   

 \- Large\-bone systems
   

 \- Small\-bone systems
   

 \- Saw systems
   

 \- Oscillating/sagittal saws
   

 \- Reciprocating saws
   

 \- Shaver systems
   

 \- Endoscopic burr systems
   

 \- Attachments
   

 \- Handpieces
   

 \- Accessories
   

 \- Consumables
   

 \- Batteries and chargers
   

 \- Related service and AMC offerings
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Define product positioning and target customer for each product.
   

 \- Maintain the product portfolio and product lifecycle.
   

 \- Identify products requiring upgrades, replacement or discontinuation.
   

 \- Develop product roadmaps in coordination with R\&D and Engineering.
   

 \- Define product specifications based on market and clinical requirements.
   

 \- Gather voice\-of\-customer and surgeon feedback.
   

 \- Convert clinical requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering/R\&D.
   

  

 C. Product Development \& New Product Introduction
   

  

 \- Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for new products.
   

 \- Work with Engineering/R\&D on product development priorities.
   

 \- Coordinate prototype evaluation with surgeons and key opinion leaders.
   

 \- Organize clinical/user evaluations and product trials.
   

 \- Coordinate with Quality \& Regulatory for required documentation and approvals.
   

 \- Develop launch plans for new products.
   

 \- Establish product readiness gates before commercial launch.
   

 \- Coordinate first production, field trials and commercial release.
   

  

 D. Pricing \& Commercial Management
   

  

 \- Develop product pricing strategy based on:
   

 \- Manufacturing cost
   

 \- Landed cost
   

 \- Competitor pricing
   

 \- Clinical value
   

 \- Channel margins
   

 \- Customer segment
   

 \- Market positioning
   

 \- Recommend MRP, distributor/dealer pricing and institutional pricing.
   

 \- Monitor discounting and price realization.
   

 \- Develop tender and institutional pricing frameworks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve category gross margin.
   

 \- Monitor profitability by product, customer segment and channel.
   

  

 E. Sales Enablement
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales team to increase conversion and category penetration.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop sales presentations and product literature.
   

 \- Create product comparison sheets.
   

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

 Zendesk

 Zendesk is seeking an experienced Senior Director to lead and develop the Global Delivery Hub based in Pune, India. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving the vision, execution, and growth of our consulting and staffing business operations in India. You will oversee end\-to\-end delivery excellence, manage key client relationships, lead a diverse team of talented professionals, and ensure our India operations support global business objectives while maintaining the highest standards of service delivery and client satisfaction.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on Zendesk's global services strategy, shape the future of our delivery capabilities, and build and mentor a world\-class organization.

title: FAAS -Global Treasury Services -Manager
description:
Locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Jose, Seattle, Tampa, Miami, Hoboken
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives
* Maintain a strong client focus by being responsive to client requests and developing/maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel.
* Collaborate with the partner and client to determine a strategy that appropriately addresses risk and manages client expectations relating to deliverables, understanding the client’s industry, key performance drivers, business trends and industry developments
* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. title: Manager, Digital Systems
description:
**Job Title:\-** Manager, Digital Systems


Req:R0097261


No. of Vacancies: 1 position


Location: Pune (Koregaon Park), India.


Full\-time/Part\-time: Full\-time


**Company Overview:**

Sandvik’s Intelligent Manufacturing is on an exciting growth journey, building the new digital era of manufacturing. Our digital manufacturing solutions automate and connect the component manufacturing value chain – from design and planning to preparation, production and verification. Our objective is to make the shift towards efficient and sustainable manufacturing. As the market leader in CAM and metrology software, with a global footprint and over 400,000 software licenses, we have a unique foundation to build on . Please read more about us here .


At Mastercam, we do not just keep pace with manufacturing—we set the pace. For over 40 years, we have been the name behind the breakthroughs, the partner for those who refuse to settle. When the industry says “too complex,” we say, “challenge accepted.”


We are more than software. We are a movement of makers, innovators, and problem\-solvers driving transformation across the globe.


Backed by a network of 400 Channel Partners and a thriving developer community, Mastercam delivers the tools and expertise to turn ambitious ideas into flawless reality. From aerospace to automotive, medical to education, we empower manufacturers to push boundaries and redefine what is possible.


As part of Intelligent Manufacturing and the Sandvik Group, we are leading the charge in digital transformation. Our team of 500\+ professionals is united by a single mission: to help achieve precision, productivity, and performance without compromise.


**Our Core Values? They are not just words. They are how we win:**

* **Winning Together:** Collaboration is not optional—it is the engine that drives us.
* **Curiosity:** We question, we explore, we innovate. Every day.
* **Responsibility:** Safety, integrity, and sustainability aren’t boxes to check—they are the foundation of trust.
* **Customer\-Focused:** We listen. We adapt. We deliver. Always.

Innovation. Collaboration. Growth. That is the Mastercam way. Explore more at www.mastercam.com , connect on LinkedIn , and join the conversation with \#mastercam.


The next big challenge is waiting—are you ready to accept?


**Position Overview:**

Mastercam seeks a Manager of Digital Systems in India who is responsible for the day\-to\-day leadership, coordination, staffing, and development of Digital Systems resources located in India.


The Manager, Digital Systems supports Digital Enablement, Digital Experience, and Digital Integrations teams, serving as the primary local people leader while partnering closely with global functional leaders to ensure successful delivery of business and technology initiatives.


**Key Responsibilities:**

**Leadership \& People Management**

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop Digital Systems team members across multiple disciplines, including business systems, customer\-facing digital platforms, and enterprise integrations.
* Establish clear performance expectations, goals, and career development plans.
* Conduct regular one\-on\-one meetings, performance evaluations, and development discussions.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, succession planning, and workforce development efforts.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
* Serve as the primary local manager for India\-based Digital Systems team members.

**Delivery \& Portfolio Management**

* Partner with Product Owners, Architects, and Digital Systems leaders to align resources against strategic priorities.
* Coordinate project delivery, sprint execution, resource allocation, capacity planning, and production support activities.
* Monitor delivery metrics, team workload, and project health to proactively identify risks and remove obstacles.
* Ensure enhancement requests, defects, incidents, and technical debt are appropriately prioritized and addressed.
* Contribute to roadmap planning and execution across the broader Digital Systems organization.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Facilitate communication between India\-based teams and global leadership.
* Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical execution.
* Help establish consistent development, integration, and support practices across all Digital Systems teams.

**Requirements** :


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Salesforce, MuleSoft, Agile, Scrum, or related certifications a plus.
* 7\+ years of experience in software development, enterprise systems, digital platforms, integrations, or related technology disciplines.
* 3\+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical teams.
* Experience working with Agile development methodologies and software delivery processes.
* Experience supporting enterprise business systems, customer\-facing digital platforms, or integration technologies.
* Demonstrated success managing both project delivery and production support responsibilities.
* Strong communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
* Proven ability to lead teams across multiple technology domains and business functions.
* Experience leveraging AI\-enabled tools or automation to improve productivity and operational effectiveness, or a demonstrated ability to rapidly learn, evaluate, and apply such technologies at scale.

**Key Competencies**

* Above average communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to provide accurate and timely information in a succinct and easy to understand manner.
* Proven time management skills and a track record of working in a team environment successfully supporting others.
* Well\-organized, attention to detail and able to multi\-task.
* Problem solving and analysis skills.

This role will focus on integrating an acquired company (to be acquired) to Mastercam per Sandvik's and Mastercam's program and processes \- from a compliance and financial controls perspective.


As the integration work will go down over time, the role is expected to take broader BA wide responsibilities e.g. under the common Sandvik compliance program (and also locally for the Hub and our other local business).

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Senior Director, Global Delivery Hub – Pune, India**
======================================================

Zendesk  



  

**Position Overview**
---------------------

Zendesk is seeking an experienced Senior Director to lead and develop the Global Delivery Hub based in Pune, India. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving the vision, execution, and growth of our consulting and staffing business operations in India. You will oversee end\-to\-end delivery excellence, manage key client relationships, lead a diverse team of talented professionals, and ensure our India operations support global business objectives while maintaining the highest standards of service delivery and client satisfaction.


This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on Zendesk's global services strategy, shape the future of our delivery capabilities, and build and mentor a world\-class organization.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Strategic Vision \& Business Leadership**

 Develop and execute the strategic vision and roadmap for the Zendesk Global Delivery Hub in India, aligned with overall business goals and growth initiatives


 Lead the entire India AI consulting, data migration and custom development teams, driving customer adoption, growth and operational excellence


 Partner with Global Services leadership team on strategic planning and execution to support global business requirements through India\-based delivery capabilities


 Enable cross\-region coordination between global clients and India delivery teams to ensure seamless service delivery  



  

### **Client \& Stakeholder Management**

 Manage key client relationships and serve as the primary executive stakeholder for major accounts


 Oversee multiple project delivery teams to ensure client satisfaction for customer engagements


 Drive client satisfaction, retention, and account growth initiatives


 Maintain focus on understanding client needs and driving continuous improvements in service delivery  



  

### **Delivery Operations \& Quality**

 Oversee end\-to\-end consulting and staffing delivery operations


 Ensure delivery quality, productivity, and fulfillment metrics meet or exceed established targets


 Establish effective governance structures, processes, and performance metrics to ensure efficient, cost\-effective operations aligned with global customer priorities


 Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance capabilities, productivity, and service delivery  



  

### **Organizational Leadership \& Development**

 Lead and develop the Global delivery organization in India, including recruiting, delivery, and operations teams


 Oversee hiring, performance management, KPIs, and organizational planning


 Build engaged, productive teams that collaborate effectively across roles, departments, locations, and external partners


 Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and employee development


 Energize and inspire people through empowerment, recognition, and passion  



  

### **Operational Excellence \& Scalability**

 Develop and optimize operational processes to enable scalability and growth


 Collaborate with Finance, HR, Compliance, Recruiting, and Operations to drive organizational effectiveness


 Mitigate risk and solve complex problems through innovative and out\-of\-the\-box thinking


 Manage continuity, change, and transition effectively in a dynamic environment  



  

### **Leadership \& Culture**

 Embody and model Zendesk values, mission, and vision


 Demonstrate integrity, develop people, and build high\-performing teams


 Drive organizational change and influence others toward shared goals


 Address the impact of attitude and action on the organization and its participants  



  

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
-----------------------------------------

 15\+ years of progressive leadership experience in consulting, services delivery, staffing, or professional services organizations


 10\+ years of senior leadership experience managing P\&L, large teams, and complex operations at a regional or global scale


 Proven track record of building and scaling high\-performing organizations from the ground up


 Demonstrated success driving revenue growth, profitability, and operational efficiency


 Experience managing key strategic client relationships and driving client satisfaction and retention


 Experience operating successfully in matrix organization structures


 Strong background in recruiting, talent development, and performance management


 Experience implementing operational improvements and continuous optimization initiatives


 Knowledge of India market dynamics and experience operating India\-based delivery centers highly preferred


 Experience in AI, technology services, or customer\-centric delivery models preferred


 Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced business qualification preferred  



  

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

  

### **Customer Focus**

Strives for customer success and exceeds expectations by understanding client needs and driving meaningful improvements in products and services. Takes a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to enhance the customer experience.  



  

### **Team Collaboration**

Builds engaged, productive teams while sharing knowledge and collaborating effectively across roles, departments, and locations. Extends collaboration externally with partners and customers. Creates an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and leveraged.  



  

### **Motivation \& Engagement**

Energizes and inspires teams through empowerment, recognition, and genuine passion for excellence. Manages continuity, change, and transition with grace. Skillfully influences and enables others to achieve shared objectives. Understands the impact of attitude and action on organizational success.  



  

### **Leading Change**

Possesses the skills and implements the functions of a transformational leader. Shares and communicates the company's values, mission, and vision effectively. Consistently displays integrity, models desired behaviors, develops talent, and builds strong, cohesive teams. Navigates organizational change while maintaining team morale and performance.  



  

### **Innovation \& Problem\-Solving**

Mitigates risk and solves complex problems through innovative, out\-of\-the\-box thinking and creative problem\-solving approaches. Challenges conventional wisdom and drives continuous improvement.  



  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

We are seeking a strategic, visionary leader with an entrepreneurial mindset who can build and scale an exceptional delivery organization in India. The ideal candidate will:


 Have a genuine passion for building world\-class organizations and developing talent


 Demonstrate a customer\-first mentality and commitment to exceeding client expectations


 Bring strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities


 Show comfort operating in ambiguity and driving results in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment


 Possess strong financial acumen and business judgment


 Display emotional intelligence and the ability to inspire diverse teams


 Be a strong communicator with excellent presentation skills for executive\-level audiences


 Have experience navigating complex organizational structures and stakeholder dynamics  



  

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.


Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration \- while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in\-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.


**The intelligent heart of customer experience**

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.


Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.


As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.


Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, \& inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e\-mail to peopleandplaces@zendesk.com with your specific accommodation request.

-----------------------


* On\-time and quality delivery of programs.
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) and NPS scores.
* Revenue growth and margin achievement.
* Resource utilization and talent retention.
* Delivery excellence and operational efficiency.
* Successful execution of strategic digital transformation initiatives.

title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------


AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.  

  

As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.  

In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.**Your Impact**
---------------

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 14 \+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


Regional travel up to 35%.


\#LI\-RK1

description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an Account Success Manager to manage and strengthen relationships with existing clients. The candidate will be responsible for staying regularly connected with clients, understanding their needs, coordinating support, following up on issues, and ensuring smooth ongoing engagement with BeFiSc.
 



 The ideal candidate should be relationship\-oriented, organized, proactive, and comfortable working with internal teams to resolve client requirements. This role is focused on client satisfaction, account health, retention, and maintaining the business relationship after onboarding.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 Maintain regular communication with assigned clients and build strong, long\-term working relationships.
 



 Understand client requirements, product usage, concerns, and support needs through consistent follow\-ups.
 



 Coordinate with Product, Technology, Operations, Support, and Business teams to resolve client issues and requests.
 



 Track client queries, escalations, pending actions, and commitments to ensure timely closure.
 



 Monitor account health, client satisfaction, usage patterns, and potential risks to the relationship.
 



 Support client onboarding, product adoption, training coordination, and usage improvement where required.
 



 Prepare client updates, meeting notes, action trackers, status reports, and account summaries.
 



 Identify opportunities to improve client experience, internal response quality, and account management processes.
 



 Help maintain existing business by ensuring clients receive timely assistance, clear communication, and reliable support.
 



**Required Skills** 




 Strong client relationship management and customer success skills.
 



 Good communication, follow\-up, and stakeholder coordination abilities.
 



 Ability to understand client requirements, concerns, and business priorities.
 



 Good problem\-solving ability with a structured approach to issue tracking and resolution.
 



 Ability to coordinate effectively with Product, Technology, Operations, Support, and Business teams.
 



 Comfort with documentation, meeting notes, account trackers, status reports, and follow\-up records.
 



 Comfort with tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, CRM tools, ticketing systems, or similar productivity tools.
 



 Ownership, accountability, patience, attention to detail, and service orientation.
 



**Required Qualifications and Experience**

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Portfolio Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
   

  

 You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
   

  

 This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at\-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re\-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow\-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.


**What You’ll Need**
* Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
* Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
* Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
* Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
* Excellent organization, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property\-management platform, or workflow\-management system.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
* Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work full\-time during Eastern Time business hours.
* Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.


 Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring\-service industry will be considered.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.
   

  

 Who Will Succeed
   

  

 The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.
   

  

 You are client\-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.
   

  

**Compensation**
 The annual compensation range is
 **C$30,000–C$36,000** 
 , based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre\-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.
   

  

 See All Open Roles

title: Technology Account Lead
description:

Leverage all technology offerings to expand the scope of technology work at the account (up\-sell/cross\-sell). Create the technology account plan and get the right people involved to maximize the opportunity and build the account.

**Good to have skills :** Delivery Operations Control

Role Summary  

The Delivery Lead is responsible for coordinating end\-to\-end delivery of services to key enterprise customers, including execution oversight across programs/projects/contracted services, and monitoring, managing, and reporting on deliverables and service performance. The role requires experience in a multinational environment and familiarity with Business Excellence frameworks and/or service delivery practices  

Key Responsibilities  

Lead and/or support development of supplier/vendor/sub\-contractor strategy for service delivery operations.  

Identify, understand, and implement tools/initiatives that drive efficiency gains across delivery.

Resolve delivery performance issues in collaboration with delivery leadership and stakeholders.

Act as an escalation point for delivery managers/project managers and clients to ensure customer satisfaction and timely resolution of concerns.  

Own service delivery across operations including incident and change management (as applicable to the delivery scope).  

Participate in account quality review processes and engage in the quality assurance program as required.  

Review and validate standard solutions/models for new deals and take accountability for execution/completion.  

Track duties and deliverables across multiple project managers and their respective projects to ensure delivery governance and control.  

Lead career management for service delivery staff (training, engagement, mentoring, succession planning, and annual performance processes).  

Act as a subject matter expert (SME), providing deep expertise and guidance to teams to optimize delivery of standard solutions.  

Required Skills / Competencies (Must Have)  

Strong oral and written English communication skills with ability to engage directly with clients.  

Proven leadership capabilities with ability to motivate teams to meet goals and deadlines.  

Conflict resolution and negotiation skills to balance customer needs with organizational priorities  

Effective delegation and execution management ability to produce clear, functional reports for technical and non\-technical audiences.  

Ability to lead complex projects/programs where new services/tools may be introduced or created strong problem identification and action orientation  

Capability to monitor performance, identify improvement opportunities, and drive service improvement activities with clients and operations teams.  

Experience working with global teams and offshore/nearshore delivery models.  

Strong client management and relationship\-building experience.  

Preferred Skills (Good to Have)  

Certifications such as PMP / Agile / Scrum / Six Sigma.  

Experience Guidelines (Adjustable per Level)  

10\+ years leading delivery (program/project/service delivery) with demonstrated ownership of SLA and operational outcomes.  

15\+ years of client management and relationship\-building experience (where applicable to role scope).  

Success Measures (What Good Looks Like)  

Consistent SLA adherence and strong customer satisfaction through effective escalation management.  

Improved delivery efficiency through standardization, synergies, and continuous improvement.  

Strong financial discipline via CCI, cost\-to\-serve targets, and accurate EAC governance.  

Healthy staffing/utilization and capability development through mentoring, training, and succession planning.

description:

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Track record of delivering IT Service Management (ITIL) infrastructure projects within a technically complex and dynamic environment, specifically that required to support multiple business.


* In Systems Management at Kyndryl, you will be critical in ensuring the smooth operation of our customers’ IT infrastructure.

* Establish a quality management system: tracking of project milestones, quality and KPIs

* Train and mentor other team members
* Participate in daily Operations meetings.
* Experience of managing business change
* Hands\-on experience on tools such as SCRUM, service snow JIRA, Trello, Microsoft tools is an advantage

Your future at Kyndryl


Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**

* At least 7\+ years of experience in a similar role, preferably in an IT or technical setting.
* Should have knowledge of ITSM processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical information to non\-technical individuals.
* Fluent in Japanese (JLPT, N2 or above) and English, both written and verbal.
* Experience in working with Japanese clients or in a multicultural team is preferred.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Experience with IT service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).

**Preferred Professional Experience** :


* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical information to non\-technical individuals. Excellent in Japanese skills both translation and interpretation including Japanese Language Proficiency Test (JLPT) level should be N1/N2\.
* Experience in working with Japanese clients or in a multicultural team is preferred.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
Keen on personal and professional development.  
* 

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:
Location: Kolkata
Other locations: Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Date: Sep 17, 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1745035
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**GDS Consulting** – **Business Analyst/P\&U\-OT/Control Systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) SMR – Manager/Senior**


**The opportunity**



We’re looking for SMRs at Manager/Senior rank with expertise in **Business Analysis/****Operational Technology/Control Systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA)**to join the P\&U Sector group of **GDS Consulting** **Team**. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Analyse, understand and document client needs from a Business perspective and work with the client to arrive at optimal solutions leveraging the experience and expertise in OT/Control systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA)
* Identify and implement business process re\-design and continuous improvements, working closely with Clients, Operations teams, and other business areas
* Lead Project Scope Study workshops to understand the scope and key business requirements which must be met during the Execution phase
* Identify integration needs with any other in house/third party systems and provide detailed information about these systems to Solution Architects as well as Technical Team
* Act as an interface between Client Teams and Technical Team
* Explore opportunities for transformation and suggest ideas/recommend ways to transform the way the client works to be truly digital in the Digital Era to outperform competitors and gain advantage in the market
* Ability to assess Value Potential of a Transmission \& Distribution transformation program and ability to architect the value proposal
* Identify and develop commercialization solutions with substantial growth potential for  

power distribution clients, and provide advisory services to clients

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Strong understanding and experience with the electric utility industry, including knowledge of Grid Operations, Field Operations, Smart Grids and Digital Grid
* Deliver large/medium P\&U Sector specific solutions/OT (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) as well as Control Systems
* Demonstrate expert core consulting skills and advanced level of OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) knowledge and industry expertise to support delivery to clients
* Understanding Distributed Energy Resources or related experience in clean energy, energy efficiency, storage and solar
* Perform an appropriate role in business development in terms of presales and practice development. for example, presales, internal engagement and / or knowledge management
* Experience working with clients throughout various parts of implementation lifecycle
* Proactive with Solution oriented mindset, ready to learn new technologies for Client requirements
* Programme management experience and track record of successful delivery of large, complex programmes
* Demonstrate people management and an ability to conduct and lead consultancy assignments
* Be result oriented as well as people focused
* Be able to manage a team, empathetic and work with Leadership for the development of the overall team

  

  

**Professionals in this role are expected to bring expertise in emerging technologies and advanced solutions that enable utilities to thrive in a digital, sustainable future. These include:**


* **AMI 2\.0 and Advanced Metering Infrastructure**: Next\-generation metering systems that go beyond traditional AMI, enabling real\-time data collection, advanced analytics, and integration with distributed energy resources for improved grid visibility and customer engagement.
* **Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)**: Knowledge of energy storage technologies and their role in grid stability, peak load management, and renewable integration. Ability to assess and design BESS solutions for operational efficiency and resilience.
* **Digital Twin Technologies:** Experience in creating virtual replicas of physical assets and systems to simulate, monitor, and optimise grid operations, predictive maintenance, and scenario planning.
* **Geographic Information Systems (GIS):** Proficiency in GIS platforms for spatial analysis, asset mapping, and network planning to enhance operational decision\-making and outage management.

description:
Flam is building the next generation of interactive media through its content format. We are an AI\-native technology company transforming how brands and consumers interact through immersive, interactive content. Our technology enables rich, app\-less experiences that can be launched instantly on smartphones, creating a fundamentally different way for brands to engage consumers. We are backed by leading investors and already work with some of the world's largest brands. We are now building Flicks, our interactive media format for the US market.
 



**Key Responsibilites :** 




**Delivery Coordination** 



* Act as the bridge between the Solutioning Team, Sales Team, and the Design and Tech/Engineering teams once campaign requirements are handed off.
* Track each campaign's progress against its requirements and timeline, from requirement handoff to go\-live.
* Follow up continuously with Design and Tech to surface bottlenecks — resourcing gaps, unclear requirements, technical blockers, delayed approvals — before they threaten the go\-live date.
* Proactively flag risks and delays to the Sales Team so client\-facing timelines can be managed realistically.
* Keep the campaign on track to go live within the committed timeline, escalating internally where needed.



**Quality Control** 



* QC every campaign before and at go\-live: correctness of design execution against the brief, formatting consistency, layout and coloring issues, and any factual or informational errors presented in the creative.
* Own the final check that separates "technically delivered" from "ready for a government client to see."
* Flag and route any design or content issues back to the relevant team for correction, and re\-verify the fix.



**Reporting** 



* Coordinate with the Tech team to pull live campaign data — go\-live date/time, views, and other relevant performance metrics.
* Compile and produce internal reports and external\-facing reports for agencies and government departments.
* Hand off client\-ready reports to the Sales Team so they can share these with agencies or clients directly.



**What Success Looks Like :** 



* Government campaigns consistently go live within the committed timeline.
* Bottlenecks are surfaced early and resolved before they affect the client\-facing deadline, not discovered after.
* Live campaigns are free of design, formatting, or factual errors by the time they reach the client \-QC catches issues before the client does.
* Sales and government stakeholders have accurate, timely reporting without having to chase for it.



**Who you are ?** 



* 2\-5\+ years in a customer success, program/project management, ad operations, or campaign delivery role — ideally in advertising, adtech, martech, or a client\-services environment (exact band TBD based on seniority of the pod hire).
* Comfortable being the connective tissue across multiple teams (sales, solutioning, design, tech) with different priorities and working styles \- able to push for timelines without owning the underlying design or code.
* Detail\-oriented, especially under QC: can spot formatting inconsistencies, design errors, and factual inaccuracies before they go live.
* Organized and timeline\-driven; can track multiple campaigns in parallel and know which ones are at risk.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communicator — this role regularly produces reports and updates that go to both internal leadership and external government/agency stakeholders.
* Prior exposure to government, public\-sector, or agency\-side client work is a strong plus, given the compliance and stakeholder sensitivity typical of this segment.
* Working familiarity with campaign/creative production concepts (infographics, motion/animation, voiceover, AR/interactive formats) is a plus, though the CSM is not expected to execute these themselves.



 \*This role involves significant travel
