That means we’re continually investing heavily into R\&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
   

  

 The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win\-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
   

  

 Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
   

  

 Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high\-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account\`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account\`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.
   

  

 Develop and strengthen the customer relationship, operating at the Key Account\`s technical department and technical management levels, to achieve preferred supplier status based on lasting personal relationships and the added value delivered.
   

  

 Solve and advise on operational requests, customer technical concerns and technical complaints related to survey and audit performance in close collaboration with relevant technical experts and the KAM to ensure continuous vessel trade. Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.
   

  

 Systematically identify any major technical and technical operation challenges and technical concerns related to the DNV interaction with the Key Account and cascade to the KAM and to relevant departments within DNV. Follow\-up with the findings and ensure that related improvement activities are executed under utilization of the relevant DNV organization.
   

  

 Bring in foresight and help spot and resolve potential technical problems before they occur.
   

  

 Consult the customer on technical matters in meetings, presentations and workshops together or in alignment with the KAM and relevant stakeholders within DNV .
   

  

 Train, guide and consult the Key Account on rules and regulations as well as on new tools and new work processes to help them leverage the full value of our solutions and to facilitate customer's planning and implementation into operations.
   

  

 Measure and monitor the Key Account\`s performance on critical technical key performance indicators, address and support improving performance gaps by developing adequate plans and actions in alignment with the KAM and the relevant DNV organization as well as the Key Account.
   

  

 While your focus is on technical issues, remain attentive towards identifying potential business opportunities and hand those over to the KAM.
   

  

 Pro\-actively stay up to date with relevant industry, regulatory and technology trends and best practices as well as with the relevant DNV products, services, processes and tools to remain relevant towards the Key Accounts.
   

  

 Liaise with Indian flag for Flag related matters.
   

  

 Experience working with MOU’s is an added advantage.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)

* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

description:

 Digixellence is a dynamic digital marketing and video content agency where creativity is guided by clear strategy. The team helps businesses grow in the digital space through compelling storytelling and innovative campaigns. By crafting engaging content tailored to each brand, Digixellence focuses on capturing audience attention and driving measurable results. The agency collaborates closely with clients to bring their brands to life and build long\-term impact across digital channels.
 



  




 About the Role
 
 As our
 **Brand Partner – Pune** 
 , you will be the local face of Digixellence.
 



 Your role will be to build relationships with business owners, founders and decision\-makers, identify new opportunities, develop client relationships, and establish Digixellence as a trusted digital growth partner in Pune.
 



 You will work closely with our
 **Nagpur\-based strategy and execution team** 
 , creating a bridge between the Pune market and our centralized delivery operations.
 



 Our Nagpur team will support you across:
 



**Strategy \| Social Media \| Content \| Creative \| Video \| Performance Marketing \| SEO \| Design \| Reporting \| Operations** 




 You focus on
 **building the market, relationships and business** 
 — our team supports you with the strategy and execution.
 



  




 What You’ll Be Responsible For
 
 • Building Digixellence’s presence across the Pune market
 



 • Identifying and developing new business opportunities
 



 • Building relationships with founders, business owners and decision\-makers
 



 • Generating and nurturing qualified leads
 



 • Conducting initial discussions and discovery meetings

 • Identifying opportunities for client growth and upselling
 



 • Building local partnerships, collaborations and networking opportunities
 



 • Coordinating on\-ground requirements such as client meetings, shoots and events
 



 • Ensuring smooth communication between Pune clients and our Nagpur team
 



  




 Who We’re Looking For
 
 We’re looking for someone with an
 **entrepreneurial mindset** 
 who wants to build something rather than simply take up another job.
 



 You could be:
 



 → A Digital Marketing Professional
 



 → A Business Development Professional
 



 → An Independent Digital Marketing Consultant
 



 → A Freelancer with an established client network
 



 → A Social Media / Marketing Professional
 



 → An Agency Owner looking to collaborate and grow
 



 → An Entrepreneur with a strong business network in Pune
 



  




 Qualifications \& Skills
 
**You should have:** 




 • Strong understanding of digital marketing and its ecosystem
 



 • Excellent communication and presentation skills
 



 • Confidence in speaking with business owners and decision\-makers
 



 • Strong relationship\-building and networking abilities
 



 • Experience in business development, sales or client acquisition
 



 • Ability to understand business requirements and identify relevant solutions
 



 • Strong client\-handling and negotiation skills
 



 • Professionalism, ownership and accountability
 



 • An entrepreneurial and growth\-oriented mindset
 



  





**Good to have:** 




 • Existing network among Pune businesses, founders or entrepreneurs
 



 • Experience working with a digital marketing agency
 



 • Existing client\-handling experience
 



 • Experience selling marketing retainers or digital services
 



 • Experience running a freelance business or agency
 



 • Good understanding of the Pune business ecosystem
   




 What You’ll Get to Build
 
 This opportunity goes beyond managing leads or handling clients.
 



 You’ll have the opportunity to
 **help build an entire market for Digixellence** 
 .
 



 With the support of our Nagpur\-based strategy and execution team, you’ll be able to focus on:
 



**Business Development → Relationships → Partnerships → Client Experience → Market Expansion** 




 As the Pune business grows, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility and build a deeper, long\-term association with Digixellence.
   




 Compensation \& Payout
 
 This is a
 **performance and partnership\-oriented opportunity** 
 .
 



 The compensation and payout structure will be discussed with shortlisted candidates
 **after the initial profile review and selection process** 
 .
 



 The final structure will be based on the candidate’s:
 



 • Relevant experience
 



 • Professional network
 



 • Business development capabilities
 



 • Scope of responsibility
 



 • Expected contribution
 



 • Overall fit with Digixellence
 



 We’re open to creating a structure that supports
 **mutual growth and long\-term value** 
 .
   




 Work Model
 
 The Brand Partner will be
 **Pune\-based** 
 and will work on a
 **hybrid model** 
 .
 



 The role will require availability for client meetings, networking, business development and other on\-ground activities whenever required.
 



 Our core strategy, creative and execution team will continue to operate from
 **Nagpur** 
 .
   




 Why Join Digixellence?
 
 You won’t be joining us simply to fill a position.
 



 You’ll be joining at an important stage of our growth and have the opportunity to:
 



 • Represent an established digital marketing agency in a new market
 



 • Build relationships with businesses and founders
 



 • Work alongside our centralized strategy and execution team
 



 • Develop the Pune market with the leadership team
 



 • Expand your professional and entrepreneurial network
 



 • Take ownership of a market and contribute directly to its growth
 



 • Build a potential long\-term partnership with Digixellence
   




 Who Should Apply?
 
 If you enjoy
 **meeting people, understanding businesses, creating opportunities and building relationships** 
 — and you’re looking for an opportunity where your contribution can directly shape a growing market — we’d like to hear from you.
 



**If you believe you can help Digixellence build a strong presence in Pune, let’s start a conversation.**

* Ensure high machine uptime through preventive maintenance and timely breakdown resolution.
* Oversee inventory planning, stock replenishment, and minimize stock\-outs across vending machines.

* Drive cost optimization initiatives and improve operational efficiency.

* Ensure compliance with company policies, statutory requirements, and safety standards.

* Experience in managing field operations teams across multiple locations.
* Hands\-on experience in inventory management and vendor coordination.
* Client and stakeholder management.
* Vendor management and coordination.
* Data analysis and reporting using MS Excel.

Our industry\-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Customer Success brings the transcendent customer experience to life by empowering customers to achieve the value and impact of their BMC investments. As a Customer Success Specialist (CSS) for Control\-M, you will combine deep technical expertise with customer success best practices to help customers accelerate adoption, maximize business value, and achieve desired outcomes throughout their lifecycle.
   

  

 Working closely with Customer Success Managers, Sales, Support, Services, and Product teams, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers optimize their Control\-M environments, adopt new capabilities, and successfully navigate implementations, upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives. This role is ideal for professionals who are passionate about enterprise automation, workloadorchestration, customer engagement, and technology\-driven business outcomes.
   

  

 The successful candidate will possess both strong customer\-facing consulting skills and hands\-on Control\-M expertise, enabling them to confidently engage with administrators, architects, technical leaders, and business stakeholders alike.
   

  

**Here is how, through this exciting role, YOU will contribute to BMC's and your own success:**
* Drive customer adoption and value realization throughout the customer lifecycle by executing Customer Success motions and engagement plans.
* Develop and execute adoption plans, workshops, webinars, health reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor, providing guidance on Control\-M best practices, architecture, operational excellence, and modernization initiatives.
* Partner with Customer Success Managers and account teams to identify risks, accelerate customer outcomes, and improve customer health.
* Deliver technical advisory sessions focused on solution adoption, operational optimization, governance, automation, and business value realization.
* Support customers during implementations, upgrades, migrations, SaaS transitions, and strategic transformation projects.
* Conduct technical reviews and adoption assessments to identify opportunities for increased utilization and business impact.
* Leverage customer telemetry, product usage data, and Gainsight insights to drive proactive engagements and recommend adoption actions.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Support, Professional Services, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and improve customer outcomes.
* Identify growth and expansion opportunities through increased adoption of Control\-M capabilities and communicate business leads to Sales teams.


**To ensure you're set up for success, you will bring the following skillset \& experience:**
* Minimum 3 years of experience working with Control\-M or comparable enterprise workload automation and scheduling solutions.
* Hands\-on experience administering, supporting, implementing, or consulting on Control\-M environments, including on\-premises and/or SaaS deployments.
* Strong knowledge of Control\-M version 9\.x environments, preferably 9\.18, 9\.19, 9\.20, 9\.21, 9\.22 and newer releases.
* Experience with Control\-M capabilities such as APIs, Workload Change Manager (WCM), Managed File Transfer (MFT), Workload Archiving, forecasting, monitoring, high availability, and enterprise scheduling.
* Practical experience performing upgrades, migrations, implementations, and supporting enterprise\-scale production environments.
* Working knowledge of enterprise databases including Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent technologies.
* Understanding of integrations across cloud platforms, DevOps toolchains, ERP applications, data platforms, automation frameworks, and enterprise application ecosystems.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, consulting, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate business objectives into technical recommendations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and customer engagement skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships at multiple organizational levels.
* Experience using Customer Success methodologies and platforms such as Gainsight is preferred. Control\-M certifications are considered strong advantages.


**Our commitment to you!**
 BMC’s culture is built around its people. We have 6000\+ brilliant minds working together across the globe. You won’t be known just by your employee number, but for your true authentic self. BMC lets you be YOU!

title: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager - Brand & Engagement
description:
**💻 Position: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager \- Brand \& Engagement** 




**📍Location: Delhi** 




**🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Friday** 




**📌 Experience Required: 4–7 years** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About AiSensy** 




  





 AiSensy is a
 **WhatsApp Engagement \& Marketing platform** 
 helping businesses acquire, engage, sell, and support customers on WhatsApp.
 



  





 We work with leading brands including
 **Adani, Delhi Transport Corporation, Yakult, Godrej, Aditya Birla Hindalco, Wipro, Asian Paints, India Today Group, Skullcandy, Vivo, PhysicsWallah and Cosco** 
 , along with thousands of SMBs and growing businesses.
 



 Today,
 **250,000\+ businesses** 
 use AiSensy to power their WhatsApp engagement and marketing.
 



  





 We're building products across
 **WhatsApp Marketing, Click\-to\-WhatsApp Ads, AI Agents, conversational commerce, automation and payments** 
 .
 



  





 As AiSensy continues to scale, we're looking for a
 **Key Account Manager – Enterprise Accounts** 
 to own relationships with some of our most important customers and help them get significantly more value from AiSensy.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 This isn't a typical account management role where you simply check in with customers and resolve issues.
 



  





**You will own the relationship, growth, adoption, and revenue of strategic enterprise accounts.** 




  





 You'll become the primary point of contact for key customers, understand their business goals, identify opportunities to expand their use of AiSensy, and work with internal teams to make sure they succeed.
 



  





 Your goal is to move customers from:
 



**Customer → Active Customer → Growing Customer → Strategic AiSensy Account** 




  





 You'll work closely with
 **Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support, Marketing, Partnerships, and Leadership** 
 to drive customer outcomes.
 



  





 We want someone who can build strong executive relationships, understand business problems, spot expansion opportunities, and
 **take ownership until things get done.** 




  





**What You'll Own** 




**1\. Enterprise Account Ownership** 



* Own a portfolio of strategic and enterprise customers.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.
* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Understand each customer's business model, objectives, challenges, and WhatsApp strategy.
* Establish regular account review and engagement cadences.
* Build strong relationships across multiple stakeholders within each account.
* Ensure customers receive a high\-quality AiSensy experience.
* Maintain a clear understanding of account health, risks, opportunities, and next steps.



  





**2\. Account Growth \& Revenue Expansion** 




 Your responsibility doesn't end once the customer is onboarded.
 



**You will actively identify opportunities to grow the account.** 



* Identify expansion opportunities within existing enterprise accounts.
* Drive upsell and cross\-sell opportunities across AiSensy's products.
* Identify opportunities around:
* WhatsApp Marketing
* Click\-to\-WhatsApp Ads
* AI Agents
* Automation
* Conversational Commerce
* Payments
* Expand AiSensy's presence across business units, teams, products, and use cases.
* Build account\-specific growth plans.
* Work with Sales and Product teams to convert opportunities into revenue.
* Maintain a healthy expansion pipeline across assigned accounts.
* Track account revenue, usage, adoption, and expansion potential.



  





**3\. Strategic Account Planning** 




 Build a clear growth plan for every strategic account.
 



 For each customer, understand:
 



**Where are they today?** 




**What are they using AiSensy for?** 




**What are they not using yet?** 




**What business problem can we solve next?** 




**Who are the decision\-makers?** 




**What can the account become?** 



* Create account plans for key customers.
* Map stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Understand customer business priorities and upcoming initiatives.
* Identify whitespace opportunities across products and teams.
* Build quarterly and annual account growth plans.
* Track progress against account\-level objectives.
* Present account plans and growth opportunities internally.



  





**4\. Customer Engagement \& Executive Relationships** 




 Build relationships beyond the day\-to\-day user.
 


* Conduct regular business reviews with enterprise customers.
* Engage senior stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Present AiSensy solutions based on business objectives.
* Share product updates, industry insights, and relevant use cases.
* Identify opportunities to bring AiSensy leadership into strategic conversations.
* Build relationships that support long\-term retention and expansion.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally.



 The goal is to become a
 **trusted business partner** 
 , not just another vendor contact.
 



  





**5\. Product Adoption \& Customer Success** 




 Help customers get more value from AiSensy.
 


* Monitor product adoption and account usage.
* Identify underutilized products and features.
* Educate customers on new AiSensy capabilities.
* Work with Customer Success and Product teams to improve adoption.
* Identify accounts showing declining engagement or usage.
* Build action plans for at\-risk accounts.
* Ensure customer issues are followed through to resolution.
* Collect customer feedback and communicate meaningful insights to Product and Leadership.



  





**6\. Customer Growth Programs** 




 Develop structured programs to increase engagement and business outcomes across enterprise accounts.
 


* Create account\-specific growth and adoption plans.
* Identify high\-impact WhatsApp use cases.
* Share best practices and successful customer use cases.
* Help customers improve their WhatsApp marketing and engagement strategy.
* Drive adoption of new AiSensy products and capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to replicate successful use cases across different teams or business units.



  





**7\. Cross\-Functional Execution** 




 Enterprise accounts require strong internal coordination.
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Sales
* Customer Success
* Product
* Customer Support
* Marketing
* Partnerships
* Engineering
* Leadership



 to ensure smooth execution across strategic accounts.
 



 You will coordinate internal teams, manage expectations, remove blockers, and ensure commitments made to customers are followed through.
 



**You own the outcome—even when multiple teams are involved.** 




  





**8\. Retention \& Account Health** 




 Own the overall health of your accounts.
 



 Monitor:
 


* Product usage
* Customer engagement
* Revenue
* Expansion
* Renewal
* Support issues
* Customer satisfaction
* Stakeholder relationships



 Identify churn risks early.
 



 Build account recovery plans where required.
 



 Work proactively rather than waiting for the customer to raise a problem.
 



  





**9\. Customer Advocacy \& Strategic Relationships** 




 Turn successful customers into long\-term AiSensy advocates.
 


* Identify customers with strong business outcomes.
* Build opportunities for:
* Case studies
* Customer testimonials
* Customer stories
* Webinars
* Events
* References
* Brand Showcase
* Work with Marketing to showcase customer success.
* Build relationships that create opportunities for referrals and introductions.



  





**10\. Reporting \& Account Intelligence** 




 Maintain strong visibility into your account portfolio.
 



 Track:
 


* Account revenue
* Expansion revenue
* Product adoption
* Usage
* Renewal status
* Account health
* Pipeline
* Upsell opportunities
* Customer risks
* Key stakeholder relationships



 Maintain accurate CRM records and account plans.
 



 Provide regular updates on:
 



**What's growing?** 




**What's at risk?** 




**What's the opportunity?** 




**What needs leadership attention?** 




  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





**Must Have** 



* **4–7 years of experience** 
 in Key Account Management, Enterprise Account Management, Customer Success, Account Growth, or Business Development.
* Proven experience managing and growing
 **existing enterprise/B2B accounts** 
 .
* Experience owning a portfolio of strategic customers.
* Track record of driving
 **upsell, cross\-sell, expansion, retention, or account revenue growth** 
 .
* Strong understanding of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer relationships.
* Strong stakeholder and relationship management skills.
* Experience interacting with senior decision\-makers.
* Strong commercial understanding and negotiation skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and project management abilities.
* Ability to coordinate multiple internal teams to deliver customer outcomes.
* Strong ownership and follow\-through.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience in
 **B2B SaaS, MarTech, CPaaS, CRM, FinTech, AI, automation, or technology** 
 .
* Experience with
 **WhatsApp Business API** 
 .
* Understanding of WhatsApp Marketing and conversational commerce.
* Experience managing large enterprise accounts.
* Experience with strategic account planning.
* Experience running QBRs / business reviews.
* Experience with customer expansion and land\-and\-expand models.
* Experience working with agencies, resellers, or technology partners.
* Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing and customer engagement.



  





**What Will Make You Stand Out** 



* You've
 **grown large enterprise accounts significantly** 
 .
* You can demonstrate measurable expansion or revenue growth from existing customers.
* You know how to find whitespace inside an account.
* You've successfully expanded relationships from one team/business unit to multiple.
* You can engage both users and senior decision\-makers.
* You understand customer business problems—not just product features.
* You know how to run a strong QBR and turn it into an account\-growth conversation.
* You proactively identify churn risks before they become problems.
* You can coordinate multiple teams and still own the final outcome.
* You have experience selling additional products into existing accounts.
* You can turn successful customers into references, case studies, and advocates.



  





**Why Join AiSensy?** 




  





**Work With Recognized Brands** 




 You'll work directly with businesses including
 **Adani, Vivo, PhysicsWallah, Godrej, Wipro, Asian Paints, India Today Group and more.** 




  





**Work on a High\-Impact Product** 




 Businesses use AiSensy to acquire, engage, sell, and support customers through WhatsApp.
 



 The product directly connects to customer engagement and revenue.
 



  





**Build Strategic Relationships** 




 You'll work with enterprise businesses and senior stakeholders rather than managing transactional accounts.
 



  





**Real Ownership** 




 You'll own:
 



**Relationship \+ Adoption \+ Retention \+ Expansion \+ Revenue** 




 Grow With the Category
 



  





 AiSensy is building across
 **WhatsApp Marketing, Click\-to\-WhatsApp Ads, AI Agents, conversational commerce, automation and payments** 
 .
 



 That gives you multiple opportunities to expand customer relationships as the platform grows.
 



  





**The Bottom Line** 




 We're looking for a
 **Key Account Manager who thinks beyond account management.** 




 Someone who can build relationships, understand the customer's business, identify opportunities, drive adoption, solve problems, and grow the account.
 



 Someone who doesn't wait for customers to ask:
 



**"What else can AiSensy do for us?"** 




 You should already know the answer.
 



 If you know how to turn enterprise customers into
 **long\-term, growing AiSensy accounts** 
 —
 



**come build with us.**

title: Brand Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Us** 




  





**Tooused** 
 powers circularity for India's leading brands, retailers, textile producers, and households.
 



  





**Tooused's** 
 vision is to divert 1 billion textiles from landfill by 2030, recycling them for a second life instead, and we’re on track to do it with India's first full\-stack textile recycling platform. This platform is setting the course for the future of the industry, connecting textile waste to responsible end\-of\-life options, meaningfully addressing the textile waste crisis, and redefining the sustainability narrative for the next generation – to one that is win\-win\-win for brands, consumers, and our planet.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 We are building
 **TakeBack** 
 for Brands. It gives a brand everything it needs to run its own take\-back programme without building any of it, including reverse logistics across the country, chain of custody on every garment, and the reporting brands will need as India's textile EPR rules take shape.
 



  





 We already have early interest from brands like NewMe, No Nasties, Mahina and Debaans. What we do not have yet is one person who owns this line end to end. That is this role.
 



  





 You will be the first commercial hire on
 **TakeBack** 
 . You will find the brands, run the pitch, close the deal, and then stay on to get the programme live with our ops and tech teams. This is not a role where you hand off after signature. At our stage, the person who sells it is the person who makes it work.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* Build and run the brand pipeline, from cold outreach and events to inbound and referrals
* Own the full sales cycle, including discovery, pitch, commercials, negotiation and close
* Design each brand's take\-back programme with them, covering collection format, customer incentive, logistics flow and reporting
* Work with our ops and tech teams to launch signed brands and keep them running
* Be the brand's main point of contact after go\-live, and own renewal and expansion
* Build the pitch materials as you go, including decks, pricing models, and case studies
* Track what is and is not working in the funnel and tell us plainly
* Keep on top of EPR and textile regulation in India, and translate it into a reason for brands to act now



  





**What we are looking for** 





 This is a hands\-on commercial role with responsibility for building the pipeline, winning business, and getting programmes live.
 




  




* **2 to 5 years** 
 in B2B retail sales, partnerships, key accounts, or category management
* Background in fashion, retail, D2C, sustainability
* **Create opportunities proactively:** 
 You will research brands, identify decision\-makers, initiate outreach, and follow up consistently. The founders will support important conversations; you will own keeping opportunities moving.
* **Work towards agreed outcomes:** 
 We will set targets for qualified brand conversations, proposals, signed agreements, and programme launches. A qualified conversation should establish a relevant need, the decision\-making process, and a clear next step.
* **Keep the pipeline current:** 
 Record meaningful activity in our shared CRM or tracker by the next working day. Every active opportunity should show the contact, latest discussion, stage, next action, and follow\-up date.
* **Make progress and blockers visible:** 
 Share a weekly update covering what moved forward, what stalled, why, and what support you need. Raise risks early and recommend a next step.
* **Own delivery with the team:** 
 Confirm operational and technical feasibility before making commitments. After signature, coordinate the launch, track open issues, and keep the brand informed until they are resolved.
* **Ensure continuity:** 
 When an account changes hands or your engagement ends, provide an organised handover covering contacts, commitments, documents, pending actions, and timelines. Another team member should be able to continue the work from those records.



  





**What we are not looking for** 




  




* Someone who only wants to work warm inbound
* Someone who needs a fully built product, a fixed price list, and a finished deck on day one
* Someone who treats sustainability as a talking point rather than an operating problem



  





**Why this is worth your time** 




  





 Textile EPR is coming to India. When it lands, every mid and large apparel brand in the country will need a take\-back partner, and very few will want to build the infrastructure themselves. We already have the grid running. This role is the person who turns that into a business before the rules force everyone to catch up.
 



  





 You will report directly to the founder, and you will own the line rather than a slice of it. If it works, you build the team under it.
 



  





**Compensation** 




  





 Fixed salary plus performance\-linked incentive on signed and launched brands. ESOPs on the table for the right person. We will talk numbers openly in the first call.
 



  





**How to apply** 




  





 Send your CV to hello@tooused.com with a short note on one brand you think should be running a take\-back programme in India and how you would get to them. We read those notes.

description:
**Job Summary:** 




 HONO.ai is a premium HR\-Tech Solution and range of HR Services for all your requirements. HONO aims to nurture Human Relationships, propel employees’ pursuit of realizing their true potential and embrace the best of talent through a host of innovative technologies. We at HONO are committed to connect people across cultures, traditions, ideas, beliefs and boundaries. Connecting across multi\-channels, platforms and systems.
 



  





 The Head – Partnerships is responsible for developing, managing, and scaling strategic partnerships that drive business growth, market expansion, revenue generation, and brand visibility.  As the Account Manager for Adobe Digital Media, you will be responsible for accelerating the growth in the assigned Named Accounts for Digital Media portfolio (Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, Adobe Sign etc.). * Advance and close sales opportunities \- through the successful execution of the sales strategy and roadmap.


**What you need to succeed:**
* Bachelor’s Degree and preferably an MBA from respected colleges in the country
* Minimum of 12/15 years of consultative sales experience including strategic selling, persuasion and negotiation
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience of selling software / could subscriptions to enterprise customers.
* Experience collaborating with both internal team members and external customers as a part of a solution\-based sales process.
* Demonstrated ability to energize, develop, and build rapport at all levels within an organization.
* Strong communication skills to synthesize complex issues and communicate into simple messages
* Willingness and ability to travel within your specified geographic region


**What leading at Adobe means?**
 At Adobe, we’re passionate about developing leaders at all levels of the organization from individual contributors to people managers. Anyone who’s considering a career with us should know that we evaluate leadership based on these five capabilities:
   

  

* Demonstrating Strong EQ (Be Aware) – Having a keen sense of self awareness is the foundation of leadership at Adobe. As a leader, we look to you to inspire teams to greatness with compassion and mindfulness of your impact on others from interns to the Board of Directors. And whether you’re in headquarters, New York, London, Tokyo or Bangalore, you’re attuned to emotional, situational and cultural surroundings and adapt your approach accordingly.
* Selecting Talent (Be a Recruiter) – You’re on top of current and future talent needs as the business evolves because one of your key goals is to build high performing teams. You do so by adopting a rigorous approach to hiring superior talent and are intentionally inclusive to attract diversity of ideas and experiences.
* Role Modeling Check\-In (Be a Coach) – We don’t believe in annual reviews and rankings. That’s why, feedback flows continually at Adobe. You’re a motivational and effective coach; a leader who discusses expectations, feedback and development regularly with your direct reports. To succeed in this role, you’ll need to address performance gaps early and effectively, and be open to seeking feedback from others to improve your performance and your team’s.
* Leading Change (Be an Agent of Change) – Change leadership is what you do! You actively find opportunities to align team goals with organizational change. You’re phenomenal at building support for change because you communicate with conviction and you help those around you to see both the rational and mechanics for business changes and how to adapt accordingly.
* Scaling the Business (Be an Owner) – You’re someone who sees and understands the vision of the company. You’re able to articulate business strategy and develop business processes, systems and structures to make performance sustainable. Your mission is to deliver an exceptional customer experience by promoting shared goals and driving accountability.


**More reasons why Adobe life is the good life**
* Skip those awful “performance reviews.”
* Work in a place that cultivates great leaders throughout the organization. A place that understands that product innovation comes from people innovation.
* Feed your brain and grow your skills with our educational assistance program.

* Give to your favorite cause each year, and we’ll match your charitable donation
* Enjoy serious discounts on the Adobe software that will make friends jealous.
* Those “best places to work” lists love us (in multiple countries).
* Put your mind at ease with our health and welfare benefits, industry\-competitive salary, and more.
* The work is awesome. The people are awesome. We think there’s no better place to make an impact.


**About Adobe**
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
   

  

 Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
   

  

**Let’s Adobe together**
 At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
   

  

 Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
   

  

 Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.

title: Studio Manager
description:
**Studio Manager** 








* **The Opportunity**



 Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're redefining what a premium tattoo experience looks like. With 16\+ premium studios, a team of 160\+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become the world's most admired tattoo company, every studio is more than just a workplace—it's where unforgettable stories begin. We're not looking for someone who simply manages a studio. We're looking for a business leader who treats the studio like their own company. Someone who is passionate about delivering extraordinary customer experiences, building high\-performing teams, driving revenue, maintaining operational excellence, and creating a culture where every customer leaves with a lifelong memory—not just a tattoo. As a Studio Manager, you are the face of Aliens Tattoo within your studio. You will lead the business, inspire your team, own the customer journey, drive commercial performance, and ensure every operational detail reflects the premium standards of the Aliens Tattoo brand. This role combines sales leadership, customer experience, operational excellence, financial ownership, people development, and business management. You'll work closely with the Cluster Manager and cross\-functional teams to build a studio that consistently exceeds business targets while delivering world\-class customer experiences.
 



  




* **The Mandate**



 Your mission is simple. Build a studio that customers love, employees are proud to work in, and the business is proud to grow. As the Studio Manager, you are entrusted with the complete ownership of your studio's business performance. Every customer who walks through the door, every consultation conducted, every tattoo created, every team member coached, and every operational decision made ultimately reflects your leadership. Your responsibility extends far beyond achieving monthly sales targets. You are expected to create an environment where customers receive exceptional service from their very first enquiry through their entire tattoo journey. You will build a disciplined, customer\-centric team that consistently delivers premium experiences while operating with the highest standards of professionalism, hygiene, safety, and operational excellence. You are responsible for driving sustainable business growth by balancing sales performance, profitability, operational efficiency, inventory management, studio readiness, and people development. Success in this role is not measured by how busy you are—it is measured by how effectively your studio performs. You will build systems that prevent problems before they occur, develop future leaders within your team, maintain impeccable operational standards, and create a culture where accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and customer obsession become everyday habits. Above all, your responsibility is to ensure that your studio represents everything Aliens Tattoo stands for—premium quality, artistic excellence, operational discipline, integrity, innovation, and unforgettable customer experiences.
 



  




* **What you'll be doing**



 As the Studio Manager, you will own the complete business performance of your studio by balancing commercial success, operational excellence, customer delight, and people leadership. You will drive revenue growth by ensuring every consultation is converted professionally, every customer receives an exceptional experience, and every opportunity to maximize business value is effectively captured. Through disciplined CRM management, proactive follow\-ups, repeat business initiatives, and premium upselling, you will ensure sustainable business growth while maintaining customer trust. You will lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team of tattoo artists, Assistant Studio Managers, customer experience professionals, and support staff by creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, coaching, and continuous improvement. Through daily briefings, regular feedback, performance reviews, and recognition, you will help every team member perform at their highest potential. Operational excellence will be one of your highest priorities. You will ensure your studio remains operationally ready every day by maintaining world\-class hygiene standards, statutory compliance, inventory accuracy, equipment readiness, housekeeping excellence, and strict adherence to all operational SOPs. You will oversee inventory planning, stock accuracy, tattoo consumables, merchandise, aftercare products, biomedical waste management, and studio maintenance while ensuring resources are utilized efficiently and responsibly. You will coordinate closely with the Design Team, Artist Team Leaders, Cluster Manager, and other support functions to ensure tattoo designs are delivered on time, customer expectations are consistently managed, and business operations run seamlessly. Using data, business insights, and performance metrics, you will continuously identify improvement opportunities, solve operational challenges proactively, optimize profitability, and implement scalable processes that strengthen the studio's long\-term success. Ultimately, your role is to ensure that your studio consistently operates as a profitable, customer\-centric, operationally excellent, and high\-performing business that sets the benchmark for premium tattoo experiences.
 



  




* **What we're looking for**



 We are looking for a leader who combines entrepreneurial thinking with exceptional execution. You should possess a strong understanding of business operations, sales management, customer experience, financial accountability, inventory control, and team leadership. You naturally take ownership of results, make sound decisions under pressure, and consistently balance commercial objectives with customer satisfaction. You enjoy leading from the front, coaching people to succeed, solving operational challenges before they become problems, and continuously improving systems that make businesses more efficient. You believe great customer experiences are created through discipline, preparation, attention to detail, and genuine care for people. You are highly organized, commercially aware, operationally disciplined, and capable of managing multiple priorities without compromising quality. Most importantly, you lead with humility, integrity, accountability, and a relentless commitment to excellence while living the values that define Aliens Tattoo.
 



  




* **What success looks like**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. You'll know you're succeeding when. Business\- Revenue targets are consistently achieved, Studios operate profitably, Business performance improves month after month. Customer\-Customers become promoters of the brand, Google ratings consistently remain above target, Customer complaints reduce while loyalty increases. Operations\- Studios consistently achieve operational audit standards. Compliance remains flawless. Business risks are proactively managed. People\-Studio Managers become stronger leaders. Team engagement improves. Future leaders are developed internally. Attrition remains low. Commercial \- Conversion improves. Average Bill Value grows. Sales teams consistently outperform targets. Continuous Improvement. Processes become simpler. Teams become smarter. Business becomes more scalable every quarter.
 



  




* **Practical details**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. Business Monthly revenue targets are consistently achieved or exceeded. Average Bill Value and repeat business continue to improve. Studio profitability remains healthy while operational costs stay under control. Sales pipeline remains disciplined with zero lead leakage. Customer Customers become lifelong advocates of the Aliens Tattoo brand. Net Promoter Score consistently exceeds company benchmarks. Google Reviews and customer referrals continue to increase. Customer complaints are resolved quickly while customer loyalty continues to grow. Operations The studio remains operationally ready every single day. Hygiene, safety, statutory compliance, and operational audits consistently achieve excellent scores. Inventory accuracy remains high with minimal wastage and zero stock\-outs. Tattoo design coordination and appointment execution happen seamlessly. People Team members are engaged, motivated, and continuously developing. Daily briefings, coaching sessions, and performance conversations become part of the studio culture. Attrition remains low while internal talent continues to grow. Future leaders are developed from within the studio. Commercial Excellence Consultation\-to\-booking conversion consistently improves. CRM compliance and customer follow\-up discipline remain exceptional. Premium services, aftercare products, and merchandise sales continue to grow. Business opportunities are maximized without compromising customer trust. Continuous Improvement Processes become simpler. Teams become stronger. Customers become happier. The studio becomes more profitable every quarter.

**Company Description** 
 Vedavaag Systems Ltd is a technology\-driven company headquartered in India, focusing on innovative solutions that support governance, financial services, and inclusive growth. The organization works closely with public and private sector partners to extend essential services to underserved and rural communities. Vedavaag Systems Ltd emphasizes operational efficiency, customer\-centric service delivery, and sustainable models that promote financial inclusion. The company offers opportunities for professionals interested in social impact, technology\-enabled service delivery, and expanding access to financial services across diverse regions in India.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Financial Inclusion District Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Telangana, India. This role oversees district\-level financial inclusion initiatives, including planning, implementing, and monitoring programs that extend banking and financial services to underserved communities. The person in this role will manage field teams, coordinate with partner banks and agencies, track performance against outreach and service targets, and ensure compliance with relevant policies and guidelines. Daily responsibilities include reviewing operational reports, resolving escalated issues, conducting site visits, facilitating community engagement activities, and ensuring quality customer service and data accuracy. The District Manager will also promote inclusive practices, support training and capacity building for staff, and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and service delivery.

* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, social sciences, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Comfort working on\-site across district locations in Telangana and willingness to travel within the assigned region as needed.

description:
Job Overview: Responsible for general maintenance and any required archival of documents produced by the CPS Project Management (PM) Team. Organizing, gathering, scanning, and filing of all applicable documents into appropriate electronic and/or paper copy locations, including the Trial Master File (TMF), as directed by Fortrea SOPs or other applicable directive. Responsible for filing TMF documents for CPS PM, Non-Fortrea sites, and the Fortrea P1MS Clinical Monitoring Team. Responsible for document query generation and file reconciliation/resolution activities to support delivery of the TMF to client quality and integrity specifications, as well as to meet project timelines and productivity targets. Summary of Responsibilities: Proactively maintains an internal standardized filing structure for study-related documents, as well as departmental files, which may include non-project-specific sponsor files. Creates and/or maintains any general document/file-related tracking forms and/or spreadsheets, as applicable. Gathers, organizes, scans, and ships project documentation, as required. Assists in the review and finalization of the TMF Plan and Index for individual projects. May assist the PC/PM in project setup activities around TMF (e.g., TMF account request, TMF Specialist request, etc.), as well as TMF closeout processes. Takes ownership for maintaining the TMF (Fortrea /Client systems) by working with applicable project team members to retrieve, file, and upload documents in accordance with applicable project milestones/timelines, SOPs, policies, system, and client requirements. Interacts directly with project teams in securing documents for the TMF, as well as for follow[1]up regarding missing documents, as appropriate; actively monitors and performs document quality checks, identifying, tracking, and following up on document quality issues with relevant staff members. Works with the PM/PC involved project teams, and applicable business partners for reconciliation of the TMF as part of the quality control process. May generate copies of project data and other project information on various electronic media for archival and/or to provide to the PM or PC for client delivery. Leads and performs archiving duties for paper and/or electronic media, as needed. May provide departmental management teams with metric data within areas of expertise, as needed, to show compliance with applicable processes; performs other departmental or project administrative tasks, as assigned. Trains and mentors new Document Specialists in all aspects of the role; responsible for routine development/review/revision of DS training materials. TMF Subject Matter Expert; trains new document specialists and other team members in the use of various eTMF systems/processes, as needed. All other duties as needed or assigned. Qualifications (Minimum Required): High School Diploma or equivalent at minimum. BS or equivalent in scientific field preferred. Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements. Language Skills Required: Speaking: English Writing/Reading: English Experience (Minimum Required): Strong written and verbal communication skills (English language). Experience working with computers and basic programs (i.e., Adobe Acrobat, Word, Excel, Power Point). Strong organizational skills, with the ability to work in a fast-paced setting with many interruptions. Physical Demands/Work Environment: Must be able to sit at a computer for long periods of time. Must be able to use hands to finger, handle or touch objects, tools, or controls, including a computer keyboard, for up to 8 hours per day. Standard office and/or home working environment. Risk of eye strain. Will involve out of normal office hours as required by the role. Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here .

description:

Support new part introductions and PPAP runs with the Customer Success team.

Experience supplying export or global OEM customers is a strong plus. Working knowledge of lean manufacturing, IATF 16949/ISO 9001 and ERP systems (training on our customised ERP will be provided). Interest and experience in shop floor digitisation is preferred. Good communication in English, Marathi and Hindi. Strong people leadership, problem solving and decision making.

title: Urgent Opening For Senior Analyst - Accounts Receivable (AR)
description:
We are seeking a detailoriented Senior Analyst Accounts Receivable (AR) to lead endtoend receivables management with a primary focus on collections, cash receipts, and cash application . This role ensures timely customer payments, accurate reconciliation of accounts, and smooth execution of financial processes that directly impact cash flow and revenue recognition. In addition, the position supports subscription management, pricing lifecycle activities, credit card refunds, patient claims submissions and reserve writeoffs, etc. The ideal candidate would possess a strong knowledge of the Order to Cash (O2C) cycle , AR sub-processes, and Sales Operations, along with analytical skills, accuracy in financial documentation, and adherence to structured SOPs across multiple systems (Salesforce, QApps, Tableau, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, TrustCommerce, Intacct, ProviderOne Portal). The role is expected to work in a close collaboration with USbased AR teams. Key Responsibilities Collections Management – Drive proactive followup on outstanding receivables, monitor aging reports, and ensure timely resolution of customer billing disputes. Partner with crossfunctional teams to optimize the ordertocash process and reduce DSO (Days Sales Outstanding). Cash Receipts – Record and apply customer payments accurately, reconcile unpaid invoices, and manage reversals/overpayments to maintain clean ledgers. Cash Application – Apply ACH/check payments, reconcile deposits, and resolve discrepancies to ensure accurate allocation of funds. Subscription Management – Manage contract amendments, cancellations, missing pricing issues, and monthly price increases in Salesforce. Pricing Lifecycle – Synchronize pricing across systems, define billing groups, and ensure annual increases are applied consistently. Credit Card Refunds – Process daily refunds, validate transactions, manage chargebacks, and maintain refund records. Reserve WriteOffs – Execute credit notes in Invoiced.com with accurate coding and compliance. Patient Claim Submissions - Collect invoice data, verify ProviderOne IDs, and submit accurate vouchers in ProviderOne to convert accounts receivable into cleared cash Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or Business Administration. 6-8 years of hands-on experience in Accounts Receivable with emphasis on collections and cash application . Experience of working in Healthcare, SaaS, IT/ITeS multi-national companies is preferred. Proficiency in Salesforce, Tableau, QApps, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central; knowledge of TrustCommerce, Intacct, ProviderOne Portal is preferred. Advanced MS-Office & MS-Excel skills and working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Attention to detail and ability to follow structured SOPs. Excellent communication skills for crossfunctional coordination with Finance, Legal, and Commercial & Customer Success teams. Ability to manage multiple tasks under strict deadlines (monthly billing cycles, audit timelines). Expected to work in Eastern Time zone (USA) as per business requirements. Preferred Attributes Experience in collections strategy, cash applications, and subscriptionbased pricing models . Familiarity with audit processes, compliance documentation, and contract amendments. Problemsolving mindset to handle missing data, pricing discrepancies, and system errors. Ability to work independently while collaborating across departments.

description:
Manager - Learning & Development (Content & Digital Learning) Location: India
 Department: Learning & Development / Talent Development
 Reports To: Head - Learning & Development Role Overview We are seeking an experienced and innovative Manager - Learning & Development to lead the design, development, and implementation of high-impact learning solutions across business operations. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in training content creation within the BPO industry , instructional design, digital learning technologies, and learner experience design. This role requires a strategic learning professional who can manage end-to-end learning projects, lead a team of content developers and instructional designers, and deliver engaging learning experiences through e-learning modules, AI-enabled learning solutions, digital simulations, gamification, and immersive learning technologies . The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of adult learning principles, business process training, and modern learning technologies, including Articulate 360, Adobe Captivate, AI-driven authoring tools, and simulation-based learning platforms . Key Responsibilities Learning Strategy & Content Development Design and implement scalable learning solutions aligned with business objectives and operational requirements. Lead the development of training curricula, facilitator guides, learner manuals, assessments, job aids, SOP-based learning content, and knowledge management resources. Create engaging and performance-focused learning experiences for customer service, sales, technical support, and back-office operations within a BPO environment. Apply instructional design methodologies such as ADDIE, SAM, Design Thinking, and Learning Experience Design (LxD). Ensure all learning content meets quality, compliance, and organizational standards. E-Learning & Digital Learning Solutions Develop interactive e-learning programs using Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, and Adobe Captivate . Design and implement simulation-based learning experiences to enhance learner engagement and skill application. Leverage AI-powered authoring tools and automation technologies to improve content development efficiency. Create scenario-based learning, branching simulations, gamified learning journeys, and interactive assessments. Drive adoption of innovative digital learning approaches, including virtual learning environments and immersive technologies. AI & Digital Simulation Innovation Lead initiatives involving Artificial Intelligence, digital simulations, virtual role-plays, and experiential learning solutions . Integrate AI-enabled learning tools for content creation, personalization, performance support, and learner analytics. Develop customer interaction simulations and process-based learning experiences that reflect real-world business scenarios. Evaluate emerging learning technologies and recommend solutions that improve learning effectiveness and business impact. Team Leadership & Capability Building Lead, coach, and mentor instructional designers, content developers, and learning specialists. Establish governance frameworks, content standards, and quality assurance processes. Drive continuous capability-building initiatives focused on modern instructional design practices and digital learning innovation. Promote a culture of creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Stakeholder & Project Management Manage multiple learning projects simultaneously while ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards. Partner with Operations, Quality, Training, SMEs, and Business Leaders to identify learning needs and performance gaps. Communicate project progress effectively and manage stakeholder expectations across multiple business functions. Ensure optimal resource allocation and project prioritization. Learning Analytics & Effectiveness Define and track learning metrics, including learner engagement, completion rates, knowledge retention, and performance improvement. Evaluate training effectiveness using Kirkpatrick's Evaluation Model and other measurement frameworks. Utilize learning analytics to drive continuous improvement and demonstrate business impact. Establish KPIs related to learner performance, operational efficiency, and training quality. Qualifications & Experience Experience 8-12 years of experience in Learning & Development, Instructional Design, or Learning Experience Design. Minimum 3-5 years of people management experience. Strong experience in BPO, Customer Experience, Shared Services, Contact Center, or Global Operations environments . Proven experience in content development, curriculum design, and digital learning implementation. Educational Qualification Bachelor's Degree in Education, Human Resources, Business, Communications, or a related field. Certification in Instructional Design, Digital Learning, Learning Technologies, or Project Management is preferred. Core Skills & Competencies Content Creation & Instructional Design Expertise in instructional design and adult learning principles. Strong content writing, editing, and curriculum development capabilities. Experience developing SOP-based, process training, behavioral, and functional learning content. Ability to translate complex business processes into learner-friendly formats. Learning Technologies Advanced proficiency in: Articulate Storyline 360 Rise 360 Adobe Captivate Learning Management Systems (LMS) AI-enabled learning platforms Simulation and gamification tools AI & Digital Learning Hands-on experience with AI-powered content creation and learning technologies. Knowledge of digital simulations, virtual role-plays, and immersive learning experiences. Exposure to conversational AI, adaptive learning, and learner analytics platforms. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Strong people leadership and coaching skills. Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment. Excellent collaboration and relationship management capabilities. Strong project planning, execution, and governance skills. Communication Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong business writing and technical documentation expertise. Ability to present learning strategies and outcomes to leadership audiences. Success Measures Success in this role will be demonstrated through: Delivery of high-quality learning content and scalable digital learning solutions. Increased adoption of AI-driven learning methodologies and simulation-based training. Improved learner engagement, proficiency, and operational performance. Effective utilization of Articulate, Captivate, and digital learning technologies to drive business outcomes. Strong team performance, innovation, and capability development. Measurable impact on productivity, quality, customer experience, and operational KPIs. Preferred Attributes Experience working in global or matrix organizations. Exposure to digital transformation and workforce upskilling initiatives. Passion for learning innovation, AI technologies, and learner experience design. Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking abilities. Continuous learner with a growth mindset and a focus on business impact.

title: Senior Customer Success Executive
description:
**Company Profile:** 




 MProfit is a rapidly growing wealth\-tech company reshaping how Indians view and track their wealth.
 



  





 Backed by Rainmatter (by Zerodha) and other distinguished investors, MProfit equips investors and wealth professionals with cutting\-edge solutions that offer a clear, consolidated view of their financial assets, enabling better insights and decision\-making.
 



  





 As a robust, data\-driven platform, MProfit is trusted by HNIs, UHNIs, and Family Offices to track and analyse diverse, multi\-asset investment portfolios. Our proprietary integrations with 1200\+ institutions elevate data aggregation to a new standard of precision and automation.
 



  





 Today, MProfit is a leader in India’s wealth\-tech ecosystem, with customers in 300\+ cities collectively tracking 1\.5 lakh\+ portfolios. As we continue to expand our dynamic team, we remain committed to launching new products, pioneering innovations, and redefining wealth tracking for modern India.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




 We are looking for a highly driven and experienced
 **Customer Success Lead – Non\-Voice (Email Support** 
 ) to lead our customer support operations and deliver an exceptional customer experience. This role combines hands\-on customer support expertise with team leadership responsibilities. You will manage a team of 4–5 Customer Success Executives, oversee customer communication through email and ticketing platforms, and ensure timely resolution of customer queries related to portfolio tracking, investment data, integrations, and platform functionality. The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of financial markets, investment products, and SaaS platforms, as well as excellent written communication, analytical thinking, and leadership skills. We are looking for a self\-starter who can contribute from day one, work independently with minimal supervision, and take complete ownership of the customer support function.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Team Leadership \& Support Operations Management:** 



* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of 4–5 Customer Success Executives (Non\-Voice Email Support).
* Drive team productivity, service quality, SLA adherence, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Monitor ticket queues, workload distribution, escalations, and resolution timelines.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and feedback discussions to improve team effectiveness.
* Establish best practices for customer communication, issue resolution, and support processes.
* Take complete ownership of customer support coordination and day\-to\-day support operations.
* Ensure effective resource planning, workload management, and timely resolution of customer issues.



  





**2\. Customer Query Resolution \& Ticket Management:** 



* Manage customer support tickets end\-to\-end through email and helpdesk platforms.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve customer issues related to portfolio tracking, imports, reconciliations, integrations, reports, and product functionality.
* Ensure adherence to defined SLAs, response quality standards, and customer satisfaction goals.
* Prioritise and manage multiple customer conversations simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Handle critical customer escalations and drive timely resolutions.
* Maintain ownership of customer issues until they are successfully closed.



  





**3\. Quality Assurance, Audits \& Coaching:** 



* Conduct regular audits of customer support emails, tickets, and calls in accordance with the organisation's quality audit framework.
* Review customer interactions to ensure adherence to communication standards, product knowledge requirements, SLA commitments, and customer experience benchmarks.
* Track quality metrics and identify recurring gaps, trends, and opportunities for improvement across the team.
* Provide structured feedback, coaching, and training recommendations based on audit findings.
* Ensure consistent compliance with support processes, quality standards, and customer communication guidelines.
* Partner with relevant stakeholders to implement corrective and preventive actions based on audit observations.



  





**4\. Financial Data \& Investment Product Support:** 




 Assist customers with queries related to:
 


* Equities (Stocks)
* Mutual Funds
* PMS
* AIFs
* Bonds \& Fixed Income Instruments
* ETFs
* Alternative Investments



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Analysing portfolio data, transactions, holdings, and reports to identify root causes of customer issues.
* Assisting customers in understanding platform outputs, reports, performance calculations, and investment\-related data.
* Providing consultative guidance on data interpretation and portfolio reporting.



  





**5\. Customer Success \& Relationship Management:** 



* Deliver a high\-quality customer experience through professional, accurate, and empathetic written communication.
* Build trust and credibility by acting as a knowledgeable advisor to customers.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve customer adoption and platform utilisation.
* Gather and document customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring pain points.
* Ensure consistent communication and follow\-up throughout the customer lifecycle.



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 



* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, Onboarding, and Customer Success teams to resolve customer issues efficiently.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure smooth handling of escalations and customer concerns.
* Communicate customer insights, recurring trends, and improvement opportunities to internal teams.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.



  





**7\. Process Improvement \& Operational Excellence:** 



* Take ownership of continuously improving customer support processes, workflows, and operational efficiency.
* Identify process gaps, bottlenecks, recurring customer issues, and inefficiencies across the support function.
* Analyse support metrics, ticket trends, audit findings, customer feedback, and escalation patterns to drive improvements.
* Design and implement scalable solutions that improve response times, resolution quality, customer satisfaction, and team productivity.
* Develop, standardise, and maintain SOPs, workflows, quality guidelines, and best practices across the support team.
* Drive automation and process optimisation initiatives to reduce manual effort and improve operational effectiveness.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, and Customer Success teams to implement long\-term solutions for recurring issues.
* Track the impact of process improvement initiatives and establish measurable outcomes to ensure continuous enhancement of support operations.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence within the team.



  





**8\. Knowledge Management \& Documentation:** 



* Create and maintain internal knowledge resources, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and training documentation.
* Ensure knowledge repositories remain up to date with product enhancements, process changes, and resolutions of recurring issues.
* Contribute to onboarding and training initiatives for new team members.
* Promote knowledge sharing and best practices across the Customer Success team.



  





**Desired Candidate** 



* ProfileBachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Business, Economics, or a related field.
* 4\-6 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Support, Client Servicing, Operations, or related roles.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring customer support or customer success teams.
* Strong understanding of financial markets and investment products, including Stocks, Mutual Funds, PMS, AIFs, Bonds, ETFs, and other wealth management products.
* Excellent written communication skills with strong grammar and business email etiquette.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to investigate customer issues, identify root causes, and communicate solutions effectively.
* Experience working with SaaS products and technology platforms.
* Proficiency in helpdesk and ticketing tools such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Zoho Desk, or similar platforms.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work with financial data.



  





**Key Leadership Traits** 



* Self\-starter who can quickly understand processes and contribute from day one.
* Self\-learner with the ability to independently acquire product, process, and domain knowledge.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision while maintaining high accountability.
* Strong ownership mindset with the capability to independently manage and improve support operations.
* Comfortable making decisions, driving initiatives, and resolving challenges proactively.
* Strong focus on quality, process discipline, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to identify operational inefficiencies and implement sustainable solutions.
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to analyse support metrics, audit findings, and customer feedback to drive decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to build processes, improve team performance, and scale customer support operations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, and team coordination skills.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior experience in fintech, wealth\-tech, broking, investment advisory, mutual fund, PMS, AIF, or financial services organisations.
* Familiarity with portfolio management, capital markets, and investment operations.
* Exposure to customer support metrics, SLAs, CSAT, quality audits, and process improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing customer escalations and leading support teams in a fast\-paced SaaS environment.
