title: Customer Success Manager
description:
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) will be responsible for managing the post\-sales customer lifecycle for BizChat's Omnichannel Communication portfolio, including WhatsApp Business (WABA), RCS, SMS, Email, Voice, and other CPaaS solutions. The role will focus on driving customer onboarding, adoption, retention, and business value realization while building strong relationships with key customer stakeholders. The CSM will act as a trusted advisor, ensuring customers maximize platform utilization and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of additional CPaaS products across the existing customer base.
 








**Reporting to : Regional Head Customer Success.** 




**Grade : Deputy Manager / Manager** 




**Location : Hyderabad /Chennai/Bangalore** 









**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the customer lifecycle from onboarding to renewal for assigned accounts.
* Drive customer activation, adoption, and utilization of WhatsApp Business, RCS, Email, SMS, Voice, and other CPaaS solutions.
* Ensure customers go live within defined timelines and achieve desired business outcomes.
* Monitor customer health, engagement, and usage trends to proactively identify and mitigate churn risks.
* Conduct regular customer reviews and provide recommendations to improve platform adoption, utilization, and business outcomes.
* Act as the primary point of contact for customer escalations and work with internal teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key business and technology stakeholders within customer organizations.
* Collaborate with Sales, Product, Support, and Operations teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
* **Drive cross\-selling and adoption of additional CPaaS products such as SMS, RCS, Email, Voice, Smartflo, Truecaller, and emerging communication solutions within existing customer accounts.**
* Identify upsell opportunities and support account expansion initiatives to increase customer wallet share and platform usage.
* Develop and execute customer success plans focused on retention, growth, expansion, and value realization.
* Capture customer feedback and provide inputs to Product and Business teams for continuous improvement.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 




**Adoption, Retention \& Customer Health (65%)** 



* Customers go\-live within SLA
* Monthly active accounts
* WhatsApp verification/logo adoption
* Reduction in non\-pulsing accounts
* Growth in platform utilization and messaging traffic



**Retention \& Customer Health (30%)** 



* Customer retention rate
* Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
* Churn reduction
* Customer health score
* Renewal success rate



**Cross\-Sell Growth \& Expansion (25%)** 



* Cross\-sell revenue achievement
* Number of accounts adopting additional CPaaS products
* Upsell revenue achievement
* Multi\-product adoption within customer accounts
* Growth in customer wallet share
* Expansion in messaging and communication volumes



**Customer Experience \& Operations (10%)** 



* CSAT/NPS
* SLA adherence
* Escalation management
* CRM hygiene and reporting accuracy



  





**Qualifications** 



* 3–7 years of experience in Customer Success, SaaS, CPaaS, Telecom, or Enterprise Account Management.
* Strong customer relationship and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with WhatsApp Business, RCS, SMS, Email, Voice, or digital engagement platforms is preferred.
* Commercial acumen with the ability to identify cross\-sell and growth opportunities within existing accounts.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively across cross\-functional teams.



  





**Success Profile** 




 A customer\-focused and commercially driven professional who can drive customer adoption, retention, and growth while building trusted customer relationships. The ideal candidate will proactively identify opportunities to expand the use of CPaaS portfolio, increase customer lifetime value, and ensure customers achieve measurable business outcomes from their omnichannel communication investments.
 



 Candidate should be willing to work in the market visiting customers. .

Distributed across 160\+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in\-line cloud security platform.
   

  

 We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

 We are looking for an experienced Technical Success Manager (TSM) to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Manager, Technical Success Management within the Customer Success department. You will serve as a strategic technical advisor, deeply understanding customer goals to align our solutions and drive long\-term satisfaction. By building strong stakeholder relationships and providing proactive recommendations, you will ensure our customers realize the full value of the Zscaler platform.

* Master Zscaler products and services to contribute best\-practice content for internal and customer\-facing Knowledge Bases
* Collaborate across Sales, Support, and Product teams to ensure a seamless and high\-impact customer experience

* You are a high\-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.


**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

description:

Founded by Ashish Singhal, Govind Soni, and Vimal Sagar Tiwari, PeepalCo's products include CoinSwitch and Lemonn. The Group is backed by blue\-chip investors including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Tiger Global, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Ribbit Capital, Paradigm, and Coinbase Ventures.
 



 PeepalCo is the brand name for our Group entity and will house all our wealth\-tech brands. The largest of our brands, CoinSwitch, Lemonn will be housed under PeepalCo.
 



 For more information, visit:
 
 https://peepal.co
 
 \| For media queries, contact: press@peepal.co
 



  





**About Zing** 




 Zing is your personal trading assistant and technical analysis tool, built directly for your charts. It is a plug\-and\-play Chrome extension that works across your favourite web trading platforms, with no coding or complex setup required.
 



 Zing offers a library of curated strategies, real\-time market signals, and one\-click execution with targets and stop\-losses built in and sent directly to your broker. Whether you're placing your first or thousandth F\&O trade, Zing is designed to help traders make more informed decisions.
 



 Zing is currently in beta and is building a new experience for advanced traders.
 



 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a
 **Partnerships Manager** 
 to build and manage Zing's partnerships with
 **creators, influencers, trading coaches, and other partners** 
 who bring traders to the platform.
 



 This is a relationship\-driven role that combines
 **partnership management, business development, relationship management, and customer success** 
 . You will own partner relationships end\-to\-end—from identifying and onboarding new partners to managing ongoing relationships and ensuring successful outcomes.
 



 What You Will Do
 



**1\. Relationship Management** 



* Own and manage Zing's partner relationships end\-to\-end.
* Build strong, long\-term relationships with creators, influencers, coaches, and other partners.
* Act as the primary point of contact for partners and ensure consistent engagement.



**2\. Partnership Management** 



* Identify, develop, and manage partnerships with creators, influencers, trading coaches, and relevant communities.
* Set up and manage partnerships from initial discussions through launch and ongoing execution.
* Work closely with partners to develop effective ways of introducing Zing to their audience.



**3\. Creator \& Influencer Partnerships** 



* Identify and approach relevant creators and influencers in the trading and financial markets space.

**4\. Trading Coach Partnerships** 



* Build relationships with trading coaches and educators.

**5\. Business Development** 



* Identify new partnership opportunities and channels for acquiring traders.
* Take partnerships from the first conversation through negotiation, launch, and ongoing management.
* Explore new ways to grow Zing's reach and user base through strategic partnerships.



**6\. Customer Success** 



* Stay connected with traders acquired through partnerships.
* Understand their experience with Zing and help address relevant issues or concerns.
* Work with internal teams to improve partner and user experience based on feedback.



 What We Are Looking For
 


* Experience in
 **partnership management, business development, creator/influencer partnerships, or customer success** 
 .
* Prior experience working directly with
 **creators, influencers, trading coaches, educators, or online communities** 
 .
* Strong relationship\-building and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable being the primary point of contact and owning relationships independently.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to identify opportunities and take them from
 **initial conversation to execution** 
 .
* Interest in
 **trading, financial markets, F\&O, and advanced charting tools** 
 is highly preferred.
* Self\-driven, entrepreneurial, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced, early\-stage environment.



  





**Life at PeepalCo**

 You will own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of our AI\-powered inspection projects — from technical scoping through installation, configuration, commissioning, UAT, and handover. You will lead a team of Field Application Engineers and Project Managers, and you will be the person our Fortune 500 customers rely on to get their line running. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will be in the detail on project plans, SLAs, and escalations, and you will also be building the systems and standards that let us scale from 30 parallel projects to many more without adding chaos. You will work closely with the Head of Operations, Product and Engineering, and the Sales team.
 



  





**Project Delivery \& Execution** 




 • Own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of projects — scoping, timelines, installation, configuration, commissioning, UAT, and customer handover.
 



 • Deliver projects on time and within budget, and hold the team to the same standard.
 



 • Track and manage timelines and deliverables across technical verticals; anticipate slippage before it happens rather than reporting it afterwards.
 



 • Own Response and Resolution SLAs across queues coming in from Product, Sales, and customers, and ensure optimal work distribution.
 



 • Run root\-cause analysis on delays and rework, and close the loop so the same failure does not repeat.
 



  





**Technical Excellence** 




 • Translate new requirements from Account Executives and customers into clear scope, technical requirements, and realistic timelines.
 



 • Drive delivery of deep\-tech projects (AI / ML / Computer Vision) with a hardware and software footprint on live production lines.
 



 • Represent Operations in project discussions and client calls — identify the exact technical deliverable, communicate it clearly to the technical team, and drive it to completion.
 



 • Continuously improve efficiency metrics: productivity, quality, first\-time\-right installation, and SLA adherence.
 



 • Partner with Product and Engineering to feed structured field learnings back into the roadmap.
 



  





**Customer Delight** 




 • Own the relationship with client SPOCs through proactive communication and disciplined review cadence.
 



 • Make sure what was agreed during the sales process is exactly what gets delivered — and that we consistently over\-deliver.
 



 • Align with the customer's own KPIs and drive improvement initiatives after the system goes live.
 



 • Handle escalations and outages calmly and decisively — with the customer, and on the customer's behalf with third\-party vendors.
 



 • Communicate credibly with plant leadership and senior stakeholders at Fortune 500 manufacturers.
 



  





**Planning \& Resource Management** 




 • Manage day\-to\-day planning, allocation, and problem\-solving across a distributed field team.
 



 • Own resource planning: who goes where, when, and for how long — balancing project urgency against team wellbeing.
 



 • Track work hours and utilisation, and make the case for additional capacity with data when it is genuinely needed.
 



 • Manage project costs, travel, and hardware logistics in coordination with Finance and Supply Chain
 



  





**Team Leadership** 




 • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Field Application Engineers and Project Managers.
 



 • Hire FAEs as our project count and geographic footprint expand — we look for technically stellar and deeply empathetic people.
 



 • Build a high\-performance environment that people want to stay in; our Operations team is one of the most driven teams at SwitchOn and keeping it that way is part of the job.
 



 • Run regular one\-on\-ones and team meetings, surface issues early, and resolve conflict directly and fairly.
 



 • Present team performance honestly to the Head of Operations and senior leadership — including what is not working.

title: Operations Support Manager
description:
**Support Operations Manager — New Products** 




 Function: Operations · Location: Bangalore · Experience: 2–5 years
 



  





**How we hire** 




 Real humans read this. No cover letters.
 



 Send a short note on
 **one process you automated with AI** 
 — what you built, what broke, what it saved.
 



  





**The role** 




 We run a portfolio of consumer apps with 300M\+ users, and this role is for everything we launch next.
 



 You own support for every new product we ship: the queue, the quality, the team, the numbers. At its core this is a support job — early users, real complaints, refunds, bugs, angry reviews.
 



 What makes it different is how you run it. AI is the default here, not an experiment. Every recurring query gets automated; humans handle only what genuinely needs judgement. You'll write prompts and build no\-code workflows — but no product code.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* **Support for every launch.** 
 From day zero: SOPs, canned responses, escalation paths, AI flows. Day\-one users get real answers, not silence.
* **The numbers.** 
 First\-response time, resolution time, CSAT, backlog. You report them weekly and you defend them.
* **The team.** 
 Lead a small group of support agents — hiring, training, rostering, quality reviews, daily priorities. Keep the team small and sharp by automating everything that doesn't need a human.
* **AI\-first by default.** 
 A new product has no ticket history to mine — you'll build on informed guesses, watch the first 500 conversations closely, correct fast.
* **Voice of the first users.** 
 Weekly, with numbers: what's confusing, what's broken, what people actually want.
* **The hard cases.** 
 Payment disputes, safety and abuse reports, bans, anything legal\-sensitive. These stay with you and never run unsupervised.



  





**What we look for** 



* **2–5 years in customer support or support ops** 
 , including time as the senior person on a queue.
* **Daily hands\-on AI user.** 
 Not “I've used ChatGPT” — show us something you automated end to end.
* **You've led or trained agents.** 
 Even two or three people counts.
* Comfort with a blank page. A new product means no process, no data, no precedent.
* Strong on numbers. You can explain a CSAT drop, not just report it.
* Clear written English \+ fluent Hindi. More Indian languages is a real edge.
* Judgement under pressure. Err toward the user, but spot fraud.

title: Client Implementation & Service - Team Lead
description:
Who we are looking for
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced and delivery\-focused Team Lead to manage end\-to\-end client onboarding and conversion activities within the Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding function. The role is accountable for translating business requirements into scalable reconciliation solutions, directing system and data readiness, overseeing testing and production deployment, managing delivery risks, and ensuring a controlled transition to business\-as\-usual operations.
   

  

 The candidate will lead onboarding specialists and work closely with investment managers, custodians, fund administrators, business teams, technology partners, and reconciliation operations. Strong expertise in middle office reconciliation, data analysis, data mapping, TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, project delivery, people leadership, and stakeholder management is required.
   

  

 Why this role is important to us
   

  

 The Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding team supports the implementation of new investment managers and funds onto State Street’s reconciliation platforms. The Team Lead provides day\-to\-day delivery leadership and serves as the central coordination and escalation point across business, operations, technology, clients, and external data providers.
   

  

 The role is critical to ensuring that cash, position, transaction, and market\-value reconciliation requirements are accurately designed, configured, tested, deployed, and handed over to operations. It also promotes consistent delivery standards, effective risk management, team capability, process scalability, and a controlled, low\-risk transition into live reconciliation services.
   

  

 What you will be responsible for
   

  

* Lead assigned onboarding projects from requirement gathering through solution design, configuration, testing, production deployment, stabilization, and operational handover.
* Manage, coach, and develop onboarding specialists; allocate work, set priorities, monitor progress, and provide timely guidance.
* Establish project plans, roles, milestones, dependencies, controls, and success criteria for each implementation.
* Lead discussions with clients, custodians, fund administrators, operations, and technology teams to confirm reconciliation requirements, scope, assumptions, and delivery approach.
* Review and approve fund matrices, account structures, reconciliation types, data sources, frequencies, tolerances, matching criteria, workflows, and reporting requirements.
* Oversee analysis and validation of cash, position, transaction, and market\-value data received through SWIFT messages, flat files, and custodian portals.
* Direct data analysis and mapping for non\-SWIFT files and coordinate with ETL, technology, and deployment teams to establish scalable processing solutions.
* Oversee account, reconciliation shell, lead\-account, match\-rule, workflow, and static\-data setup in BUAT and production environments.
* Plan and oversee functional testing, BUAT, DITL, conversion rehearsals, production parallel testing, and go\-live readiness reviews.
* Act as the escalation point for complex reconciliation exceptions, configuration issues, delivery risks, client concerns, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Lead root\-cause analysis and coordinate sustainable corrective and preventive actions with business, operations, and technology partners.
* Maintain oversight of project plans, open\-item logs, Jira tickets, risk and dependency trackers, status reports, decisions, and implementation documentation.
* Provide concise reporting to management and stakeholders on delivery status, milestones, risks, controls, capacity, and critical decisions.
* Ensure procedures, reconciliation playbooks, configuration records, control evidence, and handover documentation are complete, current, and audit\-ready.
* Oversee post\-production stabilization and ensure outstanding issues, risks, and actions are tracked through closure.
* Maintain a robust operational\-risk and control environment, including adherence to maker\-checker controls, information\-security standards, governance requirements, and escalation protocols.
* Monitor workload, quality, productivity, service levels, project capacity, and delivery performance; implement corrective action where required.
* Identify opportunities to standardize processes, strengthen controls, improve client experience, and reduce manual effort through automation and workflow improvements.
* Lead team training, cross\-skilling, succession planning, knowledge management, and continuous capability development.
* Support system enhancements, strategic initiatives, operating\-model improvements, audit activities, and management reporting as required.


 What we value
   

  

* Strong understanding of middle office reconciliation, investment operations, and the investment\-management lifecycle.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with cash, position, transaction, and market\-value reconciliation.
* Strong knowledge of TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, including static setup, reconciliation configuration, matching rules, tolerances, exception workflows, and administrative functions.
* Experience in external custody data acquisition, SWIFT\-message validation, file analysis, ETL data mapping, and production implementation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead end\-to\-end onboarding projects while managing multiple priorities, dependencies, and timelines.
* Proven people\-leadership capability, including work allocation, coaching, performance support, knowledge development, and quality oversight.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to lead root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions.
* Effective stakeholder\-management, influencing, negotiation, and escalation skills across global teams.
* Strong risk and control mindset, with experience maintaining audit\-ready evidence and addressing operational or implementation risks.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive\-reporting skills.

title: Account Manager- South
description:
Lead the safe, reliable, compliant and cost\-effective operation and maintenance of multiple industrial water and wastewater treatment sites. The role has end\-to\-end accountability for plant performance, contractual KPIs, customer satisfaction, workforce capability, maintenance systems, budgets, vendors, statutory compliance and continuous improvement across the assigned portfolio.
 



 The successful candidate will provide strong technical and operational leadership to site managers and multidisciplinary teams, standardize O\&M practices across locations, and ensure timely resolution of critical operational and customer issues.
 



 2\. Scope of Responsibility
 


* Oversee multiple O\&M contracts and treatment facilities operating on a continuous shift basis.
* Provide governance and technical direction for WTP, ETP, STP, RO and ZLD facilities, including associated pumping, clarification, filtration, sludge handling, evaporation and drying systems.
* Manage mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, automation and process performance through site teams and specialist support functions.
* Own service delivery in line with contract terms, agreed budgets, customer specifications, environmental requirements and internal standards.



 3\. Key Responsibilities
 



 A. Multi\-Site Operations \& Performance
 


* Take overall ownership of day\-to\-day O\&M performance across all assigned sites and ensure uninterrupted availability of critical water systems.
* Review plant operating parameters, water quality, throughput, recovery, uptime and consumption trends; initiate corrective action for deviations.
* Conduct structured site reviews and risk\-based visits, with focused support for underperforming or critical facilities.
* Coordinate rapid technical support for breakdowns, chronic problems and process upsets to minimize downtime and customer production impact.
* Drive process optimization, debottlenecking, reliability improvement and operating\-cost reduction without compromising safety, quality or compliance.
* Ensure effective shift deployment, escalation protocols and management coverage across sites.



 B. Treatment Process \& Technical Oversight
 


* Provide technical governance for raw\-water treatment, clarification, filtration, cooling\-water systems, ETP, STP, RO, UF/NF where applicable, MEE, ATFD, filter press, clarifier, thickener, oil skimmer and complete ZLD systems.
* Monitor influent and effluent quality, RO recovery and rejection, membrane performance, chemical dosing, sludge generation, evaporation efficiency and final discharge or reuse quality.
* Guide root\-cause analysis and sustainable resolution of process, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and automation issues.
* Ensure calibration and documentation of instruments, gauges and measuring devices as per schedule and audit requirements.
* Maintain current technical knowledge and promote adoption of proven operating and maintenance practices.



 C. Maintenance \& Reliability
 


* Establish and govern preventive, predictive, condition\-based, time\-based and breakdown maintenance programs.
* Ensure maintenance planning, work\-order discipline, shutdown planning, spares management and equipment\-history records are effective at every site.
* Review critical equipment health for pumps, motors, blowers, compressors, agitators, dosing systems, dewatering equipment, membranes, evaporators, dryers, MCCs, VFDs, PLC/SCADA and field instruments.
* Lead failure investigations, root\-cause analysis and closure of corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive equipment reliability, reduced repeat failures and optimized maintenance cost.



 D. Safety, Environment \& Compliance
 


* Be accountable for a goal\-zero safety culture across the assigned sites.
* Ensure compliance with HSE/EHS requirements, permit\-to\-work systems, SOPs, risk assessments, PPE, chemical handling, lockout/tagout and emergency preparedness.
* Ensure incidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and environmental events are reported, investigated and closed with effective corrective actions.
* Conduct and monitor safety audits, toolbox talks, hazard\-register reviews and statutory inspections.
* Maintain environmental, legal and customer compliance records in audit\-ready condition.



 E. Contract, KPI \& Customer Management
 


* Establish and review site KPIs in line with contract requirements, including plant availability, water quality, throughput, recovery, downtime, consumption, cost, safety and customer satisfaction.
* Prepare consolidated monthly MIS, performance dashboards, variance analysis and recovery plans for management and customer reviews.
* Lead customer meetings, technical discussions and escalation management; ensure timely closure of observations and commitments.
* Protect contractual performance and billing by ensuring KPI evidence, service records, approvals and monthly documentation are complete and timely.
* Identify contract risks, scope gaps and change requirements, and escalate them with clear technical and commercial justification.



 F. Budget, Cost \& Commercial Control
 


* Prepare and manage annual and monthly O\&M budgets for the assigned portfolio.
* Monitor actual expenditure against budget and control manpower, chemicals, energy, spares, maintenance and subcontracting costs.
* Develop savings initiatives through process optimization, chemical and energy reduction, improved reliability and resource productivity.
* Plan critical spares, consumables, annual maintenance and shutdown requirements based on operational risk and contract obligations.
* Support timely customer billing, certification and resolution of performance\-linked deductions or commercial issues.



 G. Team Leadership \& Capability Building
 


* Lead site managers, engineers, supervisors, technicians, operators and support teams across locations.
* Define accountability, review staffing and shift structures, and ensure deployment matches plant criticality and skill needs.
* Recruit, onboard, coach, train and develop site teams; maintain skill matrices and succession plans for critical roles.
* Set clear performance expectations and conduct structured reviews, while promoting discipline, ownership and collaboration.
* Ensure technically competent manpower is available to troubleshoot critical equipment and process issues.



 H. Systems, Standardization \& Continuous Improvement
 


* Standardize SOPs, checklists, log sheets, maintenance practices, reporting formats and escalation mechanisms across sites.
* Ensure critical work instructions are practical, pictorial and available in a language understood by the workforce where required.
* Use performance data to identify systemic issues, benchmark sites and replicate best practices.
* Coordinate effectively with Process, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, HR, Finance and corporate support functions.
* Promote digital tools such as CMMS/SAP, dashboards and MS Office applications for planning, documentation and performance control.



 4\. Key Performance Indicators
 



**KPI Area** 




**Measures** 




**Safety \& Compliance** 




 Zero injuries; closure of audit findings; statutory and environmental compliance
 



**Plant Performance** 




 Availability, uptime, throughput, treated\-water quality and adherence to operating targets
 



**Process Efficiency** 




 Recovery, chemical consumption, energy consumption, water reuse and sludge or reject management
 



**Reliability** 




 Breakdown frequency, repeat failures, preventive\-maintenance compliance and downtime
 



**Commercial** 




 Budget adherence, cost savings, billing documentation and reduction of performance deductions
 



**Customer** 




 Satisfaction, escalation closure, review effectiveness and completion of commitments
 



**People** 




 Manpower productivity, training completion, skill coverage and retention of critical capability
 



 5\. Qualification \& Experience
 


* Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Environmental or a related engineering discipline. A relevant postgraduate qualification is desirable.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant O\&M experience, preferably in industrial water and wastewater treatment, utilities, heavy industry, metals, chemicals or similar process industries.
* Proven experience managing multiple sites, large contracts or a geographically distributed O\&M portfolio.
* Demonstrated hands\-on exposure to water and wastewater treatment and ZLD operations, together with multidisciplinary maintenance management.
* Experience in customer\-facing roles, budgeting, vendor management, workforce leadership, KPI governance and management reporting.



 6\. Required Technical Knowledge
 


* Water treatment processes: clarification, filtration, disinfection, demineralization and membrane systems.
* Wastewater and reuse systems: ETP, STP, RO, sludge handling and ZLD, including MEE and ATFD where applicable.
* Mechanical systems: pumps, motors, blowers, compressors, agitators, valves, piping and rotating equipment.
* Electrical and instrumentation: HT/LT interfaces, MCC/PCC, VFDs, PLC/SCADA, transmitters, analyzers, control valves, interlocks and calibration.
* Maintenance systems: preventive, predictive, condition\-based and breakdown maintenance; root\-cause analysis; spares planning.
* HSE, environmental compliance, statutory requirements, quality systems and audit documentation.
* Working knowledge of CMMS/SAP, MS Office and data\-based reporting tools.



 7\. Leadership Competencies
 


* Ownership and accountability across multiple operating locations.
* Strong planning, prioritization and decision\-making under operational pressure.
* Customer orientation with confident technical and commercial communication.
* Analytical problem\-solving and disciplined closure of corrective actions.
* Ability to coach teams, build trust and create a safety\-focused performance culture.
* Effective cross\-functional coordination, negotiation and stakeholder management.
* High integrity, adaptability and willingness to travel frequently.



 8\. Decision\-Making Authority
 


* Operational decisions required to protect safety, compliance, equipment and continuity of service.
* Deployment of manpower and resources within the approved organization structure and budget.
* Prioritization of maintenance, spares and technical support based on plant criticality.
* Vendor and service\-provider recommendations in accordance with company procedures.
* Escalation of contractual, commercial, safety and compliance risks to appropriate management.



 9\. Candidate Profile
 



 A hands\-on, results\-oriented O\&M leader who can manage a diverse portfolio of water and wastewater treatment plants, strengthen site leadership, build reliable operating systems and maintain strong customer confidence. The candidate should combine process knowledge with maintenance discipline, commercial awareness, people leadership and an uncompromising approach to safety and compliance.

description:
**Senior Account Manager** 




  





**About Us** 




 Founded in 2013, Datawrkz is a rapidly growing global digital advertising solutions company with a strong presence in India, the US, and the UK. Acquired by Nazara Technologies in 2022 and further strengthened by the acquisition of S\&T in the UK, we continue to expand our global footprint and capabilities.
 



  





 Led by industry veterans, Datawrkz partners with advertisers and publishers to solve complex marketing challenges across industries. We specialize in full\-funnel advertising with a strong focus on delivering measurable outcomes.
 



  





 Our expertise spans Search, Social, Programmatic, and cutting\-edge platform partnerships (including Google, Meta, The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, Vizibl, Ignition, and others) \- enabling us to deliver innovative, performance\-driven solutions. With over a decade of experience, our team of Performance Specialists combines analytical rigor with deep product knowledge to help mid\-market clients and global brands achieve their marketing goals.
 



  





 Learn More About Us
 




 datawrkz.com/careers
 





 datawrkz.com/company
 





 LinkedIn
 





 mediawrkz.com
 




  





**Join Our Managed Services Team** 




  





 Demand Side Managed Services is at the forefront of delivering cutting\-edge digital marketing services to our clients. Joining Managed Services means working on global projects, leveraging cutting\-edge technologies, and shaping the digital marketing landscape for our clients. Expect a culture of continuous learning, collaboration with diverse talents, and impactful contributions to the success of both Datawrkz and our clients. If you thrive on innovation and seek a role where you will make a real difference, the Managed Services team wants to speak with you.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 Lead the Account Management function for your portfolio \- the clients and the team behind them. This is a lead role, and the track into pod leadership.
 



 While the Performance Manager owns the deep campaign analysis, you own the client outcome. Three things define success here:
 


* Keep the clients you have, and grow them.
* Be the person the client trusts, and the one who handles the difficult conversations.
* Keep the portfolio running cleanly, with nothing falling through the cracks.



 The role is for someone who takes ownership without being asked and surfaces problems early, while they're still small.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





*Client Ownership \& Communication* 



* Own a portfolio of clients \- accountable for retention, satisfaction, and revenue growth
* Lead client calls, WBRs/QBRs, and performance evaluations against the client's objectives.
* Build real relationships across client stakeholders \- marketing, growth, and CXO level
* Run the tough client conversations directly \- pricing pushback, scope disputes, escalations that need a firm answer.
* Own escalations. Be the calm, credible voice of the customer inside Datawrkz when things go wrong.
* Build and present client proposals grounded in performance data and market analysis
* .



*Operations \& Performance Oversight* 



* Track performance against CVR, CAC, LTV, ROAS. Flag deviations before the client does.
* Own the insight\-to\-outcome loop: take what the Performance Manager surfaces, drive it into action, and report back to the client on what actually changed.
* Read the numbers well enough to bridge AM and PM, without needing either side to interpret for you.
* Partner closely with Adops, Performance Manager, Analysts, and Sales to close execution gaps and drive account growth.
* Own the operating cadence per account \- reporting timelines, review schedules, pacing checks, without needing reminders.
* Turn performance data into a business narrative with insights and recommendations.


- 


*Team Leadership* 



* Lead the AM team on your portfolio. Set the standard, allocate the work, and own how they show up with clients.
* Be the first escalation point. Issues stop with you before they reach the pod lead.
* Coach the AMs on your team: review their QBR prep, enable them, help them handle escalations themselves next time.
* Represent Account Management in planning with the Performance Manager and Adops leads. Shape the plan..


- 


**What separates a high performer here** 




  




* Walks into a QBR already knowing what the client will ask, with the answer ready.
* Treats an escalation as a chance to rebuild trust, not a fire to put out and move past.
* Spots the growth opportunity in the data before anyone else does.
* Pushes back on execution teams when delivery doesn't match what was promised.
* Makes the AMs on their team better. The coaching shows up in how the team handles clients
* Says the difficult thing to the client early, while it's still fixable.


- 


**Skills and Experience** 



* 4\+ years in Account Management within digital advertising, digital media, or analytics, including experience owning complex or high\-stakes accounts.
* Experience leading a team, or informally leading and developing others alongside your own book.
* Proven track record leading client conversations and turning performance data into a business story.
* Strong problem\-solving with a real track record of driving client engagement.
* Experience managing high\-pressure situations, including client escalation resolution.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Strong organizational discipline. Manages multiple accounts and threads without things slipping.
* Experience working with US and/or UK clients or markets.
* Familiarity with digital advertising platforms is mandatory.



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 




  




* Medical Insurance Coverage of ₹3,00,000 for individual, spouse, and kids, with the option to include parents and increase coverage to ₹5,00,000
* Performance\-driven compensation with upside linked to revenue/gross margin
* Professional development support, including reimbursement for relevant certifications/courses
* A flexible, outcome\-oriented work culture, supported by a global leadership team.
* Onsite perks: meals, recreation, and an open, collaborative environment

Serving industries such as E\-commerce, EdTech, OTT, Travel, Consumer Apps, and News Media.  global scale.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own customer onboarding and ensure a smooth transition from sales to successful adoption.

* Drive 100% renewal of assigned accounts through proactive engagement and value realization.

* Coordinate with Sales, Product, Support and Engineering teams to resolve customer requirements
* Maintain accurate account information, activities, opportunities and renewal timelines in CRM.
* Conduct regular customer check\-ins/business reviews and identify opportunities to increase account value.



  





**What we are looking for:** 



* 1–3 years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success or B2B SaaS.
* Experience in SaaS, IT, CPaaS, Media/Video Technology or a similar technology environment



 preferred.
 


* Strong communication and relationship\-management skills.
* Customer\-first mindset with a strong sense of ownership.
* Ability to understand technology products and translate customer needs into solutions.

title: Operations Co-Ordinator
description:
**Company Description**  

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.


 We’re an award\-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK \& Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft \& Oracle partner
* 3300\+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10\+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland \& UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK \& Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW


We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**  

Group Operations within Version 1 is seeking an experienced and results\-driven Operations Coordinator to join our team.


The role plays a critical part in ensuring the smooth and effective running of multiple Practices. As a key member of the Shared Operations Team, you will be responsible for coordinating operational processes, systems, reporting and data governance, providing the insight, structure and support needed to drive operational excellence and business performance. You will also be expected to follow and adhere to established standard operating procedures (SOPs), while identifying opportunities to enhance and improve them where appropriate.


We are looking for an organised, detail\-oriented and solution\-focused individual who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is motivated by delivering real value. The successful candidate will possess strong commercial awareness, a passion for data and a keen eye for accuracy, while building effective relationships across a wide range of teams and stakeholders. They will have a proven track record of driving outcomes, coordinating activities and getting things done, even where they do not have direct ownership or authority over the resources involved.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Kantata \& Operational Administration**

* Own and coordinate **Kantata**, our centralised timesheet and resourcing tool, including:
* Coordinating ownership of new proposals through CRM synchronisation.
* Managing timesheet administration and follow\-up.
* Working closely with Operations Business Partners (OBPs) to ensure monthly forecasts are in place and accurately maintained.
* Processing end\-of\-tenure leavers.
* Triggering new hire requests (ESRs).
* Maintaining system hygiene and following up on missing business units, unbuilt proposals and other items identified by the Kantata team.
* Ensure key operational data is maintained, reviewed and understood accurately and on a timely basis.

**Financial \& Commercial Data**

* Develop a strong understanding of the financial and commercial drivers within Practice forecasts.
* Monitor and maintain recurring revenue information, ensuring contract data is accurate and revenue is appropriately captured.
* Monitor project resourcing, including available talent and external hiring requirements.
* Monitor individual and team chargeability and understand the key drivers behind week\-on\-week fluctuations.
* Track and report contractor utilisation on a monthly basis.
* Prepare regular reports and provide meaningful insights and key information to support the Leadership Team.

**Governance, Compliance \& Reporting**

* Support compliance reporting across areas including ITIL, Cyber Essentials, phishing awareness and vulnerability communications.
* Support the tracking and governance of operational actions, ensuring appropriate follow\-up and closure.
* Own and/or attend key meetings across the week, ensuring minutes, actions and follow\-ups are accurately documented and progressed.

**Process Improvement \& Automation**

* Continuously identify opportunities to improve processes and procedures within the Practice and across the wider organisation.
* Collaborate regularly with counterparts across the business to promote consistency and a single way of working.
* Identify opportunities to automate operational processes and drive automation where practical and beneficial.
* Proactively identify issues and work with relevant stakeholders to develop and implement solutions.

**General Operations Support**

* Provide general administrative and operational support to the Practice as required.
* Manage multiple priorities effectively, ensuring tasks and activities are completed accurately and within agreed deadlines.
* Build strong working relationships with Practice Leads, Delivery Managers and other stakeholders across the business.

 **Qualifications** **Skills, Experience \& Qualifications**

* **At least 5 years' experience** in similar operations, coordination or practice support role.
* Strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in working with data, understanding trends and identifying the drivers behind the numbers.
* Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
* Good commercial awareness and numerical acumen. A financial background is desirable but not essential.
* Comfortable working with **Excel at an intermediate level**, including lookups and pivot tables.
* Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against deadlines.
* Strong ownership and accountability, with a proven ability to follow tasks through to completion.
* Proactive and solution\-focused, with the confidence to identify issues and initiate appropriate action.
* Collaborative approach, with the ability to bring the right people together to resolve issues and drive outcomes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across different teams and levels of the organisation.
* Discreet and trustworthy, with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment and adapting to changing priorities.
* Professional and ethical approach, aligned with Version 1's core values.

 **Additional Information**  

Why Version 1?


 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance\-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression \& mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance \& Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards \& ‘Call\-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.


And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.


Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.


We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.


We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact your recruiter at Version 1\. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Specialist - India
description:

### **About JumpCloud®**


JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

  

**About the Role :**

You will be working directly with executive and senior leadership with various initiatives surrounding the renewal process, customer lifecycle, Account Management team, SKUs, pricing and quotes, and more. This role would be considered a senior position where you have the autonomy to help drive strategy, lead projects, and cross collaborate with other stakeholders to ensure we build the best overall customer experience. The ideal candidate will be a self\-starter with a proven track record in Account Management, Sales \& Revenue Ops, a strong understanding of GTM and Account Management business models, and excellent communication skills.


### **Roles \& Responsibilities :**


* **CRM \& Pipeline Hygiene:** Maintain data accuracy, completeness, and standardization in Salesforce to ensure reliable forecasting and reporting. Conduct regular audits of pipeline data in collaboration with regional RevOps leads and Sales/Marketing teams.
* **Sales Forecasting:** Own day\-to\-day operations and hygiene in sales forecasting and pipeline management. Ensure forecasting inputs are reliable and system usage remains consistent across Account Management / Renewal teams. Track proper utilization of the tool as a forecasting tool across the company
* **Project Contribution:** Assist with leading projects as well as contributing to large complex requests that involve multiple cross departmental stakeholders. This role will act as point for the Account Management team and will need to ensure that management of requests, changes, projects, and reporting is executed upon in a manageable timeline and while meeting requirements and expectations.
* **Ad\-hoc Analysis:** Drive on\-demand analysis, data pulls, CRM changes, and insights generation for Operations and GTM stakeholders. Partner with Deal Desk and support operational processes.
* **Operational Support:** Responsible for ensuring Account Management team’s workflows for sending quotes and the underlying operations are effective, efficient, and delivered prior to month\-end. Work alongside the DealDesk team to ensure accurate data is reflected within quarterly and yearly quotas, revenue expansion, upsells, and Book of Business metrics. Work cross collaboratively with stakeholders and department leaders to support business vision and initiatives of the Account Management team.
### **You Have :**


* 8\+ years in Account Management, Revenue Operations, Success Operations, or a related GTM operational role.




	+ At least 3\+ years of experience supporting Account Management and Renewals teams
* Deep expertise in Salesforce administration, development, and GTM system governance, including process mapping and automation.
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast\-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly growing environment.
* Excellent communication skills and timely communications
* Experience with AI tooling such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Rovo, or AgentForce.
* Ability to take initiative, work flexibly, and adhere to priorities with minimal direct supervision
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross\-functionally and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Bachelor's degree.
* Willingness to work EMEA hours \- 1pm to 10pm IST
###### **\#LI\-PS1**

 **Where you’ll be working/Location:**
JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**
**Language:**JumpCloud® has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

\#LI\-Remote \#BI\-Remote
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: R&D Operations and Communication Manager
description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**

**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.** **At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**

**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**

**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**

**Your Role:** R\&D Operations and Communication Manager

 **Location:** Elanco IAC, Bangalore

 **Reports to:** R\&D Site Lead

 **Role Summary**


This role is a strategic partner and force multiplier to the R\&D Site Lead \& Lead Team, operating at the center of site leadership rather than in support of it.  



  

This role is responsible for translating global \& site strategy into tangible action, culture \& communication at Elanco Innovation \& Alliance Center (IAC).  



  

This role is responsible for serving as the chief of operations and communications for the local site. The person in this role serves as a trusted extension of the R\&D Lead Team, representing the office in forums where sound judgment, discretion, and credibility are essential.  



  

The Site Operations role not only provides administrative and coordination support but also helps advance key site priorities through a focus on leadership effectiveness, strategic alignment, and organizational health advancing global initiatives and translating them at the ground level in consultation with the local R\&D Lead Team.

 **Your Responsibilities: \-**

 **Strategic Partnership \& Site Leadership**

* Serve as strategic advisor and thought partner to the R\&D Site Lead \& Lead Team shaping how strategic initiatives translate into concrete site\-level action
* Partner with the leadership team and enable the site's strategic planning and prioritization efforts by facilitating discussions, tracking key initiatives, and helping ensure leadership attention is directed toward critical priorities
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions and support business case development for strategic site capabilities, including opportunities to enhance IAC’s role as an AI hub within the R\&D, partnering on the AI COP
* Build and sustain direct working partnerships with R\&D executive and functional lead team members, acting as a trusted point of contact on their behalf for site\-level priorities, cross\-functional dependencies, and follow\-through

**Executive Communications \& Organizational Narrative**

* Provide support and enable successful delivery of flagship site events such as R\&D Connect Week —from theme and content architecture through post\-event communications to the larger audiences (internal \& external)
* Facilitate and support senior leadership engagement initiatives including townhalls, and speaker preparation
* Provide communications support for the Site Lead by helping craft executive briefings, leader emails, and broader site communications that are impactful, engaging, and people\-centric
* Build and protect a consistent communications narrative that ties site activity back to a central R\&D theme across the year

**Organizational Health**

* Work closely with the HSE Lead and team, providing coordination and operational support while acting as an integral member of the team.
* Champion site culture enhancement ideas that include employee engagement initiatives, cross\-functional team building activities, and serving as the R\&D ERG Liaison in partnership with the EBS ERG Leadership.
* Lead organizational change management (OCM) on site, through major transitions, pairing structured process with communication that helps people make sense of what's changing and why
* Partner with R\&D Lead Team to collate talent advancement and the STA (short\-term assignment) pipeline for talent across the site

**Governance, Project \& Team Leadership**

* Project manage operational initiatives to delivery representing the local R\&D Lead Team and global functional leaders
* Schedule and facilitate R\&D Lead Team meetings, floor initiatives and cross\-functional governance forums, capture minutes, key decisions \+ action points
* Own the site's project portfolio dashboard and reporting cadence for leadership and global stakeholders
* Maintain oversight of site operations (logistics, visitor and delegate management, calendar and travel support for visiting leaders), ensuring consistent quality and timeliness
* Potentially own and execute site\-based projects

 **What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**

  

* Minimum 10\+ Years of relevant experience working in a global environment or supporting a global environment, specifically in animal/human health R\&D

 **What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):**

  

* Proven experience operating as a strategic partner to leaders in a global, matrixed organization
* Executive presence and the discretion to handle highly confidential, sensitive matters
* Exceptional written communication — able to write convincingly and authentically
* Track record of driving execution across functions without formal authority
* Comfort leading through ambiguity and building structure or governance where none previously existed

 **Additional Information:**

  

* Based in Bangalore, India, at the IAC site, expected to complete 30 days/Quarter of in\-office presence.
* Frequent partnership with global, cross\-time\-zone stakeholders across the US and Europe
* Proficiency across the MS Office suite; comfortable adopting AI and new\-age content tools


Elanco is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status

These tools help ensure a consistent, structured evaluation, but they do not make hiring decisions. All decisions involve a human reviewer. description:
**Job Description :**

 **About the Function:**  

  

Digital \& Technology (D\&T) is transforming how Diageo works, from how we source ingredients to how we connect with customers and consumers around the world.


This is where data, technology and creativity come together to solve real business challenges and unlock new opportunities. Whether it’s building platforms, using data to drive decisions or shaping digital experiences, the work here has tangible impact across every part of our business.

**Job Title**


Sr. Manager – Data Integration (S4Hana \& Azure Data Lake)

**Location**


Bangalore HO / Hybrid

**Reporting To**


Head of Data and Analytics

**Role Purpose**


We are seeking an experienced Manager to lead the design, implementation, and transition of data extraction and replication processes from SAP S/4HANA to Azure Data Lake as part of our enterprise S/4HANA transformation program.


The role will be responsible for managing changes to SAP extractors, data structures, replication frameworks, and data pipelines while ensuring continuity of business reporting, analytics, and downstream data consumption. The successful candidate will act as the bridge between SAP functional teams, data engineering teams, analytics stakeholders, and system integrators to deliver a robust and scalable data architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**S/4HANA Data Extraction \& Replication**

* Lead the design and implementation of data extraction strategies from SAP S/4HANA into Azure Data Lake.
* Assess existing SAP ECC/BW extractors and define migration and replacement strategies for S/4HANA.
* Design and manage extraction mechanisms including:
	+ SAP CDS Views
	+ ODP (Operational Data Provisioning)
	+ SAP Extractors
	+ SLT (SAP Landscape Transformation)
	+ SAP Datasphere integrations (where applicable)
	+ SAP Data Intelligence/Data Services
* Define approaches for real\-time, near real\-time, and batch data replication.

 **Azure Data Lake Integration**

* Manage end\-to\-end data movement from S/4HANA into Azure Data Lake.
* Collaborate with Azure Data Engineering teams on:
	+ Azure Data Factory (ADF)
	+ Azure Synapse Analytics
	+ Databricks
	+ Event\-driven architectures
	+ Delta Lake frameworks
* Ensure scalable, performant, and secure data ingestion pipelines.

**Data Model \& Table Transition Management**

* Analyze impacts of S/4HANA simplification on source tables and data structures.
* Identify changes between ECC and S/4HANA data models, including:
	+ Universal Journal (ACDOCA)
	+ Material Ledger
	+ Business Partner Model
	+ Inventory Management changes
	+ Procurement and Sales table changes
* Define source\-to\-target mapping and transformation logic.
* Govern transition of legacy tables and custom extractors to S/4HANA\-compatible structures.

**Data Governance \& Quality**

* Establish controls to ensure data completeness, accuracy, and reconciliation between SAP and Azure environments.
* Define data validation, monitoring, and exception handling processes.
* Support data lineage, metadata management, and audit requirements.
* Partner with Data Governance teams to ensure compliance with enterprise standards.

 **Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**

* Work closely with:
	+ SAP Functional Teams
	+ SAP Basis Teams
	+ Data \& Analytics Teams
	+ Azure Engineering Teams
	+ System Integrators
	+ Business Reporting Teams
* Manage delivery from implementation partners and third\-party vendors.
* Drive issue resolution and decision\-making during migration and cutover phases.

**Program Delivery**

* Support planning and execution of:
	+ Data migration activities
	+ Testing cycles
	+ Mock conversions
	+ Dress rehearsals
	+ Cutover activities
* Identify risks and dependencies related to data integration and reporting continuity.
* Develop transition plans from legacy extraction frameworks to S/4HANA\-based architecture.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 8–12\+ years of experience in SAP Data \& Analytics environments.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
* Proven experience implementing SAP\-to\-Azure data integration solutions.

 **Essential Experience**

**SAP**

* SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA data architecture.
* SAP extractors and operational reporting frameworks.
* ODP framework.
* CDS Views and Embedded Analytics.
* SAP BW/BW4HANA (preferred).
* Understanding of key S/4HANA simplification items and table changes.

**Data Integration**

* Real\-time and batch replication architectures.
* ETL/ELT frameworks.
* Data quality and reconciliation processes.
* Large\-scale enterprise data migration programs.

**Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder management and business partnering skills.
* Excellent communication and workshop facilitation capabilities.
* Analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* Ability to influence senior business stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration and cross\-functional leadership skills.
* Results\-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex transformation environm

title: Manager - Strategy
description:
Job Description
**Manager Strategy \& Operations**
**Clear’s Vision**
==================


Clear makes software for the CFO's office. We started with tax compliance in India and now sell in 11 countries. Governments around the world are introducing rules that require businesses to report their invoices to the tax authority and exchange them over government\-designated networks. 29 countries have mandates coming into force between now and 2030\. Each mandate means enterprises have to change how their finance systems work, usually against a fixed deadline, and they need a vendor to do it for them.  

  

**Where we are as of today:**  

* 3,700\+ enterprise customers
  
* Live or ready in 11 countries, up from 3 a year ago. We expect 25\+ by early 2027\.
  
* Government accreditation in India, Saudi Arabia, UAE, France and Oman
  
* 6M\+ invoices processed a week in Saudi Arabia alone, at 99\.9% success
  
* Targeting profitable growth with 40%\+ revenue CAGR over the next three years
  


Our international business will be larger than our India business within the year. We have also started working in markets well ahead of their mandate dates, currently the Philippines and Spain.
Alongside the compliance business we have begun building AI products on top of the finance data we already hold for customers. CFO Studio and Agent Studio let finance teams build agents that do actual work rather than produce reports.
This is the bigger opportunity for us over the next few years. We already hold compliance data for a few thousand enterprises, which puts us in a reasonable position to take on more of the work that runs a CFO's office.
**Purpose of the Role**
=======================


This role sits in the CEO's office and reports to the Chief of Staff to the CEO.  

  

**What you will be responsible for**
**Running programmes through to a decision.** You will be given something loosely defined — that we take too long to open a new market, or that our win rate in Europe is not improving. You work out what the goal should be, who needs to be involved and what the plan is, then run it until a decision is made and implemented.
**Operating cadence and reporting.** Weekly and monthly reviews across markets and business lines, with one set of numbers that everyone works off. A large part of this is noticing when something is going wrong early enough that it can still be acted on, rather than reporting it once the quarter has closed.
**New market work.** For countries whose mandates are 18 to 24 months away, we need to understand the size of the opportunity, the partner and regulatory landscape, and what has to be ready and by when. You would be doing this research yourself.
**Analysis on open questions.** Pricing, partnership models, cross\-sell, where the next increment of GTM budget should go. We would want a recommendation you have thought through and can argue for, rather than a summary of what other people think.  

  

**Role Scope**
The scope is to cover any kind of programs pertaining to Strategy and Operations. The list of programs is not constant and keeps evolving as new problems are uncovered or changing priorities. To give examples of a few programs are \-  

* **Business strategy \-** Going through the historical patterns and identifying strategic levers \& initiatives to grow sales
  
* **Rhythms and rituals \-** These would include business review rhythms, pipeline reviews, interlocks with other non\-sales functions, etc.
  
* **Customer segmentation \-** Segment customers into logical cohorts and orient sales/ sdr/ marketing towards high value cohorts.
  
* **KPI planning \-** Defining the right KPIs for the sales / sdr teams \- output and inputs
  
* **Sales enablement \-** Defining the training needs based on wins/ losses and running a structured program to upgrade the wider sales team
  
* **Process streamlining and automation \-** Critically evaluating the as\-is process of sales (external as well as internal) and implement tools for automation to drive productivity
  


**Competencies Required**  

* Analytical Acumen \- Ability to drive meaning out of numbers. This has multiple components:
	+ Data accuracy \- ensuring data is always accurate and reliable
	+ Insights \- leveraging data to generate insights for the leaders
	+ Actions \- leveraging insights to recommend high impact actions.
  
* Strategic Thinking \- Ability to take step\-back from regular operations work and think long\-term for the business. This implies \- Building independent point of views on strategic decisions \- such as partnership or cross\-sell motion, etc.
  
* Program Management \- ability to manage multiple programs via impact\-based prioritisation and keep relevant stakeholders always informed. This also includes forecasting risk (pre\-morterm) and taking corrective actions.
  
* Process, Playbook \& Technology first Mindset \- ability to think of processes in the form of scalable playbooks which can be implemented and sales can be enabled on. This also means having a technology and AI first first mindset to maximise automation vs manual work.
  
* Sales Acumen \- Ability to understand how B2B sales motion works, what are the deal success factors, what are the top metrics tracked, how sales folks behave, etc.
  


**Qualification Pre\-Requisite**  

* Proven 1\-3 years of experience for the Program Manager role

  

* Should have worked in a technology startup before or premier Consulting firm with projects in the technology/ software industry
  
* Exposure to B2B Sales is preferable but not mandatory
