title: Customer Success Business Partner - Anaplan
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.



What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture.



Our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.



Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.



Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you'll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let's build what's next \- together!

  


**Anaplan is looking for a highly driven and dynamic Customer Success Business Partner (CSBP)** **to join the Customer Success team in Bangalore, India.** *The CSBP will be primarily responsible for the successful deployment, enablement, adoption, and ongoing health of our customers and their Anaplan solutions*. Acting as a trusted advisor for customers, the CSBP will work alongside our Partners and Professional Services team to drive customer outcomes and ensure Anaplan delivers high ROI. As the primary customer contact for any platform challenges, the CSBP will handle critical issues and ensure customer satisfaction.
  

**This is what you will do at Anaplan**
* **Manage a portfolio of customers with the primary goal of driving adoption, expansion, retention and maximizing ROI**
* Act as a *trusted adviser* to our customers throughout the value delivery life cycle, helping them achieve business objectives and transform their processes using Anaplan.
* Work with customers to understand pain points and guide them on how Anaplan solutions can address their specific needs
* Build and present Success Scorecards during QSRs (Quarterly Success Reviews) with Executive sponsor and senior stakeholders
* Grow the Anaplan footprint by conducting workshops to build customer mindshare on new use cases and solutions resulting in upsell or cross sell opportunities.
* Own key relationships with customers and proactively maintain high levels of engagement with a focus on increasing customer satisfaction and loyalty
* Act as the voice of customer to our internal stakeholders, including flagging and managing risks, advocating for their needs and ensuring alignment on objectives.
* Identify renewal risk and work with Renewal managers and Account executives on a mitigation plan
* Advise customer on developing a Center of Excellence or similar governance structure to enable customers self\-sufficiency on Anaplan
* Develop customer success assets and playbooks and help drive customer references and case studies

**Your Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of work experience in customer success, presales or management consulting
* **Prior experience with Enterprise performance management (EPM), Enterprise Planning \& Analytics is a must**
* **Highly preferable to have experience in Anaplan; If not any of the relevant EPM / Planning tools such as Oracle EPM, SAP IBP / SAC, OneStream, Kinaxis, O9 etc.**
* Bachelor's degree, with focus on business, finance, marketing, operations, supply chain. CA/MBA a plus.
* Excellent communication skills with an ability to interact with C suite and other stakeholders in a consultative setting
* Familiarity with value selling and ability to do discovery with customers
* Experience understanding, translating, and optimizing client processes is a plus
* Subject matter expertise in planning and modelling with specialisation in either Supply Chain, Finance or Sales is a plus

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren't just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it's how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!



We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.


**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**



It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.



Anaplan does not:


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.


All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.



Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

* Expert in functional programming and JVM based languages\- Python/Kotlin, Java

* Experience with building production\-grade ML pipelines, APIs amd MLOps frameworks such MLflow, Kubeflow

title: AI Architect
description:
**You Belong at Greenway**

Bring your best and truest self. We celebrate what makes us different and what brings us all together. At Greenway Health, we are committed to an inclusive environment and a culture of belonging as we pursue our purpose of healthier communities, successful providers, and empowered patients. We are united in our goal to build the future of healthcare technology. Join us.


The AI Architect defines and guides scalable, maintainable, AI\-enabled product architecture for modern product delivery and legacy modernization. This role translates product goals, customer commitments, engineering constraints, and modernization needs into practical architecture, service models, integration patterns, technical standards, and reusable solution accelerators. The role is expected to use AI tools to improve architecture discovery, documentation, design comparison, codebase understanding, modernization planning, and engineering enablement while maintaining accountability for technical decisions.


**Key Outcomes**
----------------


* Clear architecture direction for new product features, modernization, cloud adoption, integrations, and scalable product capabilities.


* Reduced technical debt and increased maintainability through service modeling, architecture standards, reusable patterns, and modernization roadmaps.


* Improved engineering productivity through AI\-assisted architecture documentation, codebase analysis, design accelerators, and internal architecture bots.


* Stronger alignment among product, engineering, QA, DevOps, data, and leadership stakeholders around feasible and sustainable technical solutions.


**Roles and Responsibilities**
------------------------------


* Lead product architecture for new capabilities, modernization initiatives, service decomposition, API strategies, integration patterns, data flows, cloud adoption, and non\-functional requirements.


* Use GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise/Team, and approved AI tools to accelerate codebase exploration, design option comparison, architecture documentation, sequence diagrams, ADR, risk analysis, and modernization planning.


* Develop and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical service models that support product initiatives, integration requirements, operational needs, and long\-term maintainability.


* Define architecture standards, design patterns, API guidelines, service boundaries, data handling patterns, observability expectations, and quality attributes for product teams.


* Analyze current\-state architecture, product performance, reliability, scalability, technical debt, integration constraints, and modernization opportunities.


* Partner with product management to translate business priorities and customer commitments into technically feasible roadmaps, implementation strategies, and release increments.


* Guide engineers and QA teams on design decisions, testability, service contracts, performance risks, backward compatibility, and modernization safety.


* Create proofs of concept to evaluate feasibility, desirability, viability, and operational impact of emerging technologies, cloud capabilities, AI\-enabled engineering accelerators, and internal bots.


* Establish product\-level architecture governance that is lightweight, practical, and aligned to agile delivery


* Mentor senior engineers and engineering managers in system design, service ownership, technical debt management, AI\-assisted architecture practices, and full\-cycle engineering standards.


* Document architecture decisions, diagrams, service catalogs, integration patterns, technical risks, and modernization roadmaps in formats usable by engineers and product stakeholders.


* Continuously review industry trends and internal product constraints to evolve architecture practices, technology direction, and AI\-enabled engineering adoption.


### **Education**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline is required; equivalent deep technical experience may be considered.


* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Architecture, or related discipline is preferred.


* Cloud, architecture, DevOps, data, or AI\-related certifications are preferred when supported by practical implementation experience.


### **Experience**


* Overall Experience of 14\+ years in software development and architecture.


* 8\+ years of software development, product engineering, architecture, or technical design experience.


* 5\+ years of senior technical leadership, architecture ownership, product modernization, service design, integration architecture, or platform engineering experience is preferred.


* Proven experience designing scalable, secure, maintainable, high\-performance product architectures for complex applications.


* Experience with legacy modernization, cloud services, distributed systems, API design, data architecture, technical debt management, and cross\-functional solutioning.


* Experience using AI tools for architecture analysis, documentation, codebase understanding, proof\-of\-concept acceleration, or engineering enablement is preferred.


### **Skills**


* Expert knowledge of software architecture, system design, service modeling, integration patterns, cloud\-native design, distributed systems, and non\-functional requirements.


* Strong understanding of full\-stack product engineering, databases, APIs, event\-driven systems, CI/CD, observability, performance, reliability, and security principles.


* Ability to use AI tools to analyze legacy systems, summarize codebase behavior, compare design alternatives, identify risks, draft documentation, and accelerate proof\-of\-concept work.


* Ability to create architecture decision records, diagrams, service catalogs, modernization roadmaps, technical standards, and reusable engineering patterns.


* Strong communication skills with the ability to align technical and non\-technical stakeholders around architecture decisions and trade\-offs.


### **Abilities**


* Influences across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, data, and leadership teams without relying only on formal authority.


* Balances long\-term architecture health with customer commitments and delivery constraints.


* Converts ambiguity into clear architecture direction, incremental modernization plans, and executable engineering guidance.


* Mentors teams toward full\-cycle ownership, reusable patterns, and accountable AI\-enabled engineering practices.


* Maintains practical governance that improves quality and speed rather than increasing unnecessary process overhead.


### **Tools and Technologies**


* GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise/Team, Claude, approved AI assistants for architecture exploration, documentation, code explanation, modernization analysis, proof\-of\-concept acceleration, and engineering enablement.


* Architecture and documentation tools for diagrams, ADRs, service catalogs, backlog alignment, and architecture reviews.

* Hands\-on experience with automation frameworks and tools, including Reqnroll, BDD, C\#, .NET, Appium, and Selenium.

* AI\-assisted architecture recommendations must be validated against product context, engineering constraints, performance needs, maintainability, and operational risk.

* AI tools should accelerate discovery and documentation but not replace architecture review, stakeholder alignment, or hands\-on technical validation.

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Join OneAdvanced:

We are looking for a ServiceNow Administrator to own the day\-to\-day health, hygiene and administration of our ServiceNow instances, so that AI workflow capability can be built and deployed on foundations that behave predictably.


You will own access and configuration control, run family release upgrades, manage environments and releases, and keep platform performance, data quality and licence position under control. This role is the difference between a platform that scales and one that slowly becomes a maintenance problem — and it carries the authority to say no to changes that would take us in the wrong direction.


What You Will Do:
**Key responsibiliteis include, but not limited too:*** Administering users, groups, roles and ACLs, and maintaining a defensible access model across instances.
* Maintaining core platform configuration including assignment rules, notifications, SLAs, service catalogue and reporting.
* Supporting the planning and running ServiceNow family release upgrades end to end — skipped\-update review, regression testing, remediation planning and post\-upgrade verification.
* Supporting the management of environments and releases: update set or source control promotion, clone scheduling and clean\-up, and pre\-production data integrity.
* Monitoring platform performance and health — scheduled jobs, transaction and log analysis, system diagnostics — and acting before issues reach users.
* Supporting CMDB and data quality, including discovery data integrity and the accuracy of CI relationships used by workflow and AI capability.
* Managing the licence and subscription position, including entitlement usage tracking and flagging commercial risk.
* Building and maintaining reports, dashboards and Performance Analytics content for operational and leadership use.
* Operating and enforcing change control, and maintaining accurate platform documentation and configuration records.
* Providing second\-line platform support to the Workflow Development team and to internal users, and resolving issues to root cause.


What You Will Have:
**What you will have:**

* Minimum **2\-4years** of experience as a ServiceNow Administrator.
* Proven experience as a ServiceNow Administrator in a complex enterprise environment, with strong knowledge of platform configuration and governance.
* Strong understanding of users, groups, roles, ACLs, environments, releases and change control.
* Experience supporting ServiceNow family upgrades, including testing, remediation and post\-upgrade validation.
* Good understanding of platform health, performance, CMDB, Discovery and data quality.
* Experience with ServiceNow reporting, dashboards, Performance Analytics and licence management.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues to root cause and proactively identify platform risks.
* A disciplined approach to documentation, governance and configuration management, with the confidence to challenge changes that could compromise platform stability.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with an interest in automation and AI\-enabled workflows.


\#LI\-PB1


What We Do For You:
* **Wellbeing focused** – Our people are our greatest assets, and ensuring everyone feels their best self to come to work is integral.
* **Annual Leave** – 20 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
* **Employee Assistance Programme** – Free advice, support, and confidential counselling available 24/7\.

	+ **Development Programmes** – From Future Managers to Leadership Training, our development programmes help you get where you need to go
	+ **Online Learning Platform: SkillsHub!** \- Learning at your fingertips, anytime from anywhere. You can access our online library with relevant content for your career growth.
* **Life Insurance** \- 3x annual salary
* **Personal Accident Insurance** \- providing cover in the event of serious injury/illness.
* **Performance Bonus** – Our Group\-wide bonus scheme enables you to reap the rewards of your success


Who We Are:

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector\-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.  

We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.  

OneAdvanced is one of the UK’s largest business software and services companies. Based in Birmingham (The Mailbox), operating across the UK, Ireland, India, and Australia.  

Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.  

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.  

Proud to be recognised in the Financial Times’ Best Employers 2026 list for the second\-year running, an independent and data led ranking based on employee feedback. Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.


Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.

title: Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Your role
  

Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today \- and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem\-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  

  

In this role, you’ll balance hands\-on delivery with long\-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  

Analyze and Solve, Diagnose complex issues across servers, networks, cloud environments and systems to identify root causes. Recommend solutions that balance technical feasibility, timelines and customer priorities. Test, refine and automate processes to improve reliability, efficiency and repeatability. Assess risks proactively and implement strategies to prevent disruptions
  

Design and Integrate, Plan end\-to\-end infrastructure solutions across platforms and technologies. Integrate systems in hybrid cloud and on\-prem environments to ensure seamless operation. Automate workflows and processes to streamline delivery and reduce errors. Document architectures and procedures for hand\-offs, knowledge sharing and operational continuity
  

  

Collaborate and Deliver, Coordinate cross\-functional teams including Architects, Project Managers and Technicians. Drive project delivery from initiation to completion with attention to quality and timelines. Communicate technical solutions clearly to customers and stakeholders. Build customer confidence by delivering tangible, high\-impact results, Grow and Advance, Expand technical expertise across cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems and emerging technologies, Earn certifications and qualifications while applying them on real projects, Pursue career paths toward Architect or Distinguished Engineer roles


**Your Future at Kyndryl**  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


**Required skills and experience**

* Deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics)
* Enterprise IT application experience
* Hands\-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain
In\-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System  
* 

  

**Preferred skills and experience**

* Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures
* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models
* Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems
Analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail  
* 

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Regional Learning Manager, ATS
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon's Learning \& Development (L\&D) team within IN ATS Operations is seeking a highly experienced and results\-oriented Learning Manager to lead and scale strategic L\&D initiatives across our rapidly growing operations network. This is a pivotal role that sits at the intersection of talent strategy, learning innovation, and operational excellence — directly influencing how Amazon builds, develops, and retains world\-class talent at scale.  

  

The role will own end\-to\-end program management of high\-impact initiatives spanning the full L\&D value chain: from shaping the hiring strategy and building organizational capability (associates and managers) through programs, to driving content development, expanding centralized learning systems, and leading change management across the network. You will be the single\-threaded owner for programs such as Flex (ALFA), global learning benchmarks, and defect reduction — translating data into actionable learning interventions that move the needle on associate performance and operational quality.  

  

This role demands a leader who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level — someone who can present compelling L\&D narratives in Quarterly Business Reviews and Operational Planning forums to senior leadership, while simultaneously diving deep into data cuts to identify root causes and scope improvement opportunities. You will manage the L\&D budget with fiscal discipline, drive the expansion of learning technology infrastructure, and navigate the learning implications of externalization changes — all while maintaining focus on the associate experience.  

  

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of program management expertise, analytical horsepower, learning domain knowledge, and the ability to influence without authority across operations, HR, quality, and technology teams. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast with purpose, and are energized by the opportunity to build mechanisms that scale learning impact across one of the world's most complex fulfillment networks.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Hiring Strategy: Own the end\-to\-end L\&D hiring strategy, including workforce planning, talent pipeline development, and role\-specific competency frameworks. Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure timely and quality hiring aligned to business growth plans.  

ALFA Strategy: Evaluate and iterate on Flex Fulfillment Associate strategy — identify what is working, diagnose gaps, and drive continuous improvement through mechanism\-based interventions.  

Capability Building (GB \& BB): Design, launch, and scale capability building programs. Define success metrics, track certification throughput, and ensure programs are tied to operational improvement outcomes.  

Program Management: Own program management for new programs, global benchmarks. Drive cross\-functional alignment, establish milestones, manage risks, and report progress to senior leadership.  

QBR \& OP1: Prepare and present L\&D performance narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) and OP1 planning. Own the data story — translate learning metrics into business impact language that resonates with senior leaders.  

Defect Reduction: Lead defect reduction initiatives by generating data cuts that identify scope of improvement. Partner with operations and quality teams to prioritize high\-impact defect categories and design targeted learning interventions.  

Content Development: Own the end\-to\-end content development strategy and execution. Define content standards, manage the content creation pipeline, and ensure learning materials are current, engaging, and aligned to operational needs. Drive content effectiveness measurement and continuous improvement.  

Change Management: Lead change management initiatives related to learning programs and processes. Develop communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and adoption frameworks to ensure smooth rollout of new learning initiatives across the network.  

Central Learning Systems Expansion: Drive the expansion and optimization of centralized learning systems and technology infrastructure. Evaluate platform capabilities, manage vendor relationships, and ensure systems scale to meet growing organizational needs.  

Learning: Manage learning implications of ATS externalization changes. Assess impact on training requirements, develop transition learning plans, and ensure associates impacted by externalization are equipped with the right skills and knowledge.  

L\&D Cost and Budgeting: Own the L\&D budget and cost management process. Develop annual budgets, track spend against plan, identify cost optimization opportunities, and provide regular financial reporting to leadership.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience analyzing business metrics and training data to measure program effectiveness
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams
* Experience developing and implementing training programs
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience creating learning content and driving learning through a Learning Management System

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Assistant Manager / Manager – Brand Partnerships & Alliances
description:
Matrimony.com Limited is India’s first pure\-play consumer internet company to be listed, with BharatMatrimony recognized as the country’s largest and most trusted matrimony brand. The company offers matchmaking and marriage\-related services across websites, mobile platforms, apps, and over 130 company\-owned retail outlets. Its portfolio includes BharatMatrimony, EliteMatrimony, and CommunityMatrimony, serving diverse communities and customer segments. Matrimony.com is certified as a Great Place to Work®, reflecting its focus on employee well\-being and an inclusive workplace. Building on its leadership in matchmaking, the company is expanding into the $55 billion marriage services industry via WeddingBazaar and Mandap.com, with an ambition to become a billion\-dollar revenue organization.
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Brand Partnerships \& Alliances professional** 
 to support the development and management of a growing brand partnership ecosystem.
 



 The role will primarily focus on building a strong pipeline of prospective brand partners through structured market research, brand identification, decision\-maker mapping and outreach, while also managing the coordination, performance tracking and commercial follow\-up of existing partnerships.
 



 The candidate should be capable of independently identifying relevant brands and the right stakeholders, establishing initial contact and generating qualified meetings.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Brand Research \& Partnership Pipeline** 



* Research and identify potential brand partners across consumer\-facing categories such as Jewellery, Apparel, Consumer Electronics, Appliances, Travel, Beauty \& Grooming, Furniture, Lifestyle and other relevant sectors.
* Build and maintain category\-wise, city\-wise and state\-wise databases of prospective brands.
* Research brand profiles, geographical presence, store networks and partnership potential.
* Identify relevant decision\-makers across Partnerships, Alliances, Marketing, Business Development and senior management.



**2\. Brand Outreach \& Meeting Generation** 



* Independently reach out to prospective partners through LinkedIn, email, calls, corporate board lines, professional networks and referrals.
* Establish initial conversations with relevant brand stakeholders.
* Generate and schedule qualified meetings with decision\-makers.
* Undertake structured follow\-ups to move conversations forward.
* Maintain an active and measurable partnership pipeline.



**3\. Existing Brand \& Partner Management** 



* Coordinate periodic performance and relationship reviews with active brand partners.
* Track partnership performance, customer engagement and other agreed business metrics.
* Coordinate collection and consolidation of relevant partner data.
* Maintain action items from partner reviews and follow through until closure.
* Identify recurring issues or dependencies and escalate them appropriately.



**4\. Commercial \& Payment Coordination** 



* Coordinate with internal teams for partner\-related delivery and performance data.
* Support timely raising and submission of applicable invoices.
* Maintain brand\-wise trackers covering invoices, due dates, payments and outstanding amounts.
* Follow up with partners and internal Finance teams for reconciliation and closure.



**5\. Cross\-functional Coordination** 



* Work closely with Finance, Operations, Product, Marketing and other internal stakeholders.
* Ensure brand information, commercials, offers, locations and operational requirements are accurately maintained.
* Coordinate resolution of operational and partner\-related issues.
* Maintain organised records and documentation across partnerships.



**6\. MIS \& Reporting** 



* Maintain a comprehensive partnership dashboard covering the funnel from
 **Target Brand → Decision\-Maker → Outreach → Meeting → Partnership Status → Performance → Invoicing → Collections** 
 .
* Provide weekly updates on prospects, outreach, meetings and pending follow\-ups.
* Prepare periodic performance summaries for active partnerships.
* Maintain clear visibility on ownership, timelines and pending actions.


 Candidate Profile
 * Minimum
 **5 years of relevant professional experience** 
 , preferably in Brand Partnerships, Brand Alliances, Strategic Alliances, Partnerships, Key Account Management or related functions.
* Strong experience in independently researching brands and identifying relevant decision\-makers.
* Hands\-on experience using
 **LinkedIn and professional networks for corporate prospecting and stakeholder mapping** 
 .
* Comfortable with cold outreach, corporate calling and engaging senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing multiple external partners and coordinating with internal teams.
* Experience in
 **Retail, Jewellery, Apparel, Consumer Electronics, FMCG, E\-commerce, Travel, Lifestyle, Loyalty/Rewards or Gifting** 
 would be an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Management or a related discipline;
 **MBA/PGDM preferred but not mandatory** 
 .


 Key Skills
 
 Strong market research and prospecting skills, excellent communication and networking ability, relationship management, commercial understanding, structured follow\-up, stakeholder management, strong execution and closure orientation, and proficiency in
 **Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint and CRM/MIS tools** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should be
 **resourceful and network\-oriented** 
 , with the ability to independently identify opportunities, open doors with relevant stakeholders and take partnership conversations from prospecting through execution.

**Choose your engagement route**

**Independent consultant**

Consultants cannot promise unapproved pricing or bind Lean Hyphen to terms.
 



  





**What we are looking for**

 ·  Experience selling education services, curriculum, assessments, publishing, STEM or school technology is valuable. Employees should generally bring 5 to 8 years of relevant institutional sales experience; consultants should show comparable deal outcomes.
 



 ·  Strong presentation, negotiation and follow through; ability to coordinate internal teams while keeping accountability for the school relationship.

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
Senior Growth Manager
 
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Reports To:** 
 Business Head / Founder
 


 About Bazaar.in
 
 Bazaar.in helps brands, manufacturers, distributors and retailers liquidate surplus and slow\-moving inventory while offering consumers quality products at attractive prices.
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are seeking a hands\-on
 **Senior Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of the growth of Bazaar.in across sales, marketing and marketplace operations.
 



 The role will be responsible for
 **strategizing and executing initiatives that grow sellers, business buyers, consumers, GMV and revenue** 
 . The candidate will manage the complete growth funnel from identifying acquisition opportunities and onboarding sellers to driving customer acquisition, conversion, repeat purchases and marketplace performance.
 



 This is a cross\-functional role requiring the ability to move between
 **strategy and execution** 
 , identify growth opportunities from data, run experiments, coordinate teams and take accountability for measurable business outcomes.
 


 Seller Growth \& Acquisition
 * Build and execute strategies to acquire brands, manufacturers, distributors and retailers.
* Generate seller leads through outbound sales, digital campaigns, referrals, events and partnerships.
* Manage strategic negotiations and seller onboarding.
* Ensure KYC completion, catalogue activation, competitive pricing and inventory availability.
* Improve seller activation, retention and contribution to marketplace revenue.


 B2B Growth \& Business Development
 * Acquire retailers, resellers, corporate buyers, institutional buyers and bulk purchasers.
* Build and manage a qualified B2B sales pipeline.
* Match buyer requirements with relevant marketplace inventory.
* Develop partnerships and outbound campaigns for high\-value and category\-specific inventory.
* Negotiate commercial terms and manage strategic accounts.
* Increase bulk orders, repeat purchases and revenue from active business buyers.


 B2C Marketing \& Customer Growth
 * Develop and execute performance marketing, social media, SEO, content, influencer and partnership strategies.
* Plan campaigns around deals, categories, inventory and customer segments.
* Manage marketing budgets and improve CAC, ROAS and conversion rates.
* Increase qualified website traffic, new customers, first purchases, average order value and repeat purchases.
* Develop CRM, remarketing, loyalty and referral programmes.
* Identify and improve drop\-offs across product discovery, product pages, cart and checkout.


 Marketplace \& Revenue Growth
 * Take ownership of marketplace growth across supply, demand and conversion.
* Align seller inventory with customer demand.
* Drive
 **GMV, revenue, order volume, sell\-through and contribution margin** 
 .
* Improve merchandising, pricing, promotions and product visibility.
* Identify high\-growth categories, sellers, products and customer segments.
* Analyse sales, marketing, seller and customer data to identify growth opportunities.
* Design and execute growth experiments and measure their impact.
* Work with catalogue, operations, technology and finance teams to remove growth bottlenecks.



 The GMV, revenue, sell\-through and contribution\-margin responsibilities already form part of the existing role, so this broader growth framing is consistent with the original scope rather than creating an entirely different position.
 


 Growth Strategy \& Execution
 * Develop short\-term and long\-term growth plans for Bazaar.in.
* Translate company growth objectives into executable sales and marketing initiatives.
* Identify new acquisition channels, partnerships and revenue opportunities.
* Prioritise initiatives based on business impact, cost and scalability.
* Run growth experiments across seller acquisition, customer acquisition, conversion and retention.
* Track results and continuously optimise initiatives based on data.
* Maintain a clear growth pipeline covering initiatives, owners, timelines and expected outcomes.


 Team Leadership
 * Lead and manage sales and marketing team members.
* Set measurable targets across seller acquisition, B2B sales, customer growth, GMV and revenue.
* Establish CRM, reporting, forecasting and performance\-review processes.
* Coordinate closely with catalogue, operations, finance and technology teams.
* Create accountability for execution and achievement of growth targets.


 Key Performance Indicators
 * Qualified and activated sellers
* Seller activation and retention
* B2B pipeline value and conversion
* Active B2B buyers and repeat business
* New B2C customers acquired
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* ROAS
* Website traffic and conversion rate
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Repeat\-purchase rate
* Inventory sell\-through
* Order volume
* GMV
* Revenue
* Contribution margin
* Growth experiment performance
* Team target achievement



 These metrics are largely already present in the existing JD, including CAC, ROAS, traffic, conversion, AOV, repeat purchases, sell\-through, GMV and revenue.
 


 Candidate Profile
 * 3\-7 years of experience in e\-commerce, marketplaces, D2C, retail, sales, marketing or growth roles.
* At least 2\-3 years of experience managing sales, marketing or growth teams.
* Proven experience in driving customer acquisition, seller/vendor acquisition, business development or marketplace growth.
* Strong understanding of B2B sales cycles, digital marketing, CRM, conversion optimisation and marketplace economics.
* Ability to combine
 **strategic thinking with hands\-on execution** 
 .
* Strong commercial, negotiation, analytical and leadership skills.
* Comfortable working with growth metrics including CAC, ROAS, conversion, AOV, GMV and revenue.
* Proficiency in CRM systems, analytics tools, advertising platforms and Excel.
* Data\-driven, target\-oriented and comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment.


 What We Offer
 
**Ownership of the growth of Bazaar.in across sales, marketing and marketplace performance.** 




 The role provides direct exposure to company leadership and strategy, significant responsibility for business growth, fixed compensation with performance\-linked incentives, and career progression based on measurable business outcomes.
 



 The biggest change I would make compared with the current document is therefore
 **not rewriting the entire role** 
 , because the existing responsibilities are already very growth\-oriented. I would change the title to
 **Senior Growth Manager** 
 , rewrite the opening around
 **ownership of Bazaar.in's growth** 
 , and add the dedicated
 **Growth Strategy \& Execution** 
 section so candidates understand that this person is expected to
 *decide what should drive growth and then make it happen* 
 , rather than simply manage separate sales and marketing activities.

title: CustomerTech - MobileTech - IT Delivery - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Title:** 
**Manager II, IT Delivery**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology** 
 supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

* Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.


**The opportunity**
 The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross\-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project.
* Works closely with management to develop and implement staffing and operational plans. Participates in the development of short and long term department goals. Monitors and reports on service delivery metrics and overall performance.
* Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals.
* Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners.
* Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines.
* Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead cross\-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders.
* Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery.
* Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* A technically orietnted leader who is familiar with AWS, CI/CD Pipelines (Github) TDD/BDD practices, user level understanding of Splunk, Honeycomb. Familiarity leading a MS Dynamics team is a plus.
* Familiarity with Claude Code, Github Co\-Pilot is a plus
* Previous people leadership experience.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


**What We Look For**
* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager, Enterprise Partnership
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Razorpay Ads is building a commerce media and audience intelligence business powered by Razorpay’s transaction ecosystem. We are looking for a
 **Manager, Enterprise Partnership** 
 to build and scale our relationships with leading media agencies, digital agencies, agency trading teams, and their advertiser portfolios.
   

  

 This is a high\-ownership role at the intersection of
 **advertising, data, commerce, and fintech** 
 . You will be responsible for making Razorpay Ads a strategic partner for agencies — helping them leverage Razorpay’s audience intelligence and media capabilities to solve advertiser objectives across performance, customer acquisition, brand building, audience targeting and measurement.
   

  

 The role goes beyond selling individual campaigns. You will own agency relationships, develop advertiser pipelines within agency portfolios, unlock briefs and budgets, and build a repeatable agency\-led revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
**Agency Relationship \& Business Development**
* Build and own strategic relationships across leading agency networks, independent agencies and digital/performance agencies.
* Develop strong relationships with senior stakeholders across agency leadership, investment, planning, strategy, digital, performance and account management teams.
* Establish Razorpay Ads as a preferred partner for data\-led, commerce\-media and performance advertising solutions.
* Create agency\-level account plans covering priority agencies, key stakeholders, advertiser portfolios, opportunities and revenue potential.
* Drive regular agency engagements, capability sessions, workshops and joint client conversations.


**Advertiser \& Revenue Development**
* Identify high\-potential advertisers within agency portfolios and build a structured pipeline of briefs and opportunities.
* Work with agency teams to understand advertiser objectives, media plans, campaign challenges and investment priorities.
* Convert agency relationships into active advertisers, repeat advertisers and scalable revenue opportunities.
* Own the sales cycle from prospecting and solutioning through proposal, commercial negotiation, campaign closure and renewal.
* Drive penetration across priority categories including BFSI, fintech, D2C, e\-commerce, travel, consumer internet, auto and other digitally intensive categories.
* Build quarterly and annual agency revenue plans and maintain strong visibility on pipeline, closures and forecasts.


**Consultative \& Solution Selling**
* Translate advertiser and agency briefs into solutions using Razorpay Ads’ media, audience and data capabilities.
* Position Razorpay’s transaction\-led audience intelligence as a differentiated alternative or complement to conventional digital targeting signals.
* Develop solutions spanning audience intelligence, transaction\-led targeting, onsite/offsite media, performance campaigns, brand campaigns and measurement.
* Build compelling narratives and proposals that connect Razorpay’s capabilities to measurable advertiser outcomes.
* Partner with agencies to create customized solutions rather than relying on standardized inventory\-led selling.


**Agency GTM**
* Build a structured GTM strategy for priority agency groups and their advertiser portfolios.
* Map agency stakeholders, key accounts, upcoming pitches, annual planning cycles and seasonal/festive opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for agency\-level partnerships, preferred partner programs, joint pitches and advertiser workshops.
* Develop repeatable playbooks for converting agency relationships into briefs, campaigns and recurring advertiser investments.
* Represent Razorpay Ads at relevant agency forums, industry conversations and advertiser engagements.


**Campaign Success \& Account Growth**
* Partner closely with Campaign Management, Product and Operations teams to ensure campaigns deliver against advertiser objectives.
* Stay engaged beyond campaign closure to ensure strong advertiser and agency experience.
* Use campaign results and insights to drive renewals, upsells and larger annual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to expand successful campaigns across brands, categories and agency teams.
* Build case studies and proof points that can accelerate adoption across the wider agency ecosystem.


**Market Intelligence \& Product Feedback**
* Maintain a strong understanding of the Indian digital advertising ecosystem, agency structures, advertiser budgets and emerging media trends.
* Track competitive offerings across ad networks, commerce media, retail media, audience platforms and large digital publishers.
* Bring structured agency and advertiser feedback to Product, Strategy and Campaign teams.
* Help shape Razorpay Ads’ positioning, packaging, pricing and product roadmap based on market demand.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Success in this role will be measured primarily through:
   

  

**Agency penetration:** 
 Depth and quality of relationships across priority agencies and senior agency stakeholders.
   

  

**Active advertisers:** 
 Number of advertisers activated through the agency ecosystem.
   

  

**Quality advertisers:** 
 Ability to acquire strategic advertisers with meaningful and scalable budget potential.
   

  

**Advertiser retention:** 
 Repeat campaigns and continued investment from activated advertisers.
   

  

**Pipeline creation:** 
 Strength and quality of advertiser briefs and qualified opportunities generated through agencies.
   

  

**Revenue:** 
 Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue objectives.
   

  

**Strategic relationships:** 
 Ability to convert transactional agency relationships into long\-term partnerships.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* 5–8 years of experience in agency sales, digital advertising, media sales, adtech, commerce media, publisher sales or related businesses.
* Strong existing relationships across media agencies, digital agencies and/or performance agencies in India.
* Demonstrated experience selling digital advertising solutions through agencies and influencing advertiser budgets.
* Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem including Meta, Google, programmatic, publisher media, performance marketing and brand advertising.
* Ability to engage comfortably with stakeholders ranging from agency planners and account leads to Business Heads, Managing Partners and CXOs.
* Strong consultative selling and solutioning capabilities — able to start with a client problem rather than an inventory proposition.
* Strong commercial orientation with experience owning pipelines, negotiations and revenue targets.
* Good understanding of advertising metrics including CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency and brand/measurement metrics.
* Ability to interpret campaign performance and convert results into a compelling growth narrative.
* Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
* High ownership, bias for action and comfort operating in an early\-stage business where GTM playbooks are still being built.


**Strong Plus**
* Experience working at an ad network, large digital publisher, commerce/retail media network, DSP, adtech platform or agency partnership function.
* Existing relationships across leading agency networks and independent digital agencies.
* Experience selling to BFSI, fintech, D2C, e\-commerce or consumer internet advertisers.
* Experience selling both performance and branding solutions.
* Exposure to first\-party data, audience intelligence, CDPs, clean rooms, retail/commerce media or transaction\-led advertising.
* Experience building a new agency channel or GTM motion from an early stage.


**The Person We’d Like to Hire**
 We are looking for someone who is
 **well\-networked but not dependent on their network; commercially aggressive but consultative in approach; comfortable selling what exists today while helping shape what needs to be built tomorrow** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate understands how agencies operate, knows how budgets and briefs move through the ecosystem, can open senior\-level conversations, and has the persistence and strategic thinking required to turn those relationships into a sustainable revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.
   

  

 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
   

  

 Follow us on LinkedIn \& Twitter

title: Head - Partner Success and Performance Management (PSS08110)
description:
**About The Company**
 A technology\-driven platform with a wide\-reaching presence across India, supported by an extensive network of customers, partners, service providers, and distribution channels. The organisation is focused on scalable growth, strengthening its partner ecosystem, and leveraging data to enhance business performance and governance.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The
 **Head \- Partner Success and Performance Management** 
 role exists to establish disciplined partner governance, transparent reporting, and structured engagement across the complete partner ecosystem. This leadership position is responsible for converting MIS into actionable insights, running governance cadences, securing action closure, and improving service, customer, and business outcomes. The role reports directly to the
 **Head CX** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design a common governance framework covering partner segmentation, KPIs, SLAs, review frequency, escalation paths, and decision rights.
* Create differentiated engagement models based on partner size, criticality, performance, geography, and customer impact.
* Maintain a central partner repository including scope, contracts, locations, contacts, SLAs, scorecards, review history, and open actions.
* Own a single source of truth for partner MIS; ensure data accuracy, consistency, validation, and on\-time publication.
* Build automated dashboards for volumes, TAT, SLA, ageing, quality, productivity, cost, customer experience, escalations, and action closure.
* Publish daily, weekly, and monthly reports with trends, root causes, risks, exceptions, and management actions using Advanced Excel and Power BI/Tableau.
* Partner with Data and Technology teams to automate extraction, alerts, and scorecards, reducing manual reporting.
* Establish and run operational huddles, weekly reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly business reviews with defined agendas and participants.
* Prepare fact\-based review packs covering performance trends, customer feedback, risks, decisions, and improvement actions.
* Document actions with accountable owners, timelines, and outcomes; maintain rigorous follow\-through and escalation until closure.
* Define partner\-specific scorecards aligned to business commitments and customer expectations.
* Identify performance deviations early and initiate recovery plans before they affect customers or commercial relationships.
* Benchmark partners and recommend load allocation, incentives, penalties, probation, capability building, or exit based on sustained results.
* Govern partner categories including sales partners, service centres, logistics partners, and contact\-centre partners with tailored KPIs and recovery plans.
* Convert dashboards, reviews, audits, and VOC into corrective and preventive action plans with clear owners, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.
* Track actions centrally, escalate overdue or recurring gaps, and validate effectiveness through operating data and customer outcomes.
* Embed reporting, SOP, system, SLA, and governance requirements during partner onboarding and expansion.
* Identify partner capability and training needs; coordinate targeted interventions and measure post\-training improvement.
* Build and lead the Partner Success Office; align Sales, Service, Logistics, Contact Centre, Quality, Finance, Data, and Technology teams.
* Present consolidated partner performance, risks, and recommendations to the CSOO and leadership team.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Analytics or related discipline; MBA preferred. Certifications in Project Management, Lean Six Sigma, Business Analytics, or Power BI are advantageous.
* Experience: 10\-14 years in Partner Success, Partner Operations, Performance Management, Service Operations, Customer Experience, or Business Operations; with 4\+ years in leadership roles.
* Leadership: Experience managing high\-volume, multi\-location, SLA\-driven partner ecosystems and senior partner stakeholders; leading cross\-functional teams and reporting to senior leadership.
* Technical Expertise: Partner governance and relationship management; KPI/SLA design; MIS automation; Advanced Excel; Power BI or Tableau; working knowledge of SQL; performance scorecards; WBR/MBR/QBR management; RCA and CAPA; NPS/CSAT analytics.
* Soft Skills: Strategic, analytical, disciplined in action closure, strong executive communication, negotiation, stakeholder influence, and business/commercial acumen.


 Why Consider this Opportunity?
   

  

* Lead the central governance and performance management function for a large, complex partner ecosystem impacting millions of customers.
* Drive measurable improvements in SLA, TAT, quality, productivity, NPS/CSAT, and partner performance scores.
* Shape and embed data\-driven partner governance frameworks and automated reporting tools with high stakeholder visibility.
* Collaborate across Sales, Service, Logistics, Contact Centre, Quality, Finance, Data, and Technology teams to influence business outcomes.
* Operate at the intersection of customer experience and operational excellence within a fast\-growing technology\-enabled service platform.

**Are you a dynamic leader with a passion for healthcare and a talent for building strategic relationships? Do you thrive in a fast\-paced environment where your efforts directly impact patient access to life\-changing products and services? If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you!**
 Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 17\.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.
   

  

**The Role**
 Responsible for achieving territory sales objectives through field\-based selling activities which include product promotion, building relationships with key opinion leaders, such as surgeons and nurses as well as other relevant Health Care Professionals and driving market share and sales growth
   

  

**Areas of Accountability**
* Meet or exceed sales targets by promoting Coloplast’s Wound Care portfolio
* Develop and maintain long\-term relationships with KOLs to enhance Coloplast brand preference and increase business
* Ensure execution of annual business plan activities such as product evaluation, CMEs, ISPs, RTMs, to create loyalty towards Coloplast products
* Winning rate contract with all private/public hospitals to achieve sales targets.
* Regularly gathers and feeds back market information to immediate manager to refine Segmentation and Targeting and market and competitor understanding.
* Plans and documents daily call routine to ensure appropriate coverage of key accounts given sales time allocation, sales potential, geographical location, development of sales process, and utilize the CRM tool for the management of information.
* Follow pre\-defined call plan based on Segmentation and Targeting and records activity to ensure appropriate coverage of key accounts. Develop and execute Account Specific Action Plans together for selected high priority accounts
* Ensure product availability and rate contract with the hospitals Demonstrate clear understanding of clinical and technical product knowledge
* Create transparency in secondary sales (in\-market sales) e.g dealers to hospitals, pharmacies \& end users.
* Develop and maintain productive cross\-functional relationships to share knowledge and leverage synergies within the organization


**Education \& Experience**
* 5\+ years demonstrated successful sales experience (Pharmaceutical \& Medical device field strongly preferred).
* Graduate in Science/Pharmacy, diploma/degree in sales or marketing management will be preferred


**Required Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Demonstrates drive and ambition to grow himself / herself as well as Coloplast India with a positive and “can do” attitude.
* Strong belief in alignment with Coloplast Mission, Vision and Values.
* Passionate to make a difference and curious to learn
* Strong ethical mindset
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel and PowerPoint
* Effective written and oral communication skills


*Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.*
*Visit us on Coloplast.com.*
*Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.*
