title: Associate Vice President - Client Services
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further
   

  

**Sub\-Custody – Securities Services**
**About HSBC Securities Services**
 HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is a markets\-led, financing\-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Within CIB, Securities Services provides robust and reliable solutions that help clients mitigate risk and enhance their business performance. Working with institutional investors, banks, insurance companies, governments, and multinational corporations, this team covers fund administration, global custody, sub\-custody and clearing, and corporate trust and loan agency services.
   

  

 HSBC Securities Services provides robust, reliable solutions that help institutional investors, banks, insurance companies, governments and multinational corporations enhance performance and manage risk—both today and in the future.
   

  

 Our services include fund administration, global custody, sub\-custody and clearing, corporate trust, and loan agency services.
   

  

 We’re seeking an experienced professional to join the Sub\-Custody team within HSBC Securities Services.
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities**
* Provide clear, accurate and timely responses to client queries, identifying and addressing the underlying issue at the outset.
* Ensure all written and verbal communications are consistent, unambiguous and aligned with HSBC standards, reducing the risk of misinterpretation, service concerns or compensation claims.
* Respond to client requests within agreed turnaround times (TATs), whether by email or telephone.
* Develop and maintain a detailed understanding of HSBC’s internal procedures, systems and client\-specific service requirements.
* Support projects and initiatives with cross\-functional impact, including:
+ Standing instruction reviews
+ Client transaction and market query response
+ Other operational improvement initiatives

* Stay current with market developments, regulatory requirements and internal procedures relevant to investment options available to foreign investors. This includes reviewing applicable policies (FIMs and DIMs) and attending Topic Champion presentations.
* Monitor queries from allocated clients within the relevant area of functional expertise and identify opportunities to improve service delivery.
* Work with the Client Service team, and Client Services Manager to ensure client feedback is communicated effectively to the relevant operations teams and acted upon.
* Contribute to formal discussions and service reviews between the Client Services Manager and operations teams.
* Maintain accurate productivity and efficiency data, identifying non\-value\-added activities and implementing agreed actions to streamline processes.
* Complete all required Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training, including any post\-course assessments.
* Demonstrate ownership, sound judgement and a strong focus on delivering high\-quality client service.


**Qualifications And Experience**
**Eligibility Criteria**
* Employees must have completed at least 12 months in their current role to be eligible for a level transfer or promotion.


**Essential And Preferred Requirements**
* Graduate from a recognised university.
* Minimum three to four years of relevant experience, preferably within custody, securities services, financial services or client operations.
* Working knowledge of HSBC processes and systems is preferred.
* Minimum performance rating of “Good” and behavioural rating of “Strong”, where applicable.
* Demonstrates HSBC Values by being Open, Dependable and Connected, and acts with courageous integrity at all times.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex operational matters clearly.
* Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities while meeting agreed deadlines.
* A proactive approach to identifying service improvements and resolving client issues.


**Pro Tip:** 
 Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.
   

  

**Additional Notes:** 
 Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required
   

  

 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
   

  

 Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: District Manager - Pune
description:

* Experience: Min 7 years of experience in sales management or animal health.

* Proven track record in achieving sales growth across diverse product portfolios.

title: Control Manager - Program - Controls Room - Program Management & Governance Vice President
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

The Controls Room Team within Control Management works collaboratively with other control disciplines and oversees existing control functions as well as the development of new control functions and protocols. The team's objective is to empower the three lines of defense with risk\-based information to manage their control environment. We achieve this by collecting, analyzing, and monitoring firmwide risk\-based intelligence across all lines of business and corporate functions. As a Control Manager Program Vice President, you will be a key member of the team, leading cross\-functional delivery for firmwide programs that impact Control Management.


As a Control Manager Program Vice President within the Controls Room organization, you will translate enterprise requirements into executable project strategies, integrated roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. You will serve as a senior delivery and governance leader, aligning stakeholders across lines of business, product, and technology; proactively identifying and mitigating delivery, operational, and control risks; and driving disciplined execution against milestones, quality standards, and service\-level agreements.


You will also own User Acceptance Testing governance for in\-scope programs by establishing the UAT strategy, readiness standards, entry and exit criteria, and consolidated reporting. Working across business and technology teams, you will ensure end\-to\-end testing is appropriately planned, staffed, and executed, and that UAT scope, defects, and results remain aligned with program objectives and control effectiveness outcomes. Join our collaborative, high\-impact team and help strengthen how Control Management delivers complex firmwide change.

**Job responsibilities**

* Lead multiple concurrent firmwide application development projects end\-to\-end, ensuring roadmap creation and delivery predictability, stakeholder alignment, and execution against commitments, milestones, and SLAs
* Establish and run governance forums (steerco, working groups, executive readouts), define decision rights, manage RAID, and enforce standards for roadmap, scope, schedule, and quality
* Partner with firmwide program owners to translate requirements into actionable plans, ensuring full traceability from commitments to deliverables, testing evidence, and outcomes
* Proactively identify delivery, operational, and control risks; drive mitigations; ensure timely escalation; and partner with Control Management stakeholders to strengthen control outcomes at scale
* Lead change management for program requirements, influencing senior stakeholders and evolving operating models/processes to embed sustainable ways of working
* Define UAT governance framework, readiness checkpoints, entry/exit criteria, and reporting; oversee UAT planning and execution across teams; ensure defects are managed with appropriate accountability and sign\-off
* Own executive\-level scorecards and reporting (delivery progress, SLA adherence, testing progress, defect trends, dependency tracking), driving transparency and continuous improvement
* Influence and drive alignment across Business, Product, Technology and Risk/Control leadership; resolve cross\-program dependencies and remove execution barriers
* Mentor and manage program managers, set expectations for delivery rigor, and standardize best practices across the portfolio




**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred (or equivalent experience)
* 12\+ years overall experience, including 8\+ years in Program/Portfolio Management (preferably in large, matrixed, global organizations)
* Demonstrated success leading firmwide, multi\-year, cross\-LOB programs with complex dependencies and executive\-level governance
* Experience in crafting product roadmaps, managing enterprise wide data migration projects and coordinating dry runs prior for production readiness
* Strong ability to communicate with and influence both technical and business leaders, including executive storytelling and concise decision\-oriented updates
* Proven ability to manage multiple programs/projects simultaneously, balancing priorities, resources, timelines, and risk.
* Strong analytical rigor, attention to detail, and ability to drive structured problem solving under ambiguity.
* Highly adaptable, proactive, self\-directed leader with strong interpersonal skills and a track record of building trusted partnerships.




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Experience in financial industry, auditing, compliance, or consulting and an understanding of risks \& controls management is beneficial.
* Knowledge of compliance and regulatory requirements for consumer banking industry is a plus.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word, SharePoint, and planning tools (e.g., MS Project); able to produce high\-quality executive presentations is mandatory.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery and Jira (and comfort operating across Agile and hybrid delivery models).

title: Tendering Manager – EHV Substations
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day (Tendering Manager – HV/EHV AIS \& GIS Substation Projects)  

As the Tendering Manager – HV/EHV AIS \& GIS Substation Projects, you will lead the end\-to\-end tendering and bid management activities for High Voltage (HV) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) substation projects, transmission and distribution infrastructure, EPC packages, and related power system solutions. You will be responsible for identifying business opportunities, developing winning bid strategies, managing techno\-commercial proposals, and ensuring competitive positioning across utility and private sector markets.  

In this leadership role, you will collaborate closely with engineering, procurement, project management, finance, legal, and supply chain teams to deliver high\-quality and profitable bids. You will engage with customers, utilities, consultants, and EPC partners while leveraging market intelligence, risk assessment, and pricing strategies to maximize business success. We are looking for an experienced tendering professional with deep expertise in AIS/GIS substations, power infrastructure projects, and business acquisition who can combine technical knowledge, commercial acumen, and market insight to drive sustainable growth and successful project acquisitions.  

How You'll Make an Impact* Drive business growth by identifying and evaluating tender opportunities across HV/EHV AIS \& GIS substations, transmission lines, switchyards, EPC projects, and power infrastructure developments.

* Monitor utility tenders, government procurement portals, private sector RFQs, and emerging market opportunities to support strategic business expansion.

* Lead bid/no\-bid evaluations by assessing project viability, competitive landscape, risk profiles, customer requirements, and organizational capabilities.

* Build and strengthen relationships with utilities, consultants, EPC partners, renewable developers, industrial customers, and key industry stakeholders.

* Lead the complete tendering lifecycle from opportunity identification through bid submission and contract award.

* Review tender documents, technical specifications, BOQs, drawings, contractual conditions, and commercial requirements to ensure comprehensive bid compliance.

* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including engineering, procurement, finance, legal, projects, and supply chain functions for successful bid preparation.

* Develop and submit technical proposals, commercial offers, prequalification documents, and supporting credentials in line with customer requirements.

* Conduct detailed techno\-commercial assessments, evaluating project scope, engineering solutions, execution methodologies, delivery schedules, and resource requirements.

* Identify project risks, commercial exposures, contractual deviations, and mitigation strategies to protect business interests.

* Prepare management approval notes, bid strategy documents, and executive summaries to support informed decision\-making.

* Develop competitive project costing models, pricing strategies, and profitability assessments while maintaining strong win probability.

* Perform market intelligence studies, competitor benchmarking, pricing analysis, and commodity trend assessments to strengthen bid competitiveness.

* Coordinate with vendors, OEMs, and suppliers to obtain optimized quotations, technical inputs, and commercial support.

* Prepare project cash\-flow analyses, margin evaluations, and business case assessments to support commercial decision\-making.

* Analyze transmission, distribution, renewable integration, AIS/GIS technology, and utility investment trends to support strategic growth initiatives.

* Maintain bid databases, pricing benchmarks, and competitive intelligence repositories to enhance future tendering effectiveness.

* Conduct customer meetings, technical discussions, pre\-bid clarifications, and tender negotiations to position Siemens Energy as a preferred partner.

* Participate in site visits for scope validation, feasibility assessment, logistics evaluation, constructability reviews, and risk identification.

* Review contractual terms and conditions, identify commercial and contractual risks, and recommend negotiation strategies and risk mitigation measures.

* Support post\-tender activities including customer clarifications, techno\-commercial discussions, contract finalization, and project handover to execution teams.

* Drive lessons learned and post\-bid reviews to continuously improve bid quality, competitiveness, and business acquisition success rates.

  

What You Bring* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (B.E./B.Tech).

* MBA in Marketing, Operations, Finance, or a related discipline is preferred.

* 12\-20 years of professional experience in tendering, estimation, proposal engineering, business acquisition, or bid management within the power sector.

* Minimum 8\-10 years of experience specifically focused on HV/EHV AIS and GIS substation projects.

* Strong expertise in AIS substations up to 765 kV and GIS substations up to 400 kV/765 kV.

* Deep understanding of transmission line projects, switchyards, EPC contracting, and power system infrastructure projects.

* Strong knowledge of protection and control systems, power transformers, reactors, HV switchgear, GIS equipment, SCADA, SAS, and communication systems.

* Proven experience managing tenders for utility customers including PGCIL, State Utilities, SEBs, DISCOMs, Railways, Metro projects, and other government entities.

* Demonstrated experience in bidding for private sector customers including industrial facilities, renewable energy developers, data centers, oil \& gas companies, and commercial infrastructure projects.

* Strong understanding of utility tendering procedures, contractual frameworks, project execution models, and regulatory requirements.

* Expertise in project costing, pricing strategy development, margin optimization, and financial risk assessment.

* Experience conducting competitor analysis, market intelligence studies, benchmark assessments, and business opportunity evaluations.

* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance competitiveness, profitability, and project execution risks.

* Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders across all organizational levels.

* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem\-solving skills with a customer\-centric approach.

* Proven experience working within cross\-functional, multicultural, and matrix organizations.

* Professional proficiency in English with excellent verbal, written, presentation, and business communication skills.

* Willingness to travel as required for customer meetings, site assessments, bid discussions, and business development activities.

title: Manager, Identity Maturity Acceleration
description:
**Why SailPoint?** 




  
 



 Love what you do. And love where you do it. Smart people, fun culture, innovative work, beautiful offices — oh, and everyone’s really nice. That’s what people say about SailPoint. We’re known as the company where everyone wants to work, and we have the awards to prove it. If you’re passionate about outsmarting cybercriminals and working at a company where you can truly have an impact, we want you to join our team. 
 



  
 



 SailPoint empowers the largest, most complex organizations by putting identity at the Center of Security and IT.  Our 2,000\+ customers include global financial institutions, government entities, and pharmaceutical organizations and more.  
 



  
 



  
 



**About the role:** 




  
 



 SailPoint is the leading AI\-driven identity security platform delivering autonomous governance to secure the modern enterprise. We provide unified security across the human fabric (employees, contractors, partners) and the emerging agentic/non\-human fabric (autonomous AI agents, machine identities, service accounts). 
 



  
 



 Within SailPoint’s Identity Maturity Acceleration (IMA) organization, the Manager, Agentic Identity Acceleration is a high\-impact, client\-facing growth role designed for an ambitious, humble, and technically grounded professional ready to step into practice leadership. 
 



  
 



 In this customer\-facing role, you will partner with our elite Technical Advisors (TAs) to guide enterprise clients through modern identity governance, AI agent security, and maturity acceleration using the SailPoint Agentic Fabric and SailPoint Atlas. This role offers a clear path to develop your executive advisory presence, lead strategic client programs, and grow into a full\-scale practice leader. 
 



  
 



  
 



  
 



**What You Will Do** 




  
 



 Client Advisory \& Program Acceleration (60%) 
 



  
 


* Executive Partnership \& Steering Committees: Partner with client IAM leaders, CISOs, and enterprise stakeholders to run steering committees, track program milestones, and communicate business value across human and agentic identity programs.


* Support \& Amplify Technical Advisors: Work hand\-in\-hand with designated Technical Advisors on key enterprise accounts—handling engagement planning, stakeholder alignment, and operational health so the TA can lead technical architecture with CISOs and AI Officers.


* Maturity Framework Guidance: Help clients assess and progress along the Identity Maturity Acceleration (IMA) curve, moving from foundational governance (Horizons 1–2\) toward advanced, automated security (Horizons 4–5\).


* Engagement Health \& Scope Governance: Monitor delivery health, identify risks early, and coordinate with Delivery Partners and System Integrators to ensure engagements stay on track and deliver on contracted outcomes.



  
 


* GTM \& Scoping Collaboration: Work alongside Sales, Sales Engineering, and Agentic Technology Specialists (ATS) to assist in scoping Advisory and Delivery Assurance proposals.



  
 



 Practice Development \& Growth (40%) 
 



  
 


* Mentorship \& Team Coordination: Coordinate day\-to\-day engagement assignments, mentor junior team members, and foster a collaborative, high\-trust team culture.


* AI\-Augmented Operational Learning: Eagerly adopt and test internal AI accelerators (e.g., Harbor Pilot), automated workflows, and agentic tools to make practice reporting and status tracking faster and more efficient.


* Field Insights Feedback: Gather feedback and emerging use cases from client interactions to help Product and GTM teams refine our Agentic Fabric offerings.



  
 


* Continuous Personal Development: Actively seek coaching from senior leadership to expand your executive presence, C\-level communication, and commercial acumen.



  
 



  
 



**Who You Are (Qualifications \& Mindset)**



* Hungry, Humble \& Curious: You bring strong self\-awareness, low ego, and high intellectual curiosity. You love learning new technologies (especially AI and identity) and are eager to prove yourself in a leadership capacity.


* Experience Baseline: 5 –10\+ years of progressive experience in IAM/IGA, Cybersecurity consulting, Technical Account Management, or SaaS Professional Services.


* Technical \& Domain Foundation: Solid foundational knowledge of Identity Governance, access lifecycles (JML), cloud security, and an eager appetite to master Non\-Human Identities (NHI) and autonomous AI agent concepts.


* Consultative Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead structured client meetings, present project findings clearly, and navigate stakeholder expectations.


* Project \& Delivery Organization: Demonstrated experience managing multiple client projects, tracking deliverables, mitigating risks, and maintaining engagement momentum.


* Leadership Potential: Prior experience informally mentoring peers, leading project squads, or acting as a lead consultant, with a clear desire to grow into people management.



**Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.**




 SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  
   

  





 Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

title: Technical Account Manager (TAM)

Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India
   

  

 As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will work closely with our customers, build relationships with them, help them achieve their technical goals, and overcome technical challenges.The Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as a trusted technical partner to customers, acting as the primary point of contact for technical guidance, system optimization, and issue coordination after implementation. The TAM works closely with customer System Administrators and internal teams to understand business processes, ensure effective system configuration, and help customers maximize value from the platform.

Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast\-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Greetings from NAM Info Pvt Ltd,
 



  





*We have an opportunity for the position below. Please go through the job description. If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply and share your updated resume at praveen@nam\-info.com* 




  





**Role: Delivery Manager** 




**Work Location: Pune (Hinjewadi Phase 2\) — Local Pune Candidates Only** 




**Work Mode: Hybrid** 




**Client: Inferyx (Full\-time)** 




**Total Experience: 9\+ Yrs** 




  





**Interview Mode: 2 Virtual Rounds \+ 1 Face\-to\-Face Round** 




  





**About Inferyx** 




 Inferyx is a next\-generation Data Orchestration Platform enabling enterprises to build scalable Data Lakes using Medallion Architecture (
 *Bronze → Silver → Gold* 
 ) across various domains including BFSI, Telecom, Retail, Manufacturing, and Healthcare. Inferyx accelerates data engineering delivery through a low\-code orchestration engine, reducing data pipeline build times by up to 60% compared to traditional approaches.
 



  





 We are aggressively expanding our India footprint and looking for a seasoned Delivery Manager to take end\-to\-end ownership of our client delivery programs.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 As the senior delivery owner for Inferyx’s enterprise client accounts, you will inherit an active, operational engagement and serve as the single point of accountability for delivery health, stakeholder management, and client satisfaction. You will operate with high autonomy, manage technical complexity, and ensure delivery excellence—enabling our executive leadership to focus on nationwide growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Client Delivery Ownership** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the Inferyx data platform, including medallion architecture implementation, sprint governance, and Go\-Live milestones.
* Lead daily/fortnightly scrum calls, sprint reviews, and stakeholder reporting.
* Maintain delivery health by tracking sprint velocity, proactively managing risks, resolving blockers, and escalating only critical exceptions to executive leadership.
* Ensure all contractual SLAs, delivery milestones, and quality standards are consistently met or exceeded.
* Maintain and update the Client Delivery Runbook, RACI matrix, and issue logs, presenting monthly summaries to Inferyx leadership.



  





**2\. Stakeholder \& Relationship Management** 



* Act as the primary senior relationship manager between Inferyx and client teams (Project Managers, Architects, and Business Owners).
* Conduct fortnightly on\-site visits to client locations to participate in steering committees, executive reviews, and architecture sessions.
* Manage delivery escalations professionally, converting challenges into opportunities to strengthen client trust.
* Identify and cultivate internal client champions to advocate for Inferyx platform adoption and expansion across other business units.



  





**3\. Program Governance \& Reporting** 



* Drive structured program governance using weekly status reports, risk registers, RAID logs, and monthly steering dashboards.
* Maintain a transparent, metric\-driven single source of truth for delivery status that is executive\-ready at all times.
* Prepare and present monthly delivery review decks to Inferyx’s Head of Technology, COO, and CEO.
* Track key delivery KPIs, including sprint velocity, defect rates, deployment frequency, and Client NPS.
* Manage Production incidents, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implement sustainable action plans to minimize incident recurrence.
* Manage Change Requests (CRs) professionally—scoping, pricing, and negotiating without damaging client relationships.



  





**4\. Technical Collaboration \& Platform Adoption** 



* Partner with Inferyx engineering and pre\-sales teams to ensure the platform is deployed to its maximum capability at the client site.
* Identify expansion opportunities within client accounts for new business units, additional data domains, or advanced medallion layers.
* Participate in architecture reviews, data model walkthroughs, and pipeline design sessions, applying technical depth to ask the right questions.
* Translate client feedback into actionable insights for internal product teams to shape the Inferyx product roadmap.



  





**5\. Team Leadership \& Onboarding** 



* Successfully onboard into the engagement via a structured 4–6 week handover from the outgoing delivery lead.
* Mentor and manage junior delivery resources or Business Analysts assigned to the account.
* Establish and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for repeatable delivery processes.
* Contribute to Inferyx's overall delivery methodology through best practices, reusable frameworks, and lessons learned.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 




**Essential (Must Have)** 



* Experience: 9 to 13 years of total experience in technology delivery, program management, or client\-facing delivery roles within enterprise IT.
* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of Data platforms—Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, or Data Orchestration tools.
* Architecture: Practical understanding of Medallion Architecture, Lakehouse concepts, or multi\-layer data processing (
 *Bronze / Silver / Gold* 
 ).
* Agile Governance: Hands\-on experience leading Agile/Scrum delivery (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and velocity tracking).
* Location \& Mobility: Must be currently residing in Pune (or local to Pune) and willing to visit client sites in Hinjewadi Phase 2 on a fortnightly basis.
* Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent Project Management certification.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi; proven capability to navigate complex corporate structures and manage stakeholders up to the C\-suite level.



  





**Preferred (Good to Have)** 



* Exposure to cloud data platforms such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, GCP BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS.
* Experience working in a product startup or scale\-up environment, demonstrating adaptability in fast\-paced setups.
* Understanding of BFSI data domains (e.g., reconciliation, settlement, regulatory reporting) or Telecom data domains.
* Cloud certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Data Analytics, or GCP Professional Data Engineer.
* Track record of building delivery playbooks, SOPs, and scaling delivery processes from scratch.

title: Associate Director - Technical Account Management
description:
**About Hevo** 




 Hevo Data is a no\-code data pipeline platform that helps companies consolidate data from multiple sources for faster analytics. Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150\+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.
 



  





 Over 2,000 data teams in 45\+ countries use Hevo, including DoorDash, Foot Locker, Iceland Air and Shopify. We’re top\-rated in the G2 Data Pipeline category, backed by Sequoia Capital, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, and operate out of San Francisco and Bangalore.
 



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 Hevo’s customers are data engineers, analytics leaders, and platform teams who rely on us for critical data infrastructure. Customer Success here goes well beyond satisfaction surveys. The job is to help technical teams get real value from their pipelines, cut the time it takes to get to insight, and grow their data operations.
 



 We’re looking for a strong leader to build and run the CS function. You’ll own the full post\-sales journey (onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion) and be directly accountable for Net Revenue Retention and customer health across our global base.
 



  





**The Setup** 



* A growing team of TAMs, based primarily in Bangalore and Pune
* A product with 1000\+ customers but an evolving post\-sales playbook for 250\-300 accounts
* A customer base spanning SMB to enterprise across e\-commerce, fintech, medtech and B2B Software companies.
* Strong executive support and buy\-in for investing in Technical Account Management
* A chance to shape CS strategy at a company that’s defining the data pipeline category



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Build and Own the TAM Program** 



* Design and roll out Hevo\-specific TAM playbooks covering onboarding, adoption, health scoring, renewal, and expansion
* Segment the customer base (enterprise, mid\-market, self\-serve) and build the right engagement model for each
* Own net revenue retention, gross retention, and expansion metrics



**Drive Customer Outcomes** 



* Improve renewal rates and reduce churn by driving deeper product adoption and making sure customers see tangible results
* Work with Sales on cross\-sell and upsell opportunities, always leading with retention
* Build customer advocacy through NPS programs, case studies, and community engagement
* Grow lifetime value by catching risks early through health monitoring and having clear playbooks for when to step in



**Customer Lifecycle** 



* Map out the customer journey for Hevo’s technical buyers and end users
* Set up the right checkpoints across the lifecycle (usage data, satisfaction signals, support sentiment) and create standard responses for each stage
* Keep improving based on what the data and customer feedback tell you



**Lead and Grow the Team** 



* Hire and develop strong TAMs
* Put together an onboarding process that gets new hires productive fast
* Build a team culture where people are technically curious, care about customers, and take ownership of outcomes



**Measure What Matters** 



* Define and track operational metrics: time\-to\-value, adoption rates, health scores, NRR, GRR.
* Build dashboards and regular review cadences, and report key metrics to the executive team and board



**Cross\-Functional Work** 



* Work with Product to make sure customer insights feed into the roadmap
* Coordinate with Sales on ideal customer definition, handoff process, and expansion pipeline
* Team up with Marketing on customer campaigns, advocacy programs, and lifecycle comms
* Work with Finance on forecasting, renewal projections, and unit economics



**Invest in CS/TAM Technology** 



* Use AI and automation to make the program more efficient and scale the team’s impact without growing headcount at the same rate



  





**Who We’re Looking For** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 10\+ years of overall experience, and 5\+ years leading Technical Customer Success or Tech Account Mgmt teams in B2B SaaS, with experience building or scaling a technical CS/TAM function
* Experience with technical or developer\-facing products, ideally in data infrastructure, analytics, or related areas like ETL/ELT, data warehousing, observability, or DevOps
* Track record of owning and improving net revenue retention in a subscription / recurring\-revenue business
* Comfortable managing technical CSEs who spend their days working with data engineers and analysts
* Analytical and numbers\-driven. You make decisions based on data and you build the systems to track it
* Strong communication skills. Comfortable presenting to the board and working across functions to get things done



  





**Nice\-to\-Have** 



* Time spent at a modern data stack company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, or similar)
* Familiarity with usage\-based or consumption\-based pricing models
* Mix of technical (engineering, solutions) and business (CS, account management) experience
* Experience managing CSEs across multiple geographies or time zones



  





**Why Hevo** 



* We’re in a large, growing market (data integration is projected to hit $17B\+) and we’re one of the leaders
* Our customers actually like the product. Top\-rated on G2, with strong word\-of\-mouth growth
* Sequoia Capital\-backed with strong investor support
* CS is treated as a growth function here, not a cost center. You’ll have real ownership
* Low\-ego team with deep engineering and product roots

Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.


Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.


**Job Role:**

You will be a windchill developer. Their responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing software components, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and ensuring the quality and performance of the platform. They also work on enhancing the user experience, tailoring tasks to specific organizational needs, and providing support to users.
 

Core Responsibilities:


* Software Design and Development: Designing and implementing new features, functionalities, and improvements for the product using Java, J2EE, and web technologies.
* Code Quality and Maintenance: Writing clean, efficient, and well\-documented code that adheres to PTC's coding standards and best practices, ensuring the software is maintainable and scalable.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Developing and executing test plans, identifying and resolving software defects, and ensuring the platform meets the required quality standards.
* Collaboration and Communication: Working closely with product managers, UX designers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of the platform.
* Technical Documentation: Creating and maintaining technical documentation for the software, including design specifications, code documentation, and user guides.
* Performance Optimization: Identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, optimizing the platform for speed and efficiency.
* Staying Up\-to\-Date: Keeping abreast of new technologies, trends, and best practices relevant to PTC and the broader PLM landscape.
* Troubleshooting and Support: Assisting in troubleshooting and resolving customer issues, providing technical support, and collaborating with other PTC teams to address complex problems.
* Automation: Contributing to the automation of software development and deployment processes.

**Your Impact:**

The R\&D team is working on PLM solutions to improve user Experience. Various technologies going to be used for which team is looking for highly motivated individuals with appropriate skills.


**Your Team:**

Candidate will be part of our R\&D team based in Pune.


**Your Day\-to\-Day:**

* Participate and Provide required information in scrum ceremonies.
* Manage major and minor release deliverables by following SDLC standards.
* Technically guides colleagues on design and implementation techniques.
* Analyze the functional requirements specification given by SMEs.
* Design the applications.
* Implement the applications according to approved designs.
* Conduct rigorous testing of the applications.
* Deploy the applications to cloud computing infrastructure.
* Perform technical reviews on the design \& solutions from your colleagues.
* Remain current on PTC technology solutions and develop skills on emerging technologies, as needed.
* Attend daily stand\-up to stay agile, share ideas, give feedback, and stay on track.

**Required Skills:**

* Candidate should be comfortable with Server\-Side as well as Client\-Side technologies.
* Programming Languages: Proficiency in Java, J2EE, and web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
* Web Services: Experience with RESTful APIs and other web service technologies.
* Familiarity with MLOPs/AIOps/LLMOps tools is added advantage.
* Database Knowledge: Familiarity with relational databases like Oracle or MS SQL Server.
* Cloud Technologies: Exposure to cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP is beneficial.
* Agile Development: Experience working in an Agile development environment.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to debug and resolve complex technical issues.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience with PTC Products: Experience with PTC's Windchill PLM system and ThingWorx platform is added advantage.
* Experience with Content Management, Page Layout, and Publishing software is also helpful.
  

  

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.


If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?


We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here ."

title: BSA Administration and Reporting Junior Analyst
description:
**Entity:**

Finance  

  

**Job Family Group:**

Finance Group  

  

**Job Description:**

**Background and purpose** **of role:**


BP is driving a central transformation project with an objective to upgrade and standardise the policies, process, control and technology around balance sheet assurance/ reconciliation and journal entry, to implement an integrated solution via Blackline SaaS solution.


The project aims to bring digitization and enhance BP’s balance sheet reconciliation and manual journals operating and assurance capabilities.


This role is going to play a pivotal role as a part of project team. Primary objective of this role is to support be proficient in Blackline maintenance and reporting functionalities. The role requires Blackline admin expertise coupled with finance process and accounting knowledge.


The role entails ample opportunities and requires working with senior collaborators across BP’s GBS teams, liaise with BP\-wide finance and control teams while assisting transformation project team.


**Key Results / Accountabilities:**


Key roles and responsibilities will include:


* Complete the maintenance and configuration of the Blackline platform to ensure optimal performance and alignment with business requirements.
* Configure system settings, user permissions, and access controls according to organizational policies and requirements.
* Handle user assignments within the Blackline platform, including adding new users, updating user profiles, and deactivating accounts as needed.
* Provide user support and fix assistance to address any issues related to user access or functionality within Blackline.
* Maintain precise master data in Blackline, including charts of accounts and mapping tables, ensuring platform\-wide consistency and integrity through regular audits and validation checks.
* Supervise compliance with internal policies, industry regulations, and security standards within the Blackline environment.
* Develop and customize reports in Blackline to supervise key performance indicators (KPIs) related to reconciliation activities and process efficiency.
* Generate monthly reports summarizing reconciliation completion status, outstanding actions, and other relevant metrics for management review.
* Facilitate training sessions for new users to familiarize them with BlackLine functionalities, processes, and guidelines and provide ongoing support and assistance to users, answering inquiries, trousolving issuesd addressing training needs as they arise.
* Configure and manage workflows within Blackline to streamline reconciliation processes and approval workflows.

**Key Challenges:**


* Demonstrate clear understanding of the business context of the company in order to deliver high quality service.
* Quick to react and adapt to constantly changing business requirements to support rapidly changing business requirements.
* Ability to communicate effectively with and influence people at all levels, geographies and time zones within the organisation, building strong relationships quickly.
* Complete understanding of system landscape and infrastructure
* End to end understanding of GBS control monitoring and governance processes.
* Ensuring that BP's control environment remains effective through compliance with internal/ external requirements via the application of controls and systems across all activities in scope of operations.
* Looks for ways to do things better, faster, more efficiently.

**Qualification and Experience.**


**Education and Experience**


* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
* 4\+ years of relevant experience in finance, Blackline / SAP ECC / S4 HANA / MS Office Suite.
* Clear, fluent, and confident written and verbal communication skills
* Strong continuous improvement mentality and drive for excellence
* Agile outlook to adapt to changing circumstances and priorities.

**Knowledge and Skills Required**


* Good levels of proactivity \& drive, analytical thinking, strong communications \& engagement, tenacity and preferably have pre\-BP background experience in Blackline.
* BlackLine and SAP FI\-CO is preferred.
* Project role for 12\-18 months which transitions back to an operational team lead / senior analyst role after the project finishes.
* Understanding of the end\-to\-end financial process lifecycle like O2C, P2P and R2R
* Strong planning and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to communicate effectively.
* Strong collaborator leadership skills
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks concurrently.

**Desirable**


* Experience with power, Oil and gas industry, big4 or GBS/ SSC experience.

**Leadership Competencies**


**Value Expertise**


**Develop capability through continual learning:** Proactively develops the expertise of themselves and others and encourages and supports a climate of continual learning.


**Energise People**


**Foster effective teamwork and collaboration:** Facilitates effective teamwork and builds collaborative relationships internally and externally.


**Act Decisively**


**Demonstrate relentless drive and determination:** Continually demonstrates a real hunger and drive to achieve, high levels of energy and a solid resilience, and understands and manages the impact of this on others.


**Deliver Results**


**Manage risk and drive safe, reliable and efficient operations:** Proactively manages risks and insists on sustained operational excellence.


*Mindsets*


Own your success


* Demonstrates leadership and is accountable for driving team performance.
* Inspires teams to evaluate and enhance delivery of business outcomes.
* Models safe and ethical work practices and a culture of transparency

Think big


* Actively seeks opportunities to transform and enhance processes and systems.
* Constantly seeks ways to transform, improve and innovate.
* Builds the skills and knowledge of self and the team and promotes a collaborative team environment

Be curious


* Encourages a culture of curiosity across teams.
* Ensures the delivery and improvement of digital solutions to benefit customers.
* Supports the team to try new technologies, fail and learn fast and implement solutions at pace

Effortless customer experience


* Drives team to understand customer needs and deliver digital seamless self\-service customer experiences.
* Fosters multi\-functional collaboration in support of One Finance

Digital first


* Keeps up to date with digital innovation and seeks digital solutions for problems.
* Encourages the team to deliver creative digital solutions

title: Customer Relationship Management Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 EDUMISSION 100 is a collaborative community of experienced and passionate teachers, each with deep expertise in their subject areas. The organization is driven by a clear vision to provide best\-in\-class academic support and guidance to students. EDUMISSION 100 focuses on personalized assistance, helping learners achieve strong educational outcomes and long\-term success. Team members work closely together to design effective learning experiences that are both high\-quality and student\-centered.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in New Delhi. This role is responsible for managing and optimizing the student and parent relationship lifecycle, including onboarding, engagement, retention, and feedback collection. Day\-to\-day tasks include analyzing customer data, segmenting markets, designing outreach campaigns, and coordinating with sales and academic teams to ensure consistent communication. The CRM Manager will monitor performance metrics, maintain CRM systems, and lead projects aimed at improving service quality and student satisfaction. This role also involves building long\-term relationships, addressing concerns promptly, and recommending process improvements to enhance overall customer experience.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Market Segmentation abilities to interpret data and identify customer trends.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to interact effectively with students, parents, and internal teams.
* Candidates should possess solid Sales skills to support enrollment, upselling of programs, and relationship\-based outreach.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills to plan, execute, and track CRM initiatives and improvement projects.
* Familiarity with CRM software and data reporting tools is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Education Management, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in the education sector or customer success roles is an advantage.
* Ability to work collaboratively, manage multiple priorities, and maintain a customer\-centric mindset.

title: Client Servicing Manager - Events and Activations
description:
**Company Description** 
 Anthem is an integrated experiential marketing agency that creates brand experiences, campaigns, and IPs that connect brands with culture and consumers. The agency delivers services including experience design, brand activations, event management, luxury experiences, creator collaborations, content production, corporate events, and influencer marketing. With over 12 years of industry experience, Anthem has produced more than 150 experiences across 30\+ cities and partnered with over 80 brands. The team focuses on crafting immersive moments that engage audiences and help brands stand out in competitive markets. Anthem is driven by a culture\-focused approach that blends creativity, strategy, and execution.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Client Servicing Manager – Events and Activations is a full\-time, on\-site role based in New Delhi. This role involves managing day\-to\-day client communication, understanding client objectives, and translating them into clear briefs for internal teams. The manager will oversee event and activation projects from planning to execution, coordinate with creative, production, and operations teams, and ensure deliverables are on time and within budget. Responsibilities include preparing proposals and presentations, monitoring project performance, troubleshooting issues, and maintaining high standards of service and client satisfaction. The role also involves building long\-term client relationships, identifying opportunities to grow accounts, and contributing to new business pitches as needed.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong client\-facing skills, including Client Services and Client Relations, to manage and grow key accounts.
* Focus on Customer Satisfaction and Customer Service, ensuring responsive support and high\-quality delivery.
* Excellent Communication skills, both written and verbal, for clear presentations, emails, and meetings.
* Experience in events, brand activations, or experiential marketing, with end\-to\-end project management capabilities.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, handle multiple projects, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.

* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including specification success rate, pipeline growth, and customer engagement outcomes.
* Develop and execute training plans for assigned Global Engineering Center, delivering awareness, application, and advanced technical training tailored to client seniority and discipline mix. Leverage Emerson’s training organization, Application Specialists, and Product Marketing. Position training as a strategic specification and preference tool. Track execution and measure outcomes including specification activity, stakeholder coverage, and client feedback.
* Partner with Global Strategic Account teams to align pursuit strategies, commercial positioning, and stakeholder messaging for shared accounts. Regularly share account and project pipeline updates and support the execution of global approved vendor list qualification, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement activities at the local Global Engineering Center level.


**Who You Are:**
 You consistently deliver on commitments by following through on plans with accuracy and attention to detail while maintaining a strong focus on measurable outcomes. You build partnerships and work collaboratively across teams and functions, sharing knowledge and aligning efforts to achieve shared goals. You develop a deep understanding of customer needs and use that insight to create meaningful solutions that drive long\-term value. You adapt your approach to identify new opportunities, think creatively, and respond effectively to evolving business and customer requirements.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a relevant technical field (such as instrumentation, electrical, mechanical, or chemical engineering).
* A minimum of 8 years of related experience required; 10\+ years preferred.
* Experience in industrial automation, process measurement, or related industries, with exposure to EPC or owner\-operator environments.
* Understanding of the project lifecycle, including engineering design, specification development, and procurement processes.
* Experience engaging with engineering teams on technical specifications, vendor qualification, or project pursuit activities.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and deliver engaging presentations or training sessions.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and a data\-driven approach to managing pipelines and customer interactions.
* Willingness and ability to travel as part of the role.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver technical training or product capability sessions to engineering audiences, including drafting structured, multi\-level training plans.
* Experience engaging or coordinating with strategic or major account management teams on shared accounts including aligning pursuit strategies and sharing structured account intelligence.


**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**
* Experience working with or within EPC organizations or Global Engineering Centers.
* Knowledge of Measurement Solutions technologies (flow, pressure, temperature, level, analytical, or systems) or similar product portfolios.
* Exposure to industries such as oil and gas, petrochemicals, power generation, or industrial manufacturing.
* Experience with engineering tools or platforms used for specification and design (e.g., SmartPlant, AVEVA).
* Demonstrated ability to work across global teams and influence without direct authority.
* Experience supporting global approved vendor list qualification efforts, Global Frame Agreement utilization, or licensor engagement programs at a local or regional level.


**Our Culture and Commitment To You:**
 At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

title: Lead Data Advisor
description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
   

  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
 SimCorp DMS is a complete data management solution for pricing and reference data, provided as a Managed Service. The SimCorp DMS Advisory and change management service is a team of industry and data management experts who consistently monitor for any industry, regulatory and vendor feed changes that may affect our client’s business operations. The Advisory Service regularly informs clients of these changes, and how best to adapt.
   

  

 As a Senior Data Advisor, you will be responsible to look after the client onboarding, monitoring vendor changes, maintaining the standard data model and orchestrating change management activities for the SimCorp DMS clients by liaising with internal service teams from IT and Operations. You will be directly reporting to the head of Data Advisory team
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Create and maintain data standards (lookups, mappings, conventions, and rules), data models and data ontologies (how are data objects related to each other)
* Maintain meta data information documentation regarding data models, data interpretation, data lineage and utilization along the key processes and make it available to internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor, track and conduct assessment of all vendors related changes that impacts SimCorp DMS and Enterprise Data Manager clients.
* Facilitate Change \& Control Board (CCB) governance with internal service teams to prioritize and deliver the standard and client change requests.
* Design and implement a robust client onboarding framework for a seamless DMS client onboarding
* Serve as the advisor and quality gateway regarding data and change integrations related to data.
* Support design and maintenance of an overall data test concepts and conduct regular data tests to assure data and service quality.
* Support DMS Operations on various process improvement initiatives.
* Advise clients on data needs and data usage for new requirements.
* Build and maintain in\-depth know\-how on industry and regulatory changes within data management.
* This is a client\-centric role that involves regular interaction with our valued customers
* Continuously develop a comprehensive understanding of the latest industry and regulatory trends in the data management space and promote best practices within the SimCorp community to benefit our clients.


**What We Value**
 Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to \- and interested in \- learning the rest.
   

  

* Have a relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent in finance
* Relevant experience in areas of Change Management with data vendor feeds (Bloomberg, IDC, Reuters, etc.)
* Have good knowledge of financial products and markets including derivatives, structured instruments etc.
* Have experience in requirements engineering, data modelling and full SDLC approach.
* Have a structured approach, attention to detail, service mindset, and solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Process management, control and design experience are beneficial skills but not mandatory.
* Have relevant experience in Data Management and Business Analysis
* Possess strong knowledge of various investment/trade lifecycle activities
* Show the ability to collaborate easily with various departments to ensure client success.

description:

 At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.
   

  

**Role Title: Customer Success Manager, Booking for Business \-** 
**Gurgaon (Gurugram)**
 At Booking.com for Business, you are the trusted face and voice of our platform for corporate customers around the globe. Whether representing us at business events and trade fairs or engaging directly with clients via phone and web meetings, you will be the key driver in attracting, connecting with, and supporting our business travel users.
   

  

 You’ll bring passion, expertise, and a service\-first mindset to every interaction—helping customers navigate our platform and adopt it in ways that bring real value to their companies. Your goal is to build long\-lasting relationships grounded in trust, loyalty, and mutual success. You are “the representative” of Booking.com for Business for our corporate customers around the globe.
   

  

 On business events as well as via the phone and web meetings, you will contact, attract, connect and inform corporate customers of our product and services. You will share your knowledge, your passion with our customers and teams and guide them in using Booking.com for Business to best fit them and their company’s needs.
   

  

 Your goal is to build up a long term relationship full of trust and loyalty towards Booking.com for Business. Furthermore you will become an expert in the Business Travel industry and continuously enrich your knowledge in this area for and with all stakeholders involved.
   

  

 With excellent communication skills and a strong service minded attitude you are the ideal connector to bring people together experiencing the world through Booking.com for Business.
   

  

 Your key objective will be owning the customer lifecycle by activating and converting high value (potential) small business customers into loyal ambassadors. You will coach, educate and advise them through training, webinars, calls and interactive support materials giving them the confidence to be an expert in using our product themselves and spread the word.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Customer Lifecycle Ownership: Guide new and existing SME customers through the full customer journey—from onboarding and adoption to optimization and advocacy.
* Client Engagement: Regularly engage with customers via virtual meetings, phone calls, webinars, and selective live events to understand their business travel needs and demonstrate how Booking.com for Business can meet those needs.
* Product Education: Deliver tailored training and product walk\-throughs to ensure customers are confident and capable in using our platform independently.
* Relationship Building: Act as the key point of contact and trusted advisor, building relationships grounded in trust, loyalty, and mutual success.
* Advocacy Development: Identify high\-value users and support them in becoming Booking.com for Business ambassadors, promoting organic growth and user adoption.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Support teams to relay customer feedback and drive continuous improvement in our offerings.
* Event Representation: Represent Booking.com for Business at relevant industry trade shows, conferences, and networking events to attract new customers and strengthen existing relationships.

* Regional Leaders (CEM, ArM, RM and RD)

* Product teams

* Customer\-Centric Mindset: Passion for delivering top\-tier service and solving customer problems with empathy and efficiency.
* Communication Skills: Strong communication skills \- in person and over the phone, comfortable hosting webinars, leading training sessions, and representing the brand at events.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About Virohan:** 




 Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an
 **education–to\-industry partner** 
 building the workforce powering India’s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry\- aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real\-world employability. At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms.
 **Our model combines academic learning with hands\-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles.** 
 Today, Virohan has trained 13,000\+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
 



 Backed by
 **global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan),** 
 we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare — two of India’s fastest\-growing sectors.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 Signing a university partnership is the easy part. Making it work — filling seats, running the programme well, placing students, keeping the Registrar and the Chancellor’s office confident that the partnership was a good decision — is where the business is actually won or lost. And it all comes due once a year, at renewal.
 



 This role owns that. You are the single point of accountability for a portfolio of partner universities: their success, their satisfaction, and their renewal. You are the bridge between the institution and every internal team at Virohan — admissions, academics, placements, operations, finance — translating in both directions, setting expectations honestly, and making sure what we promised is what actually happens on campus.
 



  





**What you’ll own** 




 •
 **Renewal targets\-** 
 Carry and deliver the end\-of\-year renewal goal for every university in your portfolio. Renewals are the number you are measured on, and you own the plan to get there from day one of the year — not in the last quarter.
 



 •
 **Partner success\-** 
 Define what success looks like for each partner — enrolment, programme delivery, student outcomes, placements — then track it, report it, and drive the internal action that moves it.
 



 •
 **The relationship map\-** 
 Build trusted relationships across each institution: Registrar, Deans, HoDs, admissions teams, and the leadership who ultimately sign the renewal. Never be dependent on a single contact.
 



 •
 **Expectation setting\-** 
 Agree what Virohan will deliver and what the university will deliver, in writing, up front — and hold both sides to it. Most partnership failures are expectation failures.
 



 •
 **Internal advocacy and escalation\-** 
 Represent the partner\&\#39;s reality inside Virohan and get cross\- functional teams to act, without having authority over them. Escalate early, with evidence, and follow through to closure.
 



 •
 **Business reviews\-** 
 Run a disciplined cadence of reviews with each partner — a clear numbers\-led narrative on what is working, what is not, and what happens next. These reviews are what make the renewal conversation a formality.
 



 •
 **Commercial conversations\-** 
 Lead renewal negotiations, pricing and scope discussions, and identify expansion within existing partners — new programmes, new campuses, higher intake.
 



 •
 **Risk detection\-** 
 Spot an at\-risk account two quarters out, not two weeks out. Build the early\-warning signals into how you run the portfolio.
 



  





**What we’re looking for** 




 •
 **3\-6 years of experience in business roles,** 
 with real ownership of a number — retention, renewal, revenue or growth. You have been accountable for an outcome, not just for supporting one.
 



 •
 **Outstanding communication.** 
 You are credible in a Registrar\&\#39;s office and clear in an internal escalation. You can say no, deliver bad news early, and still keep the relationship strong.
 



 •
 **Logical, structured thinking.** 
 You diagnose why an account is underperforming rather than reacting to the loudest complaint, and you can separate a real problem from a symptom.
 



 •
 **Comfort with numbers.** 
 You are fluent in spreadsheets and you run your portfolio off data —
 



 enrollment funnels, placement rates, revenue per partner, renewal probability. You build your own view rather than waiting for a report.
 



 •
 **Strong AI leverage.** 
 You already use Claude and similar AI tools to prepare for reviews, analyse partner data, draft proposals and cut your admin time. We want someone who compounds their own output.
 



 •
 **Clear writing.** 
 Review decks, partner emails, MoU scopes and internal escalations that are
 



 unambiguous and get acted on.
 



 •
 **Ownership and follow\-through.** 
 You close loops without being chased. When something falls between two teams, you pick it up.
 



 •
 **Willingness to travel.** 
 You will be on partner campuses regularly. The relationship is not built over email.
 



  





**This role is probably not for you if** 




 • You see account management as relationship maintenance rather than a number you carry.
 



 • You are uncomfortable pushing internal teams, or you avoid difficult conversations with a partner until they escalate.
 



 • You would rather report on the portfolio than be accountable for it.
 



  





**What you get** 




 •
 **A clear number and real ownership** 
 — your portfolio, your renewal target, your call on how to get there.
 



 •
 **Senior exposure** 
 , internally with Virohan’s leadership and externally with university leadership, from your first month.
 



 •
 **Work that matters** 
 — every partnership that renews is another few hundred students with a route to a real healthcare job.
 



  





**If you believe in making an impact on society and are keen to be a part of the fast growing healthcare education sector, we would be delighted to hear from you!**

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

title: Manager, Knowledge Management Services, GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work \- guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 We are seeking an enthusiastic, self\-motivated knowledge management professional to join our growing KM Services team. As part of A\&M’s Global AI and Knowledge Organization, KM Services is at the center of an exciting firm\-wide transformation in how A\&M works and derives value from its intellectual property. The team is focused on building a mature knowledge management practice, including strengthening relationships with business stakeholders; breaking down siloes; and improving how consulting teams capture, organize, share, and find critical knowledge. In addition to supporting people\-to\-people and people\-to\-content use cases, the team has a critical role in building the data and information layer needed to power business\-relevant AI agents and tools. The successful candidate will own the KM relationship for a portfolio of India business units, partnering closely with those businesses to improve their existing KM processes, understand their evolving needs, and connect them to the global KM strategy and toolkit. This is a high\-visibility role for someone who wants to help business units get more value from their knowledge while also contributing directly to global KM and AI initiatives. The role will report to the EMEA \& India KM Services Director
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
* Partner with A\&M Business Units on KM Initiatives
* Own the day\-to\-day KM relationship for India business units, with the opportunity to expand the portfolio over time
* Serve as the primary liaison between assigned business units and the central KM team, identifying opportunities to extend each business unit’s use of KM services and maximize KM adoption and value
* Lead projects to build and refine business\-unit KM processes and tools, including coordinating timelines and partnering with KM services, KM technology, and other corporate groups on execution
* Monitor and provide routine support for business\-unit KM processes and tools (e.g., knowledge libraries, taxonomies, capture processes, search, and communities)
* Provide advice and recommendations to business units based on internal and external KM best practices.
* Contribute to KM Knowledge and Expertise
* Partner with KM colleagues to design and build global capabilities and tools (e.g., expert profiles, conversational knowledge search, agentic knowledge capture) and help extend them to new areas of the business
* Support KM team members on initiatives both within and beyond the immediate region, contributing to a cohesive global KM capability
* Share knowledge of processes, approaches, methods, and tools/platforms with team colleagues so the team can leverage its collective experience across the globe
* Provide insight into business needs, initiatives, and end\-user experience to help ensure global KM service offerings remain relevant and aligned to overall strategy
* Support the growth and evolution of the KM team by applying KM best practices in ways that strengthen the success of the overall KM support model
* AI Risk \& Audit
* Identify internal and external KM trends and best practices; communicate and promote these to business\-unit KM contacts
* Champion KM best practices and encourage knowledge sharing and adoption of new tools throughout the region and firm


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in a knowledge management role
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent work/technical experience in Business Studies, Business Administration, or Management
* Experience leading projects from inception to completion, including collaborating with stakeholders on timelines and expectations and handling change management
* Experience in a professional services or consultancy firm
* Proven experience working with professionals of all staff classes, up to C\-level
* Experience with KM technology (e.g., SharePoint libraries, AI\-enabled search and discovery tools)
* Fluent English required. Additional languages (Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, or Korean) are a plus but not required
* Consultative approach when partnering with the business
* Experience with KM and content management approaches (e.g., communities, skills and experience platforms, document libraries, taxonomy and metadata, search, curation, content analytics)
* Analytical reasoning and solution\-focused problem solving, with the ability to connect the dots and scale KM efforts across a portfolio of business units
* Capable of synthesizing information and driving results in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to balance multiple projects and prioritize effectively
* Excellent communication and listening skills, with the ability to present complex ideas and solutions to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated history of operating with urgency, responsiveness, and a client\-first focus
* Exceptionally close attention to detail
* Resilience and an ability to persevere in order to break down resistance and accomplish long\-term goals


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.
