title: Account Manager- South
description:
Lead the safe, reliable, compliant and cost\-effective operation and maintenance of multiple industrial water and wastewater treatment sites. The role has end\-to\-end accountability for plant performance, contractual KPIs, customer satisfaction, workforce capability, maintenance systems, budgets, vendors, statutory compliance and continuous improvement across the assigned portfolio.
 



 The successful candidate will provide strong technical and operational leadership to site managers and multidisciplinary teams, standardize O\&M practices across locations, and ensure timely resolution of critical operational and customer issues.
 



 2\. Scope of Responsibility
 


* Oversee multiple O\&M contracts and treatment facilities operating on a continuous shift basis.
* Provide governance and technical direction for WTP, ETP, STP, RO and ZLD facilities, including associated pumping, clarification, filtration, sludge handling, evaporation and drying systems.
* Manage mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, automation and process performance through site teams and specialist support functions.
* Own service delivery in line with contract terms, agreed budgets, customer specifications, environmental requirements and internal standards.



 3\. Key Responsibilities
 



 A. Multi\-Site Operations \& Performance
 


* Take overall ownership of day\-to\-day O\&M performance across all assigned sites and ensure uninterrupted availability of critical water systems.
* Review plant operating parameters, water quality, throughput, recovery, uptime and consumption trends; initiate corrective action for deviations.
* Conduct structured site reviews and risk\-based visits, with focused support for underperforming or critical facilities.
* Coordinate rapid technical support for breakdowns, chronic problems and process upsets to minimize downtime and customer production impact.
* Drive process optimization, debottlenecking, reliability improvement and operating\-cost reduction without compromising safety, quality or compliance.
* Ensure effective shift deployment, escalation protocols and management coverage across sites.



 B. Treatment Process \& Technical Oversight
 


* Provide technical governance for raw\-water treatment, clarification, filtration, cooling\-water systems, ETP, STP, RO, UF/NF where applicable, MEE, ATFD, filter press, clarifier, thickener, oil skimmer and complete ZLD systems.
* Monitor influent and effluent quality, RO recovery and rejection, membrane performance, chemical dosing, sludge generation, evaporation efficiency and final discharge or reuse quality.
* Guide root\-cause analysis and sustainable resolution of process, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and automation issues.
* Ensure calibration and documentation of instruments, gauges and measuring devices as per schedule and audit requirements.
* Maintain current technical knowledge and promote adoption of proven operating and maintenance practices.



 C. Maintenance \& Reliability
 


* Establish and govern preventive, predictive, condition\-based, time\-based and breakdown maintenance programs.
* Ensure maintenance planning, work\-order discipline, shutdown planning, spares management and equipment\-history records are effective at every site.
* Review critical equipment health for pumps, motors, blowers, compressors, agitators, dosing systems, dewatering equipment, membranes, evaporators, dryers, MCCs, VFDs, PLC/SCADA and field instruments.
* Lead failure investigations, root\-cause analysis and closure of corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive equipment reliability, reduced repeat failures and optimized maintenance cost.



 D. Safety, Environment \& Compliance
 


* Be accountable for a goal\-zero safety culture across the assigned sites.
* Ensure compliance with HSE/EHS requirements, permit\-to\-work systems, SOPs, risk assessments, PPE, chemical handling, lockout/tagout and emergency preparedness.
* Ensure incidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and environmental events are reported, investigated and closed with effective corrective actions.
* Conduct and monitor safety audits, toolbox talks, hazard\-register reviews and statutory inspections.
* Maintain environmental, legal and customer compliance records in audit\-ready condition.



 E. Contract, KPI \& Customer Management
 


* Establish and review site KPIs in line with contract requirements, including plant availability, water quality, throughput, recovery, downtime, consumption, cost, safety and customer satisfaction.
* Prepare consolidated monthly MIS, performance dashboards, variance analysis and recovery plans for management and customer reviews.
* Lead customer meetings, technical discussions and escalation management; ensure timely closure of observations and commitments.
* Protect contractual performance and billing by ensuring KPI evidence, service records, approvals and monthly documentation are complete and timely.
* Identify contract risks, scope gaps and change requirements, and escalate them with clear technical and commercial justification.



 F. Budget, Cost \& Commercial Control
 


* Prepare and manage annual and monthly O\&M budgets for the assigned portfolio.
* Monitor actual expenditure against budget and control manpower, chemicals, energy, spares, maintenance and subcontracting costs.
* Develop savings initiatives through process optimization, chemical and energy reduction, improved reliability and resource productivity.
* Plan critical spares, consumables, annual maintenance and shutdown requirements based on operational risk and contract obligations.
* Support timely customer billing, certification and resolution of performance\-linked deductions or commercial issues.



 G. Team Leadership \& Capability Building
 


* Lead site managers, engineers, supervisors, technicians, operators and support teams across locations.
* Define accountability, review staffing and shift structures, and ensure deployment matches plant criticality and skill needs.
* Recruit, onboard, coach, train and develop site teams; maintain skill matrices and succession plans for critical roles.
* Set clear performance expectations and conduct structured reviews, while promoting discipline, ownership and collaboration.
* Ensure technically competent manpower is available to troubleshoot critical equipment and process issues.



 H. Systems, Standardization \& Continuous Improvement
 


* Standardize SOPs, checklists, log sheets, maintenance practices, reporting formats and escalation mechanisms across sites.
* Ensure critical work instructions are practical, pictorial and available in a language understood by the workforce where required.
* Use performance data to identify systemic issues, benchmark sites and replicate best practices.
* Coordinate effectively with Process, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, HR, Finance and corporate support functions.
* Promote digital tools such as CMMS/SAP, dashboards and MS Office applications for planning, documentation and performance control.



 4\. Key Performance Indicators
 



**KPI Area** 




**Measures** 




**Safety \& Compliance** 




 Zero injuries; closure of audit findings; statutory and environmental compliance
 



**Plant Performance** 




 Availability, uptime, throughput, treated\-water quality and adherence to operating targets
 



**Process Efficiency** 




 Recovery, chemical consumption, energy consumption, water reuse and sludge or reject management
 



**Reliability** 




 Breakdown frequency, repeat failures, preventive\-maintenance compliance and downtime
 



**Commercial** 




 Budget adherence, cost savings, billing documentation and reduction of performance deductions
 



**Customer** 




 Satisfaction, escalation closure, review effectiveness and completion of commitments
 



**People** 




 Manpower productivity, training completion, skill coverage and retention of critical capability
 



 5\. Qualification \& Experience
 


* Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Environmental or a related engineering discipline. A relevant postgraduate qualification is desirable.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant O\&M experience, preferably in industrial water and wastewater treatment, utilities, heavy industry, metals, chemicals or similar process industries.
* Proven experience managing multiple sites, large contracts or a geographically distributed O\&M portfolio.
* Demonstrated hands\-on exposure to water and wastewater treatment and ZLD operations, together with multidisciplinary maintenance management.
* Experience in customer\-facing roles, budgeting, vendor management, workforce leadership, KPI governance and management reporting.



 6\. Required Technical Knowledge
 


* Water treatment processes: clarification, filtration, disinfection, demineralization and membrane systems.
* Wastewater and reuse systems: ETP, STP, RO, sludge handling and ZLD, including MEE and ATFD where applicable.
* Mechanical systems: pumps, motors, blowers, compressors, agitators, valves, piping and rotating equipment.
* Electrical and instrumentation: HT/LT interfaces, MCC/PCC, VFDs, PLC/SCADA, transmitters, analyzers, control valves, interlocks and calibration.
* Maintenance systems: preventive, predictive, condition\-based and breakdown maintenance; root\-cause analysis; spares planning.
* HSE, environmental compliance, statutory requirements, quality systems and audit documentation.
* Working knowledge of CMMS/SAP, MS Office and data\-based reporting tools.



 7\. Leadership Competencies
 


* Ownership and accountability across multiple operating locations.
* Strong planning, prioritization and decision\-making under operational pressure.
* Customer orientation with confident technical and commercial communication.
* Analytical problem\-solving and disciplined closure of corrective actions.
* Ability to coach teams, build trust and create a safety\-focused performance culture.
* Effective cross\-functional coordination, negotiation and stakeholder management.
* High integrity, adaptability and willingness to travel frequently.



 8\. Decision\-Making Authority
 


* Operational decisions required to protect safety, compliance, equipment and continuity of service.
* Deployment of manpower and resources within the approved organization structure and budget.
* Prioritization of maintenance, spares and technical support based on plant criticality.
* Vendor and service\-provider recommendations in accordance with company procedures.
* Escalation of contractual, commercial, safety and compliance risks to appropriate management.



 9\. Candidate Profile
 



 A hands\-on, results\-oriented O\&M leader who can manage a diverse portfolio of water and wastewater treatment plants, strengthen site leadership, build reliable operating systems and maintain strong customer confidence. The candidate should combine process knowledge with maintenance discipline, commercial awareness, people leadership and an uncompromising approach to safety and compliance.

 ● Extensive experience managing dealer, franchise, or retail network audits in large\-scale, multi\-location service environments.

 ● Expert mastery of Customer Journey Design and mapping to architect seamless, brand\-consistent end\-to\-end service delivery experiences.

**Role Overview** 




  





 Lead the Account Management function for your portfolio \- the clients and the team behind them. This is a lead role, and the track into pod leadership.
 



 While the Performance Manager owns the deep campaign analysis, you own the client outcome. Three things define success here:
 


* Keep the clients you have, and grow them.
* Be the person the client trusts, and the one who handles the difficult conversations.
* Keep the portfolio running cleanly, with nothing falling through the cracks.



 The role is for someone who takes ownership without being asked and surfaces problems early, while they're still small.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





*Client Ownership \& Communication* 



* Own a portfolio of clients \- accountable for retention, satisfaction, and revenue growth
* Lead client calls, WBRs/QBRs, and performance evaluations against the client's objectives.
* Build real relationships across client stakeholders \- marketing, growth, and CXO level
* Run the tough client conversations directly \- pricing pushback, scope disputes, escalations that need a firm answer.

* Build and present client proposals grounded in performance data and market analysis
* .



*Operations \& Performance Oversight* 



* Track performance against CVR, CAC, LTV, ROAS. Flag deviations before the client does.
* Own the insight\-to\-outcome loop: take what the Performance Manager surfaces, drive it into action, and report back to the client on what actually changed.
* Read the numbers well enough to bridge AM and PM, without needing either side to interpret for you.
* Partner closely with Adops, Performance Manager, Analysts, and Sales to close execution gaps and drive account growth.

-

* Represent Account Management in planning with the Performance Manager and Adops leads. Shape the plan..


-

* Walks into a QBR already knowing what the client will ask, with the answer ready.
* Treats an escalation as a chance to rebuild trust, not a fire to put out and move past.
* Spots the growth opportunity in the data before anyone else does.
* Pushes back on execution teams when delivery doesn't match what was promised.
* Makes the AMs on their team better. The coaching shows up in how the team handles clients
* Says the difficult thing to the client early, while it's still fixable.


-

* 4\+ years in Account Management within digital advertising, digital media, or analytics, including experience owning complex or high\-stakes accounts.

* Proven track record leading client conversations and turning performance data into a business story.

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.


 We’re an award\-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK \& Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft \& Oracle partner
* 3300\+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10\+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland \& UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK \& Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW


We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**  

Group Operations within Version 1 is seeking an experienced and results\-driven Operations Coordinator to join our team.


The role plays a critical part in ensuring the smooth and effective running of multiple Practices. As a key member of the Shared Operations Team, you will be responsible for coordinating operational processes, systems, reporting and data governance, providing the insight, structure and support needed to drive operational excellence and business performance. You will also be expected to follow and adhere to established standard operating procedures (SOPs), while identifying opportunities to enhance and improve them where appropriate.


We are looking for an organised, detail\-oriented and solution\-focused individual who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is motivated by delivering real value. The successful candidate will possess strong commercial awareness, a passion for data and a keen eye for accuracy, while building effective relationships across a wide range of teams and stakeholders. They will have a proven track record of driving outcomes, coordinating activities and getting things done, even where they do not have direct ownership or authority over the resources involved.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Kantata \& Operational Administration**

* Own and coordinate **Kantata**, our centralised timesheet and resourcing tool, including:
* Coordinating ownership of new proposals through CRM synchronisation.
* Managing timesheet administration and follow\-up.
* Working closely with Operations Business Partners (OBPs) to ensure monthly forecasts are in place and accurately maintained.
* Processing end\-of\-tenure leavers.
* Triggering new hire requests (ESRs).
* Maintaining system hygiene and following up on missing business units, unbuilt proposals and other items identified by the Kantata team.
* Ensure key operational data is maintained, reviewed and understood accurately and on a timely basis.

**Financial \& Commercial Data**

* Develop a strong understanding of the financial and commercial drivers within Practice forecasts.
* Monitor and maintain recurring revenue information, ensuring contract data is accurate and revenue is appropriately captured.
* Monitor project resourcing, including available talent and external hiring requirements.
* Monitor individual and team chargeability and understand the key drivers behind week\-on\-week fluctuations.
* Track and report contractor utilisation on a monthly basis.
* Prepare regular reports and provide meaningful insights and key information to support the Leadership Team.

**Governance, Compliance \& Reporting**

* Support compliance reporting across areas including ITIL, Cyber Essentials, phishing awareness and vulnerability communications.
* Support the tracking and governance of operational actions, ensuring appropriate follow\-up and closure.
* Own and/or attend key meetings across the week, ensuring minutes, actions and follow\-ups are accurately documented and progressed.

**Process Improvement \& Automation**

* Continuously identify opportunities to improve processes and procedures within the Practice and across the wider organisation.
* Collaborate regularly with counterparts across the business to promote consistency and a single way of working.
* Identify opportunities to automate operational processes and drive automation where practical and beneficial.
* Proactively identify issues and work with relevant stakeholders to develop and implement solutions.

**General Operations Support**

* Provide general administrative and operational support to the Practice as required.
* Manage multiple priorities effectively, ensuring tasks and activities are completed accurately and within agreed deadlines.
* Build strong working relationships with Practice Leads, Delivery Managers and other stakeholders across the business.

 **Qualifications** **Skills, Experience \& Qualifications**

* **At least 5 years' experience** in similar operations, coordination or practice support role.
* Strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in working with data, understanding trends and identifying the drivers behind the numbers.
* Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
* Good commercial awareness and numerical acumen. A financial background is desirable but not essential.
* Comfortable working with **Excel at an intermediate level**, including lookups and pivot tables.
* Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against deadlines.
* Strong ownership and accountability, with a proven ability to follow tasks through to completion.
* Proactive and solution\-focused, with the confidence to identify issues and initiate appropriate action.
* Collaborative approach, with the ability to bring the right people together to resolve issues and drive outcomes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across different teams and levels of the organisation.
* Discreet and trustworthy, with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment and adapting to changing priorities.
* Professional and ethical approach, aligned with Version 1's core values.

 **Additional Information**  

Why Version 1?


 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance\-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression \& mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance \& Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards \& ‘Call\-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.


And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.


Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.


We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

###### **\#LI\-PS1**

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**

The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. **Why JumpCloud?**
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

title: Senior Manager - Data Integration (S4 Hana)
description:
**Job Description :**

 **About the Function:**  

  

Digital \& Technology (D\&T) is transforming how Diageo works, from how we source ingredients to how we connect with customers and consumers around the world.


This is where data, technology and creativity come together to solve real business challenges and unlock new opportunities. Whether it’s building platforms, using data to drive decisions or shaping digital experiences, the work here has tangible impact across every part of our business.


You’ll be part of a team that’s constantly learning, experimenting and pushing boundaries, with the freedom to explore new ideas and the support to turn them into reality.  

  

**Job Title**


Sr. Manager – Data Integration (S4Hana \& Azure Data Lake)

**Location**


Bangalore HO / Hybrid

**Reporting To**


Head of Data and Analytics

**Role Purpose**


We are seeking an experienced Manager to lead the design, implementation, and transition of data extraction and replication processes from SAP S/4HANA to Azure Data Lake as part of our enterprise S/4HANA transformation program.


The role will be responsible for managing changes to SAP extractors, data structures, replication frameworks, and data pipelines while ensuring continuity of business reporting, analytics, and downstream data consumption. The successful candidate will act as the bridge between SAP functional teams, data engineering teams, analytics stakeholders, and system integrators to deliver a robust and scalable data architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**S/4HANA Data Extraction \& Replication**

* Lead the design and implementation of data extraction strategies from SAP S/4HANA into Azure Data Lake.
* Assess existing SAP ECC/BW extractors and define migration and replacement strategies for S/4HANA.
* Design and manage extraction mechanisms including:
	+ SAP CDS Views
	+ ODP (Operational Data Provisioning)
	+ SAP Extractors
	+ SLT (SAP Landscape Transformation)
	+ SAP Datasphere integrations (where applicable)
	+ SAP Data Intelligence/Data Services
* Define approaches for real\-time, near real\-time, and batch data replication.

 **Azure Data Lake Integration**

* Manage end\-to\-end data movement from S/4HANA into Azure Data Lake.
* Collaborate with Azure Data Engineering teams on:
	+ Azure Data Factory (ADF)
	+ Azure Synapse Analytics
	+ Databricks
	+ Event\-driven architectures
	+ Delta Lake frameworks
* Ensure scalable, performant, and secure data ingestion pipelines.

**Data Model \& Table Transition Management**

* Analyze impacts of S/4HANA simplification on source tables and data structures.
* Identify changes between ECC and S/4HANA data models, including:
	+ Universal Journal (ACDOCA)
	+ Material Ledger
	+ Business Partner Model
	+ Inventory Management changes
	+ Procurement and Sales table changes
* Define source\-to\-target mapping and transformation logic.
* Govern transition of legacy tables and custom extractors to S/4HANA\-compatible structures.

**Data Governance \& Quality**

* Establish controls to ensure data completeness, accuracy, and reconciliation between SAP and Azure environments.
* Define data validation, monitoring, and exception handling processes.
* Support data lineage, metadata management, and audit requirements.
* Partner with Data Governance teams to ensure compliance with enterprise standards.

 **Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**

* Work closely with:
	+ SAP Functional Teams
	+ SAP Basis Teams
	+ Data \& Analytics Teams
	+ Azure Engineering Teams
	+ System Integrators
	+ Business Reporting Teams
* Manage delivery from implementation partners and third\-party vendors.
* Drive issue resolution and decision\-making during migration and cutover phases.

**Program Delivery**

* Support planning and execution of:
	+ Data migration activities
	+ Testing cycles
	+ Mock conversions
	+ Dress rehearsals
	+ Cutover activities
* Identify risks and dependencies related to data integration and reporting continuity.
* Develop transition plans from legacy extraction frameworks to S/4HANA\-based architecture.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 8–12\+ years of experience in SAP Data \& Analytics environments.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
* Proven experience implementing SAP\-to\-Azure data integration solutions.

 **Essential Experience**

**SAP**

* SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA data architecture.
* SAP extractors and operational reporting frameworks.
* ODP framework.
* CDS Views and Embedded Analytics.
* SAP BW/BW4HANA (preferred).
* Understanding of key S/4HANA simplification items and table changes.

**Data Integration**

* Real\-time and batch replication architectures.
* ETL/ELT frameworks.
* Data quality and reconciliation processes.
* Large\-scale enterprise data migration programs.

**Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder management and business partnering skills.
* Excellent communication and workshop facilitation capabilities.
* Analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* Ability to influence senior business stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration and cross\-functional leadership skills.
* Results\-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex transformation environm

title: Manager - Strategy
description:
Job Description
**Manager Strategy \& Operations**
**Clear’s Vision**
==================


Clear makes software for the CFO's office. We started with tax compliance in India and now sell in 11 countries. Governments around the world are introducing rules that require businesses to report their invoices to the tax authority and exchange them over government\-designated networks. 29 countries have mandates coming into force between now and 2030\. Each mandate means enterprises have to change how their finance systems work, usually against a fixed deadline, and they need a vendor to do it for them.  

  

**Where we are as of today:**  

* 3,700\+ enterprise customers
  
* Live or ready in 11 countries, up from 3 a year ago. We expect 25\+ by early 2027\.
  
* Government accreditation in India, Saudi Arabia, UAE, France and Oman
  
* 6M\+ invoices processed a week in Saudi Arabia alone, at 99\.9% success
  
* Targeting profitable growth with 40%\+ revenue CAGR over the next three years
  


Our international business will be larger than our India business within the year. We have also started working in markets well ahead of their mandate dates, currently the Philippines and Spain.
Alongside the compliance business we have begun building AI products on top of the finance data we already hold for customers. CFO Studio and Agent Studio let finance teams build agents that do actual work rather than produce reports.
This is the bigger opportunity for us over the next few years. We already hold compliance data for a few thousand enterprises, which puts us in a reasonable position to take on more of the work that runs a CFO's office.
**Purpose of the Role**
=======================


This role sits in the CEO's office and reports to the Chief of Staff to the CEO.  

  

**What you will be responsible for**
**Running programmes through to a decision.** You will be given something loosely defined — that we take too long to open a new market, or that our win rate in Europe is not improving. You work out what the goal should be, who needs to be involved and what the plan is, then run it until a decision is made and implemented.
**Operating cadence and reporting.** Weekly and monthly reviews across markets and business lines, with one set of numbers that everyone works off. A large part of this is noticing when something is going wrong early enough that it can still be acted on, rather than reporting it once the quarter has closed.
**New market work.** For countries whose mandates are 18 to 24 months away, we need to understand the size of the opportunity, the partner and regulatory landscape, and what has to be ready and by when. You would be doing this research yourself.
**Analysis on open questions.** Pricing, partnership models, cross\-sell, where the next increment of GTM budget should go. We would want a recommendation you have thought through and can argue for, rather than a summary of what other people think.  

  

**Role Scope**
The scope is to cover any kind of programs pertaining to Strategy and Operations. The list of programs is not constant and keeps evolving as new problems are uncovered or changing priorities. To give examples of a few programs are \-  

* **Business strategy \-** Going through the historical patterns and identifying strategic levers \& initiatives to grow sales
  
* **Rhythms and rituals \-** These would include business review rhythms, pipeline reviews, interlocks with other non\-sales functions, etc.
  
* **Customer segmentation \-** Segment customers into logical cohorts and orient sales/ sdr/ marketing towards high value cohorts.
  
* **KPI planning \-** Defining the right KPIs for the sales / sdr teams \- output and inputs
  
* **Sales enablement \-** Defining the training needs based on wins/ losses and running a structured program to upgrade the wider sales team
  
* **Process streamlining and automation \-** Critically evaluating the as\-is process of sales (external as well as internal) and implement tools for automation to drive productivity
  


**Competencies Required**  

* Analytical Acumen \- Ability to drive meaning out of numbers. This has multiple components:
	+ Data accuracy \- ensuring data is always accurate and reliable
	+ Insights \- leveraging data to generate insights for the leaders
	+ Actions \- leveraging insights to recommend high impact actions.
  
* Strategic Thinking \- Ability to take step\-back from regular operations work and think long\-term for the business. This implies \- Building independent point of views on strategic decisions \- such as partnership or cross\-sell motion, etc.
  
* Program Management \- ability to manage multiple programs via impact\-based prioritisation and keep relevant stakeholders always informed. This also includes forecasting risk (pre\-morterm) and taking corrective actions.
  
* Process, Playbook \& Technology first Mindset \- ability to think of processes in the form of scalable playbooks which can be implemented and sales can be enabled on. This also means having a technology and AI first first mindset to maximise automation vs manual work.
  
* Sales Acumen \- Ability to understand how B2B sales motion works, what are the deal success factors, what are the top metrics tracked, how sales folks behave, etc.
  


**Qualification Pre\-Requisite**  

* Proven 1\-3 years of experience for the Program Manager role

  

* Should have worked in a technology startup before or premier Consulting firm with projects in the technology/ software industry
  
* Exposure to B2B Sales is preferable but not mandatory

title: Customer Success Business Partner - Anaplan
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.



What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture.



Our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.



Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.



Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you'll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let's build what's next \- together!

  


**Anaplan is looking for a highly driven and dynamic Customer Success Business Partner (CSBP)** **to join the Customer Success team in Bangalore, India.** *The CSBP will be primarily responsible for the successful deployment, enablement, adoption, and ongoing health of our customers and their Anaplan solutions*. Acting as a trusted advisor for customers, the CSBP will work alongside our Partners and Professional Services team to drive customer outcomes and ensure Anaplan delivers high ROI. As the primary customer contact for any platform challenges, the CSBP will handle critical issues and ensure customer satisfaction.
  

**This is what you will do at Anaplan**
* **Manage a portfolio of customers with the primary goal of driving adoption, expansion, retention and maximizing ROI**
* Act as a *trusted adviser* to our customers throughout the value delivery life cycle, helping them achieve business objectives and transform their processes using Anaplan.
* Work with customers to understand pain points and guide them on how Anaplan solutions can address their specific needs
* Build and present Success Scorecards during QSRs (Quarterly Success Reviews) with Executive sponsor and senior stakeholders
* Grow the Anaplan footprint by conducting workshops to build customer mindshare on new use cases and solutions resulting in upsell or cross sell opportunities.
* Own key relationships with customers and proactively maintain high levels of engagement with a focus on increasing customer satisfaction and loyalty
* Act as the voice of customer to our internal stakeholders, including flagging and managing risks, advocating for their needs and ensuring alignment on objectives.
* Identify renewal risk and work with Renewal managers and Account executives on a mitigation plan
* Advise customer on developing a Center of Excellence or similar governance structure to enable customers self\-sufficiency on Anaplan
* Develop customer success assets and playbooks and help drive customer references and case studies

**Your Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of work experience in customer success, presales or management consulting
* **Prior experience with Enterprise performance management (EPM), Enterprise Planning \& Analytics is a must**
* **Highly preferable to have experience in Anaplan; If not any of the relevant EPM / Planning tools such as Oracle EPM, SAP IBP / SAC, OneStream, Kinaxis, O9 etc.**
* Bachelor's degree, with focus on business, finance, marketing, operations, supply chain. CA/MBA a plus.
* Excellent communication skills with an ability to interact with C suite and other stakeholders in a consultative setting
* Familiarity with value selling and ability to do discovery with customers
* Experience understanding, translating, and optimizing client processes is a plus
* Subject matter expertise in planning and modelling with specialisation in either Supply Chain, Finance or Sales is a plus

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren't just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it's how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!



We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.


**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**



It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.



Anaplan does not:


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.


All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

At Greenway Health, we are committed to an inclusive environment and a culture of belonging as we pursue our purpose of healthier communities, successful providers, and empowered patients. We are united in our goal to build the future of healthcare technology. Join us.


The AI Architect defines and guides scalable, maintainable, AI\-enabled product architecture for modern product delivery and legacy modernization. This role translates product goals, customer commitments, engineering constraints, and modernization needs into practical architecture, service models, integration patterns, technical standards, and reusable solution accelerators. The role is expected to use AI tools to improve architecture discovery, documentation, design comparison, codebase understanding, modernization planning, and engineering enablement while maintaining accountability for technical decisions.

* Clear architecture direction for new product features, modernization, cloud adoption, integrations, and scalable product capabilities.


* Reduced technical debt and increased maintainability through service modeling, architecture standards, reusable patterns, and modernization roadmaps.


* Improved engineering productivity through AI\-assisted architecture documentation, codebase analysis, design accelerators, and internal architecture bots.


* Stronger alignment among product, engineering, QA, DevOps, data, and leadership stakeholders around feasible and sustainable technical solutions.

* Lead product architecture for new capabilities, modernization initiatives, service decomposition, API strategies, integration patterns, data flows, cloud adoption, and non\-functional requirements.


* Use GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise/Team, and approved AI tools to accelerate codebase exploration, design option comparison, architecture documentation, sequence diagrams, ADR, risk analysis, and modernization planning.


* Develop and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical service models that support product initiatives, integration requirements, operational needs, and long\-term maintainability.


* Define architecture standards, design patterns, API guidelines, service boundaries, data handling patterns, observability expectations, and quality attributes for product teams.


* Analyze current\-state architecture, product performance, reliability, scalability, technical debt, integration constraints, and modernization opportunities.


* Partner with product management to translate business priorities and customer commitments into technically feasible roadmaps, implementation strategies, and release increments.


* Guide engineers and QA teams on design decisions, testability, service contracts, performance risks, backward compatibility, and modernization safety.


* Create proofs of concept to evaluate feasibility, desirability, viability, and operational impact of emerging technologies, cloud capabilities, AI\-enabled engineering accelerators, and internal bots.

* Mentor senior engineers and engineering managers in system design, service ownership, technical debt management, AI\-assisted architecture practices, and full\-cycle engineering standards.


* Document architecture decisions, diagrams, service catalogs, integration patterns, technical risks, and modernization roadmaps in formats usable by engineers and product stakeholders.


* Continuously review industry trends and internal product constraints to evolve architecture practices, technology direction, and AI\-enabled engineering adoption.


### **Education**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline is required; equivalent deep technical experience may be considered.


* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Architecture, or related discipline is preferred.


* Cloud, architecture, DevOps, data, or AI\-related certifications are preferred when supported by practical implementation experience.


### **Experience**


* Overall Experience of 14\+ years in software development and architecture.


* 8\+ years of software development, product engineering, architecture, or technical design experience.


* 5\+ years of senior technical leadership, architecture ownership, product modernization, service design, integration architecture, or platform engineering experience is preferred.


* Proven experience designing scalable, secure, maintainable, high\-performance product architectures for complex applications.


* Experience with legacy modernization, cloud services, distributed systems, API design, data architecture, technical debt management, and cross\-functional solutioning.


* Experience using AI tools for architecture analysis, documentation, codebase understanding, proof\-of\-concept acceleration, or engineering enablement is preferred.


### **Skills**


* Expert knowledge of software architecture, system design, service modeling, integration patterns, cloud\-native design, distributed systems, and non\-functional requirements.


* Strong understanding of full\-stack product engineering, databases, APIs, event\-driven systems, CI/CD, observability, performance, reliability, and security principles.


* Ability to use AI tools to analyze legacy systems, summarize codebase behavior, compare design alternatives, identify risks, draft documentation, and accelerate proof\-of\-concept work.


* Ability to create architecture decision records, diagrams, service catalogs, modernization roadmaps, technical standards, and reusable engineering patterns.


* Strong communication skills with the ability to align technical and non\-technical stakeholders around architecture decisions and trade\-offs.


### **Abilities**


* Influences across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, data, and leadership teams without relying only on formal authority.


* Balances long\-term architecture health with customer commitments and delivery constraints.


* Converts ambiguity into clear architecture direction, incremental modernization plans, and executable engineering guidance.


* Mentors teams toward full\-cycle ownership, reusable patterns, and accountable AI\-enabled engineering practices.


* Maintains practical governance that improves quality and speed rather than increasing unnecessary process overhead.


### **Tools and Technologies**

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Join OneAdvanced:

We are looking for a ServiceNow Administrator to own the day\-to\-day health, hygiene and administration of our ServiceNow instances, so that AI workflow capability can be built and deployed on foundations that behave predictably.


You will own access and configuration control, run family release upgrades, manage environments and releases, and keep platform performance, data quality and licence position under control. This role is the difference between a platform that scales and one that slowly becomes a maintenance problem — and it carries the authority to say no to changes that would take us in the wrong direction.


What You Will Do:
**Key responsibiliteis include, but not limited too:*** Administering users, groups, roles and ACLs, and maintaining a defensible access model across instances.
* Maintaining core platform configuration including assignment rules, notifications, SLAs, service catalogue and reporting.
* Supporting the planning and running ServiceNow family release upgrades end to end — skipped\-update review, regression testing, remediation planning and post\-upgrade verification.
* Supporting the management of environments and releases: update set or source control promotion, clone scheduling and clean\-up, and pre\-production data integrity.
* Monitoring platform performance and health — scheduled jobs, transaction and log analysis, system diagnostics — and acting before issues reach users.
* Supporting CMDB and data quality, including discovery data integrity and the accuracy of CI relationships used by workflow and AI capability.
* Managing the licence and subscription position, including entitlement usage tracking and flagging commercial risk.
* Building and maintaining reports, dashboards and Performance Analytics content for operational and leadership use.
* Operating and enforcing change control, and maintaining accurate platform documentation and configuration records.
* Providing second\-line platform support to the Workflow Development team and to internal users, and resolving issues to root cause.


What You Will Have:
**What you will have:**

* Minimum **2\-4years** of experience as a ServiceNow Administrator.
* Proven experience as a ServiceNow Administrator in a complex enterprise environment, with strong knowledge of platform configuration and governance.
* Strong understanding of users, groups, roles, ACLs, environments, releases and change control.
* Experience supporting ServiceNow family upgrades, including testing, remediation and post\-upgrade validation.
* Good understanding of platform health, performance, CMDB, Discovery and data quality.
* Experience with ServiceNow reporting, dashboards, Performance Analytics and licence management.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues to root cause and proactively identify platform risks.
* A disciplined approach to documentation, governance and configuration management, with the confidence to challenge changes that could compromise platform stability.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with an interest in automation and AI\-enabled workflows.


\#LI\-PB1

* **Life Insurance** \- 3x annual salary

Who We Are:

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector\-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.  

We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.  

OneAdvanced is one of the UK’s largest business software and services companies. Based in Birmingham (The Mailbox), operating across the UK, Ireland, India, and Australia.  

Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.  

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.  

Proud to be recognised in the Financial Times’ Best Employers 2026 list for the second\-year running, an independent and data led ranking based on employee feedback. Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.

title: Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Your role
  

Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today \- and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem\-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  

  

In this role, you’ll balance hands\-on delivery with long\-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  

Analyze and Solve, Diagnose complex issues across servers, networks, cloud environments and systems to identify root causes. Recommend solutions that balance technical feasibility, timelines and customer priorities. Test, refine and automate processes to improve reliability, efficiency and repeatability. Assess risks proactively and implement strategies to prevent disruptions
  

Design and Integrate, Plan end\-to\-end infrastructure solutions across platforms and technologies. Integrate systems in hybrid cloud and on\-prem environments to ensure seamless operation. Automate workflows and processes to streamline delivery and reduce errors. Document architectures and procedures for hand\-offs, knowledge sharing and operational continuity
  

  

Collaborate and Deliver, Coordinate cross\-functional teams including Architects, Project Managers and Technicians. Drive project delivery from initiation to completion with attention to quality and timelines. Communicate technical solutions clearly to customers and stakeholders. Build customer confidence by delivering tangible, high\-impact results, Grow and Advance, Expand technical expertise across cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems and emerging technologies, Earn certifications and qualifications while applying them on real projects, Pursue career paths toward Architect or Distinguished Engineer roles

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

In\-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System  
* 

  

**Preferred skills and experience**

* Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures
* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models
* Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems
Analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail  
* 

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. title: Regional Learning Manager, ATS
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon's Learning \& Development (L\&D) team within IN ATS Operations is seeking a highly experienced and results\-oriented Learning Manager to lead and scale strategic L\&D initiatives across our rapidly growing operations network. This is a pivotal role that sits at the intersection of talent strategy, learning innovation, and operational excellence — directly influencing how Amazon builds, develops, and retains world\-class talent at scale.  

  

The role will own end\-to\-end program management of high\-impact initiatives spanning the full L\&D value chain: from shaping the hiring strategy and building organizational capability (associates and managers) through programs, to driving content development, expanding centralized learning systems, and leading change management across the network. You will be the single\-threaded owner for programs such as Flex (ALFA), global learning benchmarks, and defect reduction — translating data into actionable learning interventions that move the needle on associate performance and operational quality.  

  

This role demands a leader who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level — someone who can present compelling L\&D narratives in Quarterly Business Reviews and Operational Planning forums to senior leadership, while simultaneously diving deep into data cuts to identify root causes and scope improvement opportunities. You will manage the L\&D budget with fiscal discipline, drive the expansion of learning technology infrastructure, and navigate the learning implications of externalization changes — all while maintaining focus on the associate experience.  

  

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of program management expertise, analytical horsepower, learning domain knowledge, and the ability to influence without authority across operations, HR, quality, and technology teams. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast with purpose, and are energized by the opportunity to build mechanisms that scale learning impact across one of the world's most complex fulfillment networks.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Hiring Strategy: Own the end\-to\-end L\&D hiring strategy, including workforce planning, talent pipeline development, and role\-specific competency frameworks. Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure timely and quality hiring aligned to business growth plans.  

ALFA Strategy: Evaluate and iterate on Flex Fulfillment Associate strategy — identify what is working, diagnose gaps, and drive continuous improvement through mechanism\-based interventions.  

Capability Building (GB \& BB): Design, launch, and scale capability building programs. Define success metrics, track certification throughput, and ensure programs are tied to operational improvement outcomes.  

Program Management: Own program management for new programs, global benchmarks. Drive cross\-functional alignment, establish milestones, manage risks, and report progress to senior leadership.  

QBR \& OP1: Prepare and present L\&D performance narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) and OP1 planning. Own the data story — translate learning metrics into business impact language that resonates with senior leaders.  

Defect Reduction: Lead defect reduction initiatives by generating data cuts that identify scope of improvement. Partner with operations and quality teams to prioritize high\-impact defect categories and design targeted learning interventions.  

Content Development: Own the end\-to\-end content development strategy and execution. Define content standards, manage the content creation pipeline, and ensure learning materials are current, engaging, and aligned to operational needs. Drive content effectiveness measurement and continuous improvement.  

Change Management: Lead change management initiatives related to learning programs and processes. Develop communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and adoption frameworks to ensure smooth rollout of new learning initiatives across the network.  

Central Learning Systems Expansion: Drive the expansion and optimization of centralized learning systems and technology infrastructure. Evaluate platform capabilities, manage vendor relationships, and ensure systems scale to meet growing organizational needs.  

Learning: Manage learning implications of ATS externalization changes. Assess impact on training requirements, develop transition learning plans, and ensure associates impacted by externalization are equipped with the right skills and knowledge.  

L\&D Cost and Budgeting: Own the L\&D budget and cost management process. Develop annual budgets, track spend against plan, identify cost optimization opportunities, and provide regular financial reporting to leadership.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience analyzing business metrics and training data to measure program effectiveness
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams
* Experience developing and implementing training programs
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience creating learning content and driving learning through a Learning Management System

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Assistant Manager / Manager – Brand Partnerships & Alliances
description:
Matrimony.com Limited is India’s first pure\-play consumer internet company to be listed, with BharatMatrimony recognized as the country’s largest and most trusted matrimony brand. The company offers matchmaking and marriage\-related services across websites, mobile platforms, apps, and over 130 company\-owned retail outlets. Its portfolio includes BharatMatrimony, EliteMatrimony, and CommunityMatrimony, serving diverse communities and customer segments. Matrimony.com is certified as a Great Place to Work®, reflecting its focus on employee well\-being and an inclusive workplace. Building on its leadership in matchmaking, the company is expanding into the $55 billion marriage services industry via WeddingBazaar and Mandap.com, with an ambition to become a billion\-dollar revenue organization.
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Brand Partnerships \& Alliances professional** 
 to support the development and management of a growing brand partnership ecosystem.
 



 The role will primarily focus on building a strong pipeline of prospective brand partners through structured market research, brand identification, decision\-maker mapping and outreach, while also managing the coordination, performance tracking and commercial follow\-up of existing partnerships.
 



 The candidate should be capable of independently identifying relevant brands and the right stakeholders, establishing initial contact and generating qualified meetings.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Brand Research \& Partnership Pipeline** 



* Research and identify potential brand partners across consumer\-facing categories such as Jewellery, Apparel, Consumer Electronics, Appliances, Travel, Beauty \& Grooming, Furniture, Lifestyle and other relevant sectors.
* Build and maintain category\-wise, city\-wise and state\-wise databases of prospective brands.
* Research brand profiles, geographical presence, store networks and partnership potential.
* Identify relevant decision\-makers across Partnerships, Alliances, Marketing, Business Development and senior management.



**2\. Brand Outreach \& Meeting Generation** 



* Independently reach out to prospective partners through LinkedIn, email, calls, corporate board lines, professional networks and referrals.
* Establish initial conversations with relevant brand stakeholders.
* Generate and schedule qualified meetings with decision\-makers.
* Undertake structured follow\-ups to move conversations forward.
* Maintain an active and measurable partnership pipeline.



**3\. Existing Brand \& Partner Management** 



* Coordinate periodic performance and relationship reviews with active brand partners.
* Track partnership performance, customer engagement and other agreed business metrics.
* Coordinate collection and consolidation of relevant partner data.
* Maintain action items from partner reviews and follow through until closure.
* Identify recurring issues or dependencies and escalate them appropriately.



**4\. Commercial \& Payment Coordination** 



* Coordinate with internal teams for partner\-related delivery and performance data.
* Support timely raising and submission of applicable invoices.
* Maintain brand\-wise trackers covering invoices, due dates, payments and outstanding amounts.
* Follow up with partners and internal Finance teams for reconciliation and closure.



**5\. Cross\-functional Coordination** 



* Work closely with Finance, Operations, Product, Marketing and other internal stakeholders.
* Ensure brand information, commercials, offers, locations and operational requirements are accurately maintained.
* Coordinate resolution of operational and partner\-related issues.
* Maintain organised records and documentation across partnerships.



**6\. MIS \& Reporting** 



* Maintain a comprehensive partnership dashboard covering the funnel from
 **Target Brand → Decision\-Maker → Outreach → Meeting → Partnership Status → Performance → Invoicing → Collections** 
 .
* Provide weekly updates on prospects, outreach, meetings and pending follow\-ups.
* Prepare periodic performance summaries for active partnerships.
* Maintain clear visibility on ownership, timelines and pending actions.


 Candidate Profile
 * Minimum
 **5 years of relevant professional experience** 
 , preferably in Brand Partnerships, Brand Alliances, Strategic Alliances, Partnerships, Key Account Management or related functions.
* Strong experience in independently researching brands and identifying relevant decision\-makers.
* Hands\-on experience using
 **LinkedIn and professional networks for corporate prospecting and stakeholder mapping** 
 .
* Comfortable with cold outreach, corporate calling and engaging senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing multiple external partners and coordinating with internal teams.
* Experience in
 **Retail, Jewellery, Apparel, Consumer Electronics, FMCG, E\-commerce, Travel, Lifestyle, Loyalty/Rewards or Gifting** 
 would be an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Management or a related discipline;
 **MBA/PGDM preferred but not mandatory** 
 .


 Key Skills
 
 Strong market research and prospecting skills, excellent communication and networking ability, relationship management, commercial understanding, structured follow\-up, stakeholder management, strong execution and closure orientation, and proficiency in
 **Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint and CRM/MIS tools** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should be
 **resourceful and network\-oriented** 
 , with the ability to independently identify opportunities, open doors with relevant stakeholders and take partnership conversations from prospecting through execution.

title: Team Leader - Freight Brokerage
description:
**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced and results\-driven Team Leader to lead Freight Brokerage operations and a team responsible for shipment coordination, carrier management, customer communication, load tracking, and exception resolution.
   

  

 The candidate should have strong experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain, customer service, or related operations, along with proven people\-management, stakeholder\-management, and operational leadership skills.
   

  

 The role involves driving team performance, ensuring service quality, managing escalations, developing team capability, and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Team \& People Leadership**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Freight Brokerage Specialists to achieve business and service objectives.
* Drive team performance through structured coaching, performance management, and targeted development plans.
* Identify capability gaps and implement training initiatives to strengthen operational expertise.
* Build a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and customer focus.
* Support onboarding and capability development of new team members.


**Freight Brokerage Operations**
* Oversee end\-to\-end load execution from pickup through delivery, ensuring service commitments are consistently met.
* Drive effective coordination across customers, carriers, drivers, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless shipment execution.
* Monitor load execution, shipment status, appointments, and potential service disruptions, ensuring proactive intervention.
* Oversee carrier coordination, load coverage, scheduling, and execution to maximize operational efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with SOPs, customer requirements, contractual obligations, and escalation protocols.


**Performance \& Business Management**
* Own and drive key operational KPIs, including productivity, service levels, on\-time performance, response time, quality, and load execution.
* Analyse performance trends, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to close performance gaps.
* Provide regular performance insights and business updates to management.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on efficiency, service quality, cost effectiveness, and customer experience.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to identify and eliminate recurring operational issues.


**Customer \& Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex customer and operational issues, driving timely resolution.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure customer expectations are translated into clear operational priorities and consistently delivered by the team.
* Manage critical service issues with a strong focus on customer experience, communication, and resolution.


**We Are Looking For**
* Proven experience in a Team Leader, Supervisor, or People Manager role.
* Willingness to work night shifts and weekends as required by business operations.
* Demonstrated experience managing teams against operational KPIs and service\-level targets.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and escalation\-management skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proven ability to analyse performance data, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage priorities in a fast\-paced operational environment.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities with good proficiency in MS Excel.
* Ability to coach, motivate, and develop team members.
* Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and operational quality.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience**
 Team Management / People Leadership within any of the below functions:
   

  

* Freight / Transportation Operations
* Trucking / Carrier Operations
* Dispatch / Load Coordination
* Transportation Planning \& Execution
* Shipment Tracking / Track \& Trace

description:

 Verantwortung für die globale Projektsteuerungsaktivität und Förderung einheitlicher Funktionsspezifikationen und gemeinsamer globaler Prozesse für die Projektimplementierung.  Die Stelle ermöglicht die Änderung von Arbeitsabläufen und Praktiken, sofern die Endergebnisse den Standards der Akzeptanz (Qualität, Umfang, Aktualität usw.) entsprechen.

* Nutzt vertiefte Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin sowie analytisches Denken und technische Erfahrung zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.

* Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).

Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

The IT Asset Manager is responsible for the daily and long\-term strategic management of software and technology\-related hardware within the organization. * Manage acquisition of assets from planning through deployment
* Report to senior management ITAM/life cycles and resolve conflicts
* Verify, enter, and adjust equipment IT asset management data in a variety of forms, schedules, and reports
* Track entire life\-cycle management for each asset in order to maintain warranty information, refresh date, and end of life data information
* Work directly with the administrator(s) to maintain 100 percent inventory accuracy
* Develop written plans, policies, and procedures to document processes to support the asset management lifecycle

* Develop and implement eWaste policies and procedures.

---------------------------------


* ServiceNow platform experience with a focus on ITAM, ITOM and Software Asset Management
* Specific experience evaluating, recommending and implementing infrastructure solutions
* Experience evaluating or implementing private cloud solutions, dynamic capacity provisioning, metering and chargeback and self\-service capability
* Experience in scoping, planning and managing complex and concurrent technical activities supported by a strong understanding of IT project management; demonstrated ability to manage scope, timeline, and budget; PMP certification a plus
* Experience with business requirements gathering and analysis
* Understanding of information processing principles and practices
* Strong foundation of experience leveraging technologies to build highly scalable, rapidly recoverable and efficiently provisioned platforms
* Experience developing business cases and negotiating with vendors

* Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; resourceful and capable of working in the abstract, with the ability to understand multiple facets of complex technologies
* Experience leading the deployment of complex solutions involving multiple vendor technologies
* Effective facilitator of technical decisions; comfortable with working through ambiguous initiatives to develop effective solutions
* Excellent written, presentation, and verbal communication skills with experience communicating complex, technical concepts to all levels
* Solid relationship management skills interacting horizontally and vertically across organizations
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high\-pressure environment
* Exceptional customer service orientation

  




**Physical Demands**
--------------------


* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
