title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
Senior Growth Manager
 
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Reports To:** 
 Business Head / Founder
 


 About Bazaar.in
 
 Bazaar.in helps brands, manufacturers, distributors and retailers liquidate surplus and slow\-moving inventory while offering consumers quality products at attractive prices.
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are seeking a hands\-on
 **Senior Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of the growth of Bazaar.in across sales, marketing and marketplace operations.
 



 The role will be responsible for
 **strategizing and executing initiatives that grow sellers, business buyers, consumers, GMV and revenue** 
 . The candidate will manage the complete growth funnel from identifying acquisition opportunities and onboarding sellers to driving customer acquisition, conversion, repeat purchases and marketplace performance.
 



 This is a cross\-functional role requiring the ability to move between
 **strategy and execution** 
 , identify growth opportunities from data, run experiments, coordinate teams and take accountability for measurable business outcomes.
 


 Seller Growth \& Acquisition
 * Build and execute strategies to acquire brands, manufacturers, distributors and retailers.
* Generate seller leads through outbound sales, digital campaigns, referrals, events and partnerships.
* Manage strategic negotiations and seller onboarding.
* Ensure KYC completion, catalogue activation, competitive pricing and inventory availability.
* Improve seller activation, retention and contribution to marketplace revenue.


 B2B Growth \& Business Development
 * Acquire retailers, resellers, corporate buyers, institutional buyers and bulk purchasers.
* Build and manage a qualified B2B sales pipeline.
* Match buyer requirements with relevant marketplace inventory.
* Develop partnerships and outbound campaigns for high\-value and category\-specific inventory.
* Negotiate commercial terms and manage strategic accounts.
* Increase bulk orders, repeat purchases and revenue from active business buyers.


 B2C Marketing \& Customer Growth
 * Develop and execute performance marketing, social media, SEO, content, influencer and partnership strategies.
* Plan campaigns around deals, categories, inventory and customer segments.
* Manage marketing budgets and improve CAC, ROAS and conversion rates.
* Increase qualified website traffic, new customers, first purchases, average order value and repeat purchases.
* Develop CRM, remarketing, loyalty and referral programmes.
* Identify and improve drop\-offs across product discovery, product pages, cart and checkout.


 Marketplace \& Revenue Growth
 * Take ownership of marketplace growth across supply, demand and conversion.
* Align seller inventory with customer demand.
* Drive
 **GMV, revenue, order volume, sell\-through and contribution margin** 
 .
* Improve merchandising, pricing, promotions and product visibility.
* Identify high\-growth categories, sellers, products and customer segments.
* Analyse sales, marketing, seller and customer data to identify growth opportunities.
* Design and execute growth experiments and measure their impact.
* Work with catalogue, operations, technology and finance teams to remove growth bottlenecks.



 The GMV, revenue, sell\-through and contribution\-margin responsibilities already form part of the existing role, so this broader growth framing is consistent with the original scope rather than creating an entirely different position.
 


 Growth Strategy \& Execution
 * Develop short\-term and long\-term growth plans for Bazaar.in.
* Translate company growth objectives into executable sales and marketing initiatives.
* Identify new acquisition channels, partnerships and revenue opportunities.
* Prioritise initiatives based on business impact, cost and scalability.
* Run growth experiments across seller acquisition, customer acquisition, conversion and retention.
* Track results and continuously optimise initiatives based on data.
* Maintain a clear growth pipeline covering initiatives, owners, timelines and expected outcomes.


 Team Leadership
 * Lead and manage sales and marketing team members.
* Set measurable targets across seller acquisition, B2B sales, customer growth, GMV and revenue.
* Establish CRM, reporting, forecasting and performance\-review processes.
* Coordinate closely with catalogue, operations, finance and technology teams.
* Create accountability for execution and achievement of growth targets.


 Key Performance Indicators
 * Qualified and activated sellers
* Seller activation and retention
* B2B pipeline value and conversion
* Active B2B buyers and repeat business
* New B2C customers acquired
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* ROAS
* Website traffic and conversion rate
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Repeat\-purchase rate
* Inventory sell\-through
* Order volume
* GMV
* Revenue
* Contribution margin
* Growth experiment performance
* Team target achievement



 These metrics are largely already present in the existing JD, including CAC, ROAS, traffic, conversion, AOV, repeat purchases, sell\-through, GMV and revenue.
 


 Candidate Profile
 * 3\-7 years of experience in e\-commerce, marketplaces, D2C, retail, sales, marketing or growth roles.
* At least 2\-3 years of experience managing sales, marketing or growth teams.
* Proven experience in driving customer acquisition, seller/vendor acquisition, business development or marketplace growth.
* Strong understanding of B2B sales cycles, digital marketing, CRM, conversion optimisation and marketplace economics.
* Ability to combine
 **strategic thinking with hands\-on execution** 
 .
* Strong commercial, negotiation, analytical and leadership skills.
* Comfortable working with growth metrics including CAC, ROAS, conversion, AOV, GMV and revenue.
* Proficiency in CRM systems, analytics tools, advertising platforms and Excel.
* Data\-driven, target\-oriented and comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment.


 What We Offer
 
**Ownership of the growth of Bazaar.in across sales, marketing and marketplace performance.** 




 The role provides direct exposure to company leadership and strategy, significant responsibility for business growth, fixed compensation with performance\-linked incentives, and career progression based on measurable business outcomes.
 



 The biggest change I would make compared with the current document is therefore
 **not rewriting the entire role** 
 , because the existing responsibilities are already very growth\-oriented. I would change the title to
 **Senior Growth Manager** 
 , rewrite the opening around
 **ownership of Bazaar.in's growth** 
 , and add the dedicated
 **Growth Strategy \& Execution** 
 section so candidates understand that this person is expected to
 *decide what should drive growth and then make it happen* 
 , rather than simply manage separate sales and marketing activities.

title: CustomerTech - MobileTech - IT Delivery - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Title:** 
**Manager II, IT Delivery**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology** 
 supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

* Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.


**The opportunity**
 The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross\-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project.
* Works closely with management to develop and implement staffing and operational plans. Participates in the development of short and long term department goals. Monitors and reports on service delivery metrics and overall performance.
* Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals.
* Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners.
* Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines.
* Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

title: Director, Delivery Success Support
description:
**About the Team**
 Customer Experience \& Integrity (CXI) is one of DoorDash's core operations teams. We ensure that when challenges arise in the last mile, there's always someone ready to make things right. Our team designs, manages, and operates DoorDash's global network of support centers, with the ultimate goal of delivering a consistently exceptional customer experience.
   

  

**About the Role**
 We're hiring a Director, Delivery Success to lead CXI's highest\-volume, highest\-impact operational function. Delivery Success handles all live delivery contacts across the Customer and Dasher experiences Solving problems in the moments that matter most for our Customers and Dashers!
   

  

 This is a role for someone who is a relentless customer advocate and thrives creating scalable solutions in a complex environment. You'll own a globally distributed team spanning internal and partner sites and build a tiered capability model that grows associates from customer delivery basics through full customer, Dasher and Merchant expertise. You will create the strategy and drive the operational rigor that keeps millions of deliveries on track every day.
   

  

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will...**
**Own the Strategy**
* Define and execute the operating model for Delivery Success as CXI's core live\-operations function, covering all delivery\-related contacts across Customers and Dashers.
* Build and own a tiered capability progression
* Design and implement a skill\-based pay progression framework tied to tier advancement and demonstrated capability.
* Lead annual and quarterly planning cycles for Delivery Success, partnering with WFM, Finance, and S\&O to drive quality, and align headcount, cost, and capacity to volume forecasts.
* Build the long\-term vision for how automation and BPO integration reduce Tier 1 volume while enabling internal teams to focus on higher\-complexity work.


**Drive Execution**
* Oversee daily operations across multiple internal and partner sites, ensuring performance standards, quality, and SLAs are consistently met.
* Partner with BPO teams to maintain high\-quality human interactions for contacts that require live support, driving network shape while also ensuring automation adoption for eligible contact types.
* Manage the operational pipeline through tiers of complexity, ensuring smooth progression, appropriate routing, and clear escalation paths to Edge Case Management.
* Build scalable playbooks, governance structures, and feedback mechanisms that allow the team to operate consistently across locations and time zones.
* Create and facilitate a high performance environment where site leads and functional managers drive and are accountable to performance targets with clear metrics, regular calibration, and direct feedback.


**Influence Across the Organization**
* Partner with Product, S\&O, and Finance to surface operational insights that drive upstream improvements in delivery reliability and contact reduction.
* Represent Delivery Success in cross\-functional forums, providing data\-driven input on staffing, automation readiness, and quality.
* Serve as the operational authority on live delivery support for senior CXI leadership.


**Lead a High\-Performing Team**
* Lead and develop senior operational leaders across the internal sites, fostering strong local culture and accountability at each site.
* Build bench strength and succession pipelines across the Delivery Success organization.
* Coach leaders through the complexity of managing large, multi\-tiered teams across geographies and time zones.
* Champion a high\-standards, high\-support culture \-\- one where people grow, performance is managed directly, and the bar stays high.


**We're Excited About You Because You Have...**
* Customer\-obsessed mindset with a bias toward resolution quality, not just throughput.
* 10\+ years of operations leadership experience, with significant time leading large\-scale, high\-volume customer or field support functions.
* Proven experience managing multi\-site, globally distributed teams including BPO partnerships across LATAM and/or APAC.
* Deep familiarity with support models, skill\-based progression, and workforce capability development.
* Strong WFM and capacity planning acumen, including experience managing cost\-per\-contact and headcount efficiency at scale.
* Track record of driving automation adoption within live\-operations environments without degrading quality.
* Exceptional people leadership skills, with a history of developing frontline and mid\-level leaders in high\-growth environments.
* Data\-fluent, with experience using operational metrics to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
* Experience developing and managing multi year operations transformation programs


**About DoorDash**
 At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
   

  

 DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Manager, Enterprise Partnership
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Razorpay Ads is building a commerce media and audience intelligence business powered by Razorpay’s transaction ecosystem. We are looking for a
 **Manager, Enterprise Partnership** 
 to build and scale our relationships with leading media agencies, digital agencies, agency trading teams, and their advertiser portfolios.
   

  

 This is a high\-ownership role at the intersection of
 **advertising, data, commerce, and fintech** 
 . You will be responsible for making Razorpay Ads a strategic partner for agencies — helping them leverage Razorpay’s audience intelligence and media capabilities to solve advertiser objectives across performance, customer acquisition, brand building, audience targeting and measurement.
   

  

 The role goes beyond selling individual campaigns. You will own agency relationships, develop advertiser pipelines within agency portfolios, unlock briefs and budgets, and build a repeatable agency\-led revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
**Agency Relationship \& Business Development**

**Advertiser \& Revenue Development**
* Identify high\-potential advertisers within agency portfolios and build a structured pipeline of briefs and opportunities.

* Convert agency relationships into active advertisers, repeat advertisers and scalable revenue opportunities.
* Own the sales cycle from prospecting and solutioning through proposal, commercial negotiation, campaign closure and renewal.
* Drive penetration across priority categories including BFSI, fintech, D2C, e\-commerce, travel, consumer internet, auto and other digitally intensive categories.
* Build quarterly and annual agency revenue plans and maintain strong visibility on pipeline, closures and forecasts.


**Consultative \& Solution Selling**
* Translate advertiser and agency briefs into solutions using Razorpay Ads’ media, audience and data capabilities.
* Position Razorpay’s transaction\-led audience intelligence as a differentiated alternative or complement to conventional digital targeting signals.
* Develop solutions spanning audience intelligence, transaction\-led targeting, onsite/offsite media, performance campaigns, brand campaigns and measurement.
* Build compelling narratives and proposals that connect Razorpay’s capabilities to measurable advertiser outcomes.
* Partner with agencies to create customized solutions rather than relying on standardized inventory\-led selling.


**Agency GTM**
* Build a structured GTM strategy for priority agency groups and their advertiser portfolios.
* Map agency stakeholders, key accounts, upcoming pitches, annual planning cycles and seasonal/festive opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for agency\-level partnerships, preferred partner programs, joint pitches and advertiser workshops.
* Develop repeatable playbooks for converting agency relationships into briefs, campaigns and recurring advertiser investments.
* Represent Razorpay Ads at relevant agency forums, industry conversations and advertiser engagements.


**Campaign Success \& Account Growth**

* Stay engaged beyond campaign closure to ensure strong advertiser and agency experience.
* Use campaign results and insights to drive renewals, upsells and larger annual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to expand successful campaigns across brands, categories and agency teams.
* Build case studies and proof points that can accelerate adoption across the wider agency ecosystem.


**Market Intelligence \& Product Feedback**
* Maintain a strong understanding of the Indian digital advertising ecosystem, agency structures, advertiser budgets and emerging media trends.
* Track competitive offerings across ad networks, commerce media, retail media, audience platforms and large digital publishers.
* Bring structured agency and advertiser feedback to Product, Strategy and Campaign teams.
* Help shape Razorpay Ads’ positioning, packaging, pricing and product roadmap based on market demand.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Success in this role will be measured primarily through:
   

  

**Agency penetration:** 
 Depth and quality of relationships across priority agencies and senior agency stakeholders.
   

  

**Active advertisers:** 
 Number of advertisers activated through the agency ecosystem.
   

  

**Quality advertisers:** 
 Ability to acquire strategic advertisers with meaningful and scalable budget potential.
   

  

**Advertiser retention:** 
 Repeat campaigns and continued investment from activated advertisers.
   

  

**Pipeline creation:** 
 Strength and quality of advertiser briefs and qualified opportunities generated through agencies.
   

  

**Revenue:** 
 Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue objectives.
   

  

**Strategic relationships:** 
 Ability to convert transactional agency relationships into long\-term partnerships.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* 5–8 years of experience in agency sales, digital advertising, media sales, adtech, commerce media, publisher sales or related businesses.
* Strong existing relationships across media agencies, digital agencies and/or performance agencies in India.
* Demonstrated experience selling digital advertising solutions through agencies and influencing advertiser budgets.
* Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem including Meta, Google, programmatic, publisher media, performance marketing and brand advertising.
* Ability to engage comfortably with stakeholders ranging from agency planners and account leads to Business Heads, Managing Partners and CXOs.
* Strong consultative selling and solutioning capabilities — able to start with a client problem rather than an inventory proposition.
* Strong commercial orientation with experience owning pipelines, negotiations and revenue targets.
* Good understanding of advertising metrics including CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency and brand/measurement metrics.
* Ability to interpret campaign performance and convert results into a compelling growth narrative.
* Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
* High ownership, bias for action and comfort operating in an early\-stage business where GTM playbooks are still being built.


**Strong Plus**
* Experience working at an ad network, large digital publisher, commerce/retail media network, DSP, adtech platform or agency partnership function.
* Existing relationships across leading agency networks and independent digital agencies.
* Experience selling to BFSI, fintech, D2C, e\-commerce or consumer internet advertisers.
* Experience selling both performance and branding solutions.
* Exposure to first\-party data, audience intelligence, CDPs, clean rooms, retail/commerce media or transaction\-led advertising.
* Experience building a new agency channel or GTM motion from an early stage.


**The Person We’d Like to Hire**
 We are looking for someone who is
 **well\-networked but not dependent on their network; commercially aggressive but consultative in approach; comfortable selling what exists today while helping shape what needs to be built tomorrow** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate understands how agencies operate, knows how budgets and briefs move through the ecosystem, can open senior\-level conversations, and has the persistence and strategic thinking required to turn those relationships into a sustainable revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.

title: FDE Lead
description:
**FDE Lead – Forward Deployed Engineering** 




**About GreyLabs AI** 




 GreyLabs AI is building the voice operating system for India’s BFSI ecosystem. Our Agentic Voice AI platform helps banks, insurers, NBFCs, and fintechs automate and humanize millions of customer conversations across sales, collections, customer service, and compliance in multiple Indian languages.
 



 In under two years, we’ve scaled to
 **75\+ BFSI enterprise clients** 
 including RBL Bank, AU Small Finance Bank, IDFC FIRST Bank, SBI Life Insurance, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, and Motilal Oswal Financial Services, processing hundreds of millions of conversations. We recently raised
 **₹85 Crores in Series A funding** 
 led by Elevation Capital and Z47\.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We’re hiring an
 **FDE Lead** 
 to own strategic enterprise deployments and help shape the forward deployment function at GreyLabs AI.
 



 This is a
 **player\-coach role** 
 where you’ll lead complex customer engagements, act as the senior technical point of contact for strategic accounts, and mentor FDEs on technical execution and customer management.
 



 You’ll work closely with
 **banking ops leaders, CTO offices, product heads, Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Success** 
 to drive deployments from solution design through go\-live and production.
 



 The role demands
 **strong technical depth, customer ownership, mentoring ability, and the commercial instinct** 
 to understand what enterprise customers actually need and translate that into scalable solutions.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




**Own Strategic Enterprise Accounts** 



* Take end\-to\-end technical ownership of
 **high\-value, strategic, and complex enterprise accounts** 
 .
* Act as the senior technical point of contact for key customers across banks, insurers, NBFCs, and fintechs.
* Lead architecture and integration discussions, technical workshops, solution reviews, and executive\-level customer conversations.
* Build strong relationships with CTO offices, engineering teams, business heads, operations leaders, and product stakeholders.
* Understand customer business problems and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Drive complex deployments from requirement discovery through integration, go\-live, and production stabilization.
* Participate in pre\-sales conversations where technical complexity, integrations, or enterprise requirements warrant senior involvement.
* Own customer escalations and drive them to resolution while maintaining trust and long\-term relationships.



**Mentor and Enable FDEs** 



* Mentor FDEs on technical problem\-solving, customer communication, solution design, and deployment execution.
* Review solution approaches, architecture decisions, and integration designs before implementation or go\-live.
* Coach FDEs through complex customer situations and technical escalations.
* Share learnings from strategic accounts to improve how the broader FDE team approaches similar deployments.
* Raise the technical and execution standards across the FDE function without becoming a bottleneck for the team.



**Systematize What Works** 



* Reduce time\-to\-go\-live across the portfolio by identifying recurring friction points in every implementation and fixing the root cause \- not just the instance.
* Build reusable assets that make the team faster without cutting corners: integration playbooks, reference architectures, implementation templates, internal tooling.
* Establish clear delivery standards, milestones, review mechanisms, and escalation criteria.
* Identify patterns across strategic accounts and turn them into repeatable deployment practices.



**Close the Loop with Tech** 



* Turn field patterns into product input. Individual FDEs surface insights; you make sure those insights are prioritized, structured, and acted on.
* Identify where platform gaps are slowing deployments and advocate for fixes that improve every future deployment, not just the current one.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to influence platform improvements based on real customer needs.



**Stay Technical When It Matters** 



* Review customer integrations before they go live, weigh in on architectural decisions where the stakes are high, and write code when the situation genuinely calls for it.
* Be the person who can read a production issue, understand what broke and why, and make a judgment call \- not just escalate it.
* Stay hands\-on with APIs, integrations, data flows, workflows, and production troubleshooting.



**What We’re Looking For** 




**Must\-Haves** 



* **5\-8 years of experience** 
 in technical roles, with a meaningful portion in customer\-facing delivery \- forward deployment, solutions engineering, implementation leadership, or technical consulting.
* Experience owning
 **complex enterprise accounts and technical deployments** 
 end\-to\-end.
* Strong Python skills and hands\-on experience with system integration: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication patterns, data pipelines \- you can review an integration design and spot the problem before it reaches production.
* Comfortable in front of enterprise stakeholders at multiple levels \- from engineering teams to business ops leads \- and experienced enough to know that what the customer asks for and what they need are often different things.
* Track record of improving delivery: reduced onboarding timelines, reusable frameworks, or repeatable processes you built that made a team faster, not just a single engagement better.
* Experience
 **mentoring technical ICs/FDEs** 
 and helping them develop their technical and customer\-facing capabilities.
* Strong ownership mindset \- you hold yourself accountable for customer outcomes across strategic accounts, not just individual tasks.



**Strong Signals** 



* You’ve led complex FDE, implementation engineering, solutions, or customer engineering engagements \- ideally at a SaaS company deploying into enterprise environments with real integration complexity.
* You’ve been the
 **senior technical owner for strategic enterprise accounts** 
 , managing ambiguity and driving outcomes across multiple stakeholders.
* You’ve been the senior technical voice in a customer escalation, held the relationship, resolved the issue, and come out with more trust than you went in with.
* You’ve built something field\-specific \- a playbook, a reusable integration, an internal tool \- that measurably improved the team’s next five engagements.
* You’ve mentored engineers/FDEs and helped them independently handle increasingly complex technical and customer situations.
* You understand BFSI \- not necessarily as a domain expert, but enough to move quickly in environments where compliance, data sensitivity, and enterprise procurement timelines are real constraints.
* You find voice AI, conversational systems, and real\-time customer interaction infrastructure genuinely interesting \- not just a category you’ve landed in.



**Why GreyLabs AI?** 



* Work at the intersection of
 **AI, voice, and enterprise technology** 
 .
* Own high\-impact customer deployments from solutioning to production.
* Work across
 **Engineering, Product, Solutions, Sales, and Customer Success** 
 .
* Build scalable systems rather than simply solving individual customer problems.
* Work with
 **75\+ BFSI enterprise clients** 
 and production AI systems operating at significant scale.



  





*We’re committed to creating a fair, respectful, and inclusive workplace. From hiring to growth opportunities, our decisions are based on merit, skills, and potential, never on gender, identity, background, or any other personal characteristic. Talent has no labels here, and everyone is welcome to grow and thrive with us.*

title: Key Account Manager - VIP Accounts

 While we go ahead and keep dominating the Web3 world, we would like to HODL you on our team! Join our team of passionate innovators who are breaking barriers and building the future of Web3\. Together, we will make the complex simple, the inaccessible accessible, and the impossible possible. Boost your innovation to an ALL TIME HIGH with us!
   

  

**About The Role**
 This isn’t a typical Sales role.
   

  

 You will work on initiatives that genuinely transform how finance works in India, a type of work few roles offer.
   

  

 Build and nurture relationships with VIP customers actively trading options on CoinDCX. Engage users through calls and personalised communications, sharing updates on new listings, product launches, market developments and trading features to drive engagement, retention and satisfaction.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Drive VIP Trader Engagement: Build and own relationships with high\-value Options Traders through personalised engagement, delivering timely updates on options products, listings and market opportunities.

* Own Trading Growth \& Retention: Monitor trading activity and volumes, design targeted interventions to reactivate traders and deliver sustained trading engagement.
* Deliver Market \& Product Insights: Build trader trust by sharing actionable insights on options strategies, volatility, market trends, margin and product developments.
* Drive Trader VoC: Own the feedback loop with active traders and collaborate with Product, Research and Operations to design and deliver a superior options trading experience.


**You’ll Excel in This Role If You**
* Think like a trader: Stay curious about markets, options, volatility and trading behaviour.
* Learn fast, execute faster: Absorb new concepts quickly and turn learning into action.
* Think analytically: Use data to identify patterns, opportunities and trader behaviour.
* Own the outcome: Take end\-to\-end ownership of tasks and follow through with minimal hand\-holding.
* Have a bias for action: Move quickly, experiment, and iterate based on results.
* Communicate with clarity: Present insights and ideas in a simple, structured and actionable way.
* Stay customer\-obsessed: Understand the needs of options traders and continuously look for ways to improve their experience.


**You’ll Know You’re Winning When**
* Improved user retention: Contributed to initiatives that improve retention and reactivation of active Options Traders.
* Increased trading volumes: Delivered measurable growth in options trading activity and user volumes within the assigned cohort.
* Improved trader engagement: Built and executed targeted initiatives to increase engagement among high\-value Options Traders.
* Delivered actionable insights: Generated data\-backed insights on trader behaviour, churn, and product adoption to support growth initiatives.


**Why This Role Matters \& What’s In It For You**
* Build from the ground up : Be part of the first major experiment focused on VIP Options as a product.
* Own \& lead : Get meaningful ownership to shape initiatives, experiment with new ideas and drive outcomes.
* High\-impact exposure : Work closely with Options Traders, Product, Research and business teams to understand and build for a fast\-evolving market.
* Make your mark : Your work can directly influence how VIP Team builds and scales its Options business.


**Hiring Process**
 Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
   

  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem\-solving
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A take\-home task or live problem\-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* Culture \& Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best


**Where We Work**
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
   

  

 With this belief, we operate as a work\-from\-office organisation. This role is based out of our Mumbai office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You**
 We believe great people deserve great experiences.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi\-weekly learning and growth opportunities


**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
 If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high\-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
   

  

 Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

This leadership position is responsible for converting MIS into actionable insights, running governance cadences, securing action closure, and improving service, customer, and business outcomes. The role reports directly to the
 **Head CX** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design a common governance framework covering partner segmentation, KPIs, SLAs, review frequency, escalation paths, and decision rights.
* Create differentiated engagement models based on partner size, criticality, performance, geography, and customer impact.
* Maintain a central partner repository including scope, contracts, locations, contacts, SLAs, scorecards, review history, and open actions.
* Own a single source of truth for partner MIS; ensure data accuracy, consistency, validation, and on\-time publication.
* Build automated dashboards for volumes, TAT, SLA, ageing, quality, productivity, cost, customer experience, escalations, and action closure.
* Publish daily, weekly, and monthly reports with trends, root causes, risks, exceptions, and management actions using Advanced Excel and Power BI/Tableau.
* Partner with Data and Technology teams to automate extraction, alerts, and scorecards, reducing manual reporting.
* Establish and run operational huddles, weekly reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly business reviews with defined agendas and participants.
* Prepare fact\-based review packs covering performance trends, customer feedback, risks, decisions, and improvement actions.
* Document actions with accountable owners, timelines, and outcomes; maintain rigorous follow\-through and escalation until closure.
* Define partner\-specific scorecards aligned to business commitments and customer expectations.
* Identify performance deviations early and initiate recovery plans before they affect customers or commercial relationships.
* Benchmark partners and recommend load allocation, incentives, penalties, probation, capability building, or exit based on sustained results.
* Govern partner categories including sales partners, service centres, logistics partners, and contact\-centre partners with tailored KPIs and recovery plans.
* Convert dashboards, reviews, audits, and VOC into corrective and preventive action plans with clear owners, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.
* Track actions centrally, escalate overdue or recurring gaps, and validate effectiveness through operating data and customer outcomes.
* Embed reporting, SOP, system, SLA, and governance requirements during partner onboarding and expansion.
* Identify partner capability and training needs; coordinate targeted interventions and measure post\-training improvement.
* Build and lead the Partner Success Office; align Sales, Service, Logistics, Contact Centre, Quality, Finance, Data, and Technology teams.
* Present consolidated partner performance, risks, and recommendations to the CSOO and leadership team.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Analytics or related discipline; MBA preferred. Certifications in Project Management, Lean Six Sigma, Business Analytics, or Power BI are advantageous.
* Experience: 10\-14 years in Partner Success, Partner Operations, Performance Management, Service Operations, Customer Experience, or Business Operations; with 4\+ years in leadership roles.
* Leadership: Experience managing high\-volume, multi\-location, SLA\-driven partner ecosystems and senior partner stakeholders; leading cross\-functional teams and reporting to senior leadership.
* Technical Expertise: Partner governance and relationship management; KPI/SLA design; MIS automation; Advanced Excel; Power BI or Tableau; working knowledge of SQL; performance scorecards; WBR/MBR/QBR management; RCA and CAPA; NPS/CSAT analytics.
* Soft Skills: Strategic, analytical, disciplined in action closure, strong executive communication, negotiation, stakeholder influence, and business/commercial acumen.


 Why Consider this Opportunity?
   

  

* Lead the central governance and performance management function for a large, complex partner ecosystem impacting millions of customers.
* Drive measurable improvements in SLA, TAT, quality, productivity, NPS/CSAT, and partner performance scores.
* Shape and embed data\-driven partner governance frameworks and automated reporting tools with high stakeholder visibility.
* Collaborate across Sales, Service, Logistics, Contact Centre, Quality, Finance, Data, and Technology teams to influence business outcomes.
* Operate at the intersection of customer experience and operational excellence within a fast\-growing technology\-enabled service platform.

title: Control Manager - Program - Controls Room - Program Management & Governance Vice President
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

The Controls Room Team within Control Management works collaboratively with other control disciplines and oversees existing control functions as well as the development of new control functions and protocols. The team's objective is to empower the three lines of defense with risk\-based information to manage their control environment. We achieve this by collecting, analyzing, and monitoring firmwide risk\-based intelligence across all lines of business and corporate functions. As a Control Manager Program Vice President, you will be a key member of the team, leading cross\-functional delivery for firmwide programs that impact Control Management.


As a Control Manager Program Vice President within the Controls Room organization, you will translate enterprise requirements into executable project strategies, integrated roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. You will serve as a senior delivery and governance leader, aligning stakeholders across lines of business, product, and technology; proactively identifying and mitigating delivery, operational, and control risks; and driving disciplined execution against milestones, quality standards, and service\-level agreements.


You will also own User Acceptance Testing governance for in\-scope programs by establishing the UAT strategy, readiness standards, entry and exit criteria, and consolidated reporting. Working across business and technology teams, you will ensure end\-to\-end testing is appropriately planned, staffed, and executed, and that UAT scope, defects, and results remain aligned with program objectives and control effectiveness outcomes. Join our collaborative, high\-impact team and help strengthen how Control Management delivers complex firmwide change.

**Job responsibilities**

* Lead multiple concurrent firmwide application development projects end\-to\-end, ensuring roadmap creation and delivery predictability, stakeholder alignment, and execution against commitments, milestones, and SLAs

* Own executive\-level scorecards and reporting (delivery progress, SLA adherence, testing progress, defect trends, dependency tracking), driving transparency and continuous improvement

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred (or equivalent experience)

title: Tendering Manager – EHV Substations
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day (Tendering Manager – HV/EHV AIS \& GIS Substation Projects)  

As the Tendering Manager – HV/EHV AIS \& GIS Substation Projects, you will lead the end\-to\-end tendering and bid management activities for High Voltage (HV) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) substation projects, transmission and distribution infrastructure, EPC packages, and related power system solutions. You will be responsible for identifying business opportunities, developing winning bid strategies, managing techno\-commercial proposals, and ensuring competitive positioning across utility and private sector markets.  

In this leadership role, you will collaborate closely with engineering, procurement, project management, finance, legal, and supply chain teams to deliver high\-quality and profitable bids. You will engage with customers, utilities, consultants, and EPC partners while leveraging market intelligence, risk assessment, and pricing strategies to maximize business success. We are looking for an experienced tendering professional with deep expertise in AIS/GIS substations, power infrastructure projects, and business acquisition who can combine technical knowledge, commercial acumen, and market insight to drive sustainable growth and successful project acquisitions.  

How You'll Make an Impact* Drive business growth by identifying and evaluating tender opportunities across HV/EHV AIS \& GIS substations, transmission lines, switchyards, EPC projects, and power infrastructure developments.

* Monitor utility tenders, government procurement portals, private sector RFQs, and emerging market opportunities to support strategic business expansion.

* Lead bid/no\-bid evaluations by assessing project viability, competitive landscape, risk profiles, customer requirements, and organizational capabilities.

* Build and strengthen relationships with utilities, consultants, EPC partners, renewable developers, industrial customers, and key industry stakeholders.

* Lead the complete tendering lifecycle from opportunity identification through bid submission and contract award.

* Review tender documents, technical specifications, BOQs, drawings, contractual conditions, and commercial requirements to ensure comprehensive bid compliance.

* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including engineering, procurement, finance, legal, projects, and supply chain functions for successful bid preparation.

* Develop and submit technical proposals, commercial offers, prequalification documents, and supporting credentials in line with customer requirements.

* Conduct detailed techno\-commercial assessments, evaluating project scope, engineering solutions, execution methodologies, delivery schedules, and resource requirements.

* Identify project risks, commercial exposures, contractual deviations, and mitigation strategies to protect business interests.

* Prepare management approval notes, bid strategy documents, and executive summaries to support informed decision\-making.

* Develop competitive project costing models, pricing strategies, and profitability assessments while maintaining strong win probability.

* Perform market intelligence studies, competitor benchmarking, pricing analysis, and commodity trend assessments to strengthen bid competitiveness.

* Coordinate with vendors, OEMs, and suppliers to obtain optimized quotations, technical inputs, and commercial support.

* Prepare project cash\-flow analyses, margin evaluations, and business case assessments to support commercial decision\-making.

* Analyze transmission, distribution, renewable integration, AIS/GIS technology, and utility investment trends to support strategic growth initiatives.

* Maintain bid databases, pricing benchmarks, and competitive intelligence repositories to enhance future tendering effectiveness.

* Conduct customer meetings, technical discussions, pre\-bid clarifications, and tender negotiations to position Siemens Energy as a preferred partner.

* Participate in site visits for scope validation, feasibility assessment, logistics evaluation, constructability reviews, and risk identification.

* Review contractual terms and conditions, identify commercial and contractual risks, and recommend negotiation strategies and risk mitigation measures.

* Support post\-tender activities including customer clarifications, techno\-commercial discussions, contract finalization, and project handover to execution teams.

* Drive lessons learned and post\-bid reviews to continuously improve bid quality, competitiveness, and business acquisition success rates.

  

What You Bring* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (B.E./B.Tech).

* MBA in Marketing, Operations, Finance, or a related discipline is preferred.

* 12\-20 years of professional experience in tendering, estimation, proposal engineering, business acquisition, or bid management within the power sector.

* Minimum 8\-10 years of experience specifically focused on HV/EHV AIS and GIS substation projects.

* Strong expertise in AIS substations up to 765 kV and GIS substations up to 400 kV/765 kV.

* Deep understanding of transmission line projects, switchyards, EPC contracting, and power system infrastructure projects.

* Strong knowledge of protection and control systems, power transformers, reactors, HV switchgear, GIS equipment, SCADA, SAS, and communication systems.

* Proven experience managing tenders for utility customers including PGCIL, State Utilities, SEBs, DISCOMs, Railways, Metro projects, and other government entities.

* Demonstrated experience in bidding for private sector customers including industrial facilities, renewable energy developers, data centers, oil \& gas companies, and commercial infrastructure projects.

* Strong understanding of utility tendering procedures, contractual frameworks, project execution models, and regulatory requirements.

* Expertise in project costing, pricing strategy development, margin optimization, and financial risk assessment.

* Experience conducting competitor analysis, market intelligence studies, benchmark assessments, and business opportunity evaluations.

* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance competitiveness, profitability, and project execution risks.

* Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders across all organizational levels.

* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem\-solving skills with a customer\-centric approach.

* Proven experience working within cross\-functional, multicultural, and matrix organizations.

* Professional proficiency in English with excellent verbal, written, presentation, and business communication skills.

* Willingness to travel as required for customer meetings, site assessments, bid discussions, and business development activities.

title: Customer Relationship Manager
description:
**About JUSTO**
 Established in August 2019, JUSTO is a dynamic real estate solutions company driving innovation and growth. With a robust team of over 500 professionals, we empower developers to transform their vision into reality. Our tailored strategies maximize value for both developers and end\-users. Our proven track record includes delivering over 9,000 units, generating sales exceeding Rs. 6,000 crores. Currently executing projects worth Rs. 3,500 crores, with a promising pipeline of Rs. 17,000 crores, we’re rapidly expanding our footprint across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Pune, Bhubaneswar, Kolhapur, Aurangabad, and Nashik. Our approach is rooted in three core principles: providing expert Advice, we help Create innovative products, and Nurture long\-term partnerships. This, combined with our unique blend of technology and personalized service, positions JUSTO as a leading offline\-to\-online real estate platform.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Asst Manager / Manager
   

  

**Job Role:** 
 CRM
   

  

**Location:** 
 Pune (All Areas)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 Minimum 2\-6 years
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 CRM Head
   

  

**About The Role**
 The CRM (Customer Relationship Management) Manager will play a pivotal role in ensuring superior customer satisfaction through proactive engagement and seamless coordination. This role focuses on managing the complete customer lifecycle, from onboarding to post\-possession services, while maintaining high service quality standards and ensuring adherence to company policies and ensuring billing to be raised on time along with disbursements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer Engagement \& Relationship Management**
 Build and maintain strong relationships with the assigned customer base, ensuring consistent and personalized engagement throughout the customer lifecycle.
   

  

 Plan and execute "wow moments" at significant stages like onboarding, agreement signing, and handover of possession.
   

  

 Conduct welcome calls and emails within 24 hours of booking to provide booking\-related information and gather feedback.
   

  

**Customer Service \& Query Resolution**
 Resolve customer queries and issues promptly via calls, emails, and face\-to\-face meetings.
   

  

 Address concerns related to cancellations, transfers, allotments, and registration processes, ensuring 100% customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Assist customers with processes like loan documentation, flat allotments and deed transfers.
   

  

 Handle escalations and provide adequate resolutions to ensure customer retention.
   

  

**Operational Excellence**
 Manage all post\-booking customer services, from demand generation and cheque validation to documentation and possession.
   

  

 Ensure accurate and timely completion of customer documentation, including KYC, Builder\-Buyer Agreements, payment receipts, and possession letters.
   

  

 Format, issue, and manage customer documents like demand letters, credit notes, and transfer forms.
   

  

 Maintain organized records of all customer\-related files and documents.
   

  

**MIS Management \& Reporting**
 Maintain and update the MIS system with accurate customer data, tracking all critical touchpoints.
   

  

 Prepare company MIS, DSR (Daily Sales Report), and final work reports for leadership review.
   

  

 Analyze data to identify process improvements and enhance service delivery.
   

  

**Team Collaboration \& Coordination**
 Work closely with internal teams, including sales and other operational teams, to ensure a smooth customer experience.
   

  

 Coordinate with sales teams to ensure accurate and timely bookings and customer onboarding.
   

  

**Payment \& Possession Management**
 Monitor payment collection and ensure demands align with construction progress (As per the payment schedule)
   

  

 Facilitate possession processes, including final fit\-outs and handovers, while maintaining customer satisfaction.
   

  

**Required Skills And Qualifications**
**Age:** 
 Max upto 30 years
   

  

**Educational Qualifications:** 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or related fields.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2\+ years in CRM or sales operations from real estate.
   

  

**Industry Knowledge:** 
 Strong understanding of the real estate industry, including customer lifecycle, sales processes, possession procedures, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Competencies:** 
 Familiarity with real estate financing processes, such as home loans and documentation.
   

  

**Technical Proficiency:** 
 Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, CRM systems and relevant software for reporting and presentations.
   

  

**Preferred Candidate Profile**
* Team building skills
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
* Familiarity with local, state, and federal real estate laws and regulations (RERA).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines under pressure.


**Why Join Us?**
 Join our team for unparalleled opportunities to contribute to a rapidly expanding organization. As we scale, you'll have the chance to make a significant impact and grow alongside us. We offer a competitive salary along with attractive incentives to reward your hard work and dedication. We provide ample opportunities for professional growth and career advancement. With our supportive environment and ongoing training programs, you'll have the chance to expand your skills and reach new heights in your career.

 https://www.justo.co.in/careers.php

title: Manager, Identity Maturity Acceleration
description:
**Why SailPoint?** 




  
 



 Love what you do. And love where you do it. Smart people, fun culture, innovative work, beautiful offices — oh, and everyone’s really nice. That’s what people say about SailPoint. We’re known as the company where everyone wants to work, and we have the awards to prove it. If you’re passionate about outsmarting cybercriminals and working at a company where you can truly have an impact, we want you to join our team. 
 



  
 



 SailPoint empowers the largest, most complex organizations by putting identity at the Center of Security and IT.  Our 2,000\+ customers include global financial institutions, government entities, and pharmaceutical organizations and more.  
 



  
 



  
 



**About the role:** 




  
 



 SailPoint is the leading AI\-driven identity security platform delivering autonomous governance to secure the modern enterprise. We provide unified security across the human fabric (employees, contractors, partners) and the emerging agentic/non\-human fabric (autonomous AI agents, machine identities, service accounts). 
 



  
 



 Within SailPoint’s Identity Maturity Acceleration (IMA) organization, the Manager, Agentic Identity Acceleration is a high\-impact, client\-facing growth role designed for an ambitious, humble, and technically grounded professional ready to step into practice leadership. 
 



  
 



 In this customer\-facing role, you will partner with our elite Technical Advisors (TAs) to guide enterprise clients through modern identity governance, AI agent security, and maturity acceleration using the SailPoint Agentic Fabric and SailPoint Atlas. This role offers a clear path to develop your executive advisory presence, lead strategic client programs, and grow into a full\-scale practice leader. 
 



  
 



  
 



  
 



**What You Will Do** 




  
 



 Client Advisory \& Program Acceleration (60%) 
 



  
 


* Executive Partnership \& Steering Committees: Partner with client IAM leaders, CISOs, and enterprise stakeholders to run steering committees, track program milestones, and communicate business value across human and agentic identity programs.


* Support \& Amplify Technical Advisors: Work hand\-in\-hand with designated Technical Advisors on key enterprise accounts—handling engagement planning, stakeholder alignment, and operational health so the TA can lead technical architecture with CISOs and AI Officers.


* Maturity Framework Guidance: Help clients assess and progress along the Identity Maturity Acceleration (IMA) curve, moving from foundational governance (Horizons 1–2\) toward advanced, automated security (Horizons 4–5\).


* Engagement Health \& Scope Governance: Monitor delivery health, identify risks early, and coordinate with Delivery Partners and System Integrators to ensure engagements stay on track and deliver on contracted outcomes.



  
 


* GTM \& Scoping Collaboration: Work alongside Sales, Sales Engineering, and Agentic Technology Specialists (ATS) to assist in scoping Advisory and Delivery Assurance proposals.



  
 



 Practice Development \& Growth (40%) 
 



  
 


* Mentorship \& Team Coordination: Coordinate day\-to\-day engagement assignments, mentor junior team members, and foster a collaborative, high\-trust team culture.


* AI\-Augmented Operational Learning: Eagerly adopt and test internal AI accelerators (e.g., Harbor Pilot), automated workflows, and agentic tools to make practice reporting and status tracking faster and more efficient.


* Field Insights Feedback: Gather feedback and emerging use cases from client interactions to help Product and GTM teams refine our Agentic Fabric offerings.



  
 


* Continuous Personal Development: Actively seek coaching from senior leadership to expand your executive presence, C\-level communication, and commercial acumen.



  
 



  
 



**Who You Are (Qualifications \& Mindset)**



* Hungry, Humble \& Curious: You bring strong self\-awareness, low ego, and high intellectual curiosity. You love learning new technologies (especially AI and identity) and are eager to prove yourself in a leadership capacity.


* Experience Baseline: 5 –10\+ years of progressive experience in IAM/IGA, Cybersecurity consulting, Technical Account Management, or SaaS Professional Services.


* Technical \& Domain Foundation: Solid foundational knowledge of Identity Governance, access lifecycles (JML), cloud security, and an eager appetite to master Non\-Human Identities (NHI) and autonomous AI agent concepts.


* Consultative Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead structured client meetings, present project findings clearly, and navigate stakeholder expectations.


* Project \& Delivery Organization: Demonstrated experience managing multiple client projects, tracking deliverables, mitigating risks, and maintaining engagement momentum.


* Leadership Potential: Prior experience informally mentoring peers, leading project squads, or acting as a lead consultant, with a clear desire to grow into people management.



**Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.**




 SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  
   

  





 Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

title: Technical Account Manager (TAM)
description:
Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India
   

  

 As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will work closely with our customers, build relationships with them, help them achieve their technical goals, and overcome technical challenges.The Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as a trusted technical partner to customers, acting as the primary point of contact for technical guidance, system optimization, and issue coordination after implementation. * Maintain deep familiarity with each customer’s environment, priorities, and use cases55

Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast\-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.
