description:
Greetings from NAM Info Pvt Ltd,
 



  





*We have an opportunity for the position below. Please go through the job description. If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply and share your updated resume at praveen@nam\-info.com* 




  





**Role: Delivery Manager** 




**Work Location: Pune (Hinjewadi Phase 2\) — Local Pune Candidates Only** 




**Work Mode: Hybrid** 




**Client: Inferyx (Full\-time)** 




**Total Experience: 9\+ Yrs** 




  





**Interview Mode: 2 Virtual Rounds \+ 1 Face\-to\-Face Round** 




  





**About Inferyx** 




 Inferyx is a next\-generation Data Orchestration Platform enabling enterprises to build scalable Data Lakes using Medallion Architecture (
 *Bronze → Silver → Gold* 
 ) across various domains including BFSI, Telecom, Retail, Manufacturing, and Healthcare. Inferyx accelerates data engineering delivery through a low\-code orchestration engine, reducing data pipeline build times by up to 60% compared to traditional approaches.
 



  





 We are aggressively expanding our India footprint and looking for a seasoned Delivery Manager to take end\-to\-end ownership of our client delivery programs.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 As the senior delivery owner for Inferyx’s enterprise client accounts, you will inherit an active, operational engagement and serve as the single point of accountability for delivery health, stakeholder management, and client satisfaction. You will operate with high autonomy, manage technical complexity, and ensure delivery excellence—enabling our executive leadership to focus on nationwide growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Client Delivery Ownership** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the Inferyx data platform, including medallion architecture implementation, sprint governance, and Go\-Live milestones.
* Lead daily/fortnightly scrum calls, sprint reviews, and stakeholder reporting.
* Maintain delivery health by tracking sprint velocity, proactively managing risks, resolving blockers, and escalating only critical exceptions to executive leadership.
* Ensure all contractual SLAs, delivery milestones, and quality standards are consistently met or exceeded.
* Maintain and update the Client Delivery Runbook, RACI matrix, and issue logs, presenting monthly summaries to Inferyx leadership.



  





**2\. Stakeholder \& Relationship Management** 



* Act as the primary senior relationship manager between Inferyx and client teams (Project Managers, Architects, and Business Owners).
* Conduct fortnightly on\-site visits to client locations to participate in steering committees, executive reviews, and architecture sessions.
* Manage delivery escalations professionally, converting challenges into opportunities to strengthen client trust.
* Identify and cultivate internal client champions to advocate for Inferyx platform adoption and expansion across other business units.



  





**3\. Program Governance \& Reporting** 



* Drive structured program governance using weekly status reports, risk registers, RAID logs, and monthly steering dashboards.
* Maintain a transparent, metric\-driven single source of truth for delivery status that is executive\-ready at all times.
* Prepare and present monthly delivery review decks to Inferyx’s Head of Technology, COO, and CEO.
* Track key delivery KPIs, including sprint velocity, defect rates, deployment frequency, and Client NPS.
* Manage Production incidents, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implement sustainable action plans to minimize incident recurrence.
* Manage Change Requests (CRs) professionally—scoping, pricing, and negotiating without damaging client relationships.



  





**4\. Technical Collaboration \& Platform Adoption** 



* Partner with Inferyx engineering and pre\-sales teams to ensure the platform is deployed to its maximum capability at the client site.
* Identify expansion opportunities within client accounts for new business units, additional data domains, or advanced medallion layers.
* Participate in architecture reviews, data model walkthroughs, and pipeline design sessions, applying technical depth to ask the right questions.
* Translate client feedback into actionable insights for internal product teams to shape the Inferyx product roadmap.



  





**5\. Team Leadership \& Onboarding** 



* Successfully onboard into the engagement via a structured 4–6 week handover from the outgoing delivery lead.
* Mentor and manage junior delivery resources or Business Analysts assigned to the account.
* Establish and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for repeatable delivery processes.
* Contribute to Inferyx's overall delivery methodology through best practices, reusable frameworks, and lessons learned.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 




**Essential (Must Have)** 



* Experience: 9 to 13 years of total experience in technology delivery, program management, or client\-facing delivery roles within enterprise IT.
* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of Data platforms—Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, or Data Orchestration tools.
* Architecture: Practical understanding of Medallion Architecture, Lakehouse concepts, or multi\-layer data processing (
 *Bronze / Silver / Gold* 
 ).
* Agile Governance: Hands\-on experience leading Agile/Scrum delivery (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and velocity tracking).
* Location \& Mobility: Must be currently residing in Pune (or local to Pune) and willing to visit client sites in Hinjewadi Phase 2 on a fortnightly basis.
* Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent Project Management certification.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi; proven capability to navigate complex corporate structures and manage stakeholders up to the C\-suite level.



  





**Preferred (Good to Have)** 



* Exposure to cloud data platforms such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, GCP BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS.
* Experience working in a product startup or scale\-up environment, demonstrating adaptability in fast\-paced setups.
* Understanding of BFSI data domains (e.g., reconciliation, settlement, regulatory reporting) or Telecom data domains.
* Cloud certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Data Analytics, or GCP Professional Data Engineer.
* Track record of building delivery playbooks, SOPs, and scaling delivery processes from scratch.

title: Community Lead (Managed Office)
description:
**About Us**
 Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India’s leading premium flexible workspace operators \- GPTW certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025, Dec 2025 – Dec 2026\). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. Since its inception, WeWork India has expanded across 8 cities in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, with 76 operational centres spanning 8\.2 million square feet (as of December 2025\).
   

  

 WeWork India has played a significant role in the growth of the flexible workspace sector and contributed to the evolution of its products and services, providing customized and curated solutions for various office space needs.
   

  

 For more information, please visit our website.
   

  

**About Job**
 As a Lead for our Managed Offices, you will own the end\-to\-end client, operational and commercial experience for a portfolio of Managed Office clients. You will lead seamless onboarding and operational handovers, strengthen client and member relationships, drive workplace experience and engagement, identify revenue opportunities, and ensure operational, financial and compliance standards are met.
   

  

 This role works closely with Sales, Projects, Operations, Client Solutions, Finance, Community and Events teams, and provides leadership to the Community Manager / MO POD where applicable, ensuring consistent delivery and continuous improvement across the portfolio.
   

  

**Skills \& Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, business administration, marketing, operations, or a related field.
* 5–8\+ years of experience in hospitality, co\-working, managed offices, workplace experience, operations, account management or customer\-facing roles; experience leading teams or portfolios is preferred.
* Strong client management, stakeholder management and commercial acumen.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross\-functional projects, operational escalations and complex client requirements.
* Strong understanding of P\&L, billing, budgeting, revenue generation and business performance.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem\-solving abilities with attention to detail.
* Proficient in digital tools for ticketing, reporting, dashboards, communication and business reviews.
* A proactive, accountable and collaborative leader who can balance customer experience, operational excellence, people leadership and business outcomes. A passion for workplace experience, community.


**Responsibilities**
* Onboarding \& Transition Leadership
* Own the Managed Office onboarding and transition experience from pre\-move\-in through operational handover.
* Drive cross\-functional coordination with Sales, Projects and Operations to ensure a seamless client handover and readiness.
* Ensure 100% completion of the Building Opening Checklist within stipulated timelines.
* Coordinate with Operations and Client Solutions teams to identify, track and close post\-move\-in snags within agreed timelines, including closure of critical snags within 60 days.
* Use move\-in feedback and internal stakeholder feedback to improve onboarding and handover processes.
* Account Management \& Member Experience
* Own relationships with client SPOCs and key stakeholders, acting as the escalation point for Managed Office accounts.
* Drive exceptional day\-to\-day workplace experience while balancing member experience and facilities management.
* Plan and execute quarterly engagement activities for all Managed Office clients and measure outcomes through client/member feedback.
* Drive an average MO NPS of 75 or above across the portfolio.
* Conduct quarterly community and operations audits for Managed Offices and PCI, maintaining a minimum compliance score of 90%.
* Proactively identify service gaps, trends and opportunities to improve client satisfaction and retention.
* Operations, Compliance \& Service Delivery
* Ensure spaces remain operationally ready, well maintained and aligned to WeWork standards through structured reviews and audits.
* Own operational dashboards, ticketing, issue resolution, walkthroughs, audits and service reviews for the portfolio.
* Establish clear ownership and escalation mechanisms across Community, Operations, Projects, Finance and other internal teams.
* Ensure timely closure and communication of operational issues and client commitments.
* Drive standardisation and continuous improvement of operating processes, ROEs and SOPs.
* Revenue \& Commercial Management
* Own upsell and additional revenue opportunities across events, F\&B, community support, technology, parking, customisation and other services.
* Ensure Workplace Experience services are positioned and pitched to all relevant clients.
* Partner with Sales and internal teams to convert client needs intovalue\-added solutions and commercial opportunities.
* Own billing, P\&L and topline audit management for the Managed Office portfolio, including invoice review, budget finalisation and post\-sales P\&L management.
* Work in tandem with the BOB owner from the MO/GCC teams to ensure financial accuracy, visibility and performance.
* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
* Lead, coach and develop the MO Community / CM POD, including hiring, role design, performance management and growth planning for client\-billed headcount.
* Drive team engagement and wellbeing, with a focus on building a high\-performing and collaborative culture.
* Own team learning and development through LMS completion, endorsements, training and a quarterly L\&D calendar.
* Conduct quarterly IDP progress checks and reporting for the team.
* Build capability within the team to independently manage client relationships, workplace experience, events and operational delivery.
* Innovation, Workplace Experience \& Strategic Initiatives
* Drive continuous improvement through ROE/SOP 2\.0 and other process innovation initiatives.
* Create and develop an Event Management capability/wing to enable the team to drive events independently.
* Explore CXO/networking opportunities that strengthen client relationships and workplace experience.
* Develop PR\-as\-a\-service opportunities, including media time, interviews and podcasts, where relevant to clients and the business.
* Use client and operational insights to identify scalable solutions that improve experience and contribute to the bottom line.
* Communication, Reporting \& Stakeholder Management
* Provide structured portfolio updates covering client experience, operations, revenue, P\&L, risks, compliance and key actions.
* Maintain strong communication across Sales, Projects, Operations,
* Client Solutions, Finance, Community and Events teams.
* Present business reviews and insights to senior stakeholders and clients as required.
* Ensure timely escalation of risks, service issues and commercial opportunities.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 WeWork India is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees and members. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
   

  

 We expect all employees to embody our values and all aspects of employment including the decisions to hire and promote, are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.
   

  

 Our total rewards philosophy is aimed at providing compensation that is competitive, performance linked and helps us attract and retain the talent we need to drive our business forward and serve our members. As part of WeWork India, our commitment to you is that you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters collaboration, flexibility and inclusion.

title: Associate Director - Technical Account Management
description:
**About Hevo** 




 Hevo Data is a no\-code data pipeline platform that helps companies consolidate data from multiple sources for faster analytics. Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150\+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.
 



  





 Over 2,000 data teams in 45\+ countries use Hevo, including DoorDash, Foot Locker, Iceland Air and Shopify. We’re top\-rated in the G2 Data Pipeline category, backed by Sequoia Capital, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, and operate out of San Francisco and Bangalore.
 



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 Hevo’s customers are data engineers, analytics leaders, and platform teams who rely on us for critical data infrastructure. Customer Success here goes well beyond satisfaction surveys. The job is to help technical teams get real value from their pipelines, cut the time it takes to get to insight, and grow their data operations.
 



 We’re looking for a strong leader to build and run the CS function. You’ll own the full post\-sales journey (onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion) and be directly accountable for Net Revenue Retention and customer health across our global base.
 



  





**The Setup** 



* A growing team of TAMs, based primarily in Bangalore and Pune
* A product with 1000\+ customers but an evolving post\-sales playbook for 250\-300 accounts
* A customer base spanning SMB to enterprise across e\-commerce, fintech, medtech and B2B Software companies.
* Strong executive support and buy\-in for investing in Technical Account Management
* A chance to shape CS strategy at a company that’s defining the data pipeline category



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Build and Own the TAM Program** 



* Design and roll out Hevo\-specific TAM playbooks covering onboarding, adoption, health scoring, renewal, and expansion
* Segment the customer base (enterprise, mid\-market, self\-serve) and build the right engagement model for each
* Own net revenue retention, gross retention, and expansion metrics



**Drive Customer Outcomes** 



* Improve renewal rates and reduce churn by driving deeper product adoption and making sure customers see tangible results
* Work with Sales on cross\-sell and upsell opportunities, always leading with retention
* Build customer advocacy through NPS programs, case studies, and community engagement
* Grow lifetime value by catching risks early through health monitoring and having clear playbooks for when to step in



**Customer Lifecycle** 



* Map out the customer journey for Hevo’s technical buyers and end users
* Set up the right checkpoints across the lifecycle (usage data, satisfaction signals, support sentiment) and create standard responses for each stage
* Keep improving based on what the data and customer feedback tell you



**Lead and Grow the Team** 



* Hire and develop strong TAMs
* Put together an onboarding process that gets new hires productive fast
* Build a team culture where people are technically curious, care about customers, and take ownership of outcomes



**Measure What Matters** 



* Define and track operational metrics: time\-to\-value, adoption rates, health scores, NRR, GRR.
* Build dashboards and regular review cadences, and report key metrics to the executive team and board



**Cross\-Functional Work** 



* Work with Product to make sure customer insights feed into the roadmap
* Coordinate with Sales on ideal customer definition, handoff process, and expansion pipeline
* Team up with Marketing on customer campaigns, advocacy programs, and lifecycle comms
* Work with Finance on forecasting, renewal projections, and unit economics



**Invest in CS/TAM Technology** 



* Use AI and automation to make the program more efficient and scale the team’s impact without growing headcount at the same rate



  





**Who We’re Looking For** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 10\+ years of overall experience, and 5\+ years leading Technical Customer Success or Tech Account Mgmt teams in B2B SaaS, with experience building or scaling a technical CS/TAM function
* Experience with technical or developer\-facing products, ideally in data infrastructure, analytics, or related areas like ETL/ELT, data warehousing, observability, or DevOps
* Track record of owning and improving net revenue retention in a subscription / recurring\-revenue business
* Comfortable managing technical CSEs who spend their days working with data engineers and analysts
* Analytical and numbers\-driven. You make decisions based on data and you build the systems to track it
* Strong communication skills. Comfortable presenting to the board and working across functions to get things done



  





**Nice\-to\-Have** 



* Time spent at a modern data stack company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, or similar)
* Familiarity with usage\-based or consumption\-based pricing models
* Mix of technical (engineering, solutions) and business (CS, account management) experience
* Experience managing CSEs across multiple geographies or time zones



  





**Why Hevo** 



* We’re in a large, growing market (data integration is projected to hit $17B\+) and we’re one of the leaders
* Our customers actually like the product. Top\-rated on G2, with strong word\-of\-mouth growth
* Sequoia Capital\-backed with strong investor support
* CS is treated as a growth function here, not a cost center. You’ll have real ownership
* Low\-ego team with deep engineering and product roots

 eClerx is a global leader in productized services, bringing together people, technology and domain expertise to amplify business results. Since our inception in 2000, we've partnered with top companies across various industries, including financial services, telecommunications, retail, and high\-tech. At eClerx, we believe in nurturing talent and providing hands\-on experience.

title: Pune Account Manager
description:

As part of your responsibilities, you’ll oversee 0 to 2 existing customer accounts. Your focus will be on nurturing these relationships and expanding partnerships. Additionally, you’ll engage with 35 to 40 potential customers, introducing them to our offerings. After successfully converting prospects, you’ll have the chance to maintain those accounts and explore opportunities for upselling and cross selling our solutions. Additionally, you’ll benefit from mentorship provided by our award\-winning leadership team. Collaborating closely with our high\-performing sales professionals, SDRs, and partners, you’ll be on the path toward achieving ultimate success.
   

  

 Location: Pune, India
   

  

**What you will be focusing on as an Account Manager:**
* Execute on territory plans to deliver maximum revenue potential within a pool of broad, regionally focused accounts.
* Collaborative pre\-defined SE support based on region.

* You have outstanding organizational and communication skills (written and oral, negotiation and presentations skills).

* You have proven experience in acquiring new business.
* You thrive in high\-velocity situations and can think/act with a sense of urgency.

* You know how to collaborate and co\-sell internally across all supporting resources to maximize your effectiveness and advance the sales process (familiar with MEDDPIC).

* Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
* We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
* Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
* You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
* Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

title: Technical Customer Interface Manager
description:

title: Pune Account Manager
description:
**Your role at Dynatrace**
--------------------------

We are looking for a candidate to fill a newly created position as an Account Manager. In this role, you will drive sales growth through targeted acquisition efforts across various industry segments. It’s all about a “land and expand” approach amongst enterprise\-grade organizations. As part of your responsibilities, you’ll oversee 0 to 2 existing customer accounts. Your focus will be on nurturing these relationships and expanding partnerships. Additionally, you’ll engage with 35 to 40 potential customers, introducing them to our offerings. After successfully converting prospects, you’ll have the chance to maintain those accounts and explore opportunities for upselling and cross selling our solutions. Additionally, you’ll benefit from mentorship provided by our award\-winning leadership team. Collaborating closely with our high\-performing sales professionals, SDRs, and partners, you’ll be on the path toward achieving ultimate success.


Location: Pune, India


**What you will be focusing on as an Account Manager:**

* Execute on territory plans to deliver maximum revenue potential within a pool of broad, regionally focused accounts.
* Collaborative pre\-defined SE support based on region.
* 0\-2 customers, 35\-40 prospects, with 40 total accounts.
* Drive new logo customers, focusing on landing and expanding Dynatrace usage.
* Consult with Vice President and C\-level executives to develop and implement an effective enterprise\-wide strategy that maximizes the value delivered by Dynatrace; position Dynatrace relative to the competition.
* Generate velocity by establishing Dynatrace in new markets through product demonstrations, in\-market events and account specific initiatives.
* Develop a contact network within named accounts and channel partners to ensure Dynatrace can be sold broadly and effectively.
* Work closely with Dynatrace functional areas such as sales engineering, marketing, legal, finance and other lines of business to develop and execute a solution strategy to meet customer business needs.
* Ensure your customers’ implementations are wildly successful.

**What will help you succeed**

* You can manage sales cycles within complex organizations, while compressing decision cycles.
* You have outstanding organizational and communication skills (written and oral, negotiation and presentations skills).
* You are confident in building a diverse territory plan and have familiarity in leveraging a sales ecosystem.
* You have proven experience in acquiring new business.
* You thrive in high\-velocity situations and can think/act with a sense of urgency.

* Dynatrace is a leader in **unified observability** and **security** .
* We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
* Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
* You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with **Dynatrace Intelligence** —the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
* Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.
**Note to Recruiters and Agencies** : Thank you for your interest in Dynatrace. Please note that **we do not accept unsolicited agency resumes** —do not forward them via our website or directly to Dynatrace employees. Dynatrace will not pay fees for unsolicited resumes, and any resumes received this way will be considered the property of Dynatrace.

We offer best\-in\-class core rewards, including paid time off, financial security benefits, retirement savings plans, and health insurance. Beyond that, you’ll get other benefits and work\-life perks designed to make your ride with us even more rewarding.

Our Employee Assistance Program, powered by Telus Health, offers support for you and your family members.

Four company\-designated extra paid days off for you to recharge batteries.

Our hybrid working model and flexible working hours offer you the flexibility you need.

Use AI as your daily teammate to automate tasks and focus on what matters.

Company\-wide learning perks, designated team's learning days, and more.

A day of paid volunteer time to support a community or cause you care about.


#### **Regular team events**


We host Global Culture Parties, Family \& Friends at Work Day, Global Breakfasts, Green Weeks, Pride Month, and beyond!


#### **International vibe**


Most of our offices and teams are proudly multicultural. English is our shared language, but we embrace and learn from each other's cultures.


Rewards vary depending on your employment type. Some benefits and perks also differ by location — explore your city to see what’s available there.


**About Dynatrace**
-------------------


Dynatrace (NYSE: DT) is the leading AI\-powered observability and security platform. We're advancing observability for today's digital businesses, helping transform modern digital ecosystems' complexity into powerful business assets.


Our AI\-driven insights cut through the noise, allowing customers to focus on what truly matters by automating manual tasks and resolving issues with pinpoint accuracy. title: Software Specialist
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.


Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.


**Job Role:**

You will be a windchill developer. Their responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing software components, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and ensuring the quality and performance of the platform. They also work on enhancing the user experience, tailoring tasks to specific organizational needs, and providing support to users.
 

Core Responsibilities:


* Software Design and Development: Designing and implementing new features, functionalities, and improvements for the product using Java, J2EE, and web technologies.
* Code Quality and Maintenance: Writing clean, efficient, and well\-documented code that adheres to PTC's coding standards and best practices, ensuring the software is maintainable and scalable.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Developing and executing test plans, identifying and resolving software defects, and ensuring the platform meets the required quality standards.
* Collaboration and Communication: Working closely with product managers, UX designers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of the platform.
* Technical Documentation: Creating and maintaining technical documentation for the software, including design specifications, code documentation, and user guides.
* Performance Optimization: Identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, optimizing the platform for speed and efficiency.
* Staying Up\-to\-Date: Keeping abreast of new technologies, trends, and best practices relevant to PTC and the broader PLM landscape.
* Troubleshooting and Support: Assisting in troubleshooting and resolving customer issues, providing technical support, and collaborating with other PTC teams to address complex problems.
* Automation: Contributing to the automation of software development and deployment processes.

**Your Impact:**

The R\&D team is working on PLM solutions to improve user Experience. Various technologies going to be used for which team is looking for highly motivated individuals with appropriate skills.


**Your Team:**

Candidate will be part of our R\&D team based in Pune.


**Your Day\-to\-Day:**

* Participate and Provide required information in scrum ceremonies.
* Manage major and minor release deliverables by following SDLC standards.
* Technically guides colleagues on design and implementation techniques.
* Analyze the functional requirements specification given by SMEs.
* Design the applications.
* Implement the applications according to approved designs.
* Conduct rigorous testing of the applications.
* Deploy the applications to cloud computing infrastructure.
* Perform technical reviews on the design \& solutions from your colleagues.
* Remain current on PTC technology solutions and develop skills on emerging technologies, as needed.
* Attend daily stand\-up to stay agile, share ideas, give feedback, and stay on track.

**Required Skills:**

* Candidate should be comfortable with Server\-Side as well as Client\-Side technologies.
* Programming Languages: Proficiency in Java, J2EE, and web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
* Web Services: Experience with RESTful APIs and other web service technologies.
* Familiarity with MLOPs/AIOps/LLMOps tools is added advantage.
* Database Knowledge: Familiarity with relational databases like Oracle or MS SQL Server.
* Cloud Technologies: Exposure to cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP is beneficial.
* Agile Development: Experience working in an Agile development environment.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to debug and resolve complex technical issues.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience with PTC Products: Experience with PTC's Windchill PLM system and ThingWorx platform is added advantage.
* Experience with Content Management, Page Layout, and Publishing software is also helpful.
  

  

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.


If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

 You consistently deliver on commitments by following through on plans with accuracy and attention to detail while maintaining a strong focus on measurable outcomes. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

* Own end\-to\-end operational performance across all assigned cities and states
* Coordinate and monitor ground logistics fleet
* Act as control tower — monitor order lifecycle from creation to closure daily
* Track pending/failed pickups, aging orders, escalations, and exceptions; drive timely resolution
* Ensure SLA, TAT, pickup success, and delivery success metrics are consistently met
* Drive continuous process improvements to eliminate recurring failures



**Vendor \& Partner Management** 



* Own relationships with logistics partners, transport vendors, warehouses, and service providers
* Drive performance through structured data\-backed reviews and action plans
* Ensure SLA and contractual compliance; manage escalations with clear ownership and TAT
* Conduct regular business reviews; identify gaps and implement corrective actions



**Data Analytics \& Insights** 



* Analyze operational dashboards to identify trends, root causes, and efficiency gaps
* Build and maintain performance scorecards for regions, cities, and vendors
* Translate data into actionable recommendations to improve cost, speed, and experience



**Technology \& Process Excellence** 



* Leverage platforms for visibility and control; champion adoption of new tools and dashboards
* Collaborate with Product and Tech teams to identify automation opportunities
* Enforce SOP compliance across all operational stakeholders



**Field Operations \& Governance** 



* Conduct regular field visits to partner locations, warehouses, and hubs
* Perform audits; identify operational gaps and implement fixes with accountability
* Ensure adherence to safety, quality, and operational standards



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




**Must\-Haves** 



* 4–8 years in Operations, Quick Commerce, , Hyperlocal, or doorstep services
* Proven experience managing multi\-city or multi\-partner operations
* Hands\-on vendor and logistics partner management — mandatory
* Strong analytical skills; advanced Excel / Google Sheets proficiency
* Comfortable with large datasets, dashboards, and operational KPIs
* High ownership mindset; bias for action over escalation
* Exceptional stakeholder management and negotiation skills



**Strong Plus** 



* Experience in startup or high\-growth environments
* MBA in Operations, Supply Chain, or related field
* Background in central operations or control tower functions



  





**PREFERRED BACKGROUNDS** 




 Candidates from these organizations or domains are strongly preferred:
 



**Quick Commerce** 




 Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Flipkart Minutes
 



**Doorstep Services** 




 Urban Company, Instahelp, Snabbit, Hello Madam,
 



**Hyperlocal Logistics** 




 Porter, Shadowfax, Delhivery, Loadshare, LetsTransport
 



  





**SUCCESS METRICS (KPIs)** 




  





**SLA Adherence %** 




**Pickup Success Rate** 




**Order Closure TAT** 




**Customer Escalation TAT** 




**Vendor Performance Score** 




**Cost per Order** 




**Regional Productivity** 




**Customer Satisfaction** 




**Audit Compliance Score**

title: Lead Data Advisor
description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
   

  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
 SimCorp DMS is a complete data management solution for pricing and reference data, provided as a Managed Service. The SimCorp DMS Advisory and change management service is a team of industry and data management experts who consistently monitor for any industry, regulatory and vendor feed changes that may affect our client’s business operations. The Advisory Service regularly informs clients of these changes, and how best to adapt.
   

  

 As a Senior Data Advisor, you will be responsible to look after the client onboarding, monitoring vendor changes, maintaining the standard data model and orchestrating change management activities for the SimCorp DMS clients by liaising with internal service teams from IT and Operations. You will be directly reporting to the head of Data Advisory team
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Create and maintain data standards (lookups, mappings, conventions, and rules), data models and data ontologies (how are data objects related to each other)
* Maintain meta data information documentation regarding data models, data interpretation, data lineage and utilization along the key processes and make it available to internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor, track and conduct assessment of all vendors related changes that impacts SimCorp DMS and Enterprise Data Manager clients.
* Facilitate Change \& Control Board (CCB) governance with internal service teams to prioritize and deliver the standard and client change requests.
* Design and implement a robust client onboarding framework for a seamless DMS client onboarding
* Serve as the advisor and quality gateway regarding data and change integrations related to data.
* Support design and maintenance of an overall data test concepts and conduct regular data tests to assure data and service quality.
* Support DMS Operations on various process improvement initiatives.
* Advise clients on data needs and data usage for new requirements.
* Build and maintain in\-depth know\-how on industry and regulatory changes within data management.
* This is a client\-centric role that involves regular interaction with our valued customers
* Continuously develop a comprehensive understanding of the latest industry and regulatory trends in the data management space and promote best practices within the SimCorp community to benefit our clients.


**What We Value**
 Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to \- and interested in \- learning the rest.
   

  

* Have a relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent in finance
* Relevant experience in areas of Change Management with data vendor feeds (Bloomberg, IDC, Reuters, etc.)
* Have good knowledge of financial products and markets including derivatives, structured instruments etc.
* Have experience in requirements engineering, data modelling and full SDLC approach.
* Have a structured approach, attention to detail, service mindset, and solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Process management, control and design experience are beneficial skills but not mandatory.
* Have relevant experience in Data Management and Business Analysis
* Possess strong knowledge of various investment/trade lifecycle activities
* Show the ability to collaborate easily with various departments to ensure client success.
* Exhibit clear verbal and written communication to engage and inform various stakeholders


**Benefits**
* Global hybrid work policy \- We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation \- Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
* Self\-Direction \- High degree of self\-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture
* Work\-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes


**NEXT STEPS**
 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

 If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
   

  

 SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.
   

  

 SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

title: Customer Success Manager, Booking for Business
description:
**About Us:**
 At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.
   

  

**Role Title: Customer Success Manager, Booking for Business \-** 
**Gurgaon (Gurugram)**
 At Booking.com for Business, you are the trusted face and voice of our platform for corporate customers around the globe. Whether representing us at business events and trade fairs or engaging directly with clients via phone and web meetings, you will be the key driver in attracting, connecting with, and supporting our business travel users.
   

  

 You’ll bring passion, expertise, and a service\-first mindset to every interaction—helping customers navigate our platform and adopt it in ways that bring real value to their companies. Your goal is to build long\-lasting relationships grounded in trust, loyalty, and mutual success. You are “the representative” of Booking.com for Business for our corporate customers around the globe.
   

  

 On business events as well as via the phone and web meetings, you will contact, attract, connect and inform corporate customers of our product and services. You will share your knowledge, your passion with our customers and teams and guide them in using Booking.com for Business to best fit them and their company’s needs.
   

  

 Your goal is to build up a long term relationship full of trust and loyalty towards Booking.com for Business. Furthermore you will become an expert in the Business Travel industry and continuously enrich your knowledge in this area for and with all stakeholders involved.
   

  

 With excellent communication skills and a strong service minded attitude you are the ideal connector to bring people together experiencing the world through Booking.com for Business.
   

  

 Your key objective will be owning the customer lifecycle by activating and converting high value (potential) small business customers into loyal ambassadors. You will coach, educate and advise them through training, webinars, calls and interactive support materials giving them the confidence to be an expert in using our product themselves and spread the word.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Customer Lifecycle Ownership: Guide new and existing SME customers through the full customer journey—from onboarding and adoption to optimization and advocacy.
* Client Engagement: Regularly engage with customers via virtual meetings, phone calls, webinars, and selective live events to understand their business travel needs and demonstrate how Booking.com for Business can meet those needs.
* Product Education: Deliver tailored training and product walk\-throughs to ensure customers are confident and capable in using our platform independently.
* Relationship Building: Act as the key point of contact and trusted advisor, building relationships grounded in trust, loyalty, and mutual success.
* Advocacy Development: Identify high\-value users and support them in becoming Booking.com for Business ambassadors, promoting organic growth and user adoption.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Support teams to relay customer feedback and drive continuous improvement in our offerings.
* Event Representation: Represent Booking.com for Business at relevant industry trade shows, conferences, and networking events to attract new customers and strengthen existing relationships.


**Key Stakeholders include:**
* Regional Leaders (CEM, ArM, RM and RD)
* HQ
* Product teams
* AE, AMs, KAMs


**Requirements Of Special Knowledge/skills**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or work experience in a related field.
* Experience: 5\+ years of relevant experience in the hospitality or commercial services sector, preferably in a customer\-facing B2B role.
* Customer\-Centric Mindset: Passion for delivering top\-tier service and solving customer problems with empathy and efficiency.
* Communication Skills: Strong communication skills \- in person and over the phone, comfortable hosting webinars, leading training sessions, and representing the brand at events.
* Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of business travel dynamics and the ability to align platform capabilities with customer goals.
* Tech\-Savvy: Comfortable working with digital tools, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), and virtual meeting platforms.
* Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross\-functionally and contribute to a shared vision.


**Benefits \& Perks \- Global Impact, Personal Relevance**
 Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well as unique\-to\-Booking.com benefits which include:
   

  

* Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave
* Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)
* Industry leading product discounts \- up to €1400 per year \- for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit


**Inclusion at Booking.com:**
 Inclusion been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.
   

  

 Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, our people don't just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”
   

  

 We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
   

  

**Application Process:**
* Let’s go places together: How we Hire
* Detailed instructions on post\-application requirements including any required application materials, deadlines, portfolios, coding challenges, or other assessments as defined by BU or department.


 Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive
   

  

**Pre\-Employment Screening**
*If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre\-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre\-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.*

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About Virohan:** 




 Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an
 **education–to\-industry partner** 
 building the workforce powering India’s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry\- aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real\-world employability. At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms.
 **Our model combines academic learning with hands\-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles.** 
 Today, Virohan has trained 13,000\+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
 



 Backed by
 **global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan),** 
 we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare — two of India’s fastest\-growing sectors.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 Signing a university partnership is the easy part. Making it work — filling seats, running the programme well, placing students, keeping the Registrar and the Chancellor’s office confident that the partnership was a good decision — is where the business is actually won or lost. And it all comes due once a year, at renewal.
 



 This role owns that. You are the single point of accountability for a portfolio of partner universities: their success, their satisfaction, and their renewal. You are the bridge between the institution and every internal team at Virohan — admissions, academics, placements, operations, finance — translating in both directions, setting expectations honestly, and making sure what we promised is what actually happens on campus.
 



  





**What you’ll own** 




 •
 **Renewal targets\-** 
 Carry and deliver the end\-of\-year renewal goal for every university in your portfolio. Renewals are the number you are measured on, and you own the plan to get there from day one of the year — not in the last quarter.
 



 •
 **Partner success\-** 
 Define what success looks like for each partner — enrolment, programme delivery, student outcomes, placements — then track it, report it, and drive the internal action that moves it.
 



 •
 **The relationship map\-** 
 Build trusted relationships across each institution: Registrar, Deans, HoDs, admissions teams, and the leadership who ultimately sign the renewal. Never be dependent on a single contact.
 



 •
 **Expectation setting\-** 
 Agree what Virohan will deliver and what the university will deliver, in writing, up front — and hold both sides to it. Most partnership failures are expectation failures.
 



 •
 **Internal advocacy and escalation\-** 
 Represent the partner\&\#39;s reality inside Virohan and get cross\- functional teams to act, without having authority over them. Escalate early, with evidence, and follow through to closure.
 



 •
 **Business reviews\-** 
 Run a disciplined cadence of reviews with each partner — a clear numbers\-led narrative on what is working, what is not, and what happens next. These reviews are what make the renewal conversation a formality.
 



 •
 **Commercial conversations\-** 
 Lead renewal negotiations, pricing and scope discussions, and identify expansion within existing partners — new programmes, new campuses, higher intake.
 



 •
 **Risk detection\-** 
 Spot an at\-risk account two quarters out, not two weeks out. Build the early\-warning signals into how you run the portfolio.
 



  





**What we’re looking for** 




 •
 **3\-6 years of experience in business roles,** 
 with real ownership of a number — retention, renewal, revenue or growth. You have been accountable for an outcome, not just for supporting one.
 



 •
 **Outstanding communication.** 
 You are credible in a Registrar\&\#39;s office and clear in an internal escalation. You can say no, deliver bad news early, and still keep the relationship strong.
 



 •
 **Logical, structured thinking.** 
 You diagnose why an account is underperforming rather than reacting to the loudest complaint, and you can separate a real problem from a symptom.
 



 •
 **Comfort with numbers.** 
 You are fluent in spreadsheets and you run your portfolio off data —
 



 enrollment funnels, placement rates, revenue per partner, renewal probability. You build your own view rather than waiting for a report.
 



 •
 **Strong AI leverage.** 
 You already use Claude and similar AI tools to prepare for reviews, analyse partner data, draft proposals and cut your admin time. We want someone who compounds their own output.
 



 •
 **Clear writing.** 
 Review decks, partner emails, MoU scopes and internal escalations that are
 



 unambiguous and get acted on.
 



 •
 **Ownership and follow\-through.** 
 You close loops without being chased. When something falls between two teams, you pick it up.
 



 •
 **Willingness to travel.** 
 You will be on partner campuses regularly. The relationship is not built over email.
 



  





**This role is probably not for you if** 




 • You see account management as relationship maintenance rather than a number you carry.
 



 • You are uncomfortable pushing internal teams, or you avoid difficult conversations with a partner until they escalate.
 



 • You would rather report on the portfolio than be accountable for it.
 



  





**What you get** 




 •
 **A clear number and real ownership** 
 — your portfolio, your renewal target, your call on how to get there.
 



 •
 **Senior exposure** 
 , internally with Virohan’s leadership and externally with university leadership, from your first month.
 



 •
 **Work that matters** 
 — every partnership that renews is another few hundred students with a route to a real healthcare job.
 



  





**If you believe in making an impact on society and are keen to be a part of the fast growing healthcare education sector, we would be delighted to hear from you!**

title: Brand Category Manager
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
   

  

 We're building one of India's most interesting marketing teams in the mobility space, and we need someone who can own a portfolio of channels the way a brand manager owns a category: with commercial instinct, cross\-functional pull, and a genuine drive to grow.
   

  

 This isn't a coordination role \-you will own Brand partnerships, offline distribution, and OTA set strategy, run execution, and be accountable for outcomes. You'll work directly with the India Leadership and also operate as a key node between local teams and global stakeholders.
   

  

 If you've grown up in FMCG or a fast\-scaling startup and know what it means to own a channel from the ground up, this is the job.
   

  

**About The Role**
* You think about the Flix brand in India with both a short and long term lens. Contributing to how the brand shows up across your channels today while helping shape the positioning and perception we want to build over the next 3 to 5 years
* Build and manage Flix's B2B and brand partnership pipeline in India. Identifying prospects, closing deals, onboarding partners, and tracking commercial contribution to load
* Be the external face of Flix on OTA platforms, owning platform relationships, content quality, listing health, and commercial terms across all major OTA partners in India
* Manage the offline sales network. Travel agencies, ticket shops, and kiosks — from acquisition through to partner enablement, training, and performance management
* You collaborate across marketing, performance, CRM, and product to prevent channel strategies from running in silos and to unlock shared growth levers
* Identify and pursue new distribution and partnership opportunities in the Indian market, bringing commercial rigour to everything from a first pitch to a signed deal
* You liaise with HQ and global teams to keep local channel strategies aligned with Flix's broader commercial and brand direction
* You act as the primary external point of contact for partners across B2B, offline, and OTA, representing Flix with authority


**About You**
* 3 to 5 years in brand management, category management, or channel marketing, ideally in D2C, or a high\-growth startup
* You've owned marketing spends or a channel target before, not just reported into one.
* Comfortable managing a wide portfolio without losing depth on what matters most.
* Strong negotiator and relationship builder. You can hold a room with a internal teams, external partner and on ground sales agents in the same day.
* Sharp with numbers, fast with decisions, and honest about what's working


 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning \& Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


 To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations \- Flix Career
   

  

**Why Join Flix?**
 At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
   

  

 As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
   

  

 If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Operations Director
description:
**Overview**
**170\+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.** 
 At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world\-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
   

  

 Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our team of industry subject matter experts.
   

  

 The Operations Director – Pinkerton India leads end\-to\-end service delivery across Pinkerton’s EPIC portfolio (Embed, Protect, Investigate, Consult) to ensure outstanding client outcomes, rigorous accountability, and optimal cost\-to\-value. This role orchestrates multi\-service operations, vendor/partner networks, and internal teams to deliver on\-time, in\-scope, and within\-budget results. The Director drives a culture of ownership, safety, integrity, vigilance, and excellence while scaling processes, enhancing quality, and meeting or exceeding contractual SLAs and KPIs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Serve as the senior operations point of contact for client accounts in India, aligning scope, priorities, and SLAs with Pinkerton’s EPIC model.
* Coordinate services and operational/administrative support needs; oversee dispatch, scheduling, and reporting across assignments and programs.
* Answer and triage escalations from clients, Directors, and Operations Coordinators, ensure swift, transparent communication and resolution.
* Communicate assignment/project expectations, timelines, risks, and success criteria to all parties; maintain impeccable documentation.
* Design, standardize, and enforce SOPs, operational playbooks for consistent delivery across regions and service lines.
* Manage workflows end\-to\-end; assign agents and specialist resources to specific assignments based on capability, compliance, and cost.
* Track program milestones and deadlines; monitor the status of assigned projects and initiate course\-corrections proactively.
* Utilize scorecards to measure activities and outcomes (e.g., Deployable Assets programs), driving continuous improvement.
* Track results and issue reports on completed work, non\-conformities, corrective and improvement plans; own CAPA closure.
* Ensure deadlines are met for scheduling, dispatching, audits, and post checks; verify outcomes (vendor hour approvals, virtual/onsite post checking).
* Send and manage external partner self\-assessments and security questionnaires using approved web\-based tools; drive timely completion and remediation.
* Lead root\-cause analyses, implement preventive actions, and institutionalize lessons learned across teams and vendors.
* Build and govern a high\-performing vendor ecosystem (including Global Alliance Members where applicable) with clear rate cards, SLAs, and compliance obligations.
* Negotiate, onboard, and performance\-manage vendors; conduct QBRs, enforce service credits, and manage escalations to protect client outcomes and margin.
* Optimize vendor utilization, travel/logistics, and deployment patterns to balance speed, quality, risk, and cost.
* Own operational budgeting, forecasting, and margin protection; drive cost\-per\-outcome efficiency without compromising quality or safety.
* Implement demand planning, capacity models, and pricing/quoting discipline; monitor variance and initiate corrective actions.
* Improve invoice accuracy, WIP hygiene, and cycle times; partner with Finance on revenue recognition and profitability.
* Ensure compliance with PSARA, Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act, Shops \& Establishments, PoSH, client codes of conduct, and data privacy/information security requirements.
* Maintain audit readiness; coordinate internal/external audits and remediation plans.
* Champion agent safety through virtual and on\-site post checks, journey management, and incident reporting protocols.
* Hire, coach, and develop a high\-performing operations team; set clear goals and hold teams and vendors accountable.
* Foster a culture of integrity, vigilance, excellence, transparency, and client\-obsession; recognize strong performance and address underperformance promptly.
* Drive change management and cross\-functional collaboration with Sales, Finance, Legal, HR, and Regional Ops.
* All other duties, as assigned.


**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred. 12–15 years of progressive experience in corporate security/operations or adjacent services, including multi\-vendor orchestration and client service delivery. Experience with escalation/crisis management, incident response coordination, and audit/quality systems. Certifications preferred: CPP, PSP, PMP, Lean Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt) or equivalent.
   

  

* Accountability and ownership mindset; data\-driven decisioning; strong financial acumen.
* Vendor negotiation, rate\-card governance, and performance management.
* Program/Project management, capacity planning, and resource optimization.
* Risk assessment, SOP design, and continuous improvement (Kaizen/CAPA/RCA).
* High integrity, vigilance, and excellence aligned to Pinkerton values.
* Fluency in English and Hindi; additional Indian languages an advantage.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence at executive level.
* Proven leadership of national programs with measurable SLA/KPI achievement and cost optimization.
* Strong knowledge of India regulatory environment (PSARA, CLRA, Shops \& Establishments, PoSH) and client compliance expectations.
* Proficiency with scheduling/dispatch platforms, CRM/ITSM tools (e.g., Salesforce/ServiceNow), and collaboration suites.
* Advanced Excel; reporting/BI (Power BI/Tableau) for scorecards and operational insights.
* Web\-based tools for self\-assessments/security questionnaires; audit and document control systems.


**Working Conditions**
 With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;
   

  

* Regular computer usage.
* Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
* Frequent sitting, standing, and/or walking.
* Travel, as required.


 Pinkerton is an equal opportunity employer to all applicants and positions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital/prenatal status, pregnancy/childbirth or related conditions, religion, creed, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any protected status by local, state, federal or country\-specific law.
